namespace TQGA.Application.Reporting;

public sealed record ReportRunContext
{
    public required DateTime RunUtc { get; init; }
    public required DateTime RunPkt { get; init; }

    public DateTime? BacktestStartUtc { get; init; }
    public DateTime? BacktestStartPkt { get; init; }

    public DateTime? BacktestEndUtc { get; init; }
    public DateTime? BacktestEndPkt { get; init; }

    public string StrategyId { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public string StrategyName { get; init; } = string.Empty;

    public int SelectedStrategiesCount { get; init; }
    public int SelectedMarketsCount { get; init; }
    public int SelectedSymbolsCount { get; init; }
    public int SelectedTimeframesCount { get; init; }

    public string RunMode { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public string SourceFileName { get; init; } = string.Empty;

    public static ReportRunContext Create(
        DateTime runUtc,
        DateTime? backtestStartUtc = null,
        DateTime? backtestEndUtc = null,
        string strategyId = "",
        string strategyName = "",
        int selectedStrategiesCount = 0,
        int selectedMarketsCount = 0,
        int selectedSymbolsCount = 0,
        int selectedTimeframesCount = 0,
        string runMode = "",
        string sourceFileName = "")
    {
        return new ReportRunContext
        {
            RunUtc = EnsureUtc(runUtc),
            RunPkt = ToPakistan(runUtc),
            BacktestStartUtc = backtestStartUtc.HasValue ? EnsureUtc(backtestStartUtc.Value) : null,
            BacktestStartPkt = backtestStartUtc.HasValue ? ToPakistan(backtestStartUtc.Value) : null,
            BacktestEndUtc = backtestEndUtc.HasValue ? EnsureUtc(backtestEndUtc.Value) : null,
            BacktestEndPkt = backtestEndUtc.HasValue ? ToPakistan(backtestEndUtc.Value) : null,
            StrategyId = strategyId ?? string.Empty,
            StrategyName = strategyName ?? string.Empty,
            SelectedStrategiesCount = selectedStrategiesCount,
            SelectedMarketsCount = selectedMarketsCount,
            SelectedSymbolsCount = selectedSymbolsCount,
            SelectedTimeframesCount = selectedTimeframesCount,
            RunMode = runMode ?? string.Empty,
            SourceFileName = sourceFileName ?? string.Empty
        };
    }

    private static DateTime EnsureUtc(DateTime value)
    {
        return value.Kind == DateTimeKind.Utc
            ? value
            : DateTime.SpecifyKind(value, DateTimeKind.Utc);
    }

    private static DateTime ToPakistan(DateTime utc)
    {
        DateTime safeUtc = EnsureUtc(utc);

        try
        {
            TimeZoneInfo tz = TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById("Pakistan Standard Time");
            return TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeFromUtc(safeUtc, tz);
        }
        catch
        {
            return safeUtc.AddHours(5);
        }
    }

using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Domain.Trading;

namespace TQGA.Application.Reporting;

public sealed class TestnetStrategyShadowReportService
{
    public string WriteShadowReport(TestnetStrategyShadowResult result)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(result);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);
        string safeSymbol = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(result.Symbol) ? "UNKNOWN" : result.Symbol.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
        string path = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, $"BINANCE_TESTNET_SHADOW_SIGNAL_{safeSymbol}_{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.txt");
        result.ReportPath = path;
        File.WriteAllText(path, BuildReport(result));
        return path;
    }

    public string BuildReport(TestnetStrategyShadowResult result)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("TQGA V8.10.2 STRATEGY SIGNAL SHADOW MODE");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Result                : {(result.Success ? "PASS" : "CHECK")}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Message               : {result.Message}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated UTC         : {result.GeneratedUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Symbol                : {result.Symbol}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Intended Side         : {result.IntendedSide}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Shadow Mode           : {result.ShadowMode}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Path           : {result.ReportPath}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("HYPOTHETICAL ORDER PLAN - NO ORDER SENT");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Trade Size USDT       : {result.TradeSizeUsdt:F4}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Max Size USDT         : {result.MaxTradeSizeUsdt:F4}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Leverage              : {result.Leverage}x");
        sb.AppendLine($"Mark Price            : {result.MarkPrice:F8}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Raw Quantity          : {result.RawQuantity:F12}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Valid Quantity        : {result.ValidQuantity:F12}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Notional USDT         : {result.NotionalUsdt:F4}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Required Margin       : {result.RequiredMarginUsdt:F4}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Available USDT        : {result.AvailableUsdt:F4}");
        sb.AppendLine($"SL % / Price          : {result.StopLossPercent:F2}% / {result.StopLossPrice:F8}");
        sb.AppendLine($"TP % / Price          : {result.TakeProfitPercent:F2}% / {result.TakeProfitPrice:F8}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("ACCOUNT-WIDE SAFETY STATE");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Open Positions        : {result.AccountOpenPositionCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Normal Open Orders    : {result.AccountNormalOpenOrderCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Algo TP/SL Orders     : {result.AccountAlgoOpenOrderCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Account Flat / Clean  : {result.AccountFlatClean}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("SHADOW DECISION");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Would Place Entry     : {result.WouldPlaceEntry}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Would Place SL        : {result.WouldPlaceStopLoss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Would Place TP        : {result.WouldPlaceTakeProfit}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Live Trading Blocked  : {result.LiveTradingBlocked}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Auto Strategy Trading : {(result.AutoStrategyTradingUsed ? "USED" : "NOT USED")}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        if (result.AccountOpenPositions.Count > 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("OPEN POSITIONS DETAIL");
            sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
            foreach (LivePosition p in result.AccountOpenPositions)
                sb.AppendLine($"{p.Symbol,-12} Amt={p.PositionAmount:F8} Entry={p.EntryPrice:F8} Mark={p.MarkPrice:F8} UPnL={p.UnrealizedProfit:F4} Lev={(p.Leverage > 0 ? p.Leverage.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "?")}x");
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        if (result.Warnings.Count > 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("WARNINGS / BLOCK REASONS");
            sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
            foreach (string warning in result.Warnings)
                sb.AppendLine("- " + warning);
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        sb.AppendLine("IMPORTANT");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("This is shadow mode only. It does not place orders.");
        sb.AppendLine("It validates whether the selected symbol/side/settings would be eligible for the next testnet auto-trade stage.");
        sb.AppendLine("SR strategy signal wiring will be attached after this safety shadow mode is stable.");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        return sb.ToString();
    }
}

using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Domain.Trading;

namespace TQGA.Application.Reporting;

public sealed class TestnetTradeCycleJournalReportService
{
    public string WriteJournal(TestnetTradeCycleJournalResult result)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(result);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        string safeSymbol = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(result.Symbol) ? "UNKNOWN" : result.Symbol.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
        string stamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string txtPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, $"BINANCE_TESTNET_TRADE_CYCLE_{safeSymbol}_{stamp}.txt");
        string csvPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, "BINANCE_TESTNET_TRADE_JOURNAL.csv");

        result.ReportPath = txtPath;
        result.CsvPath = csvPath;

        File.WriteAllText(txtPath, BuildReport(result));
        AppendCsv(csvPath, result);
        return txtPath;
    }

    public string BuildReport(TestnetTradeCycleJournalResult result)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("TQGA V8.10.1 BINANCE TESTNET TRADE JOURNAL BY CYCLE ID");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Result                : {(result.Success ? "PASS" : "CHECK")}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Message               : {result.Message}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated UTC         : {result.GeneratedUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Symbol                : {result.Symbol}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Trade Cycle ID        : {result.TradeCycleId}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Cycle Status          : {result.CycleStatus}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Close Reason          : {result.CloseReason}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Path           : {result.ReportPath}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Journal CSV           : {result.CsvPath}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("CURRENT POSITION / PROTECTION STATE");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Position Open         : {result.PositionOpen}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Position Amount       : {result.PositionAmount:F8}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Mark Price            : {result.MarkPrice:F8}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Unrealized PnL USDT   : {result.UnrealizedPnlUsdt:F4}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Has Stop Loss         : {result.HasStopLoss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Stop Loss Price       : {result.StopLossPrice:F8}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Has Take Profit       : {result.HasTakeProfit}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Take Profit Price     : {result.TakeProfitPrice:F8}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("ENTRY SUMMARY");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Entry Order ID        : {result.EntryOrderId}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Entry Side            : {result.EntrySide}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Entry Time UTC        : {FormatTime(result.EntryTimeUtc)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Entry Fill Count      : {result.EntryFillCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Entry Quantity        : {result.EntryQuantity:F8}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Entry Avg Price       : {result.EntryAveragePrice:F8}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Entry Gross Notional  : {result.EntryGrossNotionalUsdt:F4}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Entry Commission      : {result.EntryCommission:F8} {result.EntryCommissionAsset}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("EXIT SUMMARY");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Exit Order ID         : {result.ExitOrderId}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Exit Side             : {result.ExitSide}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Exit Time UTC         : {FormatTime(result.ExitTimeUtc)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Exit Fill Count       : {result.ExitFillCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Exit Quantity         : {result.ExitQuantity:F8}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Exit Avg Price        : {result.ExitAveragePrice:F8}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Exit Gross Notional   : {result.ExitGrossNotionalUsdt:F4}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Exit Commission       : {result.ExitCommission:F8} {result.ExitCommissionAsset}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("PNL SUMMARY");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Realized PnL USDT     : {result.RealizedPnlUsdt:F4}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Total Commission      : {result.TotalCommission:F8}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Net PnL After Comm.   : {result.NetPnlAfterCommissionUsdt:F4}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        WriteFills(sb, "ENTRY FILLS", result.EntryFills);
        WriteFills(sb, "EXIT FILLS", result.ExitFills);

        if (result.Warnings.Count > 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("WARNINGS / NOTES");
            sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
            foreach (string warning in result.Warnings)
                sb.AppendLine("- " + warning);
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        sb.AppendLine("SAFETY STATE");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("Environment           : Binance Futures Testnet only");
        sb.AppendLine("Live trading          : BLOCKED / NOT IMPLEMENTED");
        sb.AppendLine("Auto strategy trading : NOT USED");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static void WriteFills(StringBuilder sb, string title, IReadOnlyList<LiveTradeFill> fills)
    {
        sb.AppendLine(title);
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        if (fills.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("No fills assigned to this side of the current cycle.");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (LiveTradeFill f in fills.OrderBy(x => x.TimeUtc).ThenBy(x => x.Id))
                sb.AppendLine($"{f.TimeUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} Id={f.Id} Order={f.OrderId} {f.Side} Qty={f.Quantity:F8} Price={f.Price:F8} Realized={f.RealizedPnl:F4} Commission={f.Commission:F8} {f.CommissionAsset}");
        }
        sb.AppendLine();
    }

    private static void AppendCsv(string csvPath, TestnetTradeCycleJournalResult r)
    {
        bool exists = File.Exists(csvPath);
        using var writer = new StreamWriter(csvPath, append: true, Encoding.UTF8);
        if (!exists)
        {
            writer.WriteLine("GeneratedUtc,TradeCycleId,Symbol,Success,Message,CycleStatus,CloseReason,PositionOpen,EntryOrderId,EntrySide,EntryTimeUtc,EntryQty,EntryAvgPrice,EntryCommission,ExitOrderId,ExitSide,ExitTimeUtc,ExitQty,ExitAvgPrice,ExitCommission,RealizedPnlUsdt,TotalCommission,NetPnlAfterCommissionUsdt,HasSL,SLPrice,HasTP,TPPrice,ReportPath");
        }

        writer.WriteLine(string.Join(',', new[]
        {
            Csv(r.GeneratedUtc.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
            Csv(r.TradeCycleId),
            Csv(r.Symbol),
            Csv(r.Success.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
            Csv(r.Message),
            Csv(r.CycleStatus),
            Csv(r.CloseReason),
            Csv(r.PositionOpen.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
            r.EntryOrderId.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            Csv(r.EntrySide),
            Csv(FormatTime(r.EntryTimeUtc)),
            F(r.EntryQuantity),
            F(r.EntryAveragePrice),
            F(r.EntryCommission),
            r.ExitOrderId.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            Csv(r.ExitSide),
            Csv(FormatTime(r.ExitTimeUtc)),
            F(r.ExitQuantity),
            F(r.ExitAveragePrice),
            F(r.ExitCommission),
            F(r.RealizedPnlUsdt),
            F(r.TotalCommission),
            F(r.NetPnlAfterCommissionUsdt),
            Csv(r.HasStopLoss.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
            F(r.StopLossPrice),
            Csv(r.HasTakeProfit.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
            F(r.TakeProfitPrice),
            Csv(r.ReportPath)
        }));
    }

    private static string FormatTime(DateTime? value) => value.HasValue ? value.Value.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : string.Empty;
    private static string F(decimal value) => value.ToString("0.########", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    private static string Csv(string value)
    {
        value ??= string.Empty;
        if (value.Contains(',') || value.Contains('"') || value.Contains('\n') || value.Contains('\r'))
            return "\"" + value.Replace("\"", "\"\"") + "\"";
        return value;
    }
}

using TQGA.Domain.Trading;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
namespace TQGA.Application.Reporting;

public static class TradeCsvExporter
{
    public static void Export(
        IEnumerable<Trade> trades,
        string fileName)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        var path = Path.Combine(
            DataPaths.Reports, fileName);

        using var writer = new StreamWriter(path);

        writer.WriteLine(
            "Symbol,Side,Quantity,EntryTime,EntryPrice,ExitTime,ExitPrice,PnL");

        foreach (var t in trades)
        {
            writer.WriteLine(
                $"{t.Symbol},{t.Side},{t.Quantity},{t.EntryTime},{t.EntryPrice},{t.ExitTime},{t.ExitPrice},{t.RealizedPnL}");
        }
    }
}

using TQGA.Domain.Trading;

namespace TQGA.Application.Reporting;

public sealed class TradeExpectancyAnalyzer
{
    public decimal Expectancy { get; }
    public decimal AvgWin { get; }
    public decimal AvgLoss { get; }
    public decimal ProfitFactor { get; }
    public decimal WinRate { get; }
    public int TotalTrades { get; }

    public TradeExpectancyAnalyzer(IReadOnlyList<Trade> trades)
    {
        var closed = trades.Where(t => t.IsClosed).ToList();

        TotalTrades = closed.Count;

        if (TotalTrades == 0)
            return;

        var wins = closed.Where(t => t.RealizedPnL > 0).ToList();
        var losses = closed.Where(t => t.RealizedPnL < 0).ToList();

        AvgWin = wins.Any() ? wins.Average(t => t.RealizedPnL) : 0;
        AvgLoss = losses.Any() ? losses.Average(t => t.RealizedPnL) : 0;

        WinRate = (decimal)wins.Count / TotalTrades;

        var grossWin = wins.Sum(t => t.RealizedPnL);
        var grossLoss = losses.Sum(t => Math.Abs(t.RealizedPnL));

        ProfitFactor = grossLoss == 0 ? 0 : grossWin / grossLoss;

        Expectancy =
            (WinRate * AvgWin) -
            ((1 - WinRate) * Math.Abs(AvgLoss));
    }

    public override string ToString()
    {
        return
            "\n====== EXPECTANCY REPORT ======\n" +
            $"Total Trades  : {TotalTrades}\n" +
            $"Win Rate      : {WinRate:P2}\n" +
            $"Avg Win       : {AvgWin:F2}\n" +
            $"Avg Loss      : {AvgLoss:F2}\n" +
            $"Profit Factor : {ProfitFactor:F2}\n" +
            $"Expectancy    : {Expectancy:F2}\n" +
            "===============================\n";
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Backtesting;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Application.Reporting;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

/// <summary>
/// Alpha decay monitoring using portfolio equity timeline only.
/// PATCH 10A:
/// Remove A84 ID collisions.
/// - CIO Rating exclusively owns A84_03 via A84_03_CIO_RATING
/// - Growth Projection exclusively owns A84_04 via A84_04_GROWTH_PROJECTION
/// Therefore this service now writes unique non-colliding IDs:
/// - A84_07_ALPHA_DECAY_PORTFOLIO
/// - A84_08_ALPHA_DECAY_ALERTS
/// </summary>
public sealed class A84AlphaDecayMonitoringReportService
{
    public void Generate(PortfolioBacktestResult result)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        var equity = result?.PortfolioEquityTimeline;
        if (equity == null || equity.Count < 20)
        {
            Write(
                ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("ALPHA_DECAY_PORTFOLIO", "010"),
                "REPORT 010 — ALPHA DECAY (PORTFOLIO)",
                "NO DATA: PortfolioEquityTimeline is missing or too small.");

            Write(
                ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("ALPHA_DECAY_ALERTS", "011"),
                "REPORT 011 — ALPHA DECAY (ALERTS)",
                "NO DATA: PortfolioEquityTimeline is missing or too small.");

            return;
        }

        var pts = equity
            .OrderBy(x => x.Key)
            .Select(x => (t: x.Key, v: x.Value))
            .ToList();

        var half = pts.Count / 2;
        var early = pts.Take(half).ToList();
        var late = pts.Skip(half).ToList();

        var earlyRet = SegmentReturn(early);
        var lateRet = SegmentReturn(late);

        var decayScan = RollingDecayScan(
            pts,
            window: Math.Max(20, pts.Count / 10));

        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 010 — ALPHA DECAY (PORTFOLIO)");
        sb.AppendLine("================================");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine($"Total Points          : {pts.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Early Half Return     : {earlyRet:P2}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Late Half Return      : {lateRet:P2}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Decay Delta           : {(lateRet - earlyRet):P2}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        if (lateRet < earlyRet)
            sb.AppendLine("Assessment            : Alpha decay detected (late period weaker than early period).");
        else
            sb.AppendLine("Assessment            : No alpha decay detected by half-split comparison.");

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("ROLLING WINDOW DECAY SCAN");
        sb.AppendLine("-------------------------");

        if (decayScan.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("No rolling scan windows were available.");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (var row in decayScan.TakeLast(20))
            {
                sb.AppendLine(
                    $"{row.EndUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} UTC | " +
                    $"Window Return: {row.WindowReturn:P2} | " +
                    $"Peak-to-Trough DD: {row.MaxDrawdown:P2}");
            }
        }

        Write(ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("ALPHA_DECAY_PORTFOLIO", "010"), sb);

        var alerts = new StringBuilder();
        alerts.AppendLine("REPORT 011 — ALPHA DECAY (ALERTS)");
        alerts.AppendLine("=============================");
        alerts.AppendLine();

        bool decayDetected = lateRet < earlyRet;
        bool severeDecay = (earlyRet - lateRet) >= 0.10m;
        bool rollingWeakness = decayScan.Count > 0 &&
                               decayScan.Count(x => x.WindowReturn < 0m) >= Math.Max(3, decayScan.Count / 3);

        alerts.AppendLine($"Decay Detected        : {(decayDetected ? "YES" : "NO")}");
        alerts.AppendLine($"Severe Decay          : {(severeDecay ? "YES" : "NO")}");
        alerts.AppendLine($"Rolling Weakness      : {(rollingWeakness ? "YES" : "NO")}");
        alerts.AppendLine();

        alerts.AppendLine("ALERT SUMMARY");
        alerts.AppendLine("-------------");

        if (!decayDetected && !rollingWeakness)
        {
            alerts.AppendLine("No major alpha decay alerts triggered.");
        }
        else
        {
            if (decayDetected)
                alerts.AppendLine("- Late-half performance is weaker than early-half performance.");

            if (severeDecay)
                alerts.AppendLine("- Decay magnitude is severe by half-split comparison.");

            if (rollingWeakness)
                alerts.AppendLine("- Rolling window scan shows repeated recent weakness.");
        }

        alerts.AppendLine();
        alerts.AppendLine("OPERATIONAL GUIDANCE");
        alerts.AppendLine("--------------------");

        if (severeDecay || rollingWeakness)
        {
            alerts.AppendLine("- Review strategy ranking and top-N execution policy.");
            alerts.AppendLine("- Check whether edge concentration is too narrow.");
            alerts.AppendLine("- Investigate whether recent market regime differs from training period.");
            alerts.AppendLine("- Tighten gating for weak strategies if decay persists.");
        }
        else if (decayDetected)
        {
            alerts.AppendLine("- Monitor next run closely for continued deterioration.");
            alerts.AppendLine("- Compare top symbols/timeframes between early and late segments.");
        }
        else
        {
            alerts.AppendLine("- Continue monitoring; no immediate alpha-decay intervention required.");
        }

        Write(ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("ALPHA_DECAY_ALERTS", "011"), alerts);
    }

    private static decimal SegmentReturn(List<(DateTime t, decimal v)> pts)
    {
        if (pts == null || pts.Count < 2)
            return 0m;

        var start = pts.First().v;
        var end = pts.Last().v;

        if (start <= 0m)
            return 0m;

        return (end / start) - 1m;
    }

    private static List<DecayWindowRow> RollingDecayScan(
        List<(DateTime t, decimal v)> pts,
        int window)
    {
        var output = new List<DecayWindowRow>();

        if (pts == null || pts.Count < 2 || window < 2 || pts.Count < window)
            return output;

        for (int i = window - 1; i < pts.Count; i++)
        {
            var slice = pts.Skip(i - window + 1).Take(window).ToList();
            var start = slice.First().v;
            var end = slice.Last().v;

            decimal ret = 0m;
            if (start > 0m)
                ret = (end / start) - 1m;

            decimal peak = decimal.MinValue;
            decimal maxDd = 0m;

            foreach (var p in slice)
            {
                if (p.v > peak)
                    peak = p.v;

                if (peak > 0m)
                {
                    var dd = (p.v / peak) - 1m;
                    if (dd < maxDd)
                        maxDd = dd;
                }
            }

            output.Add(new DecayWindowRow
            {
                EndUtc = slice.Last().t,
                WindowReturn = ret,
                MaxDrawdown = maxDd
            });
        }

        return output;
    }

    private static void Write(ReportDefinition definition, string title, string body)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine(title);
        sb.AppendLine(new string('=', title.Length));
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine(body);

        Write(definition, sb);
    }

    private static void Write(ReportDefinition definition, StringBuilder sb)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        var naming = new ReportFileNamingService();
        string fileName = naming.BuildLocalFileName(definition, DateTime.UtcNow, ".txt");

        File.WriteAllText(
            Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, fileName),
            sb.ToString());
    }

    private sealed class DecayWindowRow
    {
        public DateTime EndUtc { get; init; }
        public decimal WindowReturn { get; init; }
        public decimal MaxDrawdown { get; init; }
    }
}

using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Backtesting;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Application.Reporting;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

/// <summary>
/// Produces a compact (ChatGPT-paste-friendly) summary of the key system outputs.
/// Target size: ~3–4 KB, with 5–10 lines per major section.
/// </summary>
public sealed class A84ChatGptUploadReportService
{
    public void GenerateAndWrite(
        PortfolioBacktestResult result,
        DateTime runUtc,
        IReadOnlyList<Type> selectedStrategies,
        Dictionary<int, StrategyFitnessSnapshot>? fitness,
        HashSet<int>? allowedStrategyIds,
        Dictionary<string, decimal>? cioWeightsPostGating)
    {
        if (result == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(result));
        if (selectedStrategies == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(selectedStrategies));

        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        fitness ??= new Dictionary<int, StrategyFitnessSnapshot>();
        allowedStrategyIds ??= new HashSet<int>();
        cioWeightsPostGating ??= new Dictionary<string, decimal>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        var sb = new StringBuilder(capacity: 5000);

        var reportDefinition = ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("CHATGPT_UPLOAD", "009");
        var naming = new ReportFileNamingService();
        string fileName = naming.BuildLocalFileName(reportDefinition, runUtc, ".txt");
        var outFile = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, fileName);

        // ---------- Header ----------
        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 009 — CHATGPT UPLOAD (COMPACT)");
        sb.AppendLine("================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Run Timestamp (UTC) : {runUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        // ---------- Architecture state ----------
        sb.AppendLine("TQGA — ARCHITECTURE STATE (Institutional Mode)");
        sb.AppendLine("---------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("• Market grid: Top20 symbols × 3 TF (1h, 4h, 1d) => 60 markets.");
        sb.AppendLine("• Backtest: Strategy × Market grid; captures StrategyPnL, SymbolPnL, Symbol×TF PnL, Strategy×Symbol×TF PnL.");
        sb.AppendLine("• CIO: ranks markets by PnL score (per Symbol×TF) then allocates with caps (per-market + per-symbol).");
        sb.AppendLine("• Fitness gating: kills dead strategies (0 trades / low PnL / fitness<=0) before CIO recompute.");
        sb.AppendLine();

        // ---------- Run scope ----------
        sb.AppendLine("RUN SCOPE");
        sb.AppendLine("---------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Strategies Selected : {selectedStrategies.Count}");
        for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(10, selectedStrategies.Count); i++)
            sb.AppendLine($"  S{i + 1:00}  {selectedStrategies[i].Name}");
        if (selectedStrategies.Count > 10) sb.AppendLine("  ...");
        sb.AppendLine();

        // ---------- Portfolio snapshot ----------
        sb.AppendLine("PORTFOLIO SNAPSHOT");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------");
        var startEq = 100000m;
        var endEq = TryGetEndEquity(result, startEq);
        var retPct = startEq <= 0 ? 0m : ((endEq - startEq) / startEq) * 100m;

        sb.AppendLine($"Start Equity : {startEq:0.00}");
        sb.AppendLine($"End Equity   : {endEq:0.00}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Total Return : {retPct:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Equity Points: {result.PortfolioEquityTimeline?.Count ?? 0}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        // ---------- Top strategies ----------
        sb.AppendLine("TOP STRATEGIES (PnL)");
        sb.AppendLine("--------------------");
        foreach (var x in (result.StrategyPnL ?? new Dictionary<int, decimal>())
                     .OrderByDescending(k => k.Value)
                     .Take(6))
        {
            sb.AppendLine($"S{x.Key:00}  PnL {x.Value:0.00}");
        }
        sb.AppendLine();

        // ---------- Fitness / gating ----------
        sb.AppendLine("FITNESS GATING (summary)");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------");
        if (fitness.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("No fitness snapshot available.");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (var row in fitness.Values
                         .OrderByDescending(r => r.FitnessScore)
                         .Take(6))
            {
                sb.AppendLine($"{row.StrategyCode} | PnL {row.PnL:0.00} | Trades {row.Trades} | Fit {row.FitnessScore:0.000} | Allowed {row.Allowed} | {row.GateReason}");
            }

            sb.AppendLine($"Allowed Strategies: {(allowedStrategyIds.Count == 0 ? "NONE" : string.Join(",", allowedStrategyIds.OrderBy(x => x).Select(x => $"S{x:00}")))}");
        }
        sb.AppendLine();

        // ---------- Top markets ----------
        sb.AppendLine("TOP MARKETS (Symbol×TF PnL)");
        sb.AppendLine("---------------------------");
        foreach (var kv in (result.SymbolTimeframePnL ?? new Dictionary<string, decimal>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                     .OrderByDescending(x => x.Value)
                     .Take(10))
        {
            sb.AppendLine($"{kv.Key}  PnL {kv.Value:0.00}");
        }
        sb.AppendLine();

        // ---------- CIO allocation post-gating ----------
        sb.AppendLine("CIO ALLOCATION (POST-GATING, Top 10)");
        sb.AppendLine("-----------------------------------");
        if (cioWeightsPostGating.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("No CIO post-gating weights available.");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (var kv in cioWeightsPostGating
                         .OrderByDescending(x => x.Value)
                         .Take(10))
            {
                sb.AppendLine($"{kv.Key}  W {(kv.Value * 100m):0.00}%");
            }
        }
        sb.AppendLine();

        // ---------- Walk-forward + realism checklist ----------
        sb.AppendLine("REALISM / SURVIVAL CHECKLIST (minimum)");
        sb.AppendLine("--------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("• Walk-forward: split history into sequential windows; tune on train, validate on next window only.");
        sb.AppendLine("• Friction: add fees + slippage + spread; stress with 2× and 4× friction multipliers.");
        sb.AppendLine("• Regime robustness: require stable performance across multiple regime buckets (trend/range/volatile).");
        sb.AppendLine("• Risk limits: max exposure per symbol, max drawdown stop, and kill-switch for degraded fitness.");
        sb.AppendLine("• No-leakage: indicators must use only past candles; avoid using final equity to pick parameters.");
        sb.AppendLine();

        // ---------- What to upload ----------
        sb.AppendLine("WHAT TO UPLOAD TO CHATGPT");
        sb.AppendLine("-------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("1) This file (A84_06_CHATGPT_UPLOAD)");
        sb.AppendLine("2) A84_00 Executive Summary");
        sb.AppendLine("3) A84_05 Strategy Fitness + CIO Gating");
        sb.AppendLine("4) REPORT_11 Symbol×TF PnL and REPORT_12 CIO weights");
        sb.AppendLine();

        File.WriteAllText(outFile, sb.ToString(), Encoding.UTF8);
    }

    private static decimal TryGetEndEquity(PortfolioBacktestResult result, decimal fallback)
    {
        if (result.PortfolioEquityTimeline == null || result.PortfolioEquityTimeline.Count == 0)
            return fallback;

        // SortedDictionary<DateTime, decimal> => last value is end equity
        return result.PortfolioEquityTimeline.Last().Value;
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Backtesting;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Application.Reporting;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

public sealed class A84ExecutiveSummaryReportService
{
    public void GenerateAndWrite(
        PortfolioBacktestResult result,
        DateTime runUtc,
        IReadOnlyList<Type> selectedStrategies,
        Dictionary<string, decimal> cioWeightsFinal,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<int, StrategyFitnessSnapshot> fitnessSnapshots,
        IReadOnlyCollection<int> allowedStrategyIds,
        int recentMinutesWindow = 10)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(result);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(selectedStrategies);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(cioWeightsFinal);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(fitnessSnapshots);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(allowedStrategyIds);

        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        var reportDefinition = TQGA.Application.Reporting.ReportCatalog.ExecutiveSummary;
        var naming = new TQGA.Application.Reporting.ReportFileNamingService();
        string fileName = naming.BuildLocalFileName(reportDefinition, runUtc, ".txt");

        string outFile = Path.Combine(
            DataPaths.Reports,
            fileName);

        var eq = result.PortfolioEquityTimeline ?? new Dictionary<DateTime, decimal>();

        var ordered = eq
            .OrderBy(x => x.Key)
            .ToList();

        var realPoints = ordered
            .Where(x => x.Key != DateTime.MinValue)
            .ToList();

        DateTime? startTimeUtc = null;
        DateTime? endTimeUtc = null;
        decimal startEquity = 0m;
        decimal endEquity = 0m;

        if (realPoints.Count > 0)
        {
            startTimeUtc = NormalizeUtc(realPoints.First().Key);
            endTimeUtc = NormalizeUtc(realPoints.Last().Key);
            startEquity = realPoints.First().Value;
            endEquity = realPoints.Last().Value;
        }
        else if (ordered.Count > 0)
        {
            startEquity = ordered.First().Value;
            endEquity = ordered.Last().Value;
        }

        decimal totalReturnPct = startEquity <= 0m
            ? 0m
            : ((endEquity / startEquity) - 1m) * 100m;

        var selectedStrategyIds = selectedStrategies
            .Select(ResolveStableStrategyId)
            .Distinct()
            .OrderBy(x => x)
            .ToList();

        var selectedStrategyLines = selectedStrategies
            .Select(t =>
            {
                int id = ResolveStableStrategyId(t);
                return $"  S{id:00}  {t.Name}";
            })
            .Distinct()
            .ToList();

        var allowedLines = allowedStrategyIds
            .OrderBy(x => x)
            .Select(id =>
                $"  S{id:00}  {ResolveStrategyName(id, selectedStrategies, fitnessSnapshots)}")
            .ToList();

        var strategyIdsPresentInPnl = (result.StrategyPnL ?? new Dictionary<int, decimal>())
            .Keys
            .Distinct()
            .OrderBy(x => x)
            .ToList();

        var strategyPnlIdentityLines = strategyIdsPresentInPnl
            .Select(id =>
                $"  S{id:00}  {ResolveStrategyName(id, selectedStrategies, fitnessSnapshots)}")
            .ToList();

        var topStrategies = (result.StrategyPnL ?? new Dictionary<int, decimal>())
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.Value)
            .Take(30)
            .Select(x =>
                $"S{x.Key:00}  {PadRightSafe(ResolveStrategyName(x.Key, selectedStrategies, fitnessSnapshots), 28)}  PnL  {x.Value,14:0.00}")
            .ToList();

        var topMarkets = (result.SymbolTimeframePnL ?? new Dictionary<string, decimal>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.Value)
            .Take(30)
            .Select(x =>
                $"{PadRightSafe(x.Key, 22)}  PnL  {x.Value,14:0.00}")
            .ToList();

        var recentFiles = new List<string>();
        try
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(DataPaths.Reports))
            {
                DateTime cutoff = runUtc.AddMinutes(-recentMinutesWindow);
                recentFiles = Directory
                    .GetFiles(DataPaths.Reports)
                    .Select(f => new FileInfo(f))
                    .Where(fi => fi.LastWriteTimeUtc >= cutoff && fi.LastWriteTimeUtc <= runUtc.AddMinutes(1))
                    .OrderByDescending(fi => fi.LastWriteTimeUtc)
                    .Take(50)
                    .Select(fi =>
                        $"{PakistanTime.FormatLabel(fi.LastWriteTimeUtc)}  |  {fi.LastWriteTimeUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} UTC  |  {fi.Name}")
                    .ToList();
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            // Best-effort only.
        }

        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        sb.AppendLine($"FILE: {fileName}");
        sb.AppendLine("----------------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 001 — EXECUTIVE SUMMARY");
        sb.AppendLine("==============================");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("PUBLISH PATH SIGNATURE");
        sb.AppendLine("----------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("PATCH_14D_A84_00_PKT_ABOVE_UTC");
        sb.AppendLine("PATCH_32_A84_00_IDENTITY_TRUTH_SEPARATION");
        sb.AppendLine("WRITER = A84ExecutiveSummaryReportService.GenerateAndWrite");
        sb.AppendLine("RULE   = PKT is printed first, UTC printed immediately below");
        sb.AppendLine("RULE   = DateTime.MinValue is never published");
        sb.AppendLine("RULE   = UI-selected identity, gate identity, and PnL identity must be printed separately");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine($"Run Timestamp (PKT)   : {PakistanTime.FormatLabel(runUtc)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Run Timestamp (UTC)   : {FormatUtc(runUtc)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Strategies Selected   : {selectedStrategies.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Equity Points         : {eq.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Start Time (PKT)      : {FormatPkt(startTimeUtc)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Start Time (UTC)      : {FormatUtc(startTimeUtc)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"End Time (PKT)        : {FormatPkt(endTimeUtc)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"End Time (UTC)        : {FormatUtc(endTimeUtc)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Start Equity          : {startEquity:0.00}");
        sb.AppendLine($"End Equity            : {endEquity:0.00}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Total Return          : {totalReturnPct:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("POST-GATING CIO SUMMARY");
        sb.AppendLine("-----------------------");
        if (cioWeightsFinal.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO DATA: Canonical CIO weights are empty.");
        }
        else
        {
            sb.AppendLine($"Markets Allocated     : {cioWeightsFinal.Count}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Top Weight            : {cioWeightsFinal.Values.Max():P2}");
            sb.AppendLine();

            foreach (var kv in cioWeightsFinal
                         .OrderByDescending(x => x.Value)
                         .Take(10))
            {
                sb.AppendLine($"{PadRightSafe(kv.Key, 24)}  {kv.Value,10:P2}");
            }
        }

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("IDENTITY TRUTH — UI CHECKED");
        sb.AppendLine("---------------------------");
        if (selectedStrategyLines.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NONE");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (string line in selectedStrategyLines)
                sb.AppendLine(line);
        }

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("IDENTITY TRUTH — ALLOWED AFTER GATE");
        sb.AppendLine("-----------------------------------");
        if (allowedLines.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NONE");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (string line in allowedLines)
                sb.AppendLine(line);
        }

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("IDENTITY TRUTH — STRATEGY IDS PRESENT IN PNL");
        sb.AppendLine("--------------------------------------------");
        if (strategyPnlIdentityLines.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NONE");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (string line in strategyPnlIdentityLines)
                sb.AppendLine(line);
        }

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("TOP STRATEGIES BY PNL");
        sb.AppendLine("---------------------");
        if (topStrategies.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO DATA");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (string line in topStrategies)
                sb.AppendLine(line);
        }

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("TOP MARKETS BY SYMBOL::TF PNL");
        sb.AppendLine("-----------------------------");
        if (topMarkets.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO DATA");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (string line in topMarkets)
                sb.AppendLine(line);
        }

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("RECENT GENERATED FILES");
        sb.AppendLine("----------------------");
        if (recentFiles.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO RECENT FILES FOUND IN WINDOW");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (string line in recentFiles)
                sb.AppendLine(line);
        }

        File.WriteAllText(outFile, sb.ToString(), Encoding.UTF8);
    }

    private static int ResolveStableStrategyId(Type type)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(type);

        return type.Name switch
        {
            "AltcoinLeadershipPullbackQuantStrategy" => 1,
            "DiagnosticQuantStrategy" => 2,
            "EmaRsiQuantStrategy" => 3,
            "EmaTrendPullbackQuantStrategy" => 4,
            "EmaTrendQuantStrategy" => 5,
            "FourHourEarlyTrendContinuationQuantStrategy" => 6,
            "RsiSwingQuantStrategy" => 7,
            _ => 0
        };
    }

    private static string ResolveStrategyName(
        int strategyId,
        IReadOnlyList<Type> selectedStrategies,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<int, StrategyFitnessSnapshot> fitnessSnapshots)
    {
        if (fitnessSnapshots.TryGetValue(strategyId, out var snapshot))
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(snapshot.StrategyCode))
                return snapshot.StrategyCode;
        }

        Type? selectedMatch = selectedStrategies.FirstOrDefault(t => ResolveStableStrategyId(t) == strategyId);
        if (selectedMatch != null)
            return selectedMatch.Name;

        return $"Strategy_{strategyId:00}";
    }

    private static string PadRightSafe(string value, int totalWidth)
    {
        value ??= string.Empty;
        if (value.Length == totalWidth)
            return value;

        if (value.Length < totalWidth)
            return value.PadRight(totalWidth);

        if (totalWidth <= 3)
            return value[..totalWidth];

        return value[..(totalWidth - 3)] + "...";
    }

    private static DateTime NormalizeUtc(DateTime value)
    {
        return value.Kind switch
        {
            DateTimeKind.Utc => value,
            DateTimeKind.Local => value.ToUniversalTime(),
            _ => DateTime.SpecifyKind(value, DateTimeKind.Utc)
        };
    }

    private static string FormatPkt(DateTime? value)
    {
        if (!value.HasValue)
            return "N/A";

        return PakistanTime.FormatLabel(NormalizeUtc(value.Value));
    }

    private static string FormatUtc(DateTime value)
    {
        DateTime normalized = NormalizeUtc(value);
        return $"{normalized:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} UTC";
    }

    private static string FormatUtc(DateTime? value)
    {
        if (!value.HasValue)
            return "N/A";

        return FormatUtc(value.Value);
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Backtesting;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Application.Reporting;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

/// <summary>
/// A84 special reports orchestrator:
/// - REPORT 002 / 007 / 008 family coordination
/// - compile-safe bridge from runner result to regime writers
/// - duplicate-write protection for same-run multi-path invocation
/// </summary>
public sealed class A84MarketRegimeDetectionReportService
{
    private readonly A84_RegimeResearchService _regime = new();

    public void Generate(PortfolioBacktestResult result)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        if (result == null)
        {
            WriteReportText(
                ReportCatalog.MarketRegime,
                "REPORT 002 — MARKET REGIME",
                "NO DATA: PortfolioBacktestResult is null.");

            WriteReportText(
                ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("REGIME_TRANSITIONS", "007"),
                "REPORT 007 — REGIME TRANSITIONS (PORTFOLIO)",
                "NO DATA: PortfolioBacktestResult is null.");

            WriteReportText(
                ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("REGIME_STATS", "008"),
                "REPORT 008 — REGIME STATS (PORTFOLIO)",
                "NO DATA: PortfolioBacktestResult is null.");

            return;
        }

        var canonicalCio = BuildCanonicalCioForRegime(result);

        // REPORT 002 / 004 / 005 / 006
        _regime.Generate(result, canonicalCio);

        // REPORT 007 / 008
        GeneratePortfolioRegimeTransitions(result.PortfolioEquityTimeline);
    }

    private static Dictionary<string, decimal> BuildCanonicalCioForRegime(PortfolioBacktestResult result)
    {
        if (result.CanonicalCioPostGatingWeights != null &&
            result.CanonicalCioPostGatingWeights.Count > 0)
        {
            return new Dictionary<string, decimal>(
                result.CanonicalCioPostGatingWeights,
                StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        }

        var cioRaw = result.CioSymbolTimeframeWeights ?? new Dictionary<string, decimal>();
        var aligned = new Dictionary<string, decimal>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        foreach (var kv in cioRaw)
        {
            var key = kv.Key ?? string.Empty;
            var value = kv.Value;

            if (value <= 0m)
                continue;

            if (key.StartsWith("CIO::", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                key = key["CIO::".Length..];

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(key))
                continue;

            aligned[key] = value;
        }

        var sum = aligned.Values.Sum();
        if (sum > 0m)
        {
            var keys = aligned.Keys.ToList();
            foreach (var k in keys)
                aligned[k] = aligned[k] / sum;
        }

        return aligned;
    }

    private void GeneratePortfolioRegimeTransitions(IReadOnlyDictionary<DateTime, decimal> equityTimeline)
    {
        if (equityTimeline == null || equityTimeline.Count < 30)
        {
            WriteReportText(
                ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("REGIME_TRANSITIONS", "007"),
                "REPORT 007 — REGIME TRANSITIONS (PORTFOLIO)",
                "NO DATA: PortfolioEquityTimeline missing or too small.");

            WriteReportText(
                ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("REGIME_STATS", "008"),
                "REPORT 008 — REGIME STATS (PORTFOLIO)",
                "NO DATA: PortfolioEquityTimeline missing or too small.");

            return;
        }

        var ordered = equityTimeline
            .Where(x => x.Key != DateTime.MinValue)
            .OrderBy(x => x.Key)
            .ToList();

        if (ordered.Count < 30)
        {
            WriteReportText(
                ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("REGIME_TRANSITIONS", "007"),
                "REPORT 007 — REGIME TRANSITIONS (PORTFOLIO)",
                "NO DATA: Real PortfolioEquityTimeline points are too small after removing seed marker.");

            WriteReportText(
                ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("REGIME_STATS", "008"),
                "REPORT 008 — REGIME STATS (PORTFOLIO)",
                "NO DATA: Real PortfolioEquityTimeline points are too small after removing seed marker.");

            return;
        }

        var transitionsSb = new StringBuilder();
        transitionsSb.AppendLine("REPORT 007 — REGIME TRANSITIONS (PORTFOLIO)");
        transitionsSb.AppendLine("===========================================");
        transitionsSb.AppendLine();

        var stats = new Dictionary<string, int>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        string? prevState = null;
        int transitionCount = 0;

        for (int i = 20; i < ordered.Count; i++)
        {
            var window = ordered.Skip(i - 20).Take(20).ToList();
            var state = DetectPortfolioState(window);

            if (!stats.ContainsKey(state))
                stats[state] = 0;
            stats[state]++;

            if (prevState != null && !string.Equals(prevState, state, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                transitionCount++;
                transitionsSb.AppendLine(
                    $"{ordered[i].Key:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} | {prevState} -> {state}");
            }

            prevState = state;
        }

        if (transitionCount == 0)
            transitionsSb.AppendLine("NO TRANSITIONS DETECTED UNDER CURRENT RULES.");

        WriteRaw(
            ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("REGIME_TRANSITIONS", "007"),
            transitionsSb.ToString());

        var statsSb = new StringBuilder();
        statsSb.AppendLine("REPORT 008 — REGIME STATS (PORTFOLIO)");
        statsSb.AppendLine("=====================================");
        statsSb.AppendLine();
        statsSb.AppendLine($"Real Equity Points : {ordered.Count}");
        statsSb.AppendLine($"Transition Count   : {transitionCount}");
        statsSb.AppendLine();
        statsSb.AppendLine("STATE COUNTS");
        statsSb.AppendLine("------------");

        foreach (var kv in stats.OrderByDescending(x => x.Value))
            statsSb.AppendLine($"{kv.Key,-16} {kv.Value,8}");

        WriteRaw(
            ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("REGIME_STATS", "008"),
            statsSb.ToString());
    }

    private static string DetectPortfolioState(List<KeyValuePair<DateTime, decimal>> window)
    {
        if (window == null || window.Count < 2)
            return "INSUFFICIENT";

        var start = window.First().Value;
        var end = window.Last().Value;

        if (start <= 0m)
            return "INSUFFICIENT";

        var ret = ((end / start) - 1m) * 100m;

        decimal peak = decimal.MinValue;
        decimal maxDd = 0m;

        foreach (var p in window)
        {
            if (p.Value > peak)
                peak = p.Value;

            if (peak > 0m)
            {
                var dd = ((p.Value / peak) - 1m) * 100m;
                if (dd < maxDd)
                    maxDd = dd;
            }
        }

        if (ret >= 3m && maxDd > -2m) return "TREND_UP";
        if (ret <= -3m && maxDd <= -4m) return "DRAWDOWN";
        if (Math.Abs(ret) < 1m) return "RANGE";
        if (ret > 0m) return "RECOVERY";
        return "WEAKNESS";
    }

    private static void WriteReportText(ReportDefinition definition, string title, string body)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine(title);
        sb.AppendLine(new string('=', title.Length));
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine(body);

        WriteRaw(definition, sb.ToString());
    }

    private static void WriteRaw(ReportDefinition definition, string content)
    {
        if (!A84ReportWriteGuard.ShouldWrite(definition.Number))
            return;

        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        var naming = new ReportFileNamingService();
        string fileName = naming.BuildLocalFileName(definition, DateTime.UtcNow, ".txt");
        string path = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, fileName);

        File.WriteAllText(path, content);
    }
}

internal static class A84ReportWriteGuard
{
    private static readonly Dictionary<string, DateTime> LastWriteUtc = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    private static readonly object Sync = new();
    private static readonly TimeSpan DuplicateWindow = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);

    public static bool ShouldWrite(string reportNumber)
    {
        lock (Sync)
        {
            DateTime now = DateTime.UtcNow;

            if (LastWriteUtc.TryGetValue(reportNumber, out DateTime previous))
            {
                if (now - previous <= DuplicateWindow)
                    return false;
            }

            LastWriteUtc[reportNumber] = now;
            return true;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Backtesting;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Application.Reporting;
using TQGA.Application.Portfolio;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

public sealed class A84StrategyFitnessGatingReportService
{
    public sealed class FitnessConfig
    {
        public int MinTrades { get; init; } = 30;
        public decimal MinPnL { get; init; } = 0m;
        public int MaxStrategiesAllowed { get; init; } = 50;
        public int TopKMarkets { get; init; } = 20;
        public decimal MaxWeightPerMarket { get; init; } = 0.10m;
        public decimal MaxWeightPerSymbol { get; init; } = 0.25m;

        // PATCH 23 — regime-aware scarcity override
        // Goal:
        // when Wave B + cash preservation already forced the system into defensive scarcity,
        // do NOT auto-reject the strongest positive strategy only because trade count is below the normal threshold.
        public decimal ScarcityModeMinCashWeight { get; init; } = 0.75m;
        public int ScarcityModeMaxSelectedMarkets { get; init; } = 1;
        public int ScarcityOverrideMinTrades { get; init; } = 12;
        public decimal ScarcityOverrideMinPnL { get; init; } = 50m;
        public int ScarcityOverrideMaxStrategies { get; init; } = 1;
    }

    public sealed class FitnessRow
    {
        public int StrategyId { get; init; }
        public string StrategyCode { get; init; } = "";
        public decimal PnL { get; init; }
        public int Trades { get; init; }
        public int Exits { get; init; }
        public decimal FitnessScore { get; init; }
        public bool Allowed { get; init; }
        public string GateReason { get; init; } = "";

        // PATCH 23
        public bool ScarcityOverrideApplied { get; init; }
    }

    public (Dictionary<int, FitnessRow> fitness, HashSet<int> allowedIds) ComputeFitness(
        PortfolioBacktestResult result,
        FitnessConfig cfg)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(result);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(cfg);

        var fitness = new Dictionary<int, FitnessRow>();
        var allowed = new HashSet<int>();

        bool scarcityModeActive = IsScarcityDefensiveMode(result, cfg);
        int scarcityWinnerId = GetScarcityWinnerStrategyId(result);

        int scarcityOverrideAppliedCount = 0;

        foreach (var kv in result.StrategyPnL.OrderBy(k => k.Key))
        {
            var sid = kv.Key;
            var pnl = kv.Value;

            result.StrategyDiagnostics.TryGetValue(sid, out var diag);
            var trades = diag?.ExecutedEntries ?? 0;
            var exits = diag?.ExecutedExits ?? 0;

            const decimal startEquity = 100_000m;
            var retPct = startEquity <= 0m ? 0m : (pnl / startEquity) * 100m;

            decimal scoreCore = 0m;
            if (retPct > 0m && trades > 0)
            {
                var logTerm = (decimal)Math.Log(1.0 + (double)(retPct / 100m));
                var sqrtTrades = (decimal)Math.Sqrt(trades);
                scoreCore = logTerm * sqrtTrades;
            }

            bool allowedFlag = true;
            string reason = "OK";
            bool scarcityOverrideApplied = false;

            if (trades < cfg.MinTrades)
            {
                allowedFlag = false;
                reason = $"GATED: trades<{cfg.MinTrades}";
            }
            else if (pnl <= cfg.MinPnL)
            {
                allowedFlag = false;
                reason = $"GATED: pnl<= {cfg.MinPnL:0.##}";
            }
            else if (scoreCore <= 0m)
            {
                allowedFlag = false;
                reason = "GATED: fitness<=0";
            }

            // PATCH 23:
            // scarcity override may rescue exactly one top positive winner
            // when:
            // - defensive scarcity mode is active
            // - normal gate failure is ONLY low trades
            // - strategy is the top positive PnL winner
            // - trades clear a lower scarcity threshold
            // - pnl is materially positive
            if (!allowedFlag &&
                scarcityModeActive &&
                scarcityOverrideAppliedCount < cfg.ScarcityOverrideMaxStrategies &&
                sid == scarcityWinnerId &&
                trades >= cfg.ScarcityOverrideMinTrades &&
                pnl > cfg.ScarcityOverrideMinPnL &&
                scoreCore > 0m &&
                reason.StartsWith("GATED: trades<", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                allowedFlag = true;
                scarcityOverrideApplied = true;
                scarcityOverrideAppliedCount++;

                reason =
                    $"SCARCITY_OVERRIDE: defensive mode active, top positive winner rescued despite trades<{cfg.MinTrades}";
            }

            var row = new FitnessRow
            {
                StrategyId = sid,
                StrategyCode = $"S{sid:00}",
                PnL = pnl,
                Trades = trades,
                Exits = exits,
                FitnessScore = scoreCore,
                Allowed = allowedFlag,
                GateReason = reason,
                ScarcityOverrideApplied = scarcityOverrideApplied
            };

            fitness[sid] = row;

            if (allowedFlag)
                allowed.Add(sid);
        }

        if (allowed.Count > cfg.MaxStrategiesAllowed)
        {
            allowed = allowed
                .OrderByDescending(id => fitness[id].FitnessScore)
                .Take(cfg.MaxStrategiesAllowed)
                .ToHashSet();
        }

        foreach (var id in fitness.Keys.ToList())
        {
            var r = fitness[id];

            if (!allowed.Contains(id) && r.Allowed)
            {
                fitness[id] = new FitnessRow
                {
                    StrategyId = r.StrategyId,
                    StrategyCode = r.StrategyCode,
                    PnL = r.PnL,
                    Trades = r.Trades,
                    Exits = r.Exits,
                    FitnessScore = r.FitnessScore,
                    Allowed = false,
                    GateReason = "GATED: max strategies clamp",
                    ScarcityOverrideApplied = false
                };
            }
        }

        return (fitness, allowed);
    }

    public Dictionary<string, decimal> RecomputeCioWeightsWithGating(
        PortfolioBacktestResult result,
        HashSet<int> allowedStrategyIds,
        FitnessConfig cfg)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(result);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(allowedStrategyIds);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(cfg);

        var scoreByMarket = new Dictionary<MarketKey, decimal>();

        foreach (var kv in result.StrategySymbolTimeframePnL)
        {
            if (!TryParseStrategySymbolTfKey(kv.Key, out var sid, out var symbol, out var tf))
                continue;

            if (!allowedStrategyIds.Contains(sid))
                continue;

            var mk = new MarketKey(symbol, tf);

            if (!scoreByMarket.ContainsKey(mk))
                scoreByMarket[mk] = 0m;

            scoreByMarket[mk] += kv.Value;
        }

        var cio = new CioDynamicReallocationEngine(
            topK: cfg.TopKMarkets,
            minWeight: 0.00m,
            maxWeight: cfg.MaxWeightPerMarket,
            maxWeightPerSymbol: cfg.MaxWeightPerSymbol);

        var weights = cio.ComputeWeights(scoreByMarket);

        return weights.ToDictionary(
            x => $"CIO::{x.Key.Symbol}::{x.Key.Timeframe}",
            x => x.Value,
            StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    public void GenerateAndWrite(
        PortfolioBacktestResult result,
        DateTime runUtc,
        FitnessConfig? cfg = null)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(result);

        cfg ??= new FitnessConfig();

        var (fitness, allowed) = ComputeFitness(result, cfg);

        // PATCH 13C:
        // A84_05 MUST publish only the exact stored canonical dictionary.
        // This method is forbidden from using:
        // - RecomputeCioWeightsWithGating(...)
        // - MaxWeightPerMarket display logic
        // - local cleaning / local normalization / local capping
        var canonicalCio = result.CanonicalCioPostGatingWeights
            ?? new Dictionary<string, decimal>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        bool scarcityModeActive = IsScarcityDefensiveMode(result, cfg);
        int scarcityWinnerId = GetScarcityWinnerStrategyId(result);

        var reportDefinition = ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("STRATEGY_FITNESS_GATING", "012");
        var naming = new ReportFileNamingService();
        string fileName = naming.BuildLocalFileName(reportDefinition, runUtc, ".txt");
        var outFile = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, fileName);

        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 012 — STRATEGY FITNESS + CIO GATING");
        sb.AppendLine("======================================");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine($"Run Timestamp (UTC) : {runUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("PUBLISH PATH SIGNATURE");
        sb.AppendLine("----------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("PATCH_13C_A84_05_CANONICAL_ONLY");
        sb.AppendLine("PATCH_23_SCARCITY_STRATEGY_GATE");
        sb.AppendLine("SOURCE = exact result.CanonicalCioPostGatingWeights");
        sb.AppendLine("RECOMPUTE = DISABLED");
        sb.AppendLine("LOCAL_CAP = DISABLED");
        sb.AppendLine("LOCAL_RESCALING = DISABLED");
        sb.AppendLine("LOCAL_CLEANING = DISABLED");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("FITNESS CONFIG (GATING INPUTS ONLY)");
        sb.AppendLine("-----------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"MinTrades                : {cfg.MinTrades}");
        sb.AppendLine($"MinPnL                   : {cfg.MinPnL:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"TopKMarkets              : {cfg.TopKMarkets}");
        sb.AppendLine($"MaxWeightPerMarket       : {cfg.MaxWeightPerMarket:P2}  (NOT USED FOR A84_05 PUBLISH)");
        sb.AppendLine($"MaxWeightPerSymbol       : {cfg.MaxWeightPerSymbol:P2}  (NOT USED FOR A84_05 PUBLISH)");
        sb.AppendLine($"ScarcityModeMinCash      : {cfg.ScarcityModeMinCashWeight:P2}");
        sb.AppendLine($"ScarcityModeMaxMarkets   : {cfg.ScarcityModeMaxSelectedMarkets}");
        sb.AppendLine($"ScarcityOverrideMinTrades: {cfg.ScarcityOverrideMinTrades}");
        sb.AppendLine($"ScarcityOverrideMinPnL   : {cfg.ScarcityOverrideMinPnL:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"ScarcityOverrideMaxStrat : {cfg.ScarcityOverrideMaxStrategies}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("SCARCITY DEFENSIVE MODE");
        sb.AppendLine("-----------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Active                   : {(scarcityModeActive ? "YES" : "NO")}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Runner Selected Markets  : {result.SelectedMarkets?.Count ?? 0}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Runner Cash Weight       : {result.CashAllocationWeight:P2}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Top Positive Winner      : {(scarcityWinnerId <= 0 ? "NONE" : $"S{scarcityWinnerId:00}")}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("STRATEGY FITNESS TABLE");
        sb.AppendLine("----------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("Code | PnL         | Trades | Exits | Fitness   | Allowed | Override | GateReason");
        sb.AppendLine("-----+-------------+--------+-------+-----------+---------+----------+-----------------------------------------------");

        foreach (var row in fitness.Values.OrderByDescending(r => r.FitnessScore))
        {
            sb.AppendLine(
                $"{row.StrategyCode,-4} | {row.PnL,11:0.00} | {row.Trades,6} | {row.Exits,5} | {row.FitnessScore,9:0.0000} | {(row.Allowed ? "YES" : "NO "),-7} | {(row.ScarcityOverrideApplied ? "YES" : "NO "),-8} | {row.GateReason}");
        }

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine($"Allowed strategies : {allowed.Count} / {fitness.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Allowed list       : {(allowed.Count == 0 ? "NONE" : string.Join(", ", allowed.OrderBy(x => x).Select(x => $"S{x:00}")))}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("CANONICAL CIO SNAPSHOT");
        sb.AppendLine("----------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Canonical Count    : {canonicalCio.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Canonical Sum      : {canonicalCio.Values.Sum():P2}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Canonical Max      : {(canonicalCio.Count == 0 ? 0m : canonicalCio.Values.Max()):P2}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("CIO WEIGHTS (POST-GATING) TOP 20");
        sb.AppendLine("-------------------------------");
        if (canonicalCio.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO DATA: Stored canonical CIO weights are empty.");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (var w in canonicalCio
                         .OrderByDescending(x => x.Value)
                         .Take(20))
            {
                sb.AppendLine($"{w.Key,-22} W {w.Value:P2}");
            }
        }

        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);
        File.WriteAllText(outFile, sb.ToString(), Encoding.UTF8);
    }

    private static bool TryParseStrategySymbolTfKey(
        string key,
        out int strategyId,
        out string symbol,
        out string timeframe)
    {
        strategyId = 0;
        symbol = "";
        timeframe = "";

        var parts = key.Split(new[] { "::" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
        if (parts.Length != 3)
            return false;

        var s = parts[0].Trim();
        if (!s.StartsWith("S", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return false;

        if (!int.TryParse(s.Substring(1), out strategyId))
            return false;

        symbol = parts[1].Trim();
        timeframe = parts[2].Trim();

        return !(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(timeframe));
    }

    private static bool IsScarcityDefensiveMode(
        PortfolioBacktestResult result,
        FitnessConfig cfg)
    {
        int selectedMarkets = result.SelectedMarkets?.Count ?? 0;
        decimal cashWeight = result.CashAllocationWeight;

        return selectedMarkets <= cfg.ScarcityModeMaxSelectedMarkets &&
               cashWeight >= cfg.ScarcityModeMinCashWeight;
    }

    private static int GetScarcityWinnerStrategyId(PortfolioBacktestResult result)
    {
        if (result.StrategyPnL == null || result.StrategyPnL.Count == 0)
            return 0;

        return result.StrategyPnL
            .Where(x => x.Value > 0m)
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.Value)
            .ThenBy(x => x.Key)
            .Select(x => x.Key)
            .FirstOrDefault();
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Backtesting;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Application.Reporting;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

/// <summary>
/// REPORT 013 — STRATEGY FITNESS
/// Institutional heuristic using existing PortfolioBacktestResult fields only.
/// </summary>
public sealed class A84StrategyFitnessReportService
{
    public void Generate(PortfolioBacktestResult result)
    {
        GenerateAndWrite(result, DateTime.UtcNow);
    }

    public void GenerateAndWrite(PortfolioBacktestResult result, DateTime runUtc)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        var definition = ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("STRATEGY_FITNESS", "013");

        if (result is null)
        {
            WriteReportText(
                definition,
                runUtc,
                "REPORT 013 — STRATEGY FITNESS",
                "NO DATA: PortfolioBacktestResult is null.");
            return;
        }

        var pnlByStrategy = result.StrategyPnL ?? new Dictionary<int, decimal>();
        var diagByStrategy = result.StrategyDiagnostics ?? new Dictionary<int, TradeDecisionDiagnosticsSnapshot>();

        if (pnlByStrategy.Count == 0 && diagByStrategy.Count == 0)
        {
            WriteReportText(
                definition,
                runUtc,
                "REPORT 013 — STRATEGY FITNESS",
                "NO DATA: StrategyPnL and StrategyDiagnostics are empty.");
            return;
        }

        var maxAbsPnL = pnlByStrategy.Count == 0
            ? 1m
            : pnlByStrategy.Values.Select(v => Math.Abs(v)).DefaultIfEmpty(1m).Max();

        if (maxAbsPnL <= 0m)
            maxAbsPnL = 1m;

        var ids = pnlByStrategy.Keys
            .Concat(diagByStrategy.Keys)
            .Distinct()
            .OrderBy(x => x)
            .ToList();

        var rows = new List<Row>(ids.Count);

        foreach (var id in ids)
        {
            pnlByStrategy.TryGetValue(id, out var pnl);
            diagByStrategy.TryGetValue(id, out var d);

            int ticks = d?.TicksProcessed ?? 0;
            int entryAttempts = d?.EntryAttempts ?? 0;
            int executedEntries = d?.ExecutedEntries ?? 0;
            int executedExits = d?.ExecutedExits ?? 0;
            int signalLong = d?.SignalLong ?? 0;
            int signalExit = d?.SignalExit ?? 0;

            int trades = executedEntries;

            decimal execRate = SafeDiv(executedEntries, entryAttempts);
            decimal completionRate = SafeDiv(executedExits, Math.Max(1, executedEntries));
            decimal churnPenalty = entryAttempts <= 0 ? 0m : SafeDiv(entryAttempts - executedEntries, entryAttempts);
            decimal discipline = SafeDiv(signalExit, Math.Max(1, signalLong));

            decimal pnlScore = Clamp01(Math.Abs(pnl) / maxAbsPnL);
            decimal directionScore = pnl >= 0m ? 1.0m : 0.0m;
            decimal activityScore = Clamp01(trades / 5000m);

            decimal fitness =
                (pnlScore * 0.45m) +
                (directionScore * 0.15m) +
                (activityScore * 0.20m) +
                (execRate * 0.10m) +
                (completionRate * 0.10m) -
                (churnPenalty * 0.10m);

            if (trades <= 0)
                fitness = 0m;

            rows.Add(new Row(
                Id: id,
                PnL: pnl,
                Ticks: ticks,
                Trades: trades,
                EntryAttempts: entryAttempts,
                ExecutedEntries: executedEntries,
                ExecutedExits: executedExits,
                ExecRate: execRate,
                CompletionRate: completionRate,
                Discipline: discipline,
                ChurnPenalty: churnPenalty,
                Fitness: fitness));
        }

        var ranked = rows
            .OrderByDescending(r => r.Fitness)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.PnL)
            .ToList();

        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 013 — STRATEGY FITNESS");
        sb.AppendLine("=============================");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine($"Run Timestamp (UTC) : {runUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("Fitness is a bounded institutional score (0..1) using StrategyPnL + StrategyDiagnostics.");
        sb.AppendLine("Dead strategies (0 trades) are forced to Fitness 0.");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine($"MaxAbsPnL normalization : {maxAbsPnL:F2}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("Rank | Strat | Fitness | PnL           | Trades | ExecRate | ExitCov | Churn  | Discipline");
        sb.AppendLine("-----+-------+---------+---------------+--------+----------+---------+--------+-----------");

        int rank = 1;
        foreach (var r in ranked)
        {
            string strat = $"S{r.Id:00}";
            sb.AppendLine(
                $"{rank,4} | {strat,-5} | {r.Fitness,7:F3} | {r.PnL,13:F2} | {r.Trades,6} | {r.ExecRate,8:P2} | {r.CompletionRate,7:P2} | {r.ChurnPenalty,6:P2} | {r.Discipline,9:P2}");
            rank++;
        }

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("CIO Action Hint:");
        sb.AppendLine("- Only allocate capital to strategies with Fitness >= 0.25 and Trades > 0.");
        sb.AppendLine("- If Fitness=0, the strategy is inactive (signals not firing or execution path blocked).");

        WriteReportFile(definition, runUtc, sb.ToString());
    }

    private static decimal SafeDiv(int a, int b) => b <= 0 ? 0m : (decimal)a / b;

    private static decimal Clamp01(decimal x)
    {
        if (x < 0m) return 0m;
        if (x > 1m) return 1m;
        return x;
    }

    private static void WriteReportText(ReportDefinition definition, DateTime runUtc, string title, string body)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine(title);
        sb.AppendLine(new string('=', Math.Max(10, title.Length)));
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine(body);

        WriteReportFile(definition, runUtc, sb.ToString());
    }

    private static void WriteReportFile(ReportDefinition definition, DateTime runUtc, string content)
    {
        var naming = new ReportFileNamingService();
        string fileName = naming.BuildLocalFileName(definition, runUtc, ".txt");

        File.WriteAllText(
            Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, fileName),
            content,
            Encoding.UTF8);
    }

    private sealed record Row(
        int Id,
        decimal PnL,
        int Ticks,
        int Trades,
        int EntryAttempts,
        int ExecutedEntries,
        int ExecutedExits,
        decimal ExecRate,
        decimal CompletionRate,
        decimal Discipline,
        decimal ChurnPenalty,
        decimal Fitness);
}
