using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Backtesting;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Application.Reporting;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

public sealed class A84_RegimeResearchService
{
    public void Generate(
        PortfolioBacktestResult result,
        Dictionary<string, decimal> canonicalCioPostGatingWeights)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(result);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(canonicalCioPostGatingWeights);

        GenerateMarketRegime(result.SymbolTimeframePnL);
        GenerateMarketRanking(result.SymbolTimeframePnL);
        GenerateCioSkill(result, canonicalCioPostGatingWeights);
        GenerateGrowthScenarioMode(result, canonicalCioPostGatingWeights);
    }

    private void GenerateMarketRegime(Dictionary<string, decimal> pnl)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 002 — MARKET REGIME MAP");
        sb.AppendLine("==============================");
        sb.AppendLine();

        if (pnl == null || pnl.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO DATA: SymbolTimeframePnL is empty.");
            Write(ReportCatalog.MarketRegime, sb);
            return;
        }

        foreach (var kv in pnl.OrderByDescending(x => x.Value).Take(30))
        {
            var regime = DetectRegime(kv.Value);
            sb.AppendLine($"{kv.Key,-20} {kv.Value,12:F2}   {regime}");
        }

        Write(ReportCatalog.MarketRegime, sb);
    }

    private void GenerateMarketRanking(Dictionary<string, decimal> pnl)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 004 — MARKET EDGE RANKING");
        sb.AppendLine("================================");
        sb.AppendLine();

        if (pnl == null || pnl.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO DATA: SymbolTimeframePnL is empty.");
            Write(ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("MARKET_RANKING", "004"), sb);
            return;
        }

        int rank = 1;

        foreach (var kv in pnl.OrderByDescending(x => x.Value))
        {
            sb.AppendLine($"{rank,3} | {kv.Key,-20} | {kv.Value,12:F2}");
            rank++;
        }

        Write(ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("MARKET_RANKING", "004"), sb);
    }

    private void GenerateCioSkill(
        PortfolioBacktestResult result,
        Dictionary<string, decimal> canonicalCioPostGatingWeights)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 005 — CIO ALLOCATION SKILL");
        sb.AppendLine("=================================");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("SOURCE: Exact stored post-gating CIO deployment with cash preservation intact.");
        sb.AppendLine();

        if (canonicalCioPostGatingWeights.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO DATA: Stored canonical CIO dictionary is empty.");
            sb.AppendLine($"Cash Held         : {Math.Max(0m, Math.Min(1m, result.CashAllocationWeight)):P2}");
            Write(ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("CIO_RATING", "005"), sb);
            return;
        }

        var concentration = canonicalCioPostGatingWeights.Values.Max();
        var diversification = canonicalCioPostGatingWeights.Count;
        var cashHeld = Math.Max(0m, Math.Min(1m, result.CashAllocationWeight));

        sb.AppendLine($"Markets Allocated : {diversification}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Max Weight        : {concentration:P2}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Cash Held         : {cashHeld:P2}");

        string rating =
            concentration < 0.10m ? "Institutional"
          : concentration < 0.20m ? "Professional"
          : concentration < 0.35m ? "Selective"
          : "Concentrated";

        sb.AppendLine($"CIO Rating        : {rating}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        if (cashHeld >= 0.50m)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("PATCH 20 SIGNAL");
            sb.AppendLine("---------------");
            sb.AppendLine("Regime-aware no-trade guard is active. Large residual cash is being preserved instead of forcing second-tier exposure.");
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        sb.AppendLine("CANONICAL POST-GATING CIO WEIGHTS");
        sb.AppendLine("---------------------------------");

        foreach (var kv in canonicalCioPostGatingWeights.OrderByDescending(x => x.Value).Take(10))
            sb.AppendLine($"{kv.Key,-24} {kv.Value,10:P2}");

        Write(ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("CIO_RATING", "005"), sb);
    }

    private void GenerateGrowthScenarioMode(
        PortfolioBacktestResult result,
        Dictionary<string, decimal> canonicalCioPostGatingWeights)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 006 — SYSTEM GROWTH SCENARIO MODE");
        sb.AppendLine("========================================");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("PUBLISH PATH SIGNATURE");
        sb.AppendLine("----------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("PATCH_15_A84_04_SCENARIO_MODE");
        sb.AppendLine("RULE = fixed monthly ROI projection removed");
        sb.AppendLine("RULE = scenario output must warn on negative return, single-market concentration, alpha decay");
        sb.AppendLine();

        var equity = result.PortfolioEquityTimeline ?? new Dictionary<DateTime, decimal>();
        var ordered = equity.OrderBy(x => x.Key).ToList();
        var realPoints = ordered.Where(x => x.Key != DateTime.MinValue).ToList();

        decimal startEquity = 0m;
        decimal endEquity = 0m;
        decimal totalReturnPct = 0m;

        if (realPoints.Count > 0)
        {
            startEquity = realPoints.First().Value;
            endEquity = realPoints.Last().Value;
            totalReturnPct = startEquity <= 0m
                ? 0m
                : ((endEquity / startEquity) - 1m) * 100m;
        }

        var allocationCount = canonicalCioPostGatingWeights.Count;
        var topWeight = allocationCount == 0 ? 0m : canonicalCioPostGatingWeights.Values.Max();
        var cashHeld = Math.Max(0m, Math.Min(1m, result.CashAllocationWeight));

        decimal earlyHalfReturn = 0m;
        decimal lateHalfReturn = 0m;
        bool alphaDecayDetected = false;

        if (realPoints.Count >= 4)
        {
            var half = realPoints.Count / 2;
            var early = realPoints.Take(half).ToList();
            var late = realPoints.Skip(half).ToList();

            earlyHalfReturn = SegmentReturnPct(early);
            lateHalfReturn = SegmentReturnPct(late);
            alphaDecayDetected = lateHalfReturn < earlyHalfReturn;
        }

        bool negativeReturn = totalReturnPct < 0m;
        bool singleMarketConcentration = allocationCount <= 1;
        bool extremeConcentration = topWeight >= 0.80m;

        sb.AppendLine("CURRENT RUN REALITY");
        sb.AppendLine("-------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Start Equity              : {startEquity:0.00}");
        sb.AppendLine($"End Equity                : {endEquity:0.00}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Total Return              : {totalReturnPct:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Post-Gating Markets       : {allocationCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Top CIO Weight            : {topWeight:P2}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Post-Gating Cash Held     : {cashHeld:P2}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Early Half Return         : {earlyHalfReturn:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Late Half Return          : {lateHalfReturn:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Alpha Decay Detected      : {(alphaDecayDetected ? "YES" : "NO")}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("REALISM WARNINGS");
        sb.AppendLine("----------------");
        if (!negativeReturn && !singleMarketConcentration && !extremeConcentration && !alphaDecayDetected)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO MAJOR WARNING: Current run does not trip the Patch 15 realism flags.");
        }
        else
        {
            if (negativeReturn)
                sb.AppendLine("WARNING: Current run total return is negative. Fixed optimistic growth projection is forbidden.");

            if (singleMarketConcentration)
                sb.AppendLine("WARNING: Post-gating allocation breadth is one market. Portfolio is a single-edge survivor.");

            if (!singleMarketConcentration && extremeConcentration)
                sb.AppendLine("WARNING: Top CIO weight is extreme. Diversification is materially weak.");

            if (alphaDecayDetected)
                sb.AppendLine("WARNING: Alpha decay detected. Late-half performance is weaker than early-half performance.");
        }

        if (cashHeld >= 0.50m)
            sb.AppendLine("INFO: Patch 20 defensive posture is active. Capital is being held in cash because edge breadth is too weak for broader deployment.");

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("SCENARIO MODE");
        sb.AppendLine("-------------");
        sb.AppendLine("This section is scenario planning only. It is NOT a fixed forward projection.");
        sb.AppendLine();

        decimal currentCapital = endEquity > 0m ? endEquity : 100000m;

        var scenarios = BuildScenarios(
            negativeReturn,
            singleMarketConcentration || extremeConcentration,
            alphaDecayDetected);

        sb.AppendLine("Scenario        Monthly Assumption   12-Month Capital   Interpretation");
        sb.AppendLine("--------------  -------------------  -----------------  ------------------------------");

        foreach (var s in scenarios)
        {
            decimal projected = Project12Months(currentCapital, s.MonthlyRate);
            sb.AppendLine(
                $"{PadRightSafe(s.Name, 14)}  {s.MonthlyRate,18:P2}  {projected,17:0.00}  {s.Interpretation}");
        }

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("OPERATOR GUIDANCE");
        sb.AppendLine("-----------------");
        if (negativeReturn || alphaDecayDetected || singleMarketConcentration || extremeConcentration)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("1) Treat this run as unstable for institutional projection purposes.");
            sb.AppendLine("2) Prioritize Wave B signal ranking and top-N execution before trusting growth narratives.");
            sb.AppendLine("3) Require better breadth across strategies and SYMBOL::TF edges before restoring optimistic scenario assumptions.");
            sb.AppendLine("4) Use A84_05, A84_07, and A84_08 as the primary reality checks before any growth claim.");

            if (cashHeld >= 0.50m)
                sb.AppendLine("5) High cash is currently a defensive feature, not automatically a defect, when regime breadth is weak.");
        }
        else
        {
            sb.AppendLine("Current run does not trigger the Patch 15 realism alarms, but scenarios remain illustrative only.");
        }

        Write(ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("GROWTH_PROJECTION", "006"), sb);
    }

    private static List<GrowthScenario> BuildScenarios(
        bool negativeReturn,
        bool concentrated,
        bool alphaDecayDetected)
    {
        if (negativeReturn || concentrated || alphaDecayDetected)
        {
            return
            [
                new("Stress",  -0.02m, "Weak run persists / further degradation"),
                new("Base",     0.00m, "Capital preservation, no growth assumption"),
                new("Recovery", 0.01m, "Partial stabilization after execution improvements")
            ];
        }

        return
        [
            new("Stress",   -0.01m, "Temporary setback / mild degradation"),
            new("Base",      0.01m, "Measured continuation under controlled conditions"),
            new("Upside",    0.02m, "Improved breadth and stable non-decaying edge")
        ];
    }

    private static decimal Project12Months(decimal capital, decimal monthlyRate)
    {
        decimal output = capital;

        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++)
            output *= (1m + monthlyRate);

        return output;
    }

    private static decimal SegmentReturnPct(List<KeyValuePair<DateTime, decimal>> segment)
    {
        if (segment.Count < 2)
            return 0m;

        decimal start = segment.First().Value;
        decimal end = segment.Last().Value;

        if (start <= 0m)
            return 0m;

        return ((end / start) - 1m) * 100m;
    }

    private static string DetectRegime(decimal pnl)
    {
        if (pnl > 40000m) return "STRONG TREND";
        if (pnl > 10000m) return "TREND";
        if (pnl > 0m) return "WEAK TREND";
        if (pnl > -5000m) return "RANGE";

        return "HOSTILE";
    }

    private static void Write(ReportDefinition definition, StringBuilder sb)
    {
        if (!A84ReportWriteGuard.ShouldWrite(definition.Number))
            return;

        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        var naming = new ReportFileNamingService();
        string fileName = naming.BuildLocalFileName(definition, DateTime.UtcNow, ".txt");

        File.WriteAllText(
            Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, fileName),
            sb.ToString());
    }

    private static string PadRightSafe(string value, int totalWidth)
    {
        value ??= string.Empty;

        if (value.Length == totalWidth)
            return value;

        if (value.Length < totalWidth)
            return value.PadRight(totalWidth);

        if (totalWidth <= 3)
            return value[..totalWidth];

        return value[..(totalWidth - 3)] + "...";
    }

    private sealed record GrowthScenario(
        string Name,
        decimal MonthlyRate,
        string Interpretation);
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Backtesting;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Application.Reporting;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

public sealed class AlphaRankingReportService
{
    // Institutional fix:
    // - Do NOT resolve a DI-scoped TradeDecisionDiagnostics here.
    // - Always read diagnostics snapshots from PortfolioBacktestResult (per-strategy).
    public void Generate(PortfolioBacktestResult? result)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 014 — ALPHA DIAGNOSTICS (PER STRATEGY)");
        sb.AppendLine("===========================================");
        sb.AppendLine();

        if (result == null)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO DATA: result is null.");
            Write(sb);
            return;
        }

        var strategyPnL = result.StrategyPnL ?? new Dictionary<int, decimal>();
        var strategyDiagnostics = result.StrategyDiagnostics ?? new Dictionary<int, TradeDecisionDiagnosticsSnapshot>();

        bool hasPnL = strategyPnL.Count > 0;
        bool hasDiag = strategyDiagnostics.Count > 0;

        if (!hasPnL && !hasDiag)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO DATA: StrategyPnL and StrategyDiagnostics are empty.");
            sb.AppendLine("NOTE: Ensure PortfolioBacktestRunner populates StrategyDiagnostics snapshots per strategy.");
            Write(sb);
            return;
        }

        var ids = new HashSet<int>();

        if (hasPnL)
        {
            foreach (int id in strategyPnL.Keys)
                ids.Add(id);
        }

        if (hasDiag)
        {
            foreach (int id in strategyDiagnostics.Keys)
                ids.Add(id);
        }

        sb.AppendLine("ID  | PnL        | Ticks     | Long    | Short   | Exit    | EntryAtt | EntryOK  | ExitOK");
        sb.AppendLine("----+------------+-----------+---------+---------+---------+----------+----------+--------");

        foreach (int id in ids.OrderBy(i => i))
        {
            strategyPnL.TryGetValue(id, out decimal pnl);

            TradeDecisionDiagnosticsSnapshot? snapshot = null;
            bool hasSnapshot = false;

            if (hasDiag)
                hasSnapshot = strategyDiagnostics.TryGetValue(id, out snapshot);

            int ticksProcessed = hasSnapshot && snapshot != null ? snapshot.TicksProcessed : 0;
            int signalLong = hasSnapshot && snapshot != null ? snapshot.SignalLong : 0;
            int signalShort = hasSnapshot && snapshot != null ? snapshot.SignalShort : 0;
            int signalExit = hasSnapshot && snapshot != null ? snapshot.SignalExit : 0;
            int entryAttempts = hasSnapshot && snapshot != null ? snapshot.EntryAttempts : 0;
            int executedEntries = hasSnapshot && snapshot != null ? snapshot.ExecutedEntries : 0;
            int executedExits = hasSnapshot && snapshot != null ? snapshot.ExecutedExits : 0;

            sb.AppendLine(string.Format(
                "{0,2:00}  | {1,10:F2} | {2,9} | {3,7} | {4,7} | {5,7} | {6,8} | {7,8} | {8,6}",
                id,
                pnl,
                ticksProcessed,
                signalLong,
                signalShort,
                signalExit,
                entryAttempts,
                executedEntries,
                executedExits));
        }

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("NOTES");
        sb.AppendLine("-----");
        sb.AppendLine("- This report is generated from PortfolioBacktestResult snapshots (institutional-safe).");
        sb.AppendLine("- If counts are zero, verify TradingEngine increments diagnostics and Runner stores snapshots.");

        Write(sb);
    }

    private static void Write(StringBuilder sb)
    {
        var definition = ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("ALPHA", "014");
        var naming = new ReportFileNamingService();
        string fileName = naming.BuildLocalFileName(definition, DateTime.UtcNow, ".txt");
        string path = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, fileName);

        File.WriteAllText(path, sb.ToString());
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Application.Reporting;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

public sealed class CioCapitalReportService
{
    public void Generate(Dictionary<int, decimal> weights)
    {
        Generate(
            strategyWeights: weights,
            runnerMarketAllocationWeights: null,
            canonicalCioPostGatingWeights: null,
            cashWeight: 0m);
    }

    public void Generate(
        Dictionary<int, decimal> strategyWeights,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, decimal>? marketAllocationWeights,
        decimal cashWeight)
    {
        Generate(
            strategyWeights,
            runnerMarketAllocationWeights: marketAllocationWeights,
            canonicalCioPostGatingWeights: null,
            cashWeight: cashWeight);
    }

    public void Generate(
        Dictionary<int, decimal> strategyWeights,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, decimal>? runnerMarketAllocationWeights,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, decimal>? canonicalCioPostGatingWeights,
        decimal cashWeight)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(strategyWeights);

        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 015 — CAPITAL ALLOCATION");
        sb.AppendLine("================================");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("SECTION A — STRATEGY TRUST WEIGHTS");
        sb.AppendLine("----------------------------------");

        foreach (var w in strategyWeights.OrderByDescending(x => x.Value))
            sb.AppendLine($"Strategy {w.Key:00} -> {(w.Value * 100m):F2}%");

        sb.AppendLine();

        AppendRunnerCandidateMixSection(
            sb,
            runnerMarketAllocationWeights,
            cashWeight);

        AppendCanonicalDeployableSection(
            sb,
            canonicalCioPostGatingWeights,
            cashWeight);

        var definition = ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("CAPITAL", "015");
        var naming = new ReportFileNamingService();
        string fileName = naming.BuildLocalFileName(definition, DateTime.UtcNow, ".txt");

        File.WriteAllText(
            Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, fileName),
            sb.ToString());
    }

    private static void AppendRunnerCandidateMixSection(
        StringBuilder sb,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, decimal>? runnerMarketAllocationWeights,
        decimal cashWeight)
    {
        sb.AppendLine("SECTION B — RUNNER CANDIDATE MIX (PRE-DEPLOYMENT)");
        sb.AppendLine("-------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("SEMANTICS: These weights describe relative mix inside the candidate sleeve.");
        sb.AppendLine("SEMANTICS: They are NOT gross deployed portfolio weights.");
        sb.AppendLine("SEMANTICS: Preserved cash is shown only as a reference to downstream deployment posture.");
        sb.AppendLine();

        if (runnerMarketAllocationWeights is null || runnerMarketAllocationWeights.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO DATA: Runner candidate mix is empty.");
            sb.AppendLine($"Reference Preserved Cash (gross) -> {(cashWeight * 100m):F2}%");
            sb.AppendLine();
            return;
        }

        foreach (var kv in runnerMarketAllocationWeights.OrderByDescending(x => x.Value))
            sb.AppendLine($"{kv.Key} -> {(kv.Value * 100m):F2}%");

        sb.AppendLine($"Reference Preserved Cash (gross) -> {(cashWeight * 100m):F2}%");
        sb.AppendLine();

        AppendCandidateMixMetrics(
            sb,
            sectionTitle: "SECTION C — RUNNER CANDIDATE MIX METRICS",
            underline: "-----------------------------------------",
            candidateMixWeights: runnerMarketAllocationWeights,
            referenceCashWeight: cashWeight);
    }

    private static void AppendCanonicalDeployableSection(
        StringBuilder sb,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, decimal>? canonicalCioPostGatingWeights,
        decimal cashWeight)
    {
        sb.AppendLine("SECTION D — CANONICAL DEPLOYABLE CIO ALLOCATION (GROSS CAPITAL)");
        sb.AppendLine("---------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("SEMANTICS: This section is the true post-gating deployable capital snapshot.");
        sb.AppendLine("SEMANTICS: Cash here is gross preserved capital, paired directly with canonical CIO weights.");
        sb.AppendLine();

        if (canonicalCioPostGatingWeights is null)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO DATA: Canonical post-gating CIO allocation is null.");
            sb.AppendLine($"CASH -> {(cashWeight * 100m):F2}%");
            sb.AppendLine();
            return;
        }

        if (canonicalCioPostGatingWeights.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO DATA: Canonical post-gating CIO weights are empty.");
            sb.AppendLine($"CASH -> {(cashWeight * 100m):F2}%");
            sb.AppendLine();

            AppendDeployableAllocationMetrics(
                sb,
                sectionTitle: "SECTION E — CANONICAL DEPLOYABLE ALLOCATION METRICS",
                underline: "----------------------------------------------------",
                deployableWeights: canonicalCioPostGatingWeights,
                cashWeight: cashWeight);

            return;
        }

        foreach (var kv in canonicalCioPostGatingWeights.OrderByDescending(x => x.Value))
            sb.AppendLine($"{kv.Key} -> {(kv.Value * 100m):F2}%");

        sb.AppendLine($"CASH -> {(cashWeight * 100m):F2}%");
        sb.AppendLine();

        AppendDeployableAllocationMetrics(
            sb,
            sectionTitle: "SECTION E — CANONICAL DEPLOYABLE ALLOCATION METRICS",
            underline: "----------------------------------------------------",
            deployableWeights: canonicalCioPostGatingWeights,
            cashWeight: cashWeight);
    }

    private static void AppendCandidateMixMetrics(
        StringBuilder sb,
        string sectionTitle,
        string underline,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, decimal> candidateMixWeights,
        decimal referenceCashWeight)
    {
        sb.AppendLine(sectionTitle);
        sb.AppendLine(underline);

        int marketCount = candidateMixWeights.Count;
        decimal mixSum = candidateMixWeights.Values.Sum();
        decimal maxWeight = candidateMixWeights.Values.DefaultIfEmpty(0m).Max();
        decimal minWeight = candidateMixWeights.Values.DefaultIfEmpty(0m).Min();
        decimal hhi = candidateMixWeights.Values.Sum(x => x * x);

        sb.AppendLine($"Candidate Markets: {marketCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Candidate Mix Sum: {(mixSum * 100m):F2}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Reference Preserved Cash (gross): {(referenceCashWeight * 100m):F2}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Max Candidate Sleeve Weight: {(maxWeight * 100m):F2}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Min Candidate Sleeve Weight: {(minWeight * 100m):F2}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"HHI Candidate Mix: {hhi:F4}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("INTERPRETATION");
        sb.AppendLine("--------------");
        sb.AppendLine("Candidate mix weights are internal sleeve proportions only.");
        sb.AppendLine("Do NOT add candidate mix sum and preserved cash together.");
        sb.AppendLine("Gross deployment truth is reported only in Section D / Section E.");
        sb.AppendLine();
    }

    private static void AppendDeployableAllocationMetrics(
        StringBuilder sb,
        string sectionTitle,
        string underline,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, decimal> deployableWeights,
        decimal cashWeight)
    {
        sb.AppendLine(sectionTitle);
        sb.AppendLine(underline);

        int marketCount = deployableWeights.Count;
        decimal totalAllocated = deployableWeights.Values.Sum();
        decimal maxWeight = deployableWeights.Values.DefaultIfEmpty(0m).Max();
        decimal minWeight = deployableWeights.Values.DefaultIfEmpty(0m).Min();
        decimal hhi = deployableWeights.Values.Sum(x => x * x);
        decimal grossTotal = totalAllocated + cashWeight;

        sb.AppendLine($"Deployable Markets: {marketCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Gross Deployable Allocation: {(totalAllocated * 100m):F2}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Gross Preserved Cash: {(cashWeight * 100m):F2}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Gross Total (Deployable + Cash): {(grossTotal * 100m):F2}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Max Gross Market Weight: {(maxWeight * 100m):F2}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Min Gross Market Weight: {(minWeight * 100m):F2}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"HHI Deployable Allocation: {hhi:F4}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("REALISM / RISK FLAGS");
        sb.AppendLine("--------------------");

        bool wroteWarning = false;

        if (marketCount == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("WARNING: No deployable markets survived into canonical CIO allocation.");
            wroteWarning = true;
        }

        if (marketCount == 1)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("WARNING: Single-market deployable allocation. Institutional diversification is absent.");
            wroteWarning = true;
        }
        else if (marketCount <= 3)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("WARNING: Very low deployable breadth.");
            wroteWarning = true;
        }
        else if (marketCount < 5)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("WARNING: Low deployable breadth.");
            wroteWarning = true;
        }

        if (maxWeight >= 0.90m)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("WARNING: Extreme gross concentration. One market dominates almost all deployable capital.");
            wroteWarning = true;
        }
        else if (maxWeight >= 0.80m)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("WARNING: Severe gross concentration. Max market weight exceeds 80%.");
            wroteWarning = true;
        }
        else if (maxWeight >= 0.60m)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("WARNING: High gross concentration. Max market weight exceeds 60%.");
            wroteWarning = true;
        }
        else if (maxWeight > 0.25m)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("WARNING: Elevated gross concentration. Max market weight exceeds 25%.");
            wroteWarning = true;
        }

        if (hhi >= 0.80m)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("WARNING: HHI indicates extreme deployable concentration.");
            wroteWarning = true;
        }
        else if (hhi >= 0.50m)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("WARNING: HHI indicates high deployable concentration.");
            wroteWarning = true;
        }

        if (cashWeight > 0.25m)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("WARNING: High preserved cash.");
            wroteWarning = true;
        }

        if (Math.Abs(grossTotal - 1m) > 0.0001m)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("WARNING: Gross deployable allocation plus cash does not reconcile to 100.00%.");
            wroteWarning = true;
        }

        if (!wroteWarning)
            sb.AppendLine("OK: No major deployable capital warning under current thresholds.");

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("OPERATOR INTERPRETATION");
        sb.AppendLine("-----------------------");

        if (marketCount == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("Capital realism is weak because no markets survived into gross deployable CIO allocation.");
        }
        else if (marketCount == 1 || maxWeight >= 0.80m)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("Capital realism is weak for institutional use. The system is effectively operating as a single-edge deployer.");
        }
        else if (marketCount <= 3 || maxWeight >= 0.60m)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("Capital realism is moderate-to-weak. Deployable breadth is limited and concentration risk is material.");
        }
        else
        {
            sb.AppendLine("Capital realism is acceptable under current simple deployable concentration thresholds.");
        }

        if (cashWeight > 0.25m)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("High cash may be correct under Patch 20 / Patch 21 defensive posture when regime quality and breadth are weak.");
        }

        sb.AppendLine();
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

public sealed class CodeAuditMasterReportService
{
    private const string ArchitectureRelativePath = @"TQGA.Application\Docs\TQGA_ARCHITECTURE_STATE.txt";

    public string GenerateFromSolutionRoot(string solutionRootPath)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(solutionRootPath))
            throw new ArgumentException("Solution root path is required.", nameof(solutionRootPath));

        if (!Directory.Exists(solutionRootPath))
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"Solution root path not found: {solutionRootPath}");

        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        string timeStamp = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd__HH-mm-ss");
        string outFile = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, $"TQGA_AUDIT_MASTER__{timeStamp}.txt");
        string outputFileName = Path.GetFileName(outFile);

        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        // TOP HEADER
        sb.AppendLine("===== TQGA AUDIT MASTER =====");
        sb.AppendLine($"FILE NAME: {outputFileName}");
        sb.AppendLine($"FULL PATH: {outFile}");
        sb.AppendLine($"GENERATED: {DateTime.Now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        WriteProjectTree(sb, solutionRootPath);
        WriteSolutionAndProjectFiles(sb, solutionRootPath);
        WriteSourceFiles(sb, solutionRootPath);
        WriteArchitectureDocument(sb, solutionRootPath);

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("===== AUDIT COMPLETE =====");

        string auditText = sb.ToString();

        File.WriteAllText(
            outFile,
            auditText,
            new UTF8Encoding(encoderShouldEmitUTF8Identifier: false));

        // ALSO GENERATE HTML COMPANION FILE
        string htmlFile = Path.ChangeExtension(outFile, ".html");
        string htmlContent = BuildHtmlWrapper(auditText);

        File.WriteAllText(
            htmlFile,
            htmlContent,
            new UTF8Encoding(encoderShouldEmitUTF8Identifier: false));

        return outFile;
    }

    private static void WriteProjectTree(StringBuilder sb, string solutionRootPath)
    {
        sb.AppendLine("===== PROJECT TREE =====");

        foreach (string line in BuildDirectoryTree(solutionRootPath))
            sb.AppendLine(line);
    }

    private static void WriteSolutionAndProjectFiles(StringBuilder sb, string solutionRootPath)
    {
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("===== SOLUTION & PROJECT FILES =====");
        sb.AppendLine();

        foreach (string file in Directory
                     .EnumerateFiles(solutionRootPath, "*.sln", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
                     .Where(x => !IsExcludedPath(x))
                     .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            WriteFileBlock(sb, file, ".sln", includeLineCount: false);
        }

        foreach (string file in Directory
                     .EnumerateFiles(solutionRootPath, "*.csproj", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
                     .Where(x => !IsExcludedPath(x))
                     .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            WriteFileBlock(sb, file, ".csproj", includeLineCount: false);
        }
    }

    private static void WriteSourceFiles(StringBuilder sb, string solutionRootPath)
    {
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("===== SOURCE FILES (.cs) =====");
        sb.AppendLine();

        foreach (string file in Directory
                     .EnumerateFiles(solutionRootPath, "*.cs", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
                     .Where(x => !IsExcludedPath(x))
                     .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            WriteFileBlock(sb, file, ".cs", includeLineCount: true);
        }
    }

    private static void WriteArchitectureDocument(StringBuilder sb, string solutionRootPath)
    {
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("===== ARCHITECTURE DOCUMENTS =====");
        sb.AppendLine();

        string architectureFile = Path.Combine(solutionRootPath, ArchitectureRelativePath);

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("==============================");
        sb.AppendLine($"FILE: {architectureFile}");

        if (!File.Exists(architectureFile))
        {
            sb.AppendLine("STATUS: NOT FOUND");
            sb.AppendLine("==============================");
            return;
        }

        FileInfo info = new(architectureFile);
        int lines = CountLines(architectureFile);

        sb.AppendLine("TYPE: .txt");
        sb.AppendLine($"SIZE: {Math.Round(info.Length / 1024d, 2)} KB");
        sb.AppendLine($"LINES: {lines}");
        sb.AppendLine("==============================");

        foreach (string line in File.ReadLines(architectureFile))
            sb.AppendLine(line);
    }

    private static void WriteFileBlock(
        StringBuilder sb,
        string filePath,
        string typeLabel,
        bool includeLineCount)
    {
        FileInfo info = new(filePath);

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("==============================");
        sb.AppendLine($"FILE: {filePath}");
        sb.AppendLine($"TYPE: {typeLabel}");
        sb.AppendLine($"SIZE: {Math.Round(info.Length / 1024d, 2)} KB");

        if (includeLineCount)
            sb.AppendLine($"LINES: {CountLines(filePath)}");

        sb.AppendLine("==============================");

        foreach (string line in File.ReadLines(filePath))
            sb.AppendLine(line);
    }

    private static int CountLines(string filePath)
    {
        int count = 0;

        foreach (string _ in File.ReadLines(filePath))
            count++;

        return count;
    }

    private static bool IsExcludedPath(string path)
    {
        return path.Contains(@"\bin\", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || path.Contains(@"\obj\", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    private static IEnumerable<string> BuildDirectoryTree(string rootPath)
    {
        var lines = new List<string>();
        var rootDir = new DirectoryInfo(rootPath);

        lines.Add(rootDir.FullName);
        AddDirectoryRecursive(rootDir, lines, prefix: "");

        return lines;
    }

    private static void AddDirectoryRecursive(DirectoryInfo dir, List<string> lines, string prefix)
    {
        var directories = dir.GetDirectories()
            .Where(d => !IsExcludedPath(d.FullName))
            .OrderBy(d => d.Name, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        var files = dir.GetFiles()
            .OrderBy(f => f.Name, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        int total = directories.Count + files.Count;

        for (int i = 0; i < total; i++)
        {
            bool isLast = i == total - 1;

            if (i < directories.Count)
            {
                DirectoryInfo childDir = directories[i];
                lines.Add($"{prefix}{(isLast ? "└───" : "├───")}{childDir.Name}");
                AddDirectoryRecursive(childDir, lines, prefix + (isLast ? "    " : "│   "));
            }
            else
            {
                FileInfo file = files[i - directories.Count];
                lines.Add($"{prefix}{(isLast ? "└───" : "├───")}{file.Name}");
            }
        }
    }

    private static string BuildHtmlWrapper(string auditText)
    {
        string encoded = HtmlEncode(auditText);

        return
$@"<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset=""utf-8"">
  <title>TQGA Audit Master</title>
</head>
<body>
<div>
<pre>

{encoded}

</pre>
</div>
</body>
</html>";
    }

    private static string HtmlEncode(string text)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
            return string.Empty;

        return text
            .Replace("&", "&amp;")
            .Replace("<", "&lt;")
            .Replace(">", "&gt;");
    }
}

using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

public sealed class FullReportService
{
    private static readonly string[] IncludeExtensions = { ".txt", ".csv" };

    private const string Report32Prefix = "REPORT_32_TRADE_BLOTTER_ENTRY_EXIT_REASON_JOURNAL_";
    private const string Report33Prefix = "REPORT_33_TRADE_INTELLIGENCE_MASTER_";
    private const string Report34Prefix = "REPORT_34_TRADE_BLOTTER_";
    private const string Report35Prefix = "REPORT_35_TRADE_INTELLIGENCE_";
    private const string Report36Prefix = "REPORT_36_SOLO_STRATEGY_SCORE_SUMMARY_";

    public string BuildCombinedReport()
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        var files = Directory
            .EnumerateFiles(DataPaths.Reports, "*.*", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly)
            .Where(ShouldIncludeInCombinedReport)
            .OrderBy(f => Path.GetFileName(f), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 999 — REPORT ALL");
        sb.AppendLine("=======================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Folder: {DataPaths.Reports}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Files:  {files.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"UTC:    {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("SIZE CONTROL POLICY");
        sb.AppendLine("-------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 32 TXT omitted from combined report for GitHub size control.");
        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 32 CSV omitted from combined report for GitHub size control.");
        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 33 TXT omitted from combined report for GitHub size control.");
        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 33 CSV omitted from combined report for GitHub size control.");
        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 34 TXT omitted from combined report. Publish separately as standalone Report_34.html.");
        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 35 TXT omitted from combined report. Publish separately as standalone Report_35.html.");
        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 36 TXT omitted from combined report. Publish separately as standalone Report_36.html.");
        sb.AppendLine();

        AppendCompactReplacementNotice(sb);
        sb.AppendLine();

        foreach (var file in files)
        {
            string name = Path.GetFileName(file);

            sb.AppendLine($"FILE: {name}");
            sb.AppendLine(new string('-', 70));
            sb.AppendLine(File.ReadAllText(file));
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine(new string('=', 70));
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        return sb.ToString();
    }

    public string BuildChatGptSizedReport(int maxChars = 120_000)
    {
        string full = BuildCombinedReport();
        return full.Length <= maxChars ? full : full[..maxChars];
    }

    public string SaveCombinedToFile()
    {
        string text = BuildCombinedReport();
        var reportDefinition = TQGA.Application.Reporting.ReportCatalog.ReportAll;
        var naming = new TQGA.Application.Reporting.ReportFileNamingService();
        string fileName = naming.BuildLocalFileName(reportDefinition, DateTime.UtcNow, ".txt");
        string path = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, fileName);

        File.WriteAllText(path, text);
        return path;
    }

    private static bool ShouldIncludeInCombinedReport(string filePath)
    {
        string extension = Path.GetExtension(filePath);
        if (!IncludeExtensions.Contains(extension, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return false;

        string fileName = Path.GetFileName(filePath);

        if (fileName.StartsWith(Report32Prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return false;

        if (fileName.StartsWith(Report33Prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return false;

        if (fileName.StartsWith(Report34Prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return false;

        if (fileName.StartsWith(Report35Prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return false;

        if (fileName.StartsWith(Report36Prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return false;

        return true;
    }

    private static void AppendCompactReplacementNotice(StringBuilder sb)
    {
        string? report32Txt = GetLatestFile($"{Report32Prefix}*.txt");
        string? report32Csv = GetLatestFile($"{Report32Prefix}*.csv");
        string? report33Txt = GetLatestFile($"{Report33Prefix}*.txt");
        string? report33Csv = GetLatestFile($"{Report33Prefix}*.csv");
        string? report34Txt = GetLatestFile($"{Report34Prefix}*.txt");
        string? report35Txt = GetLatestFile($"{Report35Prefix}*.txt");
        string? report36Txt = GetLatestFile($"{Report36Prefix}*.txt");

        if (report32Txt != null)
            sb.AppendLine($"OMITTED: {Path.GetFileName(report32Txt)} -- superseded by standalone REPORT 34");

        if (report32Csv != null)
            sb.AppendLine($"OMITTED: {Path.GetFileName(report32Csv)} -- superseded by standalone REPORT 34");

        if (report33Txt != null)
            sb.AppendLine($"OMITTED: {Path.GetFileName(report33Txt)} -- superseded by standalone REPORT 35");

        if (report33Csv != null)
            sb.AppendLine($"OMITTED: {Path.GetFileName(report33Csv)} -- superseded by standalone REPORT 35");

        if (report34Txt != null)
            sb.AppendLine($"STANDALONE: {Path.GetFileName(report34Txt)} -> Publish to Report_34.html");

        if (report35Txt != null)
            sb.AppendLine($"STANDALONE: {Path.GetFileName(report35Txt)} -> Publish to Report_35.html");

        if (report36Txt != null)
            sb.AppendLine($"STANDALONE: {Path.GetFileName(report36Txt)} -> Publish to Report_36.html");
    }

    private static string? GetLatestFile(string pattern)
    {
        return Directory
            .EnumerateFiles(DataPaths.Reports, pattern, SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly)
            .OrderByDescending(File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc)
            .FirstOrDefault();
    }
}

using System;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

public sealed class GitHubCodeAuditPublishService
{
    private const string TargetPublishedFileName = "fourtyfied561234598.html";
    private const string PublicUrl = "https://arifpisonium.github.io/fourtyfied561234598.html";
    private const string RemoteName = "origin";
    private const string BranchName = "main";

    public GitHubCodeAuditPublishResult PublishLatestAuditHtml(string repoRootPath)
    {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(repoRootPath);

        if (!Directory.Exists(repoRootPath))
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"GitHub Pages repo folder not found: {repoRootPath}");

        EnsureGitRepository(repoRootPath);

        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        string latestAuditHtml = Directory
            .EnumerateFiles(DataPaths.Reports, "TQGA_AUDIT_MASTER__*.html", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly)
            .OrderByDescending(File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc)
            .FirstOrDefault()
            ?? throw new FileNotFoundException(
                "No generated audit HTML file was found in Reports. Please click CODES FILE first.");

        string sourceHtmlText = File.ReadAllText(latestAuditHtml, Encoding.UTF8);
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sourceHtmlText))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Audit HTML file is empty: {latestAuditHtml}");

        // PATCH:
        // This repo is a publish mirror and may be edited manually on GitHub web.
        // We do NOT want rebase/merge conflict workflows here.
        // Always recover to a clean state first, then hard-sync to origin/main.

        // 1) Abort any unfinished rebase if present.
        RunGit(repoRootPath, "rebase --abort", allowFailure: true);

        // 2) Fetch latest remote state.
        RunGit(repoRootPath, $"fetch {RemoteName}");

        // 3) Force local repo to match remote main exactly.
        // This intentionally discards local uncommitted / unpublished repo changes.
        RunGit(repoRootPath, $"reset --hard {RemoteName}/{BranchName}");

        string destinationPath = Path.Combine(repoRootPath, TargetPublishedFileName);
        string timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss");

        File.WriteAllText(destinationPath, sourceHtmlText, new UTF8Encoding(encoderShouldEmitUTF8Identifier: false));

        RunGit(repoRootPath, $"add \"{TargetPublishedFileName}\"");
        RunGit(repoRootPath, $"commit -m \"TQGA code audit publish {timestamp}\"", allowNoChanges: true);
        RunGit(repoRootPath, $"push {RemoteName} {BranchName}");

        return new GitHubCodeAuditPublishResult
        {
            RepoRootPath = repoRootPath,
            SourceAuditHtmlPath = latestAuditHtml,
            PublishedHtmlPath = destinationPath,
            PublicUrl = PublicUrl
        };
    }

    private static void EnsureGitRepository(string repoRootPath)
    {
        string gitFolder = Path.Combine(repoRootPath, ".git");
        if (!Directory.Exists(gitFolder))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"Selected folder is not a Git repository. Missing .git folder at: {repoRootPath}");
        }
    }

    private static void RunGit(
        string workingDirectory,
        string arguments,
        bool allowNoChanges = false,
        bool allowFailure = false)
    {
        string gitExePath = ResolveGitExecutablePath();

        using var process = new Process();
        process.StartInfo = new ProcessStartInfo
        {
            FileName = gitExePath,
            Arguments = arguments,
            WorkingDirectory = workingDirectory,
            RedirectStandardOutput = true,
            RedirectStandardError = true,
            UseShellExecute = false,
            CreateNoWindow = true
        };

        try
        {
            process.Start();
        }
        catch (Win32Exception ex)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "Git executable could not be started. Install Git for Windows or add git.exe to PATH. " +
                $"Resolved git path attempt: {gitExePath}",
                ex);
        }

        string stdOut = process.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd();
        string stdErr = process.StandardError.ReadToEnd();

        process.WaitForExit();

        if (process.ExitCode == 0)
            return;

        string combined = $"{stdOut}\n{stdErr}".Trim();

        if (allowFailure)
            return;

        if (allowNoChanges &&
            (combined.Contains("nothing to commit", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
             combined.Contains("no changes added to commit", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
        {
            return;
        }

        throw new InvalidOperationException(
            $"Git command failed.\n\nCommand: git {arguments}\n\nOutput:\n{combined}");
    }

    private static string ResolveGitExecutablePath()
    {
        string[] candidates =
        [
            "git",
            @"C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe",
            @"C:\Program Files\Git\bin\git.exe",
            @"C:\Program Files (x86)\Git\cmd\git.exe",
            @"C:\Program Files (x86)\Git\bin\git.exe"
        ];

        foreach (string candidate in candidates)
        {
            if (candidate.Equals("git", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return candidate;

            if (File.Exists(candidate))
                return candidate;
        }

        return "git";
    }
}

public sealed class GitHubCodeAuditPublishResult
{
    public string RepoRootPath { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public string SourceAuditHtmlPath { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public string PublishedHtmlPath { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public string PublicUrl { get; init; } = string.Empty;
}

using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

public sealed class GitHubPagesPublishService
{
    private const string RepoPathConfigFileName = "github_pages_repo_path.txt";
    private const int WebSafeMaxChars = 500_000;
    private const string RemoteName = "origin";
    private const string BranchName = "main";

    private const string CodesFolderName = "TQGA_Codes";

    private const string PublicBaseUrl = "https://arifpisonium.github.io";
    private const string GitHubEditBaseUrl = "https://github.com/arifpisonium/arifpisonium.github.io/edit/main";

    private static readonly string[] ReportExtensions =
    [
        ".txt", ".csv", ".html"
    ];

    private static readonly string[] CodeExtensions =
    [
        ".cs", ".sln", ".csproj", ".props", ".targets", ".json", ".config",
        ".xml", ".md", ".yml", ".yaml", ".txt", ".sql", ".ps1", ".cmd", ".bat"
    ];

    private static readonly string[] ExcludedCodeDirectories =
    [
        ".git", ".vs", "bin", "obj", "packages", "node_modules",
        ReportsFolderName, CodesFolderName
    ];

    private static readonly string[] PreferredCodeRoots =
    [
        "TQGA.Application",
        "TQGA.Domain",
        "TQGA.Infrastructure",
        "TQGA.WinForms"
    ];

    public GitHubPagesPublishResult PublishReportAll31(
        string sourceReportPath,
        string sourceReportText,
        string repoRootPath)
    {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(sourceReportPath);
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(sourceReportText);
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(repoRootPath);

        if (!File.Exists(sourceReportPath))
            throw new FileNotFoundException("Source report file not found.", sourceReportPath);

        if (!Directory.Exists(repoRootPath))
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"GitHub Pages repo folder not found: {repoRootPath}");

        EnsureGitRepository(repoRootPath);

        string timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss");
        string sourceFileName = Path.GetFileName(sourceReportPath);

        string localArchiveRoot = GetLocalArchiveRoot(repoRootPath);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(localArchiveRoot);

        string archivedReportPath = Path.Combine(
            localArchiveRoot,
            $"REPORT_ALL_31_{timestamp}.txt");

        string latestReportPath = Path.Combine(repoRootPath, "FULL_REPORT_LATEST.txt");
        string latestHtmlPath = Path.Combine(repoRootPath, "index.html");
        string reportsIndexHtmlPath = Path.Combine(repoRootPath, "reports.html");
        string gitIgnorePath = Path.Combine(repoRootPath, ".gitignore");

        File.Copy(sourceReportPath, archivedReportPath, overwrite: true);

        string webSafeText = TrimReportForWeb(sourceReportText, WebSafeMaxChars);
        File.WriteAllText(latestReportPath, webSafeText, Encoding.UTF8);

        string html = BuildHtmlAuditPage(webSafeText, sourceFileName, timestamp);
        File.WriteAllText(latestHtmlPath, html, Encoding.UTF8);

        string reportsIndexHtml = BuildReportsIndexPage(localArchiveRoot);
        File.WriteAllText(reportsIndexHtmlPath, reportsIndexHtml, Encoding.UTF8);

        EnsureGitIgnoreRules(gitIgnorePath);

        CleanupGitTrackedLargeFiles(repoRootPath);
        CleanupPhysicalLargeFilesFromRepoRoot(repoRootPath);

        RunGit(repoRootPath, "add .");
        RunGit(repoRootPath, $"commit -m \"TQGA auto publish {timestamp}\"", allowNoChanges: true);
        RunGit(repoRootPath, "push");

        SaveRepoPath(repoRootPath);

        return new GitHubPagesPublishResult
        {
            RepoRootPath = repoRootPath,
            SourceReportPath = sourceReportPath,
            PublishedLatestTextPath = latestReportPath,
            PublishedIndexHtmlPath = latestHtmlPath,
            PublishedArchiveReportPath = archivedReportPath,
            PublishedReportsIndexPath = reportsIndexHtmlPath,
            PublicUrl = $"{PublicBaseUrl}/",
            PublicLatestTextUrl = $"{PublicBaseUrl}/FULL_REPORT_LATEST.txt",
            PublicReportsIndexUrl = $"{PublicBaseUrl}/reports.html"
        };
    }

    public GitHubLatestReportHtmlPublishResult PublishLatestReportAll31Html(string repoRootPath)
    {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(repoRootPath);

        if (!Directory.Exists(repoRootPath))
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"GitHub Pages repo folder not found: {repoRootPath}");

        EnsureGitRepository(repoRootPath);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        string latestReportHtmlPath = Directory
            .EnumerateFiles(DataPaths.Reports, "REPORT_ALL_31_*.html", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly)
            .OrderByDescending(File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc)
            .FirstOrDefault()
            ?? throw new FileNotFoundException(
                "No generated REPORT_ALL_31 HTML file was found in Reports. Please click REPORT ALL 31 first.");

        string sourceHtmlText = File.ReadAllText(latestReportHtmlPath, Encoding.UTF8);
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sourceHtmlText))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"REPORT_ALL_31 HTML file is empty: {latestReportHtmlPath}");

        string timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss");
        string localArchiveRoot = GetLocalArchiveRoot(repoRootPath);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(localArchiveRoot);

        string archivedHtmlPath = Path.Combine(
            localArchiveRoot,
            $"REPORT_ALL_31_PUBLISHED_HTML_{timestamp}.html");

        string publishedIndexHtmlPath = Path.Combine(repoRootPath, "index.html");

        File.Copy(latestReportHtmlPath, archivedHtmlPath, overwrite: true);
        File.WriteAllText(
            publishedIndexHtmlPath,
            sourceHtmlText,
            new UTF8Encoding(encoderShouldEmitUTF8Identifier: false));

        RunGit(repoRootPath, "add index.html");
        RunGit(repoRootPath, $"commit -m \"TQGA report html publish {timestamp}\"", allowNoChanges: true);
        RunGit(repoRootPath, $"push {RemoteName} {BranchName}");

        SaveRepoPath(repoRootPath);

        return new GitHubLatestReportHtmlPublishResult
        {
            RepoRootPath = repoRootPath,
            SourceReportHtmlPath = latestReportHtmlPath,
            PublishedIndexHtmlPath = publishedIndexHtmlPath,
            ArchivedHtmlPath = archivedHtmlPath,
            PublicUrl = $"{PublicBaseUrl}/"
        };
    }

    public GitHubFoldersPublishResult PublishTqgaReportsAndCodes(
        string repoRootPath,
        string localReportsPath,
        string localSolutionRoot)
    {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(repoRootPath);
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(localReportsPath);
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(localSolutionRoot);

        if (!Directory.Exists(repoRootPath))
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"GitHub Pages repo folder not found: {repoRootPath}");

        if (!Directory.Exists(localReportsPath))
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"Local Reports folder not found: {localReportsPath}");

        if (!Directory.Exists(localSolutionRoot))
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"Local TQGA solution folder not found: {localSolutionRoot}");

        EnsureGitRepository(repoRootPath);

        string reportsPublishRoot = Path.Combine(repoRootPath, ReportsFolderName);
        string codesPublishRoot = Path.Combine(repoRootPath, CodesFolderName);

        Directory.CreateDirectory(reportsPublishRoot);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(codesPublishRoot);

        ClearPublishedFolderContents(reportsPublishRoot);
        ClearPublishedFolderContents(codesPublishRoot);

        List<GeneratedPageInfo> reportPages = PublishReportFolderIncremental(localReportsPath, reportsPublishRoot);
        List<GeneratedPageInfo> codePages = PublishCodeFolderIncremental(localSolutionRoot, codesPublishRoot);

        string reportsIndexPath = Path.Combine(reportsPublishRoot, "index.html");
        string codesIndexPath = Path.Combine(codesPublishRoot, "index.html");

        WriteFileIfChanged(
            reportsIndexPath,
            BuildGeneratedFolderIndexPage(
                title: "TQGA Reports",
                description: "Published report pages generated automatically from the local Reports folder.",
                webBasePath: ReportsFolderName,
                pages: reportPages));

        WriteFileIfChanged(
            codesIndexPath,
            BuildGeneratedFolderIndexPage(
                title: "TQGA Codes",
                description: "Published code pages generated automatically from the local TQGA solution folder.",
                webBasePath: CodesFolderName,
                pages: codePages));

        RunGit(repoRootPath, $"add \"{ReportsFolderName}\" \"{CodesFolderName}\"");
        RunGit(repoRootPath, $"commit -m \"TQGA publish reports and codes folders {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}\"", allowNoChanges: true);
        RunGit(repoRootPath, $"push {RemoteName} {BranchName}");

        SaveRepoPath(repoRootPath);

        return new GitHubFoldersPublishResult
        {
            RepoRootPath = repoRootPath,
            LocalReportsPath = localReportsPath,
            LocalSolutionRoot = localSolutionRoot,
            ReportsFolderPath = reportsPublishRoot,
            CodesFolderPath = codesPublishRoot,
            ReportsPublishedCount = reportPages.Count,
            CodesPublishedCount = codePages.Count,
            ReportsRootPublicUrl = $"{PublicBaseUrl}/{ReportsFolderName}/",
            CodesRootPublicUrl = $"{PublicBaseUrl}/{CodesFolderName}/",
            ReportsRootEditUrl = $"{GitHubEditBaseUrl}/{ReportsFolderName}/index.html",
            CodesRootEditUrl = $"{GitHubEditBaseUrl}/{CodesFolderName}/index.html"
        };
    }
