        sb.AppendLine("-----------------");
        sb.AppendLine("1) If one family clearly dominates here, next work should target that family specifically.");
        sb.AppendLine("2) If no family is compelling, stop admission tuning and consider a truly different alpha archetype.");
        sb.AppendLine("3) Prefer 4h-compatible families first because live winners remain concentrated in 4h.");
        sb.AppendLine();

        File.WriteAllText(path, sb.ToString());
    }

    private static string BuildTxtPath(ReportDefinition definition, DateTime runUtc)
    {
        string stamp = runUtc.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss");
        return Path.Combine(
            DataPaths.Reports,
            $"REPORT_{definition.Number}_{definition.PurposeName}_{stamp}.txt");
    }

    private static EdgeFamilyRow BuildFamilyRow(
        string familyName,
        IReadOnlyList<KeyValuePair<string, string>> rejected4h,
        IReadOnlyList<string> familySymbols,
        IReadOnlySet<string> selectedMarkets)
    {
        var candidates = rejected4h
            .Where(x =>
            {
                string symbol = ExtractSymbol(x.Key);
                return familySymbols.Contains(symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                       && !selectedMarkets.Contains(x.Key);
            })
            .Select(x => BuildCandidateRow(x.Key, x.Value))
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.CandidateScore)
            .ThenBy(x => x.MarketKey, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        string reasonMix = BuildReasonMixSummary(candidates);
        decimal opportunityScore = candidates.Count == 0
            ? 0m
            : candidates.Take(5).Sum(x => x.CandidateScore) / Math.Min(5, candidates.Count);

        string verdict = BuildFamilyVerdict(opportunityScore, candidates.Count);

        return new EdgeFamilyRow(
            familyName,
            candidates.Count,
            reasonMix,
            opportunityScore,
            verdict,
            candidates);
    }

    private static CandidateRow BuildCandidateRow(string marketKey, string rejectionReason)
    {
        string bucket = NormalizeReasonBucket(rejectionReason);
        decimal score = 0m;

        if (bucket == "WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard") score += 1.00m;
        else if (bucket == "REJECT: regime near-miss lane overflow") score += 0.85m;
        else if (bucket == "REJECT: liquidity tier-2 lane overflow") score += 0.80m;
        else if (bucket == "REJECT: regime not trend/high-vol-up") score += 0.60m;
        else if (bucket == "REJECT: low liquidity") score += 0.50m;
        else if (bucket == "REJECT: outside top leadership set") score += 0.45m;
        else score += 0.30m;

        return new CandidateRow(marketKey, bucket, score);
    }

    private static string NormalizeReasonBucket(string rejectionReason)
    {
        string value = rejectionReason?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;

        if (value.StartsWith("WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: regime near-miss lane overflow", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: regime near-miss lane overflow";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: liquidity tier-2 lane overflow", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: liquidity tier-2 lane overflow";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: regime not trend/high-vol-up", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: regime not trend/high-vol-up";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: low liquidity", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: low liquidity";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: outside top", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: outside top leadership set";

        return value;
    }

    private static string BuildReasonMixSummary(IReadOnlyList<CandidateRow> candidates)
    {
        if (candidates.Count == 0)
            return "NO CANDIDATES";

        var parts = candidates
            .GroupBy(x => x.ReasonBucket)
            .OrderByDescending(g => g.Count())
            .ThenBy(g => g.Key, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Take(3)
            .Select(g => $"{g.Key}={g.Count()}")
            .ToList();

        return string.Join(" | ", parts);
    }

    private static string BuildFamilyVerdict(decimal opportunityScore, int candidateCount)
    {
        if (candidateCount == 0)
            return "No opportunity";

        if (opportunityScore >= 0.90m)
            return "Best new-edge family";

        if (opportunityScore >= 0.75m)
            return "Strong research family";

        if (opportunityScore >= 0.60m)
            return "Secondary research family";

        return "Low-priority family";
    }

    private static string BuildVerdict(
        IReadOnlyList<EdgeFamilyRow> rankedFamilies,
        int liveWinnerCount,
        decimal cashWeight)
    {
        var best = rankedFamilies.FirstOrDefault();

        if (best == null)
            return "No new-edge family opportunity was identified in this run.";

        if (liveWinnerCount <= 1 && cashWeight >= 0.90m && best.OpportunityScore >= 0.75m)
        {
            return $"True new-edge research is now justified. The leading family is {best.FamilyName}.";
        }

        if (liveWinnerCount <= 2 && cashWeight >= 0.75m && best.OpportunityScore >= 0.60m)
        {
            return $"Controlled new-edge research is justified. Start with {best.FamilyName}.";
        }

        return "New-edge family opportunity is present but not decisive yet.";
    }

    private static string ResolveStrategyCode(
        int strategyId,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<int, StrategyFitnessSnapshot> fitnessSnapshots)
    {
        if (fitnessSnapshots.TryGetValue(strategyId, out var snap) &&
            !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(snap.StrategyCode))
        {
            return snap.StrategyCode;
        }

        return $"S{strategyId:00}";
    }

    private static string ExtractSymbol(string marketKey)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(marketKey))
            return string.Empty;

        var parts = marketKey.Split(new[] { "::" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
        return parts.Length >= 1 ? parts[0].Trim() : string.Empty;
    }

    private static string ExtractTimeframe(string marketKey)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(marketKey))
            return string.Empty;

        var parts = marketKey.Split(new[] { "::" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
        return parts.Length >= 2 ? parts[1].Trim() : string.Empty;
    }

    private static string TrimTo(string? text, int maxLen)
    {
        string value = text ?? string.Empty;
        if (value.Length <= maxLen)
            return value;

        if (maxLen <= 3)
            return value[..maxLen];

        return value[..(maxLen - 3)] + "...";
    }

    private sealed record CandidateRow(
        string MarketKey,
        string ReasonBucket,
        decimal CandidateScore);

    private sealed record EdgeFamilyRow(
        string FamilyName,
        int CandidateCount,
        string ReasonMixSummary,
        decimal OpportunityScore,
        string Verdict,
        IReadOnlyList<CandidateRow> TopCandidates);
}

    private static bool IsSeedMarket(string marketKey)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(marketKey))
            return false;

        string symbol = ExtractSymbol(marketKey);
        string timeframe = ExtractTimeframe(marketKey);

        return timeframe.Equals("4h", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
               && SeedSymbols.Contains(symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    private static CandidateRow BuildCandidateRow(
        string marketKey,
        string rejectionReason,
        IReadOnlySet<string> selectedMarkets)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(marketKey))
            return CandidateRow.Empty;

        if (selectedMarkets.Contains(marketKey))
            return CandidateRow.Empty;

        string reasonBucket = NormalizeReasonBucket(rejectionReason);

        decimal s05SimilarityScore = 0m;
        s05SimilarityScore += 0.50m;

        if (reasonBucket == "WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard") s05SimilarityScore += 0.35m;
        else if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: regime near-miss lane overflow") s05SimilarityScore += 0.22m;
        else if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: regime not trend/high-vol-up") s05SimilarityScore += 0.15m;
        else if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: outside top leadership set") s05SimilarityScore += 0.12m;
        else if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: low liquidity") s05SimilarityScore += 0.05m;

        decimal familyScore = s05SimilarityScore;

        bool isRelevant =
            reasonBucket == "WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard" ||
            reasonBucket == "REJECT: regime near-miss lane overflow" ||
            reasonBucket == "REJECT: regime not trend/high-vol-up" ||
            reasonBucket == "REJECT: outside top leadership set" ||
            reasonBucket == "REJECT: low liquidity";

        string verdict = BuildDesignVerdict(reasonBucket, familyScore);

        return new CandidateRow(
            marketKey,
            reasonBucket,
            s05SimilarityScore,
            familyScore,
            verdict,
            isRelevant);
    }

    private static string BuildDesignVerdict(string reasonBucket, decimal familyScore)
    {
        if (reasonBucket == "WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard" && familyScore >= 0.80m)
            return "Best family starter candidate";

        if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: regime near-miss lane overflow" && familyScore >= 0.70m)
            return "Strong secondary family candidate";

        if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: regime not trend/high-vol-up" && familyScore >= 0.60m)
            return "Watch for trend-transition inclusion";

        if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: outside top leadership set" && familyScore >= 0.60m)
            return "Borderline family candidate";

        return "Monitor only";
    }

    private static string NormalizeReasonBucket(string rejectionReason)
    {
        string value = rejectionReason?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;

        if (value.StartsWith("WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: regime near-miss lane overflow", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: regime near-miss lane overflow";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: regime not trend/high-vol-up", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: regime not trend/high-vol-up";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: outside top", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: outside top leadership set";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: low liquidity", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: low liquidity";

        return value;
    }

    private static string ResolveStrategyCode(
        int strategyId,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<int, StrategyFitnessSnapshot> fitnessSnapshots)
    {
        if (fitnessSnapshots.TryGetValue(strategyId, out var snap) &&
            !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(snap.StrategyCode))
        {
            return snap.StrategyCode;
        }

        return $"S{strategyId:00}";
    }

    private static string BuildVerdict(
        IReadOnlyList<CandidateRow> candidates,
        int liveWinnerCount,
        decimal cashWeight)
    {
        bool strongFamily = candidates.Take(3).Any(x => x.FamilyScore >= 0.75m);

        if (liveWinnerCount <= 1 && cashWeight >= 0.90m && strongFamily)
            return "Expand strategy family first. Build one new 4h early-trend continuation sleeve before expanding timeframe count or jumping to 100 pairs.";

        if (liveWinnerCount <= 2 && cashWeight >= 0.75m && strongFamily)
            return "A controlled 4h early-trend continuation family is justified. Keep universe expansion targeted and delay new timeframes.";

        return "Family opportunity exists but is not decisive yet.";
    }

    private static string ExtractSymbol(string marketKey)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(marketKey))
            return string.Empty;

        var parts = marketKey.Split(new[] { "::" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
        return parts.Length >= 1 ? parts[0].Trim() : string.Empty;
    }

    private static string ExtractTimeframe(string marketKey)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(marketKey))
            return string.Empty;

        var parts = marketKey.Split(new[] { "::" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
        return parts.Length >= 2 ? parts[1].Trim() : string.Empty;
    }

    private static string TrimTo(string? text, int maxLen)
    {
        string value = text ?? string.Empty;
        if (value.Length <= maxLen)
            return value;

        if (maxLen <= 3)
            return value[..maxLen];

        return value[..(maxLen - 3)] + "...";
    }

    private sealed record CandidateRow(
        string MarketKey,
        string ReasonBucket,
        decimal S05SimilarityScore,
        decimal FamilyScore,
        string DesignVerdict,
        bool IsRelevant)
    {
        public static CandidateRow Empty =>
            new(string.Empty, string.Empty, 0m, 0m, string.Empty, false);
    }
}

using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Backtesting;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Application.Reporting;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

public sealed class Report28FourHourEarlyTrendContinuationImplementationReadinessAuditService
{
    private static readonly string[] Phase1StarterSymbols =
    [
        "FILUSDT",
        "LINKUSDT",
        "NEARUSDT",
        "SOLUSDT",
        "SUIUSDT",
        "ARBUSDT",
        "DOTUSDT"
    ];

    public void GenerateAndWrite(
        PortfolioBacktestResult result,
        DateTime runUtc,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<int, StrategyFitnessSnapshot> fitnessSnapshots)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(result);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(fitnessSnapshots);

        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        ReportDefinition definition = ReportCatalog.FourHourEarlyTrendContinuationImplementationReadinessAudit;
        string path = BuildTxtPath(definition, runUtc);

        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        var strategyPnl = result.StrategyPnL ?? new Dictionary<int, decimal>();
        var symbolTfPnl = result.SymbolTimeframePnL ?? new Dictionary<string, decimal>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        var rejections = result.MarketSelectionRejections ?? new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        var selectedMarkets = (result.SelectedMarkets ?? new List<string>())
            .ToHashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        decimal s05Pnl = strategyPnl.TryGetValue(5, out var foundS05Pnl)
            ? foundS05Pnl
            : 0m;

        string s05Code = ResolveStrategyCode(5, fitnessSnapshots);

        var liveWinners = symbolTfPnl
            .Where(x => x.Value > 0m)
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.Value)
            .ToList();

        var implementationRows = rejections
            .Where(x => IsStarterMarket(x.Key))
            .Select(x => BuildImplementationRow(x.Key, x.Value, selectedMarkets))
            .Where(x => x.IsRelevant)
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.ReadinessScore)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.FamilyFitScore)
            .ThenBy(x => x.MarketKey, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        decimal totalWinnerPnl = liveWinners.Sum(x => x.Value);
        decimal top2WinnerShare = totalWinnerPnl == 0m
            ? 0m
            : liveWinners.Take(2).Sum(x => x.Value) / totalWinnerPnl;

        sb.AppendLine($"REPORT {definition.Number} — 4H EARLY-TREND CONTINUATION IMPLEMENTATION READINESS AUDIT");
        sb.AppendLine("======================================================================");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("PURPOSE");
        sb.AppendLine("-------");
        sb.AppendLine("Determine whether the new 4h early-trend continuation family is ready for controlled implementation, and define the exact phase-1 starter set.");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("RUN CONTEXT");
        sb.AppendLine("-----------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Run Timestamp (UTC)                : {runUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Number                      : {definition.Number}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Purpose                     : {definition.PurposeName}");
        sb.AppendLine($"S05 Strategy Code                  : {s05Code}");
        sb.AppendLine($"S05 Strategy PnL                   : {s05Pnl:F2}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Selected Markets Count             : {selectedMarkets.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Cash Allocation Weight             : {result.CashAllocationWeight:P2}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Positive Live Winner Count         : {liveWinners.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Top 2 Winner Share                 : {top2WinnerShare:P2}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Implementation Candidate Count     : {implementationRows.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("LIVE WINNER CLUSTER");
        sb.AppendLine("-------------------");
        if (liveWinners.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO POSITIVE LIVE WINNERS");
        }
        else
        {
            sb.AppendLine("Rank | Symbol::TF                | PnL");
            sb.AppendLine("-----+---------------------------+------------");
            int rank = 1;
            foreach (var kv in liveWinners.Take(10))
            {
                sb.AppendLine($"{rank,4} | {TrimTo(kv.Key, 25),-25} | {kv.Value,10:F2}");
                rank++;
            }
        }
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("IMPLEMENTATION READINESS TABLE");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------");
        if (implementationRows.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO IMPLEMENTATION CANDIDATES FOUND");
        }
        else
        {
            sb.AppendLine("Rank | Market                    | Bucket                           | FamilyFit | ReadyScore | Phase Recommendation");
            sb.AppendLine("-----+---------------------------+----------------------------------+-----------+------------+------------------------------");
            int rank = 1;
            foreach (var row in implementationRows.Take(20))
            {
                sb.AppendLine(
                    $"{rank,4} | {TrimTo(row.MarketKey, 25),-25} | {TrimTo(row.ReasonBucket, 32),-32} | " +
                    $"{row.FamilyFitScore,9:F2} | {row.ReadinessScore,10:F2} | {TrimTo(row.PhaseRecommendation, 28)}");
                rank++;
            }
        }
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("PHASE-1 STARTER SET");
        sb.AppendLine("-------------------");
        if (implementationRows.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO PHASE-1 STARTER SET AVAILABLE");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (var row in implementationRows.Take(4))
            {
                sb.AppendLine(
                    $"{row.MarketKey,-24} " +
                    $"bucket={row.ReasonBucket,-32} " +
                    $"fit={row.FamilyFitScore:F2} " +
                    $"ready={row.ReadinessScore:F2} " +
                    $"=> {row.PhaseRecommendation}");
            }
        }
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("PHASE-2 WATCHLIST");
        sb.AppendLine("-----------------");
        if (implementationRows.Count <= 4)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO PHASE-2 WATCHLIST");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (var row in implementationRows.Skip(4).Take(4))
            {
                sb.AppendLine(
                    $"{row.MarketKey,-24} " +
                    $"bucket={row.ReasonBucket,-32} " +
                    $"fit={row.FamilyFitScore:F2} " +
                    $"ready={row.ReadinessScore:F2} " +
                    $"=> {row.PhaseRecommendation}");
            }
        }
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("IMPLEMENTATION RULES");
        sb.AppendLine("--------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("1) Keep the new family on 4h only.");
        sb.AppendLine("2) Start with a small phase-1 family set before broad universe expansion.");
        sb.AppendLine("3) Do not expand to 60 pairs first.");
        sb.AppendLine("4) Do not add another timeframe first.");
        sb.AppendLine("5) Use this family to reduce dependence on RNDRUSDT::4h and improve deployable breadth.");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("FINAL VERDICT");
        sb.AppendLine("-------------");
        sb.AppendLine(BuildVerdict(implementationRows, liveWinners.Count, result.CashAllocationWeight));
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("OPERATOR GUIDANCE");
        sb.AppendLine("-----------------");
        sb.AppendLine("1) If the top 3-4 names score strongly here, implement the new family before expanding to 60 pairs.");
        sb.AppendLine("2) After the family is live, expand the universe only around the best family names.");
        sb.AppendLine("3) Delay new timeframe expansion until the family proves it can create a second and third monetized survivor.");
        sb.AppendLine();

        File.WriteAllText(path, sb.ToString());
    }

    private static string BuildTxtPath(ReportDefinition definition, DateTime runUtc)
    {
        string stamp = runUtc.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss");
        return Path.Combine(
            DataPaths.Reports,
            $"REPORT_{definition.Number}_{definition.PurposeName}_{stamp}.txt");
    }

    private static bool IsStarterMarket(string marketKey)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(marketKey))
            return false;

        string symbol = ExtractSymbol(marketKey);
        string timeframe = ExtractTimeframe(marketKey);

        return timeframe.Equals("4h", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
               && Phase1StarterSymbols.Contains(symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    private static ImplementationRow BuildImplementationRow(
        string marketKey,
        string rejectionReason,
        IReadOnlySet<string> selectedMarkets)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(marketKey))
            return ImplementationRow.Empty;

        if (selectedMarkets.Contains(marketKey))
            return ImplementationRow.Empty;

        string reasonBucket = NormalizeReasonBucket(rejectionReason);

        decimal familyFitScore = 0.50m;

        if (reasonBucket == "WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard") familyFitScore += 0.35m;
        else if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: regime near-miss lane overflow") familyFitScore += 0.22m;
        else if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: regime not trend/high-vol-up") familyFitScore += 0.15m;
        else if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: outside top leadership set") familyFitScore += 0.12m;
        else if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: low liquidity") familyFitScore += 0.05m;

        decimal readinessScore = familyFitScore;

        bool isRelevant =
            reasonBucket == "WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard" ||
            reasonBucket == "REJECT: regime near-miss lane overflow" ||
            reasonBucket == "REJECT: regime not trend/high-vol-up" ||
            reasonBucket == "REJECT: outside top leadership set" ||
            reasonBucket == "REJECT: low liquidity";

        string phaseRecommendation = BuildPhaseRecommendation(reasonBucket, readinessScore);

        return new ImplementationRow(
            marketKey,
            reasonBucket,
            familyFitScore,
            readinessScore,
            phaseRecommendation,
            isRelevant);
    }

    private static string BuildPhaseRecommendation(string reasonBucket, decimal readinessScore)
    {
        if (reasonBucket == "WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard" && readinessScore >= 0.80m)
            return "Phase 1 implementation";

        if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: regime near-miss lane overflow" && readinessScore >= 0.70m)
            return "Phase 1 secondary implementation";

        if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: regime not trend/high-vol-up" && readinessScore >= 0.60m)
            return "Phase 2 watchlist";

        if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: outside top leadership set" && readinessScore >= 0.60m)
            return "Phase 2 watchlist";

        return "Monitor only";
    }

    private static string NormalizeReasonBucket(string rejectionReason)
    {
        string value = rejectionReason?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;

        if (value.StartsWith("WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: regime near-miss lane overflow", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: regime near-miss lane overflow";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: regime not trend/high-vol-up", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: regime not trend/high-vol-up";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: outside top", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: outside top leadership set";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: low liquidity", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: low liquidity";

        return value;
    }

    private static string ResolveStrategyCode(
        int strategyId,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<int, StrategyFitnessSnapshot> fitnessSnapshots)
    {
        if (fitnessSnapshots.TryGetValue(strategyId, out var snap) &&
            !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(snap.StrategyCode))
        {
            return snap.StrategyCode;
        }

        return $"S{strategyId:00}";
    }

    private static string BuildVerdict(
        IReadOnlyList<ImplementationRow> rows,
        int liveWinnerCount,
        decimal cashWeight)
    {
        bool strongReadiness = rows.Take(4).Any(x => x.ReadinessScore >= 0.75m);

        if (liveWinnerCount <= 1 && cashWeight >= 0.90m && strongReadiness)
            return "Implement the new 4h early-trend continuation family first. Do not expand to 60 pairs before validating the family.";

        if (liveWinnerCount <= 2 && cashWeight >= 0.75m && strongReadiness)
            return "The new family is ready for controlled implementation. Keep the universe targeted and delay 60-pair expansion.";

        return "Implementation readiness is not decisive yet.";
    }

    private static string ExtractSymbol(string marketKey)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(marketKey))
            return string.Empty;

        var parts = marketKey.Split(new[] { "::" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
        return parts.Length >= 1 ? parts[0].Trim() : string.Empty;
    }

    private static string ExtractTimeframe(string marketKey)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(marketKey))
            return string.Empty;

        var parts = marketKey.Split(new[] { "::" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
        return parts.Length >= 2 ? parts[1].Trim() : string.Empty;
    }

    private static string TrimTo(string? text, int maxLen)
    {
        string value = text ?? string.Empty;
        if (value.Length <= maxLen)
            return value;

        if (maxLen <= 3)
            return value[..maxLen];

        return value[..(maxLen - 3)] + "...";
    }

    private sealed record ImplementationRow(
        string MarketKey,
        string ReasonBucket,
        decimal FamilyFitScore,
        decimal ReadinessScore,
        string PhaseRecommendation,
        bool IsRelevant)
    {
        public static ImplementationRow Empty =>
            new(string.Empty, string.Empty, 0m, 0m, string.Empty, false);
    }

        sb.AppendLine("S06 OPERATOR INTERPRETATION");
        sb.AppendLine("---------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("1) If S06 is positive but still tiny, the family is alive but not yet validated for broader universe expansion.");
        sb.AppendLine("2) If one of the phase-1 names shows the best near-survivor score, keep the universe narrow and refine there first.");
        sb.AppendLine("3) Only broaden the universe after S06 produces a credible second deployable survivor or materially reduces cash held.");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("FINAL VERDICT");
        sb.AppendLine("-------------");
        sb.AppendLine(BuildVerdict(
            s06Pnl,
            nearSurvivorRows,
            selectedMarkets.Count,
            result.CashAllocationWeight));
        sb.AppendLine();

        File.WriteAllText(path, sb.ToString());
    }

    private static string BuildTxtPath(ReportDefinition definition, DateTime runUtc)
    {
        string stamp = runUtc.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss");
        return Path.Combine(
            DataPaths.Reports,
            $"REPORT_{definition.Number}_{definition.PurposeName}_{stamp}.txt");
    }

    private static ContributionRow BuildContributionRow(
        string strategySymbolTfKey,
        decimal netPnl,
        IReadOnlySet<string> selectedMarkets,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> rejections)
    {
        string marketKey = ExtractMarketKey(strategySymbolTfKey);
        bool isSelectedNow = selectedMarkets.Contains(marketKey);

        string reasonBucket = "NOT_REJECTED";
        if (!isSelectedNow && rejections.TryGetValue(marketKey, out var rejectReason))
            reasonBucket = NormalizeReasonBucket(rejectReason);

        string familyTier = ResolveFamilyTier(marketKey);

        decimal nearSurvivorScore = 0m;

        if (netPnl > 0m)
            nearSurvivorScore += 0.50m;

        if (familyTier == "PHASE_1")
            nearSurvivorScore += 0.30m;
        else if (familyTier == "PHASE_2")
            nearSurvivorScore += 0.15m;

        if (reasonBucket == "NOT_REJECTED" && isSelectedNow)
            nearSurvivorScore += 0.50m;
        else if (reasonBucket == "WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard")
            nearSurvivorScore += 0.28m;
        else if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: outside top leadership set")
            nearSurvivorScore += 0.20m;
        else if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: regime near-miss lane overflow")
            nearSurvivorScore += 0.18m;
        else if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: regime not trend/high-vol-up")
            nearSurvivorScore += 0.12m;
        else if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: low liquidity")
            nearSurvivorScore += 0.08m;

        bool isPhase1OrPhase2 = familyTier != "OUTSIDE_FAMILY";
        string verdict = BuildNearSurvivorVerdict(isSelectedNow, familyTier, reasonBucket, netPnl, nearSurvivorScore);

        return new ContributionRow(
            marketKey,
            netPnl,
            reasonBucket,
            isSelectedNow,
            familyTier,
            nearSurvivorScore,
            verdict,
            isPhase1OrPhase2);
    }

    private static string BuildNearSurvivorVerdict(
        bool isSelectedNow,
        string familyTier,
        string reasonBucket,
        decimal netPnl,
        decimal nearSurvivorScore)
    {
        if (isSelectedNow)
            return "Already deployable survivor";

        if (familyTier == "PHASE_1" && netPnl > 0m && reasonBucket == "WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard" && nearSurvivorScore >= 1.00m)
            return "Best phase-1 near-survivor";

        if (familyTier == "PHASE_1" && netPnl > 0m && nearSurvivorScore >= 0.85m)
            return "Strong phase-1 near-survivor";

        if (familyTier == "PHASE_2" && netPnl > 0m && nearSurvivorScore >= 0.70m)
            return "Phase-2 watchlist near-survivor";

        if (netPnl > 0m)
            return "Positive but not close enough";

        return "Not yet a credible survivor";
    }

    private static string ResolveFamilyTier(string marketKey)
    {
        string symbol = ExtractSymbol(marketKey);

        if (Phase1StarterSymbols.Contains(symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "PHASE_1";

        if (Phase2WatchlistSymbols.Contains(symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "PHASE_2";

        return "OUTSIDE_FAMILY";
    }

    private static string NormalizeReasonBucket(string rejectionReason)
    {
        string value = rejectionReason?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;

        if (value.StartsWith("WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard";

        if (value.StartsWith("WaveBRejected:BelowThreshold", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "WaveBRejected:BelowThreshold";

        if (value.StartsWith("WaveBRejected:PerSymbolCap", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "WaveBRejected:PerSymbolCap";

        if (value.StartsWith("WaveBRejected:TopNOverflow", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "WaveBRejected:TopNOverflow";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: outside top", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: outside top leadership set";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: regime near-miss lane overflow", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: regime near-miss lane overflow";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: regime not trend/high-vol-up", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: regime not trend/high-vol-up";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: low liquidity", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: low liquidity";

        return value;
    }

    private static string ExtractMarketKey(string strategySymbolTfKey)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(strategySymbolTfKey))
            return string.Empty;

        var parts = strategySymbolTfKey.Split(new[] { "::" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
        if (parts.Length < 3)
            return strategySymbolTfKey;

        return $"{parts[1]}::{parts[2]}";
    }

    private static string ExtractSymbol(string marketKey)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(marketKey))
            return string.Empty;

        var parts = marketKey.Split(new[] { "::" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
        return parts.Length >= 1 ? parts[0].Trim() : string.Empty;
    }

    private static string ResolveStrategyCode(
        int strategyId,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<int, StrategyFitnessSnapshot> fitnessSnapshots)
    {
        if (fitnessSnapshots.TryGetValue(strategyId, out var snap) &&
            !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(snap.StrategyCode))
        {
            return snap.StrategyCode;
        }

        return TargetStrategyCodeFallback;
    }

    private static string BuildVerdict(
        decimal s06Pnl,
        IReadOnlyList<ContributionRow> nearSurvivorRows,
        int selectedMarketCount,
        decimal cashWeight)
    {
        bool strongNearSurvivor = nearSurvivorRows.Take(3).Any(x => x.NearSurvivorScore >= 0.90m && x.NetPnl > 0m);

        if (selectedMarketCount <= 1 && cashWeight >= 0.90m && s06Pnl > 0m && strongNearSurvivor)
            return "S06 is alive and has a credible near-survivor candidate, but broader universe expansion is still premature. Refine inside the current family first.";

        if (selectedMarketCount <= 1 && cashWeight >= 0.90m && s06Pnl > 0m)
            return "S06 is positive but still too weak to justify broader universe expansion. Keep the family narrow and refine contribution quality first.";

        if (s06Pnl <= 0m)
            return "S06 has not yet proven contribution quality. Broader universe expansion is not justified.";

        return "S06 contribution is improving, but broader universe expansion still requires a clearer second deployable survivor.";
    }

    private static string TrimTo(string? text, int maxLen)
    {
        string value = text ?? string.Empty;
        if (value.Length <= maxLen)
            return value;

        if (maxLen <= 3)
            return value[..maxLen];

        return value[..(maxLen - 3)] + "...";
    }

    private sealed record ContributionRow(
        string MarketKey,
        decimal NetPnl,
        string ReasonBucket,
        bool IsSelectedNow,
        string FamilyTier,
        decimal NearSurvivorScore,
        string NearSurvivorVerdict,
        bool IsPhase1OrPhase2);
}

using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Backtesting;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Application.Reporting;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

public sealed class Report30S06Phase1RefinementEntryTighteningAuditService
{
    private const int TargetStrategyId = 6;
    private const string TargetPrefix = "S06::";

    private static readonly string[] Phase1StarterSymbols =
    [
        "FILUSDT",
        "LINKUSDT",
        "NEARUSDT"
    ];

    private static readonly string[] Phase2WatchlistSymbols =
    [
        "SOLUSDT",
        "SUIUSDT",
        "ARBUSDT",
        "DOTUSDT"
    ];

    public void GenerateAndWrite(
        PortfolioBacktestResult result,
        DateTime runUtc,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<int, StrategyFitnessSnapshot> fitnessSnapshots)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(result);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(fitnessSnapshots);

        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        ReportDefinition definition = ReportCatalog.S06Phase1RefinementEntryTighteningAudit;
        string path = BuildTxtPath(definition, runUtc);

        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        var strategyPnl = result.StrategyPnL ?? new Dictionary<int, decimal>();
        var strategyDiagnostics = result.StrategyDiagnostics ?? new Dictionary<int, TradeDecisionDiagnosticsSnapshot>();
        var symbolTfPnl = result.SymbolTimeframePnL ?? new Dictionary<string, decimal>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        var strategySymbolTfPnl = result.StrategySymbolTimeframePnL ?? new Dictionary<string, decimal>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        var rejections = result.MarketSelectionRejections ?? new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        var selectedMarkets = (result.SelectedMarkets ?? new List<string>())
            .ToHashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        decimal s06Pnl = strategyPnl.TryGetValue(TargetStrategyId, out var foundS06Pnl)
            ? foundS06Pnl
            : 0m;

        string s06Code = ResolveStrategyCode(TargetStrategyId, fitnessSnapshots);

        var s06Rows = strategySymbolTfPnl
            .Where(x => x.Key.StartsWith(TargetPrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .Select(x => BuildRow(x.Key, x.Value, rejections, selectedMarkets))
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.NetPnl)
            .ThenBy(x => x.MarketKey, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        var phase1Rows = s06Rows
            .Where(x => x.FamilyTier == "PHASE_1")
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.EntryTighteningPriority)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.NetPnl)
            .ThenBy(x => x.MarketKey, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        var phase2Rows = s06Rows
            .Where(x => x.FamilyTier == "PHASE_2")
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.EntryTighteningPriority)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.NetPnl)
            .ThenBy(x => x.MarketKey, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        var nearMissRows = s06Rows
            .Where(x => !x.IsSelectedNow)
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.EntryTighteningPriority)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.NetPnl)
            .ToList();

        int ticksProcessed = strategyDiagnostics.TryGetValue(TargetStrategyId, out var diag) ? diag.TicksProcessed : 0;
        int signalLong = strategyDiagnostics.TryGetValue(TargetStrategyId, out diag) ? diag.SignalLong : 0;
        int signalExit = strategyDiagnostics.TryGetValue(TargetStrategyId, out diag) ? diag.SignalExit : 0;
        int entryAttempts = strategyDiagnostics.TryGetValue(TargetStrategyId, out diag) ? diag.EntryAttempts : 0;
        int executedEntries = strategyDiagnostics.TryGetValue(TargetStrategyId, out diag) ? diag.ExecutedEntries : 0;
        int executedExits = strategyDiagnostics.TryGetValue(TargetStrategyId, out diag) ? diag.ExecutedExits : 0;

        decimal conversionRate = entryAttempts <= 0 ? 0m : (decimal)executedEntries / entryAttempts;
        decimal selectedMarketCount = selectedMarkets.Count;

        sb.AppendLine($"REPORT {definition.Number} — S06 PHASE-1 REFINEMENT / ENTRY-TIGHTENING AUDIT");
        sb.AppendLine("===========================================================");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("PURPOSE");
        sb.AppendLine("-------");
        sb.AppendLine("Audit whether S06 should be refined inside the current phase-1 family by tightening entry quality, rather than expanded into phase-2 or broader universe coverage.");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("RUN CONTEXT");
        sb.AppendLine("-----------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Run Timestamp (UTC)                : {runUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Number                      : {definition.Number}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Purpose                     : {definition.PurposeName}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Target Strategy Id                 : S{TargetStrategyId:00}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Target Strategy Code               : {s06Code}");
        sb.AppendLine($"S06 Total PnL                      : {s06Pnl:F2}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Selected Markets Count             : {selectedMarketCount:F0}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Cash Allocation Weight             : {result.CashAllocationWeight:P2}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("S06 STRATEGY TELEMETRY");
        sb.AppendLine("----------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Ticks Processed                    : {ticksProcessed}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Signal Long                        : {signalLong}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Signal Exit                        : {signalExit}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Entry Attempts                     : {entryAttempts}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Executed Entries                   : {executedEntries}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Executed Exits                     : {executedExits}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Entry Conversion Rate              : {conversionRate:P2}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("LIVE TOP SYMBOL::TF PNL");
        sb.AppendLine("-----------------------");
        if (symbolTfPnl.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO SYMBOL::TF PNL DATA");
        }
        else
        {
            sb.AppendLine("Rank | Symbol::TF                | PnL");
            sb.AppendLine("-----+---------------------------+------------");
            int rank = 1;
            foreach (var kv in symbolTfPnl.OrderByDescending(x => x.Value).Take(12))
            {
                sb.AppendLine($"{rank,4} | {TrimTo(kv.Key, 25),-25} | {kv.Value,10:F2}");
                rank++;
            }
        }
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("S06 PHASE-1 CONTRIBUTION TABLE");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------");
        if (phase1Rows.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO PHASE-1 S06 ROWS");
        }
        else
        {
            sb.AppendLine("Rank | Market                    | NetPnL     | Bucket                           | SelectedNow | TightenPriority | Verdict");
            sb.AppendLine("-----+---------------------------+------------+----------------------------------+-------------+-----------------+------------------------------");
            int rank = 1;
            foreach (var row in phase1Rows)
            {
                sb.AppendLine(
                    $"{rank,4} | {TrimTo(row.MarketKey, 25),-25} | {row.NetPnl,10:F2} | " +
                    $"{TrimTo(row.ReasonBucket, 32),-32} | {(row.IsSelectedNow ? "YES" : "NO "),11} | " +
                    $"{row.EntryTighteningPriority,15:F2} | {TrimTo(row.EntryTighteningVerdict, 28)}");
                rank++;
            }
        }
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("S06 PHASE-2 WATCHLIST TABLE");
        sb.AppendLine("---------------------------");
        if (phase2Rows.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO PHASE-2 S06 ROWS");
        }
        else
        {
            sb.AppendLine("Rank | Market                    | NetPnL     | Bucket                           | TightenPriority | Verdict");
            sb.AppendLine("-----+---------------------------+------------+----------------------------------+-----------------+------------------------------");
            int rank = 1;
            foreach (var row in phase2Rows)
            {
                sb.AppendLine(
                    $"{rank,4} | {TrimTo(row.MarketKey, 25),-25} | {row.NetPnl,10:F2} | " +
                    $"{TrimTo(row.ReasonBucket, 32),-32} | {row.EntryTighteningPriority,15:F2} | {TrimTo(row.EntryTighteningVerdict, 28)}");
                rank++;
            }
        }
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("TOP ENTRY-TIGHTENING TARGETS");
        sb.AppendLine("----------------------------");
        if (nearMissRows.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO ENTRY-TIGHTENING TARGETS");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (var row in nearMissRows.Take(8))
            {
                sb.AppendLine(
                    $"{row.MarketKey,-24} tier={row.FamilyTier,-8} pnl={row.NetPnl,10:F2} " +
                    $"bucket={row.ReasonBucket,-32} priority={row.EntryTighteningPriority:F2} => {row.EntryTighteningVerdict}");
            }
        }
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("ENTRY-TIGHTENING HYPOTHESIS");
        sb.AppendLine("---------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine(BuildHypothesis(s06Pnl, conversionRate, phase1Rows, selectedMarketCount, result.CashAllocationWeight));
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("OPERATOR GUIDANCE");
        sb.AppendLine("-----------------");
        sb.AppendLine("1) Keep S06 on phase-1 only while total contribution is still small.");
        sb.AppendLine("2) Tighten entry quality on the highest-priority phase-1 names before adding phase-2 watchlist symbols.");
        sb.AppendLine("3) Do not broaden the family until S06 materially improves deployable breadth or reduces cash held.");
        sb.AppendLine("4) If phase-1 refinement works, only then test phase-2 expansion.");
        sb.AppendLine();

        File.WriteAllText(path, sb.ToString());
    }

    private static string BuildTxtPath(ReportDefinition definition, DateTime runUtc)
    {
        var naming = new ReportFileNamingService();
        string fileName = naming.BuildLocalFileName(definition, runUtc, ".txt");
        return Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, fileName);
    }

    private static AuditRow BuildRow(
        string strategySymbolTfKey,
        decimal netPnl,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> rejections,
        IReadOnlySet<string> selectedMarkets)
    {
        string marketKey = ExtractMarketKey(strategySymbolTfKey);
        bool isSelectedNow = selectedMarkets.Contains(marketKey);

        string familyTier = ResolveFamilyTier(marketKey);

        string reasonBucket = "NOT_REJECTED";
        if (!isSelectedNow && rejections.TryGetValue(marketKey, out var rejection))
            reasonBucket = NormalizeReasonBucket(rejection);

        decimal priority = 0m;

        if (familyTier == "PHASE_1") priority += 0.40m;
        if (familyTier == "PHASE_2") priority += 0.18m;

        if (netPnl > 0m) priority += 0.25m;
        if (netPnl <= 0m) priority += 0.05m;

        if (reasonBucket == "WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard") priority += 0.30m;
        else if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: regime near-miss lane overflow") priority += 0.22m;
        else if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: outside top leadership set") priority += 0.18m;
        else if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: regime not trend/high-vol-up") priority += 0.14m;
        else if (reasonBucket == "REJECT: low liquidity") priority += 0.08m;

        string verdict = BuildVerdict(familyTier, isSelectedNow, netPnl, reasonBucket, priority);

        return new AuditRow(
            marketKey,
            netPnl,
            reasonBucket,
            isSelectedNow,
            familyTier,
            priority,
            verdict);
    }

    private static string BuildVerdict(
        string familyTier,
        bool isSelectedNow,
        decimal netPnl,
        string reasonBucket,
        decimal priority)
    {
        if (isSelectedNow)
            return "Already selected now";

        if (familyTier == "PHASE_1" && netPnl > 0m && reasonBucket == "WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard" && priority >= 0.90m)
            return "Best phase-1 tightening target";

        if (familyTier == "PHASE_1" && netPnl > 0m && priority >= 0.75m)
            return "Strong phase-1 refinement target";

        if (familyTier == "PHASE_2" && netPnl > 0m && priority >= 0.55m)
            return "Watch only, not ready";

        if (familyTier == "PHASE_1" && priority >= 0.55m)
            return "Refine before expansion";

        return "Not ready for expansion";
    }

    private static string BuildHypothesis(
        decimal s06Pnl,
        decimal conversionRate,
        IReadOnlyList<AuditRow> phase1Rows,
        decimal selectedMarketCount,
        decimal cashWeight)
    {
        bool positivePhase1Exists = phase1Rows.Any(x => x.NetPnl > 0m);
        bool strongPhase1NearMiss = phase1Rows.Any(x => x.EntryTighteningPriority >= 0.85m && !x.IsSelectedNow);
        bool veryDefensive = selectedMarketCount <= 1m && cashWeight >= 0.90m;

        if (veryDefensive && s06Pnl > 0m && strongPhase1NearMiss)
            return "S06 is alive but too weak for family expansion. Tighten entry quality inside phase-1 first, especially around the best near-miss name(s).";

        if (veryDefensive && s06Pnl > 0m && positivePhase1Exists)
            return "S06 shows early life, but the portfolio is still too defensive for phase-2 expansion. Refine phase-1 entry quality before widening the family.";

        if (conversionRate < 0.10m)
            return "S06 may be too restrictive or poorly aligned. Review phase-1 entry timing before adding more symbols.";

        return "S06 still needs phase-1 refinement before broader expansion decisions.";
    }

    private static string ResolveFamilyTier(string marketKey)
    {
        string symbol = ExtractSymbol(marketKey);

        if (Phase1StarterSymbols.Contains(symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "PHASE_1";

        if (Phase2WatchlistSymbols.Contains(symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "PHASE_2";

        return "OUTSIDE_FAMILY";
    }

    private static string NormalizeReasonBucket(string rejectionReason)
    {
        string value = rejectionReason?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;

        if (value.StartsWith("WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "WaveBRejected:DispersionGuard";

        if (value.StartsWith("WaveBRejected:BelowThreshold", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "WaveBRejected:BelowThreshold";

        if (value.StartsWith("WaveBRejected:PerSymbolCap", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "WaveBRejected:PerSymbolCap";

        if (value.StartsWith("WaveBRejected:TopNOverflow", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "WaveBRejected:TopNOverflow";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: outside top", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: outside top leadership set";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: regime near-miss lane overflow", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: regime near-miss lane overflow";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: regime not trend/high-vol-up", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: regime not trend/high-vol-up";

        if (value.StartsWith("REJECT: low liquidity", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "REJECT: low liquidity";

        return value;
    }

    private static string ExtractMarketKey(string strategySymbolTfKey)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(strategySymbolTfKey))
            return string.Empty;

        var parts = strategySymbolTfKey.Split(new[] { "::" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
        if (parts.Length < 3)
            return strategySymbolTfKey;

        return $"{parts[1]}::{parts[2]}";
    }

    private static string ExtractSymbol(string marketKey)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(marketKey))
            return string.Empty;

        var parts = marketKey.Split(new[] { "::" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
        return parts.Length >= 1 ? parts[0].Trim() : string.Empty;
    }

    private static string ResolveStrategyCode(
        int strategyId,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<int, StrategyFitnessSnapshot> fitnessSnapshots)
    {
        if (fitnessSnapshots.TryGetValue(strategyId, out var snap) &&
            !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(snap.StrategyCode))
        {
            return snap.StrategyCode;
        }

        return $"S{strategyId:00}";
    }

    private static string TrimTo(string? text, int maxLen)
    {
        string value = text ?? string.Empty;
        if (value.Length <= maxLen)
            return value;

        if (maxLen <= 3)
            return value[..maxLen];

        return value[..(maxLen - 3)] + "...";
    }

    private sealed record AuditRow(
        string MarketKey,
        decimal NetPnl,
        string ReasonBucket,
        bool IsSelectedNow,
        string FamilyTier,
        decimal EntryTighteningPriority,
        string EntryTighteningVerdict);
}

using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Portfolio;
using TQGA.Application.Reporting;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Domain.Trading;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

public sealed class Report32TradeBlotterEntryExitReasonJournalService
{
    public void GenerateAndWrite(
        IReadOnlyList<StrategyBacktestNode> nodes,
        IReadOnlyList<string> selectedMarkets,
        DateTime runUtc)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(nodes);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(selectedMarkets);

        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        string txtPath = BuildTxtPath(ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("TRADE_BLOTTER_JOURNAL_TXT", "038"), runUtc);
        string csvPath = BuildCsvPath(ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("TRADE_BLOTTER_JOURNAL_CSV", "039"), runUtc);

        var symbolToTimeframe = BuildSymbolToTimeframeMap(selectedMarkets);

        var rows = nodes
            .SelectMany(node => node.Ledger.Trades.Select(trade => BuildRow(node, trade, symbolToTimeframe)))
            .OrderBy(x => x.EntryTimeUtc)
            .ThenBy(x => x.StrategyId)
            .ThenBy(x => x.Symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        WriteTxt(txtPath, rows, runUtc);
        WriteCsv(csvPath, rows);
    }

    private static string BuildTxtPath(ReportDefinition definition, DateTime runUtc)
    {
        var naming = new ReportFileNamingService();
        string fileName = naming.BuildLocalFileName(definition, runUtc, ".txt");
        return Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, fileName);
    }

    private static string BuildCsvPath(ReportDefinition definition, DateTime runUtc)
    {
        var naming = new ReportFileNamingService();
        string fileName = naming.BuildLocalFileName(definition, runUtc, ".csv");
        return Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, fileName);
    }

    private static Dictionary<string, string> BuildSymbolToTimeframeMap(IReadOnlyList<string> selectedMarkets)
    {
        var output = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        foreach (string market in selectedMarkets)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(market))
                continue;

            var parts = market.Split(new[] { "::" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
            if (parts.Length < 2)
                continue;

            string symbol = parts[0].Trim();
            string timeframe = parts[1].Trim();

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(timeframe))
                output[symbol] = timeframe;
        }

        return output;
    }

    private static TradeJournalRow BuildRow(
        StrategyBacktestNode node,
        Trade trade,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> symbolToTimeframe)
    {
        string timeframe = symbolToTimeframe.TryGetValue(trade.Symbol, out var resolvedTf)
            ? resolvedTf
            : "UNKNOWN_TF";

        decimal holdingMinutes = trade.ExitTime.HasValue
            ? (decimal)(trade.ExitTime.Value - trade.EntryTime).TotalMinutes
            : 0m;

        decimal? riskPerUnit = null;
        if (trade.StopLossAtEntry.HasValue)
            riskPerUnit = Math.Abs(trade.EntryPrice - trade.StopLossAtEntry.Value);

        decimal? moneyRisk = riskPerUnit.HasValue ? riskPerUnit.Value * trade.Quantity : null;
        decimal? rMultiple = moneyRisk.HasValue && moneyRisk.Value > 0m
            ? trade.RealizedPnL / moneyRisk.Value
            : null;

        return new TradeJournalRow(
            StrategyId: node.StrategyId,
            StrategyName: node.StrategyName,
            Symbol: trade.Symbol,
            Timeframe: timeframe,
            Side: trade.Side.ToString(),
            Quantity: trade.Quantity,
            EntryTimeUtc: trade.EntryTime,
            EntryPrice: trade.EntryPrice,
            ExitTimeUtc: trade.ExitTime,
            ExitPrice: trade.ExitPrice,
            IsClosed: trade.IsClosed,
            RealizedPnl: trade.RealizedPnL,
            HoldingMinutes: holdingMinutes,
            OrderType: trade.TrueOrderType,
            EntryReason: trade.EntryReason,
            ExitReason: trade.ExitReason ?? "OPEN",
            StopLoss: trade.StopLossAtEntry,
            TakeProfit: trade.TakeProfitAtEntry,
            ExpectedPrice: trade.ExpectedPrice,
            PlanSource: trade.PlanSource,
            FavorableExcursion: trade.FavorableExcursion * trade.Quantity,
            AdverseExcursion: trade.AdverseExcursion * trade.Quantity,
            RMultiple: rMultiple);
    }

    private static void WriteTxt(
        string path,
        IReadOnlyList<TradeJournalRow> rows,
        DateTime runUtc)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 038 — TRADE BLOTTER JOURNAL TXT");
        sb.AppendLine("======================================");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("PURPOSE");
        sb.AppendLine("-------");
        sb.AppendLine("Provide a trade-by-trade operator journal for every recorded trade in the run.");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("RUN CONTEXT");
        sb.AppendLine("-----------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Run Timestamp (PKT)                : {PakistanTime.FormatLabel(runUtc)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Total Trade Rows                   : {rows.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Closed Trades                      : {rows.Count(x => x.IsClosed)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Open Trades                        : {rows.Count(x => !x.IsClosed)}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("TRADE JOURNAL");
        sb.AppendLine("-------------");
        if (rows.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO TRADES RECORDED.");
        }
        else
        {
            int rank = 1;
            foreach (var row in rows)
            {
                sb.AppendLine($"TRADE #{rank:0000}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Strategy Id                        : S{row.StrategyId:00}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Strategy Name                      : {row.StrategyName}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Symbol                             : {row.Symbol}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Timeframe                          : {row.Timeframe}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Side                               : {row.Side}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Quantity                           : {row.Quantity:F8}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Entry Time (PKT)                   : {PakistanTime.FormatLabel(row.EntryTimeUtc)}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Entry Price                        : {row.EntryPrice:F8}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Exit Time (PKT)                    : {(row.ExitTimeUtc.HasValue ? PakistanTime.FormatLabel(row.ExitTimeUtc.Value) : "OPEN")}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Exit Price                         : {(row.ExitPrice.HasValue ? row.ExitPrice.Value.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "OPEN")}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Closed                             : {(row.IsClosed ? "YES" : "NO")}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Realized PnL                       : {row.RealizedPnl:F8}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Holding Minutes                    : {row.HoldingMinutes:F2}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Order Type                         : {row.OrderType}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Entry Reason                       : {row.EntryReason}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Exit Reason                        : {row.ExitReason}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Stop Loss                          : {(row.StopLoss.HasValue ? row.StopLoss.Value.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "NULL")}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Take Profit                        : {(row.TakeProfit.HasValue ? row.TakeProfit.Value.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "NULL")}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Expected Price                     : {(row.ExpectedPrice.HasValue ? row.ExpectedPrice.Value.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "NULL")}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Plan Source                        : {row.PlanSource}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Favorable Excursion                : {row.FavorableExcursion:F8}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Adverse Excursion                  : {row.AdverseExcursion:F8}");
                sb.AppendLine($"R Multiple                         : {(row.RMultiple.HasValue ? row.RMultiple.Value.ToString("F4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "NULL")}");
                sb.AppendLine();
                rank++;
            }
        }
        File.WriteAllText(path, sb.ToString());
    }

    private static void WriteCsv(string path, IReadOnlyList<TradeJournalRow> rows)
    {
        using var writer = new StreamWriter(path, false, Encoding.UTF8);
        writer.WriteLine("StrategyId,StrategyName,Symbol,Timeframe,Side,Quantity,EntryTimePkt,EntryPrice,ExitTimePkt,ExitPrice,IsClosed,RealizedPnl,HoldingMinutes,OrderType,EntryReason,ExitReason,StopLoss,TakeProfit,ExpectedPrice,PlanSource,FavorableExcursion,AdverseExcursion,RMultiple");
        foreach (var row in rows)
        {
            writer.WriteLine(string.Join(",",
                Csv(row.StrategyId.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
                Csv(row.StrategyName), Csv(row.Symbol), Csv(row.Timeframe), Csv(row.Side),
                Csv(row.Quantity.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
                Csv(PakistanTime.FormatLabel(row.EntryTimeUtc)),
                Csv(row.EntryPrice.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
                Csv(row.ExitTimeUtc.HasValue ? PakistanTime.FormatLabel(row.ExitTimeUtc.Value) : "OPEN"),
                Csv(row.ExitPrice.HasValue ? row.ExitPrice.Value.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "OPEN"),
                Csv(row.IsClosed ? "YES" : "NO"),
                Csv(row.RealizedPnl.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
                Csv(row.HoldingMinutes.ToString("F2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
                Csv(row.OrderType), Csv(row.EntryReason), Csv(row.ExitReason),
                Csv(row.StopLoss.HasValue ? row.StopLoss.Value.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "NULL"),
                Csv(row.TakeProfit.HasValue ? row.TakeProfit.Value.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "NULL"),
                Csv(row.ExpectedPrice.HasValue ? row.ExpectedPrice.Value.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "NULL"),
                Csv(row.PlanSource),
                Csv(row.FavorableExcursion.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
                Csv(row.AdverseExcursion.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
                Csv(row.RMultiple.HasValue ? row.RMultiple.Value.ToString("F4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "NULL")));
        }
    }

    private static string Csv(string value)
    {
        string safe = value ?? string.Empty;
        safe = safe.Replace("\"", "\"\"");
        return $"\"{safe}\"";
    }

    private sealed record TradeJournalRow(int StrategyId, string StrategyName, string Symbol, string Timeframe, string Side, decimal Quantity, DateTime EntryTimeUtc, decimal EntryPrice, DateTime? ExitTimeUtc, decimal? ExitPrice, bool IsClosed, decimal RealizedPnl, decimal HoldingMinutes, string OrderType, string EntryReason, string ExitReason, decimal? StopLoss, decimal? TakeProfit, decimal? ExpectedPrice, string PlanSource, decimal FavorableExcursion, decimal AdverseExcursion, decimal? RMultiple);
}

        foreach (string market in selectedMarkets)
        {

            string[] parts = market.Split(new[] { "::" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
            if (parts.Length < 2) continue;
            output[parts[0].Trim()] = parts[1].Trim();

    private static TradeIntelligenceRow BuildRow(StrategyBacktestNode node, Trade trade, int tradeNumber, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> symbolToTimeframe)
    {
        string timeframe = symbolToTimeframe.TryGetValue(trade.Symbol, out var tf) ? tf : "UNKNOWN_TF";
        decimal holdingMinutes = trade.ExitTime.HasValue ? (decimal)(trade.ExitTime.Value - trade.EntryTime).TotalMinutes : 0m;
        int barsHeld = EstimateBarsHeld(holdingMinutes, timeframe);
        decimal grossPnl = trade.RealizedPnL;
        decimal commission = 0m;
        decimal netPnl = grossPnl - commission;
        decimal? rMoney = null, rMultiple = null;
        if (trade.StopLossAtEntry.HasValue)
        {
            decimal riskPerUnit = Math.Abs(trade.EntryPrice - trade.StopLossAtEntry.Value);
            if (riskPerUnit > 0m)
            {
                rMoney = riskPerUnit * trade.Quantity;
                if (rMoney.Value > 0m) rMultiple = netPnl / rMoney.Value;
            }
        }
        return new TradeIntelligenceRow(tradeNumber, node.StrategyId, node.StrategyName ?? $"S{node.StrategyId:00}", trade.Symbol, timeframe, $"{trade.Symbol}::{timeframe}", trade.Side.ToString(), trade.TrueOrderType, trade.EntryTime, trade.EntryPrice, trade.ExitTime, trade.ExitPrice, trade.Quantity, trade.IsClosed, grossPnl, commission, netPnl, holdingMinutes, barsHeld, trade.StopLossAtEntry, trade.TakeProfitAtEntry, trade.ExpectedPrice, trade.EntryReason, trade.ExitReason ?? "OPEN", trade.PlanSource, trade.FavorableExcursion * trade.Quantity, trade.AdverseExcursion * trade.Quantity, rMoney, rMultiple);
    }

    private static int EstimateBarsHeld(decimal holdingMinutes, string timeframe)
    {
        int tfMinutes = timeframe.Equals("1d", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? 1440 : timeframe.Equals("4h", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? 240 : timeframe.Equals("1h", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? 60 : 0;
        if (tfMinutes <= 0 || holdingMinutes <= 0m) return 0;
        return (int)Math.Round(holdingMinutes / tfMinutes, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
    }

    private static decimal ComputeMaxDrawdown(IReadOnlyList<KeyValuePair<DateTime, decimal>> equityPoints)
    {
        if (equityPoints.Count == 0) return 0m;
        decimal peak = equityPoints[0].Value, maxDrawdown = 0m;
        foreach (var pt in equityPoints)
        {
            if (pt.Value > peak) peak = pt.Value;
            decimal currentDrawdown = peak - pt.Value;
            if (currentDrawdown > maxDrawdown) maxDrawdown = currentDrawdown;
        }
        return maxDrawdown;
    }

            sb.AppendLine($"Net P&L                            : {row.NetPnl:F8}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Holding Minutes                    : {row.HoldingMinutes:F2}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Bars Held                          : {row.BarsHeld}");

            sb.AppendLine($"Take Profit At Entry               : {(row.TakeProfitAtEntry.HasValue ? row.TakeProfitAtEntry.Value.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "NULL")}");

            sb.AppendLine($"Adverse Excursion                  : {row.AdverseExcursion:F8}");
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

    }

    private static void WriteCsv(string path, IReadOnlyList<TradeIntelligenceRow> trades)
    {
        using var writer = new StreamWriter(path, false, Encoding.UTF8);
        writer.WriteLine("TradeNumber,StrategyId,StrategyName,Symbol,Timeframe,Side,OrderType,EntryTimePkt,EntryTimeUtc,EntryPrice,ExitTimePkt,ExitTimeUtc,ExitPrice,Quantity,IsClosed,GrossPnl,Commission,NetPnl,HoldingMinutes,BarsHeld,StopLossAtEntry,TakeProfitAtEntry,ExpectedPrice,EntryReason,ExitReason,PlanSource,RMoney,RMultiple,FavorableExcursion,AdverseExcursion");
        foreach (var row in trades)
        {
            writer.WriteLine(string.Join(",",
                Csv(row.TradeNumber.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)), Csv(row.StrategyId.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)), Csv(row.StrategyName), Csv(row.Symbol), Csv(row.Timeframe), Csv(row.Side), Csv(row.OrderType), Csv(PakistanTime.FormatLabel(row.EntryTimeUtc)), Csv($"{row.EntryTimeUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} UTC"), Csv(row.EntryPrice.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)), Csv(row.ExitTimeUtc.HasValue ? PakistanTime.FormatLabel(row.ExitTimeUtc.Value) : "OPEN"), Csv(row.ExitTimeUtc.HasValue ? $"{row.ExitTimeUtc.Value:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} UTC" : "OPEN"), Csv(row.ExitPrice.HasValue ? row.ExitPrice.Value.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "OPEN"), Csv(row.Quantity.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)), Csv(row.IsClosed ? "YES" : "NO"), Csv(row.GrossPnl.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)), Csv(row.Commission.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)), Csv(row.NetPnl.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)), Csv(row.HoldingMinutes.ToString("F2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)), Csv(row.BarsHeld.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)), Csv(row.StopLossAtEntry.HasValue ? row.StopLossAtEntry.Value.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "NULL"), Csv(row.TakeProfitAtEntry.HasValue ? row.TakeProfitAtEntry.Value.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "NULL"), Csv(row.ExpectedPrice.HasValue ? row.ExpectedPrice.Value.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "NULL"), Csv(row.EntryReason), Csv(row.ExitReason), Csv(row.PlanSource), Csv(row.RMoney.HasValue ? row.RMoney.Value.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "NULL"), Csv(row.RMultiple.HasValue ? row.RMultiple.Value.ToString("F4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "NULL"), Csv(row.FavorableExcursion.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)), Csv(row.AdverseExcursion.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))));
        }
    }

    private static string Csv(string value)
    {
        string safe = value ?? string.Empty;
        safe = safe.Replace("\"", "\"\"");
        return $"\"{safe}\"";
    }

    private static string TrimTo(string? text, int maxLen)
    {
        string value = text ?? string.Empty;
        if (value.Length <= maxLen) return value;
        if (maxLen <= 3) return value[..maxLen];
        return value[..(maxLen - 3)] + "...";
    }

    private sealed record TradeIntelligenceRow(int TradeNumber, int StrategyId, string StrategyName, string Symbol, string Timeframe, string MarketKey, string Side, string OrderType, DateTime EntryTimeUtc, decimal EntryPrice, DateTime? ExitTimeUtc, decimal? ExitPrice, decimal Quantity, bool IsClosed, decimal GrossPnl, decimal Commission, decimal NetPnl, decimal HoldingMinutes, int BarsHeld, decimal? StopLossAtEntry, decimal? TakeProfitAtEntry, decimal? ExpectedPrice, string EntryReason, string ExitReason, string PlanSource, decimal FavorableExcursion, decimal AdverseExcursion, decimal? RMoney, decimal? RMultiple);
    private sealed record StrategySummaryRow(int StrategyId, string StrategyName, decimal NetPnl, int Trades, decimal WinRate, decimal ProfitFactor, decimal AvgTrade, decimal AvgR, string BestSymbol, string WorstSymbol, decimal StrategyNativePct, decimal EngineFallbackPct);

PakistanTime.FormatLabel(row.ExitTimeUtc.Value) : "OPEN", row.ExitPrice.HasValue ? row.ExitPrice.Value.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "OPEN", row.IsClosed ? "YES" : "NO", row.RealizedPnL.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), row.HoldingMinutes.ToString("F2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), row.OrderType, Sanitize(row.EntryReason), Sanitize(row.ExitReason), row.StopLoss.HasValue ? row.StopLoss.Value.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "NULL", row.TakeProfit.HasValue ? row.TakeProfit.Value.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "NULL", row.ExpectedPrice.HasValue ? row.ExpectedPrice.Value.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "NULL", row.PlanSource, row.FavorableExcursion.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), row.AdverseExcursion.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), row.RMultiple.HasValue ? row.RMultiple.Value.ToString("F4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "NULL"));
        }
        File.WriteAllText(path, sb.ToString(), Encoding.UTF8);
    }

    private static Dictionary<string, string> BuildSymbolToTimeframeMap(IReadOnlyList<string> selectedMarkets)
    {
        var output = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach (string market in selectedMarkets)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(market)) continue;
            string[] parts = market.Split(new[] { "::" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
            if (parts.Length < 2) continue;
            output[parts[0].Trim()] = parts[1].Trim();
        }
        return output;
    }

    private static Row BuildRow(StrategyBacktestNode node, Trade trade, int tradeId, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> symbolToTimeframe)
    {
        string timeframe = symbolToTimeframe.TryGetValue(trade.Symbol, out var tf) ? tf : "UNKNOWN_TF";
        decimal holdingMinutes = trade.ExitTime.HasValue ? (decimal)(trade.ExitTime.Value - trade.EntryTime).TotalMinutes : 0m;
        decimal? rMultiple = null;
        if (trade.StopLossAtEntry.HasValue)
        {
            decimal riskPerUnit = Math.Abs(trade.EntryPrice - trade.StopLossAtEntry.Value);
            decimal rMoney = riskPerUnit * trade.Quantity;
            if (rMoney > 0m) rMultiple = trade.RealizedPnL / rMoney;
        }
        decimal tradeValueUsdt = trade.Quantity * trade.EntryPrice;
        return new Row(tradeId, node.StrategyId, node.StrategyName ?? $"S{node.StrategyId:00}", trade.Symbol, timeframe, $"{trade.Symbol}::{timeframe}", trade.Side.ToString(), trade.Quantity, tradeValueUsdt, trade.EntryTime, trade.EntryPrice, trade.ExitTime, trade.ExitPrice, trade.IsClosed, trade.RealizedPnL, holdingMinutes, trade.TrueOrderType, trade.EntryReason, trade.ExitReason ?? "OPEN", trade.StopLossAtEntry, trade.TakeProfitAtEntry, trade.ExpectedPrice, trade.PlanSource, trade.FavorableExcursion * trade.Quantity, trade.AdverseExcursion * trade.Quantity, rMultiple);
    }

    private static bool ContainsToken(string? value, string token) => (value ?? string.Empty).Contains(token, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    private static string FormatPkt(DateTime? value) => !value.HasValue ? "N/A" : PakistanTime.FormatLabel(value.Value);
    private static string FormatUtc(DateTime? value) => !value.HasValue ? "N/A" : $"{value.Value:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} UTC";
    private static string Sanitize(string? value) => (value ?? string.Empty).Replace("\r", " ").Replace("\n", " ").Replace(" | ", " / ").Trim();

    private sealed record Row(int TradeId, int StrategyId, string StrategyName, string Symbol, string Timeframe, string MarketKey, string Side, decimal Quantity, decimal TradeValueUsdt, DateTime EntryTimeUtc, decimal EntryPrice, DateTime? ExitTimeUtc, decimal? ExitPrice, bool IsClosed, decimal RealizedPnL, decimal HoldingMinutes, string OrderType, string EntryReason, string ExitReason, decimal? StopLoss, decimal? TakeProfit, decimal? ExpectedPrice, string PlanSource, decimal FavorableExcursion, decimal AdverseExcursion, decimal? RMultiple);
}
