    private static Dictionary<string, string> BuildSymbolToTimeframeMap(IReadOnlyList<string> selectedMarkets)
    {
        var output = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach (string market in selectedMarkets)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(market)) continue;
            string[] parts = market.Split(new[] { "::" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
            if (parts.Length < 2) continue;
            output[parts[0].Trim()] = parts[1].Trim();
        }
        return output;
    }

    private static Row BuildRow(StrategyBacktestNode node, Trade trade, int tradeId, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> symbolToTimeframe)
    {
        string timeframe = symbolToTimeframe.TryGetValue(trade.Symbol, out var tf) ? tf : "UNKNOWN_TF";
        decimal holdingMinutes = trade.ExitTime.HasValue ? (decimal)(trade.ExitTime.Value - trade.EntryTime).TotalMinutes : 0m;
        int barsHeld = EstimateBarsHeld(holdingMinutes, timeframe);
        decimal grossPnl = trade.RealizedPnL;
        decimal commission = 0m;
        decimal netPnl = grossPnl - commission;
        decimal? rMoney = null, rMultiple = null;
        if (trade.StopLossAtEntry.HasValue)
        {
            decimal riskPerUnit = Math.Abs(trade.EntryPrice - trade.StopLossAtEntry.Value);
            if (riskPerUnit > 0m)
            {
                rMoney = riskPerUnit * trade.Quantity;
                if (rMoney.Value > 0m) rMultiple = netPnl / rMoney.Value;
            }
        }
        decimal tradeValueUsdt = trade.Quantity * trade.EntryPrice;
        return new Row(tradeId, node.StrategyId, node.StrategyName ?? $"S{node.StrategyId:00}", trade.Symbol, timeframe, $"{trade.Symbol}::{timeframe}", trade.Side.ToString(), trade.Quantity, tradeValueUsdt, trade.EntryTime, trade.EntryPrice, trade.ExitTime, trade.ExitPrice, trade.IsClosed, grossPnl, commission, netPnl, holdingMinutes, barsHeld, trade.TrueOrderType, trade.EntryReason, trade.ExitReason ?? "OPEN", trade.StopLossAtEntry, trade.TakeProfitAtEntry, trade.ExpectedPrice, trade.PlanSource, trade.FavorableExcursion * trade.Quantity, trade.AdverseExcursion * trade.Quantity, rMoney, rMultiple);
    }

    private static int EstimateBarsHeld(decimal holdingMinutes, string timeframe)
    {
        int tfMinutes = timeframe.Equals("1d", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? 1440 : timeframe.Equals("4h", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? 240 : timeframe.Equals("1h", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? 60 : 0;
        if (tfMinutes <= 0 || holdingMinutes <= 0m) return 0;
        return (int)Math.Round(holdingMinutes / tfMinutes, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
    }

    private static bool ContainsToken(string? value, string token) => (value ?? string.Empty).Contains(token, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    private static string FormatPkt(DateTime? value) => !value.HasValue ? "N/A" : PakistanTime.FormatLabel(value.Value);
    private static string FormatUtc(DateTime? value) => !value.HasValue ? "N/A" : $"{value.Value:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} UTC";
    private static string Sanitize(string? value) => (value ?? string.Empty).Replace("\r", " ").Replace("\n", " ").Replace(" | ", " / ").Trim();

    private sealed record Row(int TradeId, int StrategyId, string StrategyName, string Symbol, string Timeframe, string MarketKey, string Side, decimal Quantity, decimal TradeValueUsdt, DateTime EntryTimeUtc, decimal EntryPrice, DateTime? ExitTimeUtc, decimal? ExitPrice, bool IsClosed, decimal GrossPnl, decimal Commission, decimal NetPnl, decimal HoldingMinutes, int BarsHeld, string OrderType, string EntryReason, string ExitReason, decimal? StopLossAtEntry, decimal? TakeProfitAtEntry, decimal? ExpectedPrice, string PlanSource, decimal FavorableExcursion, decimal AdverseExcursion, decimal? RMoney, decimal? RMultiple);
    private sealed record StrategySummaryRow(int StrategyId, string StrategyName, decimal NetPnl, int Trades, decimal WinRate, decimal ProfitFactor, decimal AvgTrade, decimal AvgR, string BestMarket, string WorstMarket, decimal StrategyNativePct, decimal EngineFallbackPct);
    private sealed record SymbolSummaryRow(string MarketKey, decimal NetPnl, int Trades, decimal WinRate, decimal ProfitFactor, decimal AvgTrade, decimal AvgR, string BestStrategy, string WorstStrategy);
}

        sb.AppendLine($"Symbol Breadth Negative            : {symbolBreadthNegative}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Symbol Breadth Flat                : {symbolBreadthFlat}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Likely SL-Hit Pattern              : {slPattern}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Likely TP-Miss Pattern             : {tpPattern}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("SECTION C — EXIT FAMILY SUMMARY");
        sb.AppendLine("-------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"TakeProfitHit Count                : {tpHitCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"TakeProfitHit Avg R                : {SafeAverage(tpHitRTotal, tpHitRCount).ToString("0.0000", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"TakeProfitHit Avg Hold Min         : {SafeAverage(tpHitHoldTotal, tpHitHoldCount).ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"StopLossHit Count                  : {slHitCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"StopLossHit Avg R                  : {SafeAverage(slHitRTotal, slHitRCount).ToString("0.0000", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"StopLossHit Avg Hold Min           : {SafeAverage(slHitHoldTotal, slHitHoldCount).ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"NonNegativeExit Count              : {nonNegativeExitCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"NonNegativeExit Avg R              : {SafeAverage(nonNegRTotal, nonNegRCount).ToString("0.0000", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"NonNegativeExit Avg Hold Min       : {SafeAverage(nonNegHoldTotal, nonNegHoldCount).ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"LossExit Count                     : {lossExitCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"LossExit Avg R                     : {SafeAverage(lossExitRTotal, lossExitRCount).ToString("0.0000", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"LossExit Avg Hold Min              : {SafeAverage(lossExitHoldTotal, lossExitHoldCount).ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("SECTION D — RISK / EXPECTANCY FLAGS");
        sb.AppendLine("-----------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Severe Loss Count (R <= -2)        : {severeLossCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Catastrophic Loss Count (R <= -3)  : {catastrophicLossCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"TP-Miss-Like Count                 : {tpMissLikeCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Late-Hold-Bleed-Like Count         : {lateHoldBleedLikeCount}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("TOP POSITIVE MARKETS");
        sb.AppendLine("--------------------");
        if (topPositiveMarkets.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO POSITIVE MARKETS");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (var kv in topPositiveMarkets)
                sb.AppendLine($"{kv.Key,-24} {kv.Value.ToString("0.0000", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),14}");
        }

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("TOP NEGATIVE MARKETS");
        sb.AppendLine("--------------------");
        if (topNegativeMarkets.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO NEGATIVE MARKETS");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (var kv in topNegativeMarkets)
                sb.AppendLine($"{kv.Key,-24} {kv.Value.ToString("0.0000", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),14}");
        }

        File.WriteAllText(path, sb.ToString(), Encoding.UTF8);
    }

    private static Dictionary<string, string> BuildSymbolToTimeframeMap(IReadOnlyList<string> selectedMarkets)
    {
        var output = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        foreach (string market in selectedMarkets)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(market))
                continue;

            string[] parts = market.Split(new[] { "::" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
            if (parts.Length < 2)
                continue;

            output[parts[0].Trim()] = parts[1].Trim();
        }

        return output;
    }

    private static decimal? TryGetRMultiple(Trade trade)
    {
        if (!trade.StopLossAtEntry.HasValue)
            return null;

        decimal riskPerUnit = Math.Abs(trade.EntryPrice - trade.StopLossAtEntry.Value);
        decimal rMoney = riskPerUnit * trade.Quantity;

        if (rMoney <= 0m)
            return null;

        return trade.RealizedPnL / rMoney;
    }

    private static Dictionary<string, decimal> AggregateMarketPnl(
        IReadOnlyList<Trade> trades,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> symbolToTimeframe)
    {
        var output = new Dictionary<string, decimal>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        foreach (var trade in trades)
        {
            string timeframe = symbolToTimeframe.TryGetValue(trade.Symbol, out var tf)
                ? tf
                : "UNKNOWN_TF";

            string key = $"{trade.Symbol}::{timeframe}";

            if (output.ContainsKey(key))
                output[key] += trade.RealizedPnL;
            else
                output[key] = trade.RealizedPnL;
        }

        return output;
    }

    private static string ComputeDecision(
        decimal expectancy,
        decimal avgR,
        decimal worstR,
        int catastrophicLossCount,
        int tpMissLikeCount,
        int symbolBreadthPositive,
        int symbolBreadthNegative)
    {
        if (expectancy <= 0m || avgR <= 0m)
            return "QUARANTINE";

        if (catastrophicLossCount > 0 || worstR <= -3m || tpMissLikeCount > 0)
            return "REFINE";

        if (symbolBreadthPositive <= symbolBreadthNegative)
            return "REFINE";

        return "PROMOTE";
    }

    private static bool ContainsToken(string? value, string token)
    {
        return (value ?? string.Empty).Contains(token, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    private static decimal SafeAverage(decimal total, int count)
    {
        return count <= 0 ? 0m : total / count;
    }

    private static string FormatPkt(DateTime? value)
    {
        if (!value.HasValue)
            return "N/A";

        return PakistanTime.FormatLabel(value.Value);
    }

    private static string FormatUtc(DateTime? value)
    {
        if (!value.HasValue)
            return "N/A";

        return $"{value.Value:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} UTC";
    }
}

using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Application.Reporting;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

public sealed class ReportArchiveService
{
    private const string FixedOldReportsRoot = @"D:\D DATA BACKUP\Data\Old Reports";

    public ReportArchiveResult ArchiveExistingReports()
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(FixedOldReportsRoot);

        var existingFiles = Directory
            .EnumerateFiles(DataPaths.Reports, "*", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly)
            .ToList();

        if (existingFiles.Count == 0)
        {
            return new ReportArchiveResult
            {
                ArchiveRootPath = FixedOldReportsRoot,
                ArchiveFolderPath = string.Empty,
                MovedFileCount = 0
            };
        }

        string folderStamp = PakistanTime.Stamp(DateTime.UtcNow);
        string archiveFolderPath = Path.Combine(FixedOldReportsRoot, $"OLD_FOLDER_{folderStamp}");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(archiveFolderPath);

        int moved = 0;

        foreach (string sourcePath in existingFiles)
        {
            string fileName = Path.GetFileName(sourcePath);
            string destinationPath = Path.Combine(archiveFolderPath, fileName);

            if (File.Exists(destinationPath))
                File.Delete(destinationPath);

            File.Move(sourcePath, destinationPath);
            moved++;
        }

        return new ReportArchiveResult
        {
            ArchiveRootPath = FixedOldReportsRoot,
            ArchiveFolderPath = archiveFolderPath,
            MovedFileCount = moved
        };
    }
}

public sealed class ReportArchiveResult
{
    public string ArchiveRootPath { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public string ArchiveFolderPath { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public int MovedFileCount { get; init; }
}

using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

public sealed class ReportPortalPublishService
{
    private const string PortalRootFolderName = "TQGA_REPORT_PORTAL";
    private const string SiteFolderName = "site";
    private const string RawFolderName = "raw";

    private static readonly LocalStaticSiteHost _localHost = new();

    public PublishPortalResult PublishLatestReports()
    {
        string reportDir = DataPaths.Reports;
        Directory.CreateDirectory(reportDir);

        string portalRoot = ResolvePortalRoot(reportDir);
        string siteDir = Path.Combine(portalRoot, SiteFolderName);
        string rawDir = Path.Combine(siteDir, RawFolderName);

        Directory.CreateDirectory(portalRoot);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(siteDir);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(rawDir);

        ClearDirectoryContents(siteDir, [RawFolderName]);
        ClearDirectoryContents(rawDir, []);

        List<string> allFiles = Directory
            .GetFiles(reportDir, "*.*", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
            .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        List<PublishedReportEntry> entries = [];

        foreach (string filePath in allFiles)
        {
            string relativePath = Path.GetRelativePath(reportDir, filePath);
            string normalizedRelativePath = relativePath.Replace('\\', '/');
            string rawRelativePath = normalizedRelativePath;

            string rawOutputPath = Path.Combine(rawDir, relativePath);
            string? rawOutputFolder = Path.GetDirectoryName(rawOutputPath);
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawOutputFolder))
                Directory.CreateDirectory(rawOutputFolder);

            File.Copy(filePath, rawOutputPath, overwrite: true);

            FileInfo info = new(filePath);
            bool isTextReport = info.Extension.Equals(".txt", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

            string? htmlPageFileName = null;

            if (isTextReport)
            {
                string htmlSafeName = BuildHtmlPageFileName(relativePath);
                string htmlPath = Path.Combine(siteDir, htmlSafeName);
                string content = ReadAllTextSafe(filePath);

                File.WriteAllText(
                    htmlPath,
                    BuildReportHtml(
                        displayName: relativePath,
                        sourcePath: filePath,
                        info: info,
                        content: content,
                        rawHref: BuildRawHref(rawRelativePath)),
                    Encoding.UTF8);

                htmlPageFileName = htmlSafeName;
            }

            entries.Add(new PublishedReportEntry
            {
                DisplayName = relativePath,
                SourcePath = filePath,
                RelativeRawPath = rawRelativePath,
                HtmlPageFileName = htmlPageFileName,
                IsTextReport = isTextReport,
                Modified = info.LastWriteTime,
                SizeBytes = info.Length
            });
        }

        string indexPath = Path.Combine(siteDir, "index.html");
        File.WriteAllText(
            indexPath,
            BuildIndexHtml(reportDir, siteDir, entries),
            Encoding.UTF8);

        string baseUrl = _localHost.Start(siteDir, 8787);
        string localWebUrl = baseUrl + "index.html";

        TryOpenInBrowser(localWebUrl);

        return new PublishPortalResult
        {
            Success = true,
            ReportDirectory = reportDir,
            PortalRootDirectory = portalRoot,
            SiteDirectory = siteDir,
            IndexFilePath = indexPath,
            ReportCount = entries.Count,
            LocalWebUrl = localWebUrl
        };
    }

    private static string ResolvePortalRoot(string reportDir)
    {
        DirectoryInfo? current = new(reportDir);

        while (current != null)
        {
            if (current.Name.Equals("D DATA BACKUP", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return Path.Combine(current.FullName, PortalRootFolderName);

            current = current.Parent;
        }

        string reportParent = Directory.GetParent(reportDir)?.FullName ?? reportDir;
        return Path.Combine(reportParent, PortalRootFolderName);
    }

    private static void ClearDirectoryContents(string rootDir, IReadOnlyList<string> keepFolderNames)
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(rootDir))
            return;

        foreach (string file in Directory.GetFiles(rootDir, "*", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly))
            File.Delete(file);

        foreach (string dir in Directory.GetDirectories(rootDir, "*", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly))
        {
            string name = Path.GetFileName(dir);
            if (keepFolderNames.Contains(name, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                continue;

            Directory.Delete(dir, recursive: true);
        }
    }

    private static string ReadAllTextSafe(string path)
    {
        try
        {
            return File.ReadAllText(path, Encoding.UTF8);
        }
        catch
        {
            return File.ReadAllText(path);
        }
    }

    private static string BuildHtmlPageFileName(string relativePath)
    {
        string safe = relativePath
            .Replace('\\', '_')
            .Replace('/', '_')
            .Replace(':', '_')
            .Replace(' ', '_');

        if (safe.EndsWith(".txt", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            safe = safe[..^4];

        return safe + ".html";
    }

    private static string BuildRawHref(string relativeRawPath)
    {
        IEnumerable<string> segments = relativeRawPath
            .Replace('\\', '/')
            .Split('/', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
            .Select(Uri.EscapeDataString);

        return "raw/" + string.Join("/", segments);
    }

    private static string BuildReportHtml(
        string displayName,
        string sourcePath,
        FileInfo info,
        string content,
        string rawHref)
    {
        string escapedName = Html(displayName);
        string escapedSource = Html(sourcePath);
        string escapedContent = Html(content);

        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        sb.AppendLine("<!DOCTYPE html>");
        sb.AppendLine("<html lang=\"en\">");
        sb.AppendLine("<head>");
        sb.AppendLine("    <meta charset=\"utf-8\" />");
        sb.AppendLine("    <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\" />");
        sb.AppendLine($"    <title>{escapedName}</title>");
        sb.AppendLine("    <style>");
        sb.AppendLine("        body {");
        sb.AppendLine("            font-family: Consolas, \"Courier New\", monospace;");
        sb.AppendLine("            background: #111;");
        sb.AppendLine("            color: #eee;");
        sb.AppendLine("            margin: 0;");
        sb.AppendLine("            padding: 32px;");
        sb.AppendLine("        }");
        sb.AppendLine("        .container {");
        sb.AppendLine("            max-width: 1400px;");
        sb.AppendLine("            margin: 0 auto;");
        sb.AppendLine("        }");
        sb.AppendLine("        a {");
        sb.AppendLine("            color: #6cf;");
        sb.AppendLine("            text-decoration: none;");
        sb.AppendLine("        }");
        sb.AppendLine("        a:hover {");
        sb.AppendLine("            text-decoration: underline;");
        sb.AppendLine("        }");
        sb.AppendLine("        .meta {");
        sb.AppendLine("            color: #bbb;");
        sb.AppendLine("            margin-bottom: 24px;");
        sb.AppendLine("            line-height: 1.7;");
        sb.AppendLine("        }");
        sb.AppendLine("        pre {");
        sb.AppendLine("            white-space: pre-wrap;");
        sb.AppendLine("            word-wrap: break-word;");
        sb.AppendLine("            background: #1a1a1a;");
        sb.AppendLine("            border: 1px solid #333;");
        sb.AppendLine("            padding: 18px;");
        sb.AppendLine("            border-radius: 8px;");
        sb.AppendLine("            overflow-x: auto;");
        sb.AppendLine("        }");
        sb.AppendLine("    </style>");
        sb.AppendLine("</head>");
        sb.AppendLine("<body>");
        sb.AppendLine("    <div class=\"container\">");
        sb.AppendLine("        <div><a href=\"index.html\">← Back to index</a></div>");
        sb.AppendLine($"        <h1>{escapedName}</h1>");
        sb.AppendLine("        <div class=\"meta\">");
        sb.AppendLine($"            <div><strong>Source:</strong> {escapedSource}</div>");
        sb.AppendLine($"            <div><strong>Modified:</strong> {info.LastWriteTime:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}</div>");
        sb.AppendLine($"            <div><strong>Size:</strong> {info.Length:N0} bytes</div>");
        sb.AppendLine($"            <div><strong>Raw File:</strong> <a href=\"{rawHref}\">{escapedName}</a></div>");
        sb.AppendLine("        </div>");
        sb.AppendLine($"        <pre>{escapedContent}</pre>");
        sb.AppendLine("    </div>");
        sb.AppendLine("</body>");
        sb.AppendLine("</html>");

        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static string BuildIndexHtml(
        string reportDir,
        string siteDir,
        IReadOnlyList<PublishedReportEntry> entries)
    {
        var rows = new StringBuilder();

        foreach (PublishedReportEntry entry in entries.OrderBy(x => x.DisplayName, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            string rawHref = BuildRawHref(entry.RelativeRawPath);
            string viewCell = entry.IsTextReport && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entry.HtmlPageFileName)
                ? $"<a href=\"{Uri.EscapeDataString(entry.HtmlPageFileName)}\">view</a>"
                : "-";

            rows.AppendLine("                <tr>");
            rows.AppendLine($"                    <td>{Html(entry.DisplayName)}</td>");
            rows.AppendLine($"                    <td>{entry.Modified:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}</td>");
            rows.AppendLine($"                    <td style=\"text-align:right;\">{entry.SizeBytes:N0}</td>");
            rows.AppendLine($"                    <td>{viewCell}</td>");
            rows.AppendLine($"                    <td><a href=\"{rawHref}\">raw</a></td>");
            rows.AppendLine("                </tr>");
        }

        if (rows.Length == 0)
        {
            rows.AppendLine("                <tr>");
            rows.AppendLine("                    <td colspan=\"5\">No files found.</td>");
            rows.AppendLine("                </tr>");
        }

        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        sb.AppendLine("<!DOCTYPE html>");
        sb.AppendLine("<html lang=\"en\">");
        sb.AppendLine("<head>");
        sb.AppendLine("    <meta charset=\"utf-8\" />");
        sb.AppendLine("    <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\" />");
        sb.AppendLine("    <title>TQGA Research Reports</title>");
        sb.AppendLine("    <style>");
        sb.AppendLine("        body {");
        sb.AppendLine("            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;");
        sb.AppendLine("            background: #111;");
        sb.AppendLine("            color: #eee;");
        sb.AppendLine("            margin: 0;");
        sb.AppendLine("            padding: 32px;");
        sb.AppendLine("        }");
        sb.AppendLine("        .container {");
        sb.AppendLine("            max-width: 1500px;");
        sb.AppendLine("            margin: 0 auto;");
        sb.AppendLine("        }");
        sb.AppendLine("        a {");
        sb.AppendLine("            color: #6cf;");
        sb.AppendLine("            text-decoration: none;");
        sb.AppendLine("        }");
        sb.AppendLine("        a:hover {");
        sb.AppendLine("            text-decoration: underline;");
        sb.AppendLine("        }");
        sb.AppendLine("        .meta {");
        sb.AppendLine("            color: #bbb;");
        sb.AppendLine("            margin-bottom: 24px;");
        sb.AppendLine("            line-height: 1.7;");
        sb.AppendLine("        }");
        sb.AppendLine("        table {");
        sb.AppendLine("            width: 100%;");
        sb.AppendLine("            border-collapse: collapse;");
        sb.AppendLine("            background: #1a1a1a;");
        sb.AppendLine("            border: 1px solid #333;");
        sb.AppendLine("        }");
        sb.AppendLine("        th, td {");
        sb.AppendLine("            padding: 12px;");
        sb.AppendLine("            border-bottom: 1px solid #333;");
        sb.AppendLine("            text-align: left;");
        sb.AppendLine("            vertical-align: top;");
        sb.AppendLine("        }");
        sb.AppendLine("        th {");
        sb.AppendLine("            background: #222;");
        sb.AppendLine("        }");
        sb.AppendLine("    </style>");
        sb.AppendLine("</head>");
        sb.AppendLine("<body>");
        sb.AppendLine("    <div class=\"container\">");
        sb.AppendLine("        <h1>TQGA Research Reports</h1>");
        sb.AppendLine("        <div class=\"meta\">");
        sb.AppendLine($"            <div><strong>Generated:</strong> {DateTime.Now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}</div>");
        sb.AppendLine($"            <div><strong>Report Folder:</strong> {Html(reportDir)}</div>");
        sb.AppendLine($"            <div><strong>Site Folder:</strong> {Html(siteDir)}</div>");
        sb.AppendLine($"            <div><strong>Total Files Published:</strong> {entries.Count}</div>");
        sb.AppendLine($"            <div><strong>TXT Reports With HTML View:</strong> {entries.Count(x => x.IsTextReport)}</div>");
        sb.AppendLine("        </div>");
        sb.AppendLine("        <table>");
        sb.AppendLine("            <thead>");
        sb.AppendLine("                <tr>");
        sb.AppendLine("                    <th>File</th>");
        sb.AppendLine("                    <th>Modified</th>");
        sb.AppendLine("                    <th>Size (bytes)</th>");
        sb.AppendLine("                    <th>View</th>");
        sb.AppendLine("                    <th>Raw</th>");
        sb.AppendLine("                </tr>");
        sb.AppendLine("            </thead>");
        sb.AppendLine("            <tbody>");
        sb.Append(rows);
        sb.AppendLine("            </tbody>");
        sb.AppendLine("        </table>");
        sb.AppendLine("    </div>");
        sb.AppendLine("</body>");
        sb.AppendLine("</html>");

        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static string Html(string value)
    {
        return System.Net.WebUtility.HtmlEncode(value ?? string.Empty);
    }

    private static void TryOpenInBrowser(string urlOrPath)
    {
        Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo
        {
            FileName = urlOrPath,
            UseShellExecute = true
        });
    }

    {

        public bool IsTextReport { get; init; }

using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Application.Reporting;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

public sealed class StrategyContributionReportService
{
    public void Generate(Dictionary<int, decimal> pnl)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 019 — STRATEGY CONTRIBUTION");
        sb.AppendLine("==================================");
        sb.AppendLine();

        if (pnl == null || pnl.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO DATA: StrategyPnL is empty.");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (var p in pnl.OrderByDescending(x => x.Value))
                sb.AppendLine($"Strategy {p.Key:00} → PnL {p.Value:F2}");
        }

        var definition = ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("STRATEGY_PNL", "019");
        var naming = new ReportFileNamingService();
        string fileName = naming.BuildLocalFileName(definition, DateTime.UtcNow, ".txt");

        File.WriteAllText(
            Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, fileName),
            sb.ToString());
    }
}

using System.Text;

{

        sb.AppendLine("=============================================");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("Key format: S##::SYMBOL::TF  (example: S02::ATOMUSDT::1h)");
        sb.AppendLine();

        if (strategySymbolTimeframePnL == null || strategySymbolTimeframePnL.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO DATA");

        else
        {
            sb.AppendLine("TOP 100 (by PnL)");

            foreach (var kv in strategySymbolTimeframePnL.OrderByDescending(x => x.Value).Take(100))
                sb.AppendLine($"{kv.Key,-32} {kv.Value,14:F2}");

            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine("FULL LIST (sorted by PnL desc)");
            sb.AppendLine("------------------------------");
            foreach (var kv in strategySymbolTimeframePnL.OrderByDescending(x => x.Value))
                sb.AppendLine($"{kv.Key,-32} {kv.Value,14:F2}");

        var definition = ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("STRATEGY_SYMBOL_TF_PNL", "022");

using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Application.Strategy;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

public sealed class StructureReportService
{
    private const string OldReportsRoot = @"D:\D DATA BACKUP\Data\Old Reports";

    public void Generate()
    {
        // PATCH:
        // Before creating the new STRUCTURE_{timestamp}.txt file,
        // move all existing files from Reports into a timestamped archival folder
        // under D:\D DATA BACKUP\Data\Old Reports.
        ArchiveExistingReportsBeforeStructureWrite();

        var strategyTypes = AppDomain.CurrentDomain
            .GetAssemblies()
            .SelectMany(a => a.GetTypes())
            .Where(t => typeof(IStrategy).IsAssignableFrom(t)
                     && !t.IsAbstract
                     && !t.IsInterface)
            .OrderBy(t => t.Name)
            .ToList();

        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("TQGA ARCHITECTURE REPORT");
        sb.AppendLine("========================");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("REGISTERED STRATEGIES");
        sb.AppendLine("---------------------");

        int id = 1;

        foreach (var s in strategyTypes)
        {
            sb.AppendLine($"[{id:00}] {s.Name}");
            id++;
        }

        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        File.WriteAllText(
            Path.Combine(
                DataPaths.Reports,
                $"STRUCTURE_{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.txt"),
            sb.ToString());
    }

    private static void ArchiveExistingReportsBeforeStructureWrite()
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(OldReportsRoot);

        var filesToMove = Directory
            .EnumerateFiles(DataPaths.Reports, "*", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly)
            .ToList();

        if (filesToMove.Count == 0)
            return;

        string archiveFolderName = $"just old folder {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}";
        string archiveFolderPath = Path.Combine(OldReportsRoot, archiveFolderName);

        Directory.CreateDirectory(archiveFolderPath);

        foreach (string sourceFilePath in filesToMove)
        {
            string fileName = Path.GetFileName(sourceFilePath);
            string destinationFilePath = Path.Combine(archiveFolderPath, fileName);

            destinationFilePath = ResolveUniqueDestinationPath(destinationFilePath);

            File.Move(sourceFilePath, destinationFilePath);
        }
    }

    private static string ResolveUniqueDestinationPath(string destinationFilePath)
    {
        if (!File.Exists(destinationFilePath))
            return destinationFilePath;

        string directory = Path.GetDirectoryName(destinationFilePath) ?? string.Empty;
        string fileNameWithoutExtension = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(destinationFilePath);
        string extension = Path.GetExtension(destinationFilePath);

        int suffix = 1;
        string candidate;

        do
        {
            candidate = Path.Combine(
                directory,
                $"{fileNameWithoutExtension}__DUP_{suffix}{extension}");
            suffix++;
        }
        while (File.Exists(candidate));

        return candidate;
    }
}

using System;

using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Application.Reporting;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

public sealed class SymbolHeatmapReportService
{
    public void Generate(Dictionary<string, decimal> pnl)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        sb.AppendLine("REPORT 020 — SYMBOL HEATMAP");
        sb.AppendLine("===========================");
        sb.AppendLine();

        if (pnl == null || pnl.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("NO DATA");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (var s in pnl.OrderByDescending(x => x.Value))
                sb.AppendLine($"{s.Key,-24} {s.Value,12:F2}");
        }

        var definition = ReportCatalog.ResolveOrDefault("SYMBOL_PNL", "020");
        var naming = new ReportFileNamingService();
        string fileName = naming.BuildLocalFileName(definition, DateTime.UtcNow, ".txt");
        var path = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, fileName);

        File.WriteAllText(path, sb.ToString());
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using TQGA.Application.Backtesting;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

public sealed class UniversalResearchReportService
{
    public void GenerateAll(
        PortfolioBacktestResult result,
        DateTime runUtc,
        IReadOnlyList<Type> selectedStrategies)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(result);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(selectedStrategies);

        var canonicalCio = GetStoredCanonicalCioOrThrow(result);
        new A84MarketRegimeDetectionReportService().Generate(result);
        new A84AlphaDecayMonitoringReportService().Generate(result);

        var fitnessSvc = new A84StrategyFitnessGatingReportService();
        var cfg = new A84StrategyFitnessGatingReportService.FitnessConfig();

        var (fitnessRows, allowed) = fitnessSvc.ComputeFitness(result, cfg);

        new A84_RegimeResearchService().Generate(
            result,
            canonicalCio);

        result.CanonicalCioPostGatingWeights = canonicalCio;

        fitnessSvc.GenerateAndWrite(result, runUtc, cfg);

        var fitnessSnapshots = fitnessRows.ToDictionary(
            kv => kv.Key,
            kv => new StrategyFitnessSnapshot
            {
                StrategyId = kv.Value.StrategyId,
                StrategyCode = kv.Value.StrategyCode,
                PnL = kv.Value.PnL,
                Trades = kv.Value.Trades,
                Exits = kv.Value.Exits,
                FitnessScore = kv.Value.FitnessScore,
                Allowed = kv.Value.Allowed,
                GateReason = kv.Value.GateReason
            });

        new Report19EdgeDeathMapReportService().GenerateAndWrite(
            result,
            runUtc,
            fitnessSnapshots,
            allowed);

        new Report20AlphaDecayS05DependencyAuditService().GenerateAndWrite(
            result,
            runUtc,
            fitnessSnapshots);

        new Report21S05LateHalfFailureAuditService().GenerateAndWrite(
            result,
            runUtc,
            fitnessSnapshots);

        new Report22S05WinnerFatigueLateEntryAuditService().GenerateAndWrite(
            result,
            runUtc,
            fitnessSnapshots);

        new Report23S05ExitEfficiencyLateHoldBleedAuditService().GenerateAndWrite(
            result,
            runUtc,
            fitnessSnapshots);

        new Report24S05CompatibleEdgeExpansionNearWinnerAuditService().GenerateAndWrite(
            result,
            runUtc,
            fitnessSnapshots);

        new Report25DispersionGuardNearWinnerPromotionAuditService().GenerateAndWrite(
            result,
            runUtc,
            fitnessSnapshots);

        new Report26TrueNewEdgeFamilyOpportunityAuditService().GenerateAndWrite(
            result,
            runUtc,
            fitnessSnapshots);

        new Report27FourHourEarlyTrendContinuationFamilyDesignAuditService().GenerateAndWrite(
            result,
            runUtc,
            fitnessSnapshots);

        new Report28FourHourEarlyTrendContinuationImplementationReadinessAuditService().GenerateAndWrite(
            result,
            runUtc,
            fitnessSnapshots);

        new Report29S06EarlyTrendFamilyContributionNearSurvivorAuditService().GenerateAndWrite(
            result,
            runUtc,
            fitnessSnapshots);

        new Report30S06Phase1RefinementEntryTighteningAuditService().GenerateAndWrite(
            result,
            runUtc,
            fitnessSnapshots);

        new A84ExecutiveSummaryReportService().GenerateAndWrite(
            result,
            runUtc,
            selectedStrategies,
            canonicalCio,
            fitnessSnapshots,
            allowed,
            recentMinutesWindow: 10);

        new A84ChatGptUploadReportService().GenerateAndWrite(
            result,
            runUtc,
            selectedStrategies,
            fitnessSnapshots,
            allowed,
            canonicalCio);
    }

    private static Dictionary<string, decimal> GetStoredCanonicalCioOrThrow(
        PortfolioBacktestResult result)
    {
        if (result.CanonicalCioPostGatingWeights == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "PATCH 12: Stored CanonicalCioPostGatingWeights is null.");

        if (result.CanonicalCioPostGatingWeights.Count == 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "PATCH 12: Stored CanonicalCioPostGatingWeights is empty.");

        return result.CanonicalCioPostGatingWeights;
    }
}

using System.Text;
using TQGA.Application.Backtesting;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Application.Reporting;

namespace TQGA.Application.Services;

public sealed class WalkForwardValidationReportService
{
    public void GenerateProxyReports(
        PortfolioBacktestResult result,
        DateTime runUtc,
        IReadOnlyList<Type> selectedStrategies)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(result);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(selectedStrategies);

        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        ReportDefinition splitsDefinition = ReportCatalog.WalkForwardSplitsTxt;
        ReportDefinition foldSummaryDefinition = ReportCatalog.WalkForwardFoldSummaryTxt;
        ReportDefinition equityCsvDefinition = ReportCatalog.WalkForwardEquityCsv;
        ReportDefinition chatGptUploadDefinition = ReportCatalog.WalkForwardChatGptUploadTxt;

        string wf044 = BuildTxtPath(splitsDefinition, runUtc);
        string wf045 = BuildTxtPath(foldSummaryDefinition, runUtc);
        string wf046 = BuildCsvPath(equityCsvDefinition, runUtc);
        string wf047 = BuildTxtPath(chatGptUploadDefinition, runUtc);

        var folds = result.WalkForwardFolds
            .OrderBy(x => x.FoldNo)
            .ToList();

        if (folds.Count == 0)
        {
            File.WriteAllText(wf044, BuildEmptySplitsReport(splitsDefinition, runUtc));
            File.WriteAllText(wf045, BuildEmptyFoldSummaryReport(foldSummaryDefinition, runUtc));
            File.WriteAllText(wf046, "Fold,TrainStartUtc,TrainEndUtc,TestStartUtc,TestEndUtc,StartEquity,EndEquity,ReturnPct,TestPoints\r\n");
            File.WriteAllText(wf047, BuildEmptyChatGptUploadReport(chatGptUploadDefinition, runUtc));
            return;
        }

        WriteSplitReport(wf044, splitsDefinition, runUtc, selectedStrategies, folds);
        WriteFoldSummaryReport(wf045, foldSummaryDefinition, runUtc, folds);
        WriteWalkForwardEquityCsv(wf046, equityCsvDefinition, folds);
        WriteCompactUpload(wf047, chatGptUploadDefinition, runUtc, selectedStrategies, folds, result);
    }

    private static string BuildTxtPath(ReportDefinition definition, DateTime runUtc)
    {
        var naming = new ReportFileNamingService();
        string fileName = naming.BuildLocalFileName(definition, runUtc, ".txt");
        return Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, fileName);
    }

    private static string BuildCsvPath(ReportDefinition definition, DateTime runUtc)
    {
        var naming = new ReportFileNamingService();
        string fileName = naming.BuildLocalFileName(definition, runUtc, ".csv");
        return Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, fileName);
    }

    private static string BuildEmptySplitsReport(ReportDefinition definition, DateTime runUtc)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine($"REPORT {definition.Number} — TRUE WALK-FORWARD SPLITS");
        sb.AppendLine("=====================================");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine($"Run Timestamp (UTC) : {runUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Number       : {definition.Number}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Purpose      : {definition.PurposeName}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("No walk-forward folds available.");
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static string BuildEmptyFoldSummaryReport(ReportDefinition definition, DateTime runUtc)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine($"REPORT {definition.Number} — TRUE FOLD SUMMARY");
        sb.AppendLine("=================================");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine($"Run Timestamp (UTC) : {runUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Number       : {definition.Number}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Purpose      : {definition.PurposeName}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("No walk-forward folds available.");
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static string BuildEmptyChatGptUploadReport(ReportDefinition definition, DateTime runUtc)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine($"REPORT {definition.Number} — CHATGPT UPLOAD");
        sb.AppendLine("=================================");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine($"Run Timestamp (UTC) : {runUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Number       : {definition.Number}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Purpose      : {definition.PurposeName}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("No walk-forward folds available.");
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static void WriteSplitReport(
        string path,
        ReportDefinition definition,
        DateTime runUtc,
        IReadOnlyList<Type> selectedStrategies,
        IReadOnlyList<WalkForwardFoldSnapshot> folds)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine($"REPORT {definition.Number} — TRUE WALK-FORWARD SPLITS");
        sb.AppendLine("=====================================");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine($"Run Timestamp (UTC) : {runUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Number       : {definition.Number}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Purpose      : {definition.PurposeName}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Strategies Selected : {selectedStrategies.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("METHOD");
        sb.AppendLine("------");
        sb.AppendLine("Rule-based walk-forward rerun.");
        sb.AppendLine("Each fold uses chronological train warmup followed by unseen test window evaluation.");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("FOLDS");
        sb.AppendLine("-----");

        foreach (var f in folds)
        {
            sb.AppendLine(
                $"Fold {f.FoldNo:00} | TRAIN {f.TrainStartUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} -> {f.TrainEndUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} | TEST {f.TestStartUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} -> {f.TestEndUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} | TestPoints {f.TestPoints}");
        }

        File.WriteAllText(path, sb.ToString());
    }

    private static void WriteFoldSummaryReport(
        string path,
        ReportDefinition definition,
        DateTime runUtc,
        IReadOnlyList<WalkForwardFoldSnapshot> folds)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine($"REPORT {definition.Number} — TRUE FOLD SUMMARY");
        sb.AppendLine("=================================");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine($"Run Timestamp (UTC) : {runUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Number       : {definition.Number}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Purpose      : {definition.PurposeName}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("Fold | Start Equity | End Equity | Return % | Test Points");
        sb.AppendLine("-----+--------------+------------+----------+------------");

        foreach (var f in folds)
        {
            sb.AppendLine(
                $"{f.FoldNo,4} | {f.StartEquity,12:F2} | {f.EndEquity,10:F2} | {f.ReturnPct,8:F2} | {f.TestPoints,10}");
        }

        var positive = folds.Count(x => x.ReturnPct > 0m);
        var negative = folds.Count(x => x.ReturnPct < 0m);
        var stability = folds.Count == 0 ? 0m : (decimal)positive / folds.Count * 100m;

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("SUMMARY");
        sb.AppendLine("-------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Positive folds : {positive}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Negative folds : {negative}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Fold stability : {stability:F2}%");

        File.WriteAllText(path, sb.ToString());
    }

    private static void WriteWalkForwardEquityCsv(
        string path,
        ReportDefinition definition,
        IReadOnlyList<WalkForwardFoldSnapshot> folds)
    {
        var lines = new List<string>
        {
            "Fold,TrainStartUtc,TrainEndUtc,TestStartUtc,TestEndUtc,StartEquity,EndEquity,ReturnPct,TestPoints"
        };

        lines.AddRange(folds.Select(f =>
            $"{f.FoldNo},{f.TrainStartUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss},{f.TrainEndUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss},{f.TestStartUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss},{f.TestEndUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss},{f.StartEquity:F2},{f.EndEquity:F2},{f.ReturnPct:F4},{f.TestPoints}"));

        File.WriteAllLines(path, lines);
    }

    private static void WriteCompactUpload(
        string path,
        ReportDefinition definition,
        DateTime runUtc,
        IReadOnlyList<Type> selectedStrategies,
        IReadOnlyList<WalkForwardFoldSnapshot> folds,
        PortfolioBacktestResult result)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine($"REPORT {definition.Number} — CHATGPT UPLOAD");
        sb.AppendLine("=================================");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine($"Run Timestamp (UTC) : {runUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Number       : {definition.Number}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Purpose      : {definition.PurposeName}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Strategies Selected : {selectedStrategies.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Equity Points       : {result.PortfolioEquityTimeline.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("NOTE");
        sb.AppendLine("----");
        sb.AppendLine("True rule-based walk-forward rerun with chronological train warmup and unseen test windows.");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("FOLD RETURNS");
        sb.AppendLine("------------");

        foreach (var f in folds)
        {
            sb.AppendLine(
                $"Fold {f.FoldNo:00} | TestReturn {f.ReturnPct:F2}% | TestPoints {f.TestPoints}");
        }

        var best = folds.OrderByDescending(x => x.ReturnPct).First();
        var worst = folds.OrderBy(x => x.ReturnPct).First();

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("EXTREMES");
        sb.AppendLine("--------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Best Fold  : F{best.FoldNo:00} {best.ReturnPct:F2}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Worst Fold : F{worst.FoldNo:00} {worst.ReturnPct:F2}%");

        File.WriteAllText(path, sb.ToString());
    }
}

using TQGA.Domain.Trading;

namespace TQGA.Application.Strategy;

public sealed class DiagnosticQuantStrategy : QuantStrategy
{
    public override string Name => "Regime Pullback Quant";

    private int _ticks;

    private int _emaLong;
    private int _rsiLong;
    private int _rsiExit;

    private bool _bullishRegime;

    private int _entries;
    private int _exits;

    public override void Initialize()
    {
    }

    public override TradeSignal OnTick(StrategyContext context)
    {
        _ticks++;

        bool pullback = false;
        bool exit = false;

        foreach (var signal in Signals)
        {
            var result = signal.Evaluate(context);

            if (signal.GetType().Name == "EmaCrossSignal")
            {
                if (result == TradeSignal.Long)
                {
                    _bullishRegime = true;
                    _emaLong++;
                }
            }

            if (signal.GetType().Name == "RsiReversionSignal")
            {
                if (result == TradeSignal.Long)
                {
                    pullback = true;
                    _rsiLong++;
                }

                if (result == TradeSignal.Exit)
                {
                    exit = true;
                    _rsiExit++;
                }
            }
        }

        if (_bullishRegime && pullback && !context.HasOpenPosition)
        {
            _entries++;
            return TradeSignal.Long;
        }

        if (context.HasOpenPosition && exit)
        {
            _exits++;
            return TradeSignal.Exit;
        }

        return TradeSignal.None;
    }

    public void PrintStats()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("\n========= SIGNAL TELEMETRY =========");
        Console.WriteLine($"Ticks processed      : {_ticks}");
        Console.WriteLine($"EMA bullish signals  : {_emaLong}");
        Console.WriteLine($"RSI pullbacks        : {_rsiLong}");
        Console.WriteLine($"RSI exits            : {_rsiExit}");
        Console.WriteLine($"Entries              : {_entries}");
        Console.WriteLine($"Exits                : {_exits}");
        Console.WriteLine($"Regime active        : {_bullishRegime}");
        Console.WriteLine("====================================\n");
    }

    public void AddSignal(ISignal signal)
    {
        Signals.Add(signal);
    }
}

using TQGA.Domain.Trading;

namespace TQGA.Application.Strategy;

public abstract class QuantStrategy : IStrategy
{
    public abstract string Name { get; }

    protected readonly List<ISignal> Signals = new();

    public virtual void Initialize()
    {
    }

    // ✅ NEW — SIGNAL INJECTION SUPPORT (for StrategyFactory)
    public void SetSignals(IEnumerable<ISignal> signals)
    {
        Signals.Clear();
        Signals.AddRange(signals);
    }

    public virtual TradeSignal OnTick(StrategyContext context)
    {
        foreach (var signal in Signals)
        {
            var result = signal.Evaluate(context);

            if (result != TradeSignal.None)
                return result;
        }

        return TradeSignal.None;
    }
}

namespace TQGA.Application.Strategy;

public sealed class StrategyContext
{
    public decimal Price { get; }
    public DateTime Time { get; }
    public bool HasOpenPosition { get; }
    public decimal PositionSize { get; }

    public StrategyContext(
        decimal price,
        DateTime time,
        bool hasOpenPosition,
        decimal positionSize)
    {
        Price = price;
        Time = time;
        HasOpenPosition = hasOpenPosition;
        PositionSize = positionSize;
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace TQGA.Application.Strategy;

/// <summary>
/// StrategyFactory is the ONLY place responsible for instantiating concrete strategies.
/// - Uses ActivatorUtilities so DI can inject dependencies when needed.
/// - Also provides discovery of concrete IStrategy types across loaded assemblies.
/// </summary>
public sealed class StrategyFactory
{
    private readonly IServiceProvider _root;

    public StrategyFactory(IServiceProvider root)
    {
        _root = root;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Create a strategy instance of the provided type using DI.
    /// The type MUST implement IStrategy and MUST be concrete (not abstract).
    /// </summary>
    public IStrategy Create(Type strategyType)
    {
        if (strategyType is null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(strategyType));

        if (!typeof(IStrategy).IsAssignableFrom(strategyType))
            throw new ArgumentException($"Type '{strategyType.FullName}' does not implement IStrategy.");

        if (strategyType.IsAbstract || strategyType.IsInterface)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Type '{strategyType.FullName}' is abstract/interface and cannot be created.");

        var instance = ActivatorUtilities.CreateInstance(_root, strategyType);

        if (instance is not IStrategy strategy)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Activator created '{strategyType.FullName}' but it is not IStrategy.");

        return strategy;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Discovers all concrete IStrategy types from currently loaded assemblies.
    /// This avoids Application referencing Infrastructure directly.
    /// </summary>
    public static IReadOnlyList<Type> DiscoverConcreteStrategyTypes()
    {
        var types =
            AppDomain.CurrentDomain
                .GetAssemblies()
                .SelectMany(a =>
                {
                    try { return a.GetTypes(); }
                    catch { return Array.Empty<Type>(); }
                })
                .Where(t =>
                    t is not null &&
                    typeof(IStrategy).IsAssignableFrom(t) &&
                    !t.IsAbstract &&
                    !t.IsInterface)
                .Distinct()
                .OrderBy(t => t.Name)
                .ToList();

        return types;
    }
}

    public IReadOnlyList<LiveAccountBalance> Balances { get; init; } = Array.Empty<LiveAccountBalance>();

    public IReadOnlyList<LiveTradeFill> RecentFills { get; init; } = Array.Empty<LiveTradeFill>();

    public IReadOnlyList<string> Errors { get; init; } = Array.Empty<string>();

    public int OpenOrderCount => OpenOrders.Count;

    public decimal WalletUsdt => UsdtBalance?.WalletBalance ?? 0m;
    public decimal AvailableUsdt => UsdtBalance?.AvailableBalance ?? 0m;
    public decimal UnrealizedPnlUsdt => Positions.Sum(x => x.UnrealizedProfit);
    public decimal RecentRealizedPnlUsdt => RecentFills.Sum(x => x.RealizedPnl);
    public decimal RecentCommissionUsdt => RecentFills.Where(x => x.CommissionAsset.Equals("USDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).Sum(x => x.Commission);

using TQGA.Application.Interfaces;
using TQGA.Application.Reporting;
using TQGA.Domain.Trading;

namespace TQGA.Application.Trading;

public sealed class LiveAccountSyncService
{
    private readonly IExchangeAccountClient _accountClient;
    private readonly IExchangeMarketClient _marketClient;
    private readonly LiveSyncReportService _reportService;

    public LiveAccountSyncService(
        IExchangeAccountClient accountClient,
        IExchangeMarketClient marketClient,
        LiveSyncReportService reportService)
    {
        _accountClient = accountClient;
        _marketClient = marketClient;
        _reportService = reportService;
    }

    public async Task<(LiveAccountSnapshot Snapshot, string ReportPath)> SyncAsync(
        LiveAccountSyncRequest request,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var errors = new List<string>();
        ExchangeConnectionCheck connection;

        try
        {
            connection = await _accountClient.CheckConnectionAsync(ct);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            connection = new ExchangeConnectionCheck
            {
                Success = false,
                Message = ex.Message,
                CheckedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,
                Latency = TimeSpan.Zero
            };
            errors.Add("Connection check failed: " + ex.Message);
        }

        IReadOnlyList<LiveAccountBalance> balances = Array.Empty<LiveAccountBalance>();
        IReadOnlyList<LivePosition> positions = Array.Empty<LivePosition>();
        IReadOnlyList<LiveOpenOrder> openOrders = Array.Empty<LiveOpenOrder>();
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SymbolTradingRule> symbolRules = new Dictionary<string, SymbolTradingRule>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        var fills = new List<LiveTradeFill>();

        try
        {
            symbolRules = await _marketClient.GetSymbolRulesAsync(ct);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            errors.Add("Symbol rules sync failed: " + ex.Message);
        }

        try
        {
            balances = await _accountClient.GetBalancesAsync(ct);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            errors.Add("Balance sync failed: " + ex.Message);
        }

        try
        {
            positions = await _accountClient.GetPositionsAsync(ct);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            errors.Add("Position sync failed: " + ex.Message);
        }

        try
        {
            openOrders = await _accountClient.GetOpenOrdersAsync(null, ct);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            errors.Add("Open order sync failed: " + ex.Message);
        }

        foreach (string symbol in request.TradeHistorySymbols)
        {
            try
            {
                var symbolFills = await _accountClient.GetRecentTradeFillsAsync(
                    symbol,
                    request.TradeHistoryLimitPerSymbol,
                    ct);

                fills.AddRange(symbolFills);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                errors.Add($"Trade history sync failed for {symbol}: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        var snapshot = new LiveAccountSnapshot
        {
            SnapshotUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,
            Mode = request.Mode,
            IsHealthy = connection.Success && errors.Count == 0,
            HealthMessage = connection.Success
                ? errors.Count == 0 ? "SYNC OK - READONLY" : "SYNC PARTIAL - SEE ERRORS"
                : "CONNECTION FAILED - " + connection.Message,
            Balances = balances,
            Positions = positions,
            OpenOrders = openOrders,
            RecentFills = fills
                .OrderByDescending(x => x.TimeUtc)
                .ToList(),
            SymbolRules = symbolRules,
            Errors = errors
        };

        string reportPath = _reportService.WriteReadonlySyncReport(snapshot);
        return (snapshot, reportPath);
    }
}
