using TQGA.Application.Interfaces;
using TQGA.Application.Reporting;
using TQGA.Domain.Trading;

namespace TQGA.Application.Trading;

public sealed class TestnetOrderExecutionService
{
    private readonly IExchangeAccountClient _account;
    private readonly IExchangeMarketClient _market;
    private readonly IExchangeOrderClient _orders;
    private readonly LiveOrderExecutionReportService _reporting;

    public TestnetOrderExecutionService(
        IExchangeAccountClient account,
        IExchangeMarketClient market,
        IExchangeOrderClient orders,
        LiveOrderExecutionReportService reporting)
    {
        _account = account ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(account));
        _market = market ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(market));
        _orders = orders ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(orders));
        _reporting = reporting ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(reporting));
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<string>> GetRuleValidatedSymbolsAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SymbolTradingRule> rules = await _market.GetSymbolRulesAsync(ct);

        return rules.Keys
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
            .Select(x => x.Trim().ToUpperInvariant())
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();
    }

    public async Task<LiveOrderExecutionResult> PlaceEntryWithProtectionAsync(TestnetOrderExecutionRequest request, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(request);
        DateTime started = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var warnings = new List<string>();

        ValidateTestnetOnly(request);

        string symbol = NormalizeSymbol(request.Symbol);
        decimal tradeSize = ValidateTradeSize(request.TradeSizeUsdt, request.MaxTradeSizeUsdt);
        int leverage = Math.Clamp(request.Leverage, 1, 20);

        var connection = await _account.CheckConnectionAsync(ct);
        if (!connection.Success)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Binance connection check failed: " + connection.Message);

        var balances = await _account.GetBalancesAsync(ct);
        var usdt = balances.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Asset.Equals("USDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        if (usdt == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("USDT balance not found.");

        // Required margin is checked after Binance symbol rules are loaded, because
        // the final valid quantity may need to be rounded UP to satisfy minNotional.

        var positions = await _account.GetPositionsAsync(ct);
        var openPositions = positions
            .Where(x => x.Symbol.Equals(symbol, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && x.IsOpen)
            .ToList();

        if (request.RequireNoExistingPosition && openPositions.Count > 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Existing open position found on {symbol}. Close it before placing a new test order.");

        var openOrders = await _account.GetOpenOrdersAsync(symbol, ct);
        if (request.RequireNoOpenOrders && openOrders.Count > 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Existing open orders found on {symbol}. Cancel them before placing a new test order.");

        var rules = await _market.GetSymbolRulesAsync(ct);
        if (!rules.TryGetValue(symbol, out SymbolTradingRule? rule))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Symbol trading rule not found for {symbol}.");

        decimal markPrice = await _orders.GetMarkPriceAsync(symbol, ct);
        decimal rawQty = tradeSize / markPrice;
        decimal qty = rule.RoundQuantityDown(rawQty);

        if (qty <= 0m)
            qty = CalculateMinimumValidQuantity(rule, markPrice);

        if (rule.MinQuantity > 0m && qty < rule.MinQuantity)
            qty = RoundQuantityUp(rule.MinQuantity, rule.QuantityStepSize);

        decimal notional = qty * markPrice;

        if (rule.MinNotional > 0m && notional < rule.MinNotional)
        {
            decimal minQtyForNotional = CalculateMinimumValidQuantity(rule, markPrice);
            if (minQtyForNotional > qty)
                qty = minQtyForNotional;

            notional = qty * markPrice;
        }

        if (qty <= 0m)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Calculated quantity is zero. Raw={rawQty:F12}, Step={rule.QuantityStepSize:F12}.");

        if (rule.MinQuantity > 0m && qty < rule.MinQuantity)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Quantity {qty:F8} is below minimum {rule.MinQuantity:F8}.");

        if (rule.MinNotional > 0m && notional < rule.MinNotional)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Notional {notional:F4} is below minimum {rule.MinNotional:F4}.");

        if (notional > request.MaxTradeSizeUsdt)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"Minimum valid Binance order for {symbol} is approximately {notional:F4} USDT after quantity step rounding. " +
                $"Your Max Size safety limit is {request.MaxTradeSizeUsdt:F4} USDT. Increase Max Size to at least {Math.Ceiling(notional):F0} USDT or use a smaller-price symbol.");
        }

        decimal requiredMargin = notional / leverage;
        if (usdt.AvailableBalance < requiredMargin)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Available USDT {usdt.AvailableBalance:F4} is below required margin {requiredMargin:F4}.");

        if (qty != rawQty)
            warnings.Add($"Quantity adjusted from raw {rawQty:F12} to valid Binance step quantity {qty:F12} using step size {rule.QuantityStepSize:F12}.");

        if (notional > tradeSize)
            warnings.Add($"Requested trade size {tradeSize:F4} USDT was below Binance minimum valid step/notional. Actual testnet notional increased to {notional:F4} USDT, within Max Size {request.MaxTradeSizeUsdt:F4} USDT.");

        LiveOrderResult leverageResult = await _orders.SetLeverageAsync(symbol, leverage, ct);
        warnings.Add(leverageResult.Message);

        string tag = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMddHHmmss");
        LiveOrderResult entry = await _orders.PlaceOrderAsync(
            LiveOrderRequest.Market(
                symbol,
                request.Side,
                qty,
                reduceOnly: false,
                clientOrderId: $"TQGA891_ENTRY_{tag}"),
            ct);

        ExchangeOrderSide exitSide = request.Side == ExchangeOrderSide.Buy
            ? ExchangeOrderSide.Sell
            : ExchangeOrderSide.Buy;

        decimal slPrice = CalculateStopLoss(markPrice, request.Side, request.StopLossPercent);
        decimal tpPrice = CalculateTakeProfit(markPrice, request.Side, request.TakeProfitPercent);
        slPrice = rule.RoundPriceDown(slPrice);
        tpPrice = rule.RoundPriceDown(tpPrice);

        LiveOrderResult sl = await _orders.PlaceOrderAsync(
            LiveOrderRequest.StopMarket(
                symbol,
                exitSide,
                qty,
                slPrice,
                reduceOnly: true,
                clientOrderId: $"TQGA891_SL_{tag}"),
            ct);

        LiveOrderResult tp = await _orders.PlaceOrderAsync(
            LiveOrderRequest.TakeProfitMarket(
                symbol,
                exitSide,
                qty,
                tpPrice,
                reduceOnly: true,
                clientOrderId: $"TQGA891_TP_{tag}"),
            ct);

        var result = new LiveOrderExecutionResult
        {
            Success = true,
            Message = "TESTNET ENTRY + SL/TP PLACED",
            StartedUtc = started,
            FinishedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,
            Symbol = symbol,
            EntrySide = request.Side,
            MarkPrice = markPrice,
            Quantity = qty,
            TradeSizeUsdt = notional,
            Leverage = leverage,
            StopLossPrice = slPrice,
            TakeProfitPrice = tpPrice,
            EntryOrder = entry,
            StopLossOrder = sl,
            TakeProfitOrder = tp,
            Warnings = warnings
        };

        string reportPath = _reporting.WriteExecutionReport(result);

        return new LiveOrderExecutionResult
        {
            Success = result.Success,
            Message = result.Message,
            StartedUtc = result.StartedUtc,
            FinishedUtc = result.FinishedUtc,
            Symbol = result.Symbol,
            EntrySide = result.EntrySide,
            MarkPrice = result.MarkPrice,
            Quantity = result.Quantity,
            TradeSizeUsdt = result.TradeSizeUsdt,
            Leverage = result.Leverage,
            StopLossPrice = result.StopLossPrice,
            TakeProfitPrice = result.TakeProfitPrice,
            EntryOrder = result.EntryOrder,
            StopLossOrder = result.StopLossOrder,
            TakeProfitOrder = result.TakeProfitOrder,
            ReportPath = reportPath,
            Warnings = result.Warnings
        };
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<LiveOrderResult>> CancelAllOpenOrdersAsync(string symbol, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        return await _orders.CancelAllOpenOrdersAsync(NormalizeSymbol(symbol), ct);
    }

    public async Task<LiveOrderResult> CloseOpenPositionMarketAsync(string symbol, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        symbol = NormalizeSymbol(symbol);

        var positions = await _account.GetPositionsAsync(ct);
        var open = positions.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Symbol.Equals(symbol, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && x.IsOpen);
        if (open == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"No open position found for {symbol}.");

        decimal qty = Math.Abs(open.PositionAmount);
        ExchangeOrderSide closeSide = open.PositionAmount > 0m
            ? ExchangeOrderSide.Sell
            : ExchangeOrderSide.Buy;

        return await _orders.PlaceOrderAsync(
            LiveOrderRequest.Market(
                symbol,
                closeSide,
                qty,
                reduceOnly: true,
                clientOrderId: $"TQGA891_CLOSE_{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMddHHmmss}"),
            ct);
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<LiveOrderResult>> CloseOpenPositionMarketAndVerifyAsync(string symbol, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        symbol = NormalizeSymbol(symbol);
        var results = new List<LiveOrderResult>();

        var beforePositions = await _account.GetPositionsAsync(ct);
        var open = beforePositions.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Symbol.Equals(symbol, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && x.IsOpen);

        if (open == null)
        {
            results.Add(new LiveOrderResult
            {
                Success = true,
                Symbol = symbol,
                Status = "NO_POSITION",
                Type = "VERIFY",
                Message = $"No open testnet position found for {symbol}."
            });
        }
        else
        {
            decimal qty = Math.Abs(open.PositionAmount);
            ExchangeOrderSide closeSide = open.PositionAmount > 0m
                ? ExchangeOrderSide.Sell
                : ExchangeOrderSide.Buy;

            LiveOrderResult closeResult = await _orders.PlaceOrderAsync(
                LiveOrderRequest.Market(
                    symbol,
                    closeSide,
                    qty,
                    reduceOnly: true,
                    clientOrderId: $"TQGA_CLOSE_VERIFY_{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMddHHmmss}"),
                ct);

            results.Add(closeResult);
        }

        await Task.Delay(1200, ct);

        IReadOnlyList<LiveOrderResult> cancelResults = await _orders.CancelAllOpenOrdersAsync(symbol, ct);
        results.AddRange(cancelResults);

        await Task.Delay(1200, ct);

        var afterPositions = await _account.GetPositionsAsync(ct);
        bool stillOpen = afterPositions.Any(x => x.Symbol.Equals(symbol, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && x.IsOpen);
        var afterNormalOrders = await _account.GetOpenOrdersAsync(symbol, ct);
        var afterAlgoOrders = await _orders.GetOpenAlgoOrdersAsync(symbol, ct);

        results.Add(new LiveOrderResult
        {
            Success = !stillOpen && afterNormalOrders.Count == 0 && afterAlgoOrders.Count == 0,
            Symbol = symbol,
            Status = !stillOpen && afterNormalOrders.Count == 0 && afterAlgoOrders.Count == 0 ? "VERIFIED_CLEAN" : "CHECK_REMAINING_ITEMS",
            Type = "VERIFY",
            Message = $"Verification after close/cleanup: PositionOpen={stillOpen}, NormalOrders={afterNormalOrders.Count}, AlgoOrders={afterAlgoOrders.Count}."
        });

        return results;
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<LiveOrderResult>> CloseAllTestnetPositionsAndFullCleanupAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var results = new List<LiveOrderResult>();
        var touchedSymbols = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        var positions = await _account.GetPositionsAsync(ct);
        foreach (LivePosition open in positions.Where(x => x.IsOpen).OrderBy(x => x.Symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            string symbol = NormalizeSymbol(open.Symbol);
            touchedSymbols.Add(symbol);

            decimal qty = Math.Abs(open.PositionAmount);
            if (qty <= 0m)
                continue;

            ExchangeOrderSide closeSide = open.PositionAmount > 0m
                ? ExchangeOrderSide.Sell
                : ExchangeOrderSide.Buy;

            LiveOrderResult closeResult = await _orders.PlaceOrderAsync(
                LiveOrderRequest.Market(
                    symbol,
                    closeSide,
                    qty,
                    reduceOnly: true,
                    clientOrderId: $"TQGA_CLOSE_ALL_{symbol}_{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMddHHmmss}"),
                ct);

            results.Add(closeResult);
        }

        var normalOrders = await _account.GetOpenOrdersAsync(null, ct);
        foreach (LiveOpenOrder order in normalOrders)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(order.Symbol))
                touchedSymbols.Add(NormalizeSymbol(order.Symbol));
        }

        foreach (string symbol in touchedSymbols.OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            IReadOnlyList<LiveOrderResult> cancelResults = await _orders.CancelAllOpenOrdersAsync(symbol, ct);
            results.AddRange(cancelResults);
        }

        await Task.Delay(1500, ct);

        var afterPositions = await _account.GetPositionsAsync(ct);
        var afterNormalOrders = await _account.GetOpenOrdersAsync(null, ct);
        int openPositionCount = afterPositions.Count(x => x.IsOpen);

        results.Add(new LiveOrderResult
        {
            Success = openPositionCount == 0 && afterNormalOrders.Count == 0,
            Symbol = "ALL",
            Status = openPositionCount == 0 && afterNormalOrders.Count == 0 ? "FULL_CLEANUP_VERIFIED" : "CHECK_REMAINING_ITEMS",
            Type = "VERIFY",
            Message = $"Full cleanup verification: OpenPositions={openPositionCount}, NormalOrders={afterNormalOrders.Count}. Algo cleanup was requested per touched symbol."
        });

        return results;
    }

    public async Task<TestnetStrategyShadowResult> BuildStrategyShadowSignalAsync(TestnetOrderExecutionRequest request, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(request);
        ValidateTestnetOnly(request);

        string symbol = NormalizeSymbol(request.Symbol);
        decimal tradeSize = ValidateTradeSize(request.TradeSizeUsdt, request.MaxTradeSizeUsdt);
        int leverage = Math.Clamp(request.Leverage, 1, 20);
        var warnings = new List<string>();

        var connection = await _account.CheckConnectionAsync(ct);
        if (!connection.Success)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Binance connection check failed: " + connection.Message);

        var balances = await _account.GetBalancesAsync(ct);
        var usdt = balances.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Asset.Equals("USDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        if (usdt == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("USDT balance not found.");

        var rules = await _market.GetSymbolRulesAsync(ct);
        if (!rules.TryGetValue(symbol, out SymbolTradingRule? rule))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Symbol trading rule not found for {symbol}.");

        decimal markPrice = await _orders.GetMarkPriceAsync(symbol, ct);
        decimal rawQty = tradeSize / markPrice;
        decimal qty = rule.RoundQuantityDown(rawQty);

        if (qty <= 0m)
            qty = CalculateMinimumValidQuantity(rule, markPrice);

        if (rule.MinQuantity > 0m && qty < rule.MinQuantity)
            qty = RoundQuantityUp(rule.MinQuantity, rule.QuantityStepSize);

        decimal notional = qty * markPrice;
        if (rule.MinNotional > 0m && notional < rule.MinNotional)
        {
            decimal minQtyForNotional = CalculateMinimumValidQuantity(rule, markPrice);
            if (minQtyForNotional > qty)
                qty = minQtyForNotional;

            notional = qty * markPrice;
        }

        if (qty <= 0m)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Calculated quantity is zero. Raw={rawQty:F12}, Step={rule.QuantityStepSize:F12}.");

        if (notional > request.MaxTradeSizeUsdt)
        {
            warnings.Add(
                $"Minimum valid Binance quantity produces {notional:F4} USDT notional, above Max Size {request.MaxTradeSizeUsdt:F4}. Shadow only; no order sent.");
        }

        decimal requiredMargin = notional / leverage;
        decimal slPrice = rule.RoundPriceDown(CalculateStopLoss(markPrice, request.Side, request.StopLossPercent));
        decimal tpPrice = rule.RoundPriceDown(CalculateTakeProfit(markPrice, request.Side, request.TakeProfitPercent));

        var positions = await _account.GetPositionsAsync(ct);
        var accountOpenPositions = positions.Where(x => x.IsOpen).ToList();
        var normalOrders = await _account.GetOpenOrdersAsync(null, ct);
        var symbolAlgoOrders = await _orders.GetOpenAlgoOrdersAsync(symbol, ct);

        bool canPlace =
            accountOpenPositions.Count == 0 &&
            normalOrders.Count == 0 &&
            symbolAlgoOrders.Count == 0 &&
            usdt.AvailableBalance >= requiredMargin &&
            qty > 0m &&
            notional <= request.MaxTradeSizeUsdt;

        if (usdt.AvailableBalance < requiredMargin)
            warnings.Add($"Available USDT {usdt.AvailableBalance:F4} is below required margin {requiredMargin:F4}.");

        var result = new TestnetStrategyShadowResult
        {
            Success = canPlace,
            Message = canPlace
                ? "SHADOW PASS - strategy signal/order plan validated. NO ORDER SENT."
                : "SHADOW CHECK - strategy signal/order plan blocked by safety/account/margin gate. NO ORDER SENT.",
            GeneratedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,
            Symbol = symbol,
            IntendedSide = request.Side,
            TradeSizeUsdt = tradeSize,
            MaxTradeSizeUsdt = request.MaxTradeSizeUsdt,
            Leverage = leverage,
            StopLossPercent = request.StopLossPercent,
            TakeProfitPercent = request.TakeProfitPercent,
            MarkPrice = markPrice,
            RawQuantity = rawQty,
            ValidQuantity = qty,
            NotionalUsdt = notional,
            RequiredMarginUsdt = requiredMargin,
            AvailableUsdt = usdt.AvailableBalance,
            StopLossPrice = slPrice,
            TakeProfitPrice = tpPrice,
            AccountOpenPositionCount = accountOpenPositions.Count,
            AccountNormalOpenOrderCount = normalOrders.Count,
            AccountAlgoOpenOrderCount = symbolAlgoOrders.Count,
            WouldPlaceEntry = canPlace,
            WouldPlaceStopLoss = canPlace,
            WouldPlaceTakeProfit = canPlace,
            LiveTradingBlocked = true,
            AutoStrategyTradingUsed = false,
            AccountOpenPositions = accountOpenPositions,
            AccountNormalOpenOrders = normalOrders,
            AccountAlgoOpenOrders = symbolAlgoOrders,
            Warnings = warnings
        };

        new TestnetStrategyShadowReportService().WriteShadowReport(result);
        return result;
    }

    public async Task<LiveTradeReconciliationResult> ReconcileSymbolAsync(string symbol, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        symbol = NormalizeSymbol(symbol);

        var positions = await _account.GetPositionsAsync(ct);
        var accountOpenPositions = positions.Where(x => x.IsOpen).ToList();
        LivePosition? symbolPosition = accountOpenPositions.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Symbol.Equals(symbol, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

        var normalOrders = await _account.GetOpenOrdersAsync(symbol, ct);
        var accountNormalOrders = await _account.GetOpenOrdersAsync(null, ct);
        var algoOrders = await _orders.GetOpenAlgoOrdersAsync(symbol, ct);
        var fills = await _account.GetRecentTradeFillsAsync(symbol, 100, ct);

        decimal markPrice = 0m;
        try
        {
            markPrice = await _orders.GetMarkPriceAsync(symbol, ct);
        }
        catch
        {
            markPrice = symbolPosition?.MarkPrice ?? 0m;
        }

        LiveOpenOrder? stopLoss = algoOrders.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Type.Contains("STOP", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        LiveOpenOrder? takeProfit = algoOrders.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Type.Contains("TAKE_PROFIT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || x.Type.Contains("TAKEPROFIT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

        decimal filledQty = fills.Sum(x => Math.Abs(x.Quantity));
        decimal grossNotional = fills.Sum(x => Math.Abs(x.Price * x.Quantity));
        decimal averageFill = filledQty > 0m ? grossNotional / filledQty : 0m;
        decimal realizedPnl = fills.Sum(x => x.RealizedPnl);
        decimal commission = fills.Sum(x => x.Commission);
        string commissionAsset = fills.FirstOrDefault(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.CommissionAsset))?.CommissionAsset ?? string.Empty;

        bool flatClean = symbolPosition == null && normalOrders.Count == 0 && algoOrders.Count == 0 && accountOpenPositions.Count == 0 && accountNormalOrders.Count == 0;
        bool protectedPosition = symbolPosition != null && stopLoss != null && takeProfit != null;

        var warnings = new List<string>();
        if (symbolPosition != null && stopLoss == null)
            warnings.Add("Open position has no visible STOP_MARKET stop-loss algo order for this symbol.");
        if (symbolPosition != null && takeProfit == null)
            warnings.Add("Open position has no visible TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET take-profit algo order for this symbol.");
        if (accountOpenPositions.Count > (symbolPosition == null ? 0 : 1))
            warnings.Add("Other open account positions exist on different symbols.");
        if (accountNormalOrders.Count > normalOrders.Count)
            warnings.Add("Other account normal open orders exist on different symbols.");

        var result = new LiveTradeReconciliationResult
        {
            Success = flatClean || protectedPosition,
            Message = flatClean
                ? "RECONCILE PASS - FLAT / CLEAN"
                : protectedPosition
                    ? "RECONCILE PASS - POSITION PROTECTED"
                    : "RECONCILE CHECK - position/order state requires review",
            ReconciledUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,
            Symbol = symbol,
            PositionOpen = symbolPosition != null,
            PositionAmount = symbolPosition?.PositionAmount ?? 0m,
            PositionEntryPrice = symbolPosition?.EntryPrice ?? 0m,
            MarkPrice = markPrice,
            UnrealizedPnl = symbolPosition?.UnrealizedProfit ?? 0m,
            LiquidationPrice = symbolPosition?.LiquidationPrice ?? 0m,
            Leverage = symbolPosition?.Leverage ?? 0,
            NormalOpenOrderCount = normalOrders.Count,
            AlgoOpenOrderCount = algoOrders.Count,
            AccountOpenPositionCount = accountOpenPositions.Count,
            AccountNormalOpenOrderCount = accountNormalOrders.Count,
            AccountAlgoOpenOrderCount = algoOrders.Count,
            AccountOpenPositions = accountOpenPositions,
            AccountNormalOpenOrders = accountNormalOrders,
            AccountAlgoOpenOrders = algoOrders,
            HasStopLoss = stopLoss != null,
            HasTakeProfit = takeProfit != null,
            StopLossPrice = stopLoss?.StopPrice ?? stopLoss?.Price ?? 0m,
            TakeProfitPrice = takeProfit?.StopPrice ?? takeProfit?.Price ?? 0m,
            RecentFillCount = fills.Count,
            RecentFilledQuantity = filledQty,
            RecentAverageFillPrice = averageFill,
            RecentGrossNotionalUsdt = grossNotional,
            RecentRealizedPnlUsdt = realizedPnl,
            RecentCommission = commission,
            RecentCommissionAsset = commissionAsset,
            RecentFills = fills,
            NormalOpenOrders = normalOrders,
            AlgoOpenOrders = algoOrders,
            Warnings = warnings
        };

        new LiveTradeReconciliationReportService().WriteReconciliationReport(result);
        return result;
    }

    public async Task<TestnetTradeCycleJournalResult> BuildTradeCycleJournalAsync(string symbol, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        symbol = NormalizeSymbol(symbol);
        LiveTradeReconciliationResult reconciliation = await ReconcileSymbolAsync(symbol, ct);
        var fills = reconciliation.RecentFills.OrderBy(x => x.TimeUtc).ToList();
        var warnings = new List<string>();

        if (fills.Count == 0)
            warnings.Add("No recent fills were returned by Binance for this symbol.");

        string entrySide = fills.FirstOrDefault()?.Side ?? string.Empty;
        var entryFills = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entrySide)
            ? new List<LiveTradeFill>()
            : fills.Where(x => x.Side.Equals(entrySide, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();
        var exitFills = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entrySide)
            ? new List<LiveTradeFill>()
            : fills.Where(x => !x.Side.Equals(entrySide, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();

        decimal entryQty = entryFills.Sum(x => Math.Abs(x.Quantity));
        decimal entryNotional = entryFills.Sum(x => Math.Abs(x.Price * x.Quantity));
        decimal exitQty = exitFills.Sum(x => Math.Abs(x.Quantity));
        decimal exitNotional = exitFills.Sum(x => Math.Abs(x.Price * x.Quantity));
        decimal totalCommission = fills.Sum(x => x.Commission);
        decimal realizedPnl = fills.Sum(x => x.RealizedPnl);

        var result = new TestnetTradeCycleJournalResult
        {
            Success = reconciliation.Success,
            Message = reconciliation.PositionOpen
                ? "TRADE JOURNAL CHECK - cycle is open or partially protected."
                : fills.Count > 0
                    ? "TRADE JOURNAL PASS - latest testnet cycle summarized."
                    : "TRADE JOURNAL CHECK - no recent fills found.",
            GeneratedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,
            Symbol = symbol,
            TradeCycleId = $"{symbol}_{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}",
            CycleStatus = reconciliation.PositionOpen ? "OPEN" : fills.Count > 0 ? "CLOSED" : "CHECK",
            CloseReason = reconciliation.PositionOpen ? "OPEN" : fills.Count > 0 ? "MANUAL_OR_UNKNOWN" : "NO_RECENT_FILLS",
            PositionOpen = reconciliation.PositionOpen,
            PositionAmount = reconciliation.PositionAmount,
            MarkPrice = reconciliation.MarkPrice,
            UnrealizedPnlUsdt = reconciliation.UnrealizedPnl,
            HasStopLoss = reconciliation.HasStopLoss,
            StopLossPrice = reconciliation.StopLossPrice,
            HasTakeProfit = reconciliation.HasTakeProfit,
            TakeProfitPrice = reconciliation.TakeProfitPrice,
            EntryOrderId = entryFills.FirstOrDefault()?.OrderId ?? 0L,
            EntrySide = entrySide,
            EntryTimeUtc = entryFills.FirstOrDefault()?.TimeUtc,
            EntryFillCount = entryFills.Count,
            EntryQuantity = entryQty,
            EntryAveragePrice = entryQty > 0m ? entryNotional / entryQty : 0m,
            EntryGrossNotionalUsdt = entryNotional,
            EntryCommission = entryFills.Sum(x => x.Commission),
            EntryCommissionAsset = entryFills.FirstOrDefault(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.CommissionAsset))?.CommissionAsset ?? string.Empty,
            ExitOrderId = exitFills.LastOrDefault()?.OrderId ?? 0L,
            ExitSide = exitFills.LastOrDefault()?.Side ?? string.Empty,
            ExitTimeUtc = exitFills.LastOrDefault()?.TimeUtc,
            ExitFillCount = exitFills.Count,
            ExitQuantity = exitQty,
            ExitAveragePrice = exitQty > 0m ? exitNotional / exitQty : 0m,
            ExitGrossNotionalUsdt = exitNotional,
            ExitCommission = exitFills.Sum(x => x.Commission),
            ExitCommissionAsset = exitFills.FirstOrDefault(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.CommissionAsset))?.CommissionAsset ?? string.Empty,
            RealizedPnlUsdt = realizedPnl,
            TotalCommission = totalCommission,
            NetPnlAfterCommissionUsdt = realizedPnl - totalCommission,
            Reconciliation = reconciliation,
            EntryFills = entryFills,
            ExitFills = exitFills,
            Warnings = warnings.Concat(reconciliation.Warnings).ToList()
        };

        new TestnetTradeCycleJournalReportService().WriteJournal(result);
        return result;
    }


    private static void ValidateTestnetOnly(TestnetOrderExecutionRequest request)
    {
        if (request.Mode != ExchangeMode.BinanceTestnetTrade)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "Blocked: V8.9.1 order execution only allows BinanceTestnetTrade mode. Live trading is intentionally not available.");
        }
    }

    private static decimal ValidateTradeSize(decimal tradeSize, decimal maxTradeSize)
    {
        if (tradeSize <= 0m)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Trade size must be greater than zero.");

        if (maxTradeSize <= 0m)
            maxTradeSize = 50m;

        if (tradeSize > maxTradeSize)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Trade size {tradeSize:F2} exceeds safety max {maxTradeSize:F2} USDT.");

        return tradeSize;
    }

    private static decimal CalculateMinimumValidQuantity(SymbolTradingRule rule, decimal markPrice)
    {
        if (markPrice <= 0m)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Mark price must be greater than zero.");

        decimal minQtyFromQuantity = rule.MinQuantity > 0m ? rule.MinQuantity : 0m;
        decimal minQtyFromNotional = rule.MinNotional > 0m ? rule.MinNotional / markPrice : 0m;
        decimal required = Math.Max(minQtyFromQuantity, minQtyFromNotional);

        return RoundQuantityUp(required, rule.QuantityStepSize);
    }

    private static decimal RoundQuantityUp(decimal rawQuantity, decimal stepSize)
    {
        if (rawQuantity <= 0m)
            return 0m;

        if (stepSize <= 0m)
            return rawQuantity;

        decimal steps = Math.Ceiling(rawQuantity / stepSize);
        return steps * stepSize;
    }

    private static decimal CalculateStopLoss(decimal price, ExchangeOrderSide entrySide, decimal stopLossPercent)
    {
        decimal pct = Math.Clamp(stopLossPercent, 0.05m, 50m) / 100m;
        return entrySide == ExchangeOrderSide.Buy
            ? price * (1m - pct)
            : price * (1m + pct);
    }

    private static decimal CalculateTakeProfit(decimal price, ExchangeOrderSide entrySide, decimal takeProfitPercent)
    {
        decimal pct = Math.Clamp(takeProfitPercent, 0.05m, 100m) / 100m;
        return entrySide == ExchangeOrderSide.Buy
            ? price * (1m + pct)
            : price * (1m - pct);
    }

    private static string NormalizeSymbol(string symbol)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Symbol is required.");

        return symbol.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
    }
}

using System.Text;
using System.Threading;

namespace TQGA.Application.Trading;

public sealed class TradeDecisionDiagnostics
{
    // ================= INTERNAL COUNTERS =================

    private int _ticksProcessed;
    private int _signalLong;
    private int _signalShort;
    private int _signalExit;
    private int _entryAttempts;
    private int _executedEntries;
    private int _executedExits;

    // ================= PUBLIC READ MODEL =================

    public int TicksProcessed => _ticksProcessed;
    public int SignalLong => _signalLong;
    public int SignalShort => _signalShort;
    public int SignalExit => _signalExit;
    public int EntryAttempts => _entryAttempts;
    public int ExecutedEntries => _executedEntries;
    public int ExecutedExits => _executedExits;

    // ================= ENGINE WRITE API =================

    public void OnTickProcessed() => Interlocked.Increment(ref _ticksProcessed);
    public void OnSignalLong() => Interlocked.Increment(ref _signalLong);
    public void OnSignalShort() => Interlocked.Increment(ref _signalShort);
    public void OnSignalExit() => Interlocked.Increment(ref _signalExit);

    public void OnEntryAttempt() => Interlocked.Increment(ref _entryAttempts);
    public void OnEntryExecuted() => Interlocked.Increment(ref _executedEntries);
    public void OnExitExecuted() => Interlocked.Increment(ref _executedExits);

    public void Reset()
    {
        _ticksProcessed = 0;
        _signalLong = 0;
        _signalShort = 0;
        _signalExit = 0;
        _entryAttempts = 0;
        _executedEntries = 0;
        _executedExits = 0;
    }

    // ================= REPORT BUILDER =================

    public string BuildReport()
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        sb.AppendLine("EXECUTION ATTRIBUTION");
        sb.AppendLine("=====================");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine($"Ticks processed           : {TicksProcessed}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Signal LONG               : {SignalLong}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Signal SHORT              : {SignalShort}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Signal EXIT               : {SignalExit}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine($"Entry attempts            : {EntryAttempts}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Executed Entries          : {ExecutedEntries}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Executed Exits            : {ExecutedExits}");

        return sb.ToString();
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using TQGA.Application.Accounting;
using TQGA.Application.Risk;
using TQGA.Application.Strategy;
using TQGA.Domain.Trading;

namespace TQGA.Application.Trading;

public sealed class TradingEngine : ITradingEngine
{
    private readonly IStrategy _strategy;
    private readonly IOrderExecutor _executor;
    private readonly TradeLedger _ledger;
    private readonly EquityCurve _equity;
    private readonly ICapitalAllocator _capital;
    private readonly IRiskManager _risk;
    private readonly TradeDecisionDiagnostics _diag;

    private Trade? _openTrade;

    private const decimal DefaultLongStopLossFactor = 0.96m;
    private const decimal DefaultLongTakeProfitFactor = 1.08m;
    private const decimal DefaultLongExpectedFactor = 1.03m;
    private const decimal DefaultShortStopLossFactor = 1.04m;
    private const decimal DefaultShortTakeProfitFactor = 0.92m;
    private const decimal DefaultShortExpectedFactor = 0.97m;

    private const decimal S03LongStopLossFactor = 0.97m;
    private const decimal S03LongTakeProfitFactor = 1.06m;
    private const decimal S03LongExpectedFactor = 1.02m;
    private const decimal S03ShortStopLossFactor = 1.03m;
    private const decimal S03ShortTakeProfitFactor = 0.94m;
    private const decimal S03ShortExpectedFactor = 0.98m;

    private const decimal S03BreakEvenArmR = 1.25m;
    private const decimal S03BreakEvenFloorR = 0.15m;
    private const decimal S03DisasterExitR = -2.50m;
    private const decimal S03StaleLossExitMinutes = 2880m;
    private const decimal S03StaleNoProgressExitMinutes = 4320m;
    private const decimal S03HardTimeoutExitMinutes = 10080m;

    public TradingEngine(
        IStrategy strategy,
        IOrderExecutor executor,
        TradeLedger ledger,
        EquityCurve equity,
        ICapitalAllocator capital,
        IRiskManager risk,
        TradeDecisionDiagnostics diag)
    {
        _strategy = strategy;
        _executor = executor;
        _ledger = ledger;
        _equity = equity;
        _capital = capital;
        _risk = risk;
        _diag = diag;
    }

    public async Task OnTickAsync(
        string symbol,
        decimal price,
        DateTime time,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        _executor.UpdateMarketPrice(price);
        _diag.OnTickProcessed();

        if (_openTrade != null)
        {
            _openTrade.UpdateExcursions(price);

            var unrealized =
                (_openTrade.Side == TradeSide.Buy
                    ? price - _openTrade.EntryPrice
                    : _openTrade.EntryPrice - price)
                * _openTrade.Quantity;

            _equity.Update(time, _capital.CurrentEquity + unrealized);
        }
        else
        {
            _equity.Update(time, _capital.CurrentEquity);
        }

        if (await TryExecuteProtectiveExitAsync(symbol, price, time, ct))
            return;

        if (await TryExecuteManagedRiskExitAsync(symbol, price, time, ct))
            return;

        var context = new StrategyContext(
            price,
            time,
            _openTrade != null,
            _openTrade?.Quantity ?? 0m);

        var signal = _strategy.OnTick(context);

        if (signal == TradeSignal.Long)
        {
            _diag.OnSignalLong();

            if (_openTrade != null)
                return;

            if (!_risk.CanContinueTrading())
                return;

            var size = _capital.GetOrderSize(symbol, price);
            if (size <= 0m)
                return;

            if (!_risk.CanEnterPosition(size))
                return;

            _diag.OnEntryAttempt();

            await _executor.PlaceMarketOrderAsync(
                symbol,
                TradeSide.Buy,
                size,
                ct);

            var fillPrice = _executor.GetFillPrice();

            var (plan, planSource) = BuildEntryTradePlan(
                symbol,
                signal,
                fillPrice,
                time,
                TradeSide.Buy);

            _openTrade = new Trade(
                symbol: symbol,
                side: TradeSide.Buy,
                quantity: size,
                entryPrice: fillPrice,
                entryTime: time,
                trueOrderType: plan.TrueOrderType,
                entryReason: plan.EntryReason,
                stopLossAtEntry: plan.StopLossAtEntry,
                takeProfitAtEntry: plan.TakeProfitAtEntry,
                expectedPrice: plan.ExpectedPrice,
                planSource: planSource);

            _diag.OnEntryExecuted();
            return;
        }

        if (signal == TradeSignal.Short)
        {
            _diag.OnSignalShort();

            if (_openTrade != null)
                return;

            if (!_risk.CanContinueTrading())
                return;

            var size = _capital.GetOrderSize(symbol, price);
            if (size <= 0m)
                return;

            if (!_risk.CanEnterPosition(size))
                return;

            _diag.OnEntryAttempt();

            await _executor.PlaceMarketOrderAsync(
                symbol,
                TradeSide.Sell,
                size,
                ct);

            var fillPrice = _executor.GetFillPrice();

            var (plan, planSource) = BuildEntryTradePlan(
                symbol,
                signal,
                fillPrice,
                time,
                TradeSide.Sell);

            _openTrade = new Trade(
                symbol: symbol,
                side: TradeSide.Sell,
                quantity: size,
                entryPrice: fillPrice,
                entryTime: time,
                trueOrderType: plan.TrueOrderType,
                entryReason: plan.EntryReason,
                stopLossAtEntry: plan.StopLossAtEntry,
                takeProfitAtEntry: plan.TakeProfitAtEntry,
                expectedPrice: plan.ExpectedPrice,
                planSource: planSource);

            _diag.OnEntryExecuted();
            return;
        }

        if (signal == TradeSignal.Exit)
        {
            _diag.OnSignalExit();

            if (_openTrade == null)
                return;

            await _executor.ClosePositionAsync(symbol, ct);

            var fillPrice = _executor.GetFillPrice();

            _openTrade.Close(
                exitPrice: fillPrice,
                exitTime: time,
                exitReason: BuildExitReason(signal, symbol, fillPrice, _openTrade, time));

            _ledger.Record(_openTrade);
            _capital.OnTradeClosed(_openTrade.RealizedPnL);
            _risk.OnTradeClosed(_openTrade.RealizedPnL);

            _diag.OnExitExecuted();

            _openTrade = null;
            return;
        }
    }

    private async Task<bool> TryExecuteProtectiveExitAsync(
        string symbol,
        decimal price,
        DateTime time,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (_openTrade == null)
            return false;

        if (!string.Equals(_openTrade.Symbol, symbol, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return false;

        if (!ShouldTriggerProtectiveExit(_openTrade, price, out string protectiveExitTag))
            return false;

        await _executor.ClosePositionAsync(symbol, ct);

        var fillPrice = _executor.GetFillPrice();

        _openTrade.Close(
            exitPrice: fillPrice,
            exitTime: time,
            exitReason: BuildProtectiveExitReason(
                symbol,
                fillPrice,
                _openTrade,
                time,
                protectiveExitTag));

        _ledger.Record(_openTrade);
        _capital.OnTradeClosed(_openTrade.RealizedPnL);
        _risk.OnTradeClosed(_openTrade.RealizedPnL);

        _diag.OnExitExecuted();

        _openTrade = null;
        return true;
    }

    private async Task<bool> TryExecuteManagedRiskExitAsync(
        string symbol,
        decimal price,
        DateTime time,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (_openTrade == null)
            return false;

        if (!string.Equals(_openTrade.Symbol, symbol, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return false;

        if (!ShouldTriggerManagedRiskExit(_openTrade, price, time, out string managedExitTag))
            return false;

        await _executor.ClosePositionAsync(symbol, ct);

        var fillPrice = _executor.GetFillPrice();

        _openTrade.Close(
            exitPrice: fillPrice,
            exitTime: time,
            exitReason: BuildManagedRiskExitReason(
                symbol,
                fillPrice,
                _openTrade,
                time,
                managedExitTag));

        _ledger.Record(_openTrade);
        _capital.OnTradeClosed(_openTrade.RealizedPnL);
        _risk.OnTradeClosed(_openTrade.RealizedPnL);

        _diag.OnExitExecuted();

        _openTrade = null;
        return true;
    }

    private bool ShouldTriggerManagedRiskExit(
        Trade openTrade,
        decimal marketPrice,
        DateTime marketTime,
        out string managedExitTag)
    {
        managedExitTag = string.Empty;

        if (!IsS03EngineFallbackTrade(openTrade))
            return false;

        decimal? rMultiple = ComputeOpenTradeRMultiple(openTrade, marketPrice);
        if (!rMultiple.HasValue)
            return false;

        decimal favorableR = ComputeFavorableR(openTrade);
        decimal holdingMinutes = (decimal)(marketTime - openTrade.EntryTime).TotalMinutes;

        if (rMultiple.Value <= S03DisasterExitR)
        {
            managedExitTag = "ManagedDisasterExit";
            return true;
        }

        if (favorableR >= S03BreakEvenArmR && rMultiple.Value <= S03BreakEvenFloorR)
        {
            managedExitTag = "ManagedBreakEvenDecayExit";
            return true;
        }

        if (holdingMinutes >= S03StaleLossExitMinutes && rMultiple.Value < 0m)
        {
            managedExitTag = "ManagedLateHoldLossExit";
            return true;
        }

        if (holdingMinutes >= S03StaleNoProgressExitMinutes && favorableR < 0.50m)
        {
            managedExitTag = "ManagedStaleNoProgressExit";
            return true;
        }

        if (holdingMinutes >= S03HardTimeoutExitMinutes)
        {
            managedExitTag = "ManagedHardTimeoutExit";
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private static bool ShouldTriggerProtectiveExit(
        Trade openTrade,
        decimal marketPrice,
        out string protectiveExitTag)
    {
        protectiveExitTag = string.Empty;

        decimal? stopLoss = openTrade.StopLossAtEntry;
        decimal? takeProfit = openTrade.TakeProfitAtEntry;

        if (openTrade.Side == TradeSide.Buy)
        {
            if (stopLoss.HasValue && marketPrice <= stopLoss.Value)
            {
                protectiveExitTag = "StopLossHit";
                return true;
            }

            if (takeProfit.HasValue && marketPrice >= takeProfit.Value)
            {
                protectiveExitTag = "TakeProfitHit";
                return true;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (stopLoss.HasValue && marketPrice >= stopLoss.Value)
            {
                protectiveExitTag = "StopLossHit";
                return true;
            }

            if (takeProfit.HasValue && marketPrice <= takeProfit.Value)
            {
                protectiveExitTag = "TakeProfitHit";
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private string BuildProtectiveExitReason(
        string symbol,
        decimal exitPrice,
        Trade openTrade,
        DateTime exitTime,
        string protectiveExitTag)
    {
        string baseReason;

        if (_strategy is ITradePlanStrategy tradePlanStrategy)
        {
            baseReason = tradePlanStrategy.BuildExitReason(
                openTrade,
                TradeSignal.Exit,
                symbol,
                exitPrice,
                exitTime);
        }
        else
        {
            baseReason = BuildFallbackExitReason(
                TradeSignal.Exit,
                symbol,
                exitPrice,
                openTrade);
        }

        return $"{baseReason}|ProtectiveExit={protectiveExitTag}";
    }

    private string BuildManagedRiskExitReason(
        string symbol,
        decimal exitPrice,
        Trade openTrade,
        DateTime exitTime,
        string managedExitTag)
    {
        string baseReason;

        if (_strategy is ITradePlanStrategy tradePlanStrategy)
        {
            baseReason = tradePlanStrategy.BuildExitReason(
                openTrade,
                TradeSignal.Exit,
                symbol,
                exitPrice,
                exitTime);
        }
        else
        {
            baseReason = BuildFallbackExitReason(
                TradeSignal.Exit,
                symbol,
                exitPrice,
                openTrade);
        }

        return $"{baseReason}|ManagedExit={managedExitTag}";
    }

    private (ITradePlan Plan, string PlanSource) BuildEntryTradePlan(
        string symbol,
        TradeSignal signal,
        decimal entryPrice,
        DateTime entryTime,
        TradeSide side)
    {
        if (_strategy is ITradePlanStrategy tradePlanStrategy)
        {
            return (
                tradePlanStrategy.BuildEntryTradePlan(
                    symbol,
                    signal,
                    entryPrice,
                    entryTime),
                "StrategyNative");
        }

        return (BuildFallbackEntryTradePlan(symbol, signal, entryPrice, entryTime, side), "EngineFallback");
    }

    private string BuildExitReason(
        TradeSignal signal,
        string symbol,
        decimal exitPrice,
        Trade openTrade,
        DateTime exitTime)
    {
        if (_strategy is ITradePlanStrategy tradePlanStrategy)
        {
            return tradePlanStrategy.BuildExitReason(
                openTrade,
                signal,
                symbol,
                exitPrice,
                exitTime);
        }

        return BuildFallbackExitReason(signal, symbol, exitPrice, openTrade);
    }

    private ITradePlan BuildFallbackEntryTradePlan(
        string symbol,
        TradeSignal signal,
        decimal entryPrice,
        DateTime entryTime,
        TradeSide side)
    {
        string strategyName = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_strategy.Name)
            ? _strategy.GetType().Name
            : _strategy.Name;

        string entryReason =
            $"{strategyName}|Signal={signal}|Symbol={symbol}|Time={entryTime:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}|PlanSource=EngineFallback";

        decimal stopLossFactor;
        decimal takeProfitFactor;
        decimal expectedFactor;

        if (IsS03Strategy())
        {
            stopLossFactor = side == TradeSide.Buy ? S03LongStopLossFactor : S03ShortStopLossFactor;
            takeProfitFactor = side == TradeSide.Buy ? S03LongTakeProfitFactor : S03ShortTakeProfitFactor;
            expectedFactor = side == TradeSide.Buy ? S03LongExpectedFactor : S03ShortExpectedFactor;
        }
        else
        {
            stopLossFactor = side == TradeSide.Buy ? DefaultLongStopLossFactor : DefaultShortStopLossFactor;
            takeProfitFactor = side == TradeSide.Buy ? DefaultLongTakeProfitFactor : DefaultShortTakeProfitFactor;
            expectedFactor = side == TradeSide.Buy ? DefaultLongExpectedFactor : DefaultShortExpectedFactor;
        }

        decimal? stopLoss = entryPrice <= 0m ? null : entryPrice * stopLossFactor;
        decimal? takeProfit = entryPrice <= 0m ? null : entryPrice * takeProfitFactor;
        decimal? expectedPrice = entryPrice <= 0m ? null : entryPrice * expectedFactor;

        return new StrategyTradePlan(
            TrueOrderType: "Market",
            EntryReason: entryReason,
            StopLossAtEntry: stopLoss,
            TakeProfitAtEntry: takeProfit,
            ExpectedPrice: expectedPrice);
    }

    private string BuildFallbackExitReason(
        TradeSignal signal,
        string symbol,
        decimal exitPrice,
        Trade openTrade)
    {
        string strategyName = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_strategy.Name)
            ? _strategy.GetType().Name
            : _strategy.Name;

        string pnlState;

        if (openTrade.Side == TradeSide.Buy)
            pnlState = exitPrice >= openTrade.EntryPrice ? "NonNegativeExit" : "LossExit";
        else
            pnlState = exitPrice <= openTrade.EntryPrice ? "NonNegativeExit" : "LossExit";

        return $"{strategyName}|Signal={signal}|Symbol={symbol}|{pnlState}|PlanSource=EngineFallback";
    }

    private bool IsS03Strategy()
    {
        string strategyName = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_strategy.Name)
            ? _strategy.GetType().Name
            : _strategy.Name;

        return strategyName.Contains("EMA + RSI Quant", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || _strategy.GetType().Name.Contains("EmaRsiQuantStrategy", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    private bool IsS03EngineFallbackTrade(Trade trade)
    {
        if (!IsS03Strategy())
            return false;

        return string.Equals(trade.PlanSource, "EngineFallback", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    private static decimal? ComputeOpenTradeRMultiple(Trade trade, decimal marketPrice)
    {
        decimal? riskMoney = ComputeRiskMoney(trade);
        if (!riskMoney.HasValue || riskMoney.Value <= 0m)
            return null;

        decimal openPnl =
            (trade.Side == TradeSide.Buy
                ? marketPrice - trade.EntryPrice
                : trade.EntryPrice - marketPrice)
            * trade.Quantity;

        return openPnl / riskMoney.Value;
    }

    private static decimal ComputeFavorableR(Trade trade)
    {
        decimal? riskMoney = ComputeRiskMoney(trade);
        if (!riskMoney.HasValue || riskMoney.Value <= 0m)
            return 0m;

        decimal favorableMoney = trade.FavorableExcursion * trade.Quantity;
        return favorableMoney / riskMoney.Value;
    }

    private static decimal? ComputeRiskMoney(Trade trade)
    {
        if (!trade.StopLossAtEntry.HasValue)
            return null;

        decimal riskPerUnit = Math.Abs(trade.EntryPrice - trade.StopLossAtEntry.Value);
        decimal riskMoney = riskPerUnit * trade.Quantity;

        return riskMoney > 0m ? riskMoney : null;
    }
}

namespace TQGA.Domain.Indicators;

public sealed class Ema : IIndicator
{
    private readonly decimal _alpha;
    private decimal? _ema;

    public Ema(int period)
    {
        _alpha = 2m / (period + 1);
    }

    public void Add(decimal value)
    {
        _ema = _ema == null
            ? value
            : value * _alpha + _ema.Value * (1 - _alpha);
    }

    public decimal Value => _ema ?? 0m;

    public bool IsReady => _ema.HasValue;
}

namespace TQGA.Domain.Indicators;

public sealed class Rsi
{
    private readonly int _period;

    private decimal _avgGain;
    private decimal _avgLoss;

    private decimal? _previousPrice;
    private int _samples;

    public bool IsReady => _samples >= _period;
    public decimal Value { get; private set; }

    public Rsi(int period)
    {
        if (period <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(period));

        _period = period;
    }

    public void Update(decimal price)
    {
        if (_previousPrice == null)
        {
            _previousPrice = price;
            return;
        }

        var change = price - _previousPrice.Value;
        var gain = change > 0 ? change : 0;
        var loss = change < 0 ? -change : 0;

        if (_samples < _period)
        {
            _avgGain += gain;
            _avgLoss += loss;
            _samples++;

            if (_samples == _period)
            {
                _avgGain /= _period;
                _avgLoss /= _period;
                CalculateRsi();
            }
        }
        else
        {
            _avgGain = (_avgGain * (_period - 1) + gain) / _period;
            _avgLoss = (_avgLoss * (_period - 1) + loss) / _period;

            CalculateRsi();
        }

        _previousPrice = price;
    }

    private void CalculateRsi()
    {
        if (_avgLoss == 0)
        {
            Value = 100;
            return;
        }

        var rs = _avgGain / _avgLoss;
        Value = 100 - (100 / (1 + rs));
    }

    public void Reset()
    {
        _avgGain = 0;
        _avgLoss = 0;
        _previousPrice = null;
        _samples = 0;
        Value = 0;
    }
}

namespace TQGA.Domain.Trading;

public sealed class SymbolTradingRule
{
    public string Symbol { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public decimal MinQuantity { get; init; }
    public decimal MaxQuantity { get; init; }
    public decimal QuantityStepSize { get; init; }
    public decimal TickSize { get; init; }
    public decimal MinNotional { get; init; }
    public int PricePrecision { get; init; }
    public int QuantityPrecision { get; init; }

    public decimal RoundQuantityDown(decimal rawQuantity)
    {
        if (QuantityStepSize <= 0m)
            return rawQuantity;

        decimal steps = Math.Floor(rawQuantity / QuantityStepSize);
        return steps * QuantityStepSize;
    }

    public decimal RoundPriceDown(decimal rawPrice)
    {
        if (TickSize <= 0m)
            return rawPrice;

        decimal ticks = Math.Floor(rawPrice / TickSize);
        return ticks * TickSize;
    }
}

namespace TQGA.Domain.Trading;

public sealed class Trade
{
    public string Symbol { get; }
    public TradeSide Side { get; }
    public decimal Quantity { get; }
    public decimal EntryPrice { get; }
    public DateTime EntryTime { get; }

    public string TrueOrderType { get; }
    public string EntryReason { get; }
    public decimal? StopLossAtEntry { get; }
    public decimal? TakeProfitAtEntry { get; }
    public decimal? ExpectedPrice { get; }
    public string PlanSource { get; }

    public decimal? ExitPrice { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? ExitTime { get; private set; }
    public string? ExitReason { get; private set; }

    // Per-unit excursion from entry price.
    public decimal FavorableExcursion { get; private set; }
    public decimal AdverseExcursion { get; private set; }

    public bool IsClosed => ExitPrice.HasValue;

    public Trade(
        string symbol,
        TradeSide side,
        decimal quantity,
        decimal entryPrice,
        DateTime entryTime,
        string trueOrderType,
        string entryReason,
        decimal? stopLossAtEntry,
        decimal? takeProfitAtEntry,
        decimal? expectedPrice,
        string planSource)
    {
        Symbol = symbol;
        Side = side;
        Quantity = quantity;
        EntryPrice = entryPrice;
        EntryTime = entryTime;

        TrueOrderType = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(trueOrderType)
            ? "UNKNOWN"
            : trueOrderType;

        EntryReason = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entryReason)
            ? "UNKNOWN"
            : entryReason;

        StopLossAtEntry = stopLossAtEntry;
        TakeProfitAtEntry = takeProfitAtEntry;
        ExpectedPrice = expectedPrice;

        PlanSource = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(planSource)
            ? "UNKNOWN"
            : planSource;

        FavorableExcursion = 0m;
        AdverseExcursion = 0m;
    }

    public void UpdateExcursions(decimal currentPrice)
    {
        decimal favorable;
        decimal adverse;

        if (Side == TradeSide.Buy)
        {
            favorable = Math.Max(0m, currentPrice - EntryPrice);
            adverse = Math.Max(0m, EntryPrice - currentPrice);
        }
        else
        {
            favorable = Math.Max(0m, EntryPrice - currentPrice);
            adverse = Math.Max(0m, currentPrice - EntryPrice);
        }

        if (favorable > FavorableExcursion)
            FavorableExcursion = favorable;

        if (adverse > AdverseExcursion)
            AdverseExcursion = adverse;
    }

    public void Close(decimal exitPrice, DateTime exitTime, string exitReason)
    {
        ExitPrice = exitPrice;
        ExitTime = exitTime;
        ExitReason = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(exitReason)
            ? "UNKNOWN"
            : exitReason;
    }

    public decimal RealizedPnL =>
        !IsClosed
            ? 0m
            : Side == TradeSide.Buy
                ? (ExitPrice!.Value - EntryPrice) * Quantity
                : (EntryPrice - ExitPrice!.Value) * Quantity;
}

using System;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.Binance;

public sealed class BinanceApiCredentials
{
    public const string ApiKeyEnvironmentName = "TQGA_BINANCE_API_KEY";
    public const string SecretKeyEnvironmentName = "TQGA_BINANCE_SECRET_KEY";

    public string ApiKey { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public string SecretKey { get; init; } = string.Empty;

    public bool HasKeys =>
        !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ApiKey) &&
        !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SecretKey);

    public static BinanceApiCredentials FromEnvironment()
    {
        string processApiKey = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(ApiKeyEnvironmentName) ?? string.Empty;
        string processSecretKey = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(SecretKeyEnvironmentName) ?? string.Empty;

        string userApiKey = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(ApiKeyEnvironmentName, EnvironmentVariableTarget.User) ?? string.Empty;
        string userSecretKey = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(SecretKeyEnvironmentName, EnvironmentVariableTarget.User) ?? string.Empty;

        return new BinanceApiCredentials
        {
            ApiKey = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(processApiKey) ? processApiKey : userApiKey,
            SecretKey = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(processSecretKey) ? processSecretKey : userSecretKey
        };
    }

    public static void SaveToUserEnvironment(BinanceApiCredentials credentials)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(credentials);

        if (!credentials.HasKeys)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("API key and Secret key are required before saving.");

        string apiKey = credentials.ApiKey.Trim();
        string secretKey = credentials.SecretKey.Trim();

        Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable(ApiKeyEnvironmentName, apiKey, EnvironmentVariableTarget.User);
        Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable(SecretKeyEnvironmentName, secretKey, EnvironmentVariableTarget.User);

        // Also update the current TQGA process immediately so restart is not required.
        Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable(ApiKeyEnvironmentName, apiKey, EnvironmentVariableTarget.Process);
        Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable(SecretKeyEnvironmentName, secretKey, EnvironmentVariableTarget.Process);
    }

    public static void ClearUserEnvironment()
    {
        Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable(ApiKeyEnvironmentName, null, EnvironmentVariableTarget.User);
        Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable(SecretKeyEnvironmentName, null, EnvironmentVariableTarget.User);

        Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable(ApiKeyEnvironmentName, null, EnvironmentVariableTarget.Process);
        Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable(SecretKeyEnvironmentName, null, EnvironmentVariableTarget.Process);
    }
}

using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.Binance;

public static class BinanceApiSigner
{
    public static string SignHmacSha256(string payload, string secretKey)
    {
        byte[] keyBytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(secretKey);
        byte[] payloadBytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(payload);

        using var hmac = new HMACSHA256(keyBytes);
        byte[] hash = hmac.ComputeHash(payloadBytes);

        var sb = new StringBuilder(hash.Length * 2);
        foreach (byte b in hash)
            sb.Append(b.ToString("x2"));

        return sb.ToString();
    }
}

using System.Globalization;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Text.Json;
using TQGA.Application.Interfaces;
using TQGA.Domain.Trading;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.Binance;

public sealed class BinanceFuturesOrderClient : IExchangeOrderClient, IDisposable
{
    private readonly HttpClient _http;
    private readonly BinanceApiCredentials _credentials;
    private readonly BinanceEndpointOptions _options;
    private readonly bool _ownsHttpClient;

    public BinanceFuturesOrderClient(
        HttpClient httpClient,
        BinanceApiCredentials credentials,
        BinanceEndpointOptions options,
        bool ownsHttpClient = false)
    {
        _http = httpClient ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(httpClient));
        _credentials = credentials ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(credentials));
        _options = options ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(options));
        _ownsHttpClient = ownsHttpClient;

        _http.BaseAddress = new Uri(_options.RestBaseUrl.TrimEnd('/') + "/");
        _http.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(75);

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_credentials.ApiKey))
        {
            if (_http.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("X-MBX-APIKEY"))
                _http.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("X-MBX-APIKEY");

            _http.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("X-MBX-APIKEY", _credentials.ApiKey);
        }

        _http.DefaultRequestHeaders.Accept.Clear();
        _http.DefaultRequestHeaders.Accept.Add(new MediaTypeWithQualityHeaderValue("application/json"));
    }

    public async Task<decimal> GetMarkPriceAsync(string symbol, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        symbol = NormalizeSymbol(symbol);
        using var response = await _http.GetAsync("fapi/v1/premiumIndex?symbol=" + Uri.EscapeDataString(symbol), ct);
        string body = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct);
        EnsureSuccess(response, body);

        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);
        decimal mark = BinanceJson.D(doc.RootElement, "markPrice");
        if (mark <= 0m)
        {
            mark = BinanceJson.D(doc.RootElement, "indexPrice");
        }

        if (mark <= 0m)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Could not resolve mark price for {symbol}.");

        return mark;
    }

    public async Task<LiveOrderResult> SetLeverageAsync(string symbol, int leverage, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        EnsureTestnetTradeOnly();
        EnsureCredentials();

        symbol = NormalizeSymbol(symbol);
        leverage = Math.Clamp(leverage, 1, 125);

        var query = new Dictionary<string, string>
        {
            ["symbol"] = symbol,
            ["leverage"] = leverage.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
        };

        string body = await PostSignedAsync("fapi/v1/leverage", query, ct);
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);

        return new LiveOrderResult
        {
            Success = true,
            Symbol = BinanceJson.S(doc.RootElement, "symbol"),
            Status = "LEVERAGE_SET",
            Type = "LEVERAGE",
            RawJson = body,
            Message = "Leverage set to " + BinanceJson.I(doc.RootElement, "leverage").ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "x"
        };
    }

    public async Task<LiveOrderResult> PlaceOrderAsync(LiveOrderRequest request, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        EnsureTestnetTradeOnly();
        EnsureCredentials();

        if (request == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(request));

        string symbol = NormalizeSymbol(request.Symbol);
        if (request.Quantity <= 0m)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Order quantity must be greater than zero.");

        string side = request.Side switch
        {
            ExchangeOrderSide.Buy => "BUY",
            ExchangeOrderSide.Sell => "SELL",
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException("Order side must be BUY or SELL.")
        };

        string type = request.Type switch
        {
            ExchangeOrderType.Market => "MARKET",
            ExchangeOrderType.Limit => "LIMIT",
            ExchangeOrderType.StopMarket => "STOP_MARKET",
            ExchangeOrderType.TakeProfitMarket => "TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET",
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException("Unsupported order type.")
        };

        var query = new Dictionary<string, string>
        {
            ["symbol"] = symbol,
            ["side"] = side,
            ["type"] = type,
            ["quantity"] = FormatDecimal(request.Quantity),
            ["positionSide"] = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.PositionSide) ? "BOTH" : request.PositionSide.Trim().ToUpperInvariant(),
            ["newOrderRespType"] = "RESULT"
        };

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.ClientOrderId))
            query["newClientOrderId"] = request.ClientOrderId.Trim();

        if (request.ReduceOnly)
            query["reduceOnly"] = "true";

        if (request.Type == ExchangeOrderType.Limit)
        {
            if (!request.Price.HasValue || request.Price.Value <= 0m)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Limit order requires price.");

            query["price"] = FormatDecimal(request.Price.Value);
            query["timeInForce"] = "GTC";
        }

        bool isAlgoConditionalOrder = request.Type == ExchangeOrderType.StopMarket || request.Type == ExchangeOrderType.TakeProfitMarket;

        if (isAlgoConditionalOrder)
        {
            if (!request.StopPrice.HasValue || request.StopPrice.Value <= 0m)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Stop / take-profit market order requires trigger price.");

            // Binance USD-M Futures now requires conditional TP/SL orders to be sent
            // through the Algo Order endpoint, not /fapi/v1/order.
            query.Remove("newOrderRespType");

            if (query.Remove("newClientOrderId", out string? clientAlgoId) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(clientAlgoId))
                query["clientAlgoId"] = clientAlgoId;

            query["algoType"] = "CONDITIONAL";
            query["triggerPrice"] = FormatDecimal(request.StopPrice.Value);
            query["workingType"] = "MARK_PRICE";
            query["priceProtect"] = "false";

            string algoBody = await PostSignedAsync("fapi/v1/algoOrder", query, ct);
            return ParseAlgoOrderResult(algoBody, fallbackSymbol: symbol, fallbackSide: side, fallbackType: type, successMessage: "Algo conditional order accepted");
        }

        string body = await PostSignedAsync("fapi/v1/order", query, ct);
        return ParseOrderResult(body, fallbackSymbol: symbol, fallbackSide: side, fallbackType: type, successMessage: "Order accepted");
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<LiveOpenOrder>> GetOpenAlgoOrdersAsync(string symbol, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        EnsureTestnetTradeOnly();
        EnsureCredentials();

        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>? query = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol)
            ? null
            : new Dictionary<string, string> { ["symbol"] = NormalizeSymbol(symbol) };

        string body = await GetSignedAsync("fapi/v1/openAlgoOrders", query, ct);
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);

        var output = new List<LiveOpenOrder>();
        if (doc.RootElement.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Array)
            return output;

        foreach (var o in doc.RootElement.EnumerateArray())
        {
            string type = BinanceJson.S(o, "orderType");
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(type))
                type = BinanceJson.S(o, "type");

            string status = BinanceJson.S(o, "algoStatus");
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(status))
                status = BinanceJson.S(o, "status");

            long orderId = BinanceJson.L(o, "algoId");
            if (orderId == 0)
                orderId = BinanceJson.L(o, "orderId");

            string clientOrderId = BinanceJson.S(o, "clientAlgoId");
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(clientOrderId))
                clientOrderId = BinanceJson.S(o, "clientOrderId");

            decimal stopPrice = BinanceJson.D(o, "triggerPrice");
            if (stopPrice <= 0m)
                stopPrice = BinanceJson.D(o, "stopPrice");

            decimal originalQuantity = BinanceJson.D(o, "quantity");
            if (originalQuantity <= 0m)
                originalQuantity = BinanceJson.D(o, "origQty");

            long updateTime = BinanceJson.L(o, "updateTime");
            if (updateTime == 0)
                updateTime = BinanceJson.L(o, "updateTimeStamp");

            output.Add(new LiveOpenOrder
            {
                Symbol = BinanceJson.S(o, "symbol"),
                OrderId = orderId,
                ClientOrderId = clientOrderId,
                Side = BinanceJson.S(o, "side"),
                PositionSide = BinanceJson.S(o, "positionSide"),
                Type = type,
                Status = status,
                Price = BinanceJson.D(o, "price"),
                OriginalQuantity = originalQuantity,
                ExecutedQuantity = BinanceJson.D(o, "executedQty"),
                StopPrice = stopPrice,
                ReduceOnly = BinanceJson.B(o, "reduceOnly"),
                UpdateTimeUtc = updateTime > 0 ? BinanceJson.UnixMsToUtc(updateTime) : DateTime.UtcNow
            });
        }

        return output;
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<LiveOrderResult>> CancelAllOpenOrdersAsync(string symbol, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        EnsureTestnetTradeOnly();
        EnsureCredentials();

        symbol = NormalizeSymbol(symbol);
        var query = new Dictionary<string, string> { ["symbol"] = symbol };

        var results = new List<LiveOrderResult>();

        string normalBody = await DeleteSignedAsync("fapi/v1/allOpenOrders", query, ct);
        results.Add(new LiveOrderResult
        {
            Success = true,
            Symbol = symbol,
            Status = "CANCELED_ALL_NORMAL",
            Type = "CANCEL_ALL_NORMAL",
            RawJson = normalBody,
            Message = "Cancel-all normal open orders request accepted."
        });

        string algoBody = await DeleteSignedAsync("fapi/v1/algoOpenOrders", query, ct);
        results.Add(new LiveOrderResult
        {
            Success = true,
            Symbol = symbol,
            Status = "CANCELED_ALL_ALGO",
            Type = "CANCEL_ALL_ALGO",
            RawJson = algoBody,
            Message = "Cancel-all algo TP/SL open orders request accepted."
        });

        return results;
    }

    private static LiveOrderResult ParseOrderResult(string body, string fallbackSymbol, string fallbackSide, string fallbackType, string successMessage)
    {
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);
        var root = doc.RootElement;

        string parsedSymbol = BinanceJson.S(root, "symbol");
        string parsedSide = BinanceJson.S(root, "side");
        string parsedType = BinanceJson.S(root, "type");

        return new LiveOrderResult
        {
            Success = true,
            Symbol = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parsedSymbol) ? fallbackSymbol : parsedSymbol,
            OrderId = BinanceJson.L(root, "orderId"),
            ClientOrderId = BinanceJson.S(root, "clientOrderId"),
            Status = BinanceJson.S(root, "status"),
            Side = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parsedSide) ? fallbackSide : parsedSide,
            Type = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parsedType) ? fallbackType : parsedType,
            OriginalQuantity = BinanceJson.D(root, "origQty"),
            ExecutedQuantity = BinanceJson.D(root, "executedQty"),
            AveragePrice = BinanceJson.D(root, "avgPrice"),
            Price = BinanceJson.D(root, "price"),
            StopPrice = BinanceJson.D(root, "stopPrice"),
            ReduceOnly = BinanceJson.B(root, "reduceOnly"),
            RawJson = body,
            Message = successMessage
        };
    }

    private static LiveOrderResult ParseAlgoOrderResult(string body, string fallbackSymbol, string fallbackSide, string fallbackType, string successMessage)
    {
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);
        var root = doc.RootElement;

        string parsedSymbol = BinanceJson.S(root, "symbol");
        string parsedSide = BinanceJson.S(root, "side");
        string parsedType = BinanceJson.S(root, "orderType");

        return new LiveOrderResult
        {
            Success = true,
            Symbol = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parsedSymbol) ? fallbackSymbol : parsedSymbol,
            OrderId = BinanceJson.L(root, "algoId"),
            ClientOrderId = BinanceJson.S(root, "clientAlgoId"),
            Status = BinanceJson.S(root, "algoStatus"),
            Side = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parsedSide) ? fallbackSide : parsedSide,
            Type = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parsedType) ? fallbackType : parsedType,
            OriginalQuantity = BinanceJson.D(root, "quantity"),
            ExecutedQuantity = 0m,
            AveragePrice = 0m,
            Price = BinanceJson.D(root, "price"),
            StopPrice = BinanceJson.D(root, "triggerPrice"),
            ReduceOnly = BinanceJson.B(root, "reduceOnly"),
            RawJson = body,
            Message = successMessage
        };
    }

    private async Task<string> GetSignedAsync(string relativePath, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>? query, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        string finalQuery = BuildSignedQuery(query);
        using var response = await _http.GetAsync(relativePath + "?" + finalQuery, ct);
        string body = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct);
        EnsureSuccess(response, body);
        return body;
    }

    private async Task<string> PostSignedAsync(string relativePath, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> query, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        string finalQuery = BuildSignedQuery(query);
        using var content = new StringContent(string.Empty);
        using var response = await _http.PostAsync(relativePath + "?" + finalQuery, content, ct);
        string body = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct);
        EnsureSuccess(response, body);
        return body;
    }

    private async Task<string> DeleteSignedAsync(string relativePath, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> query, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        string finalQuery = BuildSignedQuery(query);
        using var response = await _http.DeleteAsync(relativePath + "?" + finalQuery, ct);
        string body = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct);
        EnsureSuccess(response, body);
        return body;
    }

    private string BuildSignedQuery(IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>? query)
    {
        long timestamp = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds();

        var parts = new List<string>();
        if (query != null)
        {
            foreach (var kv in query)
                parts.Add($"{Uri.EscapeDataString(kv.Key)}={Uri.EscapeDataString(kv.Value)}");
        }

        parts.Add("recvWindow=" + _options.RecvWindowMs.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        parts.Add("timestamp=" + timestamp.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));

        string unsignedQuery = string.Join("&", parts);
        string signature = BinanceApiSigner.SignHmacSha256(unsignedQuery, _credentials.SecretKey);
        return unsignedQuery + "&signature=" + signature;
    }

    private static void EnsureSuccess(HttpResponseMessage response, string body)
    {
        if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            return;

        int? code = null;
        string message = $"HTTP {(int)response.StatusCode}";

        try
        {
            using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);
            if (doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("code", out var c) && c.TryGetInt32(out int parsedCode))
                code = parsedCode;
            if (doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("msg", out var m))
                message += ": " + (m.GetString() ?? string.Empty);
        }
        catch
        {
            message += ": " + body;
        }

        throw new BinanceApiException(message, body, code);
    }

    private void EnsureCredentials()
    {
        if (!_credentials.HasKeys)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Binance API key/secret missing.");
    }

    private void EnsureTestnetTradeOnly()
    {
        if (_options.Mode != ExchangeMode.BinanceTestnetTrade)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "Order execution is blocked. This starter only allows BinanceTestnetTrade mode. Live trading is intentionally not implemented.");
        }
    }

    private static string NormalizeSymbol(string symbol)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Symbol is required.");

        return symbol.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
    }

    private static string FormatDecimal(decimal value)
    {
        return value.ToString("0.####################", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (_ownsHttpClient)
            _http.Dispose();
    }
}
