using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Text.Json;
using TQGA.Application.Interfaces;
using TQGA.Application.Trading;
using TQGA.Domain.Trading;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.Binance;

public sealed class BinanceFuturesRestClient : IExchangeAccountClient, IExchangeMarketClient, IDisposable
{
    private static readonly SemaphoreSlim SymbolRulesCacheLock = new(1, 1);
    private static readonly TimeSpan SymbolRulesCacheTtl = TimeSpan.FromHours(12);
    private static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SymbolTradingRule>? _symbolRulesCache;
    private static DateTime _symbolRulesCacheUtc;

    private readonly HttpClient _http;
    private readonly BinanceApiCredentials _credentials;
    private readonly BinanceEndpointOptions _options;
    private readonly bool _ownsHttpClient;

    public BinanceFuturesRestClient(
        HttpClient httpClient,
        BinanceApiCredentials credentials,
        BinanceEndpointOptions options,
        bool ownsHttpClient = false)
    {
        _http = httpClient ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(httpClient));
        _credentials = credentials ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(credentials));
        _options = options ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(options));
        _ownsHttpClient = ownsHttpClient;

        _http.BaseAddress = new Uri(_options.RestBaseUrl.TrimEnd('/') + "/");
        _http.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(75);

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_credentials.ApiKey))
        {
            if (_http.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("X-MBX-APIKEY"))
                _http.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("X-MBX-APIKEY");

            _http.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("X-MBX-APIKEY", _credentials.ApiKey);
        }

        _http.DefaultRequestHeaders.Accept.Clear();
        _http.DefaultRequestHeaders.Accept.Add(new MediaTypeWithQualityHeaderValue("application/json"));
    }

    public async Task<ExchangeConnectionCheck> CheckConnectionAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        using var response = await _http.GetAsync("fapi/v1/time", ct);
        string body = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct);
        sw.Stop();

        if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
        {
            return new ExchangeConnectionCheck
            {
                Success = false,
                Message = $"HTTP {(int)response.StatusCode}: {body}",
                CheckedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,
                Latency = sw.Elapsed
            };
        }

        return new ExchangeConnectionCheck
        {
            Success = true,
            Message = "Binance Futures REST reachable",
            CheckedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,
            Latency = sw.Elapsed
        };
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SymbolTradingRule>> GetSymbolRulesAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SymbolTradingRule>? cached = TryGetFreshSymbolRulesCache();
        if (cached != null)
            return cached;

        await SymbolRulesCacheLock.WaitAsync(ct);
        try
        {
            cached = TryGetFreshSymbolRulesCache();
            if (cached != null)
                return cached;

            string body = await GetPublicAsync("fapi/v1/exchangeInfo", ct);
            IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SymbolTradingRule> parsed = ParseSymbolRules(body);

            if (parsed.Count == 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Binance exchangeInfo returned zero symbol rules. Order placement is blocked until rules are available.");

            _symbolRulesCache = parsed;
            _symbolRulesCacheUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;

            return parsed;
        }
        finally
        {
            SymbolRulesCacheLock.Release();
        }
    }

    private static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SymbolTradingRule>? TryGetFreshSymbolRulesCache()
    {
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SymbolTradingRule>? cached = _symbolRulesCache;
        if (cached == null || cached.Count == 0)
            return null;

        if (DateTime.UtcNow - _symbolRulesCacheUtc > SymbolRulesCacheTtl)
            return null;

        return cached;
    }

    private static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SymbolTradingRule> ParseSymbolRules(string body)
    {
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);

        var output = new Dictionary<string, SymbolTradingRule>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        if (!doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("symbols", out var symbols) || symbols.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Array)
            return output;

        foreach (var s in symbols.EnumerateArray())
        {
            string symbol = BinanceJson.S(s, "symbol");
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol))
                continue;

            decimal minQty = 0m;
            decimal maxQty = 0m;
            decimal stepSize = 0m;
            decimal tickSize = 0m;
            decimal minNotional = 0m;

            if (s.TryGetProperty("filters", out var filters) && filters.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
            {
                foreach (var f in filters.EnumerateArray())
                {
                    string filterType = BinanceJson.S(f, "filterType");
                    if (filterType.Equals("LOT_SIZE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        minQty = BinanceJson.D(f, "minQty");
                        maxQty = BinanceJson.D(f, "maxQty");
                        stepSize = BinanceJson.D(f, "stepSize");
                    }
                    else if (filterType.Equals("MARKET_LOT_SIZE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        // Some USD-M Futures symbols have a separate market order step. Prefer it when present.
                        decimal marketMinQty = BinanceJson.D(f, "minQty");
                        decimal marketMaxQty = BinanceJson.D(f, "maxQty");
                        decimal marketStepSize = BinanceJson.D(f, "stepSize");

                        if (marketMinQty > 0m)
                            minQty = marketMinQty;
                        if (marketMaxQty > 0m)
                            maxQty = marketMaxQty;
                        if (marketStepSize > 0m)
                            stepSize = marketStepSize;
                    }
                    else if (filterType.Equals("PRICE_FILTER", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        tickSize = BinanceJson.D(f, "tickSize");
                    }
                    else if (filterType.Equals("MIN_NOTIONAL", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        minNotional = BinanceJson.D(f, "notional");
                    }
                }
            }

            output[symbol] = new SymbolTradingRule
            {
                Symbol = symbol,
                MinQuantity = minQty,
                MaxQuantity = maxQty,
                QuantityStepSize = stepSize,
                TickSize = tickSize,
                MinNotional = minNotional,
                PricePrecision = BinanceJson.I(s, "pricePrecision"),
                QuantityPrecision = BinanceJson.I(s, "quantityPrecision")
            };
        }

        return output;
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<LiveAccountBalance>> GetBalancesAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        EnsureCredentials();
        string body = await GetSignedAsync("fapi/v3/account", null, ct);
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);

        var output = new List<LiveAccountBalance>();

        if (!doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("assets", out var assets) || assets.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Array)
            return output;

        foreach (var a in assets.EnumerateArray())
        {
            output.Add(new LiveAccountBalance
            {
                Asset = BinanceJson.S(a, "asset"),
                WalletBalance = BinanceJson.D(a, "walletBalance"),
                AvailableBalance = BinanceJson.D(a, "availableBalance"),
                CrossWalletBalance = BinanceJson.D(a, "crossWalletBalance"),
                UnrealizedProfit = BinanceJson.D(a, "unrealizedProfit"),
                MarginBalance = BinanceJson.D(a, "marginBalance")
            });
        }

        return output;
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<LivePosition>> GetPositionsAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        EnsureCredentials();
        string body = await GetSignedAsync("fapi/v3/positionRisk", null, ct);
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);

        var output = new List<LivePosition>();
        if (doc.RootElement.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Array)
            return output;

        foreach (var p in doc.RootElement.EnumerateArray())
        {
            string sideText = BinanceJson.S(p, "positionSide");
            ExchangePositionSide side = sideText.Equals("LONG", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                ? ExchangePositionSide.Long
                : sideText.Equals("SHORT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                    ? ExchangePositionSide.Short
                    : sideText.Equals("BOTH", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                        ? ExchangePositionSide.Both
                        : ExchangePositionSide.Unknown;

            output.Add(new LivePosition
            {
                Symbol = BinanceJson.S(p, "symbol"),
                PositionSide = side,
                PositionAmount = BinanceJson.D(p, "positionAmt"),
                EntryPrice = BinanceJson.D(p, "entryPrice"),
                MarkPrice = BinanceJson.D(p, "markPrice"),
                UnrealizedProfit = BinanceJson.D(p, "unRealizedProfit"),
                LiquidationPrice = BinanceJson.D(p, "liquidationPrice"),
                Leverage = BinanceJson.I(p, "leverage"),
                MarginType = BinanceJson.S(p, "marginType"),
                IsolatedMargin = BinanceJson.D(p, "isolatedMargin")
            });
        }

        return output;
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<LiveOpenOrder>> GetOpenOrdersAsync(string? symbol, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        EnsureCredentials();

        var query = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol)
            ? null
            : new Dictionary<string, string> { ["symbol"] = symbol.Trim().ToUpperInvariant() };

        string body = await GetSignedAsync("fapi/v1/openOrders", query, ct);
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);

        var output = new List<LiveOpenOrder>();
        if (doc.RootElement.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Array)
            return output;

        foreach (var o in doc.RootElement.EnumerateArray())
        {
            output.Add(new LiveOpenOrder
            {
                Symbol = BinanceJson.S(o, "symbol"),
                OrderId = BinanceJson.L(o, "orderId"),
                ClientOrderId = BinanceJson.S(o, "clientOrderId"),
                Side = BinanceJson.S(o, "side"),
                PositionSide = BinanceJson.S(o, "positionSide"),
                Type = BinanceJson.S(o, "type"),
                Status = BinanceJson.S(o, "status"),
                Price = BinanceJson.D(o, "price"),
                OriginalQuantity = BinanceJson.D(o, "origQty"),
                ExecutedQuantity = BinanceJson.D(o, "executedQty"),
                StopPrice = BinanceJson.D(o, "stopPrice"),
                ReduceOnly = BinanceJson.B(o, "reduceOnly"),
                UpdateTimeUtc = BinanceJson.UnixMsToUtc(BinanceJson.L(o, "updateTime"))
            });
        }

        return output;
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<LiveTradeFill>> GetRecentTradeFillsAsync(string symbol, int limit, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        EnsureCredentials();

        var query = new Dictionary<string, string>
        {
            ["symbol"] = symbol.Trim().ToUpperInvariant(),
            ["limit"] = Math.Clamp(limit, 1, 1000).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
        };

        string body = await GetSignedAsync("fapi/v1/userTrades", query, ct);
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);

        var output = new List<LiveTradeFill>();
        if (doc.RootElement.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Array)
            return output;

        foreach (var f in doc.RootElement.EnumerateArray())
        {
            output.Add(new LiveTradeFill
            {
                Symbol = BinanceJson.S(f, "symbol"),
                Id = BinanceJson.L(f, "id"),
                OrderId = BinanceJson.L(f, "orderId"),
                Side = BinanceJson.S(f, "side"),
                Price = BinanceJson.D(f, "price"),
                Quantity = BinanceJson.D(f, "qty"),
                RealizedPnl = BinanceJson.D(f, "realizedPnl"),
                Commission = BinanceJson.D(f, "commission"),
                CommissionAsset = BinanceJson.S(f, "commissionAsset"),
                Maker = BinanceJson.B(f, "maker"),
                TimeUtc = BinanceJson.UnixMsToUtc(BinanceJson.L(f, "time"))
            });
        }

        return output;
    }

    private async Task<string> GetPublicAsync(string relativePath, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        return await GetWithRetryAsync(relativePath, operationName: "public REST GET " + relativePath, ct);
    }

    private async Task<string> GetSignedAsync(string relativePath, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>? query, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        long timestamp = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds();

        var parts = new List<string>();
        if (query != null)
        {
            foreach (var kv in query)
                parts.Add($"{Uri.EscapeDataString(kv.Key)}={Uri.EscapeDataString(kv.Value)}");
        }

        parts.Add("recvWindow=" + _options.RecvWindowMs.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        parts.Add("timestamp=" + timestamp.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));

        string unsignedQuery = string.Join("&", parts);
        string signature = BinanceApiSigner.SignHmacSha256(unsignedQuery, _credentials.SecretKey);
        string finalQuery = unsignedQuery + "&signature=" + signature;

        return await GetWithRetryAsync(relativePath + "?" + finalQuery, operationName: "signed REST GET " + relativePath, ct);
    }

    private async Task<string> GetWithRetryAsync(string requestUri, string operationName, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        const int maxAttempts = 3;

        for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++)
        {
            try
            {
                using var response = await _http.GetAsync(requestUri, ct);
                string body = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct);
                EnsureSuccess(response, body);
                return body;
            }
            catch (TaskCanceledException ex) when (!ct.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                if (attempt >= maxAttempts)
                {
                    throw new TimeoutException(
                        $"Binance {operationName} timed out after {maxAttempts} attempts. " +
                        $"The HTTP timeout is {_http.Timeout.TotalSeconds:F0} seconds. " +
                        "Retry after a few seconds, or click SYNC ACCOUNT first so symbol rules are cached before placing orders.",
                        ex);
                }

                await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(600 * attempt), ct);
            }
            catch (HttpRequestException) when (attempt < maxAttempts)
            {
                await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(600 * attempt), ct);
            }
            catch (IOException) when (attempt < maxAttempts)
            {
                await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(600 * attempt), ct);
            }
        }

        throw new InvalidOperationException("Unexpected Binance REST retry loop exit.");
    }

    private static void EnsureSuccess(HttpResponseMessage response, string body)
    {
        if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            return;

        int? code = null;
        string message = $"HTTP {(int)response.StatusCode}";

        try
        {
            using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);
            if (doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("code", out var c) && c.TryGetInt32(out int parsedCode))
                code = parsedCode;
            if (doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("msg", out var m))
                message += ": " + (m.GetString() ?? string.Empty);
        }
        catch
        {
            message += ": " + body;
        }

        throw new BinanceApiException(message, body, code);
    }

    private void EnsureCredentials()
    {
        if (!_credentials.HasKeys)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Binance API key/secret missing. Use readonly API key via environment variables or the readonly sync form.");
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (_ownsHttpClient)
            _http.Dispose();
    }
}

using System.Globalization;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.Binance;

internal static class BinanceJson
{
    public static string S(JsonElement e, string name)
    {
        if (!e.TryGetProperty(name, out var p))
            return string.Empty;

        return p.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String ? p.GetString() ?? string.Empty : p.ToString();
    }

    public static decimal D(JsonElement e, string name)
    {
        string text = S(e, name);
        return decimal.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var value)
            ? value
            : 0m;
    }

    public static int I(JsonElement e, string name)
    {
        string text = S(e, name);
        return int.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var value)
            ? value
            : 0;
    }

    public static long L(JsonElement e, string name)
    {
        string text = S(e, name);
        return long.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var value)
            ? value
            : 0L;
    }

    public static bool B(JsonElement e, string name)
    {
        if (!e.TryGetProperty(name, out var p))
            return false;

        if (p.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.True)
            return true;

        if (p.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.False)
            return false;

        string text = p.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String ? p.GetString() ?? string.Empty : p.ToString();
        return bool.TryParse(text, out bool value) && value;
    }

    public static DateTime UnixMsToUtc(long ms)
    {
        if (ms <= 0)
            return DateTime.MinValue;

        return DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds(ms).UtcDateTime;
    }
}

using System.Globalization;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.Data;

public sealed class CandleDataCleaner
{
    private readonly string _candlesRoot;

    public CandleDataCleaner(string candlesRoot)
    {
        _candlesRoot = candlesRoot;
    }

    public void Run()
    {
        var files = Directory.GetFiles(_candlesRoot, "*.csv");

        foreach (var file in files)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"\n🧹 CLEANING: {Path.GetFileName(file)}");

            Backup(file);

            var cleaned = CleanFile(file);

            File.WriteAllLines(file, cleaned);

            Console.WriteLine("✅ DONE");
        }
    }

    private static void Backup(string file)
    {
        var backup = file + ".bak";

        File.Copy(file, backup, true);

        Console.WriteLine("📦 Backup created");
    }

    private static List<string> CleanFile(string file)
    {
        var lines = File.ReadAllLines(file).ToList();

        var header = lines.First();

        var candles = lines
            .Skip(1)
            .Select(Parse)
            .Where(x => x != null)
            .Select(x => x!)
            .ToList();

        // SORT
        candles = candles
            .OrderBy(c => c.Time)
            .ToList();

        // REMOVE DUPLICATES
        candles = candles
            .GroupBy(c => c.Time)
            .Select(g => g.First())
            .ToList();

        // CHECK CONTINUITY
        ValidateContinuity(candles);

        // REBUILD
        var output = new List<string> { header };

        output.AddRange(candles.Select(ToCsv));

        return output;
    }

    private static CandleRow? Parse(string line)
    {
        var p = line.Split(',');

        if (p.Length < 6)
            return null;

        return new CandleRow
        {
            Time = DateTime.Parse(p[0], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            Open = p[1],
            High = p[2],
            Low = p[3],
            Close = p[4],
            Volume = p[5]
        };
    }

    private static string ToCsv(CandleRow c)
    {
        return string.Join(",",
            c.Time.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"),
            c.Open,
            c.High,
            c.Low,
            c.Close,
            c.Volume);
    }

    private static void ValidateContinuity(List<CandleRow> candles)
    {
        var expectedStep = TimeSpan.FromHours(1);

        for (int i = 1; i < candles.Count; i++)
        {
            var diff = candles[i].Time - candles[i - 1].Time;

            if (diff != expectedStep)
            {
                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"⚠ GAP or overlap: {candles[i - 1].Time} → {candles[i].Time}  ({diff})");
            }
        }
    }

    private sealed class CandleRow
    {
        public DateTime Time { get; set; }
        public string Open { get; set; } = "";
        public string High { get; set; } = "";
        public string Low { get; set; } = "";
        public string Close { get; set; } = "";
        public string Volume { get; set; } = "";
    }
}

        // Trading stack required by BacktestRunner / PortfolioBacktestRunner / TradingEngine
        services.AddScoped<ITradingEngine, TradingEngine>();
        services.AddScoped<IOrderExecutor, BacktestOrderExecutor>();
        services.AddScoped<IRiskManager, SimpleRiskManager>();
        services.AddScoped<ICapitalAllocator, StrategyCapitalAllocator>();

        // Per-run stateful accounting / diagnostics services
        services.AddScoped<TradeLedger>();
        services.AddScoped<EquityCurve>();
        services.AddScoped<TradeDecisionDiagnostics>();

        return services;
    }
}

using System.Globalization;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text.Json;
using TQGA.Domain.Market;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.MarketData;

public sealed class BinanceDownloader
{
    private static readonly HttpClient _http = new()
    {
        BaseAddress = new Uri("https://api.binance.com")
    };

    private const int LimitPerRequest = 1000;

    public async Task<List<Candle>> DownloadAsync(
        string symbol,
        string interval,
        DateTime startUtc,
        DateTime endUtc,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var candles = new List<Candle>();

        long startMs = ToUnixMs(startUtc);
        long endMs = ToUnixMs(endUtc);

        while (startMs < endMs)
        {
            var url =
                $"/api/v3/klines?symbol={symbol}" +
                $"&interval={interval}" +
                $"&startTime={startMs}" +
                $"&endTime={endMs}" +
                $"&limit={LimitPerRequest}";

            var response = await _http.GetAsync(url, ct);
            response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();

            var json = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct);
            var data = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<List<JsonElement>>>(json);

            if (data == null || data.Count == 0)
                break;

            foreach (var item in data)
            {
                var openTime = DateTimeOffset
                    .FromUnixTimeMilliseconds(item[0].GetInt64())
                    .UtcDateTime;

                candles.Add(new Candle(
                    openTime,
                    decimal.Parse(item[1].GetString()!, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                    decimal.Parse(item[2].GetString()!, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                    decimal.Parse(item[3].GetString()!, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                    decimal.Parse(item[4].GetString()!, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                    decimal.Parse(item[5].GetString()!, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                ));
            }

            startMs = data.Last()[0].GetInt64() + 1;

            await Task.Delay(300, ct); // rate-limit safe
        }

        return candles;
    }

    private static long ToUnixMs(DateTime dt)
        => new DateTimeOffset(dt).ToUnixTimeMilliseconds();
}

using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Text.Json;
using TQGA.Infrastructure.MarketData;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.Data;

public sealed class BinanceDownloaderService
{
    private readonly HttpClient _http = new();
    private readonly BinanceRateLimiter _rateLimiter = new();
    private readonly CandleFileWriter _writer = new();

    public async Task IncrementalUpdateAsync(
        string symbol,
        string interval,
        IProgress<int>? progress,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var last = _writer.GetLastCandleTime(symbol, interval);

        DateTime start =
            last?.AddHours(1) ??
            DateTime.UtcNow.AddYears(-5);

        DateTime end = DateTime.UtcNow;

        var allCandles = new List<string>();

        int batch = 0;

        while (start < end)
        {
            await _rateLimiter.WaitAsync(ct);

            var url =
                $"https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines" +
                $"?symbol={symbol}" +
                $"&interval={interval}" +
                $"&startTime={new DateTimeOffset(start).ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()}" +
                $"&limit=1000";

            var data = await RetryPolicy.ExecuteAsync(async () =>
                await _http.GetStringAsync(url, ct));

            var json = JsonDocument.Parse(data);

            if (json.RootElement.GetArrayLength() == 0)
                break;

            foreach (var item in json.RootElement.EnumerateArray())
            {
                var line =
                    $"{DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds(item[0].GetInt64()).UtcDateTime:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}," +
                    $"{item[1]}," +
                    $"{item[2]}," +
                    $"{item[3]}," +
                    $"{item[4]}," +
                    $"{item[5]}";

                allCandles.Add(line);
            }

            // JsonElement does not support the C# Index (^) operator on its indexer,
            // so compute the last index explicitly.
            var arrLen = json.RootElement.GetArrayLength();
            if (arrLen == 0)
                break;

            start = DateTimeOffset
                .FromUnixTimeMilliseconds(
                    json.RootElement[arrLen - 1][0].GetInt64())
                .UtcDateTime
                .AddHours(1);

            batch++;
            progress?.Report(batch);
        }

        _writer.AppendOrCreate(symbol, interval, allCandles);
    }
}

using System.Threading;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.Data;

public sealed class BinanceRateLimiter
{
    private readonly SemaphoreSlim _semaphore = new(1, 1);
    private DateTime _lastCall = DateTime.MinValue;

    private const int MinDelayMs = 250; // 4 calls per second max

    public async Task WaitAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        await _semaphore.WaitAsync(ct);

        try
        {
            var elapsed = DateTime.UtcNow - _lastCall;

            if (elapsed.TotalMilliseconds < MinDelayMs)
            {
                var delay = MinDelayMs - (int)elapsed.TotalMilliseconds;
                await Task.Delay(delay, ct);
            }

            _lastCall = DateTime.UtcNow;
        }
        finally
        {
            _semaphore.Release();
        }
    }
}

using System.Globalization;
using TQGA.Infrastructure.MarketData;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.MarketData;

public sealed class CandleFileWriter
{
    private static readonly string BasePath = DataPaths.Candles;
    private static string GetPath(string symbol, string interval)
        => Path.Combine(BasePath, $"{symbol}_{interval}.csv");

    public DateTime? GetLastCandleTime(string symbol, string interval)
    {
        var path = GetPath(symbol, interval);

        if (!File.Exists(path))
            return null;

        var lastLine = File.ReadLines(path).LastOrDefault();

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(lastLine))
            return null;

        var parts = lastLine.Split(',');

        return DateTime.Parse(parts[0], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    }

    public void AppendOrCreate(
        string symbol,
        string interval,
        IEnumerable<CandleDto> candles)
    {
        var path = GetPath(symbol, interval);

        var exists = File.Exists(path);

        using var writer = new StreamWriter(path, append: true);

        if (!exists)
        {
            writer.WriteLine("Time,Open,High,Low,Close,Volume");
        }

        foreach (var c in candles)
        {
            writer.WriteLine(string.Join(",",
                c.Time.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"),
                c.Open.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                c.High.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                c.Low.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                c.Close.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                c.Volume.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            ));
        }
    }

    // Overload to accept preformatted CSV lines (used by downloader service)
    public void AppendOrCreate(
        string symbol,
        string interval,
        IEnumerable<string> csvLines)
    {
        var path = GetPath(symbol, interval);

        var exists = File.Exists(path);

        using var writer = new StreamWriter(path, append: true);

        if (!exists)
        {
            writer.WriteLine("Time,Open,High,Low,Close,Volume");
        }

        foreach (var line in csvLines)
        {
            writer.WriteLine(line);
        }
    }
}

public sealed class CandleDto
{
    public DateTime Time { get; init; }
    public decimal Open { get; init; }
    public decimal High { get; init; }
    public decimal Low { get; init; }
    public decimal Close { get; init; }
    public decimal Volume { get; init; }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using TQGA.Application.Interfaces;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Domain.Market;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.MarketData;

/// <summary>
/// Reads candles from CSV files stored at:
/// DataPaths.Candles\{SYMBOL}_{TF}.csv
/// Example: BTCUSDT_1h.csv
/// CSV expected columns: Time,Open,High,Low,Close,Volume
/// </summary>
public sealed class CsvCandleDataFeed : ICandleDataFeed
{
    private readonly string _root;

    public CsvCandleDataFeed()
    {
        _root = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(DataPaths.Candles)
            ? Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "MarketData", "Candles")
            : DataPaths.Candles;
    }

    public IEnumerable<Candle> GetCandles(string symbol, string timeframe)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol))
            throw new ArgumentException("Symbol is required.", nameof(symbol));

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(timeframe))
            throw new ArgumentException("Timeframe is required.", nameof(timeframe));

        var file = Path.Combine(_root, $"{symbol}_{timeframe}.csv");

        if (!File.Exists(file))
            throw new FileNotFoundException($"Candle file not found: {file}");

        foreach (var line in File.ReadLines(file))
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line))
                continue;

            // Skip header lines safely
            if (line.StartsWith("Time", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                line.StartsWith("Open", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                continue;

            var parts = line.Split(',', StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries);
            if (parts.Length < 6)
                continue;

            if (!TryParseTime(parts[0], out var t))
                continue;

            if (!TryDec(parts[1], out var o)) continue;
            if (!TryDec(parts[2], out var h)) continue;
            if (!TryDec(parts[3], out var l)) continue;
            if (!TryDec(parts[4], out var c)) continue;

            // Volume sometimes missing/blank in some CSVs -> default to 0
            decimal v = 0m;
            _ = TryDec(parts[5], out v);

            // ✅ Candle is immutable in your Domain: construct via ctor
            yield return new Candle(t, o, h, l, c, v);
        }
    }

    private static bool TryDec(string s, out decimal d)
        => decimal.TryParse(s, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out d);

    private static bool TryParseTime(string raw, out DateTime t)
    {
        raw = raw.Trim();

        // Unix ms or unix sec
        if (long.TryParse(raw, out var n))
        {
            if (n > 1_000_000_000_000) // ms
            {
                t = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds(n).UtcDateTime;
                return true;
            }

            if (n > 1_000_000_000) // sec
            {
                t = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeSeconds(n).UtcDateTime;
                return true;
            }
        }

        // ISO time
        if (DateTime.TryParse(
                raw,
                CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                DateTimeStyles.AssumeUniversal | DateTimeStyles.AdjustToUniversal,
                out t))
        {
            t = DateTime.SpecifyKind(t, DateTimeKind.Utc);
            return true;
        }

        t = default;
        return false;
    }
}

using TQGA.Application.Interfaces;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.MarketData;

public sealed class CsvMarketDataFeed : IMarketDataFeed
{
    private readonly List<decimal> _prices = new();
    private int _index;

    public CsvMarketDataFeed(string filePath)
    {
        if (!File.Exists(filePath))
            throw new FileNotFoundException(
                $"Market data file not found: {filePath}");

        _prices = File.ReadAllLines(filePath)
            .Skip(1)
            .Select(l => decimal.Parse(l.Split(',')[4]))
            .ToList();
    }

    public decimal GetLastPrice(string symbol)
    {
        if (_index >= _prices.Count)
            return _prices.Last();

        return _prices[_index++];
    }
}

using TQGA.Application.Paths;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.MarketData;

public sealed class HistoricalDataBootstrapper
{
    private const int FullHistoryYears = 10;

    private readonly BinanceDownloader _downloader = new();
    private readonly CandleFileWriter _writer = new();

    public Task ForceFullDownloadAsync()
        => EnsureAsync(force: true);

    public Task UpdateAsync()
        => EnsureAsync(force: false);

    public async Task EnsureAsync(bool force = false)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Candles);

        foreach (var symbol in BinanceUniverse.ActiveSymbols)
        {
            foreach (var tf in BinanceUniverse.Timeframes)
            {
                var path = Path.Combine(
                    DataPaths.Candles,
                    $"{symbol}_{tf}.csv");

                DateTime startUtc;

                if (!force && File.Exists(path))
                {
                    var last = _writer.GetLastCandleTime(symbol, tf);

                    startUtc = last != null
                        ? last.Value.Add(GetTimeframeStep(tf))
                        : DateTime.UtcNow.AddYears(-FullHistoryYears);
                }
                else
                {
                    startUtc = DateTime.UtcNow.AddYears(-FullHistoryYears);
                }

                if (startUtc >= DateTime.UtcNow)
                    continue;

                var candles = await _downloader.DownloadAsync(
                    symbol,
                    tf,
                    startUtc,
                    DateTime.UtcNow,
                    CancellationToken.None);

                var dtos = candles.Select(c => new CandleDto
                {
                    Time = c.Time,
                    Open = c.Open,
                    High = c.High,
                    Low = c.Low,
                    Close = c.Close,
                    Volume = c.Volume
                });

                _writer.AppendOrCreate(symbol, tf, dtos);
            }
        }
    }

    private static TimeSpan GetTimeframeStep(string tf)
    {
        return tf switch
        {
            "15m" => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15),
            "1h" => TimeSpan.FromHours(1),
            "4h" => TimeSpan.FromHours(4),
            "1d" => TimeSpan.FromDays(1),
            _ => TimeSpan.FromHours(1)
        };
    }
}

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.Data;

public static class RetryPolicy
{
    public static async Task<T> ExecuteAsync<T>(
        Func<Task<T>> action,
        int maxAttempts = 5)
    {
        int attempt = 0;

        while (true)
        {
            try
            {
                return await action();
            }
            catch when (attempt < maxAttempts)
            {
                attempt++;
                var delay = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Pow(2, attempt));
                await Task.Delay(delay);
            }
        }
    }
}

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.Data;

{
    private readonly BinanceDownloaderService _service = new();

        string symbol,
        string interval)
    {
        var timer = new System.Timers.Timer
        {
            Interval = TimeSpan.FromHours(24).TotalMilliseconds,
            AutoReset = true

        timer.Elapsed += async (_, _) =>
        {
            await _service.IncrementalUpdateAsync(
                symbol,

                null,
                CancellationToken.None);
        };

        timer.Start();

using TQGA.Application.Risk;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.Risk;

public sealed class SimpleRiskManager : IRiskManager
{
    private readonly decimal _maxPositionSize;
    private readonly decimal _maxLoss;
    private decimal _cumulativePnl;

    // ✅ INSTITUTIONAL DEFAULTS
    public SimpleRiskManager(
        decimal maxPositionSize = 10_000m,
        decimal maxLoss = -5_000m)
    {
        _maxPositionSize = maxPositionSize;
        _maxLoss = maxLoss;
    }

    public bool CanEnterPosition(decimal orderSize)
    {
        return orderSize <= _maxPositionSize;
    }

    public bool CanContinueTrading()
    {
        return _cumulativePnl > _maxLoss;
    }

    public void OnTradeClosed(decimal pnl)
    {
        _cumulativePnl += pnl;
    }
}

using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using TQGA.Application.Strategy;
using TQGA.Domain.Indicators;
using TQGA.Domain.Trading;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.Strategies;

public sealed class EarlyTrendContinuationSignal : ISignal
{
    private readonly Ema _ema21 = new(21);
    private readonly Ema _ema55 = new(55);
    private readonly Rsi _rsi14 = new(14);
    private readonly Queue<decimal> _recentCloses = new();

    private const int MaxRecent = 30;

    public TradeSignal Evaluate(StrategyContext context)
    {
        decimal price = context.Price;

        _ema21.Add(price);
        _ema55.Add(price);
        _rsi14.Update(price);

        _recentCloses.Enqueue(price);
        while (_recentCloses.Count > MaxRecent)
            _recentCloses.Dequeue();

        if (!_ema21.IsReady || !_ema55.IsReady || !_rsi14.IsReady || _recentCloses.Count < 12)
            return TradeSignal.None;

        decimal emaFast = _ema21.Value;
        decimal emaSlow = _ema55.Value;
        decimal rsi = _rsi14.Value;

        if (emaFast <= 0m || emaSlow <= 0m)
            return TradeSignal.None;

        var closes = _recentCloses.ToArray();

        decimal priorHigh = closes.Length <= 1
            ? price
            : closes.Take(closes.Length - 1).Max();

        decimal recentLow = closes.Min();

        decimal emaSpreadPct = emaSlow == 0m
            ? 0m
            : (emaFast - emaSlow) / emaSlow;

        decimal distanceFromFastPct = emaFast == 0m
            ? 0m
            : (price - emaFast) / emaFast;

        decimal breakoutVsPriorHighPct = priorHigh == 0m
            ? 0m
            : (price - priorHigh) / priorHigh;

        bool trendAligned = emaFast > emaSlow;
        bool notTooMature = emaSpreadPct >= 0.002m && emaSpreadPct <= 0.080m;
        bool momentumHealthy = rsi >= 54m && rsi <= 69m;
        bool priceInContinuationZone = distanceFromFastPct >= -0.010m && distanceFromFastPct <= 0.035m;
        bool nearBreakout = breakoutVsPriorHighPct >= -0.005m;

        bool longEntry =
            !context.HasOpenPosition &&
            trendAligned &&
            notTooMature &&
            momentumHealthy &&
            priceInContinuationZone &&
            nearBreakout;

        if (longEntry)
            return TradeSignal.Long;

        bool trendBroken = emaFast < emaSlow;
        bool momentumLost = rsi < 48m;
        bool slippedUnderFast = price < (emaFast * 0.985m);
        bool brokeRecentLow = price < (recentLow * 0.992m);

        bool exit =
            context.HasOpenPosition &&
            (trendBroken || momentumLost || slippedUnderFast || brokeRecentLow);

        if (exit)
            return TradeSignal.Exit;

        return TradeSignal.None;
    }
}

using TQGA.Application.Strategy;
using TQGA.Domain.Indicators;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.Strategies;

public sealed class EmaCrossSignal : ISignal
{
    private readonly Ema _fast = new(50);
    private readonly Ema _slow = new(200);

    private bool _hasState;
    private bool _wasBullish;

    public TradeSignal Evaluate(StrategyContext context)
    {
        _fast.Add(context.Price);
        _slow.Add(context.Price);

        if (!_fast.IsReady || !_slow.IsReady)
            return TradeSignal.None;

        bool isBullish = _fast.Value > _slow.Value;

        if (!_hasState)
        {
            _wasBullish = isBullish;
            _hasState = true;

            return !context.HasOpenPosition && isBullish
                ? TradeSignal.Long
                : TradeSignal.None;
        }

        TradeSignal signal = TradeSignal.None;

        if (!context.HasOpenPosition)
        {
            if (!_wasBullish && isBullish)
                signal = TradeSignal.Long;
        }
        else
        {
            if (_wasBullish && !isBullish)
                signal = TradeSignal.Exit;
        }

        _wasBullish = isBullish;
        return signal;
    }
}

using System;
using TQGA.Application.Strategy;
using TQGA.Domain.Trading;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.Strategies;

public sealed class EmaTrendQuantStrategy : QuantStrategy, ITradePlanStrategy
{
    public override string Name => "EMA Trend (50/200)";

    // S05 REFINEMENT — PHASE 1
    // Goal:
    // - stop using EngineFallback for S05 plan metadata
    // - give S05 a native 1:2 risk/reward structure
    // - tighten downside before any broader optimization work
    //
    // Current first-pass plan:
    // - Stop Loss  : 3%
    // - Take Profit: 6%
    // - Expected   : 2.5%
    //
    // Rationale:
    // - Your REPORT 36 shows positive expectancy and breadth,
    //   but ugly tails and late-hold bleed.
    // - First refinement should reduce damage and improve harvesting discipline
    //   before touching entry logic.

    private const decimal LongStopLossPct = 0.03m;
    private const decimal LongTakeProfitPct = 0.06m;
    private const decimal LongExpectedPct = 0.025m;

    private const decimal ShortStopLossPct = 0.03m;
    private const decimal ShortTakeProfitPct = 0.06m;
    private const decimal ShortExpectedPct = 0.025m;

    public EmaTrendQuantStrategy()
    {
        Signals.Add(new EmaTrendSignal());
    }

    public ITradePlan BuildEntryTradePlan(
        string symbol,
        TradeSignal signal,
        decimal entryPrice,
        DateTime entryTime)
    {
        bool isShort = signal == TradeSignal.Short;

        decimal? stopLoss = null;
        decimal? takeProfit = null;
        decimal? expectedPrice = null;

        if (entryPrice > 0m)
        {
            if (isShort)
            {
                stopLoss = entryPrice * (1m + ShortStopLossPct);
                takeProfit = entryPrice * (1m - ShortTakeProfitPct);
                expectedPrice = entryPrice * (1m - ShortExpectedPct);
            }
            else
            {
                stopLoss = entryPrice * (1m - LongStopLossPct);
                takeProfit = entryPrice * (1m + LongTakeProfitPct);
                expectedPrice = entryPrice * (1m + LongExpectedPct);
            }
        }

        string entryReason =
            $"{Name}|Signal={signal}|Symbol={symbol}|Time={entryTime:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}|PlanSource=StrategyNative|Family=S05";

        return new StrategyTradePlan(
            TrueOrderType: "Market",
            EntryReason: entryReason,
            StopLossAtEntry: stopLoss,
            TakeProfitAtEntry: takeProfit,
            ExpectedPrice: expectedPrice);
    }

    public string BuildExitReason(
        Trade openTrade,
        TradeSignal signal,
        string symbol,
        decimal exitPrice,
        DateTime exitTime)
    {
        string pnlState;

        if (openTrade.Side == TradeSide.Buy)
            pnlState = exitPrice >= openTrade.EntryPrice ? "NonNegativeExit" : "LossExit";
        else
            pnlState = exitPrice <= openTrade.EntryPrice ? "NonNegativeExit" : "LossExit";

        return
            $"{Name}|Signal={signal}|Symbol={symbol}|Time={exitTime:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}|{pnlState}|PlanSource=StrategyNative|Family=S05";
    }
}

using TQGA.Application.Strategy;
using TQGA.Domain.Indicators;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.Strategies;

public sealed class EmaTrendSignal : ISignal
{
    private readonly Ema _fast = new(50);
    private readonly Ema _slow = new(200);

    public TradeSignal Evaluate(StrategyContext context)
    {
        _fast.Add(context.Price);
        _slow.Add(context.Price);

        if (!_fast.IsReady || !_slow.IsReady)
            return TradeSignal.None;

        bool bullish = _fast.Value > _slow.Value;

        // Entry when trend is bullish and we are flat
        if (!context.HasOpenPosition && bullish)
            return TradeSignal.Long;

        // Exit when trend flips bearish and we are long
        if (context.HasOpenPosition && !bullish)
            return TradeSignal.Exit;

        return TradeSignal.None;
    }
}

using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using TQGA.Application.Strategy;
using TQGA.Domain.Indicators;
using TQGA.Domain.Trading;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.Strategies;

public sealed class RegimeGatedAltcoinLeadershipPullbackSignal : ISignal
{
    private readonly Ema _ema21 = new(21);
    private readonly Ema _ema50 = new(50);
    private readonly Ema _ema200 = new(200);
    private readonly Rsi _rsi14 = new(14);

    private readonly Queue<decimal> _recentCloses = new();

    private const int MaxRecent = 80;

    private decimal _lastPrice;
    private decimal _previousPrice;
    private bool _isPrimedForLongReentry;

    public TradeSignal Evaluate(StrategyContext context)
    {
        decimal price = context.Price;

        _previousPrice = _lastPrice;
        _lastPrice = price;

        _ema21.Add(price);
        _ema50.Add(price);
        _ema200.Add(price);
        _rsi14.Update(price);

        PushPrice(price);

        if (_recentCloses.Count < 60)
            return TradeSignal.None;

        if (!_ema21.IsReady || !_ema50.IsReady || !_ema200.IsReady || !_rsi14.IsReady)
            return TradeSignal.None;

        decimal ema21 = _ema21.Value;
        decimal ema50 = _ema50.Value;
        decimal ema200 = _ema200.Value;
        decimal rsi = _rsi14.Value;

        bool trendAligned =
            price > ema200 &&
            ema21 > ema50 &&
            ema50 > ema200;

        bool slopeStrong =
            ema21 > AverageRecent(10) &&
            ema50 > AverageRecent(20);

        decimal extensionPctFromEma21 = PercentDistance(price, ema21);
        decimal extensionPctFromEma50 = PercentDistance(price, ema50);

        bool tooExtended =
            extensionPctFromEma21 > 8.50m ||
            extensionPctFromEma50 > 18.00m;

        if (context.HasOpenPosition)
        {
            if (ShouldExitLong(price, ema21, ema50, rsi))
            {
                _isPrimedForLongReentry = false;
                return TradeSignal.Exit;
            }

            return TradeSignal.None;
        }

        if (!trendAligned || !slopeStrong || tooExtended)
        {
            _isPrimedForLongReentry = false;
            return TradeSignal.None;
        }

        bool controlledPullback =
            price >= ema50 * 0.985m &&
            price <= ema21 * 1.015m;

        bool pullbackDepthAcceptable =
            extensionPctFromEma21 <= 3.75m &&
            price >= ema50 * 0.9925m;

        bool momentumStillHealthy =
            rsi >= 48m && rsi <= 68m;

        bool pullbackStructureHealthy =
            MinRecent(6) >= ema50 * 0.985m &&
            CountClosesBelow(ema50, 6) <= 2;

        if (controlledPullback && pullbackDepthAcceptable && momentumStillHealthy && pullbackStructureHealthy)
        {
            _isPrimedForLongReentry = true;
            return TradeSignal.None;
        }

        bool bullishResumption =
            _isPrimedForLongReentry &&
            _previousPrice > 0m &&
            price > _previousPrice &&
            price > ema21 &&
            price > AverageRecent(3) &&
            PercentDistance(price, _previousPrice) >= 0.20m;

        bool notLateChase =
            PercentDistance(price, ema21) <= 2.25m;

        bool localStrengthRecovered =
            price >= HighestRecent(5) * 0.995m;

        if (bullishResumption && notLateChase && localStrengthRecovered)
        {
            _isPrimedForLongReentry = false;
            return TradeSignal.Long;
        }

        return TradeSignal.None;
    }

    private bool ShouldExitLong(decimal price, decimal ema21, decimal ema50, decimal rsi)
    {
        bool lostFastTrend = price < ema21 * 0.9925m;
        bool lostMediumTrend = price < ema50 * 0.9975m;
        bool momentumFailure = rsi < 43m;
        bool sharpReversal = _previousPrice > 0m && PercentDistance(_previousPrice, price) >= 3.00m;

        return lostMediumTrend || (lostFastTrend && momentumFailure) || sharpReversal;
    }

    private void PushPrice(decimal price)
    {
        _recentCloses.Enqueue(price);

        while (_recentCloses.Count > MaxRecent)
            _recentCloses.Dequeue();
    }

    private decimal AverageRecent(int n)
    {
        if (_recentCloses.Count == 0)
            return 0m;

        return _recentCloses.TakeLast(System.Math.Max(1, n)).Average();
    }

    private decimal HighestRecent(int n)
    {
        if (_recentCloses.Count == 0)
            return 0m;

        return _recentCloses.TakeLast(System.Math.Max(1, n)).Max();
    }

    private decimal MinRecent(int n)
    {
        if (_recentCloses.Count == 0)
            return 0m;

        return _recentCloses.TakeLast(System.Math.Max(1, n)).Min();
    }

    private int CountClosesBelow(decimal level, int n)
    {
        if (_recentCloses.Count == 0)
            return 0;

        return _recentCloses
            .TakeLast(System.Math.Max(1, n))
            .Count(x => x < level);
    }

    private static decimal PercentDistance(decimal a, decimal b)
    {
        if (b == 0m)
            return 0m;

        return System.Math.Abs((a - b) / b) * 100m;
    }
}

using TQGA.Application.Strategy;
using TQGA.Domain.Indicators;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.Strategies;

public sealed class RsiReversionSignal : ISignal
{
    private readonly Rsi _rsi = new(14);
    private decimal? _previousRsi;

    private const decimal EntryArmRsi = 38m;
    private const decimal EntryConfirmRsi = 42m;
    private const decimal ExitTakeRsi = 58m;
    private const decimal ExitFailureRsi = 32m;
    private const decimal ExitFadeFloorRsi = 55m;

    public TradeSignal Evaluate(StrategyContext context)
    {
        _rsi.Update(context.Price);

        if (!_rsi.IsReady)
            return TradeSignal.None;

        decimal currentRsi = _rsi.Value;
        TradeSignal signal = TradeSignal.None;

        if (!context.HasOpenPosition)
        {
            if (_previousRsi.HasValue &&
                _previousRsi.Value <= EntryArmRsi &&
                currentRsi >= EntryConfirmRsi)
            {
                signal = TradeSignal.Long;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (currentRsi >= ExitTakeRsi)
            {
                signal = TradeSignal.Exit;
            }
            else if (_previousRsi.HasValue &&
                     _previousRsi.Value >= ExitFadeFloorRsi &&
                     currentRsi < _previousRsi.Value)
            {
                signal = TradeSignal.Exit;
            }
            else if (currentRsi <= ExitFailureRsi)
            {
                signal = TradeSignal.Exit;
            }
        }

        _previousRsi = currentRsi;
        return signal;
    }
}

using TQGA.Application.Strategy;
using TQGA.Domain.Indicators;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.Strategies;

public sealed class RsiSwingSignal : ISignal
{
    private readonly Ema _fast = new(50);
    private readonly Ema _slow = new(200);
    private readonly Rsi _rsi = new(14);

    public TradeSignal Evaluate(StrategyContext context)
    {
        _fast.Add(context.Price);
        _slow.Add(context.Price);
        _rsi.Update(context.Price);

        if (!_fast.IsReady || !_slow.IsReady || !_rsi.IsReady)
            return TradeSignal.None;

        bool bullishTrend = _fast.Value > _slow.Value;

        if (!context.HasOpenPosition && bullishTrend && _rsi.Value >= 38m && _rsi.Value <= 48m)
            return TradeSignal.Long;

        if (context.HasOpenPosition)
        {
            bool trendBroken = !bullishTrend;
            bool reboundComplete = _rsi.Value >= 60m;

            if (trendBroken || reboundComplete)
                return TradeSignal.Exit;
        }

        return TradeSignal.None;
    }
}

using TQGA.Application.Strategy;
using TQGA.Domain.Indicators;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.Strategies;

/// <summary>
/// Trend-pullback signal:
/// - only looks for long entries when the fast EMA is above the slow EMA
/// - uses RSI pullback for better entry location
/// - exits when momentum becomes stretched or trend weakens
/// This is intentionally aligned with the current TQGA trend-heavy edge profile.
/// </summary>
public sealed class TrendPullbackSignal : ISignal
{
    private readonly Ema _fast = new(50);
    private readonly Ema _slow = new(200);
    private readonly Rsi _rsi = new(14);

    public TradeSignal Evaluate(StrategyContext context)
    {
        _fast.Add(context.Price);
        _slow.Add(context.Price);
        _rsi.Update(context.Price);

        if (!_fast.IsReady || !_slow.IsReady || !_rsi.IsReady)
            return TradeSignal.None;

        var bullishTrend = _fast.Value > _slow.Value;

        if (!context.HasOpenPosition && bullishTrend && _rsi.Value <= 48m)
            return TradeSignal.Long;

        if (context.HasOpenPosition && (!bullishTrend || _rsi.Value >= 62m))
            return TradeSignal.Exit;

        return TradeSignal.None;
    }
}

using TQGA.Application.Trading;
using TQGA.Domain.Trading;

namespace TQGA.Infrastructure.Trading;

public sealed class InMemoryPositionRepository : IPositionRepository
{
    private Position? _position;

    public bool HasOpenPosition()
        => _position != null;

    public decimal CurrentSize()
        => _position?.Quantity ?? 0m;

    public void Open(TradeSide side, decimal quantity, decimal price)
    {
        if (_position != null)
            return;

        var signedQty = side == TradeSide.Buy
            ? quantity
            : -quantity;

        _position = new Position(
            symbol: "DEFAULT",
            quantity: signedQty,
            entryPrice: price
        );
    }

    public void Close(decimal price)
    {
        if (_position == null)
            return;

        _position = null;
    }
}

    private void LoadEnvironmentDefaults()
    {
        var env = BinanceApiCredentials.FromEnvironment();
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(env.ApiKey))
            _txtApiKey.Text = env.ApiKey;

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(env.SecretKey))
            _txtSecretKey.Text = env.SecretKey;

        if (env.HasKeys)
            _txtOutput.Text = "Saved Binance keys loaded automatically for this Windows user." + Environment.NewLine;
    }

    private BinanceApiCredentials ReadCredentialsFromTextBoxes()
    {
        return new BinanceApiCredentials
        {
            ApiKey = _txtApiKey.Text.Trim(),
            SecretKey = _txtSecretKey.Text.Trim()
        };
    }

    private void SaveKeysToUserEnvironment()
    {
        try
        {
            var credentials = ReadCredentialsFromTextBoxes();
            BinanceApiCredentials.SaveToUserEnvironment(credentials);
            MessageBox.Show(
                "Saved Binance keys for this Windows user. TQGA will auto-load them next time.\n\nDo not share these keys. Disable withdrawals and transfers on Binance.",
                "Binance Keys Saved",
                MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                MessageBoxIcon.Information);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(ex.Message, "Save Binance Keys Failed", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
        }
    }

    private void ClearSavedKeys()
    {
        BinanceApiCredentials.ClearUserEnvironment();
        _txtApiKey.Clear();
        _txtSecretKey.Clear();
        MessageBox.Show("Saved Binance keys cleared from this Windows user environment.", "Binance Keys Cleared", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
    }

    private async Task RunSyncAsync()
    {
        _btnSync.Enabled = false;
        _btnSaveKeys.Enabled = false;
        _btnClearKeys.Enabled = false;
        _txtOutput.Text = "Running Binance readonly sync..." + Environment.NewLine;

        try
        {
            ExchangeMode mode = _cmbMode.SelectedIndex == 1
                ? ExchangeMode.BinanceLiveReadonly
                : ExchangeMode.BinanceTestnetReadonly;

            BinanceEndpointOptions options = mode == ExchangeMode.BinanceLiveReadonly
                ? BinanceEndpointOptions.FuturesLiveReadonly()
                : BinanceEndpointOptions.FuturesTestnetReadonly();

            var credentials = ReadCredentialsFromTextBoxes();

            if (!credentials.HasKeys)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(
                    "API key and Secret key are required for account sync. Use readonly Binance API keys. Do not enable withdrawals.",
                    "Missing Binance API keys",
                    MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                    MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                return;
            }

            IReadOnlyList<string> symbols = _txtSymbols.Text
                .Split(new[] { ',', ';', ' ', '\r', '\n', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
                .Select(x => x.Trim().ToUpperInvariant())
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();

            using var http = new HttpClient();
            using var client = new BinanceFuturesRestClient(http, credentials, options);

            var syncService = new LiveAccountSyncService(
                client,
                client,
                new LiveSyncReportService());

            var request = LiveAccountSyncRequest.ForSymbols(
                mode,
                symbols,
                (int)_numFillLimit.Value);

            var (snapshot, reportPath) = await syncService.SyncAsync(request, CancellationToken.None);

            _txtOutput.Text = BuildOutput(snapshot, reportPath);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _txtOutput.Text = "SYNC FAILED" + Environment.NewLine + ex;
        }
        finally
        {
            _btnSync.Enabled = true;
            _btnSaveKeys.Enabled = true;
            _btnClearKeys.Enabled = true;
        }
    }

    private static string BuildOutput(LiveAccountSnapshot snapshot, string reportPath)
    {
        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("TQGA V8.9.0 BINANCE READONLY SYNC");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Mode                  : {snapshot.Mode}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Health                : {(snapshot.IsHealthy ? "PASS" : "CHECK")}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Message               : {snapshot.HealthMessage}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Snapshot UTC          : {snapshot.SnapshotUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Wallet USDT           : {snapshot.WalletUsdt:F4}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Available USDT        : {snapshot.AvailableUsdt:F4}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Unrealized PnL USDT   : {snapshot.UnrealizedPnlUsdt:F4}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Recent Realized PnL   : {snapshot.RecentRealizedPnlUsdt:F4}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Recent Commission     : {snapshot.RecentCommissionUsdt:F4}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Open Positions        : {snapshot.OpenPositionCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Open Orders           : {snapshot.OpenOrderCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Recent Fills          : {snapshot.RecentFills.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Symbol Rules          : {snapshot.SymbolRules.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Path           : {reportPath}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("OPEN POSITIONS");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        var openPositions = snapshot.Positions.Where(x => x.IsOpen).ToList();
        if (openPositions.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("No open positions.");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (var p in openPositions)
                sb.AppendLine($"{p.Symbol,-12} {p.PositionSide,-5} Amt={p.PositionAmount:F8} Entry={p.EntryPrice:F8} Mark={p.MarkPrice:F8} UPnL={p.UnrealizedProfit:F4} Lev={p.Leverage}x Liq={p.LiquidationPrice:F8}");
        }

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("OPEN ORDERS");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        if (snapshot.OpenOrders.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("No open orders.");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (var o in snapshot.OpenOrders)
                sb.AppendLine($"{o.Symbol,-12} Id={o.OrderId} {o.Side} {o.Type} {o.Status} Price={o.Price:F8} Stop={o.StopPrice:F8} Qty={o.OriginalQuantity:F8} ReduceOnly={o.ReduceOnly}");
        }

        if (snapshot.Errors.Count > 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine("ERRORS / WARNINGS");
            sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
            foreach (string error in snapshot.Errors)
                sb.AppendLine("- " + error);
        }

        return sb.ToString();
    }
}

    private const string Q2ReportsCoinListPath = @"D:\D DATA BACKUP\Data\Reports\SR_CONFIG_PROFILES\Q2 load coins.txt";
    private const string Q2ConfigCoinListPath = @"D:\D DATA BACKUP\Data\Config\SR_CONFIG_PROFILES\Q2 load coins.txt";

    // V8.10.4Q: testnet fast candle guard.
    // Before WATCH/AUTO EXECUTE runs the Button 18 candle audit, check local Q2 1h CSV files.
    // If each Q2 file has a current last candle and valid modified time, skip the network update.
    private sealed class LocalCandleFreshnessStatus
    {
        public string Symbol { get; init; } = string.Empty;
        public string FilePath { get; init; } = string.Empty;
        public bool IsFresh { get; init; }
        public DateTime LastCandleUtc { get; init; }
        public DateTime LastWriteUtc { get; init; }
        public string Reason { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    }

    private static DateTime GetLatestRequiredClosedOneHourCandleUtc()
    {
        DateTime utc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        return new DateTime(utc.Year, utc.Month, utc.Day, utc.Hour, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc).AddHours(-1);
    }

    private static string? FindOneHourCandleCsvPath(string symbol)
    {
        string normalized = (symbol ?? string.Empty).Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(normalized))
            return null;

        const string dataRoot = @"D:\D DATA BACKUP\Data";
        if (!Directory.Exists(dataRoot))
            return null;

        string direct = Path.Combine(dataRoot, normalized + "_1h.csv");
        if (File.Exists(direct))
            return direct;

        string reportsRoot = Path.Combine(dataRoot, "Reports");
        string configRoot = Path.Combine(dataRoot, "Config");
        try
        {
            return Directory.EnumerateFiles(dataRoot, normalized + "_1h.csv", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
                .FirstOrDefault(path =>
                    !path.StartsWith(reportsRoot, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                    !path.StartsWith(configRoot, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        }
        catch
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static string? ReadLastNonEmptyCsvDataLineFast(string path)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path) || !File.Exists(path))
            return null;

        try
        {
            using var fs = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite);
            if (fs.Length <= 0)
                return null;

            const int bufferSize = 4096;
            byte[] buffer = new byte[bufferSize];
            long position = fs.Length;
            var reversed = new System.Text.StringBuilder(256);

            while (position > 0)
            {
                int read = (int)Math.Min(bufferSize, position);
                position -= read;
                fs.Seek(position, SeekOrigin.Begin);
                int actual = fs.Read(buffer, 0, read);

                for (int i = actual - 1; i >= 0; i--)
                {
                    char ch = (char)buffer[i];
                    if (ch == '\n' || ch == '\r')
                    {
                        if (reversed.Length == 0)
                            continue;

                        string line = new string(reversed.ToString().Reverse().ToArray()).Trim();
                        reversed.Clear();

                        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line) && !line.StartsWith("Time", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                            return line;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        reversed.Append(ch);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (reversed.Length > 0)
            {
                string line = new string(reversed.ToString().Reverse().ToArray()).Trim();
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line) && !line.StartsWith("Time", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    return line;
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            return null;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static bool TryReadLastCandleUtcFromCsv(string path, out DateTime lastCandleUtc)
    {
        lastCandleUtc = DateTime.MinValue;
        string? lastDataLine = ReadLastNonEmptyCsvDataLineFast(path);
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(lastDataLine))
            return false;

        string firstCell = lastDataLine.Split(',')[0].Trim().Trim('"');
        string[] formats =
        {
            "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss",
            "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm",
            "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss",
            "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ",
            "M/d/yyyy H:mm:ss",
            "M/d/yyyy h:mm:ss tt"
        };

        if (DateTime.TryParseExact(firstCell, formats, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.AssumeUniversal | DateTimeStyles.AdjustToUniversal, out DateTime exact))
        {
            lastCandleUtc = DateTime.SpecifyKind(exact, DateTimeKind.Utc);
            return true;
        }

        if (DateTime.TryParse(firstCell, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.AssumeUniversal | DateTimeStyles.AdjustToUniversal, out DateTime parsed))
        {
            lastCandleUtc = DateTime.SpecifyKind(parsed, DateTimeKind.Utc);
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private static LocalCandleFreshnessStatus CheckOneHourCandleFreshness(string symbol)
    {
        string normalized = (symbol ?? string.Empty).Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
        string? path = FindOneHourCandleCsvPath(normalized);
        DateTime latestRequiredUtc = GetLatestRequiredClosedOneHourCandleUtc();

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path) || !File.Exists(path))
        {
            return new LocalCandleFreshnessStatus
            {
                Symbol = normalized,
                IsFresh = false,
                Reason = "missing 1h CSV"
            };
        }

        DateTime lastWriteUtc = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(path);
        if (!TryReadLastCandleUtcFromCsv(path, out DateTime lastCandleUtc))
        {
            return new LocalCandleFreshnessStatus
            {
                Symbol = normalized,
                FilePath = path,
                IsFresh = false,
                LastWriteUtc = lastWriteUtc,
                Reason = "could not read last candle time"
            };
        }

        bool lastCandleFresh = lastCandleUtc >= latestRequiredUtc;
        bool modifiedLooksValid = lastWriteUtc >= lastCandleUtc.AddMinutes(-90);
        string reason;
        if (lastCandleFresh && modifiedLooksValid)
            reason = "UP_TO_DATE_BY_LAST_CANDLE_AND_MODIFIED_TIME";
        else if (!lastCandleFresh)
            reason = $"stale last candle {lastCandleUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm} UTC < required {latestRequiredUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm} UTC";
        else
            reason = $"file modified time {lastWriteUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm} UTC is older than last candle {lastCandleUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm} UTC";

        return new LocalCandleFreshnessStatus
        {
            Symbol = normalized,
            FilePath = path,
            IsFresh = lastCandleFresh && modifiedLooksValid,
            LastCandleUtc = lastCandleUtc,
            LastWriteUtc = lastWriteUtc,
            Reason = reason
        };
    }

    private static string WriteTestnetCandleFreshnessReport(string title, IReadOnlyList<LocalCandleFreshnessStatus> rows, bool skippedNetworkUpdate)
    {
        const string folder = @"D:\D DATA BACKUP\Data\Reports\SR_CONFIG_PROFILES\CANDLE_FRESHNESS_FAST_SKIP";
        Directory.CreateDirectory(folder);
        string safeTitle = new string(title.Select(ch => char.IsLetterOrDigit(ch) ? ch : '_').ToArray()).Trim('_');
        string path = Path.Combine(folder, safeTitle + "_" + DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ".txt");

        DateTime latestRequiredUtc = GetLatestRequiredClosedOneHourCandleUtc();
        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("TQGA TESTNET LOCAL 1H CANDLE FRESHNESS CHECK");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Title                  : {title}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated Local        : {DateTime.Now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated UTC          : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Latest Required 1h UTC : {latestRequiredUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Network Update Skipped : {(skippedNetworkUpdate ? "YES" : "NO")}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Q2 Symbols             : {rows.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Fresh                  : {rows.Count(x => x.IsFresh)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Check/Update Needed    : {rows.Count(x => !x.IsFresh)}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("SYMBOL             STATUS       LAST_CANDLE_UTC   FILE_MODIFIED_UTC REASON");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        foreach (LocalCandleFreshnessStatus row in rows)
        {
            sb.AppendLine($"{row.Symbol,-18} {(row.IsFresh ? "UPTODATE" : "UPDATE"),-12} {FormatUtcOrBlank(row.LastCandleUtc),-17} {FormatUtcOrBlank(row.LastWriteUtc),-17} {row.Reason}");
        }
        File.WriteAllText(path, sb.ToString(), System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        return path;
    }

    private static string FormatUtcOrBlank(DateTime utc)
    {
        return utc == DateTime.MinValue ? "-" : utc.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    }

    private bool TrySkipQ2Button18CandleAudit(string title, IReadOnlyList<string> q2Symbols, System.Text.StringBuilder watchLog)
    {
        List<LocalCandleFreshnessStatus> rows = q2Symbols
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
            .Select(x => x.Trim().ToUpperInvariant())
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Select(CheckOneHourCandleFreshness)
            .ToList();

        bool allFresh = rows.Count > 0 && rows.All(x => x.IsFresh);
        string reportPath = WriteTestnetCandleFreshnessReport(title, rows, allFresh);

        watchLog.AppendLine($"Button 18 Fast Check  : {rows.Count(x => x.IsFresh)}/{rows.Count} Q2 candles fresh by modified date + last candle time");
        watchLog.AppendLine($"Fast Check Report     : {reportPath}");

        if (!allFresh)
        {
            watchLog.AppendLine("Button 18 Fast Check  : Binance candle audit/update required");
            _txtOutput.Text = watchLog.ToString();
            return false;
        }

        watchLog.AppendLine("Button 18 Result      : SKIPPED - Q2 1h candles already UP_TO_DATE locally");
        watchLog.AppendLine("Button 18 Markets     : all Q2 symbols fresh; no Binance candle download needed this cycle");
        _lblSrScannerProgress.Text = "Q2 candle audit skipped: local 1h candles already up-to-date.";
        _txtOutput.Text = watchLog.ToString();
        return true;
    }

    private void ApplyInitialSelectedSymbolsFromMainForm()
    {
        if (_initialScannerSymbols.Count == 0)
            return;

        _txtScannerSymbols.Text = string.Join(",", _initialScannerSymbols);
        _txtSymbol.Text = _initialScannerSymbols[0];
        _numMaxAutoTrades.Value = Math.Min(_numMaxAutoTrades.Maximum, Math.Max(_numMaxAutoTrades.Minimum, Math.Min(_initialMaxAutoTrades, _initialScannerSymbols.Count)));

        WriteTestnetQ2CoinFile(_initialScannerSymbols);
        _txtOutput.Text =
            "Q2 coins loaded for TESTNET operations. MainForm manual selections are ignored inside this testnet form." + Environment.NewLine +
            $"Q2 Symbols          : {string.Join(", ", _initialScannerSymbols)}" + Environment.NewLine +
            $"Max Auto/Open Trades: {_numMaxAutoTrades.Value}" + Environment.NewLine +
            $"Q2 Testnet File     : {TestnetSelectedQ2Path}" + Environment.NewLine +
            "Use SR SMART 1H SCAN, WATCH AUTO_READY, or AUTO EXECUTE MAX. All are locked to Q2 only." + Environment.NewLine;
    }

    private void LoadEnvironmentDefaults()
    {
        var env = BinanceApiCredentials.FromEnvironment();
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(env.ApiKey))
            _txtApiKey.Text = env.ApiKey;

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(env.SecretKey))
            _txtSecretKey.Text = env.SecretKey;

        if (env.HasKeys)
            _txtOutput.Text = "Saved Binance testnet keys loaded automatically for this Windows user." + Environment.NewLine;
    }

    private BinanceApiCredentials ReadCredentialsFromTextBoxes()
    {
        return new BinanceApiCredentials
        {
            ApiKey = _txtApiKey.Text.Trim(),
            SecretKey = _txtSecretKey.Text.Trim()
        };
    }

    private void SaveKeysToUserEnvironment()
    {
        try
        {
            var credentials = ReadCredentialsFromTextBoxes();
            BinanceApiCredentials.SaveToUserEnvironment(credentials);
            MessageBox.Show(
                "Saved Binance keys for this Windows user. TQGA will auto-load them next time.\n\nUse testnet keys here. Live trading is blocked in this form.",
                "Binance Keys Saved",
                MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                MessageBoxIcon.Information);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(ex.Message, "Save Binance Keys Failed", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
        }
    }

    private void ClearSavedKeys()
    {
        BinanceApiCredentials.ClearUserEnvironment();
        _txtApiKey.Clear();
        _txtSecretKey.Clear();
        MessageBox.Show("Saved Binance keys cleared from this Windows user environment.", "Binance Keys Cleared", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
    }

    private async Task RunReadonlySyncAsync()
    {
        SetBusy(true);
        try
        {
            using var context = CreateContext();
            var syncService = new LiveAccountSyncService(
                context.AccountClient,
                context.AccountClient,
                new LiveSyncReportService());

            var request = LiveAccountSyncRequest.ForSymbols(
                ExchangeMode.BinanceTestnetTrade,
                new[] { CleanSymbol() },
                50);

            var (snapshot, reportPath) = await syncService.SyncAsync(request, CancellationToken.None);
            _txtOutput.Text = BinanceReadonlySyncFormOutput.Build(snapshot, reportPath);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _txtOutput.Text = "SYNC FAILED" + Environment.NewLine + ex;
        }
        finally
        {
            SetBusy(false);
        }
    }

    private async Task PlaceEntryWithProtectionAsync()
    {
        if (!ConfirmDangerousTestnetAction("This will place a real TESTNET futures entry order plus SL/TP, then verify protection from Binance. If SL/TP is missing, TQGA will auto-close the position. Continue?"))
            return;

        SetBusy(true);
        try
        {
            using var context = CreateContext();
            var service = new TestnetOrderExecutionService(
                context.AccountClient,
                context.AccountClient,
                context.OrderClient,
                new LiveOrderExecutionReportService());

            var request = new TestnetOrderExecutionRequest
            {
                Mode = ExchangeMode.BinanceTestnetTrade,
                Symbol = CleanSymbol(),
                Side = _cmbSide.SelectedIndex == 1 ? ExchangeOrderSide.Sell : ExchangeOrderSide.Buy,
                TradeSizeUsdt = _numTradeSize.Value,
                MaxTradeSizeUsdt = _numMaxTradeSize.Value,
                Leverage = (int)_numLeverage.Value,
                StopLossPercent = _numStopLossPct.Value,
                TakeProfitPercent = _numTakeProfitPct.Value
            };

            LiveOrderExecutionResult result = await service.PlaceEntryWithProtectionAsync(request, CancellationToken.None);
            _txtOutput.Text = new LiveOrderExecutionReportService().BuildReport(result);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _txtOutput.Text = "TESTNET ORDER FAILED" + Environment.NewLine + ex;
        }
        finally
        {
            SetBusy(false);
        }
    }
