    private void ResetSrScannerProgress()
    {
        _barSrScannerProgress.Value = 0;
        _lblSrScannerProgress.Text = "SR speed scanner progress: starting all-futures scan until AUTO_READY_SHADOW_ONLY...";
    }

    private void UpdateSrScannerProgress(SrScannerProgress progress)
    {
        _barSrScannerProgress.Value = Math.Max(_barSrScannerProgress.Minimum, Math.Min(_barSrScannerProgress.Maximum, progress.Percent));

        string item = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(progress.CurrentSymbol)
            ? string.Empty
            : $" | Last: {progress.CurrentSymbol}";

        string eta = BuildSrScannerEta(progress);
        string stop = progress.StopWhenAutoReady ? " | StopOnAuto=YES" : string.Empty;

        _lblSrScannerProgress.Text =
            $"SR speed scan: {progress.Stage} {progress.Percent}% ({progress.Current}/{progress.Total}, left {progress.Remaining}, ETA {eta}) | Req {progress.Requested}, Rule OK {progress.RuleValidated}, Excl {progress.RuleExcluded}, Fresh {progress.Fresh}, Signals {progress.Signals}, Elig {progress.Eligible}, Auto {progress.AutoReady}{stop}{item}";
    }

    private string BuildSrScannerEta(SrScannerProgress progress)
    {
        if (progress.Completed || progress.Remaining <= 0)
            return "0s";

        if (_srScannerStartedUtc == default || progress.Current <= 0)
            return "calculating";

        TimeSpan elapsed = DateTime.UtcNow - _srScannerStartedUtc;
        if (elapsed.TotalSeconds < 1)
            return "calculating";

        double secondsPerItem = elapsed.TotalSeconds / Math.Max(1, progress.Current);
        double remainingSeconds = Math.Max(0, secondsPerItem * progress.Remaining);
        TimeSpan remaining = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(remainingSeconds);

        if (remaining.TotalHours >= 1)
            return $"{(int)remaining.TotalHours}h {remaining.Minutes}m";

        if (remaining.TotalMinutes >= 1)
            return $"{remaining.Minutes}m {remaining.Seconds}s";

        return $"{remaining.Seconds}s";
    }

    private void CancelSrScanner()
    {
        _srScannerCts?.Cancel();
        _lblSrScannerProgress.Text = _autoReadyWatchRunning
            ? "AUTO_READY watch: cancellation requested. Waiting for current safe step to finish..."
            : "SR smart 1h scanner: cancellation requested. Waiting for current symbol to finish safely...";
    }

    private static List<string> LoadQ2TestnetSymbols()
    {
        List<string> fromReports = TryReadCoinListFile(Q2ReportsCoinListPath);
        if (fromReports.Count > 0)
            return fromReports;

        List<string> fromConfig = TryReadCoinListFile(Q2ConfigCoinListPath);
        if (fromConfig.Count > 0)
            return fromConfig;

        return FallbackQ2PrioritySymbols
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
            .Select(NormalizeSymbol)
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();
    }

    private static List<string> TryReadCoinListFile(string filePath)
    {
        try
        {
            if (!File.Exists(filePath))
                return new List<string>();

            return File.ReadAllLines(filePath)
                .Select(x => x.Trim())
                .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
                .Where(x => !x.StartsWith("#", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                .Where(x => !x.StartsWith("File:", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                .Where(x => !x.StartsWith("Updated:", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                .Where(x => !x.StartsWith("Selected:", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                .Where(x => !x.StartsWith("---", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                .Select(NormalizeSymbol)
                .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();
        }
        catch
        {
            return new List<string>();
        }
    }

    private static string NormalizeSymbol(string value)
    {
        string symbol = (value ?? string.Empty).Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
        return symbol.EndsWith("USDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? symbol : string.Empty;
    }

    private static void WriteTestnetQ2CoinFile(IReadOnlyList<string> symbols)
    {
        try
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(TestnetSelectedQ2Path) ?? @"D:\D DATA BACKUP\Data\Reports\SR_CONFIG_PROFILES");
            var lines = new List<string>
            {
                "# TESTNET SELECTED Q2 COINS",
                "# Auto-written by BinanceTestnetOrderForm.",
                "# All testnet scan/watch/auto-execute operations are locked to these Q2 symbols only.",
                $"# Updated local : {DateTime.Now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} {TimeZoneInfo.Local.StandardName}",
                $"# Updated UTC   : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}",
                $"# Count         : {symbols.Count}",
                string.Empty
            };
            lines.AddRange(symbols);
            File.WriteAllLines(TestnetSelectedQ2Path, lines, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        }
        catch
        {
            // Never block the testnet UI just because the audit list file could not be written.
        }
    }

    private IReadOnlyList<string> EnforceQ2TestnetScope(string reason)
    {
        List<string> q2Symbols = LoadQ2TestnetSymbols();
        if (q2Symbols.Count == 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Q2 testnet symbol list is empty. Press Q2 in MainForm first or recreate Q2 load coins.txt.");

        _txtScannerSymbols.Text = string.Join(",", q2Symbols);
        _txtSymbol.Text = q2Symbols[0];
        _numMaxAutoTrades.Value = Math.Min(_numMaxAutoTrades.Maximum, Math.Max(_numMaxAutoTrades.Minimum, q2Symbols.Count));
        WriteTestnetQ2CoinFile(q2Symbols);
        _lblSrScannerProgress.Text = $"Q2 TESTNET LOCK: {q2Symbols.Count} symbols | Max Open {_numMaxAutoTrades.Value} | {reason}";
        return q2Symbols;
    }

    private async Task BuildSrShadowMarketScannerAsync()
    {
        SetBusy(true);
        _srScannerCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        _srScannerStartedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        _btnCancelSrScanner.Enabled = true;
        try
        {
            IReadOnlyList<string> q2Symbols = EnforceQ2TestnetScope("SR SMART 1H SCAN");
            using var context = CreateContext();
            var service = new TestnetOrderExecutionService(
                context.AccountClient,
                context.AccountClient,
                context.OrderClient,
                new LiveOrderExecutionReportService());

            var request = new SrShadowMarketScannerRequest
            {
                Symbols = q2Symbols,
                Timeframe = CleanTimeframe(),
                TradeSizeUsdt = _numTradeSize.Value,
                MaxTradeSizeUsdt = _numMaxTradeSize.Value,
                Leverage = (int)_numLeverage.Value,
                SpeedMode = true,
                StopWhenAutoReady = true
            };

            ResetSrScannerProgress();
            var progress = new Progress<SrScannerProgress>(UpdateSrScannerProgress);

            SrShadowMarketScannerResult result = await new SrShadowMarketScannerService()
                .ScanAsync(request, service, _srScannerCts.Token, progress);

            _txtOutput.Text = new SrShadowMarketScannerReportService().BuildReport(result);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            _txtOutput.Text = "SR SMART 1H SCANNER CANCELLED BY USER" + Environment.NewLine +
                              "No order was sent. Partial progress was stopped safely.";
            _lblSrScannerProgress.Text = "SR speed scanner: cancelled by user. NO ORDER SENT.";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _txtOutput.Text = "SR SMART 1H MARKET SCANNER FAILED" + Environment.NewLine + ex;
        }
        finally
        {
            _btnCancelSrScanner.Enabled = false;
            _srScannerCts?.Dispose();
            _srScannerCts = null;
            SetBusy(false);
        }
    }


    private async Task RunAutoReadyWatchModeAsync()
    {
        if (MessageBox.Show(
                "Start V8.10.4 PARALLEL FRESH-FIRST 1H AUTO_READY watch mode?" + Environment.NewLine + Environment.NewLine +
                "This will repeatedly run Button 18 1h candle audit, then SR smart 1h scan until AUTO_READY_SHADOW_ONLY appears or you press CANCEL." + Environment.NewLine +
                "No order will be sent.",
                "Start AUTO_READY Watch Mode",
                MessageBoxButtons.YesNo,
                MessageBoxIcon.Information) != DialogResult.Yes)
        {
            return;
        }

        SetBusy(true);
        _autoReadyWatchRunning = true;
        _srScannerCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        _srScannerStartedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        _btnCancelSrScanner.Enabled = true;
        _barSrScannerProgress.Value = 0;
        _lblSrScannerProgress.Text = "AUTO_READY watch: starting cycle 1. Button 18 1h audit will run first.";

        var watchLog = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        watchLog.AppendLine("TQGA V8.10.4 MAINNET-vs-TESTNET PRICE AUDIT 1H AUTO_READY WATCH MODE - SHADOW ONLY");
        watchLog.AppendLine("============================================================");
        watchLog.AppendLine($"Started UTC          : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        watchLog.AppendLine("Mode                 : Button 18 fast delta 1h audit + SR verify-only candidate-first smart 1h scan until AUTO_READY_SHADOW_ONLY");
        watchLog.AppendLine("Order Sent           : NO");
        watchLog.AppendLine("Live Trading         : BLOCKED / NOT IMPLEMENTED");
        watchLog.AppendLine();

        SrShadowMarketScannerResult? lastScanResult = null;
        int cycle = 0;

        try
        {
            IReadOnlyList<string> q2Symbols = EnforceQ2TestnetScope("WATCH AUTO_READY 1H");
            using var context = CreateContext();
            var service = new TestnetOrderExecutionService(
                context.AccountClient,
                context.AccountClient,
                context.OrderClient,
                new LiveOrderExecutionReportService());

            while (!_srScannerCts.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                cycle++;
                watchLog.AppendLine($"WATCH CYCLE {cycle}");
                watchLog.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
                watchLog.AppendLine($"Cycle Start UTC      : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
                _txtOutput.Text = watchLog.ToString();

                if (!TrySkipQ2Button18CandleAudit($"TESTNET WATCH AUTO_READY 1H CYCLE {cycle}", q2Symbols, watchLog))
                {
                    var candleProgress = new Progress<Top200CandleUpdateProgress>(p => UpdateAutoReadyWatchCandleProgress(cycle, p));
                    Top200CandleUpdateResult candleResult = await new Top200CandleUpdateService()
                        .UpdateSelectedSymbolsOneHourOnlyAsync(q2Symbols, _srScannerCts.Token, candleProgress);

                    watchLog.AppendLine($"Button 18 Result     : {(candleResult.Success ? "PASS" : "CHECK")}");
                    watchLog.AppendLine($"Button 18 Markets    : {candleResult.MarketsFresh}/{candleResult.MarketsRequested} fresh");
                    watchLog.AppendLine($"Audit Files          : {candleResult.CurrentUniverseFilesFound}/{candleResult.CurrentUniverseExpectedFiles}");
                    watchLog.AppendLine($"Audit Missing        : {candleResult.CurrentUniverseFilesMissing}");
                    watchLog.AppendLine($"Audit Orphan         : {candleResult.OrphanCandleFiles}");
                    watchLog.AppendLine($"Button 18 Report     : {candleResult.ReportPath}");
                    _txtOutput.Text = watchLog.ToString();
                }

                var request = new SrShadowMarketScannerRequest
                {
                    Symbols = q2Symbols,
                    Timeframe = CleanTimeframe(),
                    TradeSizeUsdt = _numTradeSize.Value,
                    MaxTradeSizeUsdt = _numMaxTradeSize.Value,
                    Leverage = (int)_numLeverage.Value,
                    SpeedMode = true,
                    StopWhenAutoReady = true
                };

                _srScannerStartedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
                var scannerProgress = new Progress<SrScannerProgress>(p => UpdateAutoReadyWatchScannerProgress(cycle, p));
                lastScanResult = await new SrShadowMarketScannerService()
                    .ScanAsync(request, service, _srScannerCts.Token, scannerProgress);

                watchLog.AppendLine($"Scanner Result       : {(lastScanResult.Success ? "PASS" : "CHECK")}");
                watchLog.AppendLine($"Auto Ready Signals   : {lastScanResult.AutoReadySignals}");
                watchLog.AppendLine($"Symbols Scanned      : {lastScanResult.SymbolsScanned}");
                watchLog.AppendLine($"Stop Reason          : {lastScanResult.StopReason}");
                watchLog.AppendLine($"Scanner Report       : {lastScanResult.ReportPath}");
                watchLog.AppendLine();

                if (lastScanResult.AutoReadySignals > 0)
                {
                    _barSrScannerProgress.Value = 100;
                    _lblSrScannerProgress.Text = "AUTO_READY watch: AUTO_READY_SHADOW_ONLY found. Watch stopped. NO ORDER SENT.";
                    _txtOutput.Text = watchLog.ToString() + Environment.NewLine + new SrShadowMarketScannerReportService().BuildReport(lastScanResult);
                    MessageBox.Show(
                        "AUTO_READY_SHADOW_ONLY found." + Environment.NewLine + Environment.NewLine +
                        "Watch mode stopped. No order was sent. Review the scanner report before any V8.10.4 testnet auto-execution step.",
                        "AUTO_READY Found - No Order Sent",
                        MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                        MessageBoxIcon.Information);
                    return;
                }

                DateTime nextRunUtc = GetNextOneHourCandleWatchRunUtc(DateTime.UtcNow);
                watchLog.AppendLine($"No AUTO_READY        : Waiting for next 1h candle close + 75 seconds");
                watchLog.AppendLine($"Next Cycle UTC       : {nextRunUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
                watchLog.AppendLine();
                _txtOutput.Text = watchLog.ToString();

                await WaitUntilUtcAsync(nextRunUtc, cycle, _srScannerCts.Token);
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            watchLog.AppendLine();
            watchLog.AppendLine("WATCH CANCELLED BY USER");
            watchLog.AppendLine("Order Sent           : NO");
            _txtOutput.Text = watchLog.ToString();
            _lblSrScannerProgress.Text = "AUTO_READY watch: cancelled by user. NO ORDER SENT.";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            watchLog.AppendLine();
            watchLog.AppendLine("WATCH FAILED");
            watchLog.AppendLine(ex.ToString());
            watchLog.AppendLine("Order Sent           : NO");
            _txtOutput.Text = watchLog.ToString();
            _lblSrScannerProgress.Text = "AUTO_READY watch: failed. NO ORDER SENT.";
        }
        finally
        {
            _autoReadyWatchRunning = false;
            _btnCancelSrScanner.Enabled = false;
            _srScannerCts?.Dispose();
            _srScannerCts = null;
            SetBusy(false);
        }
    }


    private async Task RunOneShotAutoExecutionModeAsync()
    {
        if (!ConfirmDangerousTestnetAction(
                "TESTNET AUTO-EXECUTE MAX MODE.\n\n" +
                "TQGA will scan ONLY the symbols in the Q2 locked Scan Symbols box and can place TESTNET protected entries up to the Max Open limit. Each entry still uses the protected SL/TP lifecycle and testnet-only service.\n\n" +
                "Do not use live keys. Live trading is blocked. Continue?"))
        {
            return;
        }

        SetBusy(true);
        _autoReadyWatchRunning = true;
        _srScannerCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        _srScannerStartedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        _btnCancelSrScanner.Enabled = true;
        _barSrScannerProgress.Value = 0;
        int maxAutoTrades = Math.Max(1, (int)_numMaxAutoTrades.Value);
        var executedSymbols = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        _lblSrScannerProgress.Text = $"Testnet auto-execute max: starting Button 18 1h audit. Max open/executions this run: {maxAutoTrades}.";

        var watchLog = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        watchLog.AppendLine("TQGA TESTNET AUTO-EXECUTE MAX - Q2 COINS ONLY");
        watchLog.AppendLine("============================================================");
        watchLog.AppendLine($"Started UTC          : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        watchLog.AppendLine("Mode                 : Button 18 fast delta 1h audit + selected-symbol SR scan + protected testnet entries up to Max Open");
        watchLog.AppendLine("Execution Scope      : TESTNET ONLY");
        watchLog.AppendLine("Live Trading         : BLOCKED / NOT IMPLEMENTED");
        watchLog.AppendLine($"Q2 Locked Symbols   : {_txtScannerSymbols.Text}");
        watchLog.AppendLine($"Max Auto/Open Trades : {maxAutoTrades}");
        watchLog.AppendLine("Safety               : protected SL/TP lifecycle remains active; duplicate symbol/open-order blocks remain in service layer");
        watchLog.AppendLine();

        int cycle = 0;

        try
        {
            IReadOnlyList<string> q2Symbols = EnforceQ2TestnetScope("AUTO EXECUTE MAX");
            maxAutoTrades = Math.Min(maxAutoTrades, q2Symbols.Count);
            _numMaxAutoTrades.Value = Math.Min(_numMaxAutoTrades.Maximum, Math.Max(_numMaxAutoTrades.Minimum, maxAutoTrades));

            using var context = CreateContext();
            var service = new TestnetOrderExecutionService(
                context.AccountClient,
                context.AccountClient,
                context.OrderClient,
                new LiveOrderExecutionReportService());

            while (!_srScannerCts.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                cycle++;
                watchLog.AppendLine($"WATCH / EXECUTION CYCLE {cycle}");
                watchLog.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
                watchLog.AppendLine($"Cycle Start UTC      : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
                _txtOutput.Text = watchLog.ToString();

                if (!TrySkipQ2Button18CandleAudit($"TESTNET WATCH AUTO_READY 1H CYCLE {cycle}", q2Symbols, watchLog))
                {
                    var candleProgress = new Progress<Top200CandleUpdateProgress>(p => UpdateAutoReadyWatchCandleProgress(cycle, p));
                    Top200CandleUpdateResult candleResult = await new Top200CandleUpdateService()
                        .UpdateSelectedSymbolsOneHourOnlyAsync(q2Symbols, _srScannerCts.Token, candleProgress);

                    watchLog.AppendLine($"Button 18 Result     : {(candleResult.Success ? "PASS" : "CHECK")}");
                    watchLog.AppendLine($"Button 18 Markets    : {candleResult.MarketsFresh}/{candleResult.MarketsRequested} fresh");
                    watchLog.AppendLine($"Audit Files          : {candleResult.CurrentUniverseFilesFound}/{candleResult.CurrentUniverseExpectedFiles}");
                    watchLog.AppendLine($"Audit Missing        : {candleResult.CurrentUniverseFilesMissing}");
                    watchLog.AppendLine($"Audit Orphan         : {candleResult.OrphanCandleFiles}");
                    watchLog.AppendLine($"Button 18 Report     : {candleResult.ReportPath}");
                    _txtOutput.Text = watchLog.ToString();
                }

                var request = new SrShadowMarketScannerRequest
                {
                    Symbols = q2Symbols,
                    Timeframe = CleanTimeframe(),
                    TradeSizeUsdt = _numTradeSize.Value,
                    MaxTradeSizeUsdt = _numMaxTradeSize.Value,
                    Leverage = (int)_numLeverage.Value,
                    SpeedMode = true,
                    StopWhenAutoReady = true
                };

                _srScannerStartedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
                var scannerProgress = new Progress<SrScannerProgress>(p => UpdateAutoReadyWatchScannerProgress(cycle, p));
                SrShadowMarketScannerResult scanResult = await new SrShadowMarketScannerService()
                    .ScanAsync(request, service, _srScannerCts.Token, scannerProgress);

                watchLog.AppendLine($"Scanner Result       : {(scanResult.Success ? "PASS" : "CHECK")}");
                watchLog.AppendLine($"Auto Ready Signals   : {scanResult.AutoReadySignals}");
                watchLog.AppendLine($"Symbols Scanned      : {scanResult.SymbolsScanned}");
                watchLog.AppendLine($"Stop Reason          : {scanResult.StopReason}");
                watchLog.AppendLine($"Scanner Report       : {scanResult.ReportPath}");
                watchLog.AppendLine();

                if (scanResult.AutoReadySignals > 0)
                {
                    foreach (SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate candidate in EnumerateAutoReadyExecutionCandidates(scanResult))
                    {
                        if (executedSymbols.Count >= maxAutoTrades)
                            break;

                        string candidateSymbol = candidate.Symbol.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
                        if (executedSymbols.Contains(candidateSymbol))
                            continue;

                        try
                        {
                            ValidateOneShotExecutionCandidate(candidate);
                            RememberLastAutoExecutedSymbol(candidate.Symbol);

                            watchLog.AppendLine("AUTO_READY EXECUTION CANDIDATE");
                            watchLog.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"Symbol               : {candidate.Symbol}");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"Symbol Field Updated : {_txtSymbol.Text}");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"Direction            : {candidate.SrDirection}");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"Exchange Side        : {candidate.IntendedSide}");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"Signal Age Candles   : {candidate.SignalAgeCandles}");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"Entry Drift %        : {FormatNullable(candidate.EntryDriftPercent)}");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"Current R/R          : {FormatNullable(candidate.CurrentRewardRiskRatio)}");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"Price Source Status  : {candidate.PriceSourceStatus}");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"Mainnet/Testnet Drift: {FormatNullable(candidate.TestnetVsMainnetDriftPercent)}%");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"Account Clean        : {(candidate.AccountCleanGatePassed ? "PASS" : "FAIL")}");
                            watchLog.AppendLine("Pre-Order Recheck    : PASS - scanner gates are still clean at execution handoff");
                            watchLog.AppendLine();

                            TestnetOrderExecutionRequest executionRequest = BuildOneShotExecutionRequest(candidate);
                            watchLog.AppendLine("TESTNET PROTECTED ORDER EXECUTION");
                            watchLog.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"Action               : placing TESTNET entry + SL + TP ({executedSymbols.Count + 1}/{maxAutoTrades})");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"Trade Size USDT      : {executionRequest.TradeSizeUsdt:F2}");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"Max Size USDT        : {executionRequest.MaxTradeSizeUsdt:F2}");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"Leverage             : {executionRequest.Leverage}x");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"SL %                 : {executionRequest.StopLossPercent:F4}");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"TP %                 : {executionRequest.TakeProfitPercent:F4}");
                            _txtOutput.Text = watchLog.ToString();

                            LiveOrderExecutionResult execution = await service.PlaceEntryWithProtectionAsync(
                                executionRequest,
                                _srScannerCts.Token);

                            string executionReport = new LiveOrderExecutionReportService().BuildReport(execution);
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"Execution Result     : {(execution.Success ? "PASS" : "CHECK")}");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"Execution Message    : {execution.Message}");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"Execution Report     : {execution.ReportPath}");
                            watchLog.AppendLine();

                            if (execution.Success)
                                executedSymbols.Add(candidateSymbol);

                            watchLog.AppendLine("AUTO-RECONCILE EXECUTED SYMBOL");
                            watchLog.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"Reconcile Symbol     : {executionRequest.Symbol}");
                            watchLog.AppendLine("Reason               : use executed symbol, not default/manual BTCUSDT textbox state");
                            _txtOutput.Text = watchLog.ToString();

                            LiveTradeReconciliationResult reconciliation = await service.ReconcileSymbolAsync(
                                executionRequest.Symbol,
                                _srScannerCts.Token);
                            string reconciliationReport = new LiveTradeReconciliationReportService().BuildReport(reconciliation);
                            watchLog.AppendLine("Auto-Reconcile       : COMPLETED");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"Executed Count       : {executedSymbols.Count}/{maxAutoTrades}");
                            watchLog.AppendLine();

                            _txtOutput.Text =
                                watchLog.ToString() +
                                Environment.NewLine +
                                new SrShadowMarketScannerReportService().BuildReport(scanResult) +
                                Environment.NewLine +
                                executionReport +
                                Environment.NewLine +
                                reconciliationReport;
                        }
                        catch (Exception candidateEx)
                        {
                            watchLog.AppendLine("CANDIDATE EXECUTION SKIPPED / FAILED");
                            watchLog.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
                            watchLog.AppendLine($"Symbol               : {candidate.Symbol}");
                            watchLog.AppendLine(candidateEx.Message);
                            watchLog.AppendLine();
                            _txtOutput.Text = watchLog.ToString();
                        }
                    }

                    if (executedSymbols.Count >= maxAutoTrades)
                    {
                        _barSrScannerProgress.Value = 100;
                        _lblSrScannerProgress.Text = $"Testnet auto-execute max complete: {executedSymbols.Count}/{maxAutoTrades} protected entries attempted/executed.";
                        MessageBox.Show(
                            $"Testnet auto-execute max complete.\n\nExecuted/protected symbols this run: {executedSymbols.Count}/{maxAutoTrades}\n{string.Join(", ", executedSymbols)}\n\nReview every execution and reconciliation report before continuing.",
                            "Testnet Auto-Execute Max Complete",
                            MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                            MessageBoxIcon.Information);
                        return;
                    }
                }

                DateTime nextRunUtc = GetNextOneHourCandleWatchRunUtc(DateTime.UtcNow);
                watchLog.AppendLine("No AUTO_READY        : Waiting for next 1h candle close + 75 seconds");
                watchLog.AppendLine($"Next Cycle UTC       : {nextRunUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
                watchLog.AppendLine();
                _txtOutput.Text = watchLog.ToString();

                await WaitUntilUtcAsync(nextRunUtc, cycle, _srScannerCts.Token);
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            watchLog.AppendLine();
            watchLog.AppendLine("TESTNET AUTO-EXECUTE MAX CANCELLED BY USER");
            watchLog.AppendLine("If cancellation occurred before order placement, no order was sent.");
            _txtOutput.Text = watchLog.ToString();
            _lblSrScannerProgress.Text = "Testnet auto-execute max: cancelled by user.";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            watchLog.AppendLine();
            watchLog.AppendLine("TESTNET AUTO-EXECUTE MAX FAILED");
            watchLog.AppendLine(ex.ToString());
            _txtOutput.Text = watchLog.ToString();
            _lblSrScannerProgress.Text = "Testnet auto-execute max failed. Run SYNC/RECONCILE/CLOSE ALL if any testnet order state is uncertain.";
        }
        finally
        {
            _autoReadyWatchRunning = false;
            _btnCancelSrScanner.Enabled = false;
            _srScannerCts?.Dispose();
            _srScannerCts = null;
            SetBusy(false);
        }
    }

    private static IReadOnlyList<SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate> EnumerateAutoReadyExecutionCandidates(SrShadowMarketScannerResult result)
    {
        var output = new List<SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate>();

        if (result.BestCandidate?.AutoReady == true)
            output.Add(result.BestCandidate);

        if (result.NearestAutoReadyCandidate?.AutoReady == true &&
            !output.Any(x => x.Symbol.Equals(result.NearestAutoReadyCandidate.Symbol, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
        {
            output.Add(result.NearestAutoReadyCandidate);
        }

        foreach (SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate candidate in result.Candidates)
        {
            bool isReady =
                candidate.AutoReady ||
                candidate.Decision.Equals("AUTO_READY_SHADOW_ONLY", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                candidate.AutoReadinessStatus.Equals("AUTO_READY_SHADOW_ONLY", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

            if (!isReady)
                continue;

            if (output.Any(x => x.Symbol.Equals(candidate.Symbol, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                continue;

            output.Add(candidate);
        }

        return output;
    }

    private SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate ResolveAutoReadyExecutionCandidate(SrShadowMarketScannerResult result)
    {
        SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate? candidate = null;

        if (result.BestCandidate?.AutoReady == true)
            candidate = result.BestCandidate;
        else if (result.NearestAutoReadyCandidate?.AutoReady == true)
            candidate = result.NearestAutoReadyCandidate;
        else
            candidate = result.Candidates.FirstOrDefault(x =>
                x.AutoReady ||
                x.Decision.Equals("AUTO_READY_SHADOW_ONLY", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                x.AutoReadinessStatus.Equals("AUTO_READY_SHADOW_ONLY", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

        return candidate ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("AUTO_READY signal count is positive, but no AUTO_READY candidate object was found.");
    }

    private void ValidateOneShotExecutionCandidate(SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate candidate)
    {
        if (!candidate.AutoReady)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Blocked: candidate is not AutoReady.");

        if (!candidate.Decision.Equals("AUTO_READY_SHADOW_ONLY", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
            !candidate.AutoReadinessStatus.Equals("AUTO_READY_SHADOW_ONLY", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Blocked: candidate does not have AUTO_READY_SHADOW_ONLY status.");
        }

        if (candidate.AutoReadinessMissingGateCount != 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Blocked: candidate still has {candidate.AutoReadinessMissingGateCount} missing gate(s).");

        if (!candidate.AgeGatePassed || !candidate.DriftGatePassed || !candidate.CurrentRrGatePassed)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Blocked: age/drift/RR gates are not all PASS at execution handoff.");

        if (!candidate.AccountCleanGatePassed || !candidate.CandleFreshnessGatePassed || !candidate.ExchangeShadowGatePassed)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Blocked: account/candle/exchange shadow gates are not all PASS.");

        if (!candidate.PriceSourceGatePassed)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Blocked: mainnet/testnet price compatibility gate failed.");

        if (candidate.IntendedSide != ExchangeOrderSide.Buy && candidate.IntendedSide != ExchangeOrderSide.Sell)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Blocked: candidate intended side is invalid.");

        if (!candidate.SrStopLossPercent.HasValue || candidate.SrStopLossPercent.Value <= 0m)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Blocked: candidate SL percent is missing or invalid.");

        if (!candidate.SrTakeProfitPercent.HasValue || candidate.SrTakeProfitPercent.Value <= 0m)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Blocked: candidate TP percent is missing or invalid.");

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(candidate.Symbol))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Blocked: candidate symbol is empty.");
    }

    private TestnetOrderExecutionRequest BuildOneShotExecutionRequest(SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate candidate)
    {
        decimal slPercent = ClampDecimal(candidate.SrStopLossPercent ?? _numStopLossPct.Value, 0.05m, 50m);
        decimal tpPercent = ClampDecimal(candidate.SrTakeProfitPercent ?? _numTakeProfitPct.Value, 0.05m, 100m);

        return new TestnetOrderExecutionRequest
        {
            Mode = ExchangeMode.BinanceTestnetTrade,
            Symbol = candidate.Symbol.Trim().ToUpperInvariant(),
            Side = candidate.IntendedSide,
            TradeSizeUsdt = _numTradeSize.Value,
            MaxTradeSizeUsdt = _numMaxTradeSize.Value,
            Leverage = (int)_numLeverage.Value,
            StopLossPercent = slPercent,
            TakeProfitPercent = tpPercent,
            RequireNoExistingPosition = true,
            RequireNoOpenOrders = true
        };
    }

    private static decimal ClampDecimal(decimal value, decimal min, decimal max)
    {
        if (value < min)
            return min;
        if (value > max)
            return value > max ? max : value;
        return value;
    }

    private static string FormatNullable(decimal? value)
    {
        return value.HasValue ? value.Value.ToString("F4") : "N/A";
    }


    private void UpdateAutoReadyWatchCandleProgress(int cycle, Top200CandleUpdateProgress progress)
    {
        _barSrScannerProgress.Value = Math.Max(_barSrScannerProgress.Minimum, Math.Min(_barSrScannerProgress.Maximum, progress.Percent));
        string last = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(progress.CurrentSymbol)
            ? string.Empty
            : $" | Last: {progress.CurrentSymbol} {progress.CurrentTimeframe}";

        _lblSrScannerProgress.Text =
            $"AUTO_READY 1h watch cycle {cycle}: Button 18 {progress.Stage} {progress.Percent}% ({progress.Current}/{progress.Total}, left {progress.Remaining}) | Fresh {progress.Fresh}, Check {progress.Check}, Updated {progress.UpdatedFiles}, Downloaded {progress.DownloadedCandles}{last}";
    }

    private void UpdateAutoReadyWatchScannerProgress(int cycle, SrScannerProgress progress)
    {
        _barSrScannerProgress.Value = Math.Max(_barSrScannerProgress.Minimum, Math.Min(_barSrScannerProgress.Maximum, progress.Percent));
        string item = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(progress.CurrentSymbol)
            ? string.Empty
            : $" | Last: {progress.CurrentSymbol}";

        string eta = BuildSrScannerEta(progress);
        _lblSrScannerProgress.Text =
            $"AUTO_READY 1h watch cycle {cycle}: SR scan {progress.Stage} {progress.Percent}% ({progress.Current}/{progress.Total}, left {progress.Remaining}, ETA {eta}) | Rule OK {progress.RuleValidated}, Signals {progress.Signals}, Eligible {progress.Eligible}, Auto {progress.AutoReady}{item}";
    }

    private async Task WaitUntilUtcAsync(DateTime targetUtc, int cycle, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        while (DateTime.UtcNow < targetUtc)
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            TimeSpan left = targetUtc - DateTime.UtcNow;
            _barSrScannerProgress.Value = 0;
            _lblSrScannerProgress.Text = $"AUTO_READY 1h watch: cycle {cycle} finished with no auto-ready. Waiting {FormatDuration(left)} until next 1h candle check at {targetUtc:HH:mm:ss} UTC. Press CANCEL to stop.";
            await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Min(30, Math.Max(1, left.TotalSeconds))), ct);
        }
    }

    private static DateTime GetNextOneHourCandleWatchRunUtc(DateTime nowUtc)
    {
        var baseHour = new DateTime(nowUtc.Year, nowUtc.Month, nowUtc.Day, nowUtc.Hour, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        DateTime next = baseHour.AddHours(1).AddSeconds(75);
        if (next <= nowUtc)
            next = next.AddHours(1);
        return next;
    }

    private static string FormatDuration(TimeSpan value)
    {
        if (value.TotalHours >= 1)
            return $"{(int)value.TotalHours}h {value.Minutes}m";
        if (value.TotalMinutes >= 1)
            return $"{value.Minutes}m {value.Seconds}s";
        return $"{Math.Max(0, value.Seconds)}s";
    }

    private async Task ReconcileTradeAsync()
    {
        SetBusy(true);
        try
        {
            using var context = CreateContext();
            var service = new TestnetOrderExecutionService(
                context.AccountClient,
                context.AccountClient,
                context.OrderClient,
                new LiveOrderExecutionReportService());

            string symbol = CleanSymbolForPostExecutionAction();
            LiveTradeReconciliationResult result = await service.ReconcileSymbolAsync(symbol, CancellationToken.None);
            _txtOutput.Text = new LiveTradeReconciliationReportService().BuildReport(result);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _txtOutput.Text = "RECONCILIATION FAILED" + Environment.NewLine + ex;
        }
        finally
        {
            SetBusy(false);
        }
    }

    private BinanceClientContext CreateContext()
    {
        var credentials = ReadCredentialsFromTextBoxes();

        if (!credentials.HasKeys)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("API key and Secret key are required. Use Binance Futures Testnet API key. Do not use live key here.");
        }

        var options = BinanceEndpointOptions.FuturesTestnetTrade();
        var accountHttp = new HttpClient();
        var orderHttp = new HttpClient();
        var accountClient = new BinanceFuturesRestClient(accountHttp, credentials, options, ownsHttpClient: true);
        var orderClient = new BinanceFuturesOrderClient(orderHttp, credentials, options, ownsHttpClient: true);
        return new BinanceClientContext(accountClient, orderClient);
    }

    private void RememberLastAutoExecutedSymbol(string symbol)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol))
            return;

        _lastAutoExecutedSymbol = symbol.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
        _txtSymbol.Text = _lastAutoExecutedSymbol;
    }

    private string CleanSymbolForPostExecutionAction()
    {
        string symbol = CleanSymbol();

        // Safety: after AUTO EXECUTE MAX, manual follow-up buttons such as
        // RECONCILE TRADE, CLOSE POSITION + VERIFY, CANCEL OPEN ORDERS, and TRADE JOURNAL
        // must stay on the executed market instead of accidentally falling back to BTCUSDT.
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_lastAutoExecutedSymbol) &&
            symbol.Equals("BTCUSDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            _txtSymbol.Text = _lastAutoExecutedSymbol;
            return _lastAutoExecutedSymbol;
        }

        return symbol;
    }

    private string CleanSymbol()
    {
        string symbol = _txtSymbol.Text.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Symbol is required.");
        return symbol;
    }

    private string CleanTimeframe()
    {
        // V8.10.3T: Parallel Fresh-First Watch is intentionally 1h-only for speed.
        // 4h and 1d scanner modes are removed from this fast branch.
        _txtTimeframe.Text = "1h";
        return "1h";
    }

    private IReadOnlyList<string> CleanScannerSymbols()
    {
        // TESTNET safety lock: never scan ALL and never scan arbitrary textbox symbols.
        // Every testnet scanner/watch/auto-execute path uses Q2 priority coins only.
        return EnforceQ2TestnetScope("CleanScannerSymbols safety lock");
    }

    private static bool ConfirmDangerousTestnetAction(string text)
    {
        return MessageBox.Show(
            text + Environment.NewLine + Environment.NewLine + "Mode is TESTNET ONLY. Live trading is not implemented.",
            "Confirm Testnet Action",
            MessageBoxButtons.YesNo,
            MessageBoxIcon.Warning) == DialogResult.Yes;
    }

    private void SetBusy(bool busy)
    {
        bool enabled = !busy;
        _btnSync.Enabled = enabled;
        _btnPlace.Enabled = enabled;
        _btnCancel.Enabled = enabled;
        _btnClose.Enabled = enabled;
        _btnReconcile.Enabled = enabled;
        _btnCloseAll.Enabled = enabled;
        _btnJournal.Enabled = enabled;
        _btnShadow.Enabled = enabled;
        _btnSrShadow.Enabled = enabled;
        _btnSrScanner.Enabled = enabled;
        _btnAutoReadyWatch.Enabled = enabled;
        _btnAutoExecuteOneShot.Enabled = enabled;
        _btnCancelSrScanner.Enabled = false;
        _btnSaveKeys.Enabled = enabled;
        _btnClearKeys.Enabled = enabled;
    }

    private static string BuildSimpleOrderResults(string title, IEnumerable<LiveOrderResult> results)
    {
        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("TQGA V8.10.4A BINANCE TESTNET ORDER ACTION");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine(title);
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        foreach (LiveOrderResult r in results)
        {
            sb.AppendLine($"Success   : {r.Success}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Message   : {r.Message}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Symbol    : {r.Symbol}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Order ID  : {r.OrderId}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Client ID : {r.ClientOrderId}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Status    : {r.Status}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Side/Type : {r.Side} / {r.Type}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Qty       : {r.OriginalQuantity:F8}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Exec Qty  : {r.ExecutedQuantity:F8}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Avg Price : {r.AveragePrice:F8}");
            sb.AppendLine($"StopPrice : {r.StopPrice:F8}");
            sb.AppendLine();
        }
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private sealed class BinanceClientContext : IDisposable
    {
        public BinanceFuturesRestClient AccountClient { get; }
        public BinanceFuturesOrderClient OrderClient { get; }

        public BinanceClientContext(BinanceFuturesRestClient accountClient, BinanceFuturesOrderClient orderClient)
        {
            AccountClient = accountClient;
            OrderClient = orderClient;
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            AccountClient.Dispose();
            OrderClient.Dispose();
        }
    }
}

    public static string Build(LiveAccountSnapshot snapshot, string reportPath)
    {
        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("TQGA V8.10.4A BINANCE TESTNET SYNC CHECK");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Mode                  : {snapshot.Mode}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Health                : {(snapshot.IsHealthy ? "PASS" : "CHECK")}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Message               : {snapshot.HealthMessage}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Snapshot UTC          : {snapshot.SnapshotUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Wallet USDT           : {snapshot.WalletUsdt:F4}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Available USDT        : {snapshot.AvailableUsdt:F4}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Unrealized PnL USDT   : {snapshot.UnrealizedPnlUsdt:F4}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Open Positions        : {snapshot.OpenPositionCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Open Orders           : {snapshot.OpenOrderCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Recent Fills          : {snapshot.RecentFills.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Symbol Rules          : {snapshot.SymbolRules.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Path           : {reportPath}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("OPEN POSITIONS");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        var openPositions = snapshot.Positions.Where(x => x.IsOpen).ToList();
        if (openPositions.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("No open positions.");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (var p in openPositions)
                sb.AppendLine($"{p.Symbol,-12} {p.PositionSide,-5} Amt={p.PositionAmount:F8} Entry={p.EntryPrice:F8} Mark={p.MarkPrice:F8} UPnL={p.UnrealizedProfit:F4} Lev={(p.Leverage > 0 ? p.Leverage.ToString() : "?")}x Liq={(p.LiquidationPrice > 0m ? p.LiquidationPrice.ToString("F8") : "N/A")}");
        }
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("OPEN ORDERS");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        if (snapshot.OpenOrders.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("No open orders.");
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (var o in snapshot.OpenOrders)
                sb.AppendLine($"{o.Symbol,-12} Id={o.OrderId} {o.Side} {o.Type} {o.Status} Price={o.Price:F8} Stop={o.StopPrice:F8} Qty={o.OriginalQuantity:F8} ReduceOnly={o.ReduceOnly}");
        }
        if (snapshot.Errors.Count > 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine("ERRORS / WARNINGS");
            sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
            foreach (string error in snapshot.Errors)
                sb.AppendLine("- " + error);
        }
        return sb.ToString();
    }
}

using System;
