using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Domain.Market;

namespace TQGA.WinForms;

internal static class MoreTunningReportPaths
{
    public const string Button13ReportFolder = @"D:\D DATA BACKUP\Data\Reports";
}

internal sealed record FindBestEdgeRequest(
    string Symbol,
    string Timeframe,
    DateTime StartUtc,
    DateTime EndUtcExclusive,
    List<Candle> Candles,
    SrTradeBacktestSettings SeedSettings,
    string ProfileName,
    int MaxTries);

internal sealed record FindBestEdgeProgress(
    int Completed,
    int Total,
    string CurrentTest,
    string BestSoFar,
    TimeSpan Elapsed,
    TimeSpan EstimatedRemaining);

internal sealed record FindBestEdgeMetrics(
    int PlacedTrades,
    int ClosedTrades,
    int Wins,
    int Losses,
    decimal WinRate,
    decimal NetR,
    decimal EdgeR,
    decimal ProfitFactor,
    decimal AverageMfeR,
    decimal AverageMaeR,
    decimal MfeMaeRatio,
    decimal HighMaePercent,
    decimal WeakEntryPercent,
    decimal MaxDrawdownPercent,
    decimal NetProfitUsdt,
    decimal NetProfitPercent,
    decimal FinalEquityUsdt,
    bool NetDirectionOk,
    bool PassesTarget,
    decimal Score);

internal sealed record FindBestEdgeCandidateResult(
    int Rank,
    int TryNumber,
    string Symbol,
    string Timeframe,
    DateTime StartUtc,
    DateTime EndUtcExclusive,
    SrTradeBacktestSettings Settings,
    FindBestEdgeMetrics Metrics);

internal sealed record FindBestEdgeResult(
    string ProfileName,
    int TotalTries,
    FindBestEdgeCandidateResult? Best,
    List<FindBestEdgeCandidateResult> TopResults,
    string ResultsCsvPath,
    string BestConfigPath,
    string SummaryPath,
    FindBestEdgeCandidateResult? SeedFullHistoryResult,
    string FinalProfileSource);

internal sealed class FindBestEdgeEngine
{
    private const int DefaultFastTries = 600;
    private const int MinimumFastTries = 120;
    private const int MaximumFastTries = 2000;
    private const int TopResultsToSave = 100;

    private const int TargetMinimumClosedTrades = 50;
    private const decimal TargetMinimumEdgeR = 0.10m;
    private const decimal TargetMinimumProfitFactor = 1.30m;
    private const decimal TargetMinimumMfeMaeRatio = 2.00m;
    private const decimal TargetMaximumHighMaePercent = 25m;
    private const decimal TargetMaximumWeakEntryPercent = 15m;
    private const decimal TargetMaximumDrawdownPercent = 5m;

    public FindBestEdgeResult Run(
        FindBestEdgeRequest request,
        IProgress<FindBestEdgeProgress>? progress = null,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Symbol);
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Timeframe);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(request.Candles);

        DateTime startedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        int totalTries = NormalizeMaxTries(request.MaxTries);

        DateTime fullStart = request.StartUtc;
        DateTime fullEnd = request.EndUtcExclusive;
        EdgeDateWindow fullWindow = new(fullStart, fullEnd, "FULL_HISTORY", true);

        List<EdgeDateWindow> discoveryWindows = BuildDiscoveryWindows(fullStart, fullEnd);
        if (discoveryWindows.Count == 0)
            discoveryWindows.Add(fullWindow);

        var engine = new SrTradeBacktestEngine();
        var allResults = new List<FindBestEdgeCandidateResult>(totalTries + 50);
        var fullHistoryResults = new List<FindBestEdgeCandidateResult>();
        var triedKeys = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        var random = new Random(20260629);

        int completed = 0;
        FindBestEdgeCandidateResult? bestFull = null;
        FindBestEdgeCandidateResult? seedFullHistoryResult = null;

        // Stage 0: always validate the seed profile on full history first.
        // In C2-first master mode, MainForm supplies the coin-specific C2 profile as SeedSettings.
        // This means the engine proves C2 first, then only improves/tunes if mutation finds a stronger result.
        SrTradeBacktestSettings normalizedSeed = NormalizeSettings(request.SeedSettings);
        if (TryAddRunKey(triedKeys, fullWindow.Start, fullWindow.End, normalizedSeed))
        {
            completed++;

            FindBestEdgeCandidateResult seedResult = RunCandidate(
                engine,
                request,
                fullWindow.Start,
                fullWindow.End,
                normalizedSeed,
                completed);

            allResults.Add(seedResult);
            fullHistoryResults.Add(seedResult);
            seedFullHistoryResult = seedResult;
            bestFull = PickBetterFullHistory(bestFull, seedResult);

            ReportProgress(progress, startedUtc, completed, totalTries, seedResult, bestFull, "C2 SEED FULL HISTORY VALIDATION");
        }

        // Stage 1: fast smart discovery on multiple representative windows.
        // This avoids running full-history 20,000 times, which is very slow.
        int discoveryTries = Math.Max(60, (int)(totalTries * 0.80m));
        List<SrTradeBacktestSettings> settingsPool = BuildSmartSettingsPool(request.SeedSettings, discoveryTries, random);

        for (int i = 0; i < settingsPool.Count && completed < discoveryTries; i++)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            EdgeDateWindow window = discoveryWindows[i % discoveryWindows.Count];
            SrTradeBacktestSettings settings = settingsPool[i];

            if (!TryAddRunKey(triedKeys, window.Start, window.End, settings))
                continue;

            completed++;

            FindBestEdgeCandidateResult result = RunCandidate(
                engine,
                request,
                window.Start,
                window.End,
                settings,
                completed);

            allResults.Add(result);
            ReportProgress(progress, startedUtc, completed, totalTries, result, bestFull, "FAST DISCOVERY");
        }

        // Stage 2: smart mutations around best discovery profiles.
        int mutationTries = Math.Max(20, (int)(totalTries * 0.10m));
        int mutationTarget = Math.Min(totalTries, completed + mutationTries);

        while (completed < mutationTarget && allResults.Count > 0)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            List<FindBestEdgeCandidateResult> parents = RankForDiscovery(allResults).Take(35).ToList();
            FindBestEdgeCandidateResult parent = parents[random.Next(parents.Count)];
            SrTradeBacktestSettings settings = MutateSettings(parent.Settings, request.SeedSettings, random);
            EdgeDateWindow window = random.Next(100) < 30
                ? fullWindow
                : discoveryWindows[random.Next(discoveryWindows.Count)];

            if (!TryAddRunKey(triedKeys, window.Start, window.End, settings))
                continue;

            completed++;

            FindBestEdgeCandidateResult result = RunCandidate(
                engine,
                request,
                window.Start,
                window.End,
                settings,
                completed);

            allResults.Add(result);

            if (window.IsFullHistory)
            {
                fullHistoryResults.Add(result);
                bestFull = PickBetterFullHistory(bestFull, result);
            }

            ReportProgress(progress, startedUtc, completed, totalTries, result, bestFull, "SMART MUTATION");
        }

        // Stage 3: only validate the strongest unique settings on full history.
        // This gives practical full-history result without hanging the UI for many hours.
        int validationSlots = Math.Max(20, totalTries - completed);
        List<SrTradeBacktestSettings> topSettings = UniqueSettings(RankForDiscovery(allResults).Select(x => x.Settings))
            .Take(validationSlots)
            .ToList();

        foreach (SrTradeBacktestSettings settings in topSettings)
        {
            if (completed >= totalTries)
                break;

            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            if (!TryAddRunKey(triedKeys, fullWindow.Start, fullWindow.End, settings))
                continue;

            completed++;

            FindBestEdgeCandidateResult result = RunCandidate(
                engine,
                request,
                fullWindow.Start,
                fullWindow.End,
                settings,
                completed);

            allResults.Add(result);
            fullHistoryResults.Add(result);
            bestFull = PickBetterFullHistory(bestFull, result);

            ReportProgress(progress, startedUtc, completed, totalTries, result, bestFull, "FULL HISTORY VALIDATION");
        }

        List<FindBestEdgeCandidateResult> rankingPool = fullHistoryResults.Count > 0
            ? fullHistoryResults
            : allResults;

        List<FindBestEdgeCandidateResult> ranked = RankForFinal(rankingPool)
            .Take(TopResultsToSave)
            .Select((x, i) => x with { Rank = i + 1 })
            .ToList();

        FindBestEdgeCandidateResult? best = ranked.FirstOrDefault();

        string finalProfileSource = ResolveFinalProfileSource(best, seedFullHistoryResult);

        SaveResultFiles(request.ProfileName, completed, best, ranked, seedFullHistoryResult, finalProfileSource, out string csvPath, out string configPath, out string summaryPath);

        return new FindBestEdgeResult(
            request.ProfileName,
            completed,
            best,
            ranked,
            csvPath,
            configPath,
            summaryPath,
            seedFullHistoryResult,
            finalProfileSource);
    }

    private sealed record EdgeDateWindow(DateTime Start, DateTime End, string Label, bool IsFullHistory);

    private static int NormalizeMaxTries(int requested)
    {
        if (requested <= 0)
            return DefaultFastTries;

        if (requested < MinimumFastTries)
            return MinimumFastTries;

        if (requested > MaximumFastTries)
            return MaximumFastTries;

        return requested;
    }

    private static FindBestEdgeCandidateResult RunCandidate(
        SrTradeBacktestEngine engine,
        FindBestEdgeRequest request,
        DateTime start,
        DateTime end,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings,
        int tryNumber)
    {
        SrBacktestResult backtest = engine.Run(
            request.Symbol,
            request.Timeframe,
            start,
            end,
            request.Candles,
            settings,
            saveOutputFiles: false,
            calculateBestR: false);

        return new FindBestEdgeCandidateResult(
            Rank: 0,
            TryNumber: tryNumber,
            Symbol: request.Symbol,
            Timeframe: request.Timeframe,
            StartUtc: start,
            EndUtcExclusive: end,
            Settings: settings,
            Metrics: CalculateMetrics(backtest));
    }

    private static void ReportProgress(
        IProgress<FindBestEdgeProgress>? progress,
        DateTime startedUtc,
        int completed,
        int total,
        FindBestEdgeCandidateResult current,
        FindBestEdgeCandidateResult? bestFull,
        string phase)
    {
        if (progress == null)
            return;

        if (completed != 1 && completed % 5 != 0 && completed != total)
            return;

        TimeSpan elapsed = DateTime.UtcNow - startedUtc;
        TimeSpan remaining = completed > 0
            ? TimeSpan.FromTicks((long)(elapsed.Ticks * ((decimal)(total - completed) / completed)))
            : TimeSpan.Zero;

        progress.Report(new FindBestEdgeProgress(
            Completed: completed,
            Total: total,
            CurrentTest: phase + " | " + BuildShortSettingLabel(current.Settings, current.StartUtc, current.EndUtcExclusive),
            BestSoFar: bestFull == null ? "Full-history validation not reached yet" : BuildBestShortText(bestFull),
            Elapsed: elapsed,
            EstimatedRemaining: remaining));
    }

    private static List<EdgeDateWindow> BuildDiscoveryWindows(DateTime startUtc, DateTime endUtcExclusive)
    {
        var windows = new List<EdgeDateWindow>();

        // Use full date coverage through representative windows, not only one month.
        DateTime startMonth = new DateTime(startUtc.Year, startUtc.Month, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        DateTime endMonthExclusive = new DateTime(endUtcExclusive.AddDays(-1).Year, endUtcExclusive.AddDays(-1).Month, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc).AddMonths(1);

        AddWindow(windows, startUtc, endUtcExclusive, "FULL_HISTORY_DISCOVERY", false);

        int[] windowLengths = { 1, 2, 3, 6, 12 };

        foreach (int months in windowLengths)
        {
            for (DateTime cursor = startMonth; cursor.AddMonths(months) <= endMonthExclusive; cursor = cursor.AddMonths(months))
            {
                DateTime ws = cursor < startUtc ? startUtc : cursor;
                DateTime we = cursor.AddMonths(months) > endUtcExclusive ? endUtcExclusive : cursor.AddMonths(months);
                AddWindow(windows, ws, we, $"{months}M", false);
            }
        }

        // Add recent windows because latest market regime matters.
        AddRecentWindow(windows, startUtc, endUtcExclusive, 3);
        AddRecentWindow(windows, startUtc, endUtcExclusive, 6);
        AddRecentWindow(windows, startUtc, endUtcExclusive, 12);

        return windows
            .OrderByDescending(x => (x.End - x.Start).TotalDays)
            .ThenBy(x => x.Start)
            .ToList();
    }

    private static void AddRecentWindow(List<EdgeDateWindow> windows, DateTime startUtc, DateTime endUtcExclusive, int months)
    {
        DateTime rs = endUtcExclusive.AddMonths(-months);
        if (rs < startUtc)
            rs = startUtc;

        AddWindow(windows, rs, endUtcExclusive, $"RECENT_{months}M", false);
    }

    private static void AddWindow(List<EdgeDateWindow> windows, DateTime start, DateTime end, string label, bool isFull)
    {
        if (end <= start)
            return;

        double days = (end - start).TotalDays;
        if (days < 25)
            return;

        if (!windows.Any(x => x.Start == start && x.End == end))
            windows.Add(new EdgeDateWindow(start, end, label, isFull));
    }

    private static List<SrTradeBacktestSettings> BuildSmartSettingsPool(
        SrTradeBacktestSettings seed,
        int count,
        Random random)
    {
        var list = new List<SrTradeBacktestSettings>(count);
        var seen = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        AddIfNew(list, seen, NormalizeSettings(seed), count);

        var orderModes = new[]
        {
            (MO: false, LO: true,  SO: true),
            (MO: false, LO: false, SO: true),
            (MO: false, LO: true,  SO: false),
            (MO: true,  LO: false, SO: false),
            (MO: true,  LO: false, SO: true),
            (MO: true,  LO: true,  SO: true)
        };

        var directionModes = new[]
        {
            (Long: true,  Short: true),
            (Long: true,  Short: false),
            (Long: false, Short: true)
        };

        decimal[] slValues = { 0.35m, 0.50m, 0.75m, 1.00m, 1.25m, 1.50m };
        decimal[] tpValues = { 0.75m, 1.00m, 1.25m, 1.50m, 2.00m, 2.50m };
        decimal[] trailAtrValues = { 0.50m, 0.75m, 1.00m, 1.25m };
        decimal[] trailActValues = { 0.75m, 1.00m, 1.25m };
        decimal[] scoreValues = { 75m, 80m, 85m, 90m, 95m };
        decimal[] moScoreValues = { 90m, 95m };
        decimal[] retestVol = { 1.05m, 1.15m, 1.25m, 1.35m, 1.50m };
        decimal[] breakoutVol = { 1.15m, 1.25m, 1.35m, 1.50m, 1.75m };
        decimal[] bodyValues = { 35m, 45m, 50m, 60m };
        decimal[] retestDist = { 0.25m, 0.35m, 0.50m, 0.75m, 1.00m };
        decimal[] breakoutDist = { 0.50m, 0.60m, 0.80m, 1.00m, 1.25m };
        decimal[] marginValues = BuildMarginValues(seed.StartEquityUsdt);
        decimal[] leverageValues = { 1m, 2m, 3m, 5m, 7m, 10m };

        // Important hand-built practical profiles first.
        foreach (decimal sl in new[] { 0.50m, 0.75m, 1.00m })
        foreach (decimal tp in new[] { 1.00m, 1.50m, 2.00m })
        foreach (var order in orderModes.Take(3))
        {
            SrTradeBacktestSettings s = CreateSettings(
                seed, order.MO, order.LO, order.SO, true, true,
                sl, tp, trail: tp >= 1.50m, trailAtr: 0.75m, trailAct: 1.00m,
                loScore: 80m, soScore: 80m, moScore: 95m,
                rv: 1.25m, bv: 1.25m, body: 50m, rd: 0.25m, bd: 1.00m,
                margin: seed.MarginUsdt, leverage: seed.Leverage);

            AddIfNew(list, seen, s, count);
        }

        while (list.Count < count)
        {
            var order = orderModes[random.Next(orderModes.Length)];
            var direction = directionModes[random.Next(directionModes.Length)];

            SrTradeBacktestSettings s = CreateSettings(
                seed,
                order.MO,
                order.LO,
                order.SO,
                direction.Long,
                direction.Short,
                Pick(random, slValues),
                Pick(random, tpValues),
                random.Next(100) < 45,
                Pick(random, trailAtrValues),
                Pick(random, trailActValues),
                Pick(random, scoreValues),
                Pick(random, scoreValues),
                Pick(random, moScoreValues),
                Pick(random, retestVol),
                Pick(random, breakoutVol),
                Pick(random, bodyValues),
                Pick(random, retestDist),
                Pick(random, breakoutDist),
                Pick(random, marginValues),
                Pick(random, leverageValues));

            AddIfNew(list, seen, s, count);
        }

        return list;
    }

    private static SrTradeBacktestSettings MutateSettings(SrTradeBacktestSettings parent, SrTradeBacktestSettings seed, Random random)
    {
        decimal[] slValues = { 0.35m, 0.50m, 0.75m, 1.00m, 1.25m, 1.50m };
        decimal[] tpValues = { 0.75m, 1.00m, 1.25m, 1.50m, 2.00m, 2.50m };
        decimal[] trailAtrValues = { 0.50m, 0.75m, 1.00m, 1.25m };
        decimal[] trailActValues = { 0.75m, 1.00m, 1.25m };
        decimal[] scoreValues = { 75m, 80m, 85m, 90m, 95m };
        decimal[] moScoreValues = { 90m, 95m };
        decimal[] retestVol = { 1.05m, 1.15m, 1.25m, 1.35m, 1.50m };
        decimal[] breakoutVol = { 1.15m, 1.25m, 1.35m, 1.50m, 1.75m };
        decimal[] bodyValues = { 35m, 45m, 50m, 60m };
        decimal[] retestDist = { 0.25m, 0.35m, 0.50m, 0.75m, 1.00m };
        decimal[] breakoutDist = { 0.50m, 0.60m, 0.80m, 1.00m, 1.25m };
        decimal[] marginValues = BuildMarginValues(seed.StartEquityUsdt);
        decimal[] leverageValues = { 1m, 2m, 3m, 5m, 7m, 10m };

        bool mo = random.Next(100) < 80 ? parent.EnableMO : !parent.EnableMO;
        bool lo = random.Next(100) < 80 ? parent.EnableLO : !parent.EnableLO;
        bool so = random.Next(100) < 80 ? parent.EnableSO : !parent.EnableSO;
        bool lng = random.Next(100) < 85 ? parent.EnableLong : !parent.EnableLong;
        bool shrt = random.Next(100) < 85 ? parent.EnableShort : !parent.EnableShort;

        return CreateSettings(
            seed, mo, lo, so, lng, shrt,
            MutateValue(parent.StopLossAtrMultiplier, slValues, random),
            MutateValue(parent.TargetR, tpValues, random),
            random.Next(100) < 85 ? parent.EnableTrailingStopLoss : !parent.EnableTrailingStopLoss,
            MutateValue(parent.TrailStopAtrMultiplier, trailAtrValues, random),
            MutateValue(parent.TrailActivationR, trailActValues, random),
            MutateValue(parent.MinimumLoScore, scoreValues, random),
            MutateValue(parent.MinimumSoScore, scoreValues, random),
            MutateValue(parent.MinimumMoScore < 90m ? 90m : parent.MinimumMoScore, moScoreValues, random),
            MutateValue(parent.RetestVolumeMultiplier, retestVol, random),
            MutateValue(parent.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier, breakoutVol, random),
            MutateValue(parent.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent, bodyValues, random),
            MutateValue(parent.MaxRetestDistanceAtr, retestDist, random),
            MutateValue(parent.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr, breakoutDist, random),
            MutateValue(parent.MarginUsdt > 0m ? parent.MarginUsdt : seed.MarginUsdt, marginValues, random),
            MutateValue(parent.Leverage > 0m ? parent.Leverage : seed.Leverage, leverageValues, random));
    }

    private static SrTradeBacktestSettings CreateSettings(
        SrTradeBacktestSettings seed,
        bool enableMO,
        bool enableLO,
        bool enableSO,
        bool enableLong,
        bool enableShort,
        decimal sl,
        decimal tp,
        bool trail,
        decimal trailAtr,
        decimal trailAct,
        decimal loScore,
        decimal soScore,
        decimal moScore,
        decimal rv,
        decimal bv,
        decimal body,
        decimal rd,
        decimal bd,
        decimal margin,
        decimal leverage)
    {
        if (!enableMO && !enableLO && !enableSO)
            enableSO = true;

        if (!enableLong && !enableShort)
            enableLong = true;

        decimal safeMargin = margin > 0m ? margin : seed.MarginUsdt;
        decimal safeLeverage = leverage > 0m ? leverage : seed.Leverage;

        return seed with
        {
            EnableMO = enableMO,
            EnableLO = enableLO,
            EnableSO = enableSO,
            EnableLong = enableLong,
            EnableShort = enableShort,
            StopLossAtrMultiplier = sl,
            TargetR = tp,
            EnableTrailingStopLoss = trail,
            TrailStopAtrMultiplier = trailAtr,
            TrailActivationR = trailAct,

            MarginUsdt = safeMargin,
            Leverage = safeLeverage,
            TradeSizeUsdt = safeMargin * safeLeverage,

            EnableScoreRule = true,
            MinimumLoScore = loScore,
            MinimumSoScore = soScore,
            MinimumMoScore = enableMO ? Math.Max(90m, moScore) : Math.Max(85m, moScore),

            EnableVolumeRule = true,
            RetestVolumeMultiplier = rv,
            BreakoutVolumeMultiplier = bv,

            EnableCandleRule = true,
            MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent = body,

            EnableDistanceRule = true,
            MaxRetestDistanceAtr = rd,
            MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr = bd
        };
    }

    private static FindBestEdgeMetrics CalculateMetrics(SrBacktestResult result)
    {
        List<SrTradeLogRow> rows = result.Rows;
        List<SrTradeLogRow> closed = rows
            .Where(x => x.ProfitR.HasValue && (x.Result == "WIN" || x.Result == "TRAIL_WIN" || x.Result == "LOSS"))
            .ToList();

        int placed = rows.Count(x => x.Status == SrTradeStatus.Placed);
        int closedCount = closed.Count;
        int wins = closed.Count(x => x.ProfitR!.Value > 0m);
        int losses = closed.Count(x => x.ProfitR!.Value < 0m);

        decimal netR = closed.Sum(x => x.ProfitR!.Value);
        decimal edge = closedCount > 0 ? closed.Average(x => x.ProfitR!.Value) : 0m;
        decimal winRate = closedCount > 0 ? wins * 100m / closedCount : 0m;

        decimal grossWin = closed.Where(x => x.ProfitR!.Value > 0m).Sum(x => x.ProfitR!.Value);
        decimal grossLoss = Math.Abs(closed.Where(x => x.ProfitR!.Value < 0m).Sum(x => x.ProfitR!.Value));
        decimal profitFactor = grossLoss > 0m ? grossWin / grossLoss : grossWin > 0m ? 999m : 0m;

        decimal avgMfe = closed.Where(x => x.MfeR.HasValue).Select(x => x.MfeR!.Value).DefaultIfEmpty(0m).Average();
        decimal avgMae = closed.Where(x => x.MaeR.HasValue).Select(x => Math.Abs(x.MaeR!.Value)).DefaultIfEmpty(0m).Average();
        decimal mfeMaeRatio = avgMae > 0m ? avgMfe / avgMae : avgMfe > 0m ? 999m : 0m;

        int highMae = closed.Count(x => x.MaeR.HasValue && Math.Abs(x.MaeR.Value) >= 0.80m);
        int weakEntry = closed.Count(x => ((x.TradeQualityGrade ?? string.Empty).Equals("WEAK", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)));

        decimal highMaePct = closedCount > 0 ? highMae * 100m / closedCount : 100m;
        decimal weakEntryPct = closedCount > 0 ? weakEntry * 100m / closedCount : 100m;

        decimal startEquity = result.Settings.StartEquityUsdt > 0m ? result.Settings.StartEquityUsdt : 1000m;
        decimal netProfitUsdt = rows.Where(x => x.PnlUsdt.HasValue).Sum(x => x.PnlUsdt!.Value);
        decimal finalEquity = startEquity + netProfitUsdt;
        decimal netProfitPct = startEquity > 0m ? netProfitUsdt / startEquity * 100m : 0m;

        bool directionOk = (netR >= 0m && netProfitUsdt >= 0m) || (netR <= 0m && netProfitUsdt <= 0m);
        decimal maxDdPct = CalculateMaxDrawdownPercent(rows, startEquity);

        bool passes =
            closedCount >= TargetMinimumClosedTrades &&
            edge >= TargetMinimumEdgeR &&
            profitFactor >= TargetMinimumProfitFactor &&
            mfeMaeRatio >= TargetMinimumMfeMaeRatio &&
            highMaePct <= TargetMaximumHighMaePercent &&
            weakEntryPct <= TargetMaximumWeakEntryPercent &&
            maxDdPct <= TargetMaximumDrawdownPercent &&
            directionOk &&
            netProfitUsdt > 0m;

        decimal safePf = profitFactor >= 999m ? (closedCount >= TargetMinimumClosedTrades ? 5m : 1m) : Math.Min(profitFactor, 5m);
        decimal safeMfeMae = mfeMaeRatio >= 999m ? (closedCount >= TargetMinimumClosedTrades ? 5m : 1m) : Math.Min(mfeMaeRatio, 5m);

        decimal score = 0m;
        score += edge * 900m;
        score += safePf * 90m;
        score += safeMfeMae * 90m;
        score += netR * 8m;
        score += Math.Min(150m, closedCount) * 2m;
        score += Math.Max(-250m, Math.Min(250m, netProfitPct * 30m));
        score -= highMaePct * 4.5m;
        score -= weakEntryPct * 5m;
        score -= maxDdPct * 12m;

        if (closedCount < TargetMinimumClosedTrades)
            score -= (TargetMinimumClosedTrades - closedCount) * 550m;

        if (closedCount < 30)
            score -= 12000m;

        if (closedCount < 10)
            score -= 45000m;

        if (!directionOk)
            score -= 1000m;

        if (passes)
            score += 20000m;

        return new FindBestEdgeMetrics(
            placed, closedCount, wins, losses, winRate, netR, edge, profitFactor,
            avgMfe, avgMae, mfeMaeRatio, highMaePct, weakEntryPct, maxDdPct,
            netProfitUsdt, netProfitPct, finalEquity, directionOk, passes, score);
    }

    private static decimal CalculateMaxDrawdownPercent(List<SrTradeLogRow> rows, decimal startEquity)
    {
        decimal peak = startEquity;
        decimal maxDd = 0m;

        foreach (SrTradeLogRow row in rows.Where(x => x.EquityAfterTradeUsdt.HasValue))
        {
            decimal equity = row.EquityAfterTradeUsdt!.Value;
            if (equity > peak) peak = equity;
            decimal dd = peak - equity;
            if (dd > maxDd) maxDd = dd;
        }

        return peak > 0m ? maxDd / peak * 100m : 0m;
    }

    private static IEnumerable<FindBestEdgeCandidateResult> RankForDiscovery(IEnumerable<FindBestEdgeCandidateResult> results)
    {
        return results
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.Metrics.ClosedTrades >= 30)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.Metrics.PassesTarget)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.Metrics.Score)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.Metrics.EdgeR)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.Metrics.NetProfitUsdt)
            .ThenBy(x => x.Metrics.HighMaePercent);
    }

    private static IEnumerable<FindBestEdgeCandidateResult> RankForFinal(IEnumerable<FindBestEdgeCandidateResult> results)
    {
        return results
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.Metrics.ClosedTrades >= TargetMinimumClosedTrades)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.Metrics.PassesTarget)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.Metrics.NetProfitUsdt > 0m)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.Metrics.NetDirectionOk)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.Metrics.Score)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.Metrics.EdgeR)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.Metrics.NetProfitUsdt)
            .ThenBy(x => x.Metrics.HighMaePercent)
            .ThenBy(x => x.Metrics.WeakEntryPercent);
    }


    private static string ResolveFinalProfileSource(FindBestEdgeCandidateResult? best, FindBestEdgeCandidateResult? seedFullHistoryResult)
    {
        if (best == null)
            return seedFullHistoryResult == null ? "NO_RESULT_NO_C2_SEED" : "NO_RESULT_AFTER_C2_SEED";

        if (seedFullHistoryResult == null)
            return "ZERO_SEARCH_NO_C2_SEED";

        return BuildSettingsKey(best.Settings).Equals(BuildSettingsKey(seedFullHistoryResult.Settings), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            ? "C2_SEED_KEPT"
            : "C2_TUNED_IMPROVED";
    }

    private static FindBestEdgeCandidateResult? PickBetterFullHistory(FindBestEdgeCandidateResult? current, FindBestEdgeCandidateResult candidate)
    {
        if (current == null)
            return candidate;

        return RankForFinal(new[] { candidate, current }).First() == candidate ? candidate : current;
    }

    private static List<SrTradeBacktestSettings> UniqueSettings(IEnumerable<SrTradeBacktestSettings> settings)
    {
        var result = new List<SrTradeBacktestSettings>();
        var seen = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        foreach (SrTradeBacktestSettings s in settings)
        {
            if (seen.Add(BuildSettingsKey(s)))
                result.Add(s);
        }

        return result;
    }

    private static bool TryAddRunKey(HashSet<string> tried, DateTime start, DateTime end, SrTradeBacktestSettings settings)
    {
        return tried.Add(start.ToString("yyyyMMdd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "|" +
                         end.ToString("yyyyMMdd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "|" +
                         BuildSettingsKey(settings));
    }

    private static SrTradeBacktestSettings NormalizeSettings(SrTradeBacktestSettings settings)
    {
        decimal margin = settings.MarginUsdt > 0m ? settings.MarginUsdt : 50m;
        decimal leverage = settings.Leverage > 0m ? settings.Leverage : 2m;

        return settings with
        {
            MinimumMoScore = settings.EnableMO ? Math.Max(90m, settings.MinimumMoScore) : Math.Max(85m, settings.MinimumMoScore),
            MarginUsdt = margin,
            Leverage = leverage,
            TradeSizeUsdt = margin * leverage
        };
    }

    private static decimal[] BuildMarginValues(decimal startEquity)
    {
        decimal equity = startEquity > 0m ? startEquity : 1000m;

        decimal[] values =
        {
            10m, 20m, 50m, 75m, 100m, 150m, 200m,
            Math.Round(equity * 0.05m, 2),
            Math.Round(equity * 0.10m, 2),
            Math.Round(equity * 0.15m, 2),
            Math.Round(equity * 0.20m, 2)
        };

        return values
            .Where(x => x > 0m && x <= equity * 0.25m)
            .Distinct()
            .OrderBy(x => x)
            .ToArray();
    }

    private static decimal MutateValue(decimal current, decimal[] values, Random random)
    {
        int idx = Array.IndexOf(values, current);
        if (idx < 0)
            return Pick(random, values);

        if (random.Next(100) < 25)
            return Pick(random, values);

        idx += random.Next(3) - 1;
        if (idx < 0) idx = 0;
        if (idx >= values.Length) idx = values.Length - 1;
        return values[idx];
    }

    private static decimal Pick(Random random, decimal[] values)
    {
        return values[random.Next(values.Length)];
    }

    private static void AddIfNew(List<SrTradeBacktestSettings> list, HashSet<string> seen, SrTradeBacktestSettings settings, int max)
    {
        if (list.Count >= max)
            return;

        if (seen.Add(BuildSettingsKey(settings)))
            list.Add(settings);
    }

    private static decimal CalculateDailyProfitPercent(DateTime startUtc, DateTime endUtcExclusive, decimal totalProfitPercent)
    {
        double days = Math.Max(1.0, (endUtcExclusive - startUtc).TotalDays);
        double growth = 1.0 + ((double)totalProfitPercent / 100.0);

        if (growth <= 0.0)
            return totalProfitPercent / (decimal)days;

        return (decimal)((Math.Pow(growth, 1.0 / days) - 1.0) * 100.0);
    }

    private static string BuildDailyProfitFilePrefix(decimal dailyProfitPercent)
    {
        string sign = dailyProfitPercent >= 0m ? "P" : "N";
        decimal absolute = Math.Abs(dailyProfitPercent);
        string value = absolute.ToString("0.0000", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).Replace('.', 'p');
        return $"DAILY_{sign}{value}PCT";
    }

    private static void SaveResultFiles(
        string profileName,
        int totalTries,
        FindBestEdgeCandidateResult? best,
        List<FindBestEdgeCandidateResult> ranked,
        FindBestEdgeCandidateResult? seedFullHistoryResult,
        string finalProfileSource,
        out string csvPath,
        out string configPath,
        out string summaryPath)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        string safeProfile = Sanitize(profileName);
        string stamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string dailyPrefix = best == null
            ? "DAILY_NA"
            : BuildDailyProfitFilePrefix(CalculateDailyProfitPercent(best.StartUtc, best.EndUtcExclusive, best.Metrics.NetProfitPercent));
        string baseName = $"{dailyPrefix}__FIND_BEST_EDGE_V8_4_FAST_SMART__{safeProfile}__{stamp}";

        csvPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, baseName + "__TOP_100_VALIDATED_RESULTS.csv");
        configPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, baseName + "__BEST_VALIDATED_PROFILE.config.txt");
        summaryPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, baseName + "__FAST_SUMMARY.txt");

        File.WriteAllText(csvPath, BuildCsv(ranked), Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(configPath, best == null ? "No validated best profile found." : BuildConfig(best), Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(summaryPath, BuildSummary(profileName, totalTries, best, seedFullHistoryResult, finalProfileSource), Encoding.UTF8);
    }

    private static string BuildCsv(List<FindBestEdgeCandidateResult> rows)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("Rank,Try,Pass,Symbol,Timeframe,Start,End,DailyProfit%,Closed,WinRate,NetR,EdgeR,ProfitFactor,MFE_MAE,HighMAE%,WeakEntry%,MaxDD%,NetProfitUSDT,NetProfit%,FinalEquityUSDT,DirectionOK,Score,MO,LO,SO,Long,Short,SL,TP,Trail,TrA,TrR,Margin,Leverage,TradeSize,LOScore,SOScore,MOScore,RetVol,BoVol,Body%,RetDist,BoDist");

        foreach (FindBestEdgeCandidateResult r in rows)
        {
            SrTradeBacktestSettings s = r.Settings;
            FindBestEdgeMetrics m = r.Metrics;
            sb.AppendLine(string.Join(",", new[]
            {
                r.Rank.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                r.TryNumber.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.PassesTarget.ToString(),
                r.Symbol,
                r.Timeframe,
                r.StartUtc.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                r.EndUtcExclusive.AddDays(-1).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                CalculateDailyProfitPercent(r.StartUtc, r.EndUtcExclusive, m.NetProfitPercent).ToString("0.0000", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.ClosedTrades.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.WinRate.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.NetR.ToString("0.####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.EdgeR.ToString("0.####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.ProfitFactor.ToString("0.####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.MfeMaeRatio.ToString("0.####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.HighMaePercent.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.WeakEntryPercent.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.MaxDrawdownPercent.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.NetProfitUsdt.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.NetProfitPercent.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.FinalEquityUsdt.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.NetDirectionOk.ToString(),
                m.Score.ToString("0.####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.EnableMO.ToString(), s.EnableLO.ToString(), s.EnableSO.ToString(), s.EnableLong.ToString(), s.EnableShort.ToString(),
                s.StopLossAtrMultiplier.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.TargetR.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.EnableTrailingStopLoss.ToString(),
                s.TrailStopAtrMultiplier.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.TrailActivationR.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.MarginUsdt.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.Leverage.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.TradeSizeUsdt.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.MinimumLoScore.ToString("0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.MinimumSoScore.ToString("0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.MinimumMoScore.ToString("0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.RetestVolumeMultiplier.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent.ToString("0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.MaxRetestDistanceAtr.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            }.Select(EscapeCsv)));
        }

        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static string BuildSummary(string profileName, int totalTries, FindBestEdgeCandidateResult? best, FindBestEdgeCandidateResult? seedFullHistoryResult, string finalProfileSource)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("FIND BEST EDGE V8.4 FAST SMART SUMMARY");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Profile      : {profileName}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated UTC: {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Total Tries  : {totalTries}");
        sb.AppendLine("Search Mode  : C2 seed full-history validation first, then fast discovery + smart mutation + final full-history validation");
        sb.AppendLine("Reason       : Proves the supplied C2/profile seed first, then tunes only if a stronger full-history result is found.");
        sb.AppendLine($"Final Source : {finalProfileSource}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("C2 SEED FULL-HISTORY VALIDATION");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        if (seedFullHistoryResult == null)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("Seed Result        : NOT AVAILABLE");
        }
        else
        {
            FindBestEdgeMetrics sm = seedFullHistoryResult.Metrics;
            sb.AppendLine($"Seed Try Number    : {seedFullHistoryResult.TryNumber}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Seed Date Range    : {seedFullHistoryResult.StartUtc:yyyy-MM-dd} to {seedFullHistoryResult.EndUtcExclusive.AddDays(-1):yyyy-MM-dd}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Seed Closed Trades : {sm.ClosedTrades}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Seed Win Rate      : {sm.WinRate:0.00}%");
            sb.AppendLine($"Seed Edge          : {sm.EdgeR:0.####}R");
            sb.AppendLine($"Seed PF            : {sm.ProfitFactor:0.####}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Seed DD            : {sm.MaxDrawdownPercent:0.00}%");
            sb.AppendLine($"Seed Net Profit %  : {sm.NetProfitPercent:0.00}%");
            sb.AppendLine($"Seed Pass          : {sm.PassesTarget}");
        }
        sb.AppendLine();

        if (best == null)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("No validated result found.");
            return sb.ToString();
        }

        sb.AppendLine("BEST VALIDATED RESULT");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine(BuildConfig(best));
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("TARGET CONDITIONS");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("Closed Trades      : 50+");
        sb.AppendLine("Edge               : above +0.10R per trade");
        sb.AppendLine("Profit Factor      : above 1.30");
        sb.AppendLine("MFE/MAE Ratio      : above 2.00");
        sb.AppendLine("High MAE Trades    : below 25%");
        sb.AppendLine("Weak Entry Trades  : below 15%");
        sb.AppendLine("Max Drawdown       : below 5%");
        sb.AppendLine("Net Profit USDT    : same direction as Net R and above zero");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine($"Passes All Targets : {best.Metrics.PassesTarget}");
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static string BuildConfig(FindBestEdgeCandidateResult r)
    {
        SrTradeBacktestSettings s = r.Settings;
        FindBestEdgeMetrics m = r.Metrics;
        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        sb.AppendLine($"Rank                    : {r.Rank}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Try Number              : {r.TryNumber}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Symbol                  : {r.Symbol}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Timeframe               : {r.Timeframe}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Date Range              : {r.StartUtc:yyyy-MM-dd} to {r.EndUtcExclusive.AddDays(-1):yyyy-MM-dd}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Passes Target           : {m.PassesTarget}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Closed Trades           : {m.ClosedTrades}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Win Rate                : {m.WinRate:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Net R                   : {m.NetR:0.####}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Edge                    : {m.EdgeR:0.####}R per trade");
        sb.AppendLine($"Profit Factor           : {m.ProfitFactor:0.####}");
        sb.AppendLine($"MFE/MAE Ratio           : {m.MfeMaeRatio:0.####}");
        sb.AppendLine($"High MAE Trades         : {m.HighMaePercent:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Weak Entry Trades       : {m.WeakEntryPercent:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Max Drawdown            : {m.MaxDrawdownPercent:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Net Profit USDT         : {m.NetProfitUsdt:0.00}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Net Profit %            : {m.NetProfitPercent:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Daily Profit %          : {CalculateDailyProfitPercent(r.StartUtc, r.EndUtcExclusive, m.NetProfitPercent):0.0000}% compounded/day");
        sb.AppendLine($"Final Equity USDT       : {m.FinalEquityUsdt:0.00}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Net Direction OK        : {m.NetDirectionOk}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Score                   : {m.Score:0.####}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("SETTINGS TO APPLY");
        sb.AppendLine($"MO                      : {s.EnableMO}");
        sb.AppendLine($"LO                      : {s.EnableLO}");
        sb.AppendLine($"SO                      : {s.EnableSO}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Long                    : {s.EnableLong}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Short                   : {s.EnableShort}");
        sb.AppendLine($"SL ATR                  : {s.StopLossAtrMultiplier:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"TP R                    : {s.TargetR:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Trail                   : {s.EnableTrailingStopLoss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Trail ATR               : {s.TrailStopAtrMultiplier:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Trail Activation R      : {s.TrailActivationR:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Margin USDT             : {s.MarginUsdt:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Leverage                : {s.Leverage:0.##}x");
        sb.AppendLine($"Trade Size USDT         : {s.TradeSizeUsdt:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"LO Min Score            : {s.MinimumLoScore:0}");
        sb.AppendLine($"SO Min Score            : {s.MinimumSoScore:0}");
        sb.AppendLine($"MO Min Score            : {s.MinimumMoScore:0}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Retest Volume x SMA20   : {s.RetestVolumeMultiplier:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Breakout Volume x SMA20 : {s.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Breakout Body %         : {s.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent:0}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Retest Distance ATR     : {s.MaxRetestDistanceAtr:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Breakout Distance ATR   : {s.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr:0.##}");
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static string BuildBestShortText(FindBestEdgeCandidateResult r)
    {
        FindBestEdgeMetrics m = r.Metrics;
        return $"Best validated: Edge {m.EdgeR:0.###}R | PF {m.ProfitFactor:0.##} | MFE/MAE {m.MfeMaeRatio:0.##} | Net ${m.NetProfitUsdt:0.00} | Eq ${m.FinalEquityUsdt:0.00} | Closed {m.ClosedTrades} | Pass {m.PassesTarget}";
    }

    private static string BuildShortSettingLabel(SrTradeBacktestSettings s, DateTime start, DateTime end)
    {
        return $"{start:yyyy-MM-dd} to {end.AddDays(-1):yyyy-MM-dd} | MO={s.EnableMO} LO={s.EnableLO} SO={s.EnableSO} L={s.EnableLong} S={s.EnableShort} SL={s.StopLossAtrMultiplier:0.##} TP={s.TargetR:0.##} M={s.MarginUsdt:0} Lev={s.Leverage:0.##}";
    }

    private static string BuildSettingsKey(SrTradeBacktestSettings s)
    {
        return string.Join("|", new[]
        {
            s.EnableMO.ToString(), s.EnableLO.ToString(), s.EnableSO.ToString(), s.EnableLong.ToString(), s.EnableShort.ToString(),
            s.StopLossAtrMultiplier.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            s.TargetR.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            s.EnableTrailingStopLoss.ToString(),
            s.TrailStopAtrMultiplier.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            s.TrailActivationR.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            s.MarginUsdt.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            s.Leverage.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            s.TradeSizeUsdt.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            s.MinimumLoScore.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            s.MinimumSoScore.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            s.MinimumMoScore.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            s.RetestVolumeMultiplier.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            s.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            s.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            s.MaxRetestDistanceAtr.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            s.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
        });
    }

    private static string EscapeCsv(string value)
    {
        value ??= string.Empty;
        if (value.Contains(',') || value.Contains('"') || value.Contains('\n') || value.Contains('\r'))
            return "\"" + value.Replace("\"", "\"\"") + "\"";
        return value;
    }

    private static string Sanitize(string value)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
            return "AUTO_PROFILE";

        foreach (char c in Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars())
            value = value.Replace(c, '_');

        return value.Replace(' ', '_').Trim('_');
    }
}

internal sealed record MoreTunningRequest(
    string Symbol,
    string Timeframe,
    DateTime StartUtc,
    DateTime EndUtcExclusive,
    List<Candle> Candles,
    SrTradeBacktestSettings AlphaSettings,
    string ProfileName);

internal sealed record MoreTunningProgress(
    int Completed,
    int Total,
    string CurrentTest,
    string BestSoFar,
    TimeSpan Elapsed,
    TimeSpan EstimatedRemaining);

internal sealed record MoreTunningCandidateResult(
    int Rank,
    int TryNumber,
    string Symbol,
    string Timeframe,
    DateTime StartUtc,
    DateTime EndUtcExclusive,
    SrTradeBacktestSettings Settings,
    FindBestEdgeMetrics Metrics);

internal sealed record MoreTunningResult(
    string ProfileName,
    int TotalTests,
    MoreTunningCandidateResult? Best,
    List<MoreTunningCandidateResult> TopResults,
    string ResultsCsvPath,
    string BestConfigPath,
    string SummaryPath);

internal sealed class MoreTunningEngine
{
    private const int MaximumUltraFineTests = 96;
    private const int TopResultsToSave = 50;

    private const int TargetMinimumClosedTrades = 50;
    private const decimal TargetMinimumEdgeR = 0.08m;
    private const decimal TargetMinimumProfitFactor = 1.20m;
    private const decimal TargetMaximumHighMaePercent = 28m;
    private const decimal TargetMaximumWeakEntryPercent = 18m;
    private const decimal TargetMaximumDrawdownPercent = 8m;

    public MoreTunningResult Run(
        MoreTunningRequest request,
        IProgress<MoreTunningProgress>? progress = null,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Symbol);
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Timeframe);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(request.Candles);

        DateTime startedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        List<SrTradeBacktestSettings> settingsPool = BuildUltraFineSettingsPool(request.AlphaSettings);
        var engine = new SrTradeBacktestEngine();
        var results = new List<MoreTunningCandidateResult>(settingsPool.Count);
        MoreTunningCandidateResult? best = null;

        for (int i = 0; i < settingsPool.Count; i++)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            SrTradeBacktestSettings settings = settingsPool[i];
            SrBacktestResult backtest = engine.Run(
                request.Symbol,
                request.Timeframe,
                request.StartUtc,
                request.EndUtcExclusive,
                request.Candles,
                settings,
                saveOutputFiles: false,
                calculateBestR: false);

            var current = new MoreTunningCandidateResult(
                Rank: 0,
                TryNumber: i + 1,
                Symbol: request.Symbol,
                Timeframe: request.Timeframe,
                StartUtc: request.StartUtc,
                EndUtcExclusive: request.EndUtcExclusive,
                Settings: settings,
                Metrics: CalculateUltraFineMetrics(backtest));

            results.Add(current);

            if (best == null || current.Metrics.Score > best.Metrics.Score)
                best = current;

            ReportProgress(progress, startedUtc, i + 1, settingsPool.Count, current, best);
        }

        List<MoreTunningCandidateResult> ranked = results
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.Metrics.Score)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.Metrics.NetProfitPercent)
            .ThenBy(x => x.Metrics.MaxDrawdownPercent)
            .Take(TopResultsToSave)
            .Select((x, i) => x with { Rank = i + 1 })
            .ToList();

        MoreTunningCandidateResult? finalBest = ranked.FirstOrDefault();
        SaveResultFiles(request.ProfileName, settingsPool.Count, finalBest, ranked, out string csvPath, out string configPath, out string summaryPath);

        return new MoreTunningResult(
            request.ProfileName,
            settingsPool.Count,
            finalBest,
            ranked,
            csvPath,
            configPath,
            summaryPath);
    }

    private static void ReportProgress(
        IProgress<MoreTunningProgress>? progress,
        DateTime startedUtc,
        int completed,
        int total,
        MoreTunningCandidateResult current,
        MoreTunningCandidateResult? best)
    {
        if (progress == null)
            return;

        if (completed != 1 && completed % 5 != 0 && completed != total)
            return;

        TimeSpan elapsed = DateTime.UtcNow - startedUtc;
        TimeSpan remaining = completed > 0
            ? TimeSpan.FromTicks((long)(elapsed.Ticks * ((decimal)(total - completed) / completed)))
            : TimeSpan.Zero;

        progress.Report(new MoreTunningProgress(
            Completed: completed,
            Total: total,
            CurrentTest: BuildShortSettingLabel(current.Settings),
            BestSoFar: best == null ? "Best: waiting..." : BuildBestShortText(best),
            Elapsed: elapsed,
            EstimatedRemaining: remaining));
    }

    private static List<SrTradeBacktestSettings> BuildUltraFineSettingsPool(SrTradeBacktestSettings alpha)
    {
        alpha = NormalizeAlpha(alpha);

        var list = new List<SrTradeBacktestSettings>(MaximumUltraFineTests + 20);
        var seen = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        void Add(SrTradeBacktestSettings settings)
        {
            settings = NormalizeAlpha(settings);
            string key = BuildSettingsKey(settings);
            if (seen.Add(key))
                list.Add(settings);
        }

        Add(alpha);

        // V8.8.5 DOUBLE RANGE mode: wider local search around the selected alpha.
        // This doubles the V8.8.4 tuning envelope while still staying close to the loaded best-alpha profile.
        foreach (decimal d in new[] { -0.10m, -0.05m, 0.05m, 0.10m })
            Add(alpha with { StopLossAtrMultiplier = alpha.StopLossAtrMultiplier + d });

        foreach (decimal d in new[] { -0.20m, -0.10m, -0.05m, 0.05m, 0.10m, 0.20m })
            Add(alpha with { TargetR = alpha.TargetR + d });

        foreach (decimal d in new[] { -0.10m, -0.05m, 0.05m, 0.10m })
            Add(alpha with { TrailStopAtrMultiplier = alpha.TrailStopAtrMultiplier + d });

        foreach (decimal d in new[] { -0.20m, -0.10m, 0.10m, 0.20m })
            Add(alpha with { TrailActivationR = alpha.TrailActivationR + d });

        foreach (decimal d in new[] { -0.10m, -0.05m, 0.05m, 0.10m })
            Add(alpha with { RetestVolumeMultiplier = alpha.RetestVolumeMultiplier + d });

        foreach (decimal d in new[] { -0.10m, -0.05m, 0.05m, 0.10m })
            Add(alpha with { BreakoutVolumeMultiplier = alpha.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier + d });

        foreach (decimal d in new[] { -10m, -5m, 5m, 10m })
            Add(alpha with { MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent = alpha.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent + d });

        foreach (decimal d in new[] { -10m, -5m, 5m, 10m })
            Add(alpha with { MinimumLoScore = alpha.MinimumLoScore + d });

        foreach (decimal d in new[] { -10m, -5m, 5m, 10m })
            Add(alpha with { MinimumSoScore = alpha.MinimumSoScore + d });

        foreach (decimal d in new[] { -10m, -5m, 5m, 10m })
            Add(alpha with { MinimumMoScore = alpha.MinimumMoScore + d });

        foreach (decimal d in new[] { -0.10m, -0.05m, 0.05m, 0.10m })
            Add(alpha with { MaxRetestDistanceAtr = alpha.MaxRetestDistanceAtr + d });

        foreach (decimal d in new[] { -0.20m, -0.10m, 0.10m, 0.20m })
            Add(alpha with { MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr = alpha.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr + d });

        // Higher-value two-parameter refinements using the doubled range.
        foreach (decimal sl in new[] { -0.10m, -0.05m, 0m, 0.05m, 0.10m })
        foreach (decimal tp in new[] { -0.20m, -0.10m, 0m, 0.10m, 0.20m })
            Add(alpha with { StopLossAtrMultiplier = alpha.StopLossAtrMultiplier + sl, TargetR = alpha.TargetR + tp });

        foreach (decimal bv in new[] { -0.10m, -0.05m, 0m, 0.05m, 0.10m })
        foreach (decimal body in new[] { -10m, -5m, 0m, 5m, 10m })
            Add(alpha with { BreakoutVolumeMultiplier = alpha.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier + bv, MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent = alpha.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent + body });

        // Deterministic micro mutations: only 1 to 3 doubled-range edits per candidate, never a wide random re-search.
        var random = new Random(20260703);
        int attempts = 0;
        while (list.Count < MaximumUltraFineTests && attempts < MaximumUltraFineTests * 20)
        {
            attempts++;
            SrTradeBacktestSettings s = alpha;
            int edits = random.Next(1, 4);

            for (int i = 0; i < edits; i++)
            {
                int pick = random.Next(12);
                decimal sign = random.Next(2) == 0 ? -1m : 1m;

                s = pick switch
                {
                    0 => s with { StopLossAtrMultiplier = s.StopLossAtrMultiplier + (sign * 0.10m) },
                    1 => s with { TargetR = s.TargetR + (sign * 0.10m) },
                    2 => s with { TrailStopAtrMultiplier = s.TrailStopAtrMultiplier + (sign * 0.10m) },
                    3 => s with { TrailActivationR = s.TrailActivationR + (sign * 0.20m) },
                    4 => s with { MinimumLoScore = s.MinimumLoScore + (sign * 10m) },
                    5 => s with { MinimumSoScore = s.MinimumSoScore + (sign * 10m) },
                    6 => s with { MinimumMoScore = s.MinimumMoScore + (sign * 10m) },
                    7 => s with { RetestVolumeMultiplier = s.RetestVolumeMultiplier + (sign * 0.10m) },
                    8 => s with { BreakoutVolumeMultiplier = s.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier + (sign * 0.10m) },
                    9 => s with { MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent = s.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent + (sign * 10m) },
                    10 => s with { MaxRetestDistanceAtr = s.MaxRetestDistanceAtr + (sign * 0.10m) },
                    _ => s with { MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr = s.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr + (sign * 0.20m) }
                };
            }

            Add(s);
        }

        return list.Take(MaximumUltraFineTests).ToList();
    }

    private static SrTradeBacktestSettings NormalizeAlpha(SrTradeBacktestSettings s)
    {
        decimal leverage = s.Leverage > 0m ? s.Leverage : 1m;
        decimal margin = s.MarginUsdt > 0m
            ? s.MarginUsdt
            : s.TradeSizeUsdt > 0m ? s.TradeSizeUsdt / leverage : 10m;

        bool enableMO = s.EnableMO;
        bool enableLO = s.EnableLO;
        bool enableSO = s.EnableSO;
        if (!enableMO && !enableLO && !enableSO)
            enableSO = true;

        bool enableLong = s.EnableLong;
        bool enableShort = s.EnableShort;
        if (!enableLong && !enableShort)
            enableLong = true;

        return s with
        {
            EnableMO = enableMO,
            EnableLO = enableLO,
            EnableSO = enableSO,
            EnableLong = enableLong,
            EnableShort = enableShort,
            StopLossAtrMultiplier = Round2(Clamp(s.StopLossAtrMultiplier, 0.10m, 2.00m)),
            TargetR = Round2(Clamp(s.TargetR, 0.50m, 5.00m)),
            Leverage = Round2(Clamp(leverage, 1m, 125m)),
            MarginUsdt = Round2(Clamp(margin, 1m, 10000000m)),
            TradeSizeUsdt = Round2(Clamp(margin, 1m, 10000000m) * Clamp(leverage, 1m, 125m)),
            TrailStopAtrMultiplier = Round2(Clamp(s.TrailStopAtrMultiplier, 0.10m, 5.00m)),
            TrailActivationR = Round2(Clamp(s.TrailActivationR, 0.25m, 5.00m)),
            MinimumLoScore = Round0(Clamp(s.MinimumLoScore, 0m, 100m)),
            MinimumSoScore = Round0(Clamp(s.MinimumSoScore, 0m, 100m)),
            MinimumMoScore = Round0(Clamp(s.MinimumMoScore, 0m, 100m)),
            RetestVolumeMultiplier = Round2(Clamp(s.RetestVolumeMultiplier, 0.10m, 10.00m)),
            BreakoutVolumeMultiplier = Round2(Clamp(s.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier, 0.10m, 10.00m)),
            MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent = Round0(Clamp(s.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent, 0m, 100m)),
            MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent = Round0(Clamp(s.MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent, 0m, 100m)),
            MinimumRejectionWickPercent = Round0(Clamp(s.MinimumRejectionWickPercent, 0m, 100m)),
            MaxRetestDistanceAtr = Round2(Clamp(s.MaxRetestDistanceAtr, 0.05m, 5.00m)),
            MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr = Round2(Clamp(s.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr, 0.05m, 5.00m))
        };
    }

    private static FindBestEdgeMetrics CalculateUltraFineMetrics(SrBacktestResult result)
    {
        List<SrTradeLogRow> rows = result.Rows;
        List<SrTradeLogRow> closed = rows
            .Where(x => x.ProfitR.HasValue && (x.Result == "WIN" || x.Result == "TRAIL_WIN" || x.Result == "LOSS"))
            .ToList();

        int placed = rows.Count(x => x.Status == SrTradeStatus.Placed);
        int closedCount = closed.Count;
        int wins = closed.Count(x => x.ProfitR!.Value > 0m);
        int losses = closed.Count(x => x.ProfitR!.Value < 0m);

        decimal netR = closed.Sum(x => x.ProfitR!.Value);
        decimal edge = closedCount > 0 ? closed.Average(x => x.ProfitR!.Value) : 0m;
        decimal winRate = closedCount > 0 ? wins * 100m / closedCount : 0m;

        decimal grossWin = closed.Where(x => x.ProfitR!.Value > 0m).Sum(x => x.ProfitR!.Value);
        decimal grossLoss = Math.Abs(closed.Where(x => x.ProfitR!.Value < 0m).Sum(x => x.ProfitR!.Value));
        decimal profitFactor = grossLoss > 0m ? grossWin / grossLoss : grossWin > 0m ? 999m : 0m;

        decimal avgMfe = closed.Where(x => x.MfeR.HasValue).Select(x => x.MfeR!.Value).DefaultIfEmpty(0m).Average();
        decimal avgMae = closed.Where(x => x.MaeR.HasValue).Select(x => Math.Abs(x.MaeR!.Value)).DefaultIfEmpty(0m).Average();
        decimal mfeMaeRatio = avgMae > 0m ? avgMfe / avgMae : avgMfe > 0m ? 999m : 0m;

        int highMae = closed.Count(x => x.MaeR.HasValue && Math.Abs(x.MaeR.Value) >= 0.80m);
        int weakEntry = closed.Count(x => ((x.TradeQualityGrade ?? string.Empty).Equals("WEAK", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)));

        decimal highMaePct = closedCount > 0 ? highMae * 100m / closedCount : 100m;
        decimal weakEntryPct = closedCount > 0 ? weakEntry * 100m / closedCount : 100m;

        decimal startEquity = result.Settings.StartEquityUsdt > 0m ? result.Settings.StartEquityUsdt : 1000m;
        decimal netProfitUsdt = rows.Where(x => x.PnlUsdt.HasValue).Sum(x => x.PnlUsdt!.Value);
        decimal finalEquity = startEquity + netProfitUsdt;
        decimal netProfitPct = startEquity > 0m ? netProfitUsdt / startEquity * 100m : 0m;

        bool directionOk = (netR >= 0m && netProfitUsdt >= 0m) || (netR <= 0m && netProfitUsdt <= 0m);
        decimal maxDdPct = CalculateMaxDrawdownPercent(rows, startEquity);

        bool passes =
            closedCount >= TargetMinimumClosedTrades &&
            edge >= TargetMinimumEdgeR &&
            profitFactor >= TargetMinimumProfitFactor &&
            highMaePct <= TargetMaximumHighMaePercent &&
            weakEntryPct <= TargetMaximumWeakEntryPercent &&
            maxDdPct <= TargetMaximumDrawdownPercent &&
            directionOk &&
            netProfitUsdt > 0m;

        decimal safePf = profitFactor >= 999m ? (closedCount >= TargetMinimumClosedTrades ? 5m : 1m) : Math.Min(profitFactor, 5m);
        decimal safeMfeMae = mfeMaeRatio >= 999m ? (closedCount >= TargetMinimumClosedTrades ? 5m : 1m) : Math.Min(mfeMaeRatio, 5m);

        // MORE TUNNING FAST is profit-first, but it still penalizes bad drawdown, weak entry quality, and poor MAE.
        decimal score = 0m;
        score += netProfitPct * 130m;
        score += edge * 900m;
        score += safePf * 110m;
        score += safeMfeMae * 70m;
        score += winRate * 4m;
        score += netR * 6m;
        score += Math.Min(400m, closedCount) * 1.5m;
        score -= maxDdPct * 35m;
        score -= highMaePct * 6m;
        score -= weakEntryPct * 8m;

        if (closedCount < TargetMinimumClosedTrades)
            score -= (TargetMinimumClosedTrades - closedCount) * 600m;

        if (netProfitUsdt <= 0m)
            score -= 100000m;

        if (!directionOk)
            score -= 5000m;

        if (passes)
            score += 15000m;

        return new FindBestEdgeMetrics(
            placed, closedCount, wins, losses, winRate, netR, edge, profitFactor,
            avgMfe, avgMae, mfeMaeRatio, highMaePct, weakEntryPct, maxDdPct,
            netProfitUsdt, netProfitPct, finalEquity, directionOk, passes, score);
    }

    private static decimal CalculateMaxDrawdownPercent(List<SrTradeLogRow> rows, decimal startEquity)
    {
        decimal peak = startEquity;
        decimal maxDd = 0m;

        foreach (SrTradeLogRow row in rows.Where(x => x.EquityAfterTradeUsdt.HasValue))
        {
            decimal equity = row.EquityAfterTradeUsdt!.Value;
            if (equity > peak)
                peak = equity;

            if (peak > 0m)
            {
                decimal dd = (peak - equity) / peak * 100m;
                if (dd > maxDd)
                    maxDd = dd;
            }
        }

        return maxDd;
    }

    private static decimal CalculateDailyProfitPercent(DateTime startUtc, DateTime endUtcExclusive, decimal totalProfitPercent)
    {
        double days = Math.Max(1.0, (endUtcExclusive - startUtc).TotalDays);
        double growth = 1.0 + ((double)totalProfitPercent / 100.0);

        if (growth <= 0.0)
            return totalProfitPercent / (decimal)days;

        return (decimal)((Math.Pow(growth, 1.0 / days) - 1.0) * 100.0);
    }

    private static string BuildDailyProfitFilePrefix(decimal dailyProfitPercent)
    {
        string sign = dailyProfitPercent >= 0m ? "P" : "N";
        decimal absolute = Math.Abs(dailyProfitPercent);
        string value = absolute.ToString("0.0000", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).Replace('.', 'p');
        return $"DAILY_{sign}{value}PCT";
    }

    private static void SaveResultFiles(
        string profileName,
        int totalTests,
        MoreTunningCandidateResult? best,
        List<MoreTunningCandidateResult> ranked,
        out string csvPath,
        out string configPath,
        out string summaryPath)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(MoreTunningReportPaths.Button13ReportFolder);

        string safeProfile = Sanitize(profileName);
        string stamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string dailyPrefix = best == null
            ? "DAILY_NA"
            : BuildDailyProfitFilePrefix(CalculateDailyProfitPercent(best.StartUtc, best.EndUtcExclusive, best.Metrics.NetProfitPercent));
        string baseName = $"{dailyPrefix}__MORE_TUNNING_V8_8_6_DOUBLE_RANGE_96_TESTS__{safeProfile}__{stamp}";

        csvPath = Path.Combine(MoreTunningReportPaths.Button13ReportFolder, baseName + "__TOP_50_FAST_RESULTS.csv");
        configPath = Path.Combine(MoreTunningReportPaths.Button13ReportFolder, baseName + "__BEST_FAST_TUNED_PROFILE.config.txt");
        summaryPath = Path.Combine(MoreTunningReportPaths.Button13ReportFolder, baseName + "__FAST_SUMMARY.txt");

        File.WriteAllText(csvPath, BuildCsv(ranked), Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(configPath, best == null ? "No ultra-fine profile found." : BuildConfig(best), Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(summaryPath, BuildSummary(profileName, totalTests, best), Encoding.UTF8);
    }

    {

        foreach (MoreTunningCandidateResult r in rows)
        {

            FindBestEdgeMetrics m = r.Metrics;

            {

                m.MaxDrawdownPercent.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.NetProfitUsdt.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.NetProfitPercent.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.FinalEquityUsdt.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.Score.ToString("0.####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.EnableMO.ToString(), s.EnableLO.ToString(), s.EnableSO.ToString(), s.EnableLong.ToString(), s.EnableShort.ToString(),
                s.StopLossAtrMultiplier.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),

            }.Select(EscapeCsv)));

    private static string BuildSummary(string profileName, int totalTests, MoreTunningCandidateResult? best)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("MORE TUNNING V8.8.5 DOUBLE-RANGE 96-TEST SUMMARY");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Profile       : {profileName}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated UTC : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Total Tests   : {totalTests}");
        sb.AppendLine("Mode          : Double-range local tuning around current selected alpha; 96 tests per selected symbol/timeframe/date range");
        sb.AppendLine("Important     : This is research validation, not live execution proof.");
        sb.AppendLine();

        if (best == null)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("No valid fast-tuned result found.");
            return sb.ToString();
        }

        sb.AppendLine("BEST FAST-TUNED RESULT");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine(BuildConfig(best));
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("CLASSIFICATION");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine(Classify(best.Metrics));
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static string Classify(FindBestEdgeMetrics m)
    {
        if (m.NetProfitUsdt <= 0m || m.EdgeR <= 0m || m.ProfitFactor < 1.05m)
            return "REJECT";

        if (m.MaxDrawdownPercent > 12m || m.HighMaePercent > 35m)
            return "HIGH RISK";

        if (m.PassesTarget && m.EdgeR >= 0.20m && m.ProfitFactor >= 1.50m && m.MaxDrawdownPercent <= 5m)
            return "PASS";

        if (m.PassesTarget)
            return "RESEARCH PASS";

        return "PROMISING";
    }

    }

    }

        });
    }

    private static decimal Clamp(decimal value, decimal min, decimal max)
    {
        if (value < min)
            return min;

        if (value > max)
            return max;

        return value;
    }

    private static decimal Round2(decimal value) => Math.Round(value, 2, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
    private static decimal Round0(decimal value) => Math.Round(value, 0, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);

    private static string EscapeCsv(string value)
    {
        value ??= string.Empty;
        if (value.Contains(',') || value.Contains('"') || value.Contains('\n') || value.Contains('\r'))
            return "\"" + value.Replace("\"", "\"\"") + "\"";
        return value;
    }

    private static string Sanitize(string value)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
            return "MORE_TUNNING_PROFILE";

        foreach (char c in Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars())
            value = value.Replace(c, '_');

        return value.Replace(' ', '_').Trim('_');
    }
