using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Drawing.Drawing2D;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows.Forms;
using TQGA.Domain.Market;

namespace TQGA.WinForms;

internal sealed record ChartMarketCandles(
    string Symbol,
    string Timeframe,
    DateTime VisibleFromUtc,
    DateTime VisibleToUtcExclusive,
    List<Candle> Candles)
{
    public SrTradeBacktestSettings TradeSettings { get; init; } = SrTradeBacktestSettings.Default;
}

internal sealed class June2026TradingViewChartForm : Form
{
    public June2026TradingViewChartForm(List<ChartMarketCandles> charts)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(charts);

        Text = "TQGA - TradingView Style Date Range Charts";
        StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterScreen;
        WindowState = FormWindowState.Maximized;
        BackColor = Color.White;

        var tabs = new TabControl
        {
            Dock = DockStyle.Fill
        };

        foreach (ChartMarketCandles chart in charts)
        {
            string fromLabel = chart.VisibleFromUtc.ToString("dd MMM yyyy", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            string toLabel = chart.VisibleToUtcExclusive.AddDays(-1).ToString("dd MMM yyyy", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

            var page = new TabPage($"{chart.Symbol} {chart.Timeframe}")
            {
                BackColor = Color.White,
                ToolTipText = $"{chart.Symbol} {chart.Timeframe} | {fromLabel} to {toLabel}"
            };

            var panel = new CandleChartPanel(chart)
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Fill
            };

            page.Controls.Add(panel);
            tabs.TabPages.Add(page);
        }

        Controls.Add(tabs);
    }

    private sealed class CandleChartPanel : Control
    {
        private readonly ChartMarketCandles _chart;

        // Trade Backtest Cache
        private SrBacktestResult? _tradeBacktestResult;
        private string? _tradeBacktestCacheKey;
        private string? _lastTradeSummaryPopupKey;

        // Manual Scale State
        private bool _isManualScaleActive = false;
        private decimal? _manualMinPrice = null;
        private decimal? _manualMaxPrice = null;
        private int _manualVisibleStart = 0;
        private int _manualVisibleEnd = -1;

        // Mouse Dragging State
        private bool _isDraggingPriceAxis = false;
        private bool _isDraggingTimeAxis = false;
        private Point _lastMousePosition = Point.Empty;
        private const int AxisDragTolerance = 20; // pixels to detect axis drag

        public CandleChartPanel(ChartMarketCandles chart)
        {
            _chart = chart;

            BackColor = Color.White;
            ForeColor = Color.Black;
            DoubleBuffered = true;

            SetStyle(
                ControlStyles.AllPaintingInWmPaint |
                ControlStyles.UserPaint |
                ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer |
                ControlStyles.ResizeRedraw,
                true);
        }

        protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs e)
        {
            base.OnPaint(e);

            Graphics g = e.Graphics;
            g.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
            g.Clear(Color.White);

            List<Candle> allCandles = _chart.Candles.OrderBy(c => c.Time).ToList();
            List<Candle> visibleCandles = allCandles
                .Where(c => c.Time >= _chart.VisibleFromUtc && c.Time < _chart.VisibleToUtcExclusive)
                .OrderBy(c => c.Time)
                .ToList();

            using var titleBrush = new SolidBrush(Color.Black);
            using var mutedBrush = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(95, 105, 120));
            using var gridPen = new Pen(Color.FromArgb(70, 80, 95), 1f);
            using var borderPen = new Pen(Color.FromArgb(60, 70, 85), 1f);
            using var upBrush = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(0, 170, 130));
            using var downBrush = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(230, 70, 80));
            using var upPen = new Pen(Color.FromArgb(0, 170, 130), 1.2f);
            using var downPen = new Pen(Color.FromArgb(230, 70, 80), 1.2f);
            using var volumeUpBrush = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(65, 0, 170, 130));
            using var volumeDownBrush = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(65, 230, 70, 80));
            using var titleFont = new Font("Segoe UI", 11f, FontStyle.Bold);
            using var axisFont = new Font("Segoe UI", 8.5f, FontStyle.Regular);

            if (visibleCandles.Count == 0)
            {
                g.DrawString("No candles available in selected date range.", titleFont, titleBrush, new PointF(20, 20));
                return;
            }

            SrBacktestResult tradeResult = GetOrRunTradeBacktest(visibleCandles);

            int leftPad = 82;
            int rightPad = 35;
            int topPad = 42;
            int bottomPad = 95;
            int volumeHeight = 95;
            int gap = 12;

            Rectangle priceRect = new(leftPad, topPad, Math.Max(120, Width - leftPad - rightPad), Math.Max(120, Height - topPad - bottomPad - volumeHeight - gap));
            Rectangle volumeRect = new(leftPad, priceRect.Bottom + gap, priceRect.Width, volumeHeight);

            decimal minPrice, maxPrice;

            // Use manual scale if active, otherwise auto scale
            if (_isManualScaleActive && _manualMinPrice.HasValue && _manualMaxPrice.HasValue)
            {
                minPrice = _manualMinPrice.Value;
                maxPrice = _manualMaxPrice.Value;
            }
            else
            {
                minPrice = visibleCandles.Min(c => c.Low);
                maxPrice = visibleCandles.Max(c => c.High);
                if (maxPrice <= minPrice) maxPrice = minPrice + 1m;

                decimal priceRange = maxPrice - minPrice;
                decimal pricePadding = priceRange * 0.05m;
                minPrice -= pricePadding;
                maxPrice += pricePadding;
            }

            decimal maxVolume = visibleCandles.Max(c => c.Volume);
            if (maxVolume <= 0m) maxVolume = 1m;

            string fromLabel = _chart.VisibleFromUtc.ToString("dd MMM yyyy", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            string toLabel = _chart.VisibleToUtcExclusive.AddDays(-1).ToString("dd MMM yyyy", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            g.DrawString($"{_chart.Symbol}   {_chart.Timeframe}  |  {fromLabel} to {toLabel}", titleFont, titleBrush, new PointF(leftPad, 12));

            DrawGridAndPriceAxis(g, priceRect, minPrice, maxPrice, gridPen, borderPen, axisFont, mutedBrush);
            DrawRollingDynamicSrStepBars(g, priceRect, minPrice, maxPrice, allCandles, visibleCandles, _chart.Timeframe, axisFont, mutedBrush);
            DrawTimeAxis(g, visibleCandles, priceRect, volumeRect, gridPen, axisFont, mutedBrush);
            DrawCandles(g, visibleCandles, priceRect, minPrice, maxPrice, upBrush, downBrush, upPen, downPen);
            DrawVolume(g, visibleCandles, volumeRect, maxVolume, volumeUpBrush, volumeDownBrush, borderPen, axisFont, mutedBrush);

            DrawTradeMarkers(
                g,
                visibleCandles,
                priceRect,
                minPrice,
                maxPrice,
                tradeResult.Rows,
                axisFont);

            DrawTradeLogSummary(
                g,
                priceRect,
                tradeResult,
                axisFont);

            // Draw scale mode indicator
            string modeText = _isManualScaleActive ? "Manual Scale (Double-click to reset)" : "Auto Scale";
            using var modeFont = new Font("Segoe UI", 9f, FontStyle.Regular);
            using var modeBrush = new SolidBrush(_isManualScaleActive ? Color.FromArgb(200, 100, 150) : Color.FromArgb(100, 150, 100));
            g.DrawString(modeText, modeFont, modeBrush, new PointF(priceRect.Right - 200, priceRect.Top + 5));
        }

        protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e)
        {
            base.OnMouseDown(e);
            _lastMousePosition = e.Location;

            // Detect if clicking on price axis (left side, within ~20px)
            if (e.Location.X < AxisDragTolerance && e.Location.Y > 50 && e.Location.Y < Height - 100)
            {
                _isDraggingPriceAxis = true;
            }
            // Detect if clicking on time axis (bottom, within ~20px)
            else if (e.Location.Y > Height - AxisDragTolerance - 20 && e.Location.X > 80)
            {
                _isDraggingTimeAxis = true;
            }

            // Double-click to reset to auto scale
            if (e.Clicks == 2)
            {
                ResetToAutoScale();
            }
        }

        protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
        {
            base.OnMouseMove(e);

            if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left && (_isDraggingPriceAxis || _isDraggingTimeAxis))
            {
                _isManualScaleActive = true;

                // Initialize manual scale on first drag
                if (!_manualMinPrice.HasValue || !_manualMaxPrice.HasValue)
                {
                    var visibleCandles = _chart.Candles
                        .Where(c => c.Time >= _chart.VisibleFromUtc && c.Time < _chart.VisibleToUtcExclusive)
                        .ToList();

                    decimal minPrice = visibleCandles.Min(c => c.Low);
                    decimal maxPrice = visibleCandles.Max(c => c.High);
                    decimal priceRange = maxPrice - minPrice;
                    decimal pricePadding = priceRange * 0.05m;

                    _manualMinPrice = minPrice - pricePadding;
                    _manualMaxPrice = maxPrice + pricePadding;
                }

                int deltaX = e.Location.X - _lastMousePosition.X;
                int deltaY = e.Location.Y - _lastMousePosition.Y;

                // Price axis drag (vertical) - pan price up/down
                if (_isDraggingPriceAxis && deltaY != 0)
                {
                    decimal priceRange = _manualMaxPrice.Value - _manualMinPrice.Value;
                    int chartHeight = Height - 150;
                    decimal pricePerPixel = priceRange / chartHeight;
                    decimal priceDelta = -deltaY * pricePerPixel; // negative because down = lower prices

                    _manualMinPrice += priceDelta;
                    _manualMaxPrice += priceDelta;
                }

                // Time axis drag (horizontal) - zoom in/out
                if (_isDraggingTimeAxis && deltaX != 0)
                {
                    int visibleCount = _chart.Candles.Count(c =>
                        c.Time >= _chart.VisibleFromUtc && c.Time < _chart.VisibleToUtcExclusive);

                    // Zoom: drag left = zoom in, drag right = zoom out
                    decimal zoomFactor = 1m + (deltaX * 0.01m);
                    decimal priceRange = _manualMaxPrice.Value - _manualMinPrice.Value;
                    decimal centerPrice = (_manualMinPrice.Value + _manualMaxPrice.Value) / 2m;
                    decimal newRange = priceRange / zoomFactor;

                    _manualMinPrice = centerPrice - (newRange / 2m);
                    _manualMaxPrice = centerPrice + (newRange / 2m);
                }

                Invalidate();
            }

            _lastMousePosition = e.Location;
        }

        protected override void OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
        {
            base.OnMouseUp(e);
            _isDraggingPriceAxis = false;
            _isDraggingTimeAxis = false;
        }

        private void ResetToAutoScale()
        {
            _isManualScaleActive = false;
            _manualMinPrice = null;
            _manualMaxPrice = null;
            _manualVisibleStart = 0;
            _manualVisibleEnd = -1;
            Invalidate();
        }


        private SrBacktestResult GetOrRunTradeBacktest(List<Candle> visibleCandles)
        {
            string key =
                $"{_chart.Symbol}|{_chart.Timeframe}|{_chart.VisibleFromUtc:yyyyMMddHHmmss}|{_chart.VisibleToUtcExclusive:yyyyMMddHHmmss}|{visibleCandles.Count}|{visibleCandles.FirstOrDefault()?.Time:O}|{visibleCandles.LastOrDefault()?.Time:O}";

            if (_tradeBacktestResult != null && _tradeBacktestCacheKey == key)
                return _tradeBacktestResult;

            var engine = new SrTradeBacktestEngine();

            _tradeBacktestResult = engine.Run(
                _chart.Symbol,
                _chart.Timeframe,
                _chart.VisibleFromUtc,
                _chart.VisibleToUtcExclusive,
                visibleCandles,
                _chart.TradeSettings);

            _tradeBacktestCacheKey = key;

            ShowTradeExecutiveSummaryPopupOnce(key, _tradeBacktestResult);

            return _tradeBacktestResult;
        }

        private void ShowTradeExecutiveSummaryPopupOnce(
            string key,
            SrBacktestResult result)
        {
            if (_lastTradeSummaryPopupKey == key)
                return;

            _lastTradeSummaryPopupKey = key;

            BeginInvoke(new Action(() =>
            {
                string executiveSummary = SrTradeBacktestEngine.BuildExecutiveSummaryText(result);

                try
                {
                    Clipboard.SetText(executiveSummary);
                }
                catch
                {
                    // Clipboard can be temporarily locked by Windows/another app.
                    // Do not block chart/result display if clipboard copy fails.
                }

                MessageBox.Show(
                    FindForm(),
                    executiveSummary,
                    "TQGA SR Trade Executive Summary - copied to clipboard",
                    MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                    MessageBoxIcon.Information);
            }));
        }

        private static void DrawTradeMarkers(
            Graphics g,
            List<Candle> visibleCandles,
            Rectangle priceRect,
            decimal minPrice,
            decimal maxPrice,
            List<SrTradeLogRow> rows,
            Font labelFont)
        {
            if (visibleCandles.Count == 0 || rows.Count == 0)
                return;

            Dictionary<DateTime, int> indexByTime = new();

            for (int i = 0; i < visibleCandles.Count; i++)
                indexByTime[visibleCandles[i].Time] = i;

            using var entryBrush = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(30, 30, 30));
            using var longBrush = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(0, 130, 80));
            using var shortBrush = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(180, 40, 50));
            using var slPen = new Pen(Color.FromArgb(230, 40, 50), 1.3f) { DashStyle = DashStyle.Dash };
            using var tpPen = new Pen(Color.FromArgb(0, 150, 90), 1.3f) { DashStyle = DashStyle.Dash };

            foreach (SrTradeLogRow row in rows.Where(x => x.Status == SrTradeStatus.Placed))
            {
                if (!indexByTime.TryGetValue(row.SignalTime, out int signalIndex))
                    continue;

                if (!row.Entry.HasValue || !row.StopLoss.HasValue || !row.TakeProfit.HasValue)
                    continue;

                float x = MapX(signalIndex, visibleCandles.Count, priceRect);
                float yEntry = MapY(row.Entry.Value, minPrice, maxPrice, priceRect);
                float ySl = MapY(row.StopLoss.Value, minPrice, maxPrice, priceRect);
                float yTp = MapY(row.TakeProfit.Value, minPrice, maxPrice, priceRect);

                Brush markerBrush = row.Direction == SrTradeDirection.Long ? longBrush : shortBrush;

                PointF[] triangle = row.Direction == SrTradeDirection.Long
                    ? new[]
                    {
                        new PointF(x, yEntry - 8),
                        new PointF(x - 6, yEntry + 6),
                        new PointF(x + 6, yEntry + 6)
                    }
                    : new[]
                    {
                        new PointF(x, yEntry + 8),
                        new PointF(x - 6, yEntry - 6),
                        new PointF(x + 6, yEntry - 6)
                    };

                g.FillPolygon(markerBrush, triangle);

                float x2 = Math.Min(priceRect.Right, x + 70);
                g.DrawLine(slPen, x, ySl, x2, ySl);
                g.DrawLine(tpPen, x, yTp, x2, yTp);

                string label = $"{row.OrderType} {row.Direction} {row.Result} {row.ProfitR:0.##}R";

                g.DrawString(
                    label,
                    labelFont,
                    entryBrush,
                    new PointF(Math.Min(priceRect.Right - 170, x + 8), yEntry - 18));
            }
        }

        private static void DrawTradeLogSummary(
            Graphics g,
            Rectangle priceRect,
            SrBacktestResult result,
            Font font)
        {
            int placed = result.Rows.Count(x => x.Status == SrTradeStatus.Placed);
            int missed = result.Rows.Count(x => x.Status == SrTradeStatus.Missed);
            decimal netR = result.Rows.Where(x => x.ProfitR.HasValue).Sum(x => x.ProfitR!.Value);

            decimal startEquity = result.Settings.StartEquityUsdt;
            decimal endEquity = result.Rows.LastOrDefault()?.EndEquityUsdt ?? startEquity;
            decimal profitPct = startEquity > 0m ? ((endEquity - startEquity) / startEquity) * 100m : 0m;
            decimal edge = placed > 0 ? netR / placed : 0m;
            decimal avgMfe = result.Rows.Where(x => x.MfeR.HasValue).Select(x => x.MfeR!.Value).DefaultIfEmpty(0m).Average();
            decimal avgMae = result.Rows.Where(x => x.MaeR.HasValue).Select(x => x.MaeR!.Value).DefaultIfEmpty(0m).Average();

            string text =
                $"Trades: {placed} | Missed: {missed} | NetR: {netR:0.00} | Edge: {edge:0.000}R | MFE/MAE: {avgMfe:0.00}/{avgMae:0.00}R | Equity: {startEquity:0}→{endEquity:0.00} ({profitPct:0.00}%) | BestR: {result.BestR:0.0} | Logs saved";

            using var brush = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(80, 80, 80));

            g.DrawString(
                text,
                font,
                brush,
                new PointF(priceRect.Left + 10, priceRect.Bottom + 5));
        }

        private static void DrawGridAndPriceAxis(Graphics g, Rectangle priceRect, decimal minPrice, decimal maxPrice, Pen gridPen, Pen borderPen, Font axisFont, Brush labelBrush)
        {
            g.DrawRectangle(borderPen, priceRect);
            const int horizontalLines = 6;
            for (int i = 0; i <= horizontalLines; i++)
            {
                float y = priceRect.Top + (priceRect.Height * i / (float)horizontalLines);
                g.DrawLine(gridPen, priceRect.Left, y, priceRect.Right, y);
                decimal price = maxPrice - ((maxPrice - minPrice) * i / horizontalLines);
                string formattedPrice = FormatPriceWithSmartDecimals(price);
                g.DrawString(formattedPrice, axisFont, labelBrush, new PointF(6, y - 8));
            }
        }

        private static void DrawTimeAxis(Graphics g, List<Candle> candles, Rectangle priceRect, Rectangle volumeRect, Pen gridPen, Font axisFont, Brush labelBrush)
        {
            int count = candles.Count;
            if (count == 0) return;
            int labels = Math.Min(8, count);
            int step = Math.Max(1, count / labels);
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i += step)
            {
                float x = MapX(i, count, priceRect);
                g.DrawLine(gridPen, x, priceRect.Top, x, volumeRect.Bottom);
                string label = candles[i].Time.ToString("dd MMM", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                g.DrawString(label, axisFont, labelBrush, new PointF(x - 18, volumeRect.Bottom + 8));
            }
        }

        private static void DrawCandles(Graphics g, List<Candle> candles, Rectangle priceRect, decimal minPrice, decimal maxPrice, Brush upBrush, Brush downBrush, Pen upPen, Pen downPen)
        {
            int count = candles.Count;
            if (count == 0) return;
            float step = priceRect.Width / (float)Math.Max(1, count);
            float bodyWidth = Math.Max(2f, Math.Min(14f, step * 0.65f));
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            {
                Candle c = candles[i];
                bool up = c.Close >= c.Open;
                Pen pen = up ? upPen : downPen;
                Brush brush = up ? upBrush : downBrush;
                float x = MapX(i, count, priceRect);
                float yHigh = MapY(c.High, minPrice, maxPrice, priceRect);
                float yLow = MapY(c.Low, minPrice, maxPrice, priceRect);
                float yOpen = MapY(c.Open, minPrice, maxPrice, priceRect);
                float yClose = MapY(c.Close, minPrice, maxPrice, priceRect);
                g.DrawLine(pen, x, yHigh, x, yLow);
                float bodyTop = Math.Min(yOpen, yClose);
                float bodyHeight = Math.Abs(yOpen - yClose);
                if (bodyHeight < 1f) bodyHeight = 1f;
                RectangleF body = new(x - (bodyWidth / 2f), bodyTop, bodyWidth, bodyHeight);
                g.FillRectangle(brush, body);
            }
        }

        private static void DrawVolume(Graphics g, List<Candle> candles, Rectangle volumeRect, decimal maxVolume, Brush volumeUpBrush, Brush volumeDownBrush, Pen borderPen, Font axisFont, Brush labelBrush)
        {
            int count = candles.Count;
            if (count == 0) return;
            g.DrawRectangle(borderPen, volumeRect);
            float step = volumeRect.Width / (float)Math.Max(1, count);
            float barWidth = Math.Max(2f, Math.Min(14f, step * 0.65f));
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            {
                Candle c = candles[i];
                Brush brush = c.Close >= c.Open ? volumeUpBrush : volumeDownBrush;
                float x = MapX(i, count, volumeRect);
                float h = (float)(c.Volume / maxVolume) * volumeRect.Height;
                if (h < 1f && c.Volume > 0m) h = 1f;
                RectangleF bar = new(x - (barWidth / 2f), volumeRect.Bottom - h, barWidth, h);
                g.FillRectangle(brush, bar);
            }
            g.DrawString("Volume", axisFont, labelBrush, new PointF(volumeRect.Left + 5, volumeRect.Top + 5));
        }

        private static void DrawRollingDynamicSrStepBars(Graphics g, Rectangle priceRect, decimal minPrice, decimal maxPrice, List<Candle> allCandles, List<Candle> visibleCandles, string timeframe, Font labelFont, Brush labelBrush)
        {
            if (allCandles == null || visibleCandles == null || allCandles.Count < 30 || visibleCandles.Count == 0) return;
            int visibleCount = visibleCandles.Count;
            int srUpdateEvery = visibleCount > 5000 ? 25 : visibleCount > 2000 ? 10 : visibleCount > 1000 ? 5 : 1;
            Dictionary<DateTime, int> allIndexByTime = new();
            for (int i = 0; i < allCandles.Count; i++) allIndexByTime[allCandles[i].Time] = i;
            DynamicSrSnapshot? latestSnapshot = null;
            using var resFill = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(32, 230, 70, 80));
            using var supFill = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(32, 80, 140, 230));
            using var resPen = new Pen(Color.FromArgb(220, 230, 70, 80), 1.2f) { DashStyle = DashStyle.Solid };
            using var supPen = new Pen(Color.FromArgb(220, 80, 140, 230), 1.2f) { DashStyle = DashStyle.Solid };

            // IMPORTANT: Always process the first candle (index 0) to ensure initial SR bars are drawn properly
            var positionsToProcess = new HashSet<int> { 0 };
            for (int visibleStart = srUpdateEvery; visibleStart < visibleCount; visibleStart += srUpdateEvery)
            {
                positionsToProcess.Add(visibleStart);
            }

            foreach (int visibleStart in positionsToProcess.OrderBy(x => x))
            {
                Candle visibleCandle = visibleCandles[visibleStart];
                if (!allIndexByTime.TryGetValue(visibleCandle.Time, out int activeIndex)) continue;
                (decimal? support, decimal? resistance, decimal zoneHalfWidth) = CalculateDynamicSrAtIndex(allCandles, activeIndex, timeframe);
                int visibleEnd = Math.Min(visibleStart + srUpdateEvery - 1, visibleCount - 1);
                float x1 = MapSlotLeft(visibleStart, visibleCount, priceRect);
                float x2 = MapSlotRight(visibleEnd, visibleCount, priceRect);
                if (resistance.HasValue && zoneHalfWidth > 0m) DrawSrStepSegment(g, priceRect, minPrice, maxPrice, x1, x2, resistance.Value, zoneHalfWidth, resFill, resPen);
                if (support.HasValue && zoneHalfWidth > 0m) DrawSrStepSegment(g, priceRect, minPrice, maxPrice, x1, x2, support.Value, zoneHalfWidth, supFill, supPen);
                latestSnapshot = new DynamicSrSnapshot(visibleEnd, support, resistance, zoneHalfWidth);
            }
            if (latestSnapshot != null) DrawLatestSrLabels(g, priceRect, minPrice, maxPrice, latestSnapshot, labelFont, labelBrush);
        }

        private static (decimal? Support, decimal? Resistance, decimal ZoneHalfWidth) CalculateDynamicSrAtIndex(List<Candle> candles, int activeIndex, string timeframe)
        {
            int lookbackCandles = GetSrLookbackCandles(timeframe);
            const int pivotStrength = 3;
            if (activeIndex < 0 || activeIndex >= candles.Count) return (null, null, 0m);
            int startIndex = Math.Max(0, activeIndex - lookbackCandles);
            List<Candle> window = candles.Skip(startIndex).Take(activeIndex - startIndex + 1).ToList();
            if (window.Count < 30) return (null, null, 0m);

            // Use the current candle's high/low for boundary comparison, not just close
            decimal currentLow = candles[activeIndex].Low;
            decimal currentHigh = candles[activeIndex].High;
            decimal currentPrice = candles[activeIndex].Close;

            decimal atr = CalculateAtr(window, 14);
            decimal localMin = window.Min(c => c.Low);
            decimal localMax = window.Max(c => c.High);
            decimal localRange = localMax - localMin;
            if (localRange <= 0m) return (null, null, 0m);
            decimal zoneHalfWidth = Math.Max(atr * 0.35m, localRange * 0.0025m);
            if (zoneHalfWidth <= 0m) zoneHalfWidth = currentPrice * 0.001m;
            var pivots = new List<SrPivot>();
            // Allow detecting pivots near the window edges by checking available neighbors only.
            for (int i = 0; i < window.Count; i++)
            {
                bool isSwingHigh = true;
                bool isSwingLow = true;
                int availableChecks = 0;
                for (int j = 1; j <= pivotStrength; j++)
                {
                    if (i - j >= 0)
                    {
                        availableChecks++;
                        if (window[i].High <= window[i - j].High) isSwingHigh = false;
                        if (window[i].Low >= window[i - j].Low) isSwingLow = false;
                    }
                    if (i + j < window.Count)
                    {
                        availableChecks++;
                        if (window[i].High <= window[i + j].High) isSwingHigh = false;
                        if (window[i].Low >= window[i + j].Low) isSwingLow = false;
                    }
                }

                // Require at least one comparison to consider a pivot (avoids isolated single-bar windows)
                if (availableChecks == 0)
                    continue;

                int realIndex = startIndex + i;
                if (isSwingHigh) pivots.Add(new SrPivot(window[i].High, realIndex, true));
                if (isSwingLow) pivots.Add(new SrPivot(window[i].Low, realIndex, false));
            }
            if (pivots.Count == 0) return (null, null, zoneHalfWidth);
            List<SrLevel> levels = BuildDynamicSrLevels(pivots, currentPrice, activeIndex, zoneHalfWidth);

            // Support should be below the current LOW, Resistance should be above the current HIGH
            SrLevel? support = levels.Where(x => !x.IsResistance && x.Price < currentLow).OrderByDescending(x => x.Score).FirstOrDefault();
            SrLevel? resistance = levels.Where(x => x.IsResistance && x.Price > currentHigh).OrderByDescending(x => x.Score).FirstOrDefault();
            return (support?.Price, resistance?.Price, zoneHalfWidth);
        }

        private static List<SrLevel> BuildDynamicSrLevels(List<SrPivot> pivots, decimal currentPrice, int activeIndex, decimal zoneHalfWidth)
        {
            var groups = new List<List<SrPivot>>();
            foreach (SrPivot pivot in pivots.OrderBy(x => x.Price))
            {
                List<SrPivot>? group = groups
                    .Where(g => g.Count > 0 && g[0].IsResistance == pivot.IsResistance && Math.Abs(g.Average(x => x.Price) - pivot.Price) <= zoneHalfWidth * 2m)
                    .OrderBy(g => Math.Abs(g.Average(x => x.Price) - pivot.Price))
                    .FirstOrDefault();
                if (group == null)
                {
                    group = new List<SrPivot>();
                    groups.Add(group);
                }
                group.Add(pivot);
            }
            var levels = new List<SrLevel>();
            foreach (List<SrPivot> group in groups)
            {
                decimal price = group.Average(x => x.Price);
                int touches = group.Count;
                int lastTouchIndex = group.Max(x => x.Index);
                bool isResistance = group[0].IsResistance;
                decimal distanceFromCurrent = Math.Abs(price - currentPrice);
                decimal touchScore = touches * 10m;
                decimal recencyScore = 100m / Math.Max(1, activeIndex - lastTouchIndex);
                decimal distanceScore = zoneHalfWidth / Math.Max(distanceFromCurrent, zoneHalfWidth);
                decimal score = touchScore + recencyScore + (distanceScore * 5m);
                levels.Add(new SrLevel(price, isResistance, touches, lastTouchIndex, score));
            }
            return levels;
        }

        private static void DrawSrStepSegment(Graphics g, Rectangle priceRect, decimal minPrice, decimal maxPrice, float x1, float x2, decimal level, decimal zoneHalfWidth, Brush fillBrush, Pen linePen)
        {
            decimal upper = level + zoneHalfWidth;
            decimal lower = level - zoneHalfWidth;
            if (upper <= minPrice || lower >= maxPrice) return;
            float yTop = MapY(upper, minPrice, maxPrice, priceRect);
            float yBottom = MapY(lower, minPrice, maxPrice, priceRect);
            float yCenter = MapY(level, minPrice, maxPrice, priceRect);
            float rectTop = Math.Min(yTop, yBottom);
            float rectHeight = Math.Abs(yBottom - yTop);
            if (rectHeight < 3f) rectHeight = 3f;
            float width = Math.Max(1f, x2 - x1);
            RectangleF zoneRect = new(x1, rectTop, width, rectHeight);
            g.FillRectangle(fillBrush, zoneRect);
            g.DrawLine(linePen, x1, yCenter, x2, yCenter);
        }

        private static void DrawLatestSrLabels(Graphics g, Rectangle priceRect, decimal minPrice, decimal maxPrice, DynamicSrSnapshot latestSnapshot, Font labelFont, Brush labelBrush)
        {
            // Draw S/R labels at the top of the chart (above the price area), not overlapping the chart
            int labelY = priceRect.Top - 22;
            int labelX = priceRect.Left + 10;

            string srText = "";
            if (latestSnapshot.Support.HasValue)
            {
                decimal s = latestSnapshot.Support.Value;
                string formattedS = FormatPriceWithSmartDecimals(s);
                srText += $"S: {formattedS}";
            }

            if (latestSnapshot.Resistance.HasValue)
            {
                decimal r = latestSnapshot.Resistance.Value;
                string formattedR = FormatPriceWithSmartDecimals(r);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(srText))
                    srText += "  |  ";
                srText += $"R: {formattedR}";
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(srText))
            {
                g.DrawString(srText, labelFont, labelBrush, new PointF(labelX, labelY));
            }
        }

        private static decimal CalculateAtr(List<Candle> candles, int period)
        {
            if (candles.Count < 2) return 0m;
            var trueRanges = new List<decimal>();
            for (int i = 1; i < candles.Count; i++)
            {
                Candle current = candles[i];
                Candle previous = candles[i - 1];
                decimal tr1 = current.High - current.Low;
                decimal tr2 = Math.Abs(current.High - previous.Close);
                decimal tr3 = Math.Abs(current.Low - previous.Close);
                trueRanges.Add(Math.Max(tr1, Math.Max(tr2, tr3)));
            }
            return trueRanges.TakeLast(Math.Min(period, trueRanges.Count)).DefaultIfEmpty(0m).Average();
        }

        private static int GetSrLookbackCandles(string timeframe)
        {
            return timeframe.Trim().ToLowerInvariant() switch
            {
                "1m" => 800,
                "3m" => 600,
                "5m" => 500,
                "15m" => 400,
                "30m" => 300,
                "1h" => 240,
                "2h" => 180,
                "4h" => 120,
                "6h" => 100,
                "8h" => 90,
                "12h" => 80,
                "1d" => 90,
                _ => 120
            };
        }

        private static float MapX(int index, int count, Rectangle rect)
        {
            if (count <= 1) return rect.Left + (rect.Width / 2f);
            return rect.Left + ((index + 0.5f) * rect.Width / count);
        }

        private static float MapSlotLeft(int index, int count, Rectangle rect)
        {
            if (count <= 0) return rect.Left;
            return rect.Left + (index * rect.Width / (float)count);
        }

        private static float MapSlotRight(int index, int count, Rectangle rect)
        {
            if (count <= 0) return rect.Left;
            return rect.Left + ((index + 1) * rect.Width / (float)count);
        }

        private static float MapY(decimal price, decimal minPrice, decimal maxPrice, Rectangle rect)
        {
            decimal range = maxPrice - minPrice;
            if (range <= 0m) return rect.Bottom;
            decimal normalized = (price - minPrice) / range;
            return rect.Bottom - ((float)normalized * rect.Height);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Formats price with intelligent decimal places based on magnitude.
        /// Examples: 70000 → "70000.0", 5.234 → "5.23", 0.0001234 → "0.00012"
        /// Logic: Smaller values get more decimal places, larger values get fewer
        /// </summary>
        private static string FormatPriceWithSmartDecimals(decimal price)
        {
            price = Math.Abs(price); // Work with absolute value

            if (price >= 10000m)
                return price.ToString("0.0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);           // 70000 → 70000.0
            else if (price >= 1000m)
                return price.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);          // 5234 → 5234.00
            else if (price >= 100m)
                return price.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);          // 234.5 → 234.50
            else if (price >= 10m)
                return price.ToString("0.000", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);         // 23.45 → 23.450
            else if (price >= 1m)
                return price.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);          // 5.234 → 5.23
            else if (price >= 0.01m)
                return price.ToString("0.0000", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);        // 0.5234 → 0.5234
            else if (price >= 0.0001m)
                return price.ToString("0.00000", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);       // 0.001234 → 0.00123
            else
                return price.ToString("0.0########", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);   // Very small numbers
        }

        private sealed record DynamicSrSnapshot(int DisplayIndex, decimal? Support, decimal? Resistance, decimal ZoneHalfWidth);
        private sealed record SrPivot(decimal Price, int Index, bool IsResistance);
        private sealed record SrLevel(decimal Price, bool IsResistance, int Touches, int LastTouchIndex, decimal Score);
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using System;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace TQGA.WinForms;

public sealed class MainForm : Form
{
    private readonly IServiceProvider _sp;

        _rightButtonPanel.FlowDirection = FlowDirection.TopDown;
        _rightButtonPanel.WrapContents = false;
        _rightButtonPanel.AutoScroll = true;
        _rightButtonPanel.BorderStyle = BorderStyle.FixedSingle;
        Controls.Add(_rightButtonPanel);

        for (int i = 1; i <= 30; i++)
        {
            var btn = new Button
            {
                Name = $"_btnMain{i:00}",
                Text = GetButtonText(i),
                Width = MainButtonWidth,
                Height = MainButtonHeight,
                Margin = new Padding(3, 2, 3, 1),
                Tag = i
            };

            btn.Click += MainButton_Click;
            _rightButtonPanel.Controls.Add(btn);
        }

        var lblTitle = new Label
        {
            Text = "TQGA Main Menu",
            Left = 20,
            Top = 20,
            Width = 520,
            Height = 32,
            Font = new Font(Font.FontFamily, 16f, FontStyle.Bold)
        };
        Controls.Add(lblTitle);

        var lblNote = new Label
        {
            Text = "Use Setting 2 to open the previous full TQGA WinForms UI. Setting 1 and Setting 3 are ready for future controls.",
            Left = 22,
            Top = 60,
            Width = 760,
            Height = 42
        };
        Controls.Add(lblNote);

        ResumeLayout(false);
        AlignRightButtonPanel();
    }

    protected override void OnResize(EventArgs e)
    {
        base.OnResize(e);
        AlignRightButtonPanel();
    }

    private void AlignRightButtonPanel()
    {
        _rightButtonPanel.Left = Math.Max(4, ClientSize.Width - _rightButtonPanel.Width - 4);
        _rightButtonPanel.Height = Math.Max(40, ClientSize.Height - 8);
    }

    private static string GetButtonText(int buttonNo)
    {
        return buttonNo switch
        {
            28 => "Setting 1",
            29 => "Setting 2",
            30 => "Setting 3",
            _ => buttonNo.ToString("00")
        };
    }

    private void MainButton_Click(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        if (sender is not Button btn || btn.Tag is not int buttonNo)
            return;

        switch (buttonNo)
        {
            case 28:
                using (var form = new Setting1Form())
                    form.ShowDialog(this);
                break;

            case 29:
                using (var form = ActivatorUtilities.CreateInstance<Setting2Form>(_sp))
                    form.ShowDialog(this);
                break;

            case 30:
                using (var form = new Setting3Form())
                    form.ShowDialog(this);
                break;

            default:
                MessageBox.Show(
                    this,
                    $"Button {buttonNo:00} is available for future function assignment.",
                    "TQGA",
                    MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                    MessageBoxIcon.Information);
                break;
        }
    }

    private void StartMousePositionTimer()
    {
        _mousePositionTimer.Interval = 300;
        _mousePositionTimer.Tick += (_, _) =>
        {
            Point formPoint = PointToClient(Cursor.Position);
            Text = $"TQGA - Main Menu | Mouse X={formPoint.X}, Y={formPoint.Y}";
        };
        _mousePositionTimer.Start();
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using TQGA.Application.Backtesting;
using TQGA.Application.Portfolio;
using TQGA.Application.Reporting;
using TQGA.Application.Services;
using TQGA.Application.Strategy;
using TQGA.Infrastructure;
using TQGA.Infrastructure.MarketData;

namespace TQGA.WinForms;

internal static class Program
{
    [STAThread]
    private static void Main()
    {
        var host = Host.CreateDefaultBuilder()
            .ConfigureServices((context, services) =>
            {
                services.AddInfrastructure();

                services.AddSingleton<StrategyFactory>();

                services.AddScoped<BacktestRunner>();
                services.AddScoped<PortfolioBacktestRunner>();
                services.AddScoped<PortfolioBacktestOrchestrator>();

                services.AddScoped<BacktestReport>();
                services.AddScoped<TradeExpectancyAnalyzer>();
                services.AddScoped<CoinPerformanceAnalyzer>();
                services.AddScoped<PortfolioResearchReport>();

                // Shared helper services
                services.AddScoped<MiniReportSamplingService>();

                // Report / analytics services required by PortfolioBacktestOrchestrator
                services.AddScoped<AlphaRankingReportService>();
                services.AddScoped<CioCapitalReportService>();
                services.AddScoped<StrategyContributionReportService>();
                services.AddScoped<SymbolHeatmapReportService>();
                services.AddScoped<PortfolioEquityReportService>();
                services.AddScoped<PortfolioDrawdownReportService>();

                // Other application services
                services.AddScoped<StructureReportService>();
                services.AddScoped<FullReportService>();

                services.AddSingleton<A84_RegimeResearchService>();
                services.AddSingleton<ReportPortalPublishService>();

                services.AddScoped<MainForm>();
            })
            .Build();

        ApplicationConfiguration.Initialize();

        using var scope = host.Services.CreateScope();
        var mainForm = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<MainForm>();

        System.Windows.Forms.Application.Run(mainForm);
    }
}

    protected override void OnLoad(EventArgs e)
    {
        base.OnLoad(e);

        LoadStrategyList();
        LoadTimeframeList();
        LoadCoinCategories();
        RefreshCoinNames();

        ApplyStartupDefaults();
        UpdateQ1SelectedCoinsPreviewAndFile();

        ApplySoloResearchSelectionFromUi();

        _ = LoadAllBinanceCoinNamesAsync();
    }

    private void LoadStrategyList()
    {
        if (_strategyList == null)
            return;

        _strategyList.Items.Clear();
        _cmbSoloStrategy?.Items.Clear();

        using var scope = _sp.CreateScope();
        var orchestrator = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<PortfolioBacktestOrchestrator>();

        List<StrategyListItem> strategyItems = orchestrator
            .GetRegisteredStrategies()
            .Select(t => new StrategyListItem(t))
            .ToList();

        foreach (StrategyListItem item in strategyItems)
        {
            _strategyList.Items.Add(item, true);
            _cmbSoloStrategy?.Items.Add(item);
        }

        if (_cmbSoloStrategy != null && _cmbSoloStrategy.Items.Count > 0)
        {
            int preferredIndex = -1;

            for (int i = 0; i < _cmbSoloStrategy.Items.Count; i++)
            {
                if (_cmbSoloStrategy.Items[i] is StrategyListItem sli &&
                    sli.Type.Name.Equals(DefaultSoloStrategyTypeName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    preferredIndex = i;
                    break;
                }
            }

            _cmbSoloStrategy.SelectedIndex = preferredIndex >= 0 ? preferredIndex : 0;
        }

        SyncSoloComboFromCheckedStrategy();
    }

    private void ApplySoloResearchSelectionFromUi()
    {
        if (_strategyList == null || _cmbSoloStrategy == null || _chkSoloResearchMode == null)
            return;

        if (!_chkSoloResearchMode.Checked)
        {
            SyncSoloComboFromCheckedStrategy();
            return;
        }

        if (_cmbSoloStrategy.SelectedItem is not StrategyListItem activeItem)
            return;

        _suppressSoloResearchSync = true;
        try
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _strategyList.Items.Count; i++)
            {
                if (_strategyList.Items[i] is StrategyListItem item)
                {
                    bool shouldBeChecked = item.Type == activeItem.Type;
                    _strategyList.SetItemChecked(i, shouldBeChecked);
                }
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            _suppressSoloResearchSync = false;
        }
    }

    private void SyncSoloComboFromCheckedStrategy()
    {
        if (_strategyList == null || _cmbSoloStrategy == null)
            return;

        List<StrategyListItem> checkedItems = _strategyList.CheckedItems
            .OfType<StrategyListItem>()
            .ToList();

        if (checkedItems.Count != 1)
            return;

        StrategyListItem active = checkedItems[0];

        for (int i = 0; i < _cmbSoloStrategy.Items.Count; i++)
        {
            if (_cmbSoloStrategy.Items[i] is StrategyListItem item &&
                item.Type == active.Type)
            {
                _cmbSoloStrategy.SelectedIndex = i;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task LoadAllBinanceCoinNamesAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            _allBinanceCoinNames = await SrTradingUniverse.GetAllBinanceUsdtFuturesSymbolsAsync(CancellationToken.None);
        }
        catch
        {
            _allBinanceCoinNames = AppBinanceUniverse.ActiveSymbols;
        }

        RefreshCoinNames();
    }

    private void LoadTimeframeList()
    {
        if (_timeframeList == null)
            return;

        _timeframeList.Items.Clear();

        foreach (string tf in AppBinanceUniverse.Timeframes)
            _timeframeList.Items.Add(tf, true);
    }

    private void LoadCoinCategories()
    {
        if (_coinCategoryList == null)
            return;

        _coinCategoryList.Items.Clear();

        foreach (string key in CoinCategories.Keys)
            _coinCategoryList.Items.Add(key, true);
    }

    private void RefreshCoinNames()
    {
        if (_coinNameList == null || _coinCategoryList == null)
            return;

        var blockedByC1PerCoinProfile = LoadC1PerCoinProfileBlockedSymbols();

        var previouslyChecked = _coinNameList.CheckedItems
            .OfType<string>()
            .Where(symbol => !blockedByC1PerCoinProfile.Contains(symbol))
            .ToHashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        List<string> selectedCategories = _coinCategoryList.CheckedItems
            .OfType<string>()
            .ToList();

        IReadOnlyList<string> allBinanceSymbols = _allBinanceCoinNames ?? AppBinanceUniverse.ActiveSymbols;

        List<string> selectedSymbols = selectedCategories.Count == 0
            ? allBinanceSymbols
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList()
            : selectedCategories
                .Where(CoinCategories.ContainsKey)
                .SelectMany(x => CoinCategories[x])
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .Where(x => allBinanceSymbols.Contains(x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();

        _coinNameList.Items.Clear();

        foreach (string symbol in selectedSymbols)
            _coinNameList.Items.Add(symbol, previouslyChecked.Contains(symbol) && !blockedByC1PerCoinProfile.Contains(symbol));

        QueueQ1SelectedCoinsPreviewAndFileUpdate();
    }

    private static void SetAllChecked(CheckedListBox? list, bool isChecked)
    {
        if (list == null)
            return;

        for (int i = 0; i < list.Items.Count; i++)
            list.SetItemChecked(i, isChecked);
    }

    private void QueueQ1SelectedCoinsPreviewAndFileUpdate()
    {
        try
        {
            if (IsHandleCreated)
                BeginInvoke(new Action(UpdateQ1SelectedCoinsPreviewAndFile));
            else
                UpdateQ1SelectedCoinsPreviewAndFile();
        }
        catch
        {
            // If BeginInvoke is not available during startup/shutdown, fall back to direct update.
            UpdateQ1SelectedCoinsPreviewAndFile();
        }
    }

    private void UpdateQ1SelectedCoinsPreviewAndFile()
    {
        // Manual checkbox blocking now uses ONLY Data\\Config\\C1_PER_COIN_PROFILES.
        // If a C1 profile file already exists for a symbol in that folder, that symbol is treated as completed
        // and must not remain checked in the coin-selection panel or written into Q1 load coins.txt.
        var filter = ApplyC1PerCoinProfileSelectionBlockFilter(GetCheckedCoinNamesOnly());
        WriteQ1SelectedCoinsPreviewAndFile(filter.PendingSymbols, filter.RemovedFinalProfileSymbols);
    }

    private void WriteQ1SelectedCoinsPreviewAndFile(IReadOnlyList<string> selectedSymbols)
        => WriteQ1SelectedCoinsPreviewAndFile(selectedSymbols, Array.Empty<string>());

    private void WriteQ1SelectedCoinsPreviewAndFile(IReadOnlyList<string> selectedSymbols, IReadOnlyList<string> blockedSymbols)
    {
        try
        {
            List<string> selected = (selectedSymbols ?? Array.Empty<string>())
                .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
                .Select(x => x.Trim().ToUpperInvariant())
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();

            List<string> blocked = (blockedSymbols ?? Array.Empty<string>())
                .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
                .Select(x => x.Trim().ToUpperInvariant())
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();

            Directory.CreateDirectory(QuickCoinListFolder);
            string q1Path = Path.Combine(QuickCoinListFolder, QuickCoinListQ1FileName);

            DateTime localNow = DateTime.Now;
            DateTime utcNow = DateTime.UtcNow;
            var lines = new List<string>
            {
                "# Q1 current selected coin names",
                "# Auto-written by Setting2Form coin selection panel.",
                "# Auto-update triggers: click/check coin, Coin All/None, 10/20, Q1/Q2, and Buttons 5-16/18 before run.",
                "# Manual checkbox block rule: symbols with profile files in Data\\Config\\C1_PER_COIN_PROFILES are blocked.",
                "# Q1 load coins.txt is only the output preview/file; it is not the manual block source.",
                "# One selected symbol per line. Press Q1 to reload this exact selection.",
                $"# Updated local : {localNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} {TimeZoneInfo.Local.StandardName}",
                $"# Updated UTC   : {utcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}",
                $"# Count         : {selected.Count}",
                $"# Blocked by C1_PER_COIN_PROFILES rule: {blocked.Count}",
                string.Empty
            };
            lines.AddRange(selected);

            File.WriteAllLines(q1Path, lines, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);

            if (_lblQ1SelectedCoinsPreview != null)
                _lblQ1SelectedCoinsPreview.Text = blocked.Count == 0
                    ? $"Q1 load coins.txt - selected {selected.Count}"
                    : $"Q1 load coins.txt - selected {selected.Count} | blocked C1 profiles {blocked.Count}";

            if (_txtQ1SelectedCoinsPreview != null)
            {
                var sb = new StringBuilder();
                sb.AppendLine($"File: {q1Path}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Updated: {localNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} {TimeZoneInfo.Local.StandardName}");
                sb.AppendLine(@"Manual checkbox block source: D:\D DATA BACKUP\Data\Config\C1_PER_COIN_PROFILES");
                sb.AppendLine("Q1 load coins.txt is updated after blocking; it is not the block source");
                sb.AppendLine($"Selected coins: {selected.Count}");
                sb.AppendLine($"Blocked by C1_PER_COIN_PROFILES rule: {blocked.Count}");
                sb.AppendLine(new string('-', 42));
                sb.AppendLine(selected.Count == 0 ? "No coin selected." : string.Join(Environment.NewLine, selected));

                if (blocked.Count > 0)
                {
                    sb.AppendLine();
                    sb.AppendLine("BLOCKED - symbol already has a C1 profile file in Data\\Config\\C1_PER_COIN_PROFILES");
                    sb.AppendLine(new string('-', 42));
                    sb.AppendLine(string.Join(Environment.NewLine, blocked));
                }

                _txtQ1SelectedCoinsPreview.Text = sb.ToString();
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            if (_txtQ1SelectedCoinsPreview != null)
                _txtQ1SelectedCoinsPreview.Text = "Q1 selected coin preview/write error:" + Environment.NewLine + ex.Message;
        }
    }

    private C1SelectionFilterResult ApplyC1PerCoinProfileSelectionBlockFilter(IReadOnlyList<string> selectedSymbols)
    {
        C1SelectionFilterResult filter = FilterC1PerCoinProfileSelectionBlock(selectedSymbols);

        if (_coinNameList == null || filter.RemovedFinalProfileSymbols.Count == 0 || _isApplyingC1FinalProfileSelectionFilter)
            return filter;

        var removeSet = new HashSet<string>(filter.RemovedFinalProfileSymbols, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        try
        {
            _isApplyingC1FinalProfileSelectionFilter = true;

            for (int i = 0; i < _coinNameList.Items.Count; i++)
            {
                string symbol = _coinNameList.Items[i]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
                if (removeSet.Contains(symbol) && _coinNameList.GetItemChecked(i))
                    _coinNameList.SetItemChecked(i, false);
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            _isApplyingC1FinalProfileSelectionFilter = false;
        }

        return filter;
    }

    private static C1SelectionFilterResult FilterC1PerCoinProfileSelectionBlock(IReadOnlyList<string> selectedSymbols)
    {
        HashSet<string> blockedByC1PerCoinProfile = LoadC1PerCoinProfileBlockedSymbols();
        var pending = new List<string>();
        var removed = new List<string>();

        foreach (string raw in selectedSymbols ?? Array.Empty<string>())
        {
            string symbol = (raw ?? string.Empty).Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol))
                continue;

            // Exact rule requested by user:
            // Manual checkbox selection is blocked only if that symbol already has a C1 profile file in
            // D:\D DATA BACKUP\Data\Config\C1_PER_COIN_PROFILES.
            // Fresh Binance symbols such as 0GUSDT, 1000000BOBUSDT, and 1000000MOGUSDT must remain selectable
            // when no matching file exists in that folder.
            if (blockedByC1PerCoinProfile.Contains(symbol))
                removed.Add(symbol);
            else
                pending.Add(symbol);
        }

        return new C1SelectionFilterResult(
            pending.Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToList(),
            removed.Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToList());
    }

    private static HashSet<string> LoadC1PerCoinProfileBlockedSymbols()
    {
        var blocked = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        try
        {
            if (!Directory.Exists(C1LegacyPerCoinProfileFolder))
                return blocked;

            foreach (string path in Directory.EnumerateFiles(C1LegacyPerCoinProfileFolder, "*", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly))
            {
                string fileName = Path.GetFileName(path);
                string? symbol = TryExtractSymbolFromC1ProfileLine(fileName)
                    ?? TryExtractUsdtSymbolFromProfileFileName(fileName);

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol))
                    blocked.Add(symbol.Trim().ToUpperInvariant());
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            // Do not block the UI if the profile folder is temporarily unavailable.
        }

        return blocked;
    }

    private static string? TryExtractSymbolFromC1ProfileLine(string? rawLine)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawLine))
            return null;

        string line = rawLine.Trim();
        if (line.StartsWith("#", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            return null;

        string fileName = Path.GetFileName(line);
        if (!fileName.StartsWith("C1_PROFILE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            !fileName.EndsWith(".config.txt", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return null;

        string name = fileName[..^".config.txt".Length];
        string upper = name.ToUpperInvariant();

        // Supported profile naming styles:
        // C1_PROFILE_APTUSDT_1h.config.txt
        // C1_PROFILE__APTUSDT__1h.config.txt
        string[] timeframes = { "15M", "1H", "4H", "1D" };
        foreach (string tf in timeframes)
        {
            string suffixDouble = "__" + tf;
            if (upper.StartsWith("C1_PROFILE__", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && upper.EndsWith(suffixDouble, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                string body = upper.Substring("C1_PROFILE__".Length, upper.Length - "C1_PROFILE__".Length - suffixDouble.Length);
                return NormalizeParsedProfileSymbol(body);
            }

            string suffixSingle = "_" + tf;
            if (upper.StartsWith("C1_PROFILE_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && upper.EndsWith(suffixSingle, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                string body = upper.Substring("C1_PROFILE_".Length, upper.Length - "C1_PROFILE_".Length - suffixSingle.Length);
                return NormalizeParsedProfileSymbol(body);
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static string? TryExtractUsdtSymbolFromProfileFileName(string? fileName)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fileName))
            return null;

        string name = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(fileName.Trim()).ToUpperInvariant();
        if (name.EndsWith(".CONFIG", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            name = name[..^".CONFIG".Length];

        string[] timeframes = { "15M", "1H", "4H", "1D" };
        foreach (string tf in timeframes)
        {
            string suffix = "_" + tf;
            if (name.EndsWith(suffix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                string candidate = name[..^suffix.Length].Trim('_');
                if (candidate.StartsWith("C1_PROFILE__", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    candidate = candidate["C1_PROFILE__".Length..].Trim('_');
                else if (candidate.StartsWith("C1_PROFILE_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    candidate = candidate["C1_PROFILE_".Length..].Trim('_');

                return NormalizeParsedProfileSymbol(candidate);
            }
        }

        int usdtIndex = name.IndexOf("USDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        if (usdtIndex >= 0)
        {
            string candidate = name[..(usdtIndex + 4)].Trim('_');
            if (candidate.StartsWith("C1_PROFILE__", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                candidate = candidate["C1_PROFILE__".Length..].Trim('_');
            else if (candidate.StartsWith("C1_PROFILE_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                candidate = candidate["C1_PROFILE_".Length..].Trim('_');

            return NormalizeParsedProfileSymbol(candidate);
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static string? NormalizeParsedProfileSymbol(string? symbol)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol))
            return null;

        string cleaned = symbol.Trim().Trim('_').ToUpperInvariant();
        return cleaned.EndsWith("USDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            ? cleaned
            : null;
    }

    private static bool HasC1FinalProfileForSymbol(string symbol)
    {
        try
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol) || !Directory.Exists(C1FinalProfileFolder))
                return false;

            string safeSymbol = SanitizeFileName(symbol.Trim().ToUpperInvariant());
            string[] exactNames =
            {
                $"C1_PROFILE__{safeSymbol}__15m.config.txt",
                $"C1_PROFILE__{safeSymbol}__1h.config.txt",
                $"C1_PROFILE__{safeSymbol}__4h.config.txt",
                $"C1_PROFILE__{safeSymbol}__1d.config.txt",
                $"C1_PROFILE_{safeSymbol}_15m.config.txt",
                $"C1_PROFILE_{safeSymbol}_1h.config.txt",
                $"C1_PROFILE_{safeSymbol}_4h.config.txt",
                $"C1_PROFILE_{safeSymbol}_1d.config.txt"
            };

            return exactNames.Any(name => File.Exists(Path.Combine(C1FinalProfileFolder, name)));
        }
        catch
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private sealed record C1SelectionFilterResult(
        List<string> PendingSymbols,
        List<string> RemovedFinalProfileSymbols);

    private void SelectMajorCapCoinNames(int count)
    {
        if (_coinNameList == null)
            return;

        var selected = MajorCapPrioritySymbols
            .Where(symbol => ContainsCoinNameItem(symbol))
            .Take(Math.Max(0, count))
            .ToHashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        for (int i = 0; i < _coinNameList.Items.Count; i++)
        {
            string? item = _coinNameList.Items[i]?.ToString();
            _coinNameList.SetItemChecked(
                i,
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item) && selected.Contains(item));
        }

        UpdateQ1SelectedCoinsPreviewAndFile();

        if (selected.Count == 0)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(
                "No major-cap symbols from the quick-select list are currently visible in Coin Names. Select the Majors category or Coin All, then press 10 or 20 again.",
                $"Major Cap {count}",
                MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                MessageBoxIcon.Information);
        }
    }


    private void LoadQuickCoinSelection(string slot)
    {
        string normalizedSlot = string.Equals(slot, "Q2", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            ? "Q2"
            : "Q1";

        string fileName = normalizedSlot == "Q2"
            ? QuickCoinListQ2FileName
            : QuickCoinListQ1FileName;

        string filePath = Path.Combine(QuickCoinListFolder, fileName);
        string sourceDescription = filePath;

        try
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(QuickCoinListFolder);

            if (!File.Exists(filePath))
                WriteDefaultQuickCoinListFile(filePath, normalizedSlot);

            HashSet<string> requestedSymbols;

            if (normalizedSlot.Equals("Q1", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                // Q1 is now a fixed user-requested 20-coin research basket.
                // Every Q1 press rewrites Q1 load coins.txt, then selects exactly these coins.
                List<string> fixedQ1Symbols = GetFixedQ1PrioritySymbols();
                requestedSymbols = new HashSet<string>(fixedQ1Symbols, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                WriteFixedQ1CoinListFiles(fixedQ1Symbols);
                sourceDescription = @"fixed Q1 20-coin top-cap research basket written to Data\Config\Rep_SR_CONFIG_PROFILES";
            }
            else
            {
                // Q2 is a fixed user priority/testnet basket.
                // Every Q2 press rewrites Q2 load coins.txt, then selects exactly these coins.
                List<string> fixedQ2Symbols = GetFixedQ2PrioritySymbols();
                requestedSymbols = new HashSet<string>(fixedQ2Symbols, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                WriteFixedQ2CoinListFiles(fixedQ2Symbols);
                sourceDescription = @"fixed Q2 priority basket written to Data\Config\Rep_SR_CONFIG_PROFILES";
            }

            if (requestedSymbols.Count == 0)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(
                    $"No valid coin symbols were found in:\n{filePath}\n\n" +
                    "Q1 is a fixed 20-coin research basket. Q2 remains the fixed 10-coin testnet basket.",
                    $"{normalizedSlot} Coin Selection",
                    MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                    MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                return;
            }

            // No checked category means RefreshCoinNames() displays the complete active Binance universe.
            // This prevents a category filter from hiding a symbol listed in Q1/Q2.
            SetAllChecked(_coinCategoryList, false);
            RefreshCoinNames();
            SetAllChecked(_coinNameList, false);

            IEnumerable<string> visibleSymbols = _coinNameList == null
                ? Enumerable.Empty<string>()
                : _coinNameList.Items
                    .Cast<object>()
                    .Select(x => x?.ToString() ?? string.Empty)
                    .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x));

            var availableSymbols = new HashSet<string>(
                visibleSymbols,
                StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

            HashSet<string> blockedByC1PerCoinProfile = LoadC1PerCoinProfileBlockedSymbols();
            List<string> blockedRequestedSymbols = requestedSymbols
                .Where(symbol => blockedByC1PerCoinProfile.Contains(symbol))
                .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();

            int selectedCount = 0;
            if (_coinNameList != null)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < _coinNameList.Items.Count; i++)
                {
                    string symbol = _coinNameList.Items[i]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
                    bool shouldSelect = requestedSymbols.Contains(symbol) && !blockedByC1PerCoinProfile.Contains(symbol);
                    _coinNameList.SetItemChecked(i, shouldSelect);

                    if (shouldSelect)
                        selectedCount++;
                }
            }

            List<string> missingSymbols = requestedSymbols
                .Where(symbol => !availableSymbols.Contains(symbol))
                .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();

            if (_lblCoinNames != null)
                _lblCoinNames.Text = $"Coin Names: {normalizedSlot} ({selectedCount})";

            UpdateQ1SelectedCoinsPreviewAndFile();

            string missingText = missingSymbols.Count == 0
                ? "Missing / unavailable: 0"
                : $"Missing / unavailable: {missingSymbols.Count}\n{string.Join(", ", missingSymbols.Take(25))}";
            string blockedText = blockedRequestedSymbols.Count == 0
                ? "Blocked by C1_PER_COIN_PROFILES: 0"
                : $"Blocked by C1_PER_COIN_PROFILES: {blockedRequestedSymbols.Count}\n{string.Join(", ", blockedRequestedSymbols.Take(25))}";

            MessageBox.Show(
                $"{normalizedSlot} coin list loaded.\n\n" +
                $"Selected: {selectedCount}\n" +
                $"Requested: {requestedSymbols.Count}\n" +
                $"{missingText}\n" +
                $"{blockedText}\n\n" +
                $"Source:\n{sourceDescription}\n\nFile:\n{filePath}",
                $"{normalizedSlot} Coin Selection",
                MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                selectedCount > 0 ? MessageBoxIcon.Information : MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(
                $"Could not load {normalizedSlot} coin list.\n\n{ex.Message}\n\nFile:\n{filePath}",
                $"{normalizedSlot} Coin Selection Error",
                MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                MessageBoxIcon.Error);
        }
    }

    private static List<string> GetSavedC1ProfileSymbolsForQ1()
    {
        var symbols = new List<string>();

        foreach (string folder in GetC1ProfileSearchDirectories())
        {
            if (!Directory.Exists(folder))
                continue;

            foreach (string path in Directory.EnumerateFiles(folder, "C1_PROFILE__*__1h.config*.txt", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly))
            {
                string name = Path.GetFileName(path);
                string? symbol = ExtractSymbolFromC1ProfileFileName(name);
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol) && !symbols.Contains(symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    symbols.Add(symbol);
            }
        }

        return symbols
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .OrderBy(symbol => symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();
    }

    private static string? ExtractSymbolFromC1ProfileFileName(string fileName)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fileName))
            return null;

        const string prefix = "C1_PROFILE__";
        int prefixIndex = fileName.IndexOf(prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        if (prefixIndex < 0)
            return null;

        int start = prefixIndex + prefix.Length;
        int end = fileName.IndexOf("__", start, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        if (end <= start)
            return null;

        string symbol = fileName[start..end].Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
        return symbol.EndsWith("USDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? symbol : null;
    }

    private void ShowBinanceTestnetOrderFormForSelectedCoins()
    {
        // TESTNET STANDARD: Binance testnet operations must use Q2 priority coins only.
        // This deliberately ignores Q1/current manual selection so testnet scan/auto-execute
        // cannot accidentally run all coins or an old selected basket.
        List<string> selectedSymbols = GetFixedQ2PrioritySymbols();
        if (selectedSymbols.Count == 0)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(
                "No Q2 coins found for testnet. Press Q2 first or restore the fixed Q2 priority list.",
                "BINANCE TESTNET ORDER - Q2 ONLY",
                MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
            return;
        }

        WriteFixedQ2CoinListFiles(selectedSymbols);
        SelectExactCoinNames(selectedSymbols);
        // Do not overwrite Q1 load coins.txt here. Testnet is Q2-only and writes TESTNET_SELECTED_Q2_COINS.txt.

        int maxOpenTrades = Math.Max(1, Math.Min(selectedSymbols.Count, 25));
        string testnetFile = Path.Combine(QuickCoinListFolder, "TESTNET_SELECTED_Q2_COINS.txt");
        WriteFixedQ2CoinListFile(testnetFile, selectedSymbols);

        BinanceTestnetOrderLauncher.ShowTestnetOrderForm(this, selectedSymbols, maxOpenTrades);
    }

    private static HashSet<string> ParseQuickCoinListFile(string filePath)
    {
        var output = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        foreach (string rawLine in File.ReadAllLines(filePath))
        {
            string line = rawLine.Trim();
            if (line.Length == 0 || line.StartsWith("#", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                continue;

            int slashCommentIndex = line.IndexOf("//", StringComparison.Ordinal);
            if (slashCommentIndex >= 0)
                line = line[..slashCommentIndex];

            int hashCommentIndex = line.IndexOf('#');
            if (hashCommentIndex >= 0)
                line = line[..hashCommentIndex];

            string[] tokens = line.Split(
                new[] { ',', ';', ' ', '\t', '|', '\r', '\n' },
                StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries | StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries);

            foreach (string token in tokens)
            {
                string symbol = NormalizeQuickCoinSymbol(token);
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol))
                    output.Add(symbol);
            }
        }

        return output;
    }

    private static string NormalizeQuickCoinSymbol(string token)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(token))
            return string.Empty;

        string cleaned = new string(
            token.Trim()
                .ToUpperInvariant()
                .Where(char.IsLetterOrDigit)
                .ToArray());

        if (cleaned.Length == 0)
            return string.Empty;

        if (!cleaned.EndsWith("USDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            cleaned += "USDT";

        return cleaned;
    }

    private bool ContainsCoinNameItem(string symbol)
    {
        if (_coinNameList == null)
            return false;

        for (int i = 0; i < _coinNameList.Items.Count; i++)

            if (string.Equals(_coinNameList.Items[i]?.ToString(), symbol, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private async Task RunResearch()
    {
        await RunSafe(async () =>
        {
            _reportArchive.ArchiveExistingReports();

            using var scope = _sp.CreateScope();
            var orchestrator = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<PortfolioBacktestOrchestrator>();

            IReadOnlyList<Type> selectedStrategies = GetSelectedStrategyTypes(orchestrator);
            IReadOnlyList<string> selectedTimeframes = GetSelectedTimeframes();
            IReadOnlyList<string> selectedSymbols = GetSelectedSymbols();
            FrictionProfile friction = FrictionProfile.Default;

            await orchestrator.RunSelectedAsync(
                selectedStrategies,
                selectedSymbols,
                selectedTimeframes,
                friction,
                CancellationToken.None);
        });
    }
