    private async Task<object> InvokeGitHubPagesPublisherAsync(string methodName, object[] args)
    {
        MethodInfo? method = _gitHubPagesPublish.GetType().GetMethod(methodName, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
        if (method == null)
        {
            throw new MissingMethodException(
                $"GitHubPagesPublishService does not contain method '{methodName}'. " +
                $"Please patch GitHubPagesPublishService.cs first.");
        }

        return await Task.Run(() =>
        {
            try
            {
                return method.Invoke(_gitHubPagesPublish, args)
                    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"Method '{methodName}' returned null.");
            }
            catch (TargetInvocationException tie) when (tie.InnerException != null)
            {
                throw tie.InnerException;
            }
        });
    }

    private static string BuildReflectionSuccessMessage(
        string header,
        object result,
        params (string PropertyName, string Label)[] mappings)
    {
        var lines = new List<string> { header, string.Empty };

        Type type = result.GetType();

        foreach ((string propertyName, string label) in mappings)
        {
            PropertyInfo? property = type.GetProperty(propertyName, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
            if (property == null)
                continue;

            object? value = property.GetValue(result);
            if (value == null)
                continue;

            lines.Add($"{label}: {value}");
        }

        return string.Join(Environment.NewLine, lines);
    }

    private string ResolveTqgaSolutionRoot()
    {
        string? current = AppContext.BaseDirectory;

        while (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(current))
        {
            string slnPath = Path.Combine(current, "TQGA.sln");
            if (File.Exists(slnPath))
                return current;

            DirectoryInfo? parent = Directory.GetParent(current);
            if (parent == null)
                break;

            current = parent.FullName;
        }

        current = Directory.GetCurrentDirectory();

        while (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(current))
        {
            string slnPath = Path.Combine(current, "TQGA.sln");
            if (File.Exists(slnPath))
                return current;

            DirectoryInfo? parent = Directory.GetParent(current);
            if (parent == null)
                break;

            current = parent.FullName;
        }

        throw new InvalidOperationException(
            "Could not locate TQGA.sln from the running application path. " +
            "Please run the WinForms app from within the TQGA solution structure.");
    }

    private string ResolveGitRepoPath()
    {
        if (Directory.Exists(FixedGitHubPagesRepoPath))
        {
            _gitHubPagesPublish.SaveRepoPath(FixedGitHubPagesRepoPath);
            return FixedGitHubPagesRepoPath;
        }

        string? saved = _gitHubPagesPublish.TryLoadSavedRepoPath();
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(saved) && Directory.Exists(saved))
            return saved;

        throw new DirectoryNotFoundException(
            $"GitHub Pages local repository folder was not found.\nExpected:\n{FixedGitHubPagesRepoPath}");
    }

    private async Task<string> BuildReportAll31Async(bool copyToClipboard)
    {
        string combinedPath = await Task.Run(() => _fullReport.SaveCombinedToFile());

        string rawText = await File.ReadAllTextAsync(combinedPath);
        string formattedText = FormatAuditReportAll31(rawText);

        string directory = Path.GetDirectoryName(combinedPath) ?? AppContext.BaseDirectory;
        string report31Path = Path.Combine(
            directory,
            $"REPORT_ALL_31_{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.txt");

        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(report31Path, formattedText);

        string report31HtmlPath = Path.ChangeExtension(report31Path, ".html");
        string htmlWrapped = WrapTextAsHtml(formattedText);
        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(report31HtmlPath, htmlWrapped);

        if (copyToClipboard)
            Clipboard.SetText(formattedText);

        return report31Path;
    }

    private static string FormatAuditReportAll31(string input)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input))
            return string.Empty;

        string normalized = input
            .Replace("\r\n", "\n")
            .Replace("\r", "\n");

        string[] lines = normalized.Split('\n');

        var output = new List<string>(lines.Length + 200);
        bool previousBlank = false;
        int blankCount = 0;

        output.Add("TQGA REPORT ALL 31");
        output.Add("============================================================");
        output.Add($"Generated (UTC): {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        output.Add("Formatting: Wrapped / normalized / audit-friendly separation");
        output.Add(string.Empty);

        foreach (string rawLine in lines)
        {
            string line = rawLine?.TrimEnd() ?? string.Empty;
            string upper = line.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();

            bool isMajorHeader =
                upper.StartsWith("REPORT ") ||
                upper.StartsWith("A84") ||
                upper.StartsWith("WF ") ||
                upper.StartsWith("WF_") ||
                upper.StartsWith("WALK FORWARD") ||
                upper.StartsWith("FULL REPORT") ||
                upper.StartsWith("TQGA ");

            if (isMajorHeader && output.Count > 0 && output[^1] != string.Empty)
                output.Add(string.Empty);

            if (isMajorHeader)
            {
                output.Add("------------------------------------------------------------");
                output.Add(line);
                output.Add("------------------------------------------------------------");
                previousBlank = false;
                blankCount = 0;
                continue;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line))
            {
                if (!previousBlank || blankCount < 2)
                {
                    output.Add(string.Empty);
                    blankCount++;
                }

                previousBlank = true;
                continue;
            }

            previousBlank = false;
            blankCount = 0;

            output.Add(WrapLine(line, 140));
        }

        return string.Join(Environment.NewLine, output);
    }

    private static string WrapTextAsHtml(string text)
    {
        string encoded = HtmlEncode(text);

        return
$@"<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset=""utf-8"">
  <title>Test Page</title>
</head>
<body>
<div>
<pre>

{encoded}

</pre>
</div>
</body>
</html>";
    }

    private static string HtmlEncode(string text)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
            return string.Empty;

        return text
            .Replace("&", "&amp;")
            .Replace("<", "&lt;")
            .Replace(">", "&gt;");
    }

    private static string WrapLine(string text, int maxWidth)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text) || text.Length <= maxWidth)
            return text;

        string[] parts = text.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        var lines = new List<string>();
        var current = new System.Text.StringBuilder();

        foreach (string part in parts)
        {
            if (current.Length == 0)
            {
                current.Append(part);
                continue;
            }

            if (current.Length + 1 + part.Length <= maxWidth)
            {
                current.Append(' ');
                current.Append(part);
                continue;
            }

            lines.Add(current.ToString());
            current.Clear();
            current.Append(part);
        }

        if (current.Length > 0)
            lines.Add(current.ToString());

        return string.Join(Environment.NewLine, lines);
    }

    private IReadOnlyList<Type> GetSelectedStrategyTypes(PortfolioBacktestOrchestrator orchestrator)
    {

    private async Task RunTrackedButtonProcessAsync(
        string title,
        Func<Task> action)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(action);

        Toggle(false);
        StartSharedButtonProgress(title);

        try
        {
            // Allow the progress label/bar to paint before a CPU-heavy UI-thread process begins.
            await Task.Yield();
            await action();
            CompleteSharedButtonProgress(title);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            FailSharedButtonProgress(title, ex.Message);
            MessageBox.Show(
                ex.Message,
                title + " ERROR",
                MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                MessageBoxIcon.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            Toggle(true);
        }
    }


    private void StartSharedButtonProgress(string title)
    {
        _activeCandleUpdateProgressTitle = title;
        SetCentralProgress(title, 0, "Started. Preparing work...", clearDetails: true, marquee: true);
        System.Windows.Forms.Application.DoEvents();
    }

    private void UpdateSharedButtonProgress(
        string title,
        int current,
        int total,
        string? detail = null)
    {
        int safeTotal = Math.Max(1, total);
        int safeCurrent = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(safeTotal, current));
        int percent = (int)Math.Round((safeCurrent * 100d) / safeTotal);

        string suffix = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(detail)
            ? string.Empty
            : $" | {detail}";

        SetCentralProgress(
            title,
            percent,
            $"{percent}% {safeCurrent}/{safeTotal}{suffix}",
            clearDetails: false,
            marquee: false);

        System.Windows.Forms.Application.DoEvents();
    }

    private void CompleteSharedButtonProgress(string title)
    {
        SetCentralProgress(title, 100, "Completed.", clearDetails: false, marquee: false);
        System.Windows.Forms.Application.DoEvents();
    }

    private void FailSharedButtonProgress(string title, string? error)
    {
        string detail = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(error)
            ? "Failed."
            : $"Failed - {error}";

        SetCentralProgress(title, 0, detail, clearDetails: false, marquee: false);
        System.Windows.Forms.Application.DoEvents();
    }

    private void SetCentralProgress(
        string title,
        int percent,
        string detail,
        bool clearDetails = false,
        bool marquee = false)
    {
        int safePercent = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(100, percent));

        if (_barButton18Progress != null)
        {
            _barButton18Progress.MarqueeAnimationSpeed = marquee ? 25 : 0;
            _barButton18Progress.Style = marquee ? ProgressBarStyle.Marquee : ProgressBarStyle.Continuous;
            if (!marquee)
                _barButton18Progress.Value = Math.Max(_barButton18Progress.Minimum, Math.Min(_barButton18Progress.Maximum, safePercent));
            else
                _barButton18Progress.Value = 0;
        }

        if (_lblButton18Progress != null)
            _lblButton18Progress.Text = $"{title}: {safePercent}% | {detail}";

        if (_centralProgressPanel != null)
            _centralProgressPanel.Visible = true;

        if (_lblCentralProgressTitle != null)
            _lblCentralProgressTitle.Text = title;

        if (_barCentralProgress != null)
        {
            _barCentralProgress.MarqueeAnimationSpeed = marquee ? 25 : 0;
            _barCentralProgress.Style = marquee ? ProgressBarStyle.Marquee : ProgressBarStyle.Continuous;
            if (!marquee)
                _barCentralProgress.Value = Math.Max(_barCentralProgress.Minimum, Math.Min(_barCentralProgress.Maximum, safePercent));
            else
                _barCentralProgress.Value = 0;
        }

        if (_lblCentralProgressPercent != null)
            _lblCentralProgressPercent.Text = $"{safePercent}% | {detail}";

        if (_txtCentralProgressDetails != null)
        {
            if (clearDetails)
                _txtCentralProgressDetails.Clear();

            string line = $"{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss} | {detail}";
            _txtCentralProgressDetails.AppendText(line + Environment.NewLine);
        }

        if (_centralProgressPanel != null)
            _centralProgressPanel.BringToFront();
    }

    private void AppendCentralProgressDetail(string title, string detail)
    {
        SetCentralProgress(title, _barCentralProgress?.Value ?? 0, detail, clearDetails: false, marquee: false);
    }


    private sealed class ResearchRamCandleEntry
    {
        public string Symbol { get; init; } = string.Empty;
        public string Timeframe { get; init; } = string.Empty;
        public List<Candle> Candles { get; init; } = new();
        public DateTime LoadedUtc { get; init; }
        public DateTime FirstCandleUtc { get; init; }
        public DateTime LastCandleUtc { get; init; }
    }

    private void ResetResearchRamStatsForRun(string title)
    {
        lock (_researchRamLock)
        {
            _researchRamHits = 0;
            _researchRamMisses = 0;
            _researchRamFilteredSlices = 0;
            _researchRamSessionStartedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
            _researchRamCurrentRunTitle = title;
        }
    }

    private void ClearResearchRamCandleCache(string reason)
    {
        int removed;
        lock (_researchRamLock)
        {
            removed = _researchRamCandles.Count;
            _researchRamCandles.Clear();
            _researchRamHits = 0;
            _researchRamMisses = 0;
            _researchRamFilteredSlices = 0;
            _researchRamSessionStartedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        }

        try
        {
            EnsureC1ResearchFolders();
            string path = Path.Combine(C1RunLogFolder, "LATEST_TQGA_RAM_RESEARCH_STATUS.txt");
            File.WriteAllText(
                path,
                $"TQGA RAM RESEARCH ACCELERATOR V1{Environment.NewLine}" +
                $"Cleared UTC : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}{Environment.NewLine}" +
                $"Reason      : {reason}{Environment.NewLine}" +
                $"Entries     : {removed}{Environment.NewLine}",
                System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        }
        catch
        {
            // RAM clearing must never block trading research.
        }
    }

    private List<Candle> GetCandlesFromResearchRam(
        ICandleDataFeed feed,
        string symbol,
        string timeframe,
        DateTime fromUtcInclusive,
        DateTime toUtcExclusive,
        string caller)
    {
        string normalizedSymbol = (symbol ?? string.Empty).Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
        string normalizedTimeframe = (timeframe ?? string.Empty).Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
        string key = normalizedSymbol + "::" + normalizedTimeframe;

        ResearchRamCandleEntry? entry;
        lock (_researchRamLock)
        {
            _researchRamCandles.TryGetValue(key, out entry);
            if (entry != null)
                _researchRamHits++;
        }

        if (entry == null)
        {
            List<Candle> allCandles = feed
                .GetCandles(normalizedSymbol, normalizedTimeframe)
                .OrderBy(c => c.Time)
                .ToList();

            entry = new ResearchRamCandleEntry
            {
                Symbol = normalizedSymbol,
                Timeframe = normalizedTimeframe,
                Candles = allCandles,
                LoadedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,
                FirstCandleUtc = allCandles.Count == 0 ? DateTime.MinValue : allCandles[0].Time,
                LastCandleUtc = allCandles.Count == 0 ? DateTime.MinValue : allCandles[^1].Time
            };

            lock (_researchRamLock)
            {
                _researchRamCandles[key] = entry;
                _researchRamMisses++;
            }
        }

        lock (_researchRamLock)
        {
            _researchRamFilteredSlices++;
        }

        List<Candle> slice;
        if (fromUtcInclusive <= DateTime.MinValue.AddDays(1) && toUtcExclusive >= DateTime.MaxValue.AddDays(-1))
        {
            slice = entry.Candles.ToList();
        }
        else
        {
            slice = entry.Candles
                .Where(c => c.Time >= fromUtcInclusive && c.Time < toUtcExclusive)
                .ToList();
        }

        return slice;
    }

    private string BuildResearchRamStatusLine()
    {
        int entries;
        int candles;
        int hits;
        int misses;
        int slices;
        lock (_researchRamLock)
        {
            entries = _researchRamCandles.Count;
            candles = _researchRamCandles.Values.Sum(x => x.Candles.Count);
            hits = _researchRamHits;
            misses = _researchRamMisses;
            slices = _researchRamFilteredSlices;
        }

        return $"RAM mode: entries {entries}, candles {candles:N0}, hits {hits}, disk loads {misses}, slices {slices}";
    }

    private string WriteResearchRamStatusReport(string title)
    {
        EnsureC1ResearchFolders();
        string path = Path.Combine(C1RunLogFolder, "LATEST_TQGA_RAM_RESEARCH_STATUS.txt");

        ResearchRamCandleEntry[] entries;
        int hits;
        int misses;
        int slices;
        DateTime startedUtc;
        lock (_researchRamLock)
        {
            entries = _researchRamCandles.Values
                .OrderBy(x => x.Symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ThenBy(x => x.Timeframe, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToArray();
            hits = _researchRamHits;
            misses = _researchRamMisses;
            slices = _researchRamFilteredSlices;
            startedUtc = _researchRamSessionStartedUtc;
        }

        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("TQGA RAM RESEARCH ACCELERATOR V1");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Run Title        : {title}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Started UTC      : {startedUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated UTC    : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated Local  : {DateTime.Now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"RAM Entries      : {entries.Length}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Total Candles    : {entries.Sum(x => x.Candles.Count):N0}");
        sb.AppendLine($"RAM Hits         : {hits}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Disk Loads       : {misses}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Filtered Slices  : {slices}");
        sb.AppendLine("Mode             : Candle CSV data is loaded into process RAM once per symbol/timeframe and reused by Button 5/6/8/9/15/16 until candle update clears RAM or TQGA closes.");
        sb.AppendLine("Note             : This V1 accelerates candle loading/slicing. Exact engine indicator and trade simulation still run normally, so TQGA results remain exact.");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("RAM CANDLE ENTRIES");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        foreach (ResearchRamCandleEntry entry in entries)
        {
            sb.AppendLine($"{entry.Symbol,-16} {entry.Timeframe,-4} candles {entry.Candles.Count,8:N0} first {entry.FirstCandleUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm} last {entry.LastCandleUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm} loadedUTC {entry.LoadedUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        }

        string text = sb.ToString();
        File.WriteAllText(path, text, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        return path;
    }

    // V8.10.4Q: Fast local candle freshness guard.
    // Purpose: avoid slow Binance update calls when the local 1h CSV is already up-to-date.
    // It checks BOTH file modified time and the last candle timestamp.
    private sealed class LocalCandleFreshnessStatus
    {
        public string Symbol { get; init; } = string.Empty;
        public string FilePath { get; init; } = string.Empty;
        public bool FileExists { get; init; }
        public bool IsFresh { get; init; }
        public DateTime LastCandleUtc { get; init; }
        public DateTime LastWriteUtc { get; init; }
        public string Reason { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    }

    private static DateTime GetLatestRequiredClosedOneHourCandleUtc()
    {
        DateTime utc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        return new DateTime(utc.Year, utc.Month, utc.Day, utc.Hour, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc).AddHours(-1);
    }

    private static string NormalizeSymbolForCandleFile(string symbol)
    {
        return (symbol ?? string.Empty).Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
    }

    private static string? FindOneHourCandleCsvPath(string symbol)
    {
        string normalized = NormalizeSymbolForCandleFile(symbol);
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(normalized))
            return null;

        string dataRoot = DataPaths.DataRoot;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dataRoot) || !Directory.Exists(dataRoot))
            return null;

        string direct = Path.Combine(dataRoot, normalized + "_1h.csv");
        if (File.Exists(direct))
            return direct;

        string reportsRoot = DataPaths.Reports;
        string configRoot = Path.Combine(DataPaths.DataRoot, "Config");

        try
        {
            return Directory.EnumerateFiles(dataRoot, normalized + "_1h.csv", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
                .FirstOrDefault(path =>
                    !path.StartsWith(reportsRoot, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                    !path.StartsWith(configRoot, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        }
        catch
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static string? ReadLastNonEmptyCsvDataLineFast(string path)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path) || !File.Exists(path))
            return null;

        try
        {
            using var fs = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite);
            if (fs.Length <= 0)
                return null;

            const int bufferSize = 4096;
            byte[] buffer = new byte[bufferSize];
            long position = fs.Length;
            var reversed = new System.Text.StringBuilder(256);

            while (position > 0)
            {
                int read = (int)Math.Min(bufferSize, position);
                position -= read;
                fs.Seek(position, SeekOrigin.Begin);
                int actual = fs.Read(buffer, 0, read);

                for (int i = actual - 1; i >= 0; i--)
                {
                    char ch = (char)buffer[i];
                    if (ch == '\n' || ch == '\r')
                    {
                        if (reversed.Length == 0)
                            continue;

                        string line = new string(reversed.ToString().Reverse().ToArray()).Trim();
                        reversed.Clear();

                        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line) && !line.StartsWith("Time", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                            return line;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        reversed.Append(ch);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (reversed.Length > 0)
            {
                string line = new string(reversed.ToString().Reverse().ToArray()).Trim();
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line) && !line.StartsWith("Time", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    return line;
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            return null;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static bool TryReadLastCandleUtcFromCsv(string path, out DateTime lastCandleUtc)
    {
        lastCandleUtc = DateTime.MinValue;
        string? lastDataLine = ReadLastNonEmptyCsvDataLineFast(path);
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(lastDataLine))
            return false;

        string firstCell = lastDataLine.Split(',')[0].Trim().Trim('"');
        string[] formats =
        {
            "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss",
            "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm",
            "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss",
            "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ",
            "M/d/yyyy H:mm:ss",
            "M/d/yyyy h:mm:ss tt"
        };

        if (DateTime.TryParseExact(firstCell, formats, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.AssumeUniversal | DateTimeStyles.AdjustToUniversal, out DateTime exact))
        {
            lastCandleUtc = DateTime.SpecifyKind(exact, DateTimeKind.Utc);
            return true;
        }

        if (DateTime.TryParse(firstCell, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.AssumeUniversal | DateTimeStyles.AdjustToUniversal, out DateTime parsed))
        {
            lastCandleUtc = DateTime.SpecifyKind(parsed, DateTimeKind.Utc);
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private static LocalCandleFreshnessStatus CheckOneHourCandleFreshness(string symbol)
    {
        string normalized = NormalizeSymbolForCandleFile(symbol);
        string? path = FindOneHourCandleCsvPath(normalized);
        DateTime latestRequiredUtc = GetLatestRequiredClosedOneHourCandleUtc();

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path) || !File.Exists(path))
        {
            return new LocalCandleFreshnessStatus
            {
                Symbol = normalized,
                FileExists = false,
                IsFresh = false,
                Reason = "missing 1h CSV"
            };
        }

        DateTime lastWriteUtc = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(path);
        if (!TryReadLastCandleUtcFromCsv(path, out DateTime lastCandleUtc))
        {
            return new LocalCandleFreshnessStatus
            {
                Symbol = normalized,
                FilePath = path,
                FileExists = true,
                IsFresh = false,
                LastWriteUtc = lastWriteUtc,
                Reason = "could not read last candle time"
            };
        }

        bool lastCandleFresh = lastCandleUtc >= latestRequiredUtc;
        bool modifiedLooksValid = lastWriteUtc >= lastCandleUtc.AddMinutes(-90);

        string reason;
        if (lastCandleFresh && modifiedLooksValid)
            reason = "UP_TO_DATE_BY_LAST_CANDLE_AND_MODIFIED_TIME";
        else if (!lastCandleFresh)
            reason = $"stale last candle {lastCandleUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm} UTC < required {latestRequiredUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm} UTC";
        else
            reason = $"file modified time {lastWriteUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm} UTC is older than last candle {lastCandleUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm} UTC";

        return new LocalCandleFreshnessStatus
        {
            Symbol = normalized,
            FilePath = path,
            FileExists = true,
            IsFresh = lastCandleFresh && modifiedLooksValid,
            LastCandleUtc = lastCandleUtc,
            LastWriteUtc = lastWriteUtc,
            Reason = reason
        };
    }

    private static List<LocalCandleFreshnessStatus> CheckSelectedOneHourCandleFreshness(IEnumerable<string> symbols)
    {
        return symbols
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
            .Select(x => x.Trim().ToUpperInvariant())
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Select(CheckOneHourCandleFreshness)
            .ToList();
    }

    private string WriteLocalCandleFreshnessReport(string title, IReadOnlyList<LocalCandleFreshnessStatus> rows, bool skippedNetworkUpdate)
    {
        string folder = Path.Combine(QuickCoinListFolder, "CANDLE_FRESHNESS_FAST_SKIP");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(folder);
        string safeTitle = new string(title.Select(ch => char.IsLetterOrDigit(ch) ? ch : '_').ToArray()).Trim('_');
        string path = Path.Combine(folder, safeTitle + "_" + DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ".txt");

        DateTime latestRequiredUtc = GetLatestRequiredClosedOneHourCandleUtc();
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("TQGA LOCAL 1H CANDLE FRESHNESS CHECK");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Title                  : {title}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated Local        : {DateTime.Now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated UTC          : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Latest Required 1h UTC : {latestRequiredUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Network Update Skipped : {(skippedNetworkUpdate ? "YES" : "NO")}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Rows                   : {rows.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Fresh                  : {rows.Count(x => x.IsFresh)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Check/Update Needed    : {rows.Count(x => !x.IsFresh)}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("SYMBOL             STATUS       LAST_CANDLE_UTC   FILE_MODIFIED_UTC REASON");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        foreach (LocalCandleFreshnessStatus row in rows)
        {
            sb.AppendLine($"{row.Symbol,-18} {(row.IsFresh ? "UPTODATE" : "UPDATE"),-12} {FormatUtcOrBlank(row.LastCandleUtc),-17} {FormatUtcOrBlank(row.LastWriteUtc),-17} {row.Reason}");
        }
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("Rule: skip Binance candle update only when every requested 1h CSV exists, the last candle timestamp is current, and the file modified time is consistent with the last candle.");
        File.WriteAllText(path, sb.ToString(), System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        return path;
    }

    private static string FormatUtcOrBlank(DateTime utc)
    {
        return utc == DateTime.MinValue ? "-" : utc.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    }

    private bool TrySkipSelectedOneHourCandleUpdate(string title, IReadOnlyList<string> selectedSymbols)
    {
        if (selectedSymbols.Count == 0)
            return false;

        List<LocalCandleFreshnessStatus> rows = CheckSelectedOneHourCandleFreshness(selectedSymbols);
        bool allFresh = rows.Count > 0 && rows.All(x => x.IsFresh);
        string reportPath = WriteLocalCandleFreshnessReport(title, rows, allFresh);

        if (!allFresh)
        {
            AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, $"Fast candle freshness check: {rows.Count(x => x.IsFresh)}/{rows.Count} fresh. Binance update required. Report: {reportPath}");
            return false;
        }

        ClearResearchRamCandleCache("Local candle freshness check confirmed 1h CSV files are up-to-date; RAM will reload from current CSV files on next scan.");
        SetCentralProgress(title, 100, $"1h candles already up-to-date. Skipped Binance update. Fresh {rows.Count}/{rows.Count}.", clearDetails: false, marquee: false);
        AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, $"Skipped Binance update. Local check passed by file modified date and last candle time. Report: {reportPath}");
        return true;
    }

    private bool TrySkipExistingOneHourUniverseUpdate(string title)
    {
        string dataRoot = DataPaths.DataRoot;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dataRoot) || !Directory.Exists(dataRoot))
            return false;

        string reportsRoot = DataPaths.Reports;
        string configRoot = Path.Combine(DataPaths.DataRoot, "Config");
        List<string> symbols;
        try
        {
            symbols = Directory.EnumerateFiles(dataRoot, "*_1h.csv", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
                .Where(path =>
                    !path.StartsWith(reportsRoot, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                    !path.StartsWith(configRoot, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                .Select(path => Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(path))
                .Where(name => name.EndsWith("_1h", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                .Select(name => name[..^3].ToUpperInvariant())
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();
        }
        catch
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (symbols.Count < 10)
            return false;

        List<LocalCandleFreshnessStatus> rows = CheckSelectedOneHourCandleFreshness(symbols);
        bool allFresh = rows.Count > 0 && rows.All(x => x.IsFresh);
        string reportPath = WriteLocalCandleFreshnessReport(title + " EXISTING 1H UNIVERSE", rows, allFresh);

        if (!allFresh)
        {
            AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, $"Existing 1h universe freshness: {rows.Count(x => x.IsFresh)}/{rows.Count} fresh. Binance update required. Report: {reportPath}");
            return false;
        }

        ClearResearchRamCandleCache("Button 18 local existing 1h universe is up-to-date; no network update needed.");
        SetCentralProgress(title, 100, $"Existing 1h candle universe already up-to-date. Skipped Binance update. Fresh {rows.Count}/{rows.Count}.", clearDetails: false, marquee: false);
        AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, $"Skipped Binance update for existing 1h universe. Report: {reportPath}");
        return true;
    }

    private async Task RunAllBinanceOneHourCandleUpdateAsync(string title)
    {
        ResetCandleUpdateProgress(title);
        if (TrySkipExistingOneHourUniverseUpdate(title))
            return;

        await RunCandleUpdateAsync(
            title,
            (service, ct, progress) => service.UpdateAllBinanceUsdtFuturesOneHourOnlyAsync(ct, progress));
    }

    private async Task RunSelectedOneHourCandleUpdateAsync()
    {
        List<string> selectedSymbols = GetCheckedCoinNamesOnly();
        WriteQ1SelectedCoinsPreviewAndFile(selectedSymbols);
        if (selectedSymbols.Count == 0)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(
                "Please select at least one coin name for Button 17 selected 1h candle update.",
                "17-UPDATE SELECTED 1H",
                MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
            return;
        }

        ResetCandleUpdateProgress("17-UPDATE SELECTED 1H");
        if (TrySkipSelectedOneHourCandleUpdate("17-UPDATE SELECTED 1H", selectedSymbols))
            return;

        await RunCandleUpdateAsync(
            "17-UPDATE SELECTED 1H",
            (service, ct, progress) => service.UpdateSelectedSymbolsOneHourOnlyAsync(selectedSymbols, ct, progress));
    }

    private async Task RunKeepOneHourOnlyAndUpdateFiveYearsAsync()
    {
        const string title = "18-KEEP 1H + 5Y UPDATE";

        int deletedCount = 0;
        try
        {
            ResetCandleUpdateProgress(title);
            ClearResearchRamCandleCache("Button 18 is deleting non-1h candle files before 5-year 1h update.");
            deletedCount = DeleteNonOneHourCandleFiles();
            AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, $"Deleted non-1h candle CSV files: {deletedCount}. Kept all 1h CSV files.");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(
                "Could not clean non-1h candle files before Button 18 update.\n\n" + ex.Message,
                title,
                MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                MessageBoxIcon.Error);
            return;
        }

        if (TrySkipExistingOneHourUniverseUpdate(title))
        {
            AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, $"Button 18 completed by fast local up-to-date check. Non-1h deleted={deletedCount}. No Binance download was needed.");
            return;
        }

        await RunCandleUpdateAsync(
            title,
            (service, ct, progress) => service.UpdateAllBinanceUsdtFuturesOneHourOnlyAsync(ct, progress));

        AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, $"Button 18 completed. Non-1h deleted={deletedCount}. 1h update requested for all Binance USDT futures. 1h seed depth is patched to about 5 years when a file is missing/seeded.");
    }

    private static int DeleteNonOneHourCandleFiles()
    {
        string dataRoot = DataPaths.DataRoot;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dataRoot) || !Directory.Exists(dataRoot))
            return 0;

        string reportsRoot = DataPaths.Reports;
        string configRoot = Path.Combine(DataPaths.DataRoot, "Config");
        int deleted = 0;

        foreach (string path in Directory.EnumerateFiles(dataRoot, "*.csv", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
        {
            if (path.StartsWith(reportsRoot, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                path.StartsWith(configRoot, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                continue;

            string file = Path.GetFileName(path);
            if (!IsNonOneHourCandleCsvName(file))
                continue;

            try
            {
                File.Delete(path);
                deleted++;
            }
            catch
            {
                // Keep going; locked files will remain and can be cleaned manually.
            }
        }

        return deleted;
    }

    private static bool IsNonOneHourCandleCsvName(string fileName)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fileName))
            return false;

        string upper = fileName.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
        return upper.EndsWith("_15M.CSV", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               upper.EndsWith("_15MIN.CSV", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               upper.EndsWith("_4H.CSV", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               upper.EndsWith("_1D.CSV", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    private async Task RunCandleUpdateAsync(
        string title,
        Func<Top200CandleUpdateService, CancellationToken, IProgress<Top200CandleUpdateProgress>, Task<Top200CandleUpdateResult>> action)
    {
        Toggle(false);

        try
        {
            ResetCandleUpdateProgress(title);
            var progress = new Progress<Top200CandleUpdateProgress>(UpdateCandleUpdateProgress);
            var service = new Top200CandleUpdateService();
            Top200CandleUpdateResult result = await action(service, CancellationToken.None, progress);
            ClearResearchRamCandleCache("Candle update completed for " + title + "; RAM candle data must be reloaded from updated CSV files.");

            MessageBox.Show(
                result.Message + Environment.NewLine + Environment.NewLine +
                $"Symbols: {result.SymbolsRequested}" + Environment.NewLine +
                $"Timeframes: {string.Join(", ", result.Timeframes)}" + Environment.NewLine +
                $"Markets: {result.MarketsFresh}/{result.MarketsRequested} fresh" + Environment.NewLine +
                $"Folder CSV files: {result.TotalCandleCsvFilesInFolder}" + Environment.NewLine +
                $"Orphan/old files: {result.OrphanCandleFiles}" + Environment.NewLine +
                $"Downloaded candles: {result.TotalDownloadedCandles}" + Environment.NewLine +
                $"Report: {result.ReportPath}",
                title,
                MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                result.Success ? MessageBoxIcon.Information : MessageBoxIcon.Warning);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(result.ReportPath) && File.Exists(result.ReportPath))
            {
                try
                {
                    Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo
                    {
                        FileName = result.ReportPath,
                        UseShellExecute = true
                    });
                }
                catch
                {
                    // Report was created successfully; opening it is optional.
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(
                ex.Message,
                title + " ERROR",
                MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                MessageBoxIcon.Error);
        }

        Toggle(true);
    }

    private async Task RunSafe(Func<Task> action)
    {
        Toggle(false);

        try
        {
            await Task.Run(action);
            MessageBox.Show("DONE");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(ex.Message);
        }

        Toggle(true);
    }

    private async Task RunC1TruePortfolioBacktestAsync()
    {
        const string title = "09-C1 TRUE PORTFOLIO";

        if (!TryGetSelectedMarketSelection(title, out List<string> selectedSymbols, out List<string> selectedTimeframes))
            return;

        ResolveOneYearValidationWindow(out DateTime selectedStartDate, out DateTime selectedEndDate);

        if (selectedEndDate < selectedStartDate)
        {
            MessageBox.Show("End date must be greater than or equal to start date.", title, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
            return;
        }

        DateTime fromUtc = DateTime.SpecifyKind(selectedStartDate, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        DateTime toUtcExclusive = DateTime.SpecifyKind(selectedEndDate.AddDays(1), DateTimeKind.Utc);
        DateTime calculationFromUtc = fromUtc.AddDays(-120);

        SrTradeBacktestSettings baseSettings = GetSrTradeBacktestSettingsFromUi();
        decimal startingCapitalUsdt = 100m;
        decimal leverage = 10m;
        decimal[] marginTests = [10m, 20m];
        int[] maxOpenTests = [2, 3, 5];

        int totalProgressSteps =
            (marginTests.Length * selectedSymbols.Count * selectedTimeframes.Count) +
            (marginTests.Length * maxOpenTests.Length);
        int completedProgressSteps = 0;

        Cursor previousCursor = Cursor.Current;
        Cursor.Current = Cursors.WaitCursor;
        Toggle(false);

        try
        {
            await Task.Yield();

            using var scope = _sp.CreateScope();
            var feed = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<ICandleDataFeed>();
            var engine = new SrTradeBacktestEngine();
            var scenarioResults = new List<Button9PortfolioScenarioResult>();
            var scenarioSkippedData = new List<string>();

            foreach (decimal marginPerTrade in marginTests)
            {
                SrTradeBacktestSettings scenarioSettings = baseSettings with
                {
                    StartEquityUsdt = startingCapitalUsdt,
                    MarginUsdt = marginPerTrade,
                    Leverage = leverage,
                    TradeSizeUsdt = marginPerTrade * leverage
                };

                var candidates = new List<Button9PortfolioCandidate>();

                foreach (string symbol in selectedSymbols)
                {
                    foreach (string timeframe in selectedTimeframes)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            List<Candle> candles = GetCandlesFromResearchRam(feed, symbol, timeframe, calculationFromUtc, toUtcExclusive, "Button 9 portfolio");

                            int visibleCount = candles.Count(c => c.Time >= fromUtc && c.Time < toUtcExclusive);
                            if (visibleCount == 0)
                            {
                                scenarioSkippedData.Add($"{symbol}::{timeframe} margin {marginPerTrade:0.##} = no candles in selected date range");
                                continue;
                            }

                            C1PerCoinConfigProfile? profile = TryLoadC1PerCoinConfigProfile(symbol, timeframe, scenarioSettings);
                            SrTradeBacktestSettings effectiveSettings = (profile?.Settings ?? scenarioSettings) with
                            {
                                StartEquityUsdt = startingCapitalUsdt,
                                MarginUsdt = marginPerTrade,
                                Leverage = leverage,
                                TradeSizeUsdt = marginPerTrade * leverage
                            };

                            if (profile == null)
                                scenarioSkippedData.Add($"{symbol}::{timeframe} margin {marginPerTrade:0.##} = C1 per-coin config missing; UI fallback used, future profile update needed");

                            SrBacktestResult rawResult = engine.Run(
                                symbol,
                                timeframe,
                                fromUtc,
                                toUtcExclusive,
                                candles,
                                effectiveSettings,
                                saveOutputFiles: false,
                                calculateBestR: false);

                            SrBacktestResult result = ApplyC1FullProfileRulesToResult(
                                rawResult,
                                profile,
                                candles,
                                timeframe,
                                out C1FullProfileFilterSummary filterSummary);

                            if (filterSummary.IsActive)
                                scenarioSkippedData.Add($"{symbol}::{timeframe} margin {marginPerTrade:0.##} = full profile rules applied; {filterSummary.AppliedLabel}");

                            candidates.AddRange(BuildButton9PortfolioCandidates(result));
                        }
                        catch (Exception ex)
                        {
                            scenarioSkippedData.Add($"{symbol}::{timeframe} margin {marginPerTrade:0.##} = {ex.Message}");
                        }
                        finally
                        {
                            completedProgressSteps++;
                            UpdateSharedButtonProgress(
                                title,
                                completedProgressSteps,
                                totalProgressSteps,
                                $"{symbol} {timeframe} | margin {marginPerTrade:0.##}");
                        }
                    }
                }

                foreach (int maxOpenTrades in maxOpenTests)
                {
                    scenarioResults.Add(SimulateButton9PortfolioScenario(
                        candidates,
                        fromUtc,
                        toUtcExclusive,
                        startingCapitalUsdt,
                        marginPerTrade,
                        leverage,
                        maxOpenTrades));

                    completedProgressSteps++;
                    UpdateSharedButtonProgress(
                        title,
                        completedProgressSteps,
                        totalProgressSteps,
                        $"simulate margin {marginPerTrade:0.##} | max open {maxOpenTrades}");
                }
            }

            if (scenarioResults.Count == 0)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("No Button 9 portfolio scenario was generated.", title, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                return;
            }

            SaveButton9TruePortfolioReports(
                scenarioResults,
                scenarioSkippedData,
                baseSettings,
                selectedSymbols,
                selectedTimeframes,
                fromUtc,
                toUtcExclusive,
                out string txtPath,
                out string csvPath,
                out string equityCsvPath,
                out string tradesCsvPath);

            try
            {
                Clipboard.SetText(File.ReadAllText(txtPath));
            }
            catch
            {
                // Clipboard can be locked. Report files are still written.
            }

            OpenReportFileInExplorer(txtPath);

            Button9PortfolioScenarioResult best = scenarioResults
                .OrderByDescending(x => x.DailyProfitPercent)
                .ThenBy(x => x.MaxDrawdownPercent)
                .First();

            MessageBox.Show(
                $"Button 9 true portfolio backtest completed.\n\n" +
                $"Selected coins      : {selectedSymbols.Count}\n" +
                $"Selected timeframes : {selectedTimeframes.Count}\n" +
                $"Scenarios tested    : {scenarioResults.Count}\n\n" +
                $"Best scenario:\n{best.ScenarioName}\n" +
                $"End equity: {best.EndEquityUsdt:0.00} USDT\n" +
                $"Daily: {best.DailyProfitPercent:0.0000}% | DD: {best.MaxDrawdownPercent:0.00}% | Trades: {best.ExecutedTrades}\n\n" +
                $"TXT:\n{txtPath}\n\nCSV:\n{csvPath}",
                title,
                MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                MessageBoxIcon.Information);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(ex.Message, "Button 9 True Portfolio Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            Toggle(true);
            Cursor.Current = previousCursor;
        }
    }

    private static SrBacktestResult ApplyC1FullProfileRulesToResult(
        SrBacktestResult result,
        C1PerCoinConfigProfile? profile,
        IReadOnlyList<Candle> candles,
        string timeframe,
        out C1FullProfileFilterSummary summary)
    {
        if (profile == null || !profile.HasFullProfileRules)
        {
            int rawPlaced = result.Rows.Count(r => r.Status == SrTradeStatus.Placed);
            int rawClosedNoProfile = result.Rows.Count(r => r.Status == SrTradeStatus.Placed && IsClosedSrTradeRow(r));
            summary = new C1FullProfileFilterSummary
            {
                IsActive = false,
                CooldownCandles = profile?.LossCooldownCandles ?? 0,
                AtrSpikeLimit = profile?.AtrSpikeLimit ?? 0m,
                RawPlacedTrades = rawPlaced,
                FilteredPlacedTrades = rawPlaced,
                RawClosedTrades = rawClosedNoProfile,
                FilteredClosedTrades = rawClosedNoProfile
            };
            return result;
        }

        Dictionary<DateTime, decimal> atrSpikeRatioByTime = profile.AtrSpikeLimit > 0m
            ? BuildAtrSpikeRatioByTime(candles)
            : new Dictionary<DateTime, decimal>();

        var keptPlacedRowIndexes = new HashSet<int>();
        int filteredByCooldown = 0;
        int filteredByAtrSpike = 0;
        int consecutiveLosses = 0;
        DateTime cooldownUntilUtc = DateTime.MinValue;
        double candleMinutes = ResolveTimeframeMinutes(timeframe);

        var placedRows = result.Rows
            .Select((row, index) => new { Row = row, Index = index })
            .Where(x => x.Row.Status == SrTradeStatus.Placed)
            .OrderBy(x => x.Row.SignalTime)
            .ThenBy(x => x.Row.EntryTime ?? DateTime.MaxValue)
            .ThenBy(x => x.Index)
            .ToList();

        foreach (var item in placedRows)
        {
            SrTradeLogRow row = item.Row;

            if (profile.LossCooldownCandles > 0 && row.SignalTime < cooldownUntilUtc)
            {
                filteredByCooldown++;
                continue;
            }

            if (profile.AtrSpikeLimit > 0m &&
                atrSpikeRatioByTime.TryGetValue(row.SignalTime, out decimal spikeRatio) &&
                spikeRatio >= profile.AtrSpikeLimit)
            {
                filteredByAtrSpike++;
                continue;
            }

            keptPlacedRowIndexes.Add(item.Index);

            if (row.Result.Equals("LOSS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                consecutiveLosses++;
                if (profile.LossCooldownCandles > 0 && consecutiveLosses >= 2)
                {
                    DateTime anchor = row.ExitTime ?? row.SignalTime;
                    cooldownUntilUtc = anchor.AddMinutes(candleMinutes * profile.LossCooldownCandles);
                    consecutiveLosses = 0;
                }
            }
            else if (IsWinningSrTradeRow(row))
            {
                consecutiveLosses = 0;
            }
        }

        List<SrTradeLogRow> filteredRows = result.Rows
            .Select((row, index) => new { Row = row, Index = index })
            .Where(x => x.Row.Status != SrTradeStatus.Placed || keptPlacedRowIndexes.Contains(x.Index))
            .Select(x => x.Row)
            .ToList();

        List<SrTradeLogRow> filteredPlacedRows = filteredRows
            .Where(r => r.Status == SrTradeStatus.Placed)
            .ToList();

        int winCount = filteredPlacedRows.Count(IsWinningSrTradeRow);
        int lossCount = filteredPlacedRows.Count(r => r.Result.Equals("LOSS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        int openCount = filteredPlacedRows.Count(r => !IsClosedSrTradeRow(r));
        int rawClosed = placedRows.Count(x => IsClosedSrTradeRow(x.Row));
        int filteredClosed = filteredPlacedRows.Count(IsClosedSrTradeRow);

        summary = new C1FullProfileFilterSummary
        {
            IsActive = true,
            CooldownCandles = profile.LossCooldownCandles,
            AtrSpikeLimit = profile.AtrSpikeLimit,
            RawPlacedTrades = placedRows.Count,
            FilteredPlacedTrades = filteredPlacedRows.Count,
            RawClosedTrades = rawClosed,
            FilteredClosedTrades = filteredClosed,
            FilteredByCooldown = filteredByCooldown,
            FilteredByAtrSpike = filteredByAtrSpike
        };

        return new SrBacktestResult(
            result.Symbol,
            result.Timeframe,
            result.StartUtc,
            result.EndUtcExclusive,
            filteredRows,
            result.CsvPath,
            result.TxtPath,
            result.XlsxPath,
            result.BestR,
            result.BestExpectancy,
            winCount,
            lossCount,
            openCount)
        {
            Settings = result.Settings
        };
    }

    private static List<Button9PortfolioCandidate> BuildButton9PortfolioCandidates(SrBacktestResult result)
    {
        return result.Rows
            .Where(row => row.Status == SrTradeStatus.Placed)
            .Where(row => row.EntryTime.HasValue && row.ExitTime.HasValue)
            .Where(row => row.Entry.HasValue && row.ExitPrice.HasValue)
            .Where(row => row.Direction.HasValue)
            .Where(row => row.PnlUsdt.HasValue && row.ProfitR.HasValue)
            .Where(row => row.Result == "WIN" || row.Result == "TRAIL_WIN" || row.Result == "LOSS")
            .Select(row => new Button9PortfolioCandidate
            {
                Symbol = result.Symbol,
                Timeframe = result.Timeframe,
                SignalTime = row.SignalTime,
                EntryTime = row.EntryTime!.Value,
                ExitTime = row.ExitTime!.Value,
                Direction = row.Direction!.Value,
                OrderType = row.OrderType,
                Entry = row.Entry!.Value,
                ExitPrice = row.ExitPrice!.Value,
                PnlUsdt = row.PnlUsdt!.Value,
                ProfitR = row.ProfitR!.Value,
                Score = row.Score,
                Result = row.Result
            })
            .OrderBy(x => x.EntryTime)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.Score)
            .ToList();
    }

    private static Button9PortfolioScenarioResult SimulateButton9PortfolioScenario(
        IReadOnlyList<Button9PortfolioCandidate> candidates,
        DateTime startUtc,
        DateTime endUtcExclusive,
        decimal startingCapitalUsdt,
        decimal marginPerTradeUsdt,
        decimal leverage,
        int maxOpenTrades)
    {
        decimal equity = startingCapitalUsdt;
        decimal peakEquity = startingCapitalUsdt;
        decimal maxDrawdownPercent = 0m;
        int skippedByOpenLimit = 0;
        int skippedByMargin = 0;
        int skippedByBankrupt = 0;
        int maxSimultaneousOpen = 0;
        var openPositions = new List<Button9PortfolioCandidate>();
        var executedTrades = new List<Button9PortfolioTrade>();
        var equityCurve = new List<Button9EquityPoint>
        {
            new()
            {
                Time = startUtc,
                Equity = startingCapitalUsdt,
                DrawdownPercent = 0m,
                Event = "START",
                Symbol = string.Empty
            }
        };

        void RecordEquity(DateTime time, string eventName, string symbol)
        {
            if (equity > peakEquity)
                peakEquity = equity;

            decimal drawdownPercent = peakEquity > 0m
                ? (peakEquity - equity) * 100m / peakEquity
                : 0m;

            if (drawdownPercent > maxDrawdownPercent)
                maxDrawdownPercent = drawdownPercent;

            equityCurve.Add(new Button9EquityPoint
            {
                Time = time,
                Equity = equity,
                DrawdownPercent = drawdownPercent,
                Event = eventName,
                Symbol = symbol
            });
        }

        void ClosePositionsUpTo(DateTime time)
        {
            foreach (Button9PortfolioCandidate closing in openPositions
                         .Where(x => x.ExitTime <= time)
                         .OrderBy(x => x.ExitTime)
                         .ToList())
            {
                decimal before = equity;
                equity += closing.PnlUsdt;

                executedTrades.Add(new Button9PortfolioTrade
                {
                    Symbol = closing.Symbol,
                    Timeframe = closing.Timeframe,
                    EntryTime = closing.EntryTime,
                    ExitTime = closing.ExitTime,
                    Direction = closing.Direction,
                    OrderType = closing.OrderType,
                    Entry = closing.Entry,
                    ExitPrice = closing.ExitPrice,
                    PnlUsdt = closing.PnlUsdt,
                    ProfitR = closing.ProfitR,
                    EquityBefore = before,
                    EquityAfter = equity,
                    MarginUsdt = marginPerTradeUsdt,
                    TradeSizeUsdt = marginPerTradeUsdt * leverage,
                    Score = closing.Score,
                    Result = closing.Result
                });

                openPositions.Remove(closing);
                RecordEquity(closing.ExitTime, "CLOSE", closing.Symbol);
            }
        }

        foreach (Button9PortfolioCandidate candidate in candidates
                     .Where(x => x.EntryTime >= startUtc && x.EntryTime < endUtcExclusive)
                     .OrderBy(x => x.EntryTime)
                     .ThenByDescending(x => x.Score))
        {
            ClosePositionsUpTo(candidate.EntryTime);

            if (equity <= 0m)
            {
                skippedByBankrupt++;
                continue;
            }

            if (openPositions.Count >= maxOpenTrades)
            {
                skippedByOpenLimit++;
                continue;
            }

            decimal reservedMargin = openPositions.Count * marginPerTradeUsdt;
            if (reservedMargin + marginPerTradeUsdt > equity)
            {
                skippedByMargin++;
                continue;
            }

            openPositions.Add(candidate);
            if (openPositions.Count > maxSimultaneousOpen)
                maxSimultaneousOpen = openPositions.Count;
        }

        ClosePositionsUpTo(endUtcExclusive.AddYears(100));
        RecordEquity(endUtcExclusive.AddTicks(-1), "END", string.Empty);

        int wins = executedTrades.Count(x => x.PnlUsdt > 0m);
        int losses = executedTrades.Count(x => x.PnlUsdt < 0m);
        int closedTrades = wins + losses;
        decimal grossProfit = executedTrades.Where(x => x.PnlUsdt > 0m).Sum(x => x.PnlUsdt);
        decimal grossLossAbs = Math.Abs(executedTrades.Where(x => x.PnlUsdt < 0m).Sum(x => x.PnlUsdt));
        decimal netProfitUsdt = equity - startingCapitalUsdt;
        decimal totalProfitPercent = startingCapitalUsdt > 0m ? netProfitUsdt * 100m / startingCapitalUsdt : 0m;
        decimal netR = executedTrades.Sum(x => x.ProfitR);

        return new Button9PortfolioScenarioResult
        {
            StartingCapitalUsdt = startingCapitalUsdt,
            MarginPerTradeUsdt = marginPerTradeUsdt,
            Leverage = leverage,
            TradeSizeUsdt = marginPerTradeUsdt * leverage,
            MaxOpenTrades = maxOpenTrades,
            StartUtc = startUtc,
            EndUtcExclusive = endUtcExclusive,
            Candidates = candidates.Count,
            ExecutedTrades = executedTrades.Count,
            SkippedByOpenLimit = skippedByOpenLimit,
            SkippedByMargin = skippedByMargin,
            SkippedByBankruptEquity = skippedByBankrupt,
            MaxSimultaneousOpen = maxSimultaneousOpen,
            EndEquityUsdt = equity,
            NetProfitUsdt = netProfitUsdt,
            TotalProfitPercent = totalProfitPercent,
            DailyProfitPercent = CalculateDailyProfitPercent(startUtc, endUtcExclusive, totalProfitPercent),
            MaxDrawdownPercent = maxDrawdownPercent,
            ProfitFactor = grossLossAbs > 0m ? grossProfit / grossLossAbs : grossProfit > 0m ? 9999m : 0m,
            Wins = wins,
            Losses = losses,
            WinRate = closedTrades > 0 ? wins * 100m / closedTrades : 0m,
            NetR = netR,
            EdgeR = executedTrades.Count > 0 ? netR / executedTrades.Count : 0m,
            Trades = executedTrades,
            EquityCurve = equityCurve
        };
    }

    private static void SaveButton9TruePortfolioReports(
        IReadOnlyList<Button9PortfolioScenarioResult> scenarioResults,
        IReadOnlyList<string> skippedData,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings baseSettings,
        IReadOnlyList<string> selectedSymbols,
        IReadOnlyList<string> selectedTimeframes,
        DateTime startUtc,
        DateTime endUtcExclusive,
        out string txtPath,
        out string csvPath,
        out string equityCsvPath,
        out string tradesCsvPath)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        string stamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string baseName = $"BUTTON_9_C1_TRUE_PORTFOLIO_BACKTEST_{stamp}";
        txtPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, baseName + ".txt");
        csvPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, baseName + ".csv");
        equityCsvPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, baseName + "_EQUITY_CURVE.csv");
        tradesCsvPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, baseName + "_TRADES.csv");

        string txt = BuildButton9TruePortfolioSummary(
            scenarioResults,
            skippedData,
            baseSettings,
            selectedSymbols,
            selectedTimeframes,
            startUtc,
            endUtcExclusive,
            txtPath,
            csvPath,
            equityCsvPath,
            tradesCsvPath);

        File.WriteAllText(txtPath, txt, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(csvPath, BuildButton9ScenarioCsv(scenarioResults), System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(equityCsvPath, BuildButton9EquityCurveCsv(scenarioResults), System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(tradesCsvPath, BuildButton9TradesCsv(scenarioResults), System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);

        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, "LATEST_BUTTON_9_C1_TRUE_PORTFOLIO_BACKTEST.txt"), txt, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, "LATEST_BUTTON_9_C1_TRUE_PORTFOLIO_BACKTEST.csv"), BuildButton9ScenarioCsv(scenarioResults), System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
    }

    private static string BuildButton9TruePortfolioSummary(
        IReadOnlyList<Button9PortfolioScenarioResult> scenarioResults,
        IReadOnlyList<string> skippedData,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings baseSettings,
        IReadOnlyList<string> selectedSymbols,
        IReadOnlyList<string> selectedTimeframes,
        DateTime startUtc,
        DateTime endUtcExclusive,
        string txtPath,
        string csvPath,
        string equityCsvPath,
        string tradesCsvPath)
    {
        Button9PortfolioScenarioResult bestDaily = scenarioResults
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.DailyProfitPercent)
            .ThenBy(x => x.MaxDrawdownPercent)
            .First();

        Button9PortfolioScenarioResult bestRiskAdjusted = scenarioResults
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.MaxDrawdownPercent > 0m ? x.DailyProfitPercent / x.MaxDrawdownPercent : x.DailyProfitPercent * 10m)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.DailyProfitPercent)
            .First();

        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("BUTTON 9 - C1 TRUE PORTFOLIO BACKTEST REPORT");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated UTC       : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine("Mode                : True shared-capital concurrency simulation");
        sb.AppendLine($"Selected Coins      : {string.Join(", ", selectedSymbols)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Selected Timeframes : {string.Join(", ", selectedTimeframes)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Date Range          : {startUtc:yyyy-MM-dd} to {endUtcExclusive.AddDays(-1):yyyy-MM-dd} (ONE-YEAR VALIDATION)");
        sb.AppendLine($"Scenarios Tested    : {scenarioResults.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"TXT Report          : {txtPath}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Scenario CSV        : {csvPath}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Equity Curve CSV    : {equityCsvPath}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Trades CSV          : {tradesCsvPath}");
        sb.AppendLine("Important           : This is true portfolio simulation: one shared 100 USDT account, reserved margin, max open trade limit, chronological entries/exits.");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("BASE C1 SETTINGS USED FROM UI");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Stop Loss ATR       : {baseSettings.StopLossAtrMultiplier:0.####}");
        sb.AppendLine($"TP Target R         : {baseSettings.TargetR:0.####}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Trail ATR           : {baseSettings.TrailStopAtrMultiplier:0.####}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Trail Activation R  : {baseSettings.TrailActivationR:0.####}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Orders              : Market={baseSettings.EnableMO}, Limit={baseSettings.EnableLO}, Stop={baseSettings.EnableSO}, Long={baseSettings.EnableLong}, Short={baseSettings.EnableShort}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Rules               : Score={baseSettings.EnableScoreRule}, RSI={baseSettings.EnableRsiRule}, MACD={baseSettings.EnableMacdRule}, Volume={baseSettings.EnableVolumeRule}, Candle={baseSettings.EnableCandleRule}, Distance={baseSettings.EnableDistanceRule}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("BEST SCENARIO BY DAILY PROFIT");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        AppendButton9ScenarioLine(sb, bestDaily);
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("BEST RISK-ADJUSTED SCENARIO");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        AppendButton9ScenarioLine(sb, bestRiskAdjusted);
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("ALL SCENARIO RANKING");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        foreach (Button9PortfolioScenarioResult row in scenarioResults.OrderByDescending(x => x.DailyProfitPercent).ThenBy(x => x.MaxDrawdownPercent))
            AppendButton9ScenarioLine(sb, row);

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("TOP SYMBOL CONTRIBUTION IN BEST DAILY SCENARIO");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        foreach (var row in bestDaily.Trades
                     .GroupBy(x => x.Symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                     .Select(g => new
                     {
                         Symbol = g.Key,
                         Trades = g.Count(),
                         Pnl = g.Sum(x => x.PnlUsdt),
                         Wins = g.Count(x => x.PnlUsdt > 0m),
                         Losses = g.Count(x => x.PnlUsdt < 0m)
                     })
                     .OrderByDescending(x => x.Pnl)
                     .Take(20))
        {
            decimal winRate = row.Trades > 0 ? row.Wins * 100m / row.Trades : 0m;
            sb.AppendLine($"{row.Symbol,-12} | PnL {row.Pnl,10:0.00} | Trades {row.Trades,4} | Win {winRate,6:0.00}% | W/L {row.Wins}/{row.Losses}");
        }

        if (skippedData.Count > 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine("DATA / MARKET SKIPS");
            sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
            foreach (string line in skippedData.Take(100))
                sb.AppendLine(line);

            if (skippedData.Count > 100)
                sb.AppendLine($"... plus {skippedData.Count - 100} more skipped data lines.");
        }

        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static void AppendButton9ScenarioLine(System.Text.StringBuilder sb, Button9PortfolioScenarioResult row)
    {
        sb.AppendLine(
            $"{row.ScenarioName} | Start {row.StartingCapitalUsdt:0.00} | End {row.EndEquityUsdt:0.00} | " +
            $"Profit {row.NetProfitUsdt:0.00} ({row.TotalProfitPercent:0.00}%) | Daily {row.DailyProfitPercent:0.0000}% | " +
            $"DD {row.MaxDrawdownPercent:0.00}% | Trades {row.ExecutedTrades} | Win {row.WinRate:0.00}% | " +
            $"PF {row.ProfitFactor:0.##} | Edge {row.EdgeR:0.###}R | MaxOpenSeen {row.MaxSimultaneousOpen} | " +
            $"Candidates {row.Candidates} | SkipLimit {row.SkippedByOpenLimit} | SkipMargin {row.SkippedByMargin}");
    }

    private static string BuildButton9ScenarioCsv(IReadOnlyList<Button9PortfolioScenarioResult> scenarioResults)
    {
        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("Scenario,StartingCapitalUSDT,MarginPerTradeUSDT,Leverage,TradeSizeUSDT,MaxOpenTrades,Candidates,ExecutedTrades,SkippedByOpenLimit,SkippedByMargin,SkippedByBankrupt,MaxSimultaneousOpen,EndEquityUSDT,NetProfitUSDT,TotalProfitPercent,DailyProfitPercent,MaxDrawdownPercent,Wins,Losses,WinRate,NetR,EdgeR_UnitR,ProfitFactor");
        foreach (Button9PortfolioScenarioResult row in scenarioResults.OrderByDescending(x => x.DailyProfitPercent).ThenBy(x => x.MaxDrawdownPercent))
        {
            sb.AppendLine(string.Join(",", new[]
            {
                Csv(row.ScenarioName),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.StartingCapitalUsdt),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.MarginPerTradeUsdt),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.Leverage),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.TradeSizeUsdt),
                row.MaxOpenTrades.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.Candidates.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.ExecutedTrades.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.SkippedByOpenLimit.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.SkippedByMargin.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.SkippedByBankruptEquity.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.MaxSimultaneousOpen.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.EndEquityUsdt),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.NetProfitUsdt),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.TotalProfitPercent),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.DailyProfitPercent),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.MaxDrawdownPercent),
                row.Wins.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.Losses.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.WinRate),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.NetR),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.EdgeR),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.ProfitFactor)
            }));
        }
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static string BuildButton9EquityCurveCsv(IReadOnlyList<Button9PortfolioScenarioResult> scenarioResults)
    {
        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("Scenario,Time,EquityUSDT,DrawdownPercent,Event,Symbol");
        foreach (Button9PortfolioScenarioResult scenario in scenarioResults.OrderBy(x => x.MarginPerTradeUsdt).ThenBy(x => x.MaxOpenTrades))
        {
            foreach (Button9EquityPoint point in scenario.EquityCurve.OrderBy(x => x.Time))
            {
                sb.AppendLine(string.Join(",", new[]
                {
                    Csv(scenario.ScenarioName),
                    Csv(point.Time.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
                    FormatCsvDecimal(point.Equity),
                    FormatCsvDecimal(point.DrawdownPercent),
                    Csv(point.Event),
                    Csv(point.Symbol)
                }));
            }
        }
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static string BuildButton9TradesCsv(IReadOnlyList<Button9PortfolioScenarioResult> scenarioResults)
    {
        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("Scenario,Symbol,Timeframe,EntryTime,ExitTime,Direction,OrderType,Entry,ExitPrice,PnlUSDT,ProfitR,EquityBefore,EquityAfter,MarginUSDT,TradeSizeUSDT,Score,Result");
        foreach (Button9PortfolioScenarioResult scenario in scenarioResults.OrderBy(x => x.MarginPerTradeUsdt).ThenBy(x => x.MaxOpenTrades))
        {
            foreach (Button9PortfolioTrade trade in scenario.Trades.OrderBy(x => x.ExitTime))
            {
                sb.AppendLine(string.Join(",", new[]
                {
                    Csv(scenario.ScenarioName),
                    Csv(trade.Symbol),
                    Csv(trade.Timeframe),
                    Csv(trade.EntryTime.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
                    Csv(trade.ExitTime.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
                    Csv(trade.Direction.ToString()),
                    Csv(trade.OrderType?.ToString() ?? string.Empty),
                    FormatCsvDecimal(trade.Entry),
                    FormatCsvDecimal(trade.ExitPrice),
                    FormatCsvDecimal(trade.PnlUsdt),
                    FormatCsvDecimal(trade.ProfitR),
                    FormatCsvDecimal(trade.EquityBefore),
                    FormatCsvDecimal(trade.EquityAfter),
                    FormatCsvDecimal(trade.MarginUsdt),
                    FormatCsvDecimal(trade.TradeSizeUsdt),
                    FormatCsvDecimal(trade.Score),
                    Csv(trade.Result)
                }));
            }
        }
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static string ResolveStableStrategyCode(Type type)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(type);

        string typeName = type.Name;

        return typeName switch
        {
            "AltcoinLeadershipPullbackQuantStrategy" => "S01",
            "DiagnosticQuantStrategy" => "S02",
            "EmaRsiQuantStrategy" => "S03",
            "EmaTrendPullbackQuantStrategy" => "S04",
            "EmaTrendQuantStrategy" => "S05",
            "FourHourEarlyTrendContinuationQuantStrategy" => "S06",
            "RsiSwingQuantStrategy" => "S07",
            _ => "S??"
        };
    }

    private static string ResolveStrategyDisplayName(Type type)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(type);
        return $"{ResolveStableStrategyCode(type)}  {type.Name}";
    }
    private sealed class Button16C1BacktestRunRow
    {
