    private string WriteButton5CurrentYearLoSoNearSrSummary(
        IReadOnlyList<C1DdControlSweepRow> rows,
        IReadOnlyList<string> skipped,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings baseSettings,
        C1DdControlSweepRow best,
        IReadOnlyList<string> selectedSymbols,
        IReadOnlyList<string> selectedTimeframes,
        DateTime rangeStartUtc,
        DateTime rangeEndUtcExclusive,
        string txtPath,
        string csvPath)
    {
        string folder = Path.Combine(QuickCoinListFolder, "BUTTON5_CURRENT_YEAR_LO_SO_NEAR_SR");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(folder);

        string path = Path.Combine(folder, "LATEST_BUTTON_5_CURRENT_YEAR_LO_SO_NEAR_SR_SUMMARY.txt");
        string profileFolder = GetC1PerCoinProfileDirectory();

        List<C1DdControlSweepRow> bestPerMarket = rows
            .GroupBy(r => $"{r.Symbol}::{r.Timeframe}", StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Select(g => SelectBestC1DdControlSweepRow(g)!)
            .OrderByDescending(r => r.Pass)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.DailyProfitPercent)
            .ToList();

        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("BUTTON 5 CURRENT-YEAR LO/SO NEAR-SR BACKTEST SUMMARY");
        sb.AppendLine(new string('=', 72));
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated Local          : {DateTime.Now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} {TimeZoneInfo.Local.StandardName}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated UTC            : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Date Range UTC           : {rangeStartUtc:yyyy-MM-dd} to {rangeEndUtcExclusive.AddDays(-1):yyyy-MM-dd}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Symbols                  : {string.Join(", ", selectedSymbols)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Timeframes               : {string.Join(", ", selectedTimeframes)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Rows                     : {rows.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Pass Rows                : {rows.Count(r => r.Pass)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Profiles Folder          : {profileFolder}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Source TXT               : {txtPath}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Source CSV               : {csvPath}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("FIXED BUTTON 5 RULES");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("Order Types              : LO + SO only; Market Order disabled");
        sb.AppendLine("Risk                     : Start 100 USDT | Margin 10 USDT | Leverage 10x | Trade Size 100 USDT");
        sb.AppendLine("Stop Loss Scan           : 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30 ATR");
        sb.AppendLine("Take Profit              : 2.00R fixed double TP");
        sb.AppendLine("Trailing Stop            : ON | Trail ATR 0.75 | Activation 1.75R");
        sb.AppendLine("Very Near SR Zone        : Retest Distance 0.10/0.15/0.20 ATR | Breakout Distance 0.15/0.25/0.35 ATR");
        sb.AppendLine("Score Scan               : LO/SO score 50, 60, 70");
        sb.AppendLine("DD Control               : Cooldown 0/12/24/48 | ATR Spike Off/1.50/1.75/2.00x");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("BEST OVERALL");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        AppendButton5NearSrSummaryRow(sb, best, baseSettings);
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("BEST PER MARKET");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        foreach (C1DdControlSweepRow row in bestPerMarket)
            AppendButton5NearSrSummaryRow(sb, row, baseSettings);

        if (skipped.Count > 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine("SKIPPED");
            sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
            foreach (string line in skipped)
                sb.AppendLine(line);
        }

        File.WriteAllText(path, sb.ToString(), Encoding.UTF8);
        return path;
    }

    private static void AppendButton5NearSrSummaryRow(StringBuilder sb, C1DdControlSweepRow row, SrTradeBacktestSettings baseSettings)
    {
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings = row.SettingsSnapshot ?? baseSettings;
        sb.AppendLine(
            $"{row.Symbol} {row.Timeframe} | Pass {row.Pass} | Daily {row.DailyProfitPercent:0.0000}% | DD {row.MaxDrawdownPercent:0.00}% | " +
            $"PF {row.ProfitFactor:0.##} | Edge {row.EdgeR:0.###}R | Win {row.WinRate:0.00}% | MFE {row.AverageMfeCapturePercent:0.00}% | " +
            $"Closed {row.ClosedTrades} | SL {settings.StopLossAtrMultiplier:0.##} | TP {settings.TargetR:0.##} | LO {settings.MinimumLoScore:0} | SO {settings.MinimumSoScore:0} | " +
            $"RetDist {settings.MaxRetestDistanceAtr:0.##} ATR | BrDist {settings.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr:0.##} ATR | Cool {FormatCooldownLabel(row.CooldownCandles)} | ATR {FormatAtrSpikeLabel(row.AtrSpikeLimit)}");
    }

    private static decimal[] BuildFastDecimalTests(decimal seed, decimal[] multipliers, decimal min, decimal max)
    {
        return multipliers
            .Select(m => Math.Max(min, Math.Min(max, Math.Round(seed * m, 4))))
            .Append(seed)
            .Distinct()
            .OrderBy(x => x)
            .ToArray();
    }

    private static decimal[] BuildFastDecimalFixedTests(decimal seed, decimal[] values)
    {
        return values
            .Append(seed)
            .Where(x => x >= 0m)
            .Distinct()
            .OrderBy(x => x)
            .ToArray();
    }

    private static int[] BuildFastIntTests(int seed, int[] values)
    {
        return values
            .Append(seed)
            .Where(x => x >= 0)
            .Distinct()
            .OrderBy(x => x)
            .ToArray();
    }

    private static decimal[] BuildFastScoreTests(decimal seed)
    {
        return new[] { seed - 10m, seed, seed + 10m }
            .Select(x => Math.Max(0m, Math.Min(100m, x)))
            .Distinct()
            .OrderBy(x => x)
            .ToArray();
    }

    private async Task RunC1DdControlTuneAsync()
    {
        const string title = "08-C1 DD CONTROL";

        if (!TryGetSelectedMarketSelection(title, out List<string> selectedSymbols, out List<string> selectedTimeframes))
            return;

        ResolveOneYearValidationWindow(out DateTime selectedStartDate, out DateTime selectedEndDate);

        if (selectedEndDate < selectedStartDate)
        {
            MessageBox.Show("End date must be greater than or equal to start date.", title, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
            return;
        }

        DateTime rangeStartUtc = DateTime.SpecifyKind(selectedStartDate, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        DateTime rangeEndUtcExclusive = DateTime.SpecifyKind(selectedEndDate.AddDays(1), DateTimeKind.Utc);
        DateTime calculationStartUtc = rangeStartUtc.AddDays(-120);

        SrTradeBacktestSettings baseSettings = GetSrTradeBacktestSettingsFromUi();

        // Button 8 remains controlled; Button 5 is the faster seeded profit+DD runner.
        // These ranges are wider than the original SO60/65/70 and SL0.30/0.35/0.40,
        // but still practical enough for normal desktop runs.
        decimal[] soScoreTests = { 50m, 60m, 70m, 80m, 90m };
        decimal[] slAtrTests = { 0.30m, 0.35m, 0.40m, 0.50m, 0.75m, 1.00m };
        int[] cooldownTests = { 0, 12, 24, 48 };
        decimal[] atrSpikeTests = { 0m, 1.50m, 1.75m, 2.00m };
        int totalTests = selectedSymbols.Count * selectedTimeframes.Count * soScoreTests.Length * slAtrTests.Length * cooldownTests.Length * atrSpikeTests.Length;

        using var progressForm = new Form
        {
            Text = title + " - Running",
            StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent,
            Width = 860,
            Height = 285,
            FormBorderStyle = FormBorderStyle.FixedDialog,
            MaximizeBox = false,
            MinimizeBox = false
        };

        var lblTitle = new Label
        {
            Text = "Button 8 tests DD-control rules: SO score, SL ATR, loss cooldown, and ATR spike guard.",
            Left = 12,
            Top = 12,
            Width = 815,
            Height = 34
        };

        var progressBar = new ProgressBar
        {
            Left = 12,
            Top = 54,
            Width = 805,
            Height = 24,
            Minimum = 0,
            Maximum = Math.Max(1, totalTests),
            Value = 0
        };

        var lblStatus = new Label
        {
            Text = "Preparing C1 DD-control sweep...",
            Left = 12,
            Top = 86,
            Width = 815,
            Height = 78
        };

        var lblBest = new Label
        {
            Text = "Best: waiting...",
            Left = 12,
            Top = 170,
            Width = 815,
            Height = 34
        };

        var btnCancelClose = new Button
        {
            Text = "Cancel",
            Left = 725,
            Top = 212,
            Width = 100,
            Height = 28
        };

        progressForm.Controls.AddRange(new Control[] { lblTitle, progressBar, lblStatus, lblBest, btnCancelClose });

        using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        bool completedNormally = false;

        btnCancelClose.Click += (_, _) =>
        {
            if (completedNormally)
            {
                progressForm.Close();
                return;
            }

            cts.Cancel();
            btnCancelClose.Enabled = false;
            btnCancelClose.Text = "Cancelling";
        };

        progressForm.Show(this);
        progressForm.Refresh();
        Toggle(false);

        try
        {
            using var scope = _sp.CreateScope();
            var feed = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<ICandleDataFeed>();
            var engine = new SrTradeBacktestEngine();
            var rows = new List<C1DdControlSweepRow>();
            var skipped = new List<string>();
            int completed = 0;

            foreach (string symbol in selectedSymbols)
            {
                foreach (string timeframe in selectedTimeframes)
                {
                    cts.Token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

                    List<Candle> candles = GetCandlesFromResearchRam(feed, symbol, timeframe, calculationStartUtc, rangeEndUtcExclusive, title);

                    if (candles.Count(c => c.Time >= rangeStartUtc && c.Time < rangeEndUtcExclusive) < 250)
                    {
                        int skipCount = soScoreTests.Length * slAtrTests.Length * cooldownTests.Length * atrSpikeTests.Length;
                        completed += skipCount;
                        progressBar.Value = Math.Min(progressBar.Maximum, completed);
                        skipped.Add($"{symbol} {timeframe}: skipped, not enough candles for selected range.");
                        continue;
                    }

                    C1PerCoinConfigProfile? seedProfile = TryLoadC1PerCoinConfigProfile(symbol, timeframe, baseSettings);
                    SrTradeBacktestSettings marketBaseSettings = seedProfile?.Settings ?? baseSettings;
                    if (seedProfile != null)
                        AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, $"Button 8 seed profile loaded: {symbol} {timeframe} -> {Path.GetFileName(seedProfile.Path)}");

                    Dictionary<DateTime, decimal> atrSpikeRatioByTime = BuildAtrSpikeRatioByTime(candles);

                    foreach (decimal soScore in soScoreTests)
                    {
                        foreach (decimal slAtr in slAtrTests)
                        {
                            SrTradeBacktestSettings coreSettings = marketBaseSettings with
                            {
                                MinimumSoScore = soScore,
                                StopLossAtrMultiplier = slAtr
                            };

                            SrBacktestResult result = await Task.Run(() => engine.Run(
                                symbol,
                                timeframe,
                                rangeStartUtc,
                                rangeEndUtcExclusive,
                                candles,
                                coreSettings,
                                saveOutputFiles: false,
                                calculateBestR: false), cts.Token);

                            foreach (int cooldownCandles in cooldownTests)
                            {
                                foreach (decimal atrSpikeLimit in atrSpikeTests)
                                {
                                    cts.Token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                                    completed++;

                                    lblStatus.Text =
                                        $"Test {completed}/{totalTests}: {symbol} {timeframe}\n" +
                                        $"SO score={soScore:0.#}, SL ATR={slAtr:0.##}, Cooldown={(cooldownCandles <= 0 ? "Off" : cooldownCandles + " candles")}, ATR spike={(atrSpikeLimit <= 0m ? "Off" : atrSpikeLimit.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "x")}";
                                    progressBar.Value = Math.Min(progressBar.Maximum, completed);
                                    progressForm.Refresh();

                                    if (completed == 1 || completed == totalTests || completed % Math.Max(1, totalTests / 200) == 0)
                                    {
                                        UpdateSharedButtonProgress(
                                            title,
                                            completed,
                                            totalTests,
                                            $"{symbol} {timeframe} | SO {soScore:0.#} | SL {slAtr:0.##} | Cool {(cooldownCandles <= 0 ? "Off" : cooldownCandles.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))} | ATR {(atrSpikeLimit <= 0m ? "Off" : atrSpikeLimit.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))}");
                                    }

                                    rows.Add(BuildC1DdControlSweepRow(
                                        symbol,
                                        timeframe,
                                        rangeStartUtc,
                                        rangeEndUtcExclusive,
                                        coreSettings,
                                        result.Rows,
                                        atrSpikeRatioByTime,
                                        cooldownCandles,
                                        atrSpikeLimit));

                                    C1DdControlSweepRow? bestSoFar = SelectBestC1DdControlSweepRow(rows);
                                    if (bestSoFar != null)
                                    {
                                        lblBest.Text =
                                            $"Best: {bestSoFar.Symbol} {bestSoFar.Timeframe} | SO {bestSoFar.SoMinScore:0.#} | SL {bestSoFar.StopLossAtr:0.##} | " +
                                            $"Cool {bestSoFar.CooldownLabel} | ATR {bestSoFar.AtrSpikeLabel} | Daily {bestSoFar.DailyProfitPercent:0.0000}% | DD {bestSoFar.MaxDrawdownPercent:0.00}% | PF {bestSoFar.ProfitFactor:0.##} | Edge {bestSoFar.EdgeR:0.###}R | MFE {bestSoFar.AverageMfeCapturePercent:0.00}%";
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            completedNormally = true;
            btnCancelClose.Enabled = true;
            btnCancelClose.Text = "Close";
            progressBar.Value = progressBar.Maximum;

            if (rows.Count == 0)
            {
                lblTitle.Text = "C1 DD-control sweep completed, but no result was generated.";
                lblStatus.Text = skipped.Count == 0 ? "No rows generated." : string.Join(Environment.NewLine, skipped.Take(8));
                lblBest.Text = "No result.";
                return;
            }

            C1DdControlSweepRow best = SelectBestC1DdControlSweepRow(rows)!;
            SrTradeBacktestSettings appliedSettings = baseSettings with
            {
                MinimumSoScore = best.SoMinScore,
                StopLossAtrMultiplier = best.StopLossAtr
            };
            ApplySrSettingsToUi(appliedSettings);

            SaveC1DdControlSweepReport(
                rows,
                skipped,
                baseSettings,
                best,
                selectedSymbols,
                selectedTimeframes,
                rangeStartUtc,
                rangeEndUtcExclusive,
                out string txtPath,
                out string csvPath);

            try
            {
                Clipboard.SetText(File.ReadAllText(txtPath));
                lblTitle.Text = "C1 DD-control sweep completed. Best SO score/SL ATR applied to UI and summary copied to clipboard.";
            }
            catch
            {
                lblTitle.Text = "C1 DD-control sweep completed. Best SO score/SL ATR applied to UI. Clipboard copy was skipped.";
            }

            lblStatus.Text = $"TXT:\n{txtPath}\nCSV:\n{csvPath}";
            lblBest.Text =
                $"Best: {best.Symbol} {best.Timeframe} | SO {best.SoMinScore:0.#} | SL {best.StopLossAtr:0.##} | {best.CooldownLabel} | ATR {best.AtrSpikeLabel} | " +
                $"Daily {best.DailyProfitPercent:0.0000}% | DD {best.MaxDrawdownPercent:0.00}% | PF {best.ProfitFactor:0.##}";

            OpenReportFileInExplorer(txtPath);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            completedNormally = true;
            btnCancelClose.Enabled = true;
            btnCancelClose.Text = "Close";
            lblTitle.Text = "C1 DD-control sweep cancelled.";
            lblStatus.Text = "The sweep was cancelled by user.";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            completedNormally = true;
            btnCancelClose.Enabled = true;
            btnCancelClose.Text = "Close";
            lblTitle.Text = "C1 DD-control sweep error.";
            lblStatus.Text = ex.Message;
        }
        finally
        {
            Toggle(true);
        }
    }

    private static C1DdControlSweepRow BuildC1DdControlSweepRow(
        string symbol,
        string timeframe,
        DateTime startUtc,
        DateTime endUtcExclusive,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings,
        IReadOnlyList<SrTradeLogRow> resultRows,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<DateTime, decimal> atrSpikeRatioByTime,
        int cooldownCandles,
        decimal atrSpikeLimit)
    {
        List<SrTradeLogRow> placedRows = resultRows
            .Where(r => r.Status == SrTradeStatus.Placed)
            .Where(r => r.SignalTime >= startUtc && r.SignalTime < endUtcExclusive)
            .ToList();

        List<SrTradeLogRow> rawClosedRows = placedRows
            .Where(IsClosedSrTradeRow)
            .OrderBy(r => r.SignalTime)
            .ToList();

        decimal rawProfitPercent = settings.StartEquityUsdt > 0m ? rawClosedRows.Sum(r => r.PnlUsdt ?? 0m) / settings.StartEquityUsdt * 100m : 0m;
        decimal rawDaily = CalculateDailyProfitPercent(startUtc, endUtcExclusive, rawProfitPercent);
        decimal rawDd = CalculateMonthlyDrawdownPercent(rawClosedRows, settings.StartEquityUsdt);

        List<SrTradeLogRow> filteredRows = new();
        int filteredByCooldown = 0;
        int filteredByAtrSpike = 0;
        int consecutiveLosses = 0;
        DateTime cooldownUntilUtc = DateTime.MinValue;
        double candleMinutes = ResolveTimeframeMinutes(timeframe);

        foreach (SrTradeLogRow row in rawClosedRows)
        {
            if (cooldownCandles > 0 && row.SignalTime < cooldownUntilUtc)
            {
                filteredByCooldown++;
                continue;
            }

            if (atrSpikeLimit > 0m && atrSpikeRatioByTime.TryGetValue(row.SignalTime, out decimal spikeRatio) && spikeRatio >= atrSpikeLimit)
            {
                filteredByAtrSpike++;
                continue;
            }

            filteredRows.Add(row);

            if (row.Result.Equals("LOSS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                consecutiveLosses++;
                if (cooldownCandles > 0 && consecutiveLosses >= 2)
                {
                    DateTime anchor = row.ExitTime ?? row.SignalTime;
                    cooldownUntilUtc = anchor.AddMinutes(candleMinutes * cooldownCandles);
                    consecutiveLosses = 0;
                }
            }
            else if (IsWinningSrTradeRow(row))
            {
                consecutiveLosses = 0;
            }
        }

        int wins = filteredRows.Count(IsWinningSrTradeRow);
        int losses = filteredRows.Count(r => r.Result.Equals("LOSS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        decimal winRate = filteredRows.Count > 0 ? (decimal)wins / filteredRows.Count * 100m : 0m;
        decimal netR = filteredRows.Sum(r => r.ProfitR ?? 0m);
        decimal edgeR = filteredRows.Count > 0 ? netR / filteredRows.Count : 0m;
        decimal netProfitUsdt = filteredRows.Sum(r => r.PnlUsdt ?? 0m);
        decimal netProfitPercent = settings.StartEquityUsdt > 0m ? netProfitUsdt / settings.StartEquityUsdt * 100m : 0m;
        decimal dailyProfitPercent = CalculateDailyProfitPercent(startUtc, endUtcExclusive, netProfitPercent);
        decimal maxDrawdownPercent = CalculateMonthlyDrawdownPercent(filteredRows, settings.StartEquityUsdt);
        decimal ddReduction = rawDd - maxDrawdownPercent;

        decimal grossWinR = filteredRows.Where(r => (r.ProfitR ?? 0m) > 0m).Sum(r => r.ProfitR ?? 0m);
        decimal grossLossR = Math.Abs(filteredRows.Where(r => (r.ProfitR ?? 0m) < 0m).Sum(r => r.ProfitR ?? 0m));
        decimal profitFactor = grossLossR > 0m ? grossWinR / grossLossR : grossWinR > 0m ? 999m : 0m;

        List<SrTradeLogRow> mfeMaeRows = filteredRows
            .Where(r => r.MfeR.HasValue && r.MaeR.HasValue)
            .ToList();

        decimal averageMfeR = mfeMaeRows.Count > 0 ? mfeMaeRows.Average(r => r.MfeR!.Value) : 0m;
        decimal averageMaeR = mfeMaeRows.Count > 0 ? mfeMaeRows.Average(r => r.MaeR!.Value) : 0m;
        decimal mfeMaeRatio = averageMaeR > 0m ? averageMfeR / averageMaeR : averageMfeR > 0m ? 999m : 0m;
        int highMaeTrades = mfeMaeRows.Count(r => r.MaeR.HasValue && r.MaeR.Value >= 0.80m);
        decimal highMaeTradesPercent = mfeMaeRows.Count > 0 ? (decimal)highMaeTrades / mfeMaeRows.Count * 100m : 0m;

        List<SrTradeLogRow> captureRows = filteredRows
            .Where(r => r.MfeR.HasValue && r.MfeR.Value > 0m && r.ProfitR.HasValue)
            .ToList();

        decimal averageMfeCapturePercent = captureRows.Count > 0
            ? captureRows.Average(r => Math.Max(0m, r.ProfitR!.Value) / Math.Max(0.0001m, r.MfeR!.Value) * 100m)
            : 0m;

        bool pass = filteredRows.Count >= 50 &&
                    netProfitUsdt > 0m &&
                    edgeR > 0m &&
                    winRate >= 70m &&
                    profitFactor >= 3.00m &&
                    maxDrawdownPercent <= 5.00m &&
                    averageMfeCapturePercent >= 50m;

        decimal score =
            (pass ? 100000m : 0m) +
            (Math.Max(0m, ddReduction) * 500m) +
            (dailyProfitPercent * 900m) +
            (Math.Min(profitFactor, 20m) * 90m) +
            (averageMfeCapturePercent * 8m) +
            (edgeR * 250m) -
            (maxDrawdownPercent * 350m) -
            ((rawClosedRows.Count - filteredRows.Count) * 0.25m);

        return new C1DdControlSweepRow
        {
            Symbol = symbol,
            Timeframe = timeframe,
            StartUtc = startUtc,
            EndUtcExclusive = endUtcExclusive,
            SoMinScore = settings.MinimumSoScore,
            StopLossAtr = settings.StopLossAtrMultiplier,
            CooldownCandles = cooldownCandles,
            AtrSpikeLimit = atrSpikeLimit,
            PlacedTrades = placedRows.Count,
            RawClosedTrades = rawClosedRows.Count,
            RawDailyProfitPercent = rawDaily,
            RawMaxDrawdownPercent = rawDd,
            ClosedTrades = filteredRows.Count,
            FilteredByCooldown = filteredByCooldown,
            FilteredByAtrSpike = filteredByAtrSpike,
            Wins = wins,
            Losses = losses,
            WinRate = winRate,
            NetR = netR,
            EdgeR = edgeR,
            ProfitFactor = profitFactor,
            NetProfitUsdt = netProfitUsdt,
            NetProfitPercent = netProfitPercent,
            DailyProfitPercent = dailyProfitPercent,
            MaxDrawdownPercent = maxDrawdownPercent,
            DrawdownReductionPercent = ddReduction,
            AverageMfeCapturePercent = averageMfeCapturePercent,
            AverageMfeR = averageMfeR,
            AverageMaeR = averageMaeR,
            MfeMaeRatio = mfeMaeRatio,
            HighMaeTradesPercent = highMaeTradesPercent,
            Score = score,
            Pass = pass,
            SettingsSnapshot = settings
        };
    }

    private static C1DdControlSweepRow? SelectBestC1DdControlSweepRow(IEnumerable<C1DdControlSweepRow> rows)
    {
        return rows
            .OrderByDescending(r => r.Pass)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.Score)
            .ThenBy(r => r.MaxDrawdownPercent)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.DailyProfitPercent)
            .FirstOrDefault();
    }

    private static Dictionary<DateTime, decimal> BuildAtrSpikeRatioByTime(IReadOnlyList<Candle> candles)
    {
        var output = new Dictionary<DateTime, decimal>();
        if (candles.Count < 60)
            return output;

        var trQueue14 = new Queue<decimal>();
        var trQueue50 = new Queue<decimal>();
        decimal sum14 = 0m;
        decimal sum50 = 0m;
        decimal previousClose = candles[0].Close;

        for (int i = 1; i < candles.Count; i++)
        {
            Candle candle = candles[i];
            decimal tr1 = candle.High - candle.Low;
            decimal tr2 = Math.Abs(candle.High - previousClose);
            decimal tr3 = Math.Abs(candle.Low - previousClose);
            decimal trueRange = Math.Max(tr1, Math.Max(tr2, tr3));
            previousClose = candle.Close;

            trQueue14.Enqueue(trueRange);
            sum14 += trueRange;
            if (trQueue14.Count > 14)
                sum14 -= trQueue14.Dequeue();

            trQueue50.Enqueue(trueRange);
            sum50 += trueRange;
            if (trQueue50.Count > 50)
                sum50 -= trQueue50.Dequeue();

            if (trQueue14.Count == 14 && trQueue50.Count == 50)
            {
                decimal atr14 = sum14 / 14m;
                decimal atr50 = sum50 / 50m;
                output[candle.Time] = atr50 > 0m ? atr14 / atr50 : 0m;
            }
        }

        return output;
    }

    private static double ResolveTimeframeMinutes(string timeframe)
    {
        return timeframe.ToLowerInvariant() switch
        {
            "15m" => 15.0,
            "1h" => 60.0,
            "4h" => 240.0,
            "1d" => 1440.0,
            _ => 60.0
        };
    }

    private static void SaveC1DdControlSweepReport(
        IReadOnlyList<C1DdControlSweepRow> rows,
        IReadOnlyList<string> skipped,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings baseSettings,
        C1DdControlSweepRow best,
        IReadOnlyList<string> selectedSymbols,
        IReadOnlyList<string> selectedTimeframes,
        DateTime startUtc,
        DateTime endUtcExclusive,
        out string txtPath,
        out string csvPath)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);
        string stamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string safeMarketName = selectedSymbols.Count == 1 && selectedTimeframes.Count == 1
            ? SanitizeFileName($"{selectedSymbols[0]}_{selectedTimeframes[0]}")
            : "MULTI_MARKET";

        string baseName = $"BUTTON_8_C1_DD_CONTROL_TUNE_{safeMarketName}_{stamp}";
        txtPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, baseName + ".txt");
        csvPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, baseName + ".csv");

        string txt = BuildC1DdControlSweepSummary(rows, skipped, baseSettings, best, selectedSymbols, selectedTimeframes, startUtc, endUtcExclusive, txtPath, csvPath);
        string csv = BuildC1DdControlSweepCsv(rows);

        File.WriteAllText(txtPath, txt, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(csvPath, csv, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, "LATEST_BUTTON_8_C1_DD_CONTROL_TUNE.txt"), txt, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, "LATEST_BUTTON_8_C1_DD_CONTROL_TUNE.csv"), csv, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
    }

    private static string BuildC1DdControlSweepSummary(
        IReadOnlyList<C1DdControlSweepRow> rows,
        IReadOnlyList<string> skipped,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings baseSettings,
        C1DdControlSweepRow best,
        IReadOnlyList<string> selectedSymbols,
        IReadOnlyList<string> selectedTimeframes,
        DateTime startUtc,
        DateTime endUtcExclusive,
        string txtPath,
        string csvPath)
    {
        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        int passCount = rows.Count(r => r.Pass);
        int markets = rows.Select(r => $"{r.Symbol}::{r.Timeframe}").Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).Count();
        decimal averageDd = rows.Count > 0 ? rows.Average(r => r.MaxDrawdownPercent) : 0m;
        decimal bestMarketPassCount = rows.GroupBy(r => $"{r.Symbol}::{r.Timeframe}", StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).Count(g => g.Any(x => x.Pass));

        sb.AppendLine("BUTTON 8 - C1 DD CONTROL TUNING SWEEP REPORT");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated UTC       : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine("Mode                : SO score x SL ATR x loss cooldown x ATR spike guard sweep");
        sb.AppendLine($"Selected Coins      : {string.Join(", ", selectedSymbols)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Selected Timeframes : {string.Join(", ", selectedTimeframes)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Date Range          : {startUtc:yyyy-MM-dd} to {endUtcExclusive.AddDays(-1):yyyy-MM-dd} (ONE-YEAR VALIDATION)");
        sb.AppendLine($"Markets Tested      : {markets}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Tests Completed     : {rows.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Pass Rows           : {passCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Markets With Pass   : {bestMarketPassCount:0}");
        sb.AppendLine($"TXT Report          : {txtPath}");
        sb.AppendLine($"CSV Report          : {csvPath}");
        sb.AppendLine("Important           : Button 8 CSV stores an exact replay settings snapshot. Press Button 6 after Button 8 to save exact per-coin profiles.");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("BASE SETTINGS KEPT FROM UI");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"TP Target R         : {baseSettings.TargetR:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Trail ATR / ActR    : {baseSettings.TrailStopAtrMultiplier:0.##} / {baseSettings.TrailActivationR:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Start Equity USDT   : {baseSettings.StartEquityUsdt:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Margin / Leverage   : {baseSettings.MarginUsdt:0.##} / {baseSettings.Leverage:0.##}x");
        sb.AppendLine($"Orders              : Market={baseSettings.EnableMO}, Limit={baseSettings.EnableLO}, Stop={baseSettings.EnableSO}, Long={baseSettings.EnableLong}, Short={baseSettings.EnableShort}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Rules               : Score={baseSettings.EnableScoreRule}, RSI={baseSettings.EnableRsiRule}, MACD={baseSettings.EnableMacdRule}, Volume={baseSettings.EnableVolumeRule}, Candle={baseSettings.EnableCandleRule}, Distance={baseSettings.EnableDistanceRule}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Average Tested DD   : {averageDd:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("BEST DD-CONTROL SETTING");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        AppendC1DdControlRowLine(sb, best);
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("TOP 25 DD-CONTROL RESULTS");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        foreach (C1DdControlSweepRow row in rows
            .OrderByDescending(r => r.Pass)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.Score)
            .ThenBy(r => r.MaxDrawdownPercent)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.DailyProfitPercent)
            .Take(25))
        {
            AppendC1DdControlRowLine(sb, row);
        }
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("BEST PER MARKET");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        foreach (C1DdControlSweepRow row in rows
            .GroupBy(r => $"{r.Symbol}::{r.Timeframe}", StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Select(g => SelectBestC1DdControlSweepRow(g)!)
            .OrderByDescending(r => r.Pass)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.Score)
            .ThenBy(r => r.MaxDrawdownPercent))
        {
            AppendC1DdControlRowLine(sb, row);
        }

        if (skipped.Count > 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine("SKIPPED MARKETS");
            sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
            foreach (string line in skipped.Take(100))
                sb.AppendLine(line);
        }

        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static void AppendC1DdControlRowLine(System.Text.StringBuilder sb, C1DdControlSweepRow row)
    {
        sb.AppendLine(
            $"{row.Symbol} {row.Timeframe} | SO {row.SoMinScore:0.#} | SL {row.StopLossAtr:0.##} | Cool {row.CooldownLabel} | ATR {row.AtrSpikeLabel} | " +
            $"Daily {row.DailyProfitPercent:0.0000}% (raw {row.RawDailyProfitPercent:0.0000}%) | Profit {row.NetProfitUsdt:0.00} USDT ({row.NetProfitPercent:0.00}%) | " +
            $"DD {row.MaxDrawdownPercent:0.00}% (raw {row.RawMaxDrawdownPercent:0.00}%, improve {row.DrawdownReductionPercent:0.00}) | " +
            $"Closed {row.ClosedTrades}/{row.RawClosedTrades} | Filter Cool {row.FilteredByCooldown} ATR {row.FilteredByAtrSpike} | " +
            $"Win {row.WinRate:0.00}% | Edge {row.EdgeR:0.###}R | PF {row.ProfitFactor:0.##} | MFE {row.AverageMfeCapturePercent:0.00}% | MAE {row.AverageMaeR:0.###}R | MFE/MAE {row.MfeMaeRatio:0.###} | HighMAE {row.HighMaeTradesPercent:0.00}% | Pass {row.Pass}");
    }

    private static string BuildC1DdControlSweepCsv(IEnumerable<C1DdControlSweepRow> rows)
    {
        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("Symbol,Timeframe,Start,End,SoMinScore,StopLossAtr,CooldownCandles,AtrSpikeLimit,PlacedTrades,RawClosedTrades,RawDailyProfitPercent,RawMaxDDPercent,ClosedTrades,FilteredByCooldown,FilteredByAtrSpike,Wins,Losses,WinRate,NetR,EdgeR_UnitR,ProfitFactor,NetProfitUSDT,NetProfitPercent,DailyProfitPercent_UnitPct,MaxDDPercent_UnitPct,DrawdownReductionPercent,AverageMfeCapturePercent_UnitPct,AverageMfeR_UnitR,AverageMaeR_UnitR,MfeMaeRatio,HighMaeTradesPercent_UnitPct,Score,Pass,SettingsSnapshotVersion,EnableMO,EnableLO,EnableSO,EnableLong,EnableShort,EnableTrailingStopLoss,EnableScoreRule,EnableRsiRule,EnableMacdRule,EnableVolumeRule,EnableCandleRule,EnableDistanceRule,MinimumLoScore,MinimumSoScore,MinimumMoScore,RsiSupportMin,RsiSupportMax,RsiResistanceMin,RsiResistanceMax,RsiBreakoutLongMin,RsiBreakoutLongMax,RsiBreakdownShortMin,RsiBreakdownShortMax,RetestVolumeMultiplier,BreakoutVolumeMultiplier,MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent,MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent,MinimumRejectionWickPercent,MaxRetestDistanceAtr,MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr,TargetR,TrailAtr,TrailActivationR,StartEquityUsdt,MarginUsdt,Leverage,TradeSizeUsdt");
        foreach (C1DdControlSweepRow row in rows
            .OrderByDescending(r => r.Pass)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.Score)
            .ThenBy(r => r.MaxDrawdownPercent)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.DailyProfitPercent))
        {
            sb.AppendLine(string.Join(",", new[]
            {
                Csv(row.Symbol),
                Csv(row.Timeframe),
                row.StartUtc.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.EndUtcExclusive.AddDays(-1).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SoMinScore),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.StopLossAtr),
                row.CooldownCandles.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.AtrSpikeLimit),
                row.PlacedTrades.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.RawClosedTrades.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.RawDailyProfitPercent),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.RawMaxDrawdownPercent),
                row.ClosedTrades.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.FilteredByCooldown.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.FilteredByAtrSpike.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.Wins.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.Losses.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.WinRate),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.NetR),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.EdgeR),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.ProfitFactor),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.NetProfitUsdt),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.NetProfitPercent),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.DailyProfitPercent),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.MaxDrawdownPercent),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.DrawdownReductionPercent),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.AverageMfeCapturePercent),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.AverageMfeR),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.AverageMaeR),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.MfeMaeRatio),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.HighMaeTradesPercent),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.Score),
                row.Pass.ToString(),
                Csv("C1_PROFILE_REPLAY_FIX_V1"),
                row.SettingsSnapshot.EnableMO.ToString(),
                row.SettingsSnapshot.EnableLO.ToString(),
                row.SettingsSnapshot.EnableSO.ToString(),
                row.SettingsSnapshot.EnableLong.ToString(),
                row.SettingsSnapshot.EnableShort.ToString(),
                row.SettingsSnapshot.EnableTrailingStopLoss.ToString(),
                row.SettingsSnapshot.EnableScoreRule.ToString(),
                row.SettingsSnapshot.EnableRsiRule.ToString(),
                row.SettingsSnapshot.EnableMacdRule.ToString(),
                row.SettingsSnapshot.EnableVolumeRule.ToString(),
                row.SettingsSnapshot.EnableCandleRule.ToString(),
                row.SettingsSnapshot.EnableDistanceRule.ToString(),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.MinimumLoScore),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.MinimumSoScore),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.MinimumMoScore),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.RsiSupportMin),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.RsiSupportMax),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.RsiResistanceMin),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.RsiResistanceMax),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.RsiBreakoutLongMin),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.RsiBreakoutLongMax),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.RsiBreakdownShortMin),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.RsiBreakdownShortMax),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.RetestVolumeMultiplier),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.MinimumRejectionWickPercent),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.MaxRetestDistanceAtr),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.TargetR),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.TrailStopAtrMultiplier),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.TrailActivationR),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.StartEquityUsdt),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.MarginUsdt),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.Leverage),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.SettingsSnapshot.TradeSizeUsdt)
            }));
        }
        return sb.ToString();
    }



    private async Task RunC1MasterAutoResearchAsync(bool resumeOnly)
    {
        string title = resumeOnly ? "07-C1 RESUME LEFT" : "06-C1 MASTER AUTO";
        EnsureC1ResearchFolders();
        ResetResearchRamStatsForRun(title);

        C1SelectionFilterResult startFilter = ApplyC1PerCoinProfileSelectionBlockFilter(GetCheckedCoinNamesOnly());
        List<string> selectedAtStart = startFilter.PendingSymbols;
        WriteQ1SelectedCoinsPreviewAndFile(selectedAtStart, startFilter.RemovedFinalProfileSymbols);

        if (startFilter.RemovedFinalProfileSymbols.Count > 0)
            AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, $"Auto-blocked {startFilter.RemovedFinalProfileSymbols.Count} coin(s) already present in Data\\Config\\C1_PER_COIN_PROFILES: {string.Join(", ", startFilter.RemovedFinalProfileSymbols)}");

        C1MasterResearchMemory memory;
        if (!resumeOnly)
        {
            // Button 6 must start from the exact coins currently checked by the user.
            // It must not continue an old all-market memory and must not replace Q1 load coins.txt
            // with old/final-profile symbols.
            if (selectedAtStart.Count == 0)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(
                    "Please select the coin names first. Button 6 now uses only the currently checked coins and will not auto-pick old memory coins.",
                    title,
                    MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                    MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                return;
            }

            WriteQ1SelectedCoinsPreviewAndFile(selectedAtStart);
            memory = CreateNewC1MasterMemory(selectedAtStart);
        }
        else
        {
            memory = LoadC1MasterMemory()
                ?? CreateNewC1MasterMemory(selectedAtStart.Count > 0 ? selectedAtStart : null);

            // Version V3 starts a fresh research memory because the pipeline now auto-uploads C2 seeds and runs ultra-fine tuning before DD control.
            // This prevents old C1/C2-first batches from being mixed with the new C2-first process.
            if (!string.Equals(memory.Version, C1MasterMemoryVersion, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                memory = CreateNewC1MasterMemory(selectedAtStart.Count > 0 ? selectedAtStart : null);
        }

        // IMPORTANT USER RULE (2026-07-15):
        // Do NOT silently remove coins from Button 6 at run start just because a final C1 profile
        // already exists under Config\Rep_SR_CONFIG_PROFILES\C1_FINAL_PROFILES.
        // Manual checkbox blocking is controlled only by Data\Config\C1_PER_COIN_PROFILES.
        // Therefore, if a coin remains checked in the Coin Names list, Button 6 must count it and scan it.

        if (memory.PendingCoins.Count == 0)
        {
            memory.IsComplete = true;
            memory.CurrentStep = "Completed";
            memory.LastUpdatedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
            SaveC1MasterMemory(memory);
            WriteC1MasterStatusFiles(memory);
            RebuildC1QuickListsFromFinalProfiles();

            SetCentralProgress(title, 100, "No pending coins. Master research memory is complete.", clearDetails: false);
            MessageBox.Show(
                $"C1 master research is already complete.\n\nDone: {memory.CompletedCoins.Count}\nLeft: 0\n\nMemory:\n{GetC1MasterMemoryFilePath()}",
                title,
                MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                MessageBoxIcon.Information);
            return;
        }

        SetC1MasterOneHourDefaults();

        // User rule:
        // Button 6 must not shrink the visible selected-coin list into a hidden 5-coin batch.
        // If the user checks 10 coins, Button 6 must hand 10 coins to Button 15/13/8 so progress shows Market 1/10, not 1/5.
        // C1_PER_COIN_PROFILES blocking still happens before this point; no final-profile folder cleanup is applied here.
        List<string> batch = memory.PendingCoins
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();
        int batchSize = batch.Count;

        if (batch.Count == 0)
            return;

        memory.BatchNo++;
        memory.LastBatchSize = batch.Count;
        memory.CurrentStep = $"Batch {memory.BatchNo}: selected {batch.Count} coins";
        memory.LastUpdatedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        SaveC1MasterMemory(memory);
        WriteC1MasterStatusFiles(memory);

        DateTime batchStartedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        int totalCoins = Math.Max(1, memory.TotalCoins.Count);
        int completedBeforeBatch = memory.CompletedCoins.Count;
        int currentProgress = completedBeforeBatch;

        SetCentralProgress(
            title,
            (int)Math.Round((currentProgress * 100d) / totalCoins),
            $"Batch {memory.BatchNo} starting. Coins {batch.Count}. Done {completedBeforeBatch}/{totalCoins}. Left {memory.PendingCoins.Count}.",
            clearDetails: true);

        AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, $"Profile folder: {GetC1PerCoinProfileDirectory()}");
        AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, $"Memory file: {GetC1MasterMemoryFilePath()}");
        AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, "RAM accelerator V1 active: candle files remain in RAM during Button 6 sub-jobs and are reused by Button 15/13/8 where possible.");
        AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, $"Batch coins: {string.Join(", ", batch)}");

        SelectExactCoinNames(batch);

        memory.CurrentStep = $"Batch {memory.BatchNo}: auto-upload / preload C2 seed profiles";
        SaveC1MasterMemory(memory);
        AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, "Step 1/5: auto-upload best C2 profile seeds for current batch before any scan starts.");
        string c2PreloadReportPath = AutoUploadAndPreloadBestC2ProfilesForBatch(batch, title);
        AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, "C2 preload report: " + c2PreloadReportPath);

        AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, "Candle update step removed by user request. Button 6 now uses already available candle CSV data only; run Button 17/18 separately when data refresh is needed.");

        memory.CurrentStep = $"Batch {memory.BatchNo}: C2-first validation + best edge";
        SaveC1MasterMemory(memory);
        AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, "Step 2/5: C2-first validation. Button 15 loads each coin's uploaded C2 profile as seed, validates it first, then mutates/tunes only if stronger edge is needed.");
        await RunFindBestEdgeAsync();

        await PauseC1MasterAsync(title, "Cooling pause after best-edge scan", 2);

        memory.CurrentStep = $"Batch {memory.BatchNo}: ultra-fine edge tuning";
        SaveC1MasterMemory(memory);
        AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, "Step 3/5: Button 13 ultra-fine tuning around the best C2/edge alpha before DD control.");
        await RunMoreTunningAsync();

        await PauseC1MasterAsync(title, "Cooling pause after ultra-fine tuning", 2);

        memory.CurrentStep = $"Batch {memory.BatchNo}: DD control sweep";
        SaveC1MasterMemory(memory);
        AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, "Step 4/5: Button 8 DD-control sweep after C2 seed, best-edge search, and ultra-fine tuning.");
        await RunC1DdControlTuneAsync();

        await PauseC1MasterAsync(title, "Cooling pause after DD-control sweep", 2);

        memory.CurrentStep = $"Batch {memory.BatchNo}: save final profiles";
        SaveC1MasterMemory(memory);
        AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, "Step 5/5: auto-save final C1 profiles from latest Button 8 CSV, then rebuild Q1/Q2 and memory.");
        SaveC1ProfilesFromLatestButton8Report(showMessage: false);

        AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, "Final: rebuild Q1/Q2 coin lists and master memory.");
        foreach (string symbol in batch)
        {
            if (!memory.CompletedCoins.Contains(symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                memory.CompletedCoins.Add(symbol);
        }

        memory.PendingCoins = memory.TotalCoins
            .Where(symbol => !memory.CompletedCoins.Contains(symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        // Keep the user's manual coin selection/text panel stable after Button 6.
        // Do not replace the visible selection with only remaining/pending coins.
        WriteQ1SelectedCoinsPreviewAndFile(GetCheckedCoinNamesOnly());

        double batchSeconds = Math.Max(1, (DateTime.UtcNow - batchStartedUtc).TotalSeconds);
        memory.TotalElapsedSeconds += batchSeconds;
        memory.AverageSecondsPerCoin = memory.CompletedCoins.Count == 0
            ? 0
            : memory.TotalElapsedSeconds / memory.CompletedCoins.Count;
        memory.EstimatedRemainingMinutes = memory.AverageSecondsPerCoin <= 0
            ? 0
            : (int)Math.Ceiling((memory.PendingCoins.Count * memory.AverageSecondsPerCoin) / 60d);
        memory.NextBatchSize = memory.PendingCoins.Count == 0
            ? 0
            : memory.PendingCoins.Count;
        memory.IsComplete = memory.PendingCoins.Count == 0;
        memory.LastCompletedStep = $"Batch {memory.BatchNo} completed";
        memory.CurrentStep = memory.IsComplete ? "Completed" : "Paused after batch. Press 07-C1 RESUME LEFT.";
        memory.LastUpdatedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;

        RebuildC1QuickListsFromFinalProfiles();
        SaveC1MasterMemory(memory);
        WriteC1MasterStatusFiles(memory);
        WriteC1MasterBatchReport(memory, batch, batchSeconds);
        string chatGptDigestPath = GenerateChatGptLastRunDigest(memory, batch, batchSeconds, c2PreloadReportPath);
        AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, "ChatGPT compact review digest: " + chatGptDigestPath);
        string ramStatusPath = WriteResearchRamStatusReport(title);
        AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, BuildResearchRamStatusLine());
        AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, "RAM report: " + ramStatusPath);

        int done = memory.CompletedCoins.Count;
        int percent = (int)Math.Round((done * 100d) / Math.Max(1, memory.TotalCoins.Count));

        SetCentralProgress(
            title,
            percent,
            $"Batch {memory.BatchNo} completed. Done {done}/{memory.TotalCoins.Count}. Left {memory.PendingCoins.Count}. Est left {memory.EstimatedRemainingMinutes} min.",
            clearDetails: false);

        string nextText = memory.IsComplete
            ? "All coins completed. Next: Q1 -> Button 16 -> Button 9."
            : $"Next run will process up to {memory.NextBatchSize} coins. Press 07-C1 RESUME LEFT when ready.";

        MessageBox.Show(
            $"C1 master batch completed.\n\n" +
            $"Batch coins       : {batch.Count}\n" +
            $"Total done        : {done}/{memory.TotalCoins.Count}\n" +
            $"Remaining         : {memory.PendingCoins.Count}\n" +
            $"Batch time        : {TimeSpan.FromSeconds(batchSeconds):hh\\:mm\\:ss}\n" +
            $"Avg sec / coin    : {memory.AverageSecondsPerCoin:0.0}\n" +
            $"Estimated left    : {memory.EstimatedRemainingMinutes} minutes\n\n" +
            $"{nextText}\n\n" +
            $"Memory:\n{GetC1MasterMemoryFilePath()}\n\n" +
            $"ChatGPT digest:\n{chatGptDigestPath}\n\nRAM report:\n{ramStatusPath}",
            title,
            MessageBoxButtons.OK,
            MessageBoxIcon.Information);
    }


    private string AutoUploadAndPreloadBestC2ProfilesForBatch(IReadOnlyList<string> batch, string title)
    {
        EnsureC1ResearchFolders();
        Directory.CreateDirectory(C2BestProfileFolder);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(C2SeedLogFolder);

        SrTradeBacktestSettings fallbackSettings = GetSrTradeBacktestSettingsFromUi();
        SrTradeBacktestSettings? firstLoadedSeed = null;
        string? firstLoadedSymbol = null;
        string? firstLoadedPath = null;
        int found = 0;
        int loaded = 0;
        int imported = 0;
        int missing = 0;

        string stamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string reportPath = Path.Combine(C2SeedLogFolder, $"C2_BATCH_PRELOAD_UPLOAD__{stamp}.txt");
        var lines = new List<string>
        {
            "C2 BEST PROFILE AUTO-UPLOAD / PRELOAD REPORT",
            "============================================================",
            $"Generated UTC          : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}",
            $"Button                 : {title}",
            $"Memory Version         : {C1MasterMemoryVersion}",
            $"Batch Size             : {batch.Count}",
            $"Timeframe              : 1h",
            $"C2 Best Folder         : {C2BestProfileFolder}",
            $"C2 Validation Folder   : {C2ValidationProfileFolder}",
            $"C2 Seed Log Folder     : {C2SeedLogFolder}",
            $"Final Profile Folder   : {GetC1PerCoinProfileDirectory()}",
            string.Empty,
            "INTENT",
            "------------------------------------------------------------",
            "Before Button 15 starts, this step finds each coin's best C2/profile seed, imports/copies it into C2_BEST_PROFILES when needed, and loads the first valid seed into the UI as the visible starting alpha.",
            "Button 15 still probes each symbol separately, so per-coin C2 seeds are used even when the UI shows only one seed at a time.",
            string.Empty,
            "BATCH C2 SEED RESULTS",
            "------------------------------------------------------------"
        };

        foreach (string rawSymbol in batch)
        {
            string symbol = (rawSymbol ?? string.Empty).Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol))
                continue;

            C2SeedProbeResult probe = ProbeC2BestSeedProfile(symbol, "1h", fallbackSettings);
            string importedPath = "N/A";

            if (probe.SeedFound)
                found++;
            else
                missing++;

            if (probe.Loaded && probe.Settings != null)
            {
                loaded++;

                if (firstLoadedSeed == null)
                {
                    firstLoadedSeed = probe.Settings;
                    firstLoadedSymbol = symbol;
                    firstLoadedPath = probe.SelectedPath;
                }

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(probe.SelectedPath) && File.Exists(probe.SelectedPath))
                {
                    string destinationPath = Path.Combine(C2BestProfileFolder, $"C2_BEST_PROFILE__{SanitizeFileName(symbol)}__1h.config.txt");
                    try
                    {
                        if (!string.Equals(Path.GetFullPath(probe.SelectedPath), Path.GetFullPath(destinationPath), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            File.Copy(probe.SelectedPath, destinationPath, overwrite: true);
                            imported++;
                            importedPath = destinationPath;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            importedPath = destinationPath + " (already in C2_BEST_PROFILES)";
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        importedPath = "COPY ERROR: " + ex.Message;
                    }
                }
            }

            string selectedPath = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(probe.SelectedPath) ? "N/A" : probe.SelectedPath!;
            lines.Add($"{symbol} 1h | Found={probe.SeedFound} | Loaded={probe.Loaded} | Candidates={probe.CandidateFiles.Count} | Selected={selectedPath} | Imported={importedPath} | Message={probe.Message}");
        }

        lines.Add(string.Empty);
        lines.Add("SUMMARY");
        lines.Add("------------------------------------------------------------");
        lines.Add($"C2 Seeds Found         : {found}");
        lines.Add($"C2 Seeds Loaded        : {loaded}");
        lines.Add($"C2 Seeds Imported      : {imported}");
        lines.Add($"C2 Seeds Missing       : {missing}");
        lines.Add($"First UI Seed Symbol   : {(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(firstLoadedSymbol) ? "N/A" : firstLoadedSymbol)}");
        lines.Add($"First UI Seed File     : {(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(firstLoadedPath) ? "N/A" : firstLoadedPath)}");

        if (firstLoadedSeed != null)
        {
            ApplySrSettingsToUi(firstLoadedSeed);
            lines.Add("UI Seed Loaded         : True");
            AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, $"C2 UI seed loaded before scan: {firstLoadedSymbol} | {Path.GetFileName(firstLoadedPath ?? string.Empty)}");
        }
        else
        {
            lines.Add("UI Seed Loaded         : False");
            AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, "No C2 seed found before scan. Button 15 will still run fallback + zero/smart search.");
        }

        lines.Add("============================================================");
        File.WriteAllLines(reportPath, lines, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(C2SeedLogFolder, "LATEST_C2_BATCH_PRELOAD_UPLOAD.txt"), string.Join(Environment.NewLine, lines), System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        return reportPath;
    }

    private void SetC1MasterOneHourDefaults()
    {
        if (_dtpChartEndDate != null)
            _dtpChartEndDate.Value = DateTime.Today;

        ResolveOneYearValidationWindow(out _, out _);

        SetAllChecked(_timeframeList, false);
        SetCheckedItemByText(_timeframeList, "1h", true);

        if (_chkSrMO != null) _chkSrMO.Checked = false;
        if (_chkSrLO != null) _chkSrLO.Checked = false;
        if (_chkSrSO != null) _chkSrSO.Checked = true;
        if (_chkSrLong != null) _chkSrLong.Checked = true;
        if (_chkSrShort != null) _chkSrShort.Checked = true;
        if (_chkSrTrailStop != null) _chkSrTrailStop.Checked = true;

        SetNumericValue(_numSrStartEquity, 100m);
        SetNumericValue(_numSrMargin, 20m);
        SetNumericValue(_numSrLeverage, 10m);
        SetNumericValue(_numSrTP, 1.10m);
        SetNumericValue(_numSrTrailAtr, 0.75m);
        SetNumericValue(_numSrTrailActivationR, 1.75m);
        SyncTradeSizeFromMarginLeverage();
    }

    private void SelectExactCoinNames(IReadOnlyCollection<string> symbols)
    {
        SetAllChecked(_coinCategoryList, false);
        RefreshCoinNames();
        SetAllChecked(_coinNameList, false);

        var blockedByC1PerCoinProfile = LoadC1PerCoinProfileBlockedSymbols();
        var selected = new HashSet<string>(
            (symbols ?? Array.Empty<string>()).Where(symbol => !blockedByC1PerCoinProfile.Contains(symbol)),
            StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        if (_coinNameList == null)
            return;

        for (int i = 0; i < _coinNameList.Items.Count; i++)
        {
            string symbol = _coinNameList.Items[i]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
            _coinNameList.SetItemChecked(i, selected.Contains(symbol));
        }

        if (_lblCoinNames != null)
            _lblCoinNames.Text = $"Coin Names: MASTER ({selected.Count})";
    }

    private C1MasterResearchMemory CreateNewC1MasterMemory(IReadOnlyCollection<string>? preferredSymbols = null)
    {
        EnsureC1ResearchFolders();

        List<string> allCoins = (preferredSymbols != null && preferredSymbols.Count > 0
                ? preferredSymbols
                : GetCheckedCoinNamesOnly().Count > 0
                    ? GetCheckedCoinNamesOnly()
                    : (_allBinanceCoinNames ?? AppBinanceUniverse.ActiveSymbols))
            .Where(symbol => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol))
            .Select(symbol => symbol.Trim().ToUpperInvariant())
            .Where(symbol => symbol.EndsWith("USDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .OrderBy(symbol => symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        return new C1MasterResearchMemory
        {
            Version = C1MasterMemoryVersion,
            RunId = "C1_MASTER_" + DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            StartedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,
            LastUpdatedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,
            Timeframe = "1h",
            DateRange = $"FAST_H1_2026_VALIDATION_{ForcedValidationStartDate:yyyy_MM_dd}_TO_{ForcedValidationEndDate:yyyy_MM_dd}",
            TotalCoins = allCoins,
            PendingCoins = allCoins.ToList(),
            CompletedCoins = new List<string>(),
            FailedCoins = new List<string>(),
            CurrentStep = "Created - C2 upload, C2 validation, best edge, ultra-fine tune, DD control",
            LastCompletedStep = string.Empty,
            NextBatchSize = C1MasterInitialBatchSize,
            LastBatchSize = 0,
            BatchNo = 0,
            IsComplete = false,
            TotalElapsedSeconds = 0,
            AverageSecondsPerCoin = 0,
            EstimatedRemainingMinutes = 0
        };
    }

    private static string GetC1MasterMemoryFilePath()
    {
        return Path.Combine(C1ResearchMemoryFolder, "C1_RESEARCH_MEMORY.json");
    }

    private static C1MasterResearchMemory? LoadC1MasterMemory()
    {
        string path = GetC1MasterMemoryFilePath();
        if (!File.Exists(path))
            return null;

        try
        {
            string json = File.ReadAllText(path, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
            return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<C1MasterResearchMemory>(json);
        }
        catch
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static void SaveC1MasterMemory(C1MasterResearchMemory memory)
    {
        EnsureC1ResearchFolders();
        memory.LastUpdatedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;

        string json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(
            memory,
            new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true });

        File.WriteAllText(GetC1MasterMemoryFilePath(), json, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
    }

    private static void WriteC1MasterStatusFiles(C1MasterResearchMemory memory)
    {
        EnsureC1ResearchFolders();

        string donePath = Path.Combine(C1ResearchRootFolder, "C1_RESEARCH_DONE.txt");
        string todoPath = Path.Combine(C1ResearchRootFolder, "C1_RESEARCH_TODO.txt");
        string summaryPath = Path.Combine(C1ResearchRootFolder, "C1_RESEARCH_STATUS.txt");

        File.WriteAllLines(donePath, memory.CompletedCoins.OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase), System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllLines(todoPath, memory.PendingCoins.OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase), System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);

        var lines = new List<string>
        {
            "C1 MASTER RESEARCH STATUS",
            "============================================================",
            $"Run Id              : {memory.RunId}",
            $"Version             : {memory.Version}",
            $"Started UTC         : {memory.StartedUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}",
            $"Last Updated UTC    : {memory.LastUpdatedUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}",
            $"Timeframe           : {memory.Timeframe}",
            $"Date Range          : {memory.DateRange}",
            $"Total Coins         : {memory.TotalCoins.Count}",
            $"Completed Coins     : {memory.CompletedCoins.Count}",
            $"Pending Coins       : {memory.PendingCoins.Count}",
            $"Failed Coins        : {memory.FailedCoins.Count}",
            $"Batch No            : {memory.BatchNo}",
            $"Next Batch Size     : {memory.NextBatchSize}",
            $"Current Step        : {memory.CurrentStep}",
            $"Last Completed Step : {memory.LastCompletedStep}",
            $"Avg Seconds / Coin  : {memory.AverageSecondsPerCoin:0.0}",
            $"Estimated Left Min  : {memory.EstimatedRemainingMinutes}",
            $"Memory File         : {GetC1MasterMemoryFilePath()}",
            $"Final Profile Folder: {GetC1PerCoinProfileDirectory()}",
            $"C2 Best Folder      : {C2BestProfileFolder}",
            $"C2 Validation Folder: {C2ValidationProfileFolder}",
            $"C2 Seed Log Folder  : {C2SeedLogFolder}",
            string.Empty,
            "DONE",
            "------------------------------------------------------------"
        };

        lines.AddRange(memory.CompletedCoins.OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        lines.Add(string.Empty);
        lines.Add("LEFT");
        lines.Add("------------------------------------------------------------");
        lines.AddRange(memory.PendingCoins.OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

        File.WriteAllLines(summaryPath, lines, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
    }

    private static string GenerateChatGptLastRunDigest(
        C1MasterResearchMemory memory,
        IReadOnlyList<string> batch,
        double batchSeconds,
        string c2PreloadReportPath)
    {
        EnsureC1ResearchFolders();
        Directory.CreateDirectory(C1ChatGptReviewFolder);

        string latestButton8Csv = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, "LATEST_BUTTON_8_C1_DD_CONTROL_TUNE.csv");
        string latestButton8Txt = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, "LATEST_BUTTON_8_C1_DD_CONTROL_TUNE.txt");
        string latestButton6Txt = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, "LATEST_BUTTON_6_SAVE_C1_PROFILES.txt");
        string latestButton13Txt = Path.Combine(MoreTunningReportPaths.Button13ReportFolder, "LATEST_BUTTON_13_MORE_TUNNING_REPORT.txt");
        string latestC2Proof = Path.Combine(C2SeedLogFolder, C2LatestProofFileName);

        var batchSet = new HashSet<string>(
            batch.Select(x => (x ?? string.Empty).Trim().ToUpperInvariant()).Where(x => x.Length > 0),
            StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        List<C1DdControlProfileSaveRow> rows = File.Exists(latestButton8Csv)
            ? LoadC1DdControlProfileRowsFromCsv(latestButton8Csv)
            : new List<C1DdControlProfileSaveRow>();

        List<C1DdControlProfileSaveRow> bestPerMarket = rows
            .Where(r => batchSet.Count == 0 || batchSet.Contains(r.Symbol))
            .GroupBy(r => $"{r.Symbol}::{r.Timeframe}", StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Select(g => g
                .OrderByDescending(r => r.Pass)
                .ThenByDescending(r => r.Score)
                .ThenBy(r => r.MaxDrawdownPercent)
                .ThenByDescending(r => r.DailyProfitPercent)
                .First())
            .OrderBy(r => r.Symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ThenBy(r => r.Timeframe, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        List<C1DdControlProfileSaveRow> passRows = bestPerMarket.Where(r => r.Pass).ToList();
        List<C1DdControlProfileSaveRow> failRows = bestPerMarket.Where(r => !r.Pass).ToList();

        List<C1DdControlProfileSaveRow> topBest = bestPerMarket
            .OrderByDescending(r => r.Pass)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.DailyProfitPercent)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.ProfitFactor)
            .ThenBy(r => r.MaxDrawdownPercent)
            .Take(3)
            .ToList();

        List<C1DdControlProfileSaveRow> topWorst = bestPerMarket
            .OrderBy(r => r.Pass ? 1 : 0)
            .ThenBy(r => r.ProfitFactor)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.MaxDrawdownPercent)
            .ThenBy(r => r.DailyProfitPercent)
            .Take(3)
            .ToList();

        decimal avgDaily = bestPerMarket.Count == 0 ? 0m : bestPerMarket.Average(r => r.DailyProfitPercent);
        decimal avgDd = bestPerMarket.Count == 0 ? 0m : bestPerMarket.Average(r => r.MaxDrawdownPercent);
        decimal avgEdge = bestPerMarket.Count == 0 ? 0m : bestPerMarket.Average(r => r.EdgeR);
        decimal avgPf = bestPerMarket.Count == 0 ? 0m : bestPerMarket.Average(r => r.ProfitFactor);
        decimal avgMfe = bestPerMarket.Count == 0 ? 0m : bestPerMarket.Average(r => r.AverageMfeCapturePercent);

        string stamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string runSafe = SanitizeFileName(memory.RunId);
        string path = Path.Combine(C1ChatGptReviewFolder, $"CHATGPT_LAST_RUN_DIGEST__{runSafe}__B{memory.BatchNo:000}__{stamp}.txt");
        string latestPath = Path.Combine(C1ChatGptReviewFolder, "LATEST_CHATGPT_LAST_RUN_DIGEST.txt");

        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("CGPT_TQGA_C1C2_LAST_RUN_DIGEST|v=1|minichar_moreinfo|for_chatgpt_review_only");
        sb.AppendLine($"RUN|utc={DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}|id={memory.RunId}|batch={memory.BatchNo}|batchSec={batchSeconds:0}|batchCoins={batch.Count}|done={memory.CompletedCoins.Count}/{memory.TotalCoins.Count}|left={memory.PendingCoins.Count}|nextBatch={memory.NextBatchSize}|estLeftMin={memory.EstimatedRemainingMinutes}|tf={memory.Timeframe}|range={memory.DateRange}");
        sb.AppendLine($"SRC|B8csv={PathTag(latestButton8Csv)}|B8txt={PathTag(latestButton8Txt)}|B6={PathTag(latestButton6Txt)}|B13={PathTag(latestButton13Txt)}|C2pre={PathTag(c2PreloadReportPath)}|C2proof={PathTag(latestC2Proof)}|profiles={GetC1PerCoinProfileDirectory()}");
        sb.AppendLine($"C2PRE|found={ExtractReportValue(c2PreloadReportPath, "C2 Seeds Found")}|loaded={ExtractReportValue(c2PreloadReportPath, "C2 Seeds Loaded")}|imported={ExtractReportValue(c2PreloadReportPath, "C2 Seeds Imported")}|missing={ExtractReportValue(c2PreloadReportPath, "C2 Seeds Missing")}|uiSeed={ExtractReportValue(c2PreloadReportPath, "First UI Seed Symbol")}");
        sb.AppendLine($"C2PROOF|exists={(File.Exists(latestC2Proof) ? "Y" : "N")}|blocks={ExtractReportValue(latestC2Proof, "Proof Blocks")}|mode={ExtractReportValue(latestC2Proof, "C2-FIRST MODE")}|lastSource={ExtractReportValue(latestC2Proof, "Final Profile Source")}");
        sb.AppendLine($"SUM|markets={bestPerMarket.Count}|pass={passRows.Count}|fail={failRows.Count}|avgD={avgDaily:0.0000}|avgDD={avgDd:0.00}|avgE={avgEdge:0.###}|avgPF={avgPf:0.##}|avgMFE={avgMfe:0.00}|rowsRaw={rows.Count}");

        int rank = 1;
        foreach (C1DdControlProfileSaveRow row in topBest)
        {
            sb.AppendLine($"TOPB{rank}|{BuildChatGptRowMini(row)}|why={BuildChatGptWhy(row, bestMode: true)}");
            rank++;
        }

        rank = 1;
        foreach (C1DdControlProfileSaveRow row in topWorst)
        {
            sb.AppendLine($"TOPW{rank}|{BuildChatGptRowMini(row)}|why={BuildChatGptWhy(row, bestMode: false)}");
            rank++;
        }

        foreach (C1DdControlProfileSaveRow row in bestPerMarket
            .OrderByDescending(r => r.Pass)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.DailyProfitPercent)
            .ThenBy(r => r.Symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            sb.AppendLine($"COIN|{BuildChatGptRowMini(row)}|set={BuildChatGptSettingsMini(row)}");
        }

        string focus = failRows.Count == 0
            ? "all_pass_next_validate_Q1_Button16_Button9"
            : "retune_fail=" + string.Join(",", failRows.Select(r => r.Symbol).Take(10));

        sb.AppendLine($"NEXT|{focus}|riskRule=prefer_pass_PF>=3_DD<=5_MFE>=50_closed>=50|note=Button8_final_rows_used_for_profile_save;Button13/C2_proof_sources_above");
        sb.AppendLine("END");

        string text = sb.ToString();
        File.WriteAllText(path, text, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(latestPath, text, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        return latestPath;
    }

    private static string BuildChatGptRowMini(C1DdControlProfileSaveRow row)
    {
        string pass = row.Pass ? "P" : "F";
        return $"sym={row.Symbol}|tf={row.Timeframe}|{pass}|D={row.DailyProfitPercent:0.0000}|DD={row.MaxDrawdownPercent:0.00}|rawDD={row.RawMaxDrawdownPercent:0.00}|DDimp={row.DrawdownReductionPercent:0.00}|E={row.EdgeR:0.###}|PF={row.ProfitFactor:0.##}|WR={row.WinRate:0.00}|MFE={row.AverageMfeCapturePercent:0.00}|C={row.ClosedTrades}/{row.RawClosedTrades}|PnL={row.NetProfitUsdt:0.##}|R={row.NetR:0.##}|score={row.Score:0}";
    }

    private static string BuildChatGptSettingsMini(C1DdControlProfileSaveRow row)
    {
        return $"MO={Bool01(row.EnableMO)},LO={Bool01(row.EnableLO)},SO={Bool01(row.EnableSO)},L={Bool01(row.EnableLong)},S={Bool01(row.EnableShort)},SL={row.StopLossAtr:0.##},TP={row.TargetR:0.##},TR={Bool01(row.EnableTrailingStopLoss)}:{row.TrailAtr:0.##}/{row.TrailActivationR:0.##},MG={row.MarginUsdt:0.##},LEV={row.Leverage:0.##},TS={row.TradeSizeUsdt:0.##},SOscore={row.SoMinScore:0.#},RSI={Bool01(row.EnableRsiRule)},MACD={Bool01(row.EnableMacdRule)},VOL={Bool01(row.EnableVolumeRule)},CND={Bool01(row.EnableCandleRule)},DST={Bool01(row.EnableDistanceRule)},RetVol={row.RetestVolumeMultiplier:0.##},BrVol={row.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier:0.##},Body={row.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent:0.#},RetATR={row.MaxRetestDistanceAtr:0.##},BrATR={row.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr:0.##},Cool={row.CooldownCandles},ATRsp={row.AtrSpikeLimit:0.##},FilC={row.FilteredByCooldown},FilA={row.FilteredByAtrSpike}";
    }

    private static string BuildChatGptWhy(C1DdControlProfileSaveRow row, bool bestMode)
    {
        var reasons = new List<string>();
        if (row.Pass) reasons.Add("PASS"); else reasons.Add("FAIL");
        if (row.DailyProfitPercent <= 0m) reasons.Add("D<=0");
        if (row.ProfitFactor < 3m) reasons.Add("PF<3");
        if (row.MaxDrawdownPercent > 5m) reasons.Add("DD>5");
        if (row.AverageMfeCapturePercent < 50m) reasons.Add("MFE<50");
        if (row.ClosedTrades < 50) reasons.Add("C<50");
        if (bestMode)
        {
            reasons.Add("rank=highDaily+PF+lowDD");
        }
        else
        {
            if (row.RawMaxDrawdownPercent > row.MaxDrawdownPercent)
                reasons.Add($"DDfix={row.DrawdownReductionPercent:0.00}");
            reasons.Add("rank=fail/lowPF/highDD/lowD");
        }
        return string.Join(",", reasons);
    }

    private static string Bool01(bool value) => value ? "1" : "0";

    private static string PathTag(string? path)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
            return "NA";
        return File.Exists(path) ? path : "MISSING:" + path;
    }

    private static string ExtractReportValue(string? path, string label)
    {
        try
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path) || !File.Exists(path))
                return "NA";

            foreach (string rawLine in File.ReadLines(path, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8))
            {
                string line = rawLine.Trim();
                int idx = line.IndexOf(':');
                if (idx <= 0)
                    continue;

                string left = line[..idx].Trim();
                if (left.Equals(label, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    return line[(idx + 1)..].Trim();
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            return "ERR";
        }

        return "NA";
    }

    private static void RebuildC1QuickListsFromFinalProfiles()
    {
        EnsureC1ResearchFolders();

        var profileSymbols = Directory.Exists(GetC1PerCoinProfileDirectory())
            ? Directory.EnumerateFiles(GetC1PerCoinProfileDirectory(), "C1_PROFILE__*__1h.config.txt", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly)
                .Select(path => Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(path))
                .Select(name => name.Replace("C1_PROFILE__", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                .Select(name =>
                {
                    int idx = name.IndexOf("__", StringComparison.Ordinal);
                    return idx > 0 ? name[..idx] : name;
                })
                .Where(symbol => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol))
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .OrderBy(symbol => symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList()
            : new List<string>();

        // Do NOT overwrite QuickCoinListFolder\Q1 load coins.txt here.
        // That file is the user's current manual/checked selection preview.
        // Button 6/7 final-profile coin lists are written to separate auto files only.
        string q1RootPath = Path.Combine(QuickCoinListFolder, "Q1_FINAL_PROFILE_COINS_AUTO.txt");
        string q2RootPath = Path.Combine(QuickCoinListFolder, "Q2_ALL_ACTIVE_USDT_AUTO.txt");
        string q1SubPath = Path.Combine(C1CoinListFolder, "Q1_FINAL_PROFILE_COINS_AUTO.txt");
        string q2SubPath = Path.Combine(C1CoinListFolder, "Q2_ALL_ACTIVE_USDT_AUTO.txt");

        var q1Lines = new List<string>
        {
            "# C1 final-profile coins generated by Button 6/7 C1 Master Auto",
            "# This file intentionally does NOT replace Q1 load coins.txt.",
            "# Use Q1 load coins.txt only for the user's current selected/checked coins.",
            "# One symbol per line.",
            string.Empty
        };
        q1Lines.AddRange(profileSymbols);

        File.WriteAllLines(q1RootPath, q1Lines, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllLines(q1SubPath, q1Lines, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);

        var q2Symbols = AppBinanceUniverse.ActiveSymbols
            .Where(symbol => symbol.EndsWith("USDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .OrderBy(symbol => symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        var q2Lines = new List<string>
        {
            "# All active USDT futures symbols generated by Button 6/7 C1 Master Auto",
            "# This file intentionally does NOT replace Q2 load coins.txt.",
            string.Empty
        };
        q2Lines.AddRange(q2Symbols);

        File.WriteAllLines(q2RootPath, q2Lines, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllLines(q2SubPath, q2Lines, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
    }

    private async Task PauseC1MasterAsync(string title, string reason, int seconds)
    {
        seconds = Math.Max(0, seconds);
        if (seconds == 0)
            return;

        for (int i = seconds; i >= 1; i--)
        {
            AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, $"{reason}: {i}s");
            await Task.Delay(1000);
        }
    }
