    {
        public string Version { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string RunId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public DateTime StartedUtc { get; set; }
        public DateTime LastUpdatedUtc { get; set; }
        public string Timeframe { get; set; } = "1h";
        public string DateRange { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public List<string> TotalCoins { get; set; } = new();
        public List<string> CompletedCoins { get; set; } = new();
        public List<string> PendingCoins { get; set; } = new();
        public List<string> FailedCoins { get; set; } = new();
        public string CurrentStep { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string LastCompletedStep { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public int NextBatchSize { get; set; }
        public int LastBatchSize { get; set; }

        public bool IsComplete { get; set; }
        public double TotalElapsedSeconds { get; set; }
        public double AverageSecondsPerCoin { get; set; }

    }

    private void SaveC1ProfilesFromLatestButton8Report(bool showMessage = true)
    {
        const string title = "06-SAVE C1 PROFILES";

        try
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(GetC1PerCoinProfileDirectory());

            string latestCsv = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, "LATEST_BUTTON_8_C1_DD_CONTROL_TUNE.csv");
            string latestTxt = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, "LATEST_BUTTON_8_C1_DD_CONTROL_TUNE.txt");

            if (!File.Exists(latestCsv))
            {
                MessageBox.Show(
                    "No latest Button 8 CSV report was found.\n\nFirst run Button 8 - C1 DD CONTROL, then press Button 6.",
                    title,
                    MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                    MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                return;
            }

            List<C1DdControlProfileSaveRow> rows = LoadC1DdControlProfileRowsFromCsv(latestCsv);
            int exactSnapshotRows = rows.Count(r => r.HasExactSettingsSnapshot);
            if (rows.Count == 0)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(
                    $"Button 8 CSV exists but no usable rows were found:\n{latestCsv}",
                    title,
                    MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                    MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                return;
            }

            SrTradeBacktestSettings uiSettings = GetSrTradeBacktestSettingsFromUi();
            C1Button8BaseProfileSettings baseProfile = TryLoadButton8BaseSettingsFromText(latestTxt, uiSettings);

            var bestPerMarket = rows
                .GroupBy(r => $"{r.Symbol}::{r.Timeframe}", StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .Select(g => SelectBestC1DdControlRow(g))
                .OrderBy(r => r.Symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ThenBy(r => r.Timeframe, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();

            var bestPerSymbolForClassification = bestPerMarket
                .GroupBy(r => r.Symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .Select(g => SelectBestC1DdControlRow(g))
                .OrderBy(r => r.Symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();

            int savedCount = 0;
            int futureUpdateCount = 0;
            var savedLines = new List<string>();
            var futureLines = new List<string>();

            foreach (C1DdControlProfileSaveRow row in bestPerMarket)
            {
                SrTradeBacktestSettings settings = CreateC1PerCoinSettingsFromButton8Row(uiSettings, baseProfile, row);

                if (row.Pass)
                {
                    string path = SaveC1PerCoinProfileFile(row, settings);
                    savedCount++;
                    savedLines.Add($"{row.Symbol} {row.Timeframe} | SAVED | SO {row.SoMinScore:0.#} | SL {row.StopLossAtr:0.##} | Cool {FormatCooldownLabel(row.CooldownCandles)} | ATR {FormatAtrSpikeLabel(row.AtrSpikeLimit)} | Daily {row.DailyProfitPercent:0.0000}% | DD {row.MaxDrawdownPercent:0.00}% | PF {row.ProfitFactor:0.##} | File {path}");
                }
            }

            foreach (C1DdControlProfileSaveRow row in bestPerSymbolForClassification)
            {
                SrTradeBacktestSettings settings = CreateC1PerCoinSettingsFromButton8Row(uiSettings, baseProfile, row);
                C1ProfileQualityBucket bucket = ClassifyC1ProfileBucket(row);
                SaveC1ClassifiedProfileFile(row, settings, bucket);

                if (bucket != C1ProfileQualityBucket.Good)
                {
                    futureUpdateCount++;
                    futureLines.Add($"{row.Symbol} {row.Timeframe} | {FormatC1ProfileBucketLabel(bucket)} | {BuildC1QualityGateReason(row)} | SO {row.SoMinScore:0.#} | SL {row.StopLossAtr:0.##} | Cool {FormatCooldownLabel(row.CooldownCandles)} | ATR {FormatAtrSpikeLabel(row.AtrSpikeLimit)} | Daily {row.DailyProfitPercent:0.0000}% | DD {row.MaxDrawdownPercent:0.00}% | PF {row.ProfitFactor:0.##} | Edge {row.EdgeR:0.###}R | MFE Capture {row.AverageMfeCapturePercent:0.00}%");
                }
            }

            SaveC1ScanClassificationFiles(bestPerSymbolForClassification);

            string indexPath = SaveC1PerCoinProfileIndex(savedLines, futureLines, latestCsv, latestTxt);
            string summaryPath = SaveC1PerCoinProfileSaveSummary(savedLines, futureLines, latestCsv, latestTxt, indexPath);

            string message =
                $"C1 per-coin profiles generated.\n\n" +
                $"Saved profiles       : {savedCount}\n" +
                $"Future update needed : {futureUpdateCount}\n" +
                $"Exact replay snapshots: {exactSnapshotRows}/{rows.Count}\n" +
                (exactSnapshotRows == rows.Count ? string.Empty : "WARNING: Latest Button 8 CSV is legacy. Rerun Button 8, then press Button 6 again for exact profile replay.\n") +
                $"\nConfig folder:\n{GetC1PerCoinProfileDirectory()}\n\n" +
                $"Index:\n{indexPath}";

            try
            {
                Clipboard.SetText(File.ReadAllText(summaryPath, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8));
            }
            catch
            {
                // Clipboard can fail if another process owns it; saved files remain valid.
            }

            if (showMessage)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(message, title, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);

                Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo
                {
                    FileName = GetC1PerCoinProfileDirectory(),
                    UseShellExecute = true
                });
            }
            else
            {
                AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, $"Profiles saved. Saved={savedCount}, Future={futureUpdateCount}, ExactSnapshots={exactSnapshotRows}/{rows.Count}");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            if (showMessage)
                MessageBox.Show(ex.Message, title, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
            else
                AppendCentralProgressDetail(title, "Profile save failed: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private static C1DdControlProfileSaveRow SelectBestC1DdControlRow(IEnumerable<C1DdControlProfileSaveRow> rows)
    {
        return rows
            .OrderByDescending(r => IsC1QualityProfileStrict(r))
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.Pass)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.DailyProfitPercent)
            .ThenBy(r => r.MaxDrawdownPercent)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.ProfitFactor)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.EdgeR)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.AverageMfeCapturePercent)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.MfeMaeRatio)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.ClosedTrades)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.Score)
            .First();
    }

    private static bool IsC1QualityProfileStrict(C1DdControlProfileSaveRow row)
    {
        return row.Pass
            && row.DailyProfitPercent >= C1QualityMinDailyProfitPercent
            && row.MaxDrawdownPercent <= C1QualityMaxDrawdownPercent
            && row.ProfitFactor >= C1QualityMinProfitFactor
            && row.EdgeR >= C1QualityMinEdgeR
            && row.AverageMfeCapturePercent >= C1QualityMinMfeCapturePercent
            && row.MfeMaeRatio >= C1QualityMinMfeMaeRatio
            && row.HighMaeTradesPercent <= C1QualityMaxHighMaePercent
            && row.ClosedTrades >= C1QualityMinClosedTrades;
    }

    private static bool IsC1MediumQualityProfile(C1DdControlProfileSaveRow row)
    {
        return !IsC1QualityProfileStrict(row)
            && row.DailyProfitPercent >= C1MediumMinDailyProfitPercent
            && row.DailyProfitPercent < C1QualityMinDailyProfitPercent;
    }

    private static C1ProfileQualityBucket ClassifyC1ProfileBucket(C1DdControlProfileSaveRow row)
    {
        if (IsC1QualityProfileStrict(row))
            return C1ProfileQualityBucket.Good;

        if (IsC1MediumQualityProfile(row))
            return C1ProfileQualityBucket.Medium;

        return C1ProfileQualityBucket.Bad;
    }

    private static string FormatC1ProfileBucketLabel(C1ProfileQualityBucket bucket)
    {
        return bucket switch
        {
            C1ProfileQualityBucket.Good => "QUALITY SCANNED",
            C1ProfileQualityBucket.Medium => "MEDIUM QUALITY",
            _ => "NEED TO IMPROVE"
        };
    }

    private static string GetC1ProfileBucketFolder(C1ProfileQualityBucket bucket)
    {
        return bucket switch
        {
            C1ProfileQualityBucket.Good => C1GoodListFolder,
            C1ProfileQualityBucket.Medium => C1MediumQualityFolder,
            _ => C1BadListFolder
        };
    }

    private static int GetC1ProfileBucketRank(C1ProfileQualityBucket bucket)
    {
        return bucket switch
        {
            C1ProfileQualityBucket.Good => 3,
            C1ProfileQualityBucket.Medium => 2,
            _ => 1
        };
    }

    private static bool IsC1QualityProfileStrict(
        bool? pass,
        decimal? dailyProfitPercent,
        decimal? maxDrawdownPercent,
        decimal? profitFactor,
        decimal? edgeR,
        decimal? mfeCapturePercent,
        decimal? mfeMaeRatio,
        decimal? highMaeTradesPercent,
        int? closedTrades)
    {
        return pass == true
            && dailyProfitPercent.HasValue && dailyProfitPercent.Value >= C1QualityMinDailyProfitPercent
            && maxDrawdownPercent.HasValue && maxDrawdownPercent.Value <= C1QualityMaxDrawdownPercent
            && profitFactor.HasValue && profitFactor.Value >= C1QualityMinProfitFactor
            && edgeR.HasValue && edgeR.Value >= C1QualityMinEdgeR
            && mfeCapturePercent.HasValue && mfeCapturePercent.Value >= C1QualityMinMfeCapturePercent
            && mfeMaeRatio.HasValue && mfeMaeRatio.Value >= C1QualityMinMfeMaeRatio
            && highMaeTradesPercent.HasValue && highMaeTradesPercent.Value <= C1QualityMaxHighMaePercent
            && closedTrades.HasValue && closedTrades.Value >= C1QualityMinClosedTrades;
    }

    private static string BuildC1QualityGateReason(C1DdControlProfileSaveRow row)
    {
        var reasons = new List<string>();

        if (!row.Pass) reasons.Add("Pass=False");
        if (row.DailyProfitPercent < C1QualityMinDailyProfitPercent) reasons.Add($"Daily<{C1QualityMinDailyProfitPercent:0.##}%");
        if (row.MaxDrawdownPercent > C1QualityMaxDrawdownPercent) reasons.Add($"DD>{C1QualityMaxDrawdownPercent:0.##}%");
        if (row.ProfitFactor < C1QualityMinProfitFactor) reasons.Add($"PF<{C1QualityMinProfitFactor:0.##}");
        if (row.EdgeR < C1QualityMinEdgeR) reasons.Add($"Edge<{C1QualityMinEdgeR:0.##}R");
        if (row.AverageMfeCapturePercent < C1QualityMinMfeCapturePercent) reasons.Add($"MFE<{C1QualityMinMfeCapturePercent:0.##}%");
        if (row.MfeMaeRatio < C1QualityMinMfeMaeRatio) reasons.Add($"MFE/MAE<{C1QualityMinMfeMaeRatio:0.##}");
        if (row.HighMaeTradesPercent > C1QualityMaxHighMaePercent) reasons.Add($"HighMAE>{C1QualityMaxHighMaePercent:0.##}%");
        if (row.ClosedTrades < C1QualityMinClosedTrades) reasons.Add($"Closed<{C1QualityMinClosedTrades}");

        if (reasons.Count == 0)
            return "StrictQuality=Pass";

        if (row.DailyProfitPercent >= C1MediumMinDailyProfitPercent && row.DailyProfitPercent < C1QualityMinDailyProfitPercent)
            reasons.Insert(0, $"MediumDaily={row.DailyProfitPercent:0.0000}% between {C1MediumMinDailyProfitPercent:0.##}% and below {C1QualityMinDailyProfitPercent:0.##}%");

        return string.Join(", ", reasons);
    }

    private static List<C1DdControlProfileSaveRow> LoadC1DdControlProfileRowsFromCsv(string path)
    {
        string[] lines = File.ReadAllLines(path, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        if (lines.Length < 2)
            return new List<C1DdControlProfileSaveRow>();

        string[] headers = ParseCsvLine(lines[0]);
        var headerMap = headers
            .Select((name, index) => new { Name = NormalizeConfigKey(name), Index = index })
            .Where(x => x.Name.Length > 0)
            .GroupBy(x => x.Name, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.First().Index, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        var rows = new List<C1DdControlProfileSaveRow>();
        for (int i = 1; i < lines.Length; i++)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(lines[i]))
                continue;

            string[] cells = ParseCsvLine(lines[i]);
            string symbol = CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "Symbol").Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
            string timeframe = CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "Timeframe").Trim();

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(timeframe))
                continue;

            rows.Add(new C1DdControlProfileSaveRow
            {
                Symbol = symbol,
                Timeframe = timeframe,
                StartUtc = ParseCsvDate(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "Start")),
                EndUtc = ParseCsvDate(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "End")),
                SoMinScore = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "SoMinScore")),
                StopLossAtr = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "StopLossAtr")),
                CooldownCandles = ParseCsvInt(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "CooldownCandles")),
                AtrSpikeLimit = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "AtrSpikeLimit")),
                PlacedTrades = ParseCsvInt(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "PlacedTrades")),
                RawClosedTrades = ParseCsvInt(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "RawClosedTrades")),
                RawDailyProfitPercent = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "RawDailyProfitPercent")),
                RawMaxDrawdownPercent = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "RawMaxDDPercent")),
                ClosedTrades = ParseCsvInt(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "ClosedTrades")),
                FilteredByCooldown = ParseCsvInt(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "FilteredByCooldown")),
                FilteredByAtrSpike = ParseCsvInt(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "FilteredByAtrSpike")),
                Wins = ParseCsvInt(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "Wins")),
                Losses = ParseCsvInt(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "Losses")),
                WinRate = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "WinRate")),
                NetR = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "NetR")),
                EdgeR = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCellAny(cells, headerMap, "EdgeR", "EdgeR_UnitR")),
                ProfitFactor = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "ProfitFactor")),
                NetProfitUsdt = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "NetProfitUSDT")),
                NetProfitPercent = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "NetProfitPercent")),
                DailyProfitPercent = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCellAny(cells, headerMap, "DailyProfitPercent", "DailyProfitPercent_UnitPct")),
                MaxDrawdownPercent = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCellAny(cells, headerMap, "MaxDDPercent", "MaxDDPercent_UnitPct")),
                DrawdownReductionPercent = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "DrawdownReductionPercent")),
                AverageMfeCapturePercent = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCellAny(cells, headerMap, "AverageMfeCapturePercent", "AverageMfeCapturePercent_UnitPct")),
                AverageMfeR = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCellAny(cells, headerMap, "AverageMfeR", "AverageMfeR_UnitR")),
                AverageMaeR = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCellAny(cells, headerMap, "AverageMaeR", "AverageMaeR_UnitR")),
                MfeMaeRatio = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "MfeMaeRatio")),
                HighMaeTradesPercent = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCellAny(cells, headerMap, "HighMaeTradesPercent", "HighMaeTradesPercent_UnitPct")),
                Score = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "Score")),
                Pass = ParseCsvBool(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "Pass")),
                HasExactSettingsSnapshot = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "SettingsSnapshotVersion")),
                EnableMO = ParseCsvBool(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "EnableMO")),
                EnableLO = ParseCsvBool(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "EnableLO")),
                EnableSO = ParseCsvBool(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "EnableSO")),
                EnableLong = ParseCsvBool(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "EnableLong")),
                EnableShort = ParseCsvBool(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "EnableShort")),
                EnableTrailingStopLoss = ParseCsvBool(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "EnableTrailingStopLoss")),
                EnableScoreRule = ParseCsvBool(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "EnableScoreRule")),
                EnableRsiRule = ParseCsvBool(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "EnableRsiRule")),
                EnableMacdRule = ParseCsvBool(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "EnableMacdRule")),
                EnableVolumeRule = ParseCsvBool(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "EnableVolumeRule")),
                EnableCandleRule = ParseCsvBool(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "EnableCandleRule")),
                EnableDistanceRule = ParseCsvBool(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "EnableDistanceRule")),
                MinimumLoScore = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "MinimumLoScore")),
                MinimumMoScore = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "MinimumMoScore")),
                RsiSupportMin = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "RsiSupportMin")),
                RsiSupportMax = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "RsiSupportMax")),
                RsiResistanceMin = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "RsiResistanceMin")),
                RsiResistanceMax = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "RsiResistanceMax")),
                RsiBreakoutLongMin = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "RsiBreakoutLongMin")),
                RsiBreakoutLongMax = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "RsiBreakoutLongMax")),
                RsiBreakdownShortMin = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "RsiBreakdownShortMin")),
                RsiBreakdownShortMax = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "RsiBreakdownShortMax")),
                RetestVolumeMultiplier = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "RetestVolumeMultiplier")),
                BreakoutVolumeMultiplier = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "BreakoutVolumeMultiplier")),
                MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent")),
                MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent")),
                MinimumRejectionWickPercent = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "MinimumRejectionWickPercent")),
                MaxRetestDistanceAtr = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "MaxRetestDistanceAtr")),
                MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr")),
                TargetR = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "TargetR")),
                TrailAtr = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "TrailAtr")),
                TrailActivationR = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "TrailActivationR")),
                StartEquityUsdt = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "StartEquityUsdt")),
                MarginUsdt = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "MarginUsdt")),
                Leverage = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "Leverage")),
                TradeSizeUsdt = ParseCsvDecimal(CsvCell(cells, headerMap, "TradeSizeUsdt"))
            });
        }

        return rows;
    }

    private static string[] ParseCsvLine(string line)
    {
        var cells = new List<string>();
        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        bool quoted = false;

        for (int i = 0; i < line.Length; i++)
        {
            char c = line[i];
            if (quoted)
            {
                if (c == '"')
                {
                    if (i + 1 < line.Length && line[i + 1] == '"')
                    {
                        sb.Append('"');
                        i++;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        quoted = false;
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    sb.Append(c);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                if (c == '"')
                    quoted = true;
                else if (c == ',')
                {
                    cells.Add(sb.ToString());
                    sb.Clear();
                }
                else
                    sb.Append(c);
            }
        }

        cells.Add(sb.ToString());
        return cells.ToArray();
    }

    private static string CsvCell(string[] cells, Dictionary<string, int> headerMap, string name)
    {
        return headerMap.TryGetValue(NormalizeConfigKey(name), out int index) && index >= 0 && index < cells.Length
            ? cells[index]
            : string.Empty;
    }

    private static string CsvCellAny(string[] cells, Dictionary<string, int> headerMap, params string[] names)
    {
        foreach (string name in names)
        {
            string value = CsvCell(cells, headerMap, name);
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
                return value;
        }

        return string.Empty;
    }

    private static decimal ParseCsvDecimal(string value)
    {
        value = (value ?? string.Empty)
            .Replace("USDT", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Replace("R", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Replace("x", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Replace("%", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Trim();

        return decimal.TryParse(value, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out decimal parsed)
            ? parsed
            : 0m;
    }

    private static int ParseCsvInt(string value)
    {
        return int.TryParse((value ?? string.Empty).Trim(), NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out int parsed)
            ? parsed
            : 0;
    }

    private static bool ParseCsvBool(string value)
    {
        value = (value ?? string.Empty).Trim();
        return value.Equals("TRUE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               value.Equals("YES", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               value.Equals("1", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    private static DateTime ParseCsvDate(string value)
    {
        return DateTime.TryParse(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.AssumeUniversal, out DateTime parsed)
            ? DateTime.SpecifyKind(parsed.Date, DateTimeKind.Utc)
            : DateTime.MinValue;
    }

    private static C1Button8BaseProfileSettings TryLoadButton8BaseSettingsFromText(string path, SrTradeBacktestSettings fallback)
    {
        var output = new C1Button8BaseProfileSettings
        {
            TargetR = fallback.TargetR,
            TrailAtr = fallback.TrailStopAtrMultiplier,
            TrailActivationR = fallback.TrailActivationR,
            StartEquityUsdt = fallback.StartEquityUsdt,
            MarginUsdt = fallback.MarginUsdt,
            Leverage = fallback.Leverage
        };

        if (!File.Exists(path))
            return output;

        foreach (string rawLine in File.ReadAllLines(path, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8))
        {
            string line = rawLine.Trim();
            int idx = line.IndexOf(':');
            if (idx <= 0)
                continue;

            string key = NormalizeConfigKey(line[..idx]);
            string value = line[(idx + 1)..].Trim();

            if (key.Equals(NormalizeConfigKey("TP Target R"), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                output.TargetR = ParseCsvDecimal(value);
            else if (key.Equals(NormalizeConfigKey("Trail ATR / ActR"), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                string[] parts = value.Split('/', StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries | StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                if (parts.Length >= 1)
                    output.TrailAtr = ParseCsvDecimal(parts[0]);
                if (parts.Length >= 2)
                    output.TrailActivationR = ParseCsvDecimal(parts[1]);
            }
            else if (key.Equals(NormalizeConfigKey("Start Equity USDT"), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                output.StartEquityUsdt = ParseCsvDecimal(value);
            else if (key.Equals(NormalizeConfigKey("Margin / Leverage"), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                string[] parts = value.Split('/', StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries | StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                if (parts.Length >= 1)
                    output.MarginUsdt = ParseCsvDecimal(parts[0]);
                if (parts.Length >= 2)
                    output.Leverage = ParseCsvDecimal(parts[1]);
            }
        }

        return output;
    }

    private static SrTradeBacktestSettings CreateC1PerCoinSettingsFromButton8Row(
        SrTradeBacktestSettings current,
        C1Button8BaseProfileSettings baseProfile,
        C1DdControlProfileSaveRow row)
    {
        if (row.HasExactSettingsSnapshot)
        {
            decimal exactLeverage = row.Leverage > 0m ? row.Leverage : current.Leverage;
            decimal exactMargin = row.MarginUsdt > 0m ? row.MarginUsdt : current.MarginUsdt;
            decimal exactTradeSize = row.TradeSizeUsdt > 0m
                ? row.TradeSizeUsdt
                : exactMargin > 0m && exactLeverage > 0m
                    ? exactMargin * exactLeverage
                    : current.TradeSizeUsdt;

            return new SrTradeBacktestSettings(
                EnableMO: row.EnableMO,
                EnableLO: row.EnableLO,
                EnableSO: row.EnableSO,
                EnableLong: row.EnableLong,
                EnableShort: row.EnableShort,
                StopLossAtrMultiplier: row.StopLossAtr,
                TargetR: row.TargetR > 0m ? row.TargetR : current.TargetR,
                StartEquityUsdt: row.StartEquityUsdt > 0m ? row.StartEquityUsdt : current.StartEquityUsdt,
                TradeSizeUsdt: exactTradeSize,
                Leverage: exactLeverage,
                MarginUsdt: exactMargin,
                EnableTrailingStopLoss: row.EnableTrailingStopLoss,
                TrailStopAtrMultiplier: row.TrailAtr > 0m ? row.TrailAtr : current.TrailStopAtrMultiplier,
                TrailActivationR: row.TrailActivationR > 0m ? row.TrailActivationR : current.TrailActivationR,
                EnableScoreRule: row.EnableScoreRule,
                MinimumLoScore: row.MinimumLoScore > 0m ? row.MinimumLoScore : current.MinimumLoScore,
                MinimumSoScore: row.SoMinScore,
                MinimumMoScore: row.MinimumMoScore > 0m ? row.MinimumMoScore : current.MinimumMoScore,
                EnableRsiRule: row.EnableRsiRule,
                RsiSupportMin: row.RsiSupportMin > 0m ? row.RsiSupportMin : current.RsiSupportMin,
                RsiSupportMax: row.RsiSupportMax > 0m ? row.RsiSupportMax : current.RsiSupportMax,
                RsiResistanceMin: row.RsiResistanceMin > 0m ? row.RsiResistanceMin : current.RsiResistanceMin,
                RsiResistanceMax: row.RsiResistanceMax > 0m ? row.RsiResistanceMax : current.RsiResistanceMax,
                RsiBreakoutLongMin: row.RsiBreakoutLongMin > 0m ? row.RsiBreakoutLongMin : current.RsiBreakoutLongMin,
                RsiBreakoutLongMax: row.RsiBreakoutLongMax > 0m ? row.RsiBreakoutLongMax : current.RsiBreakoutLongMax,
                RsiBreakdownShortMin: row.RsiBreakdownShortMin > 0m ? row.RsiBreakdownShortMin : current.RsiBreakdownShortMin,
                RsiBreakdownShortMax: row.RsiBreakdownShortMax > 0m ? row.RsiBreakdownShortMax : current.RsiBreakdownShortMax,
                EnableMacdRule: row.EnableMacdRule,
                EnableVolumeRule: row.EnableVolumeRule,
                RetestVolumeMultiplier: row.RetestVolumeMultiplier > 0m ? row.RetestVolumeMultiplier : current.RetestVolumeMultiplier,
                BreakoutVolumeMultiplier: row.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier > 0m ? row.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier : current.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier,
                EnableCandleRule: row.EnableCandleRule,
                MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent: row.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent > 0m ? row.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent : current.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent,
                MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent: row.MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent > 0m ? row.MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent : current.MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent,
                MinimumRejectionWickPercent: row.MinimumRejectionWickPercent > 0m ? row.MinimumRejectionWickPercent : current.MinimumRejectionWickPercent,
                EnableDistanceRule: row.EnableDistanceRule,
                MaxRetestDistanceAtr: row.MaxRetestDistanceAtr > 0m ? row.MaxRetestDistanceAtr : current.MaxRetestDistanceAtr,
                MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr: row.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr > 0m ? row.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr : current.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr);
        }

        decimal leverage = baseProfile.Leverage > 0m ? baseProfile.Leverage : current.Leverage;
        decimal margin = baseProfile.MarginUsdt > 0m ? baseProfile.MarginUsdt : current.MarginUsdt;
        decimal tradeSize = margin > 0m && leverage > 0m ? margin * leverage : current.TradeSizeUsdt;

        return new SrTradeBacktestSettings(
            EnableMO: current.EnableMO,
            EnableLO: current.EnableLO,
            EnableSO: current.EnableSO,
            EnableLong: current.EnableLong,
            EnableShort: current.EnableShort,
            StopLossAtrMultiplier: row.StopLossAtr,
            TargetR: baseProfile.TargetR > 0m ? baseProfile.TargetR : current.TargetR,
            StartEquityUsdt: baseProfile.StartEquityUsdt > 0m ? baseProfile.StartEquityUsdt : current.StartEquityUsdt,
            TradeSizeUsdt: tradeSize,
            Leverage: leverage,
            MarginUsdt: margin > 0m ? margin : 10m,
            EnableTrailingStopLoss: current.EnableTrailingStopLoss,
            TrailStopAtrMultiplier: baseProfile.TrailAtr > 0m ? baseProfile.TrailAtr : current.TrailStopAtrMultiplier,
            TrailActivationR: baseProfile.TrailActivationR > 0m ? baseProfile.TrailActivationR : current.TrailActivationR,
            EnableScoreRule: current.EnableScoreRule,
            MinimumLoScore: current.MinimumLoScore,
            MinimumSoScore: row.SoMinScore,
            MinimumMoScore: current.MinimumMoScore,
            EnableRsiRule: current.EnableRsiRule,
            RsiSupportMin: current.RsiSupportMin,
            RsiSupportMax: current.RsiSupportMax,
            RsiResistanceMin: current.RsiResistanceMin,
            RsiResistanceMax: current.RsiResistanceMax,
            RsiBreakoutLongMin: current.RsiBreakoutLongMin,
            RsiBreakoutLongMax: current.RsiBreakoutLongMax,
            RsiBreakdownShortMin: current.RsiBreakdownShortMin,
            RsiBreakdownShortMax: current.RsiBreakdownShortMax,
            EnableMacdRule: current.EnableMacdRule,
            EnableVolumeRule: current.EnableVolumeRule,
            RetestVolumeMultiplier: current.RetestVolumeMultiplier,
            BreakoutVolumeMultiplier: current.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier,
            EnableCandleRule: current.EnableCandleRule,
            MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent: current.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent,
            MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent: current.MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent,
            MinimumRejectionWickPercent: current.MinimumRejectionWickPercent,
            EnableDistanceRule: current.EnableDistanceRule,
            MaxRetestDistanceAtr: current.MaxRetestDistanceAtr,
            MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr: current.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr);
    }

    private static void EnsureConfigAuditFoldersAndFiles()
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(TqgaConfigRootFolder);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(QuickCoinListFolder);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(C1GoodListFolder);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(C1MediumQualityFolder);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(C1BadListFolder);

        EnsureTextFileExists(Path.Combine(TqgaConfigRootFolder, AlreadyScannedFileName));
        EnsureTextFileExists(Path.Combine(TqgaConfigRootFolder, NeedToImproveFileName));
        EnsureTextFileExists(Path.Combine(TqgaConfigRootFolder, QualityScannedFileName));
        EnsureTextFileExists(Path.Combine(TqgaConfigRootFolder, MediumQualityFileName));
        EnsureTextFileExists(Path.Combine(TqgaConfigRootFolder, LeftCoinsFileName));

        RebuildC1ScanTrackingFromExistingConfigProfiles();
    }

    private static void EnsureTextFileExists(string path)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(path) ?? TqgaConfigRootFolder);
        if (!File.Exists(path))
            File.WriteAllText(path, string.Empty, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
    }

    private static void RebuildC1ScanTrackingFromExistingConfigProfiles()
    {
        try
        {
            string alreadyPath = Path.Combine(TqgaConfigRootFolder, AlreadyScannedFileName);
            string needPath = Path.Combine(TqgaConfigRootFolder, NeedToImproveFileName);
            string qualityPath = Path.Combine(TqgaConfigRootFolder, QualityScannedFileName);
            string mediumPath = Path.Combine(TqgaConfigRootFolder, MediumQualityFileName);
            string leftPath = Path.Combine(TqgaConfigRootFolder, LeftCoinsFileName);

            List<C1ExistingProfileCandidate> candidates = ScanExistingC1ProfileCandidates();

            // Always rebuild these folders from the current best profile per coin.
            // This removes stale copies such as an old GOOD result left in BAD LIST or MEDIUM QUALITY.
            ClearClassifiedProfileFolder(C1GoodListFolder);
            ClearClassifiedProfileFolder(C1MediumQualityFolder);
            ClearClassifiedProfileFolder(C1BadListFolder);

            if (candidates.Count == 0)
            {
                WriteSymbolListFile(alreadyPath, Array.Empty<string>());
                WriteSymbolListFile(needPath, Array.Empty<string>());
                WriteSymbolListFile(qualityPath, Array.Empty<string>());
                WriteSymbolListFile(mediumPath, Array.Empty<string>());
                WriteSymbolListFile(leftPath, GetAllUniverseSymbolsForTracking());
                return;
            }

            var bestBySymbol = candidates
                .GroupBy(x => x.Symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .Select(g => SelectBestExistingC1ProfileCandidate(g))
                .OrderBy(x => x.Symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();

            var alreadyScanned = bestBySymbol
                .Select(x => x.Symbol)
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();

            var qualityScanned = bestBySymbol
                .Where(x => x.Bucket == C1ProfileQualityBucket.Good)
                .Select(x => x.Symbol)
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();

            var mediumQuality = bestBySymbol
                .Where(x => x.Bucket == C1ProfileQualityBucket.Medium)
                .Select(x => x.Symbol)
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();

            var qualitySet = new HashSet<string>(qualityScanned, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            var mediumSet = new HashSet<string>(mediumQuality, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            var needToImprove = alreadyScanned
                .Where(x => !qualitySet.Contains(x) && !mediumSet.Contains(x))
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();

            foreach (C1ExistingProfileCandidate candidate in bestBySymbol)
                CopyExistingProfileToClassifiedList(candidate);

            var alreadySet = new HashSet<string>(alreadyScanned, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            var leftCoins = GetAllUniverseSymbolsForTracking()
                .Where(x => !alreadySet.Contains(x))
                .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();

            WriteSymbolListFile(alreadyPath, alreadyScanned);
            WriteSymbolListFile(needPath, needToImprove);
            WriteSymbolListFile(qualityPath, qualityScanned);
            WriteSymbolListFile(mediumPath, mediumQuality);
            WriteSymbolListFile(leftPath, leftCoins);
        }
        catch
        {
            // Startup/config resync must never block the form. Button 6/Button 8 can refresh these files again later.
        }
    }

    private static void ClearClassifiedProfileFolder(string folder)
    {
        try
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(folder);
            foreach (string path in Directory.EnumerateFiles(folder, "*.config*.txt", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly))
            {
                try { File.Delete(path); }
                catch { }
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            // Do not block startup if a file is locked; per-symbol copy will still try to replace what it can.
        }
    }

    private sealed class C1ExistingProfileCandidate
    {
        public string Symbol { get; init; } = string.Empty;
        public string Timeframe { get; init; } = "1h";
        public string ProfileStatus { get; init; } = string.Empty;
        public string Path { get; init; } = string.Empty;
        public string ProfileText { get; init; } = string.Empty;
        public C1ProfileQualityBucket Bucket { get; init; } = C1ProfileQualityBucket.Bad;
        public bool IsQuality => Bucket == C1ProfileQualityBucket.Good;
        public bool IsMedium => Bucket == C1ProfileQualityBucket.Medium;
        public bool? Pass { get; init; }
        public decimal? DailyProfitPercent { get; init; }
        public decimal? MaxDrawdownPercent { get; init; }
        public decimal? ProfitFactor { get; init; }
        public decimal? EdgeR { get; init; }
        public decimal? MfeCapturePercent { get; init; }
        public decimal? MfeMaeRatio { get; init; }
        public decimal? HighMaeTradesPercent { get; init; }
        public int? ClosedTrades { get; init; }
        public DateTime LastWriteUtc { get; init; }
    }

    private static C1ExistingProfileCandidate SelectBestExistingC1ProfileCandidate(IEnumerable<C1ExistingProfileCandidate> candidates)
    {
        return candidates
            .OrderByDescending(x => GetC1ProfileBucketRank(x.Bucket))
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.Pass == true)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.DailyProfitPercent ?? decimal.MinValue)
            .ThenBy(x => x.MaxDrawdownPercent ?? decimal.MaxValue)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.ProfitFactor ?? decimal.MinValue)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.EdgeR ?? decimal.MinValue)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.MfeCapturePercent ?? decimal.MinValue)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.MfeMaeRatio ?? decimal.MinValue)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.ClosedTrades ?? int.MinValue)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.LastWriteUtc)
            .First();
    }

    private static List<C1ExistingProfileCandidate> ScanExistingC1ProfileCandidates()
    {
        var candidates = new List<C1ExistingProfileCandidate>();

        if (!Directory.Exists(TqgaConfigRootFolder))
            return candidates;

        foreach (string path in Directory.EnumerateFiles(TqgaConfigRootFolder, "*.config*.txt", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
        {
            // GOOD LIST / MEDIUM QUALITY / BAD LIST are output folders.
            // Do not use them as source input during rebuild, otherwise stale copies can recreate themselves.
            if (IsInsideFolder(path, C1GoodListFolder) ||
                IsInsideFolder(path, C1MediumQualityFolder) ||
                IsInsideFolder(path, C1BadListFolder))
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (!TryResolveProfileIdentity(path, out string symbol, out string timeframe))
                continue;

            C1ExistingProfileCandidate? candidate = TryReadExistingProfileCandidate(path, symbol, timeframe);
            if (candidate != null)
                candidates.Add(candidate);
        }

        return candidates;
    }

    private static bool IsC1QualityExistingProfile(
        string profileStatus,
        bool? pass,
        decimal? dailyProfitPercent,
        decimal? maxDrawdownPercent,
        decimal? profitFactor,
        decimal? edgeR,
        decimal? mfeCapturePercent,
        decimal? mfeMaeRatio,
        decimal? highMaeTradesPercent,
        int? closedTrades)
    {
        bool corePass =
            pass == true &&
            dailyProfitPercent.HasValue && dailyProfitPercent.Value >= C1QualityMinDailyProfitPercent &&
            maxDrawdownPercent.HasValue && maxDrawdownPercent.Value <= C1QualityMaxDrawdownPercent &&
            profitFactor.HasValue && profitFactor.Value >= C1QualityMinProfitFactor &&
            edgeR.HasValue && edgeR.Value >= C1QualityMinEdgeR &&
            mfeCapturePercent.HasValue && mfeCapturePercent.Value >= C1QualityMinMfeCapturePercent &&
            closedTrades.HasValue && closedTrades.Value >= C1QualityMinClosedTrades;

        if (!corePass)
            return false;

        bool hasMfeMae = mfeMaeRatio.HasValue;
        bool hasHighMae = highMaeTradesPercent.HasValue;

        if (hasMfeMae && mfeMaeRatio!.Value < C1QualityMinMfeMaeRatio)
            return false;

        if (hasHighMae && highMaeTradesPercent!.Value > C1QualityMaxHighMaePercent)
            return false;

        // New Button 6 profiles include both values, so strict gate is fully applied.
        if (hasMfeMae && hasHighMae)
            return true;

        // Legacy Button 6 profiles did not save MFE/MAE Ratio and High MAE Trades %.
        // Do not demote an otherwise strong PASS_READY / QUALITY profile only because those older fields are absent.
        return profileStatus.Contains("PASS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               profileStatus.Contains("QUALITY", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    private static bool IsC1MediumExistingProfile(decimal? dailyProfitPercent)
    {
        return dailyProfitPercent.HasValue
            && dailyProfitPercent.Value >= C1MediumMinDailyProfitPercent
            && dailyProfitPercent.Value < C1QualityMinDailyProfitPercent;
    }

    private static C1ProfileQualityBucket ClassifyC1ExistingProfileBucket(
        string profileStatus,
        bool? pass,
        decimal? dailyProfitPercent,
        decimal? maxDrawdownPercent,
        decimal? profitFactor,
        decimal? edgeR,
        decimal? mfeCapturePercent,
        decimal? mfeMaeRatio,
        decimal? highMaeTradesPercent,
        int? closedTrades)
    {
        if (IsC1QualityExistingProfile(
            profileStatus,
            pass,
            dailyProfitPercent,
            maxDrawdownPercent,
            profitFactor,
            edgeR,
            mfeCapturePercent,
            mfeMaeRatio,
            highMaeTradesPercent,
            closedTrades))
        {
            return C1ProfileQualityBucket.Good;
        }

        if (IsC1MediumExistingProfile(dailyProfitPercent))
            return C1ProfileQualityBucket.Medium;

        return C1ProfileQualityBucket.Bad;
    }

    private static C1ExistingProfileCandidate? TryReadExistingProfileCandidate(string path, string fallbackSymbol, string fallbackTimeframe)
    {
        try
        {
            string profileText = File.ReadAllText(path, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
            string[] lines = profileText.Split(new[] { "\r\n", "\n" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
            string symbol = ExtractProfileTextValue(lines, "Symbol");
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol))
                symbol = fallbackSymbol;

            string timeframe = ExtractProfileTextValue(lines, "Timeframe");
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(timeframe))
                timeframe = fallbackTimeframe;

            symbol = symbol.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
            timeframe = NormalizeTimeframeToken(timeframe);

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol) || !symbol.EndsWith("USDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return null;

            string profileStatus = ExtractProfileTextValue(lines, "Profile Status");

            bool? pass = ExtractProfileBoolValue(lines, "Pass");
            decimal? daily = ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, "Daily Profit %")
                ?? ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, "Daily Profit")
                ?? ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, "Daily")
                ?? ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, "Daily %");
            decimal? maxDrawdown = ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, "Max Drawdown %")
                ?? ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, "Max DD %")
                ?? ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, "DD");
            decimal? profitFactor = ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, "Profit Factor")
                ?? ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, "PF");
            decimal? edgeR = ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, "Edge R")
                ?? ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, "Edge");
            decimal? mfeCapture = ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, "MFE Capture %")
                ?? ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, "Average MFE Capture %")
                ?? ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, "MFE Capture");
            decimal? mfeMaeRatio = ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, "MFE/MAE Ratio")
                ?? ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, "MFE MAE Ratio")
                ?? ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, "MFE/MAE");
            decimal? highMae = ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, "High MAE Trades %")
                ?? ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, "High MAE %")
                ?? ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, "HighMAE");
            int? closedTrades = ExtractProfileIntValue(lines, "Closed Trades")
                ?? ExtractProfileIntValue(lines, "Closed");

            C1ProfileQualityBucket bucket = ClassifyC1ExistingProfileBucket(
                profileStatus,
                pass,
                daily,
                maxDrawdown,
                profitFactor,
                edgeR,
                mfeCapture,
                mfeMaeRatio,
                highMae,
                closedTrades);

            return new C1ExistingProfileCandidate
            {
                Symbol = symbol,
                Timeframe = timeframe,
                ProfileStatus = profileStatus,
                Path = path,
                ProfileText = profileText,
                Bucket = bucket,
                Pass = pass,
                DailyProfitPercent = daily,
                MaxDrawdownPercent = maxDrawdown,
                ProfitFactor = profitFactor,
                EdgeR = edgeR,
                MfeCapturePercent = mfeCapture,
                MfeMaeRatio = mfeMaeRatio,
                HighMaeTradesPercent = highMae,
                ClosedTrades = closedTrades,
                LastWriteUtc = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(path)
            };
        }
        catch
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static bool TryResolveProfileIdentity(string path, out string symbol, out string timeframe)
    {
        symbol = string.Empty;
        timeframe = "1h";

        string fileName = Path.GetFileName(path);
        string[] tokens = fileName
            .Split(new[] { '_', '.', ' ', '-', '(', ')', '[', ']' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries | StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries);

        for (int i = 0; i < tokens.Length; i++)
        {
            string token = tokens[i].Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
            if (!token.EndsWith("USDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                continue;

            symbol = token;
            for (int j = i + 1; j < tokens.Length; j++)
            {
                string tf = NormalizeTimeframeToken(tokens[j]);
                if (IsSupportedTrackingTimeframe(tf))
                {
                    timeframe = tf;
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private static string NormalizeTimeframeToken(string value)
    {
        string tf = (value ?? string.Empty).Trim();
        return tf.Equals("15M", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "15m" :
            tf.Equals("1H", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "1h" :
            tf.Equals("4H", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "4h" :
            tf.Equals("1D", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "1d" : tf;
    }

    private static bool IsSupportedTrackingTimeframe(string timeframe)
    {
        return timeframe.Equals("15m", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || timeframe.Equals("1h", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || timeframe.Equals("4h", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || timeframe.Equals("1d", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    private static string ExtractProfileTextValue(string[] lines, string label)
    {
        foreach (string rawLine in lines)
        {
            int idx = rawLine.IndexOf(':');
            if (idx <= 0)
                continue;

            string left = rawLine[..idx].Trim();
            if (left.Equals(label, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return rawLine[(idx + 1)..].Trim();
        }

        return string.Empty;
    }

    private static bool? ExtractProfileBoolValue(string[] lines, string label)
    {
        string raw = ExtractProfileTextValue(lines, label);
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(raw))
            return null;

        if (raw.StartsWith("true", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || raw.Equals("Y", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || raw.Equals("YES", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return true;

        if (raw.StartsWith("false", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || raw.Equals("N", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || raw.Equals("NO", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return false;

        return null;
    }

    private static decimal? ExtractProfileDecimalValue(string[] lines, string label)
    {
        string raw = ExtractProfileTextValue(lines, label);
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(raw))
            return null;

        string cleaned = raw
            .Replace("USDT", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Replace("%", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Replace("R", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Replace("x", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Trim();

        foreach (string token in cleaned.Split(new[] { ' ', '|', ',', ';', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries | StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries))
        {
            if (decimal.TryParse(token, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out decimal parsed))
                return parsed;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static int? ExtractProfileIntValue(string[] lines, string label)
    {
        decimal? value = ExtractProfileDecimalValue(lines, label);
        if (!value.HasValue)
            return null;

        return (int)decimal.Round(value.Value, 0, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
    }

    private static List<string> ReadSymbolListFile(string path)
    {
        var symbols = new List<string>();

        if (!File.Exists(path))
            return symbols;

        foreach (string rawLine in File.ReadLines(path, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8))
        {
            string? symbol = TryExtractSymbolFromTrackingLine(rawLine);
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol) && !symbols.Contains(symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                symbols.Add(symbol);
        }

        return symbols;
    }

    private static string? TryExtractSymbolFromTrackingLine(string line)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line))
            return null;

        string trimmed = line.Trim();
        if (trimmed.StartsWith("#", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return null;

        foreach (string token in trimmed.Split(new[] { ' ', '\t', ',', ';', '|', ':', '/', '\\' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries | StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries))
        {
            string candidate = token.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
            if (candidate.EndsWith("USDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return candidate;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static void WriteSymbolListFile(string path, IEnumerable<string> symbols)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(path) ?? TqgaConfigRootFolder);
        var clean = symbols
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
            .Select(x => x.Trim().ToUpperInvariant())
            .Where(x => x.EndsWith("USDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        File.WriteAllLines(path, clean, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
    }

    private static List<string> GetAllUniverseSymbolsForTracking()
    {
        return AppBinanceUniverse.ActiveSymbols
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
            .Select(x => x.Trim().ToUpperInvariant())
            .Where(x => x.EndsWith("USDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();
    }

    private static void CopyExistingProfileToClassifiedList(C1ExistingProfileCandidate candidate)
    {
        string targetFolder = GetC1ProfileBucketFolder(candidate.Bucket);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(C1GoodListFolder);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(C1MediumQualityFolder);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(C1BadListFolder);

        DeleteClassifiedProfileCopiesForSymbol(C1GoodListFolder, candidate.Symbol);
        DeleteClassifiedProfileCopiesForSymbol(C1MediumQualityFolder, candidate.Symbol);
        DeleteClassifiedProfileCopiesForSymbol(C1BadListFolder, candidate.Symbol);

        string targetName = BuildClassifiedProfileFileName(candidate.Symbol, candidate.Timeframe);
        string targetPath = Path.Combine(targetFolder, targetName);

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(candidate.ProfileText))
            File.WriteAllText(targetPath, candidate.ProfileText, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        else
            File.Copy(candidate.Path, targetPath, overwrite: true);
    }

    private static void DeleteClassifiedProfileCopiesForSymbol(string folder, string symbol)
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(folder))
            return;

        foreach (string path in Directory.EnumerateFiles(folder, "*.config*.txt", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly))
        {
            if (TryResolveProfileIdentity(path, out string existingSymbol, out _) &&
                existingSymbol.Equals(symbol, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                try { File.Delete(path); }
                catch { }
            }
        }
    }

    private static string BuildClassifiedProfileFileName(string symbol, string timeframe)
    {
        return $"C1_PROFILE__{SanitizeFileName(symbol.ToUpperInvariant())}__{SanitizeFileName(NormalizeTimeframeToken(timeframe))}.config.txt";
    }

    private static bool IsInsideFolder(string path, string folder)
    {
        try
        {
            string fullPath = Path.GetFullPath(path).TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, Path.AltDirectorySeparatorChar) + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
            string fullFolder = Path.GetFullPath(folder).TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, Path.AltDirectorySeparatorChar) + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
            return fullPath.StartsWith(fullFolder, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        }
        catch
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static void SaveC1ScanClassificationFiles(IReadOnlyList<C1DdControlProfileSaveRow> bestPerMarket)
    {
        EnsureConfigAuditFoldersAndFiles();

        string alreadyPath = Path.Combine(TqgaConfigRootFolder, AlreadyScannedFileName);
        string needPath = Path.Combine(TqgaConfigRootFolder, NeedToImproveFileName);
        string qualityPath = Path.Combine(TqgaConfigRootFolder, QualityScannedFileName);
        string mediumPath = Path.Combine(TqgaConfigRootFolder, MediumQualityFileName);
        string leftPath = Path.Combine(TqgaConfigRootFolder, LeftCoinsFileName);

        var alreadyScanned = new HashSet<string>(ReadSymbolListFile(alreadyPath), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        var needToImprove = new HashSet<string>(ReadSymbolListFile(needPath), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        var qualityScanned = new HashSet<string>(ReadSymbolListFile(qualityPath), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        var mediumQuality = new HashSet<string>(ReadSymbolListFile(mediumPath), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        foreach (C1DdControlProfileSaveRow row in bestPerMarket)
        {
            string symbol = row.Symbol.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol))
                continue;

            alreadyScanned.Add(symbol);

            C1ProfileQualityBucket bucket = ClassifyC1ProfileBucket(row);
            qualityScanned.Remove(symbol);
            mediumQuality.Remove(symbol);
            needToImprove.Remove(symbol);

            if (bucket == C1ProfileQualityBucket.Good)
                qualityScanned.Add(symbol);
            else if (bucket == C1ProfileQualityBucket.Medium)
                mediumQuality.Add(symbol);
            else
                needToImprove.Add(symbol);
        }

        var alreadySet = new HashSet<string>(alreadyScanned, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        var leftCoins = GetAllUniverseSymbolsForTracking()
            .Where(x => !alreadySet.Contains(x))
            .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        WriteSymbolListFile(alreadyPath, alreadyScanned);
        WriteSymbolListFile(needPath, needToImprove);
        WriteSymbolListFile(qualityPath, qualityScanned);
        WriteSymbolListFile(mediumPath, mediumQuality);
        WriteSymbolListFile(leftPath, leftCoins);
    }

    private static string SaveC1ClassifiedProfileFile(C1DdControlProfileSaveRow row, SrTradeBacktestSettings settings, C1ProfileQualityBucket bucket)
    {
        string folder = GetC1ProfileBucketFolder(bucket);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(C1GoodListFolder);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(C1MediumQualityFolder);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(C1BadListFolder);

        DeleteClassifiedProfileCopiesForSymbol(C1GoodListFolder, row.Symbol);
        DeleteClassifiedProfileCopiesForSymbol(C1MediumQualityFolder, row.Symbol);
        DeleteClassifiedProfileCopiesForSymbol(C1BadListFolder, row.Symbol);

        string fileName = BuildClassifiedProfileFileName(row.Symbol, row.Timeframe);
        string path = Path.Combine(folder, fileName);

        string status = bucket switch
        {
            C1ProfileQualityBucket.Good => "QUALITY_STRICT_1PCT_READY",
            C1ProfileQualityBucket.Medium => "MEDIUM_0P10_TO_LT_1PCT",
            _ => "NEED_TO_IMPROVE_STRICT_GATE"
        };

        string text = BuildC1PerCoinProfileText(row, settings, profileStatus: status, futureUpdateNeeded: bucket != C1ProfileQualityBucket.Good);
        File.WriteAllText(path, text, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        return path;
    }

    private static string SaveC1PerCoinProfileFile(C1DdControlProfileSaveRow row, SrTradeBacktestSettings settings)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(GetC1PerCoinProfileDirectory());
        string safeSymbol = SanitizeFileName(row.Symbol.ToUpperInvariant());
        string safeTf = SanitizeFileName(row.Timeframe);
        string path = Path.Combine(GetC1PerCoinProfileDirectory(), $"C1_PROFILE__{safeSymbol}__{safeTf}.config.txt");
        string text = BuildC1PerCoinProfileText(row, settings, profileStatus: "PASS_READY", futureUpdateNeeded: false);
        File.WriteAllText(path, text, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        return path;
    }

    private static string BuildC1PerCoinProfileText(C1DdControlProfileSaveRow row, SrTradeBacktestSettings s, string profileStatus, bool futureUpdateNeeded)
    {
        var lines = new List<string>
        {
            "C1 PER-COIN CONFIG PROFILE",

            $"Source                  : Button 8 latest DD-control sweep",

            $"Symbol                   : {row.Symbol}",
            $"Timeframe                : {row.Timeframe}",
            $"Future Update Needed     : {futureUpdateNeeded}",
            $"Future Update Note       : {(futureUpdateNeeded ? "Best row is not final GOOD quality. Medium profiles are profitable between 0.10% and below 1.00% daily; bad profiles need deeper tuning." : "Best row met strict 1% daily + risk-quality gate and was saved automatically by Button 6.")}",
            string.Empty,
            "BUTTON 8 PERFORMANCE SNAPSHOT",

            $"Daily Profit %           : {row.DailyProfitPercent:0.0000}",

            $"Net Profit USDT          : {row.NetProfitUsdt:0.00}",
            $"Net Profit %             : {row.NetProfitPercent:0.00}",
            $"Closed Trades            : {row.ClosedTrades}",
            $"Raw Closed Trades        : {row.RawClosedTrades}",
            $"Win Rate                 : {row.WinRate:0.00}",
            $"Edge R                   : {row.EdgeR:0.###}",
            $"Profit Factor            : {row.ProfitFactor:0.##}",
            $"Max Drawdown %           : {row.MaxDrawdownPercent:0.00}",
            $"Raw Max Drawdown %       : {row.RawMaxDrawdownPercent:0.00}",
            $"DD Improvement %         : {row.DrawdownReductionPercent:0.00}",
            $"MFE Capture %            : {row.AverageMfeCapturePercent:0.00}",
            $"Average MFE R            : {row.AverageMfeR:0.###}",
            $"Average MAE R            : {row.AverageMaeR:0.###}",
            $"MFE/MAE Ratio            : {row.MfeMaeRatio:0.###}",
            $"High MAE Trades %        : {row.HighMaeTradesPercent:0.00}",
            $"Pass                     : {row.Pass}",
            string.Empty,
            "SR TRADE / RISK",
            "------------------------------------------------------------",
            $"MO                       : {s.EnableMO}",
            $"LO                       : {s.EnableLO}",
            $"SO                       : {s.EnableSO}",
            $"Long                     : {s.EnableLong}",

            $"RSI Breakdown Short Max  : {s.RsiBreakdownShortMax:0}",
            $"Enable MACD Rule         : {s.EnableMacdRule}",
            $"Enable Volume Rule       : {s.EnableVolumeRule}",
            $"Retest Volume x SMA20    : {s.RetestVolumeMultiplier:0.##}",
            $"Breakout Volume x SMA20  : {s.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier:0.##}",
            $"Enable Candle Rule       : {s.EnableCandleRule}",
            $"Breakout Body %          : {s.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent:0}",
            $"Max Breakout Wick %      : {s.MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent:0}",
            $"Rejection Wick %         : {s.MinimumRejectionWickPercent:0}",
            $"Enable Distance Rule     : {s.EnableDistanceRule}",
            $"Retest Distance ATR      : {s.MaxRetestDistanceAtr:0.##}",
            $"Breakout Distance ATR    : {s.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr:0.##}",
            string.Empty,
            "DD CONTROL METADATA - ENGINE RULES",
            "------------------------------------------------------------",
            $"Loss Cooldown Candles    : {row.CooldownCandles}",
            $"Loss Cooldown Rule       : {FormatCooldownLabel(row.CooldownCandles)}",
            $"ATR Spike Guard          : {FormatAtrSpikeLabel(row.AtrSpikeLimit)}",
            $"ATR Spike Limit          : {row.AtrSpikeLimit:0.##}",
            $"Filtered By Cooldown     : {row.FilteredByCooldown}",
            $"Filtered By ATR Spike    : {row.FilteredByAtrSpike}",
            "Metadata Note            : Button 16/Button 9 full-profile engine applies SL/SO plus cooldown and ATR spike guard rules.",
            "============================================================"
        };

        return string.Join(Environment.NewLine, lines);
    }

    private static string SaveC1PerCoinProfileIndex(
        IReadOnlyList<string> savedLines,
        IReadOnlyList<string> futureLines,
        string latestCsv,
        string latestTxt)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(GetC1PerCoinProfileDirectory());
        string indexPath = Path.Combine(GetC1PerCoinProfileDirectory(), "C1_PER_COIN_PROFILE_INDEX.txt");
        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("C1 PER-COIN PROFILE INDEX");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated UTC            : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Source Button 8 CSV      : {latestCsv}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Source Button 8 TXT      : {latestTxt}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Profile Folder           : {GetC1PerCoinProfileDirectory()}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Saved Profiles           : {savedLines.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Future Update Needed     : {futureLines.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("SAVED / AUTO-LOAD READY");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        foreach (string line in savedLines)
            sb.AppendLine(line);
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("FUTURE UPDATE NEEDED");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        if (futureLines.Count == 0)
            sb.AppendLine("None");
        else
        {
            foreach (string line in futureLines)
                sb.AppendLine(line);
        }
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        File.WriteAllText(indexPath, sb.ToString(), System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        return indexPath;
    }

        sb.AppendLine($"Source Button 8 CSV      : {latestCsv}");

        sb.AppendLine($"Profile Folder           : {GetC1PerCoinProfileDirectory()}");

    private static string FormatCooldownLabel(int cooldownCandles)
    {
        return cooldownCandles <= 0
            ? "Off"
            : $"2 losses -> {cooldownCandles} candles";
    }

    private static string FormatAtrSpikeLabel(decimal atrSpikeLimit)
    {
        return atrSpikeLimit <= 0m
            ? "Off"
            : $"{atrSpikeLimit:0.##}x";
    }
