    private async Task RunC1ExitTuningSweepAsync(
        string title,
        string buttonLabel,
        string reportTitle,
        string reportFilePrefix,
        decimal[] targetRTests,
        decimal[] trailAtrTests,
        decimal[] trailActivationTests)
    {
        if (!TryGetSelectedMarketSelection(title, out List<string> selectedSymbols, out List<string> selectedTimeframes))
            return;

        ResolveOneYearValidationWindow(out DateTime selectedStartDate, out DateTime selectedEndDate);

        if (selectedEndDate < selectedStartDate)
        {
            MessageBox.Show("End date must be greater than or equal to start date.", title, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
            return;
        }

        DateTime rangeStartUtc = DateTime.SpecifyKind(selectedStartDate, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        DateTime rangeEndUtcExclusive = DateTime.SpecifyKind(selectedEndDate.AddDays(1), DateTimeKind.Utc);
        DateTime calculationStartUtc = rangeStartUtc.AddDays(-120);

        SrTradeBacktestSettings baseSettings = GetSrTradeBacktestSettingsFromUi();

        int totalTests = selectedSymbols.Count * selectedTimeframes.Count * targetRTests.Length * trailAtrTests.Length * trailActivationTests.Length;

        using var progressForm = new Form
        {
            Text = title + " - Running",
            StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent,
            Width = 820,
            Height = 280,
            FormBorderStyle = FormBorderStyle.FixedDialog,
            MaximizeBox = false,
            MinimizeBox = false
        };

        var lblTitle = new Label
        {
            Text = buttonLabel + " tests TP Target R, Trail ATR, and Trail Activation R only. It keeps all other C1 settings unchanged.",
            Left = 12,
            Top = 12,
            Width = 780,
            Height = 34
        };

        var progressBar = new ProgressBar
        {
            Left = 12,
            Top = 54,
            Width = 760,
            Height = 24,
            Minimum = 0,
            Maximum = Math.Max(1, totalTests),
            Value = 0
        };

        var lblStatus = new Label
        {
            Text = "Preparing C1 exit tuning sweep...",
            Left = 12,
            Top = 86,
            Width = 780,
            Height = 74
        };

        var lblBest = new Label
        {
            Text = "Best: waiting...",
            Left = 12,
            Top = 166,
            Width = 780,
            Height = 34
        };

        var btnCancelClose = new Button
        {
            Text = "Cancel",
            Left = 692,
            Top = 208,
            Width = 100,
            Height = 28
        };

        progressForm.Controls.AddRange(new Control[] { lblTitle, progressBar, lblStatus, lblBest, btnCancelClose });

        using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        bool completedNormally = false;

        btnCancelClose.Click += (_, _) =>
        {
            if (completedNormally)
            {
                progressForm.Close();
                return;
            }

            cts.Cancel();
            btnCancelClose.Enabled = false;
            btnCancelClose.Text = "Cancelling";
        };

        progressForm.Show(this);
        progressForm.Refresh();
        Toggle(false);

        try
        {
            using var scope = _sp.CreateScope();
            var feed = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<ICandleDataFeed>();
            var engine = new SrTradeBacktestEngine();
            var rows = new List<C1ExitTuningSweepRow>();
            int completed = 0;

            foreach (string symbol in selectedSymbols)
            {
                foreach (string timeframe in selectedTimeframes)
                {
                    cts.Token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

                    List<Candle> candles = GetCandlesFromResearchRam(feed, symbol, timeframe, calculationStartUtc, rangeEndUtcExclusive, title);

                    if (candles.Count < 250)
                    {
                        completed += targetRTests.Length * trailAtrTests.Length * trailActivationTests.Length;
                        progressBar.Value = Math.Min(progressBar.Maximum, completed);
                        lblStatus.Text = $"Skipped {symbol} {timeframe}: not enough candles for selected date range.";
                        continue;
                    }

                    foreach (decimal targetR in targetRTests)
                    {
                        foreach (decimal trailAtr in trailAtrTests)
                        {
                            foreach (decimal trailActivationR in trailActivationTests)
                            {
                                cts.Token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

                                completed++;
                                SrTradeBacktestSettings testSettings = CreateC1ExitSweepSettings(baseSettings, targetR, trailAtr, trailActivationR);

                                lblStatus.Text =
                                    $"Test {completed}/{totalTests}: {symbol} {timeframe}\n" +
                                    $"TP Target R={targetR:0.##}, Trail ATR={trailAtr:0.##}, Trail Activation R={trailActivationR:0.##}";
                                progressBar.Value = Math.Min(progressBar.Maximum, completed);
                                progressForm.Refresh();

                                SrBacktestResult result = await Task.Run(() => engine.Run(
                                    symbol,
                                    timeframe,
                                    rangeStartUtc,
                                    rangeEndUtcExclusive,
                                    candles,
                                    testSettings,
                                    saveOutputFiles: false,
                                    calculateBestR: false));

                                C1ExitTuningSweepRow row = BuildC1ExitTuningSweepRow(
                                    symbol,
                                    timeframe,
                                    rangeStartUtc,
                                    rangeEndUtcExclusive,
                                    testSettings,
                                    result.Rows);

                                rows.Add(row);

                                C1ExitTuningSweepRow? bestSoFar = SelectBestC1ExitTuningRow(rows);
                                if (bestSoFar != null)
                                {
                                    lblBest.Text =
                                        $"Best: {bestSoFar.Symbol} {bestSoFar.Timeframe} | TP {bestSoFar.TargetR:0.##} | Trail ATR {bestSoFar.TrailAtr:0.##} | ActR {bestSoFar.TrailActivationR:0.##} | " +
                                        $"Daily {bestSoFar.DailyProfitPercent:0.0000}% | DD {bestSoFar.MaxDrawdownPercent:0.00}% | PF {bestSoFar.ProfitFactor:0.##} | Edge {bestSoFar.EdgeR:0.###}R | MFE {bestSoFar.AverageMfeCapturePercent:0.00}% | MAE {bestSoFar.AverageMaeR:0.###}R";
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            completedNormally = true;
            btnCancelClose.Enabled = true;
            btnCancelClose.Text = "Close";
            progressBar.Value = progressBar.Maximum;

            if (rows.Count == 0)
            {
                lblTitle.Text = "C1 Exit Tuning completed, but no result was generated.";
                lblStatus.Text = "No selected market had enough candles in the selected range.";
                lblBest.Text = "No result.";
                return;
            }

            C1ExitTuningSweepRow best = SelectBestC1ExitTuningRow(rows)!;
            ApplySrSettingsToUi(CreateC1ExitSweepSettings(baseSettings, best.TargetR, best.TrailAtr, best.TrailActivationR));

            SaveC1ExitTuningSweepReport(
                rows,
                baseSettings,
                best,
                selectedSymbols,
                selectedTimeframes,
                rangeStartUtc,
                rangeEndUtcExclusive,
                reportTitle,
                reportFilePrefix,
                out string txtPath,
                out string csvPath);

            string summary = File.Exists(txtPath)
                ? File.ReadAllText(txtPath)
                : $"C1 Exit Tuning completed. Best TP={best.TargetR:0.##}, TrailATR={best.TrailAtr:0.##}, ActR={best.TrailActivationR:0.##}";

            try
            {
                Clipboard.SetText(summary);
                lblTitle.Text = "C1 Exit Tuning completed. Best exit settings applied to UI and summary copied to clipboard.";
            }
            catch
            {
                lblTitle.Text = "C1 Exit Tuning completed. Best exit settings applied to UI. Clipboard copy was skipped.";
            }

            lblStatus.Text = $"TXT:\n{txtPath}\nCSV:\n{csvPath}";
            lblBest.Text =
                $"Best: TP {best.TargetR:0.##}, Trail ATR {best.TrailAtr:0.##}, Trail Activation R {best.TrailActivationR:0.##} | " +
                $"Daily {best.DailyProfitPercent:0.0000}% | MFE Capture {best.AverageMfeCapturePercent:0.00}% | PF {best.ProfitFactor:0.##}";

            OpenReportFileInExplorer(txtPath);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            completedNormally = true;
            btnCancelClose.Enabled = true;
            btnCancelClose.Text = "Close";
            lblTitle.Text = "C1 Exit Tuning cancelled.";
            lblStatus.Text = "The sweep was cancelled by user.";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            completedNormally = true;
            btnCancelClose.Enabled = true;
            btnCancelClose.Text = "Close";
            lblTitle.Text = "C1 Exit Tuning error.";
            lblStatus.Text = ex.Message;
        }
        finally
        {
            Toggle(true);
        }
    }

    private static SrTradeBacktestSettings CreateC1ExitSweepSettings(
        SrTradeBacktestSettings current,
        decimal targetR,
        decimal trailAtr,
        decimal trailActivationR)
    {
        return new SrTradeBacktestSettings(
            EnableMO: current.EnableMO,
            EnableLO: current.EnableLO,
            EnableSO: current.EnableSO,
            EnableLong: current.EnableLong,
            EnableShort: current.EnableShort,
            StopLossAtrMultiplier: current.StopLossAtrMultiplier,
            TargetR: targetR,
            StartEquityUsdt: current.StartEquityUsdt,
            TradeSizeUsdt: current.TradeSizeUsdt,
            Leverage: current.Leverage,
            MarginUsdt: current.MarginUsdt,
            EnableTrailingStopLoss: true,
            TrailStopAtrMultiplier: trailAtr,
            TrailActivationR: trailActivationR,
            EnableScoreRule: current.EnableScoreRule,
            MinimumLoScore: current.MinimumLoScore,
            MinimumSoScore: current.MinimumSoScore,
            MinimumMoScore: current.MinimumMoScore,
            EnableRsiRule: current.EnableRsiRule,
            RsiSupportMin: current.RsiSupportMin,
            RsiSupportMax: current.RsiSupportMax,
            RsiResistanceMin: current.RsiResistanceMin,
            RsiResistanceMax: current.RsiResistanceMax,
            RsiBreakoutLongMin: current.RsiBreakoutLongMin,
            RsiBreakoutLongMax: current.RsiBreakoutLongMax,
            RsiBreakdownShortMin: current.RsiBreakdownShortMin,
            RsiBreakdownShortMax: current.RsiBreakdownShortMax,
            EnableMacdRule: current.EnableMacdRule,
            EnableVolumeRule: current.EnableVolumeRule,
            RetestVolumeMultiplier: current.RetestVolumeMultiplier,
            BreakoutVolumeMultiplier: current.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier,
            EnableCandleRule: current.EnableCandleRule,
            MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent: current.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent,
            MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent: current.MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent,
            MinimumRejectionWickPercent: current.MinimumRejectionWickPercent,
            EnableDistanceRule: current.EnableDistanceRule,
            MaxRetestDistanceAtr: current.MaxRetestDistanceAtr,
            MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr: current.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr);
    }

    private static C1ExitTuningSweepRow BuildC1ExitTuningSweepRow(
        string symbol,
        string timeframe,
        DateTime startUtc,
        DateTime endUtcExclusive,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings,
        IReadOnlyList<SrTradeLogRow> resultRows)
    {
        List<SrTradeLogRow> placedRows = resultRows
            .Where(r => r.Status == SrTradeStatus.Placed)
            .Where(r => r.SignalTime >= startUtc && r.SignalTime < endUtcExclusive)
            .ToList();

        List<SrTradeLogRow> closedRows = placedRows
            .Where(IsClosedSrTradeRow)
            .OrderBy(r => r.ExitTime ?? r.SignalTime)
            .ToList();

        int wins = closedRows.Count(IsWinningSrTradeRow);
        int losses = closedRows.Count(r => r.Result.Equals("LOSS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        decimal netR = closedRows.Sum(r => r.ProfitR ?? 0m);
        decimal edgeR = closedRows.Count > 0 ? netR / closedRows.Count : 0m;
        decimal winRate = closedRows.Count > 0 ? (decimal)wins / closedRows.Count * 100m : 0m;
        decimal netProfitUsdt = closedRows.Sum(r => r.PnlUsdt ?? 0m);
        decimal netProfitPercent = settings.StartEquityUsdt > 0m ? netProfitUsdt / settings.StartEquityUsdt * 100m : 0m;
        decimal finalEquity = settings.StartEquityUsdt + netProfitUsdt;

        decimal grossWinR = closedRows.Where(r => (r.ProfitR ?? 0m) > 0m).Sum(r => r.ProfitR ?? 0m);
        decimal grossLossR = Math.Abs(closedRows.Where(r => (r.ProfitR ?? 0m) < 0m).Sum(r => r.ProfitR ?? 0m));
        decimal profitFactor = grossLossR > 0m ? grossWinR / grossLossR : grossWinR > 0m ? 999m : 0m;

        List<SrTradeLogRow> mfeMaeRows = closedRows
            .Where(r => r.MfeR.HasValue && r.MaeR.HasValue)
            .ToList();

        decimal averageMfeR = mfeMaeRows.Count > 0 ? mfeMaeRows.Average(r => r.MfeR!.Value) : 0m;
        decimal averageMaeR = mfeMaeRows.Count > 0 ? mfeMaeRows.Average(r => r.MaeR!.Value) : 0m;
        decimal mfeMaeRatio = averageMaeR > 0m ? averageMfeR / averageMaeR : averageMfeR > 0m ? 999m : 0m;

        List<SrTradeLogRow> captureRows = closedRows
            .Where(r => r.MfeR.HasValue && r.MfeR.Value > 0m && r.ProfitR.HasValue)
            .ToList();

        decimal averageMfeCapturePercent = captureRows.Count > 0
            ? captureRows.Average(r => Math.Max(0m, r.ProfitR!.Value) / Math.Max(0.0001m, r.MfeR!.Value) * 100m)
            : 0m;

        decimal maxDrawdownPercent = CalculateMonthlyDrawdownPercent(closedRows, settings.StartEquityUsdt);
        decimal dailyProfitPercent = CalculateDailyProfitPercent(startUtc, endUtcExclusive, netProfitPercent);

        bool pass = closedRows.Count >= 50 &&
                    netProfitUsdt > 0m &&
                    edgeR > 0m &&
                    profitFactor >= 1.30m &&
                    maxDrawdownPercent <= 5.00m;

        decimal score =
            (pass ? 100000m : 0m) +
            (dailyProfitPercent * 1000m) +
            (edgeR * 100m) +
            (Math.Min(profitFactor, 20m) * 25m) +
            averageMfeCapturePercent -
            (maxDrawdownPercent * 50m) +
            (closedRows.Count * 0.05m);

        return new C1ExitTuningSweepRow
        {
            Symbol = symbol,
            Timeframe = timeframe,
            StartUtc = startUtc,
            EndUtcExclusive = endUtcExclusive,
            TargetR = settings.TargetR,
            TrailAtr = settings.TrailStopAtrMultiplier,
            TrailActivationR = settings.TrailActivationR,
            PlacedTrades = placedRows.Count,
            ClosedTrades = closedRows.Count,
            Wins = wins,
            Losses = losses,
            WinRate = winRate,
            NetR = netR,
            EdgeR = edgeR,
            ProfitFactor = profitFactor,
            NetProfitUsdt = netProfitUsdt,
            NetProfitPercent = netProfitPercent,
            FinalEquityUsdt = finalEquity,
            DailyProfitPercent = dailyProfitPercent,
            MaxDrawdownPercent = maxDrawdownPercent,
            AverageMfeR = averageMfeR,
            AverageMaeR = averageMaeR,
            MfeMaeRatio = mfeMaeRatio,
            AverageMfeCapturePercent = averageMfeCapturePercent,
            Score = score,
            Pass = pass
        };
    }

    private static C1ExitTuningSweepRow? SelectBestC1ExitTuningRow(IEnumerable<C1ExitTuningSweepRow> rows)
    {
        return rows
            .OrderByDescending(r => r.Pass)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.DailyProfitPercent)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.ProfitFactor)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.AverageMfeCapturePercent)
            .ThenBy(r => r.MaxDrawdownPercent)
            .FirstOrDefault();
    }

    private static void SaveC1ExitTuningSweepReport(
        IReadOnlyList<C1ExitTuningSweepRow> rows,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings baseSettings,
        C1ExitTuningSweepRow best,
        IReadOnlyList<string> selectedSymbols,
        IReadOnlyList<string> selectedTimeframes,
        DateTime startUtc,
        DateTime endUtcExclusive,
        string reportTitle,
        string reportFilePrefix,
        out string txtPath,
        out string csvPath)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        string stamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string safeMarketName = selectedSymbols.Count == 1 && selectedTimeframes.Count == 1
            ? SanitizeFileName($"{selectedSymbols[0]}_{selectedTimeframes[0]}")
            : "MULTI_MARKET";

        string baseName = $"{reportFilePrefix}_{safeMarketName}_{stamp}";
        txtPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, baseName + ".txt");
        csvPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, baseName + ".csv");

        string txt = BuildC1ExitTuningSweepSummary(rows, baseSettings, best, selectedSymbols, selectedTimeframes, startUtc, endUtcExclusive, reportTitle, txtPath, csvPath);
        string csv = BuildC1ExitTuningSweepCsv(rows);

        File.WriteAllText(txtPath, txt, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(csvPath, csv, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, $"LATEST_{reportFilePrefix}.txt"), txt, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, $"LATEST_{reportFilePrefix}.csv"), csv, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
    }

    private static string BuildC1ExitTuningSweepSummary(
        IReadOnlyList<C1ExitTuningSweepRow> rows,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings baseSettings,
        C1ExitTuningSweepRow best,
        IReadOnlyList<string> selectedSymbols,
        IReadOnlyList<string> selectedTimeframes,
        DateTime startUtc,
        DateTime endUtcExclusive,
        string reportTitle,
        string txtPath,
        string csvPath)
    {
        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();

        sb.AppendLine(reportTitle);
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated UTC       : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Mode                : TP Target R x Trail ATR x Trail Activation R sweep");
        sb.AppendLine($"Selected Coins      : {string.Join(", ", selectedSymbols)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Selected Timeframes : {string.Join(", ", selectedTimeframes)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Date Range          : {startUtc:yyyy-MM-dd} to {endUtcExclusive.AddDays(-1):yyyy-MM-dd} (ONE-YEAR VALIDATION)");
        sb.AppendLine($"Tests Completed     : {rows.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"TXT Report          : {txtPath}");
        sb.AppendLine($"CSV Report          : {csvPath}");
        sb.AppendLine("Important           : Only exit settings are changed. All C1 entry/rule settings remain from current UI.");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("BASE SETTINGS KEPT FROM UI");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Stop Loss ATR       : {baseSettings.StopLossAtrMultiplier:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Start Equity USDT   : {baseSettings.StartEquityUsdt:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Margin / Leverage   : {baseSettings.MarginUsdt:0.##} / {baseSettings.Leverage:0.##}x");
        sb.AppendLine($"Trade Size USDT     : {baseSettings.TradeSizeUsdt:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Orders              : Market={baseSettings.EnableMO}, Limit={baseSettings.EnableLO}, Stop={baseSettings.EnableSO}, Long={baseSettings.EnableLong}, Short={baseSettings.EnableShort}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Rules               : Score={baseSettings.EnableScoreRule}, RSI={baseSettings.EnableRsiRule}, MACD={baseSettings.EnableMacdRule}, Volume={baseSettings.EnableVolumeRule}, Candle={baseSettings.EnableCandleRule}, Distance={baseSettings.EnableDistanceRule}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("BEST EXIT SETTINGS APPLIED TO UI");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        AppendC1ExitTuningRowLine(sb, best, includeSymbol: true);
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("TOP 18 RESULTS");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        foreach (C1ExitTuningSweepRow row in rows
            .OrderByDescending(r => r.Pass)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.DailyProfitPercent)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.ProfitFactor)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.AverageMfeCapturePercent)
            .ThenBy(r => r.MaxDrawdownPercent)
            .Take(18))
        {
            AppendC1ExitTuningRowLine(sb, row, includeSymbol: true);
        }

        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static void AppendC1ExitTuningRowLine(System.Text.StringBuilder sb, C1ExitTuningSweepRow row, bool includeSymbol)
    {
        string symbolPart = includeSymbol ? $"{row.Symbol} {row.Timeframe} | " : string.Empty;
        sb.AppendLine(
            $"{symbolPart}TP {row.TargetR:0.##} | TrailATR {row.TrailAtr:0.##} | ActR {row.TrailActivationR:0.##} | " +
            $"Daily {row.DailyProfitPercent:0.0000}% | Profit {row.NetProfitUsdt:0.00} USDT ({row.NetProfitPercent:0.00}%) | " +
            $"Closed {row.ClosedTrades} | Win {row.WinRate:0.00}% | Edge {row.EdgeR:0.###}R | PF {row.ProfitFactor:0.##} | " +
            $"DD {row.MaxDrawdownPercent:0.00}% | MFE {row.AverageMfeCapturePercent:0.00}% | MAE {row.AverageMaeR:0.###}R | MFE/MAE {row.MfeMaeRatio:0.###} | Pass {row.Pass}");
    }

    private static string BuildC1ExitTuningSweepCsv(IEnumerable<C1ExitTuningSweepRow> rows)
    {
        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("Symbol,Timeframe,Start,End,TargetR,TrailATR,TrailActivationR,PlacedTrades,ClosedTrades,Wins,Losses,WinRate,NetR,EdgeR_UnitR,ProfitFactor,NetProfitUSDT,NetProfitPercent,FinalEquityUSDT,DailyProfitPercent_UnitPct,MaxDDPercent_UnitPct,AverageMfeR_UnitR,AverageMaeR_UnitR,MfeMaeRatio,AverageMfeCapturePercent_UnitPct,Score,Pass");

        foreach (C1ExitTuningSweepRow row in rows
            .OrderByDescending(r => r.Pass)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.DailyProfitPercent)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.ProfitFactor)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.AverageMfeCapturePercent)
            .ThenBy(r => r.MaxDrawdownPercent))
        {
            sb.AppendLine(string.Join(",", new[]
            {
                Csv(row.Symbol),
                Csv(row.Timeframe),
                row.StartUtc.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.EndUtcExclusive.AddDays(-1).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.TargetR.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.TrailAtr.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.TrailActivationR.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.PlacedTrades.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.ClosedTrades.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.Wins.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.Losses.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.WinRate.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.NetR.ToString("0.####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.EdgeR.ToString("0.####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.ProfitFactor.ToString("0.####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.NetProfitUsdt.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.NetProfitPercent.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.FinalEquityUsdt.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.DailyProfitPercent.ToString("0.0000", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.MaxDrawdownPercent.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.AverageMfeR.ToString("0.####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.AverageMaeR.ToString("0.####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.MfeMaeRatio.ToString("0.####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.AverageMfeCapturePercent.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.Score.ToString("0.####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.Pass.ToString()
            }));
        }

        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static void OpenReportFileInExplorer(string txtPath)
    {
        try
        {
            if (File.Exists(txtPath))
            {
                Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo
                {
                    FileName = "explorer.exe",
                    Arguments = $"/select,\"{txtPath}\"",
                    UseShellExecute = true
                });
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            // Report creation should not fail if Explorer cannot open.
        }
    }

    private async Task RunMonthlySeasonValidationAsync()
    {
        if (!TryGetSelectedMarketSelection("14-MONTH VALIDATE", out List<string> selectedSymbols, out List<string> selectedTimeframes))
            return;

        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings = GetSrTradeBacktestSettingsFromUi();
        string runStamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

        using var progressForm = new Form
        {
            Text = "MONTHLY SEASON VALIDATION - Running",
            StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent,
            Width = 760,
            Height = 220,
            FormBorderStyle = FormBorderStyle.FixedDialog,
            MaximizeBox = false,
            MinimizeBox = false
        };

        var lblTitle = new Label
        {
            Text = "Button 14 is validating current SR configuration month-by-month across full candle history.",
            Left = 12,
            Top = 12,
            Width = 720,
            Height = 28
        };

        var progressBar = new ProgressBar
        {
            Left = 12,
            Top = 48,
            Width = 760,
            Height = 24,
            Minimum = 0,
            Maximum = Math.Max(1, selectedSymbols.Count * selectedTimeframes.Count),
            Value = 0
        };

        var lblStatus = new Label
        {
            Text = "Preparing monthly validation...",
            Left = 12,
            Top = 82,
            Width = 720,
            Height = 52
        };

        var lblBest = new Label
        {
            Text = "Result summary will be copied to clipboard when completed.",
            Left = 12,
            Top = 138,
            Width = 720,
            Height = 28
        };

        var btnCancelClose = new Button
        {
            Text = "Cancel",
            Left = 632,
            Top = 166,
            Width = 100,
            Height = 28
        };

        progressForm.Controls.AddRange(new Control[] { lblTitle, progressBar, lblStatus, lblBest, btnCancelClose });

        using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        bool completedNormally = false;

        btnCancelClose.Click += (_, _) =>
        {
            if (completedNormally)
            {
                progressForm.Close();
                return;
            }

            cts.Cancel();
            btnCancelClose.Enabled = false;
            btnCancelClose.Text = "Cancelling";
        };

        progressForm.Show(this);
        progressForm.Refresh();

        Toggle(false);

        try
        {
            var allRows = new List<MonthlySeasonValidationRow>();
            int marketIndex = 0;
            int marketTotal = selectedSymbols.Count * selectedTimeframes.Count;

            using var scope = _sp.CreateScope();
            var feed = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<ICandleDataFeed>();

            await Task.Run(() =>
            {
                foreach (string symbol in selectedSymbols)
                {
                    foreach (string timeframe in selectedTimeframes)
                    {
                        cts.Token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                        marketIndex++;

                        BeginInvoke(new Action(() =>
                        {
                            progressBar.Value = Math.Min(progressBar.Maximum, marketIndex - 1);
                            lblStatus.Text = $"Loading full history candles for {symbol} {timeframe}...";
                            lblBest.Text = $"Market {marketIndex}/{marketTotal}";
                        }));

                        List<Candle> candles = GetCandlesFromResearchRam(feed, symbol, timeframe, DateTime.MinValue, DateTime.MaxValue, "14/13/15 RAM load");

                        if (candles.Count < 250)
                            continue;

                        List<MonthlySeasonValidationRow> marketRows = AnalyzeMonthlySeasonForMarket(
                            symbol,
                            timeframe,
                            candles,
                            settings,
                            cts.Token,
                            (completed, total, monthText) =>
                            {
                                BeginInvoke(new Action(() =>
                                {
                                    progressBar.Value = Math.Min(progressBar.Maximum, Math.Max(progressBar.Minimum, marketIndex - 1));
                                    lblStatus.Text =
                                        $"Market {marketIndex}/{marketTotal}: {symbol} {timeframe}\n" +
                                        $"Month {completed}/{total}: {monthText}";
                                    lblBest.Text = $"Rows collected: {allRows.Count + completed}";
                                }));
                            });

                        allRows.AddRange(marketRows);

                        BeginInvoke(new Action(() =>
                        {
                            progressBar.Value = Math.Min(progressBar.Maximum, marketIndex);
                            lblBest.Text = $"Completed {symbol} {timeframe}: {marketRows.Count} monthly rows";
                        }));
                    }
                }
            }, cts.Token);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

            string safeMarketName = selectedSymbols.Count == 1 && selectedTimeframes.Count == 1
                ? $"{selectedSymbols[0]}_{selectedTimeframes[0]}"
                : "MULTI_MARKET";

            string baseName = $"MONTHLY_SEASON_VALIDATION_{runStamp}_{safeMarketName}";
            string csvPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, $"{baseName}.csv");
            string txtPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, $"{baseName}.txt");

            SaveMonthlySeasonValidationCsv(csvPath, allRows);
            string summary = BuildMonthlySeasonValidationSummaryText(allRows, settings, csvPath, txtPath);
            File.WriteAllText(txtPath, summary);

            Clipboard.SetText(summary);

            completedNormally = true;
            btnCancelClose.Enabled = true;
            btnCancelClose.Text = "Close";
            progressBar.Value = progressBar.Maximum;
            lblTitle.Text = "MONTHLY SEASON VALIDATION completed. Summary copied to clipboard.";
            lblStatus.Text = $"TXT:\n{txtPath}\nCSV:\n{csvPath}";
            lblBest.Text = "Paste into ChatGPT directly with Ctrl+V.";

            MessageBox.Show(
                $"Monthly season validation completed.\n\nTXT:\n{txtPath}\n\nCSV:\n{csvPath}\n\nExecutive summary copied to clipboard.",
                "MONTHLY SEASON VALIDATION",
                MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                MessageBoxIcon.Information);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            MessageBox.Show("Monthly season validation cancelled.", "MONTHLY SEASON VALIDATION", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
            progressForm.Close();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(ex.Message, "MONTHLY SEASON VALIDATION ERROR", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            Toggle(true);
        }
    }

    private static List<MonthlySeasonValidationRow> AnalyzeMonthlySeasonForMarket(
        string symbol,
        string timeframe,
        List<Candle> allCandles,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken,
        Action<int, int, string>? progress)
    {
        DateTime firstMonth = new DateTime(allCandles.First().Time.Year, allCandles.First().Time.Month, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        DateTime lastMonth = new DateTime(allCandles.Last().Time.Year, allCandles.Last().Time.Month, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

        var monthStarts = new List<DateTime>();
        for (DateTime cursor = firstMonth; cursor <= lastMonth; cursor = cursor.AddMonths(1))
            monthStarts.Add(cursor);

        var output = new List<MonthlySeasonValidationRow>();
        var engine = new SrTradeBacktestEngine();

        for (int i = 0; i < monthStarts.Count; i++)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            DateTime monthStart = monthStarts[i];
            DateTime monthEndExclusive = monthStart.AddMonths(1);
            DateTime calculationStart = monthStart.AddDays(-120);

            progress?.Invoke(i + 1, monthStarts.Count, monthStart.ToString("yyyy-MM", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));

            List<Candle> runCandles = allCandles
                .Where(c => c.Time >= calculationStart && c.Time < monthEndExclusive)
                .OrderBy(c => c.Time)
                .ToList();

            if (runCandles.Count < 30)
            {
                output.Add(new MonthlySeasonValidationRow
                {
                    Symbol = symbol,
                    Timeframe = timeframe,
                    MonthStartUtc = monthStart,
                    MonthEndUtcExclusive = monthEndExclusive
                });

                continue;
            }

            SrBacktestResult result = engine.Run(
                symbol,
                timeframe,
                calculationStart,
                monthEndExclusive,
                runCandles,
                settings,
                saveOutputFiles: false,
                calculateBestR: false);

            List<SrTradeLogRow> monthlyRows = result.Rows
                .Where(r => r.SignalTime >= monthStart && r.SignalTime < monthEndExclusive)
                .ToList();

            output.Add(BuildMonthlySeasonValidationRow(symbol, timeframe, monthStart, monthEndExclusive, monthlyRows, settings));
        }

        return output;
    }

    private static MonthlySeasonValidationRow BuildMonthlySeasonValidationRow(
        string symbol,
        string timeframe,
        DateTime monthStartUtc,
        DateTime monthEndUtcExclusive,
        List<SrTradeLogRow> rows,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings)
    {
        List<SrTradeLogRow> placedRows = rows
            .Where(r => r.Status == SrTradeStatus.Placed)
            .ToList();

        List<SrTradeLogRow> closedRows = placedRows
            .Where(IsClosedSrTradeRow)
            .OrderBy(r => r.ExitTime ?? r.SignalTime)
            .ToList();

        int wins = closedRows.Count(IsWinningSrTradeRow);
        int losses = closedRows.Count(r => r.Result.Equals("LOSS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        int open = placedRows.Count(r => r.Result.StartsWith("OPEN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

        decimal netR = closedRows.Sum(r => r.ProfitR ?? 0m);
        decimal edgeR = closedRows.Count > 0 ? netR / closedRows.Count : 0m;
        decimal winRate = closedRows.Count > 0 ? (decimal)wins / closedRows.Count * 100m : 0m;

        decimal netProfitUsdt = closedRows.Sum(r => r.PnlUsdt ?? 0m);
        decimal profitPercent = settings.StartEquityUsdt > 0m
            ? netProfitUsdt / settings.StartEquityUsdt * 100m
            : 0m;

        decimal grossWinR = closedRows.Where(r => (r.ProfitR ?? 0m) > 0m).Sum(r => r.ProfitR ?? 0m);
        decimal grossLossR = Math.Abs(closedRows.Where(r => (r.ProfitR ?? 0m) < 0m).Sum(r => r.ProfitR ?? 0m));

        decimal profitFactor = grossLossR > 0m
            ? grossWinR / grossLossR
            : grossWinR > 0m ? 999m : 0m;

        List<SrTradeLogRow> mfeMaeRows = closedRows
            .Where(r => r.MfeR.HasValue && r.MaeR.HasValue)
            .ToList();

        decimal averageMfeR = mfeMaeRows.Count > 0 ? mfeMaeRows.Average(r => r.MfeR!.Value) : 0m;
        decimal averageMaeR = mfeMaeRows.Count > 0 ? mfeMaeRows.Average(r => r.MaeR!.Value) : 0m;

        decimal mfeMaeRatio = averageMaeR > 0m
            ? averageMfeR / averageMaeR
            : averageMfeR > 0m ? 999m : 0m;

        int highMaeTrades = mfeMaeRows.Count(r => r.MaeR.HasValue && r.MaeR.Value >= 0.80m);
        decimal highMaePercent = closedRows.Count > 0 ? (decimal)highMaeTrades / closedRows.Count * 100m : 0m;

        int weakEntryTrades = mfeMaeRows.Count(r => r.TradeQualityGrade.StartsWith("D", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        decimal weakEntryPercent = closedRows.Count > 0 ? (decimal)weakEntryTrades / closedRows.Count * 100m : 0m;

        int lossAfterOneRMfe = mfeMaeRows.Count(r =>
            r.ProfitR.HasValue &&
            r.ProfitR.Value <= 0m &&
            r.MfeR.HasValue &&
            r.MfeR.Value >= 1.0m);

        decimal maxDrawdownPercent = CalculateMonthlyDrawdownPercent(closedRows, settings.StartEquityUsdt);

        return new MonthlySeasonValidationRow
        {
            Symbol = symbol,
            Timeframe = timeframe,
            MonthStartUtc = monthStartUtc,
            MonthEndUtcExclusive = monthEndUtcExclusive,
            PlacedTrades = placedRows.Count,
            ClosedTrades = closedRows.Count,
            Wins = wins,
            Losses = losses,
            OpenTrades = open,
            WinRate = winRate,
            NetR = netR,
            EdgeR = edgeR,
            NetProfitUsdt = netProfitUsdt,
            ProfitPercent = profitPercent,
            MaxDrawdownPercent = maxDrawdownPercent,
            ProfitFactor = profitFactor,
            MfeMaeRatio = mfeMaeRatio,
            HighMaeTrades = highMaeTrades,
            HighMaePercent = highMaePercent,
            WeakEntryTrades = weakEntryTrades,
            WeakEntryPercent = weakEntryPercent,
            LossAfterOneRMfe = lossAfterOneRMfe
        };
    }

    private static bool IsClosedSrTradeRow(SrTradeLogRow row)
    {
        return IsWinningSrTradeRow(row) ||
               row.Result.Equals("LOSS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    private static bool IsWinningSrTradeRow(SrTradeLogRow row)
    {
        return row.Result.Equals("WIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               row.Result.Equals("TRAIL_WIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    private static decimal CalculateMonthlyDrawdownPercent(List<SrTradeLogRow> closedRows, decimal startEquity)
    {
        if (startEquity <= 0m || closedRows.Count == 0)
            return 0m;

        decimal equity = startEquity;
        decimal peak = startEquity;
        decimal maxDrawdown = 0m;

        foreach (SrTradeLogRow row in closedRows.OrderBy(r => r.ExitTime ?? r.SignalTime))
        {
            equity += row.PnlUsdt ?? 0m;

            if (equity > peak)
                peak = equity;

            if (peak <= 0m)
                continue;

            decimal drawdown = (peak - equity) / peak * 100m;

            if (drawdown > maxDrawdown)
                maxDrawdown = drawdown;
        }

        return maxDrawdown;
    }

    private static void SaveMonthlySeasonValidationCsv(string path, List<MonthlySeasonValidationRow> rows)
    {
        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();

        sb.AppendLine(string.Join(",", new[]
        {
            "Symbol",
            "Timeframe",
            "Month",
            "MonthStartUtc",
            "MonthEndUtcExclusive",
            "Status",
            "PlacedTrades",
            "ClosedTrades",
            "Wins",
            "Losses",
            "OpenTrades",
            "WinRate",
            "NetR",
            "EdgeR",
            "NetProfitUsdt",
            "ProfitPercent",
            "DailyProfitPercent",
            "MaxDrawdownPercent",
            "ProfitFactor",
            "MfeMaeRatio",
            "HighMaeTrades",
            "HighMaePercent",
            "WeakEntryTrades",
            "WeakEntryPercent",
            "LossAfterOneRMfe"
        }));

        foreach (MonthlySeasonValidationRow row in rows)
        {
            sb.AppendLine(string.Join(",", new[]
            {
                Csv(row.Symbol),
                Csv(row.Timeframe),
                Csv(row.MonthStartUtc.ToString("yyyy-MM", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
                Csv(row.MonthStartUtc.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
                Csv(row.MonthEndUtcExclusive.AddDays(-1).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
                Csv(row.Status),
                row.PlacedTrades.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.ClosedTrades.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.Wins.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.Losses.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                row.OpenTrades.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.WinRate),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.NetR),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.EdgeR),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.NetProfitUsdt),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.ProfitPercent),
                FormatCsvDecimal(CalculateDailyProfitPercent(row.MonthStartUtc, row.MonthEndUtcExclusive, row.ProfitPercent)),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.MaxDrawdownPercent),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.ProfitFactor),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.MfeMaeRatio),
                row.HighMaeTrades.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.HighMaePercent),
                row.WeakEntryTrades.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                FormatCsvDecimal(row.WeakEntryPercent),
                row.LossAfterOneRMfe.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            }));
        }

        File.WriteAllText(path, sb.ToString());
    }

    private static string BuildMonthlySeasonValidationSummaryText(
        List<MonthlySeasonValidationRow> rows,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings,
        string csvPath,
        string txtPath)
    {
        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();

        List<MonthlySeasonValidationRow> activeRows = rows.Where(r => r.ClosedTrades > 0).ToList();
        int totalMonths = rows.Count;
        int activeMonths = activeRows.Count;
        int profitableMonths = activeRows.Count(r => r.NetProfitUsdt > 0m);
        int losingMonths = activeRows.Count(r => r.NetProfitUsdt < 0m);
        int cleanPassMonths = activeRows.Count(r => r.IsCleanPass);

        int totalClosed = activeRows.Sum(r => r.ClosedTrades);
        int totalWins = activeRows.Sum(r => r.Wins);
        int totalLosses = activeRows.Sum(r => r.Losses);
        decimal totalNetR = activeRows.Sum(r => r.NetR);
        decimal totalProfitUsdt = activeRows.Sum(r => r.NetProfitUsdt);
        decimal totalProfitPercent = settings.StartEquityUsdt > 0m
            ? totalProfitUsdt / settings.StartEquityUsdt * 100m
            : 0m;

        decimal winRate = totalClosed > 0 ? (decimal)totalWins / totalClosed * 100m : 0m;
        decimal edgeR = totalClosed > 0 ? totalNetR / totalClosed : 0m;
        decimal monthlyConsistency = activeMonths > 0 ? (decimal)profitableMonths / activeMonths * 100m : 0m;
        decimal cleanPassConsistency = activeMonths > 0 ? (decimal)cleanPassMonths / activeMonths * 100m : 0m;

        MonthlySeasonValidationRow? bestMonth = activeRows.OrderByDescending(r => r.NetProfitUsdt).FirstOrDefault();
        MonthlySeasonValidationRow? worstMonth = activeRows.OrderBy(r => r.NetProfitUsdt).FirstOrDefault();
        MonthlySeasonValidationRow? worstDdMonth = activeRows.OrderByDescending(r => r.MaxDrawdownPercent).FirstOrDefault();

        decimal averageActiveMonthProfit = activeMonths > 0 ? activeRows.Average(r => r.ProfitPercent) : 0m;
        decimal averageDailyProfitFromActiveMonth = CalculateDailyProfitPercentFromDays(averageActiveMonthProfit, 30m);
        decimal averageMonthDrawdown = activeMonths > 0 ? activeRows.Average(r => r.MaxDrawdownPercent) : 0m;
        decimal averageMfeMae = activeMonths > 0 ? activeRows.Average(r => r.MfeMaeRatio) : 0m;
        decimal averageHighMae = activeMonths > 0 ? activeRows.Average(r => r.HighMaePercent) : 0m;

        string decision =
            activeMonths >= 12 &&
            monthlyConsistency >= 60m &&
            totalProfitUsdt > 0m &&
            edgeR > 0.10m &&
            cleanPassConsistency >= 40m
                ? "RESEARCH PASS - configuration is profitable across many months/seasons"
                : totalProfitUsdt > 0m && edgeR > 0m
                    ? "PROMISING - profitable but monthly consistency needs more checking"
                    : "REJECT - configuration is not stable across monthly seasons";

        sb.AppendLine("MONTHLY SEASON VALIDATION SUMMARY");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated UTC              : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Decision                   : {decision}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Markets Tested             : {rows.Select(r => $"{r.Symbol} {r.Timeframe}").Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).Count()}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Total Calendar Months      : {totalMonths}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Active Trading Months      : {activeMonths}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Profitable Months          : {profitableMonths}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Losing Months              : {losingMonths}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Clean Pass Months          : {cleanPassMonths}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Monthly Profit Consistency : {monthlyConsistency:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Clean Pass Consistency     : {cleanPassConsistency:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("OVERALL AGGREGATE");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Closed Trades              : {totalClosed}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Wins / Losses              : {totalWins} / {totalLosses}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Win Rate                   : {winRate:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Net R                      : {totalNetR:0.###}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Edge                       : {edgeR:0.###}R per closed trade");
        sb.AppendLine($"Net Profit USDT            : {totalProfitUsdt:0.00}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Total Profit %             : {totalProfitPercent:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Average Active Month %     : {averageActiveMonthProfit:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Average Daily Profit %     : {averageDailyProfitFromActiveMonth:0.0000}% compounded/day from average active month");
        sb.AppendLine($"Average Month DD %         : {averageMonthDrawdown:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"Average MFE/MAE Ratio      : {averageMfeMae:0.000}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Average High MAE %         : {averageHighMae:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("BEST / WORST MONTHS");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        AppendMonthLine(sb, "Best Profit Month", bestMonth);
        AppendMonthLine(sb, "Worst Profit Month", worstMonth);
        AppendMonthLine(sb, "Worst Drawdown Month", worstDdMonth);
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("YEARLY BREAKDOWN");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");

        foreach (var yearGroup in activeRows.GroupBy(r => r.MonthStartUtc.Year).OrderBy(g => g.Key))
        {
            int yearClosed = yearGroup.Sum(r => r.ClosedTrades);
            decimal yearProfit = yearGroup.Sum(r => r.NetProfitUsdt);
            decimal yearProfitPercent = settings.StartEquityUsdt > 0m
                ? yearProfit / settings.StartEquityUsdt * 100m
                : 0m;
            int yearProfitableMonths = yearGroup.Count(r => r.NetProfitUsdt > 0m);
            int yearMonths = yearGroup.Count();
            decimal yearConsistency = yearMonths > 0 ? (decimal)yearProfitableMonths / yearMonths * 100m : 0m;
            decimal yearWorstDd = yearGroup.Max(r => r.MaxDrawdownPercent);

            sb.AppendLine(
                $"{yearGroup.Key}: Months {yearMonths}, Profitable {yearProfitableMonths}, " +
                $"Consistency {yearConsistency:0.00}%, Closed {yearClosed}, " +
                $"Profit {yearProfit:0.00} USDT ({yearProfitPercent:0.00}%), Worst DD {yearWorstDd:0.00}%");
        }

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("CURRENT SETTINGS TESTED");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"MO / LO / SO               : {settings.EnableMO} / {settings.EnableLO} / {settings.EnableSO}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Long / Short               : {settings.EnableLong} / {settings.EnableShort}");
        sb.AppendLine($"SL ATR                     : {settings.StopLossAtrMultiplier:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"TP R                       : {settings.TargetR:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Trail                      : {settings.EnableTrailingStopLoss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Trail ATR / Activation R   : {settings.TrailStopAtrMultiplier:0.##} / {settings.TrailActivationR:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Start Equity USDT          : {settings.StartEquityUsdt:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Margin / Leverage / Size   : {settings.MarginUsdt:0.##} / {settings.Leverage:0.##}x / {settings.TradeSizeUsdt:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"LO / SO / MO Min Score     : {settings.MinimumLoScore:0.#} / {settings.MinimumSoScore:0.#} / {settings.MinimumMoScore:0.#}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Retest / Breakout Vol SMA20: {settings.RetestVolumeMultiplier:0.##} / {settings.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Breakout Body %            : {settings.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent:0.#}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Retest / Breakout Dist ATR : {settings.MaxRetestDistanceAtr:0.##} / {settings.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr:0.##}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("FILES");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"TXT Summary                : {txtPath}");
        sb.AppendLine($"CSV Monthly Table          : {csvPath}");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");

        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static void AppendMonthLine(System.Text.StringBuilder sb, string label, MonthlySeasonValidationRow? row)
    {
        if (row == null)
        {
            sb.AppendLine($"{label,-28}: none");
            return;
        }

        sb.AppendLine(
            $"{label,-28}: {row.Symbol} {row.Timeframe} {row.MonthStartUtc:yyyy-MM} | " +
            $"Profit {row.ProfitPercent:0.00}% | Daily {CalculateDailyProfitPercent(row.MonthStartUtc, row.MonthEndUtcExclusive, row.ProfitPercent):0.0000}% | NetR {row.NetR:0.###} | Closed {row.ClosedTrades} | " +
            $"Win {row.WinRate:0.00}% | DD {row.MaxDrawdownPercent:0.00}% | Status {row.Status}");
    }


    private static readonly DateTime ForcedValidationStartDate = new DateTime(2026, 1, 1);
    private static readonly DateTime ForcedValidationEndDate = new DateTime(2026, 6, 30);

    private void ResolveOneYearValidationWindow(out DateTime selectedStartDate, out DateTime selectedEndDate)
    {
        // USER FAST-SCAN DEFAULT WINDOW:
        // Keep every research/backtest/scan button on the same fixed 2026 H1 window.
        // This avoids slow 2026 H1 / 5-year validation while tuning profiles.
        selectedStartDate = ForcedValidationStartDate;
        selectedEndDate = ForcedValidationEndDate;

        if (_dtpChartStartDate != null && _dtpChartStartDate.Value.Date != selectedStartDate)
            _dtpChartStartDate.Value = selectedStartDate;

        if (_dtpChartEndDate != null && _dtpChartEndDate.Value.Date != selectedEndDate)
            _dtpChartEndDate.Value = selectedEndDate;
    }

    private static string FormatMetricPack(decimal dailyPercent, decimal maxDdPercent, decimal profitFactor, decimal edgeR, decimal mfeCapturePercent, decimal averageMaeR)
    {
        return $"Daily {dailyPercent:0.0000}% | DD {maxDdPercent:0.00}% | PF {profitFactor:0.##} | Edge {edgeR:0.###}R | MFE {mfeCapturePercent:0.00}% | MAE {averageMaeR:0.###}R";
    }

    private static string FormatCsvDecimal(decimal value)
    {
        return value.ToString("0.####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    }

    private static string Csv(string value)
    {
        value ??= string.Empty;

        if (value.Contains(',', StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
            value.Contains('"', StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
            value.Contains('\n', StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
            value.Contains('\r', StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            return "\"" + value.Replace("\"", "\"\"", StringComparison.Ordinal) + "\"";
        }

        return value;
    }


    private static decimal CalculateDailyProfitPercent(DateTime startUtc, DateTime endUtcExclusive, decimal totalProfitPercent)
    {
        double days = Math.Max(1.0, (endUtcExclusive - startUtc).TotalDays);
        double growth = 1.0 + ((double)totalProfitPercent / 100.0);

        if (growth <= 0.0)
            return totalProfitPercent / (decimal)days;

        return (decimal)((Math.Pow(growth, 1.0 / days) - 1.0) * 100.0);
    }

    private static decimal CalculateDailyProfitPercentFromDays(decimal totalProfitPercent, decimal days)
    {
        double safeDays = Math.Max(1.0, (double)days);
        double growth = 1.0 + ((double)totalProfitPercent / 100.0);

        if (growth <= 0.0)
            return totalProfitPercent / days;

        return (decimal)((Math.Pow(growth, 1.0 / safeDays) - 1.0) * 100.0);
    }

    private static string BuildDailyProfitFilePrefix(decimal dailyProfitPercent)
    {
        string sign = dailyProfitPercent >= 0m ? "P" : "N";
        decimal absolute = Math.Abs(dailyProfitPercent);
        string value = absolute.ToString("0.0000", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).Replace('.', 'p');
        return $"DAILY_{sign}{value}PCT";
    }

    private static void SaveMoreTunningMasterReport(
        string profileName,
        IReadOnlyList<MoreTunningResult> results,
        MoreTunningCandidateResult globalBest,
        out string txtPath,
        out string csvPath)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(MoreTunningReportPaths.Button13ReportFolder);

        string safeProfile = SanitizeFileName(profileName);
        string stamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string dailyPrefix = BuildDailyProfitFilePrefix(CalculateDailyProfitPercent(globalBest.StartUtc, globalBest.EndUtcExclusive, globalBest.Metrics.NetProfitPercent));
        string baseName = $"{dailyPrefix}__BUTTON_13_MORE_TUNNING_MASTER__{safeProfile}__{stamp}";

        txtPath = Path.Combine(MoreTunningReportPaths.Button13ReportFolder, baseName + ".txt");
        csvPath = Path.Combine(MoreTunningReportPaths.Button13ReportFolder, baseName + ".csv");

        string txt = BuildMoreTunningMasterSummary(profileName, results, globalBest, txtPath, csvPath);
        string csv = BuildMoreTunningMasterCsv(results);

        File.WriteAllText(txtPath, txt, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(csvPath, csv, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);

        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(MoreTunningReportPaths.Button13ReportFolder, "LATEST_BUTTON_13_MORE_TUNNING_REPORT.txt"), txt, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(MoreTunningReportPaths.Button13ReportFolder, "LATEST_BUTTON_13_MORE_TUNNING_REPORT.csv"), csv, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
    }

    private static void OpenButton13ReportFile(string txtPath)
    {
        try
        {
            if (File.Exists(txtPath))
            {
                Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo
                {
                    FileName = "explorer.exe",
                    Arguments = $"/select,\"{txtPath}\"",
                    UseShellExecute = true
                });
                return;
            }

            Directory.CreateDirectory(MoreTunningReportPaths.Button13ReportFolder);
            Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo
            {
                FileName = MoreTunningReportPaths.Button13ReportFolder,
                UseShellExecute = true
            });
        }
        catch
        {
            // Report save must not fail because Explorer cannot be opened.
        }
    }

    private static string BuildMoreTunningMasterSummary(
        string profileName,
        IReadOnlyList<MoreTunningResult> results,
        MoreTunningCandidateResult globalBest,
        string txtPath,
        string csvPath)
    {
        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        List<MoreTunningResult> validResults = results.Where(r => r.Best != null).ToList();

        sb.AppendLine("BUTTON 13 - MORE TUNNING MASTER REPORT");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Profile       : {profileName}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated UTC : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Folder : {MoreTunningReportPaths.Button13ReportFolder}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Master TXT    : {txtPath}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Master CSV    : {csvPath}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Markets Tested: {results.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Valid Markets : {validResults.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine("Mode          : Fast local alpha refinement from current selected SR settings.");
        sb.AppendLine("Important     : Research validation only. Not live execution proof.");
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("GLOBAL BEST RESULT");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        AppendMoreTunningBestLine(sb, globalBest);
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("PER-MARKET BEST RESULTS");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        foreach (MoreTunningResult result in validResults
            .OrderByDescending(r => r.Best!.Metrics.Score)
            .ThenByDescending(r => r.Best!.Metrics.NetProfitPercent))
        {
            AppendMoreTunningBestLine(sb, result.Best!);
            sb.AppendLine($"Result CSV              : {result.ResultsCsvPath}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Best Config             : {result.BestConfigPath}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Summary                 : {result.SummaryPath}");
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        return sb.ToString();
    }
