    private static string BuildMoreTunningMasterCsv(IReadOnlyList<MoreTunningResult> results)
    {
        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("Profile,Symbol,Timeframe,Start,End,DailyProfitPct,Closed,Wins,Losses,WinRate,NetR,EdgeR_UnitR,ProfitFactor,MaxDDPct,NetProfitUSDT,NetProfit%,FinalEquityUSDT,Score,Pass,MO,LO,SO,Long,Short,SL,TP,Trail,TrailATR,TrailActivationR,Margin,Leverage,TradeSize,LOScore,SOScore,MOScore,RetVol,BoVol,Body%,RetDist,BoDist,ResultCsvPath,BestConfigPath,SummaryPath");

        foreach (MoreTunningResult result in results.Where(r => r.Best != null))
        {
            MoreTunningCandidateResult best = result.Best!;
            FindBestEdgeMetrics m = best.Metrics;
            SrTradeBacktestSettings s = best.Settings;
            sb.AppendLine(string.Join(",", new[]
            {
                EscapeCsvValue(result.ProfileName),
                EscapeCsvValue(best.Symbol),
                EscapeCsvValue(best.Timeframe),
                best.StartUtc.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                best.EndUtcExclusive.AddDays(-1).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                CalculateDailyProfitPercent(best.StartUtc, best.EndUtcExclusive, m.NetProfitPercent).ToString("0.0000", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.ClosedTrades.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.Wins.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.Losses.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.WinRate.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.NetR.ToString("0.####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.EdgeR.ToString("0.####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.ProfitFactor.ToString("0.####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.MaxDrawdownPercent.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.NetProfitUsdt.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.NetProfitPercent.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.FinalEquityUsdt.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.Score.ToString("0.####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.PassesTarget.ToString(),
                s.EnableMO.ToString(),
                s.EnableLO.ToString(),
                s.EnableSO.ToString(),
                s.EnableLong.ToString(),
                s.EnableShort.ToString(),
                s.StopLossAtrMultiplier.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.TargetR.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.EnableTrailingStopLoss.ToString(),
                s.TrailStopAtrMultiplier.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.TrailActivationR.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.MarginUsdt.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.Leverage.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.TradeSizeUsdt.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.MinimumLoScore.ToString("0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.MinimumSoScore.ToString("0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.MinimumMoScore.ToString("0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.RetestVolumeMultiplier.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent.ToString("0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.MaxRetestDistanceAtr.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                s.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                EscapeCsvValue(result.ResultsCsvPath),
                EscapeCsvValue(result.BestConfigPath),
                EscapeCsvValue(result.SummaryPath)
            }));
        }

        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static string EscapeCsvValue(string value)
    {
        if (value.Contains('"') || value.Contains(',') || value.Contains('\n') || value.Contains('\r'))
            return '"' + value.Replace("\"", "\"\"") + '"';

        return value;
    }

    private async Task RunMoreTunningAsync()
    {
        if (!TryGetSelectedMarketSelection("13-MORE TUNNING", out List<string> selectedSymbols, out List<string> selectedTimeframes))
            return;

        SrTradeBacktestSettings alphaSettings = GetSrTradeBacktestSettingsFromUi();
        string profileName = $"MORE_TUNNING_DOUBLE_RANGE_ALPHA_{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}";

        using var progressForm = new Form
        {
            Text = "MORE TUNNING - Double Range Alpha Refinement",
            StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent,
            Width = 800,
            Height = 320,
            FormBorderStyle = FormBorderStyle.FixedDialog,
            MaximizeBox = false,
            MinimizeBox = false
        };

        var lblTitle = new Label
        {
            Text = "MORE TUNNING DOUBLE RANGE uses current SR alpha, selected coins/TF, and selected date range for deeper tuning.",
            Left = 12,
            Top = 12,
            Width = 760,
            Height = 34
        };

        var progressBar = new ProgressBar
        {
            Left = 12,
            Top = 54,
            Width = 720,
            Height = 24,
            Minimum = 0,
            Maximum = 100,
            Value = 0
        };

        var lblStatus = new Label
        {
            Text = "Preparing double-range fine tuning...",
            Left = 12,
            Top = 86,
            Width = 760,
            Height = 92
        };

        var lblBest = new Label
        {
            Text = "Best: waiting...",
            Left = 12,
            Top = 184,
            Width = 760,
            Height = 36
        };

        var btnCancelClose = new Button
        {
            Text = "Cancel",
            Left = 672,
            Top = 238,
            Width = 100,
            Height = 28
        };

        progressForm.Controls.AddRange(new Control[] { lblTitle, progressBar, lblStatus, lblBest, btnCancelClose });

        using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        bool completedNormally = false;

        btnCancelClose.Click += (_, _) =>
        {
            if (completedNormally)
            {
                progressForm.Close();
                return;
            }

            cts.Cancel();
            btnCancelClose.Enabled = false;
            btnCancelClose.Text = "Cancelling";
        };

        progressForm.Show(this);
        progressForm.Refresh();

        Toggle(false);

        try
        {
            using var scope = _sp.CreateScope();
            var feed = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<ICandleDataFeed>();
            var tuner = new MoreTunningEngine();

            MoreTunningResult? globalBestResult = null;
            MoreTunningCandidateResult? globalBest = null;
            var completedResults = new List<MoreTunningResult>();
            ResolveOneYearValidationWindow(out DateTime button13SelectedStartDate, out DateTime button13SelectedEndDate);
            int marketIndex = 0;
            int marketTotal = selectedSymbols.Count * selectedTimeframes.Count;

            foreach (string symbol in selectedSymbols)
            {
                foreach (string timeframe in selectedTimeframes)
                {
                    cts.Token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                    marketIndex++;

                    List<Candle> candles = GetCandlesFromResearchRam(feed, symbol, timeframe, DateTime.MinValue, DateTime.MaxValue, "14/13/15 RAM load");

                    if (candles.Count < 250)
                        continue;

                    ResolveOneYearValidationWindow(out DateTime selectedStartDate, out DateTime selectedEndDate);

                    if (selectedEndDate < selectedStartDate)
                    {
                        DateTime temp = selectedStartDate;
                        selectedStartDate = selectedEndDate;
                        selectedEndDate = temp;
                    }

                    button13SelectedStartDate = selectedStartDate;
                    button13SelectedEndDate = selectedEndDate;

                    DateTime rangeStartUtc = DateTime.SpecifyKind(selectedStartDate, DateTimeKind.Utc);
                    DateTime rangeEndUtcExclusive = DateTime.SpecifyKind(selectedEndDate.AddDays(1), DateTimeKind.Utc);

                    DateTime availableStartUtc = DateTime.SpecifyKind(candles.First().Time.Date, DateTimeKind.Utc);
                    DateTime availableEndUtcExclusive = DateTime.SpecifyKind(candles.Last().Time.Date.AddDays(1), DateTimeKind.Utc);

                    if (rangeStartUtc < availableStartUtc)
                        rangeStartUtc = availableStartUtc;

                    if (rangeEndUtcExclusive > availableEndUtcExclusive)
                        rangeEndUtcExclusive = availableEndUtcExclusive;

                    List<Candle> testCandles = candles
                        .Where(c => c.Time >= rangeStartUtc && c.Time < rangeEndUtcExclusive)
                        .OrderBy(c => c.Time)
                        .ToList();

                    if (testCandles.Count < 250)
                        continue;

                    var request = new MoreTunningRequest(
                        Symbol: symbol,
                        Timeframe: timeframe,
                        StartUtc: rangeStartUtc,
                        EndUtcExclusive: rangeEndUtcExclusive,
                        Candles: testCandles,
                        AlphaSettings: alphaSettings,
                        ProfileName: $"{profileName}_{symbol}_{timeframe}_{rangeStartUtc:yyyyMMdd}_{rangeEndUtcExclusive.AddDays(-1):yyyyMMdd}");

                    var progress = new Progress<MoreTunningProgress>(p =>
                    {
                        if (progressBar.Maximum != p.Total)
                            progressBar.Maximum = Math.Max(1, p.Total);

                        progressBar.Value = Math.Min(progressBar.Maximum, Math.Max(progressBar.Minimum, p.Completed));
                        lblStatus.Text =
                            $"Market {marketIndex}/{marketTotal}: {symbol} {timeframe}\n" +
                            $"Test {p.Completed}/{p.Total} | Elapsed {FormatTimeSpan(p.Elapsed)} | Remaining {FormatTimeSpan(p.EstimatedRemaining)}\n" +
                            p.CurrentTest + "\nDOUBLE RANGE MODE: 96 local alpha tests per market/date range.";
                        lblBest.Text = p.BestSoFar;
                    });

                    MoreTunningResult result = await Task.Run(() => tuner.Run(request, progress, cts.Token));
                    completedResults.Add(result);

                    if (result.Best != null && (globalBest == null || result.Best.Metrics.Score > globalBest.Metrics.Score))
                    {
                        globalBest = result.Best;
                        globalBestResult = result;
                    }
                }
            }


            completedNormally = true;
            btnCancelClose.Enabled = true;
            btnCancelClose.Text = "Close";
            progressBar.Value = progressBar.Maximum;

            if (globalBest != null && globalBestResult != null)
            {
                ApplySrSettingsToUi(globalBest.Settings);

                SaveMoreTunningMasterReport(
                    profileName,
                    completedResults,
                    globalBest,
                    out string masterTxtPath,
                    out string masterCsvPath);

                string summaryText = File.Exists(masterTxtPath)
                    ? File.ReadAllText(masterTxtPath)
                    : $"MORE TUNNING completed. Best: {globalBest.Symbol} {globalBest.Timeframe}";

                try
                {
                    Clipboard.SetText(summaryText);
                    lblTitle.Text = "MORE TUNNING DOUBLE RANGE completed. Best tuned settings applied to UI and summary copied to clipboard.";
                }
                catch
                {
                    lblTitle.Text = "MORE TUNNING DOUBLE RANGE completed. Best tuned settings applied to UI. Clipboard copy was skipped.";
                }

                lblStatus.Text =
                    $"Button 13 Report Folder:\n{MoreTunningReportPaths.Button13ReportFolder}\nMaster TXT:\n{masterTxtPath}\nMaster CSV:\n{masterCsvPath}\nLatest TXT:\n{Path.Combine(MoreTunningReportPaths.Button13ReportFolder, "LATEST_BUTTON_13_MORE_TUNNING_REPORT.txt")}\nBest Profile:\n{globalBestResult.BestConfigPath}";
                lblBest.Text =
                    $"Best Profit {globalBest.Metrics.NetProfitPercent:0.00}% | Edge {globalBest.Metrics.EdgeR:0.###}R | PF {globalBest.Metrics.ProfitFactor:0.##} | " +
                    $"DD {globalBest.Metrics.MaxDrawdownPercent:0.00}% | Closed {globalBest.Metrics.ClosedTrades} | Pass {globalBest.Metrics.PassesTarget}";

                OpenButton13ReportFile(masterTxtPath);
            }
            else
            {
                SaveMoreTunningNoValidResultReport(
                    profileName,
                    completedResults,
                    selectedSymbols,
                    selectedTimeframes,
                    button13SelectedStartDate == DateTime.MinValue.Date ? DateTime.Today : button13SelectedStartDate,
                    button13SelectedEndDate == DateTime.MinValue.Date ? DateTime.Today : button13SelectedEndDate,
                    out string noResultTxtPath,
                    out string noResultCsvPath);

                lblTitle.Text = "MORE TUNNING DOUBLE RANGE completed, but no valid result was found. A Button 13 report was still saved.";
                lblStatus.Text =
                    $"Button 13 Report Folder:\n{MoreTunningReportPaths.Button13ReportFolder}\nMaster TXT:\n{noResultTxtPath}\nMaster CSV:\n{noResultCsvPath}\nLatest TXT:\n{Path.Combine(MoreTunningReportPaths.Button13ReportFolder, "LATEST_BUTTON_13_MORE_TUNNING_REPORT.txt")}";
                lblBest.Text = "No valid result. Try wider date range or fewer selected markets.";

                OpenButton13ReportFile(noResultTxtPath);
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            completedNormally = true;
            btnCancelClose.Enabled = true;
            btnCancelClose.Text = "Close";
            lblTitle.Text = "MORE TUNNING cancelled.";
            lblStatus.Text = "The double-range fine tuning run was cancelled by user.";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            completedNormally = true;
            btnCancelClose.Enabled = true;
            btnCancelClose.Text = "Close";
            lblTitle.Text = "MORE TUNNING error.";
            lblStatus.Text = ex.Message;
        }
        finally
        {
            Toggle(true);
        }
    }

    private async Task RunFindBestEdgeAsync()
    {
        if (!TryGetSelectedMarketSelection("15-FIND BEST EDGE", out List<string> selectedSymbols, out List<string> selectedTimeframes))
            return;

        ResolveOneYearValidationWindow(out DateTime selectedStartDate, out DateTime selectedEndDate);

        if (selectedEndDate < selectedStartDate)
            return;

        DateTime fromUtc = DateTime.SpecifyKind(selectedStartDate, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        DateTime toUtcExclusive = DateTime.SpecifyKind(selectedEndDate.AddDays(1), DateTimeKind.Utc);
        DateTime calculationFromUtc = fromUtc.AddDays(-120);

        SrTradeBacktestSettings defaultSeedSettings = GetSrTradeBacktestSettingsFromUi();
        string profileName = $"AUTO_FIND_BEST_EDGE_{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}";

        using var progressForm = new Form
        {
            Text = "FIND BEST EDGE - Running",
            StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent,
            Width = 720,
            Height = 230,
            FormBorderStyle = FormBorderStyle.FixedDialog,
            MaximizeBox = false,
            MinimizeBox = false
        };

        var lblTitle = new Label
        {
            Text = "FIND BEST EDGE FAST uses SELECTED COINS ONLY and 2026 H1 validation (01-Jan-2026 to 30-Jun-2026). It does smart discovery windows first, then final 2026 H1 validation (01-Jan-2026 to 30-Jun-2026). No chart window/trade logs during search.",
            Left = 12,
            Top = 12,
            Width = 680,
            Height = 32
        };

        var progressBar = new ProgressBar
        {
            Left = 12,
            Top = 52,
            Width = 680,
            Height = 24,
            Minimum = 0,
            Maximum = 100,
            Value = 0
        };

        var lblStatus = new Label
        {
            Text = "Preparing...",
            Left = 12,
            Top = 84,
            Width = 680,
            Height = 52
        };

        var lblBest = new Label
        {
            Text = "Best: waiting...",
            Left = 12,
            Top = 138,
            Width = 680,
            Height = 34
        };

        var btnCancelClose = new Button
        {
            Text = "Cancel",
            Left = 590,
            Top = 172,
            Width = 100,
            Height = 28
        };

        progressForm.Controls.AddRange(new Control[] { lblTitle, progressBar, lblStatus, lblBest, btnCancelClose });

        using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        bool completedNormally = false;

        btnCancelClose.Click += (_, _) =>
        {
            if (completedNormally)
            {
                progressForm.Close();
                return;
            }

            cts.Cancel();
            btnCancelClose.Enabled = false;
            btnCancelClose.Text = "Cancelling";
        };

        progressForm.Show(this);
        progressForm.Refresh();

        Toggle(false);

        try
        {
            using var scope = _sp.CreateScope();
            var feed = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<ICandleDataFeed>();
            var finder = new FindBestEdgeEngine();

            FindBestEdgeResult? globalBestResult = null;
            FindBestEdgeCandidateResult? globalBest = null;
            int marketIndex = 0;
            int marketTotal = selectedSymbols.Count * selectedTimeframes.Count;
            var c2ProofBlocks = new List<string>();
            AppendCentralProgressDetail("15-FIND BEST EDGE", $"Selected coins only: {string.Join(", ", selectedSymbols)} | 2026 H1 validation: {selectedStartDate:yyyy-MM-dd} to {selectedEndDate:yyyy-MM-dd}");
            AppendCentralProgressDetail("15-FIND BEST EDGE", "C2-FIRST REPORT PROOF enabled. A folder validation and seed-result proof report will be saved for every market.");

            foreach (string symbol in selectedSymbols)
            {
                foreach (string timeframe in selectedTimeframes)
                {
                    cts.Token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                    marketIndex++;

                    List<Candle> candles = GetCandlesFromResearchRam(feed, symbol, timeframe, DateTime.MinValue, DateTime.MaxValue, "14/13/15 RAM load");

                    if (candles.Count < 250)
                        continue;

                    DateTime availableStartUtc = DateTime.SpecifyKind(candles.First().Time.Date, DateTimeKind.Utc);
                    DateTime availableEndUtcExclusive = DateTime.SpecifyKind(candles.Last().Time.Date.AddDays(1), DateTimeKind.Utc);
                    DateTime validationStartUtc = fromUtc < availableStartUtc ? availableStartUtc : fromUtc;
                    DateTime validationEndUtcExclusive = toUtcExclusive > availableEndUtcExclusive ? availableEndUtcExclusive : toUtcExclusive;

                    if (validationEndUtcExclusive <= validationStartUtc || candles.Count(c => c.Time >= validationStartUtc && c.Time < validationEndUtcExclusive) < 250)
                        continue;

                    C2SeedProbeResult c2Probe = ProbeC2BestSeedProfile(symbol, timeframe, defaultSeedSettings);
                    SrTradeBacktestSettings marketSeedSettings = c2Probe.Loaded && c2Probe.Settings != null
                        ? c2Probe.Settings
                        : defaultSeedSettings;

                    string c2SeedNote = c2Probe.Loaded
                        ? $"C2 seed loaded: {Path.GetFileName(c2Probe.SelectedPath ?? string.Empty)}"
                        : c2Probe.Message;

                    AppendCentralProgressDetail(
                        "15-FIND BEST EDGE",
                        $"C2 PROOF | {symbol} {timeframe} | SeedFound={c2Probe.SeedFound} | Loaded={c2Probe.Loaded} | Candidates={c2Probe.CandidateFiles.Count} | ExistingFolders={c2Probe.ExistingFolders.Count}/{c2Probe.FoldersChecked.Count} | Selected={Path.GetFileName(c2Probe.SelectedPath ?? "N/A")}");
                    WriteC2SeedValidationLog(symbol, timeframe, c2SeedNote, marketSeedSettings, c2Probe);

                    var request = new FindBestEdgeRequest(
                        Symbol: symbol,
                        Timeframe: timeframe,
                        StartUtc: validationStartUtc,
                        EndUtcExclusive: validationEndUtcExclusive,
                        Candles: candles,
                        SeedSettings: marketSeedSettings,
                        ProfileName: $"{profileName}_C2_FIRST_{symbol}_{timeframe}_FAST_H1_2026",
                        MaxTries: 600);

                    var progress = new Progress<FindBestEdgeProgress>(p =>
                    {
                        if (progressBar.Maximum != p.Total)
                            progressBar.Maximum = Math.Max(1, p.Total);

                        progressBar.Value = Math.Min(progressBar.Maximum, Math.Max(progressBar.Minimum, p.Completed));
                        lblStatus.Text =
                            $"Market {marketIndex}/{marketTotal}: {symbol} {timeframe} | ONE-YEAR {validationStartUtc:yyyy-MM-dd} to {validationEndUtcExclusive.AddDays(-1):yyyy-MM-dd}\n" +
                            $"Try {p.Completed}/{p.Total} | Elapsed {FormatTimeSpan(p.Elapsed)} | Remaining {FormatTimeSpan(p.EstimatedRemaining)}\n" +
                            p.CurrentTest;
                        lblBest.Text = p.BestSoFar + " | target units: Daily %, DD %, Edge R, MFE %, MAE R";

                        int overallCompleted = ((marketIndex - 1) * Math.Max(1, p.Total)) + p.Completed;
                        int overallTotal = Math.Max(1, marketTotal * Math.Max(1, p.Total));
                        if (p.Completed == 1 || p.Completed == p.Total || p.Completed % Math.Max(1, p.Total / 50) == 0)
                        {
                            UpdateSharedButtonProgress(
                                "15-FIND BEST EDGE",
                                overallCompleted,
                                overallTotal,
                                $"{symbol} {timeframe} | try {p.Completed}/{p.Total} | {p.CurrentTest} | units: Daily %, DD %, Edge R, MFE %, MAE R");
                        }
                    });

                    FindBestEdgeResult result = await Task.Run(() => finder.Run(request, progress, cts.Token));

                    string c2ProofPath = WriteC2FirstReportProof(symbol, timeframe, c2Probe, result, out string c2ProofBlock);
                    c2ProofBlocks.Add(c2ProofBlock);
                    AppendCentralProgressDetail("15-FIND BEST EDGE", $"C2 PROOF SAVED | {symbol} {timeframe} | FinalSource={result.FinalProfileSource} | {c2ProofPath}");

                    if (result.Best != null && (globalBest == null || result.Best.Metrics.Score > globalBest.Metrics.Score))
                    {
                        globalBest = result.Best;
                        globalBestResult = result;
                    }
                }
            }

            string c2AggregateProofPath = WriteC2FirstAggregateProofReport(profileName, c2ProofBlocks);
            AppendCentralProgressDetail("15-FIND BEST EDGE", "C2-FIRST aggregate proof: " + c2AggregateProofPath);

            completedNormally = true;
            btnCancelClose.Enabled = true;
            btnCancelClose.Text = "Close";
            progressBar.Value = progressBar.Maximum;

            if (globalBest != null && globalBestResult != null)
            {
                ApplySrSettingsToUi(globalBest.Settings);

                lblTitle.Text = "FIND BEST EDGE completed. Best settings applied to UI controls.";
                lblStatus.Text =
                    $"Best Profile Saved:\n{globalBestResult.BestConfigPath}\nTop Results CSV:\n{globalBestResult.ResultsCsvPath}";
                lblBest.Text =
                    $"Best Edge {globalBest.Metrics.EdgeR:0.###}R | PF {globalBest.Metrics.ProfitFactor:0.##} | " +
                    $"MFE/MAE {globalBest.Metrics.MfeMaeRatio:0.##} | Closed {globalBest.Metrics.ClosedTrades} | Pass {globalBest.Metrics.PassesTarget}";
            }
            else
            {
                lblTitle.Text = "FIND BEST EDGE completed, but no valid result was found.";
                lblStatus.Text = "Please select symbol/timeframe/date range with enough candle data.";
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            completedNormally = true;
            btnCancelClose.Enabled = true;
            btnCancelClose.Text = "Close";
            lblTitle.Text = "FIND BEST EDGE cancelled.";
            lblStatus.Text = "The run was cancelled by user.";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            completedNormally = true;
            btnCancelClose.Enabled = true;
            btnCancelClose.Text = "Close";
            lblTitle.Text = "FIND BEST EDGE error.";
            lblStatus.Text = ex.Message;
        }
        finally
        {
            Toggle(true);
        }
    }

    private static string FormatTimeSpan(TimeSpan value)
    {
        if (value.TotalHours >= 1)
            return value.ToString(@"hh\:mm\:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

        return value.ToString(@"mm\:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    }

    private List<string> GetCheckedCoinNamesOnly()
    {
        if (_coinNameList == null)
            return new List<string>();

        return _coinNameList.CheckedItems
            .OfType<string>()
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();
    }

    private List<string> GetCheckedTimeframesOnly()
    {
        if (_timeframeList == null)
            return new List<string>();

        return _timeframeList.CheckedItems
            .OfType<string>()
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();
    }

    private void ApplyStartupDefaults()
    {
        // 1) Default chart date range
        if (_dtpChartEndDate != null)
            _dtpChartEndDate.Value = DateTime.Today;

        ResolveOneYearValidationWindow(out _, out _);

        // 2) Strategy = none
        SetAllChecked(_strategyList, false);

        // 3) Coin categories = none
        SetAllChecked(_coinCategoryList, false);

        // Important:
        // RefreshCoinNames() after categories are unchecked.
        // Your current RefreshCoinNames() loads all active symbols when no category is selected.
        RefreshCoinNames();

        // 4) Timeframe = 1h only
        SetAllChecked(_timeframeList, false);
        SetCheckedItemByText(_timeframeList, "1h", true);

        // 5) Coin name = BTCUSDT only
        // Use BeginInvoke to ensure this runs after RefreshCoinNames completes on the UI thread
        BeginInvoke(new Action(() =>
        {
            SetAllChecked(_coinNameList, false);
            SetCheckedItemByText(_coinNameList, "BTCUSDT", true);
        }));
    }

    private static void SetCheckedItemByText(
        CheckedListBox? list,
        string targetText,
        bool isChecked)
    {
        if (list == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(targetText))
            return;

        for (int i = 0; i < list.Items.Count; i++)
        {
            string itemText = list.Items[i]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;

            if (itemText.Equals(targetText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                if (isChecked && LoadC1PerCoinProfileBlockedSymbols().Contains(itemText))
                    return;

                list.SetItemChecked(i, isChecked);
                return;
            }
        }
    }



    private void SyncTradeSizeFromMarginLeverage()
    {
        if (_syncingSrRiskControls)
            return;

        try
        {
            _syncingSrRiskControls = true;

            decimal margin = _numSrMargin?.Value ?? 0m;
            decimal leverage = _numSrLeverage?.Value ?? 0m;
            decimal tradeSize = margin > 0m && leverage > 0m
                ? margin * leverage
                : 0m;

            SetNumericValue(_numSrTradeSize, tradeSize);
        }
        finally
        {
            _syncingSrRiskControls = false;
        }
    }

    private SrTradeBacktestSettings GetSrTradeBacktestSettingsFromUi()
    {
        decimal leverage = _numSrLeverage?.Value ?? 10.0m;
        decimal margin = _numSrMargin?.Value ?? 0m;
        decimal tradeSize = margin > 0m && leverage > 0m
            ? margin * leverage
            : 0m;

        SetNumericValue(_numSrTradeSize, tradeSize);

        return new SrTradeBacktestSettings(
            EnableMO: _chkSrMO?.Checked ?? true,
            EnableLO: _chkSrLO?.Checked ?? true,
            EnableSO: _chkSrSO?.Checked ?? true,
            EnableLong: _chkSrLong?.Checked ?? true,
            EnableShort: _chkSrShort?.Checked ?? true,
            StopLossAtrMultiplier: _numSrSL?.Value ?? 0.35m,
            TargetR: _numSrTP?.Value ?? 2.0m,
            StartEquityUsdt: _numSrStartEquity?.Value ?? 100m,
            TradeSizeUsdt: tradeSize,
            Leverage: leverage,
            MarginUsdt: margin > 0m ? margin : 10m,
            EnableTrailingStopLoss: _chkSrTrailStop?.Checked ?? true,
            TrailStopAtrMultiplier: _numSrTrailAtr?.Value ?? 0.75m,
            TrailActivationR: _numSrTrailActivationR?.Value ?? 0.75m,
            EnableScoreRule: _chkRuleScore?.Checked ?? true,
            MinimumLoScore: _numRuleMinLOScore?.Value ?? 70m,
            MinimumSoScore: _numRuleMinSOScore?.Value ?? 70m,
            MinimumMoScore: _numRuleMinMOScore?.Value ?? 90m,
            EnableRsiRule: _chkRuleRsi?.Checked ?? true,
            RsiSupportMin: _numRuleRsiSupportMin?.Value ?? 30m,
            RsiSupportMax: _numRuleRsiSupportMax?.Value ?? 58m,
            RsiResistanceMin: _numRuleRsiResistanceMin?.Value ?? 42m,
            RsiResistanceMax: _numRuleRsiResistanceMax?.Value ?? 70m,
            RsiBreakoutLongMin: _numRuleRsiBoLongMin?.Value ?? 50m,
            RsiBreakoutLongMax: _numRuleRsiBoLongMax?.Value ?? 78m,
            RsiBreakdownShortMin: _numRuleRsiBdShortMin?.Value ?? 22m,
            RsiBreakdownShortMax: _numRuleRsiBdShortMax?.Value ?? 50m,
            EnableMacdRule: _chkRuleMacd?.Checked ?? true,
            EnableVolumeRule: _chkRuleVolume?.Checked ?? true,
            RetestVolumeMultiplier: _numRuleRetestVolume?.Value ?? 1.15m,
            BreakoutVolumeMultiplier: _numRuleBreakoutVolume?.Value ?? 1.15m,
            EnableCandleRule: _chkRuleCandle?.Checked ?? true,
            MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent: _numRuleBreakoutBodyPercent?.Value ?? 50m,
            MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent: _numRuleBreakoutWickPercent?.Value ?? 50m,
            MinimumRejectionWickPercent: _numRuleRejectionWickPercent?.Value ?? 25m,
            EnableDistanceRule: _chkRuleDistance?.Checked ?? true,
            MaxRetestDistanceAtr: _numRuleMaxRetestDistanceAtr?.Value ?? 0.15m,
            MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr: _numRuleMaxBreakoutDistanceAtr?.Value ?? 0.25m);
    }

    private void ApplySrSettingsToUi(SrTradeBacktestSettings settings)
    {
        if (_chkSrMO != null) _chkSrMO.Checked = settings.EnableMO;
        if (_chkSrLO != null) _chkSrLO.Checked = settings.EnableLO;
        if (_chkSrSO != null) _chkSrSO.Checked = settings.EnableSO;
        if (_chkSrLong != null) _chkSrLong.Checked = settings.EnableLong;
        if (_chkSrShort != null) _chkSrShort.Checked = settings.EnableShort;
        if (_chkSrTrailStop != null) _chkSrTrailStop.Checked = settings.EnableTrailingStopLoss;

        SetNumericValue(_numSrSL, settings.StopLossAtrMultiplier);
        SetNumericValue(_numSrTP, settings.TargetR);
        SetNumericValue(_numSrStartEquity, settings.StartEquityUsdt);

        decimal safeLeverage = settings.Leverage > 0m ? settings.Leverage : 1m;
        decimal safeMargin = settings.MarginUsdt > 0m
            ? settings.MarginUsdt
            : settings.TradeSizeUsdt > 0m ? settings.TradeSizeUsdt / safeLeverage : 0m;

        SetNumericValue(_numSrLeverage, safeLeverage);
        SetNumericValue(_numSrMargin, safeMargin);
        SetNumericValue(_numSrTradeSize, safeMargin * safeLeverage);

        SetNumericValue(_numSrTrailAtr, settings.TrailStopAtrMultiplier);
        SetNumericValue(_numSrTrailActivationR, settings.TrailActivationR);

        if (_chkRuleScore != null) _chkRuleScore.Checked = settings.EnableScoreRule;
        if (_chkRuleRsi != null) _chkRuleRsi.Checked = settings.EnableRsiRule;
        if (_chkRuleMacd != null) _chkRuleMacd.Checked = settings.EnableMacdRule;
        if (_chkRuleVolume != null) _chkRuleVolume.Checked = settings.EnableVolumeRule;
        if (_chkRuleCandle != null) _chkRuleCandle.Checked = settings.EnableCandleRule;
        if (_chkRuleDistance != null) _chkRuleDistance.Checked = settings.EnableDistanceRule;

        SetNumericValue(_numRuleMinLOScore, settings.MinimumLoScore);
        SetNumericValue(_numRuleMinSOScore, settings.MinimumSoScore);
        SetNumericValue(_numRuleMinMOScore, settings.MinimumMoScore);
        SetNumericValue(_numRuleRsiSupportMin, settings.RsiSupportMin);
        SetNumericValue(_numRuleRsiSupportMax, settings.RsiSupportMax);
        SetNumericValue(_numRuleRsiResistanceMin, settings.RsiResistanceMin);
        SetNumericValue(_numRuleRsiResistanceMax, settings.RsiResistanceMax);
        SetNumericValue(_numRuleRsiBoLongMin, settings.RsiBreakoutLongMin);
        SetNumericValue(_numRuleRsiBoLongMax, settings.RsiBreakoutLongMax);
        SetNumericValue(_numRuleRsiBdShortMin, settings.RsiBreakdownShortMin);
        SetNumericValue(_numRuleRsiBdShortMax, settings.RsiBreakdownShortMax);
        SetNumericValue(_numRuleRetestVolume, settings.RetestVolumeMultiplier);
        SetNumericValue(_numRuleBreakoutVolume, settings.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier);
        SetNumericValue(_numRuleBreakoutBodyPercent, settings.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent);
        SetNumericValue(_numRuleBreakoutWickPercent, settings.MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent);
        SetNumericValue(_numRuleRejectionWickPercent, settings.MinimumRejectionWickPercent);
        SetNumericValue(_numRuleMaxRetestDistanceAtr, settings.MaxRetestDistanceAtr);
        SetNumericValue(_numRuleMaxBreakoutDistanceAtr, settings.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr);
    }

    private static void SetNumericValue(NumericUpDown? control, decimal value)
    {
        if (control == null)
            return;

        if (value < control.Minimum)
            value = control.Minimum;

        if (value > control.Maximum)
            value = control.Maximum;

        control.Value = value;
    }

    private void SaveCurrentSrConfigProfile()
    {
        try
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(GetSrConfigProfileDirectory());

            string profileName = _txtSrConfigProfileName?.Text?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(profileName))
                profileName = "SR_CONFIG_PROFILE";

            string safeName = SanitizeFileName(profileName);
            string stamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            string path = Path.Combine(GetSrConfigProfileDirectory(), $"{safeName}_{stamp}.config.txt");

            SrTradeBacktestSettings settings = GetSrTradeBacktestSettingsFromUi();

            File.WriteAllText(path, BuildSrConfigProfileText(profileName, settings));
            MessageBox.Show($"SR config saved:\n{path}", "SR Config Profile", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(ex.Message, "Save SR Config Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
        }
    }

    private void LoadSrConfigProfileFromFile()
    {
        try
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(GetSrConfigProfileDirectory());

            using var dialog = new OpenFileDialog
            {
                Title = "Load SR Config Profile",
                InitialDirectory = GetSrConfigProfileDirectory(),
                Filter = "Config files (*.config.txt;*.txt)|*.config.txt;*.txt|All files (*.*)|*.*",
                CheckFileExists = true,
                Multiselect = false
            };

            if (dialog.ShowDialog(this) != DialogResult.OK)
                return;

            SrTradeBacktestSettings settings = LoadSrSettingsFromConfigFile(dialog.FileName);
            ApplySrSettingsToUi(settings);

            if (_txtSrConfigProfileName != null)
                _txtSrConfigProfileName.Text = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(dialog.FileName);

            MessageBox.Show($"SR config loaded:\n{dialog.FileName}", "SR Config Profile", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(ex.Message, "Load SR Config Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
        }
    }

    private void LoadLatestBestSrConfigProfile()
    {
        try
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(DataPaths.DataRoot, "Config"));

            string[] files = Directory
                .EnumerateFiles(Path.Combine(DataPaths.DataRoot, "Config"), "*.config.txt", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
                .Where(path =>
                {
                    string name = Path.GetFileName(path);
                    return name.Contains("BEST", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                           name.Contains("SR_CONFIG", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                           name.Contains("PROFILE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                })
                .OrderByDescending(File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc)
                .ToArray();

            if (files.Length == 0)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(
                    $"No config files found in:\n{Path.Combine(DataPaths.DataRoot, "Config")}",
                    "Load Last Best",
                    MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                    MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                return;
            }

            string latest = files[0];
            SrTradeBacktestSettings settings = LoadSrSettingsFromConfigFile(latest);
            ApplySrSettingsToUi(settings);

            if (_txtSrConfigProfileName != null)
                _txtSrConfigProfileName.Text = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(latest);

            MessageBox.Show($"Latest SR config loaded:\n{latest}", "Load Last Best", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(ex.Message, "Load Last Best Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
        }
    }

    private C1PerCoinConfigProfile? TryLoadC1PerCoinConfigProfile(string symbol, string timeframe, SrTradeBacktestSettings fallbackSettings)
    {
        EnsureC1ResearchFolders();

        string safeSymbol = SanitizeFileName(symbol.ToUpperInvariant());
        string safeTimeframe = SanitizeFileName(timeframe);

        string[] candidatePatterns =
        [
            $"C1_PROFILE__{safeSymbol}__{safeTimeframe}*.config.txt",
            $"C1_PROFILE__{safeSymbol}__*.config.txt",
            $"{safeSymbol}__{safeTimeframe}*.config.txt",
            $"{safeSymbol}_{safeTimeframe}*.config.txt"
        ];

        var files = new List<string>();
        foreach (string profileFolder in GetC1ProfileSearchDirectories())
        {
            if (!Directory.Exists(profileFolder))
                continue;

            foreach (string pattern in candidatePatterns)
            {
                files.AddRange(Directory.EnumerateFiles(profileFolder, pattern, SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly));
            }
        }

        string? selectedPath = files
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .OrderByDescending(File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc)
            .FirstOrDefault();

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(selectedPath))
            return null;

        Dictionary<string, string> values = ParseConfigKeyValues(File.ReadAllLines(selectedPath));
        string fileSymbol = ConfigString(values, "Symbol", symbol).Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
        string fileTimeframe = ConfigString(values, "Timeframe", timeframe).Trim();

        if (!fileSymbol.Equals(symbol, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return null;

        if (!fileTimeframe.Equals(timeframe, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return null;

        return new C1PerCoinConfigProfile
        {
            Symbol = symbol,
            Timeframe = timeframe,
            Path = selectedPath,
            ProfileStatus = ConfigString(values, "Profile Status", "READY"),
            FutureUpdateNote = ConfigString(values, "Future Update Note", "Saved per-coin C1 profile applied automatically."),
            Settings = LoadSrSettingsFromConfigFile(selectedPath, fallbackSettings),
            LossCooldownCandles = ConfigInt(values, "Loss Cooldown Candles", 0),
            AtrSpikeLimit = ConfigDecimal(values, "ATR Spike Limit", 0m)
        };
    }

    private static string GetC1PerCoinProfileDirectory()
    {
        return C1FinalProfileFolder;
    }

    private static string GetLegacyC1PerCoinProfileDirectory()
    {
        return C1LegacyPerCoinProfileFolder;

    private static IReadOnlyList<string> GetC1ProfileSearchDirectories()
    {
        var folders = new List<string>
        {
            GetC1PerCoinProfileDirectory(),
            GetLegacyC1PerCoinProfileDirectory()
        };

        return folders
            .Where(path => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();
    }

    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(C1ResearchRootFolder);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(C1ResearchMemoryFolder);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(C1EdgeProfileFolder);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(C1DdProfileFolder);

        Directory.CreateDirectory(C2BestProfileFolder);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(C2ValidationProfileFolder);

        Directory.CreateDirectory(GetLegacyC1PerCoinProfileDirectory());
    }


    private static bool TryLoadC2BestSeedProfile(
        string symbol,
        string timeframe,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings fallbackSettings,
        out SrTradeBacktestSettings? settings,
        out string? selectedPath)
    {
        C2SeedProbeResult probe = ProbeC2BestSeedProfile(symbol, timeframe, fallbackSettings);
        settings = probe.Settings;
        selectedPath = probe.SelectedPath;
        return probe.Loaded && settings != null;
    }

    private static C2SeedProbeResult ProbeC2BestSeedProfile(
        string symbol,
        string timeframe,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings fallbackSettings)
    {
        var probe = new C2SeedProbeResult
        {
            Symbol = symbol,
            Timeframe = timeframe,
            Message = "C2 seed not found - using current UI/default seed."
        };

        EnsureC1ResearchFolders();

        string safeSymbol = SanitizeFileName(symbol.ToUpperInvariant());
        string safeTimeframe = SanitizeFileName(timeframe);

        var candidateFolders = new List<string>
        {
            C2BestProfileFolder,
            C2ValidationProfileFolder,
            C1EdgeProfileFolder,
            GetSrConfigProfileDirectory(),
            Path.Combine(DataPaths.DataRoot, "Config"),
            DataPaths.Reports
        };

        foreach (string folder in candidateFolders.Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(folder))
                continue;

            probe.FoldersChecked.Add(folder);

            if (!Directory.Exists(folder))
            {
                probe.MissingFolders.Add(folder);
                continue;
            }

            probe.ExistingFolders.Add(folder);

            SearchOption option = folder.Equals(DataPaths.Reports, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                ? SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly
                : SearchOption.AllDirectories;

            try
            {
                foreach (string path in Directory.EnumerateFiles(folder, "*.config.txt", option))
                {
                    string name = Path.GetFileName(path);
                    bool symbolMatch = name.Contains(safeSymbol, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                    bool timeframeMatch = name.Contains(safeTimeframe, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                    bool profileMatch = name.Contains("C2", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                                        name.Contains("BEST", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                                        name.Contains("FIND_BEST_EDGE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                                        name.Contains("VALIDATED_PROFILE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

                    if (symbolMatch && timeframeMatch && profileMatch)
                        probe.CandidateFiles.Add(path);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                probe.FolderErrors.Add(folder + " => " + ex.Message);
            }
        }

        probe.CandidateFiles = probe.CandidateFiles
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .OrderByDescending(path => Path.GetFileName(path).Contains("C2", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .ThenByDescending(path => Path.GetFileName(path).Contains("BEST_VALIDATED_PROFILE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .ThenByDescending(File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc)
            .ToList();

        probe.SelectedPath = probe.CandidateFiles.FirstOrDefault();
        probe.SeedFound = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(probe.SelectedPath) && File.Exists(probe.SelectedPath);

        if (!probe.SeedFound)
        {
            probe.Message = "C2 seed not found - using current UI/default seed.";
            return probe;
        }

        try
        {
            probe.Settings = LoadSrSettingsFromConfigFile(probe.SelectedPath!, fallbackSettings);
            probe.Loaded = true;
            probe.Message = "C2 seed loaded and will be validated first.";
            return probe;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            probe.LoadError = ex.Message;
            probe.Loaded = false;
            probe.Settings = null;
            probe.Message = "C2 seed file found but load failed - using current UI/default seed.";
            return probe;
        }
    }

    private static void WriteC2SeedValidationLog(
        string symbol,
        string timeframe,
        string note,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings seedSettings,
        C2SeedProbeResult probe)
    {
        try
        {
            EnsureC1ResearchFolders();
            string path = Path.Combine(C2SeedLogFolder, $"C2_SEED__{SanitizeFileName(symbol)}__{SanitizeFileName(timeframe)}__{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.txt");
            var lines = new List<string>
            {
                "C2 FIRST SEED FOLDER VALIDATION LOG",
                "============================================================",
                $"Generated UTC        : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}",
                $"Symbol               : {symbol}",
                $"Timeframe            : {timeframe}",
                $"C2-FIRST MODE        : Enabled",
                $"Note                 : {note}",
                $"Seed Found           : {probe.SeedFound}",
                $"Seed Loaded          : {probe.Loaded}",
                $"Selected Seed File   : {(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(probe.SelectedPath) ? "N/A" : probe.SelectedPath)}",
                $"Candidate Files      : {probe.CandidateFiles.Count}",
                $"Folders Checked      : {probe.FoldersChecked.Count}",
                $"Existing Folders     : {probe.ExistingFolders.Count}",
                $"Missing Folders      : {probe.MissingFolders.Count}",
                $"Load Error           : {(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(probe.LoadError) ? "N/A" : probe.LoadError)}",
                string.Empty,
                "FOLDERS CHECKED",
                "------------------------------------------------------------"
            };

            lines.AddRange(probe.FoldersChecked.Select(folder => "CHECKED : " + folder));
            lines.Add(string.Empty);
            lines.Add("EXISTING FOLDERS");
            lines.Add("------------------------------------------------------------");
            lines.AddRange(probe.ExistingFolders.Count == 0 ? new[] { "None" } : probe.ExistingFolders.Select(folder => "EXISTS  : " + folder));
            lines.Add(string.Empty);
            lines.Add("MISSING FOLDERS");
            lines.Add("------------------------------------------------------------");
            lines.AddRange(probe.MissingFolders.Count == 0 ? new[] { "None" } : probe.MissingFolders.Select(folder => "MISSING : " + folder));
            lines.Add(string.Empty);
            lines.Add("CANDIDATE FILES");
            lines.Add("------------------------------------------------------------");
            lines.AddRange(probe.CandidateFiles.Count == 0 ? new[] { "None" } : probe.CandidateFiles.Take(50).Select(file => "CANDIDATE : " + file));
            lines.Add(string.Empty);
            lines.Add("FOLDER ERRORS");
            lines.Add("------------------------------------------------------------");
            lines.AddRange(probe.FolderErrors.Count == 0 ? new[] { "None" } : probe.FolderErrors.Select(error => "ERROR : " + error));
            lines.Add(string.Empty);
            lines.Add("SEED SETTINGS USED BY BUTTON 15");
            lines.Add("------------------------------------------------------------");
            lines.Add(BuildSrConfigProfileText("C2_FIRST_SEED", seedSettings));

            File.WriteAllLines(path, lines, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        }
        catch
        {
            // Seed logging must not stop research.
        }
    }

    private static string WriteC2FirstReportProof(
        string symbol,
        string timeframe,
        C2SeedProbeResult probe,
        FindBestEdgeResult result,
        out string proofBlock)
    {
        EnsureC1ResearchFolders();
        string proofPath = Path.Combine(C2SeedLogFolder, $"C2_FIRST_PROOF__{SanitizeFileName(symbol)}__{SanitizeFileName(timeframe)}__{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.txt");

        proofBlock = BuildC2FirstProofBlock(symbol, timeframe, probe, result, proofPath);
        File.WriteAllText(proofPath, proofBlock, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(C2SeedLogFolder, C2LatestProofFileName), proofBlock, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        return proofPath;
    }

    private static string WriteC2FirstAggregateProofReport(string profileName, IReadOnlyList<string> proofBlocks)
    {
        EnsureC1ResearchFolders();
        string stamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string path = Path.Combine(C2SeedLogFolder, $"C2_FIRST_AGGREGATE_PROOF__{SanitizeFileName(profileName)}__{stamp}.txt");

        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("C2-FIRST AGGREGATE REPORT PROOF");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated UTC        : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Profile Name         : {profileName}");
        sb.AppendLine($"C2-FIRST MODE        : Enabled");
        sb.AppendLine($"Proof Blocks         : {proofBlocks.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"C2 Best Folder       : {C2BestProfileFolder}");
        sb.AppendLine($"C2 Validation Folder : {C2ValidationProfileFolder}");
        sb.AppendLine($"C2 Seed Log Folder   : {C2SeedLogFolder}");
        sb.AppendLine();

        foreach (string block in proofBlocks)
        {
            sb.AppendLine(block.TrimEnd());
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine("############################################################");
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        string text = sb.ToString();
        File.WriteAllText(path, text, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(C2SeedLogFolder, C2LatestProofFileName), text, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
        return path;
    }

    private static string BuildC2FirstProofBlock(
        string symbol,
        string timeframe,
        C2SeedProbeResult probe,
        FindBestEdgeResult result,
        string proofPath)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("C2-FIRST REPORT PROOF + FOLDER VALIDATION");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated UTC        : {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Symbol               : {symbol}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Timeframe            : {timeframe}");
        sb.AppendLine($"C2-FIRST MODE        : Enabled");
        sb.AppendLine($"Proof File           : {proofPath}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("C2 FOLDER VALIDATION");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Folders Checked      : {probe.FoldersChecked.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Existing Folders     : {probe.ExistingFolders.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Missing Folders      : {probe.MissingFolders.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Candidate Files      : {probe.CandidateFiles.Count}");
        sb.AppendLine($"C2 Seed Found        : {probe.SeedFound}");
        sb.AppendLine($"C2 Seed Loaded       : {probe.Loaded}");
        sb.AppendLine($"C2 Seed Profile File : {(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(probe.SelectedPath) ? "N/A" : probe.SelectedPath)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Load Error           : {(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(probe.LoadError) ? "N/A" : probe.LoadError)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Message              : {probe.Message}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("FOLDERS CHECKED");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        foreach (string folder in probe.FoldersChecked)
            sb.AppendLine(folder);
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("CANDIDATE FILES");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        if (probe.CandidateFiles.Count == 0)
            sb.AppendLine("None");
        else
            foreach (string file in probe.CandidateFiles.Take(50))
                sb.AppendLine(file);
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("C2 SEED FULL-HISTORY RESULT");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        AppendFindBestCandidateProof(sb, result.SeedFullHistoryResult, "Seed");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("FINAL BEST RESULT");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Final Profile Source : {result.FinalProfileSource}");
        AppendFindBestCandidateProof(sb, result.Best, "Best");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("OUTPUT FILES");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Best Config          : {result.BestConfigPath}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Top Results CSV      : {result.ResultsCsvPath}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Summary TXT          : {result.SummaryPath}");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static void AppendFindBestCandidateProof(StringBuilder sb, FindBestEdgeCandidateResult? candidate, string label)
    {
        if (candidate == null)
        {
            sb.AppendLine($"{label} Result          : N/A");
            return;
        }

        FindBestEdgeMetrics m = candidate.Metrics;
        sb.AppendLine($"{label} Try Number      : {candidate.TryNumber}");
        sb.AppendLine($"{label} Date Range      : {candidate.StartUtc:yyyy-MM-dd} to {candidate.EndUtcExclusive.AddDays(-1):yyyy-MM-dd}");
        sb.AppendLine($"{label} Daily %         : {CalculateDailyProfitPercent(candidate.StartUtc, candidate.EndUtcExclusive, m.NetProfitPercent):0.0000}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"{label} Profit %        : {m.NetProfitPercent:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"{label} Closed Trades   : {m.ClosedTrades}");
        sb.AppendLine($"{label} Win Rate        : {m.WinRate:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"{label} Edge            : {m.EdgeR:0.####}R");
        sb.AppendLine($"{label} PF              : {m.ProfitFactor:0.####}");
        sb.AppendLine($"{label} DD              : {m.MaxDrawdownPercent:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"{label} MFE/MAE         : {m.MfeMaeRatio:0.####}");
        sb.AppendLine($"{label} High MAE %      : {m.HighMaePercent:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"{label} Weak Entry %    : {m.WeakEntryPercent:0.00}%");
        sb.AppendLine($"{label} Pass Target     : {m.PassesTarget}");
    }

    private SrTradeBacktestSettings LoadSrSettingsFromConfigFile(string path)
    {
        return LoadSrSettingsFromConfigFile(path, GetSrTradeBacktestSettingsFromUi());
    }

    private static SrTradeBacktestSettings LoadSrSettingsFromConfigFile(string path, SrTradeBacktestSettings current)
    {
        Dictionary<string, string> values = ParseConfigKeyValues(File.ReadAllLines(path));

        decimal leverage = ConfigDecimal(values, "Leverage", current.Leverage);
        decimal margin = ConfigDecimal(values, "Margin USDT", current.MarginUsdt);
        decimal tradeSize = ConfigDecimal(values, "Trade Size USDT", current.TradeSizeUsdt);

        if (margin > 0m && leverage > 0m)
            tradeSize = margin * leverage;
        else if (margin <= 0m && tradeSize > 0m && leverage > 0m)
            margin = tradeSize / leverage;

        return new SrTradeBacktestSettings(
            EnableMO: ConfigBool(values, "MO", current.EnableMO),
            EnableLO: ConfigBool(values, "LO", current.EnableLO),
            EnableSO: ConfigBool(values, "SO", current.EnableSO),
            EnableLong: ConfigBool(values, "Long", current.EnableLong),
            EnableShort: ConfigBool(values, "Short", current.EnableShort),
            StopLossAtrMultiplier: ConfigDecimal(values, "SL ATR", current.StopLossAtrMultiplier),
            TargetR: ConfigDecimal(values, "TP R", current.TargetR),
            StartEquityUsdt: ConfigDecimal(values, "Start Equity USDT", current.StartEquityUsdt),
            TradeSizeUsdt: tradeSize,
            Leverage: leverage,
            MarginUsdt: margin > 0m ? margin : 10m,
            EnableTrailingStopLoss: ConfigBool(values, "Trail", current.EnableTrailingStopLoss),
            TrailStopAtrMultiplier: ConfigDecimal(values, "Trail ATR", current.TrailStopAtrMultiplier),
            TrailActivationR: ConfigDecimal(values, "Trail Activation R", current.TrailActivationR),
            EnableScoreRule: ConfigBool(values, "Enable Score Rule", current.EnableScoreRule),
            MinimumLoScore: ConfigDecimal(values, "LO Min Score", current.MinimumLoScore),
            MinimumSoScore: ConfigDecimal(values, "SO Min Score", current.MinimumSoScore),
            MinimumMoScore: ConfigDecimal(values, "MO Min Score", current.MinimumMoScore),
            EnableRsiRule: ConfigBool(values, "Enable RSI Rule", current.EnableRsiRule),
            RsiSupportMin: ConfigDecimal(values, "RSI Support Min", current.RsiSupportMin),
            RsiSupportMax: ConfigDecimal(values, "RSI Support Max", current.RsiSupportMax),
            RsiResistanceMin: ConfigDecimal(values, "RSI Resistance Min", current.RsiResistanceMin),
            RsiResistanceMax: ConfigDecimal(values, "RSI Resistance Max", current.RsiResistanceMax),
            RsiBreakoutLongMin: ConfigDecimal(values, "RSI Breakout Long Min", current.RsiBreakoutLongMin),
            RsiBreakoutLongMax: ConfigDecimal(values, "RSI Breakout Long Max", current.RsiBreakoutLongMax),
            RsiBreakdownShortMin: ConfigDecimal(values, "RSI Breakdown Short Min", current.RsiBreakdownShortMin),
            RsiBreakdownShortMax: ConfigDecimal(values, "RSI Breakdown Short Max", current.RsiBreakdownShortMax),
            EnableMacdRule: ConfigBool(values, "Enable MACD Rule", current.EnableMacdRule),
            EnableVolumeRule: ConfigBool(values, "Enable Volume Rule", current.EnableVolumeRule),
            RetestVolumeMultiplier: ConfigDecimal(values, "Retest Volume x SMA20", current.RetestVolumeMultiplier),
            BreakoutVolumeMultiplier: ConfigDecimal(values, "Breakout Volume x SMA20", current.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier),
            EnableCandleRule: ConfigBool(values, "Enable Candle Rule", current.EnableCandleRule),
            MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent: ConfigDecimal(values, "Breakout Body %", current.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent),
            MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent: ConfigDecimal(values, "Max Breakout Wick %", current.MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent),
            MinimumRejectionWickPercent: ConfigDecimal(values, "Rejection Wick %", current.MinimumRejectionWickPercent),
            EnableDistanceRule: ConfigBool(values, "Enable Distance Rule", current.EnableDistanceRule),
            MaxRetestDistanceAtr: ConfigDecimal(values, "Retest Distance ATR", current.MaxRetestDistanceAtr),
            MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr: ConfigDecimal(values, "Breakout Distance ATR", current.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr));
    }

    private static Dictionary<string, string> ParseConfigKeyValues(IEnumerable<string> lines)
    {
        var values = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        foreach (string rawLine in lines)
        {
            string line = rawLine.Trim();

            if (line.Length == 0 || line.StartsWith("#", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                continue;

            int index = line.IndexOf(':');
            if (index <= 0)
                continue;

            string key = NormalizeConfigKey(line[..index]);
            string value = line[(index + 1)..].Trim();

            if (!values.ContainsKey(key))
                values.Add(key, value);
        }

        return values;
    }

    private static bool ConfigBool(Dictionary<string, string> values, string key, bool fallback)
    {
        if (!values.TryGetValue(NormalizeConfigKey(key), out string? raw))
            return fallback;

        raw = raw.Trim();

        if (bool.TryParse(raw, out bool parsed))
            return parsed;

        if (raw.Equals("1", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            raw.Equals("YES", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            raw.Equals("ON", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            raw.Equals("TRUE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return true;

        if (raw.Equals("0", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            raw.Equals("NO", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            raw.Equals("OFF", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            raw.Equals("FALSE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return false;

        return fallback;
    }

    private static string ConfigString(Dictionary<string, string> values, string key, string fallback)
    {
        return values.TryGetValue(NormalizeConfigKey(key), out string? raw)
            ? raw.Trim()
            : fallback;
    }

    private static int ConfigInt(Dictionary<string, string> values, string key, int fallback)
    {
        string normalized = NormalizeConfigKey(key);
        if (!values.TryGetValue(normalized, out string? value))
            return fallback;

        return int.TryParse(value.Replace("x", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase).Trim(), NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out int parsed)
            ? parsed
            : fallback;
    }

    private static decimal ConfigDecimal(Dictionary<string, string> values, string key, decimal fallback)
    {
        if (!values.TryGetValue(NormalizeConfigKey(key), out string? raw))
            return fallback;

        raw = raw
            .Replace("USDT", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Replace("R", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Replace("x", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Replace("%", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Trim();

        return decimal.TryParse(raw, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out decimal parsed)
            ? parsed
            : fallback;
    }

    private static string NormalizeConfigKey(string key)
    {
        return new string(key
            .Where(char.IsLetterOrDigit)
            .Select(char.ToUpperInvariant)

    private static string SanitizeFileName(string value)

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;

namespace TQGA.WinForms;

internal sealed class SrCandleAuditService
{
    private static readonly string[] ScannerTimeframes = ["1h"];

    public SrCandleAuditSnapshot BuildSnapshot(IReadOnlyList<string> currentUniverseSymbols)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(currentUniverseSymbols);

        var symbols = currentUniverseSymbols
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
            .Select(x => x.Trim().ToUpperInvariant())
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        var notes = new List<string>();
        string candleFolder = DataPaths.Candles;
        string reportFolder = DataPaths.Reports;

        var snapshot = new SrCandleAuditSnapshot
        {
            GeneratedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,
            CandleFolder = candleFolder,
            CurrentUniverseSymbols = symbols.Count,
            ExpectedCurrentUniverseFiles = symbols.Count * ScannerTimeframes.Length
        };

        try
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(candleFolder);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(reportFolder);

            FileInfo? latestReport = FindLatestButton18AuditReport(reportFolder);
            if (latestReport != null)
            {
                snapshot.LatestButton18ReportPath = latestReport.FullName;
                snapshot.LatestButton18ReportModifiedUtc = latestReport.LastWriteTimeUtc;
                ParseLatestButton18Report(latestReport.FullName, snapshot);
            }
            else
            {
                notes.Add("No V8.10.3Q Button 18 1h all-futures candle audit report was found in Reports folder yet.");
            }

            var expected = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            foreach (string symbol in symbols)
            {
                foreach (string tf in ScannerTimeframes)
                    expected.Add($"{symbol}_{tf}.csv");
            }

            var tfFiles = Directory.EnumerateFiles(candleFolder, "*.csv", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly)
                .Select(Path.GetFileName)
                .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
                .Cast<string>()
                .Where(IsOneHourCandleFile)
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();

            snapshot.TotalCsvFilesInFolder = Directory.EnumerateFiles(candleFolder, "*.csv", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly).Count();
            snapshot.OneHourFourHourOneDayCsvFilesInFolder = tfFiles.Count;

            var fileSet = new HashSet<string>(tfFiles, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            var missing = expected.Where(x => !fileSet.Contains(x)).OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToList();
            var orphan = tfFiles.Where(x => !expected.Contains(x)).OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToList();

            snapshot.CurrentUniverseFilesFound = expected.Count - missing.Count;
            snapshot.CurrentUniverseFilesMissing = missing.Count;
            snapshot.OrphanOldOneHourFourHourOneDayFiles = orphan.Count;
            snapshot.MissingCurrentUniverseFiles = missing;
            snapshot.OrphanOldFiles = orphan;

            if (snapshot.LatestButton18CheckMarkets > 0)
                notes.Add($"Latest Button 18 audit shows CHECK markets = {snapshot.LatestButton18CheckMarkets}.");

            if (snapshot.LatestButton18BinanceUsdtFutures > 0 && snapshot.LatestButton18BinanceUsdtFutures != symbols.Count)
            {
                notes.Add($"Latest Button 18 futures count ({snapshot.LatestButton18BinanceUsdtFutures}) differs from current scanner-resolved universe count ({symbols.Count}). Re-run Button 18 before scanner if Binance universe changed.");
            }

            if (missing.Count == 0 && snapshot.CurrentUniverseFilesFound == snapshot.ExpectedCurrentUniverseFiles)
            {
                snapshot.CompatibleWithScanner = true;
                snapshot.CompatibilityStatus = "PASS";
            }
            else
            {
                snapshot.CompatibleWithScanner = false;
                snapshot.CompatibilityStatus = "CHECK_MISSING_CURRENT_UNIVERSE_FILES";
            }

            if (orphan.Count > 0)
                notes.Add($"Orphan/old 1h candle files found = {orphan.Count}. These are not scanner-blocking because they are outside the current Binance USDT futures universe.");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            snapshot.CompatibleWithScanner = false;
            snapshot.CompatibilityStatus = "CHECK_AUDIT_EXCEPTION";
            notes.Add(ex.GetType().Name + ": " + ex.Message);
        }

        snapshot.Notes = notes;
        return snapshot;
    }

    private static FileInfo? FindLatestButton18AuditReport(string reportFolder)
    {
        var dir = new DirectoryInfo(reportFolder);
        if (!dir.Exists)
            return null;

        var oneHour = dir.GetFiles("BINANCE_ALL_USDT_FUTURES_CANDLE_UPDATE_1H_AUDIT_*.txt")
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.LastWriteTimeUtc)
            .FirstOrDefault();

        if (oneHour != null)
            return oneHour;

        return dir.GetFiles("BINANCE_ALL_USDT_FUTURES_CANDLE_UPDATE_3TF_AUDIT_*.txt")
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.LastWriteTimeUtc)
            .FirstOrDefault();
    }

    private static void ParseLatestButton18Report(string path, SrCandleAuditSnapshot snapshot)
    {
        foreach (string raw in File.ReadLines(path).Take(80))
        {
            string line = raw.TrimEnd();
            if (line.Length == 0)
                continue;

            int idx = line.IndexOf(':');
            if (idx < 0)
                continue;

            string key = line[..idx].Trim();
            string value = line[(idx + 1)..].Trim();

            switch (key.ToUpperInvariant())
            {
                case "RESULT":
                    snapshot.LatestButton18Result = value;
                    break;
                case "MESSAGE":
                    snapshot.LatestButton18Message = value;
                    break;
                case "UPDATE MODE":
                    snapshot.LatestButton18UpdateMode = value;
                    break;
                case "BINANCE USDT FUTURES":
                    snapshot.LatestButton18BinanceUsdtFutures = ParseInt(value);
                    break;
                case "MARKETS REQUESTED":
                    snapshot.LatestButton18MarketsRequested = ParseInt(value);
                    break;
                case "MARKETS PROCESSED":
                    snapshot.LatestButton18MarketsProcessed = ParseInt(value);
                    break;
                case "FRESH / PASSED MARKETS":
                    snapshot.LatestButton18FreshPassedMarkets = ParseInt(value);
                    break;
                case "CHECK MARKETS":
                    snapshot.LatestButton18CheckMarkets = ParseInt(value);
                    break;
                case "DOWNLOADED CANDLES":
                    snapshot.LatestButton18DownloadedCandles = ParseInt(value);
                    break;
                case "UPDATED FILE MARKETS":
                    snapshot.LatestButton18UpdatedFileMarkets = ParseInt(value);
                    break;
                case "FRESH NO REWRITE":
                    snapshot.LatestButton18FreshNoRewrite = ParseInt(value);
                    break;
            }
        }
    }

    private static int ParseInt(string value)
    {
        string digits = new string(value.Where(char.IsDigit).ToArray());
        return int.TryParse(digits, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out int parsed)
            ? parsed
            : 0;
    }

    private static bool IsOneHourCandleFile(string fileName)
    {
        return fileName.EndsWith("_1h.csv", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }
}

using System;

using System.Globalization;
