using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;
using TQGA.Domain.Market;
using TQGA.Infrastructure.MarketData;

namespace TQGA.WinForms;

internal sealed class SrCandleFreshnessUpdateResult
{
    public bool Success { get; set; }
    public string Status { get; set; } = "UNKNOWN";
    public string Message { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public DateTime GeneratedUtc { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public DateTime CurrentUtc { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public string Symbol { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Timeframe { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public int TimeframeMinutes { get; set; }
    public int MaxAllowedLagCandles { get; set; } = 2;
    public string CandleFilePath { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string BinanceKlineEndpoint { get; set; } = "https://fapi.binance.com/fapi/v1/klines";
    public bool FileExistedBefore { get; set; }
    public bool UpdateAttempted { get; set; }
    public int DownloadBatches { get; set; }
    public int DownloadedCandles { get; set; }
    public int LocalCandlesBefore { get; set; }
    public int LocalCandlesAfter { get; set; }
    public DateTime? FirstLocalBeforeUtc { get; set; }
    public DateTime? LatestLocalBeforeUtc { get; set; }
    public DateTime? FirstLocalAfterUtc { get; set; }
    public DateTime? LatestLocalAfterUtc { get; set; }
    public DateTime CurrentOpenCandleUtc { get; set; }
    public DateTime ExpectedLatestClosedCandleUtc { get; set; }
    public int LagCandlesBefore { get; set; }
    public int LagCandlesAfter { get; set; }
    public IReadOnlyList<string> Warnings { get; set; } = Array.Empty<string>();
}

internal sealed class SrCandleFreshnessUpdater
{
    private const int MaxAllowedLagCandles = 2;
    private static readonly HttpClient Http = new()
    {
        BaseAddress = new Uri("https://fapi.binance.com"),
        Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(75)
    };

    public async Task<SrCandleFreshnessUpdateResult> UpdateAndVerifyAsync(
        string symbol,
        string timeframe,
        int requestedLookbackCandleCount,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        symbol = NormalizeSymbol(symbol);
        timeframe = NormalizeTimeframe(timeframe);
        int tfMinutes = ResolveTimeframeMinutes(timeframe);
        DateTime currentUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        DateTime currentOpenUtc = FloorToTimeframe(currentUtc, tfMinutes);
        DateTime expectedLatestClosedUtc = currentOpenUtc.AddMinutes(-tfMinutes);

        var warnings = new List<string>();
        string candlePath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Candles, $"{symbol}_{timeframe}.csv");

        var result = new SrCandleFreshnessUpdateResult
        {
            GeneratedUtc = currentUtc,
            CurrentUtc = currentUtc,
            Symbol = symbol,
            Timeframe = timeframe,
            TimeframeMinutes = tfMinutes,
            MaxAllowedLagCandles = MaxAllowedLagCandles,
            CandleFilePath = candlePath,
            CurrentOpenCandleUtc = currentOpenUtc,
            ExpectedLatestClosedCandleUtc = expectedLatestClosedUtc,
            FileExistedBefore = File.Exists(candlePath),
            Warnings = warnings
        };

        try
        {
            List<Candle> localBefore = LoadLocalCandles(symbol, timeframe, warnings);
            result.LocalCandlesBefore = localBefore.Count;
            result.FirstLocalBeforeUtc = localBefore.Count == 0 ? null : localBefore.Min(x => EnsureUtc(x.Time));
            result.LatestLocalBeforeUtc = localBefore.Count == 0 ? null : localBefore.Max(x => EnsureUtc(x.Time));
            result.LagCandlesBefore = CalculateLagCandles(result.LatestLocalBeforeUtc, expectedLatestClosedUtc, tfMinutes);

            int minRequiredCandles = Math.Max(requestedLookbackCandleCount, 1200);
            bool needsHistoryBootstrap = result.LocalCandlesBefore > 0 && result.LocalCandlesBefore < minRequiredCandles;
            bool needsUpdate = result.LatestLocalBeforeUtc == null || result.LagCandlesBefore > 0 || needsHistoryBootstrap;
            result.UpdateAttempted = needsUpdate;

            var downloaded = new List<Candle>();
            if (needsUpdate)
            {
                DateTime startUtc = needsHistoryBootstrap || result.LatestLocalBeforeUtc == null
                    ? ResolveBootstrapStartUtc(expectedLatestClosedUtc, tfMinutes, requestedLookbackCandleCount)
                    : ResolveDownloadStartUtc(
                        result.LatestLocalBeforeUtc,
                        expectedLatestClosedUtc,
                        tfMinutes,
                        requestedLookbackCandleCount);

                if (startUtc <= expectedLatestClosedUtc)
                {
                    downloaded = await DownloadClosedFuturesKlinesAsync(
                        symbol,
                        timeframe,
                        startUtc,
                        currentOpenUtc,
                        ct,
                        batchCount => result.DownloadBatches = batchCount);

                    result.DownloadedCandles = downloaded.Count;

                    List<Candle> merged = MergeAndTrim(localBefore, downloaded, currentOpenUtc);
                    WriteCandles(symbol, timeframe, merged);
                }
            }

            List<Candle> localAfter = LoadLocalCandles(symbol, timeframe, warnings);
            result.LocalCandlesAfter = localAfter.Count;
            result.FirstLocalAfterUtc = localAfter.Count == 0 ? null : localAfter.Min(x => EnsureUtc(x.Time));
            result.LatestLocalAfterUtc = localAfter.Count == 0 ? null : localAfter.Max(x => EnsureUtc(x.Time));
            result.LagCandlesAfter = CalculateLagCandles(result.LatestLocalAfterUtc, expectedLatestClosedUtc, tfMinutes);

            if (result.LocalCandlesAfter > 0 && result.LocalCandlesAfter < minRequiredCandles)
                warnings.Add($"HISTORY_DEPTH_NOTE: local candles={result.LocalCandlesAfter}, requested lookback={minRequiredCandles}. This can be normal for newly listed Binance futures symbols.");

            result.Success = result.LatestLocalAfterUtc.HasValue && result.LagCandlesAfter <= MaxAllowedLagCandles;
            result.Status = result.Success
                ? (result.DownloadedCandles > 0
                    ? (needsHistoryBootstrap ? "FRESH_AFTER_FULL_HISTORY_BOOTSTRAP_REWRITE" : "FRESH_AFTER_BINANCE_KLINE_UPDATE")
                    : "FRESH_NO_UPDATE_NEEDED")
                : "STALE_AFTER_BINANCE_KLINE_UPDATE";

            result.Message = result.Success
                ? $"Candle freshness PASS. Latest local closed candle lag={result.LagCandlesAfter} candle(s)."
                : $"Candle freshness CHECK. Latest local closed candle lag={result.LagCandlesAfter} candle(s), allowed={MaxAllowedLagCandles}.";

            result.Warnings = warnings;
            return result;
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            throw;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            warnings.Add($"Candle freshness/update exception: {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
            result.Success = false;
            result.Status = "CANDLE_UPDATE_FAILED";
            result.Message = "SR SHADOW CHECK - Binance futures kline update/freshness check failed. NO ORDER SENT.";
            result.Warnings = warnings;
            return result;
        }
    }



    // V8.10.3R: true incremental fast delta path for Button 18 1h-only watch.
    // It reads only lightweight candle metadata first. If already fresh, it avoids full CSV parsing.
    // If stale, it downloads only missing closed klines and appends them instead of rewriting the whole file.
    public async Task<SrCandleFreshnessUpdateResult> UpdateAndVerifyFastIncrementalAsync(
        string symbol,
        string timeframe,
        int requestedLookbackCandleCount,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        symbol = NormalizeSymbol(symbol);
        timeframe = NormalizeTimeframe(timeframe);
        int tfMinutes = ResolveTimeframeMinutes(timeframe);
        DateTime currentUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        DateTime currentOpenUtc = FloorToTimeframe(currentUtc, tfMinutes);
        DateTime expectedLatestClosedUtc = currentOpenUtc.AddMinutes(-tfMinutes);

        var warnings = new List<string>();
        string candlePath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Candles, $"{symbol}_{timeframe}.csv");

        var result = new SrCandleFreshnessUpdateResult
        {
            GeneratedUtc = currentUtc,
            CurrentUtc = currentUtc,
            Symbol = symbol,
            Timeframe = timeframe,
            TimeframeMinutes = tfMinutes,
            MaxAllowedLagCandles = MaxAllowedLagCandles,
            CandleFilePath = candlePath,
            CurrentOpenCandleUtc = currentOpenUtc,
            ExpectedLatestClosedCandleUtc = expectedLatestClosedUtc,
            FileExistedBefore = File.Exists(candlePath),
            Warnings = warnings
        };

        try
        {
            var beforeMeta = ReadLocalCandleMetaFast(candlePath, warnings);
            result.LocalCandlesBefore = beforeMeta.Count;
            result.FirstLocalBeforeUtc = beforeMeta.FirstUtc;
            result.LatestLocalBeforeUtc = beforeMeta.LatestUtc;
            result.LagCandlesBefore = CalculateLagCandles(result.LatestLocalBeforeUtc, expectedLatestClosedUtc, tfMinutes);

            int minRequiredCandles = Math.Max(requestedLookbackCandleCount, 1200);
            bool needsHistoryBootstrap = result.LocalCandlesBefore > 0 && result.LocalCandlesBefore < minRequiredCandles;
            bool needsUpdate = result.LatestLocalBeforeUtc == null || result.LagCandlesBefore > 0 || needsHistoryBootstrap;
            result.UpdateAttempted = needsUpdate;

            if (!needsUpdate)
            {
                result.LocalCandlesAfter = result.LocalCandlesBefore;
                result.FirstLocalAfterUtc = result.FirstLocalBeforeUtc;
                result.LatestLocalAfterUtc = result.LatestLocalBeforeUtc;
                result.LagCandlesAfter = result.LagCandlesBefore;
                result.Success = result.LatestLocalAfterUtc.HasValue && result.LagCandlesAfter <= MaxAllowedLagCandles;
                result.Status = "FRESH_NO_UPDATE_NEEDED_FAST_META";
                result.Message = $"Candle freshness PASS. Fast metadata check: latest local closed candle lag={result.LagCandlesAfter} candle(s).";
                result.Warnings = warnings;
                return result;
            }

            DateTime startUtc = needsHistoryBootstrap || result.LatestLocalBeforeUtc == null
                ? ResolveBootstrapStartUtc(expectedLatestClosedUtc, tfMinutes, requestedLookbackCandleCount)
                : ResolveDownloadStartUtc(
                    result.LatestLocalBeforeUtc,
                    expectedLatestClosedUtc,
                    tfMinutes,
                    requestedLookbackCandleCount);

            if (startUtc <= expectedLatestClosedUtc)
            {
                List<Candle> downloaded = await DownloadClosedFuturesKlinesAsync(
                    symbol,
                    timeframe,
                    startUtc,
                    currentOpenUtc,
                    ct,
                    batchCount => result.DownloadBatches = batchCount);

                result.DownloadedCandles = downloaded.Count;

                if (downloaded.Count > 0)
                {
                    if (needsHistoryBootstrap || !result.FileExistedBefore || !result.LatestLocalBeforeUtc.HasValue)
                    {
                        // Full-depth/bootstrap path: rewrite the CSV from Binance history plus any local overlap.
                        // This fixes shallow 15m files that were fresh but only had ~3,100 candles.
                        List<Candle> existing = result.FileExistedBefore
                            ? LoadLocalCandles(symbol, timeframe, warnings)
                            : new List<Candle>();

                        List<Candle> merged = MergeAndTrim(existing, downloaded, currentOpenUtc);
                        WriteCandles(symbol, timeframe, merged);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        AppendCandlesFast(symbol, timeframe, downloaded, currentOpenUtc);
                    }
                }
            }

            var afterMeta = ReadLocalCandleMetaFast(candlePath, warnings);
            result.LocalCandlesAfter = afterMeta.Count;
            result.FirstLocalAfterUtc = afterMeta.FirstUtc;
            result.LatestLocalAfterUtc = afterMeta.LatestUtc;
            result.LagCandlesAfter = CalculateLagCandles(result.LatestLocalAfterUtc, expectedLatestClosedUtc, tfMinutes);

            if (result.LocalCandlesAfter > 0 && result.LocalCandlesAfter < minRequiredCandles)
                warnings.Add($"HISTORY_DEPTH_NOTE: local candles={result.LocalCandlesAfter}, requested lookback={minRequiredCandles}. This can be normal for newly listed Binance futures symbols.");

            result.Success = result.LatestLocalAfterUtc.HasValue && result.LagCandlesAfter <= MaxAllowedLagCandles;
            result.Status = result.Success
                ? (result.DownloadedCandles > 0
                    ? (needsHistoryBootstrap ? "FRESH_AFTER_FULL_HISTORY_BOOTSTRAP_REWRITE" : "FRESH_AFTER_TRUE_INCREMENTAL_APPEND")
                    : "FRESH_NO_UPDATE_NEEDED_FAST_META")
                : "STALE_AFTER_TRUE_INCREMENTAL_UPDATE";

            result.Message = result.Success
                ? $"Candle freshness PASS. True incremental latest local closed candle lag={result.LagCandlesAfter} candle(s)."
                : $"Candle freshness CHECK. True incremental latest local closed candle lag={result.LagCandlesAfter} candle(s), allowed={MaxAllowedLagCandles}.";

            result.Warnings = warnings;
            return result;
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            throw;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            warnings.Add($"Fast incremental candle update exception: {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");

            // Safety fallback: use the older full-parse merge path if the fast path fails.
            try
            {
                warnings.Add("FAST_INCREMENTAL_FALLBACK: falling back to standard update/verify path for this symbol.");
                SrCandleFreshnessUpdateResult fallback = await UpdateAndVerifyAsync(symbol, timeframe, requestedLookbackCandleCount, ct);
                fallback.Warnings = warnings.Concat(fallback.Warnings ?? Array.Empty<string>()).ToList();
                return fallback;
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                throw;
            }
            catch (Exception fallbackEx)
            {
                warnings.Add($"Fallback candle update exception: {fallbackEx.GetType().Name}: {fallbackEx.Message}");
                result.Success = false;
                result.Status = "FAST_INCREMENTAL_AND_FALLBACK_FAILED";
                result.Message = "SR SHADOW CHECK - Binance futures fast incremental kline update failed. NO ORDER SENT.";
                result.Warnings = warnings;
                return result;
            }
        }
    }


    // V8.10.3R: scanner-side fast delta VERIFY ONLY.
    // Button 18 already performs the network update. During SR scan we must not call Binance kline
    // again for every symbol, otherwise the scanner becomes slow. This method reads only local CSV
    // metadata and confirms the latest closed 1h candle is present.
    public Task<SrCandleFreshnessUpdateResult> VerifyLocalFreshnessFastAsync(
        string symbol,
        string timeframe,
        int requestedLookbackCandleCount,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        symbol = NormalizeSymbol(symbol);
        timeframe = NormalizeTimeframe(timeframe);
        int tfMinutes = ResolveTimeframeMinutes(timeframe);
        DateTime currentUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        DateTime currentOpenUtc = FloorToTimeframe(currentUtc, tfMinutes);
        DateTime expectedLatestClosedUtc = currentOpenUtc.AddMinutes(-tfMinutes);
        var warnings = new List<string>();
        string candlePath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Candles, $"{symbol}_{timeframe}.csv");

        var result = new SrCandleFreshnessUpdateResult
        {
            GeneratedUtc = currentUtc,
            CurrentUtc = currentUtc,
            Symbol = symbol,
            Timeframe = timeframe,
            TimeframeMinutes = tfMinutes,
            MaxAllowedLagCandles = MaxAllowedLagCandles,
            CandleFilePath = candlePath,
            CurrentOpenCandleUtc = currentOpenUtc,
            ExpectedLatestClosedCandleUtc = expectedLatestClosedUtc,
            FileExistedBefore = File.Exists(candlePath),
            UpdateAttempted = false,
            Warnings = warnings
        };

        try
        {
            var meta = ReadLocalCandleMetaFast(candlePath, warnings);
            result.LocalCandlesBefore = meta.Count;
            result.LocalCandlesAfter = meta.Count;
            result.FirstLocalBeforeUtc = meta.FirstUtc;
            result.FirstLocalAfterUtc = meta.FirstUtc;
            result.LatestLocalBeforeUtc = meta.LatestUtc;
            result.LatestLocalAfterUtc = meta.LatestUtc;
            result.LagCandlesBefore = CalculateLagCandles(meta.LatestUtc, expectedLatestClosedUtc, tfMinutes);
            result.LagCandlesAfter = result.LagCandlesBefore;
            result.DownloadedCandles = 0;
            result.DownloadBatches = 0;
            result.Success = meta.LatestUtc.HasValue && result.LagCandlesAfter <= MaxAllowedLagCandles;
            result.Status = result.Success
                ? "LOCAL_FRESH_VERIFY_ONLY_FAST_META"
                : "LOCAL_STALE_VERIFY_ONLY_FAST_META";
            result.Message = result.Success
                ? $"Local candle freshness PASS. Scanner verify-only mode: latest local closed candle lag={result.LagCandlesAfter} candle(s)."
                : $"Local candle freshness CHECK. Scanner verify-only mode: latest local closed candle lag={result.LagCandlesAfter} candle(s), allowed={MaxAllowedLagCandles}. Run Button 18 before scanner.";
            result.Warnings = warnings;
            return Task.FromResult(result);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            warnings.Add($"Scanner verify-only freshness exception: {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
            result.Success = false;
            result.Status = "LOCAL_FRESH_VERIFY_ONLY_FAILED";
            result.Message = "SR SCANNER CHECK - local candle freshness metadata check failed. Run Button 18 then scan again. NO ORDER SENT.";
            result.Warnings = warnings;
            return Task.FromResult(result);
        }
    }

    private static (int Count, DateTime? FirstUtc, DateTime? LatestUtc) ReadLocalCandleMetaFast(string path, List<string> warnings)
    {
        try
        {
            if (!File.Exists(path))
                return (0, null, null);

            int count = 0;
            DateTime? first = null;
            DateTime? latest = null;

            foreach (string line in File.ReadLines(path))
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line))
                    continue;

                string trimmed = line.Trim();
                if (trimmed.StartsWith("Time", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    continue;

                int comma = trimmed.IndexOf(',');
                if (comma <= 0)
                    continue;

                string timeText = trimmed[..comma].Trim();
                if (DateTime.TryParseExact(timeText,
                        new[] { "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss", "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm" },
                        CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                        DateTimeStyles.AssumeUniversal | DateTimeStyles.AdjustToUniversal,
                        out DateTime t))
                {
                    DateTime utc = EnsureUtc(t);
                    if (!first.HasValue || utc < first.Value)
                        first = utc;
                    if (!latest.HasValue || utc > latest.Value)
                        latest = utc;
                    count++;
                }
            }

            return (count, first, latest);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            warnings.Add($"Fast candle metadata read warning: {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
            return (0, null, null);
        }
    }

    private static void AppendCandlesFast(string symbol, string timeframe, List<Candle> candles, DateTime currentOpenUtc)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Candles);
        string path = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Candles, $"{symbol}_{timeframe}.csv");
        bool writeHeader = !File.Exists(path) || new FileInfo(path).Length == 0;

        using var writer = new StreamWriter(path, append: true);
        if (writeHeader)
            writer.WriteLine("Time,Open,High,Low,Close,Volume");

        foreach (Candle c in candles
                     .Where(x => EnsureUtc(x.Time) < currentOpenUtc)
                     .OrderBy(x => x.Time))
        {
            writer.WriteLine(string.Join(",",
                EnsureUtc(c.Time).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                c.Open.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                c.High.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                c.Low.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                c.Close.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                c.Volume.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
        }
    }

    private static List<Candle> LoadLocalCandles(string symbol, string timeframe, List<string> warnings)
    {
        try
        {
            return new CsvCandleDataFeed()
                .GetCandles(symbol, timeframe)
                .Select(x => new Candle(EnsureUtc(x.Time), x.Open, x.High, x.Low, x.Close, x.Volume))
                .OrderBy(x => x.Time)
                .ToList();
        }
        catch (FileNotFoundException)
        {
            return new List<Candle>();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            warnings.Add($"Local candle read warning: {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
            return new List<Candle>();
        }
    }

    private static async Task<List<Candle>> DownloadClosedFuturesKlinesAsync(
        string symbol,
        string interval,
        DateTime startUtc,
        DateTime currentOpenUtc,
        CancellationToken ct,
        Action<int> reportBatchCount)
    {
        var output = new List<Candle>();
        long startMs = ToUnixMs(startUtc);
        long endMs = ToUnixMs(currentOpenUtc) - 1;
        int batch = 0;

        while (startMs <= endMs)
        {
            string relativeUrl = $"/fapi/v1/klines?symbol={symbol}&interval={interval}&startTime={startMs}&endTime={endMs}&limit=1000";
            using var response = await Http.GetAsync(relativeUrl, ct);
            string body = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct);

            if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Binance futures kline HTTP {(int)response.StatusCode}: {body}");

            using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);
            if (doc.RootElement.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Array || doc.RootElement.GetArrayLength() == 0)
                break;

            DateTime? lastOpenTime = null;
            foreach (JsonElement item in doc.RootElement.EnumerateArray())
            {
                DateTime openTime = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds(item[0].GetInt64()).UtcDateTime;
                lastOpenTime = openTime;

                // Do not allow the current forming candle into SR strategy input.
                if (openTime >= currentOpenUtc)
                    continue;

                output.Add(new Candle(
                    openTime,
                    DecimalFromStringElement(item[1]),
                    DecimalFromStringElement(item[2]),
                    DecimalFromStringElement(item[3]),
                    DecimalFromStringElement(item[4]),
                    DecimalFromStringElement(item[5])));
            }

            batch++;
            reportBatchCount(batch);

            if (!lastOpenTime.HasValue)
                break;

            DateTime nextStart = lastOpenTime.Value.AddMinutes(ResolveTimeframeMinutes(interval));
            long nextStartMs = ToUnixMs(nextStart);
            if (nextStartMs <= startMs)
                break;

            startMs = nextStartMs;

            if (startMs > endMs)
                break;

            await Task.Delay(250, ct);
        }

        return output;
    }

    private static List<Candle> MergeAndTrim(List<Candle> local, List<Candle> downloaded, DateTime currentOpenUtc)
    {
        var merged = new SortedDictionary<DateTime, Candle>();

        foreach (Candle c in local.Concat(downloaded))
        {
            DateTime t = EnsureUtc(c.Time);
            if (t >= currentOpenUtc)
                continue;

            merged[t] = new Candle(t, c.Open, c.High, c.Low, c.Close, c.Volume);
        }

        return merged.Values.ToList();
    }

    private static void WriteCandles(string symbol, string timeframe, List<Candle> candles)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Candles);
        string path = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Candles, $"{symbol}_{timeframe}.csv");

        using var writer = new StreamWriter(path, append: false);
        writer.WriteLine("Time,Open,High,Low,Close,Volume");

        foreach (Candle c in candles.OrderBy(x => x.Time))
        {
            writer.WriteLine(string.Join(",",
                EnsureUtc(c.Time).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                c.Open.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                c.High.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                c.Low.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                c.Close.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                c.Volume.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
        }
    }

    private static DateTime ResolveDownloadStartUtc(
        DateTime? latestLocalUtc,
        DateTime expectedLatestClosedUtc,
        int timeframeMinutes,
        int requestedLookbackCandleCount)
    {
        if (latestLocalUtc.HasValue)
            return latestLocalUtc.Value.AddMinutes(timeframeMinutes);

        return ResolveBootstrapStartUtc(expectedLatestClosedUtc, timeframeMinutes, requestedLookbackCandleCount);
    }

    private static DateTime ResolveBootstrapStartUtc(
        DateTime expectedLatestClosedUtc,
        int timeframeMinutes,
        int requestedLookbackCandleCount)
    {
        int bootstrapCandles = Math.Max(requestedLookbackCandleCount + 100, 1200);
        return expectedLatestClosedUtc.AddMinutes(-(long)timeframeMinutes * bootstrapCandles);
    }

    private static int CalculateLagCandles(DateTime? latestLocalUtc, DateTime expectedLatestClosedUtc, int timeframeMinutes)
    {
        if (!latestLocalUtc.HasValue)
            return int.MaxValue;

        DateTime latest = EnsureUtc(latestLocalUtc.Value);
        if (latest >= expectedLatestClosedUtc)
            return 0;

        double minutes = (expectedLatestClosedUtc - latest).TotalMinutes;
        return Math.Max(0, (int)Math.Ceiling(minutes / timeframeMinutes));
    }

    private static DateTime FloorToTimeframe(DateTime utc, int timeframeMinutes)
    {
        utc = EnsureUtc(utc);
        long ticks = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(timeframeMinutes).Ticks;
        return new DateTime((utc.Ticks / ticks) * ticks, DateTimeKind.Utc);
    }

    private static DateTime EnsureUtc(DateTime value)
    {
        if (value.Kind == DateTimeKind.Utc)
            return value;

        return DateTime.SpecifyKind(value, DateTimeKind.Utc);
    }

    private static long ToUnixMs(DateTime dt)
        => new DateTimeOffset(EnsureUtc(dt)).ToUnixTimeMilliseconds();

    private static decimal DecimalFromStringElement(JsonElement element)
        => decimal.Parse(element.GetString() ?? "0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

    private static int ResolveTimeframeMinutes(string timeframe)
    {
        return timeframe.Trim().ToLowerInvariant() switch
        {
            "1m" => 1,
            "3m" => 3,
            "5m" => 5,
            "15m" => 15,
            "30m" => 30,
            "1h" => 60,
            "2h" => 120,
            "4h" => 240,
            "6h" => 360,
            "8h" => 480,
            "12h" => 720,
            "1d" => 1440,
            _ => 60
        };
    }

    private static string NormalizeSymbol(string symbol)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Symbol is required for candle freshness update.");

        return symbol.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
    }

    private static string NormalizeTimeframe(string timeframe)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(timeframe))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Timeframe is required for candle freshness update. Example: 1h or 4h.");

        return timeframe.Trim();
    }
}

        sb.AppendLine($"Excluded before scan  : {result.TestnetRuleExcludedSymbols}");
        if (result.TestnetRuleExcludedSymbolList.Count > 0)
            sb.AppendLine($"Excluded sample       : {Truncate(string.Join(", ", result.TestnetRuleExcludedSymbolList), 220)}");
        else
            sb.AppendLine("Excluded sample       : NONE");
        sb.AppendLine("Order Sent            : NO - rule validation is scanner hygiene only");
        sb.AppendLine();

        if (result.BestCandidate != null)
        {
            SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate b = result.BestCandidate;
            sb.AppendLine("BEST FRESH AUTO-READY SHADOW CANDIDATE - NO ORDER SENT");
            sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
            AppendCandidateDetail(sb, b);
            sb.AppendLine();
        }
        else
        {
            sb.AppendLine("BEST FRESH AUTO-READY SHADOW CANDIDATE - NO ORDER SENT");
            sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
            sb.AppendLine("No fresh auto-ready c1 clean champion SR candidate passed all 1h quality/watch/pre-auto gates.");
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        if (result.BestShadowCandidate != null && result.BestShadowCandidate != result.BestCandidate)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("BEST SHADOW-ELIGIBLE CANDIDATE, BUT NOT FRESH/AUTO-READY - NO ORDER SENT");
            sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
            AppendCandidateDetail(sb, result.BestShadowCandidate);
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        sb.AppendLine("SCANNED MARKET RANKING");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("Rank Symbol     Decision                AutoReady Miss Ready Age Drift% CurRR  Score  Direction  Entry        SL           TP           Failures / Reason");
        foreach (SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate c in result.Candidates.Take(160))
        {
            sb.AppendLine(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                "{0,4} {1,-10} {2,-23} {3,-9} {4,4} {5,5} {6,3} {7,7} {8,6} {9,6} {10,-10} {11,12} {12,12} {13,12} {14}",
                c.Rank,
                c.Symbol,
                Truncate(c.Decision, 23),
                c.AutoReady ? "YES" : "NO",
                c.AutoReadinessMissingGateCount,
                c.AutoReadinessScore.ToString("F0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                FormatInt(c.SignalAgeCandles),
                FormatDecimal(c.EntryDriftPercent, 3),
                FormatDecimal(c.CurrentRewardRiskRatio, 2),
                FormatDecimal(c.SrScore, 2),
                Safe(c.SrDirection),
                FormatDecimal(c.SrEntryPrice, 4),
                FormatDecimal(c.SrStopLossPrice, 4),
                FormatDecimal(c.SrTakeProfitPrice, 4),
                Truncate(FormatFailures(c.PreAutoGateFailures) + " | " + Safe(c.Reason), 120)));
        }
        sb.AppendLine();

        sb.AppendLine("DETAILED CANDIDATES");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("Detailed section is capped to top 80 ranked rows in V8.10.3T to reduce scanner report I/O time. CSV still contains the scan table.");
        foreach (SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate c in result.Candidates.Take(80))
        {
            AppendCandidateDetail(sb, c);
            sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        }

        if (result.Warnings.Count > 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("WARNINGS");
            sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
            foreach (string warning in result.Warnings)
                sb.AppendLine("- " + warning);
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        sb.AppendLine("SAFETY STATE");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("This is Button18-audit-compatible, Testnet-rule-validated, quality-filtered fresh signal watch / market scanner shadow mode only. It does not place orders.");
        sb.AppendLine("Live trading          : BLOCKED / NOT IMPLEMENTED");
        sb.AppendLine("Auto testnet trading  : NOT USED IN THIS VERSION");
        sb.AppendLine("Speed mode behavior   : may stop early after AUTO_READY_SHADOW_ONLY; still does not place any order");
        sb.AppendLine("Next stage            : V8.10.4 SR SIGNAL → TESTNET AUTO TRADE, only after repeated AUTO_READY_SHADOW_ONLY results with Button 18 audit PASS.");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static void AppendAutoReadyClarity(StringBuilder sb, SrShadowMarketScannerResult result)
    {
        sb.AppendLine("AUTO-READY CLARITY / NEAREST-CANDIDATE RANKING");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        if (result.AutoReadySignals > 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("Status                : AUTO_READY_SHADOW_ONLY found - scanner may stop early, but this version still sends NO order.");
        }
        else
        {
            sb.AppendLine("Status                : No AUTO_READY_SHADOW_ONLY candidate found in this scan.");
        }

        if (result.NearestAutoReadyCandidate == null)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("Nearest Candidate     : NONE");
            sb.AppendLine("Operator Meaning      : no exchange-shadow-passed SR signal reached the nearest-candidate pool.");
            return;
        }

        SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate n = result.NearestAutoReadyCandidate;
        sb.AppendLine($"Nearest Candidate     : {n.Symbol} {n.SrDirection}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Missing Gates         : {n.AutoReadinessMissingGateCount}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Readiness Score       : {n.AutoReadinessScore.ToString("F2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} / 100");
        sb.AppendLine($"Gate Failures         : {Safe(n.AutoReadinessSummary)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Signal Age Candles    : {FormatInt(n.SignalAgeCandles)}  | Gate: {(n.AgeGatePassed ? "PASS" : "FAIL")}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Entry Drift %         : {FormatDecimal(n.EntryDriftPercent, 4)} | Gate: {(n.DriftGatePassed ? "PASS" : "FAIL")}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Current Reward/Risk   : {FormatDecimal(n.CurrentRewardRiskRatio, 4)} | Gate: {(n.CurrentRrGatePassed ? "PASS" : "FAIL")}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Account Clean Gate    : {(n.AccountCleanGatePassed ? "PASS" : "FAIL")}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Next Required Action  : {Safe(n.NextRequiredAction)}");

        if (result.NearestAutoReadyCandidates.Count > 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine("Top nearest candidates:");
            sb.AppendLine("Rank Symbol     Dir   Miss Ready Age Drift% CurRR Failures");
            foreach (SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate c in result.NearestAutoReadyCandidates.Take(10))
            {
                sb.AppendLine(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,

                    FormatDecimal(c.EntryDriftPercent, 3),
                    FormatDecimal(c.CurrentRewardRiskRatio, 2),
                    Truncate(FormatFailures(c.PreAutoGateFailures), 80)));
            }
        }
    }

    private static string BuildCsv(SrShadowMarketScannerResult result)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("rank,symbol,timeframe,decision,auto_ready,auto_readiness_status,auto_readiness_summary,missing_gate_count,readiness_score,age_gate_passed,drift_gate_passed,current_rr_gate_passed,account_clean_gate_passed,candle_freshness_gate_passed,price_source_status,price_source_gate_passed,price_source_failures,local_last_close,mainnet_mark,testnet_mark,mainnet_local_drift_pct,testnet_mainnet_drift_pct,next_required_action,pre_auto_gate_failures,quality_status,quality_gate_failures,universe_quality_passed,standard_symbol_passed,minimum_history_passed,valid_sr_plan_passed,candle_count_1h,candle_count_4h,candle_count_1d,freshness_passed,lag_after,has_sr_signal,exchange_shadow_passed,signal_status,direction,score,signal_time_utc,signal_age_candles,signal_age_hours,entry,exchange_testnet_mark,entry_drift_pct,stop_loss,take_profit,sl_pct,tp_pct,current_risk_pct,current_reward_pct,current_rr,notional,required_margin,available_usdt,reason,report_path");
        foreach (SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate c in result.Candidates)
        {
            sb.AppendLine(string.Join(",",
                c.Rank.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                Csv(c.Symbol),
                Csv(c.Timeframe),
                Csv(c.Decision),
                c.AutoReady ? "true" : "false",
                Csv(c.AutoReadinessStatus),
                Csv(c.AutoReadinessSummary),
                c.AutoReadinessMissingGateCount.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                c.AutoReadinessScore.ToString("F2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                c.AgeGatePassed ? "true" : "false",
                c.DriftGatePassed ? "true" : "false",
                c.CurrentRrGatePassed ? "true" : "false",
                c.AccountCleanGatePassed ? "true" : "false",
                c.CandleFreshnessGatePassed ? "true" : "false",
                Csv(c.PriceSourceStatus),
                c.PriceSourceGatePassed ? "true" : "false",
                Csv(FormatFailures(c.PriceSourceGateFailures)),
                FormatDecimal(c.LocalLastClosePrice, 8),
                FormatDecimal(c.MainnetMarkPrice, 8),
                FormatDecimal(c.TestnetMarkPrice, 8),
                FormatDecimal(c.MainnetVsLocalDriftPercent, 6),
                FormatDecimal(c.TestnetVsMainnetDriftPercent, 6),
                Csv(c.NextRequiredAction),
                Csv(FormatFailures(c.PreAutoGateFailures)),
                Csv(c.QualityStatus),
                Csv(FormatFailures(c.QualityGateFailures)),
                c.Top200QualityPassed ? "true" : "false",
                c.StandardSymbolPassed ? "true" : "false",
                c.MinimumHistoryPassed ? "true" : "false",
                c.ValidSrPlanPassed ? "true" : "false",
                c.CandleCount1h.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                c.CandleCount4h.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                c.CandleCount1d.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                c.FreshnessPassed ? "true" : "false",
                FormatLag(c.LagCandlesAfterUpdate),
                c.HasSrSignal ? "true" : "false",
                c.ExchangeShadowPassed ? "true" : "false",
                Csv(c.SignalStatus),
                Csv(c.SrDirection),
                FormatDecimal(c.SrScore, 8),
                Csv(FormatDate(c.SrSignalTimeUtc)),
                FormatInt(c.SignalAgeCandles),
                FormatDecimal(c.SignalAgeHours, 4),
                FormatDecimal(c.SrEntryPrice, 8),
                FormatDecimal(c.MarkPrice, 8),
                FormatDecimal(c.EntryDriftPercent, 6),
                FormatDecimal(c.SrStopLossPrice, 8),
                FormatDecimal(c.SrTakeProfitPrice, 8),
                FormatDecimal(c.SrStopLossPercent, 6),
                FormatDecimal(c.SrTakeProfitPercent, 6),
                FormatDecimal(c.CurrentRiskPercent, 6),
                FormatDecimal(c.CurrentRewardPercent, 6),
                FormatDecimal(c.CurrentRewardRiskRatio, 6),
                FormatDecimal(c.NotionalUsdt, 4),
                FormatDecimal(c.RequiredMarginUsdt, 4),
                FormatDecimal(c.AvailableUsdt, 4),
                Csv(c.Reason),
                Csv(c.ReportPath)));
        }
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static string Csv(string value)
    {
        value ??= string.Empty;
        return "\"" + value.Replace("\"", "\"\"") + "\"";
    }

    private static string Safe(string value) => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ? "N/A" : value;

    private static string Truncate(string value, int length)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) || value.Length <= length)
            return value;
        return value[..Math.Max(0, length - 3)] + "...";
    }

    private static string FormatFailures(System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<string> failures)
        => failures == null || failures.Count == 0 ? "NONE" : string.Join(" | ", failures);

    private static string FormatLag(int value)
        => value == int.MaxValue ? "N/A" : value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

    private static string FormatInt(int? value)
        => value.HasValue ? value.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "N/A";

    private static string FormatDate(DateTime? value)
        => value.HasValue ? value.Value.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "N/A";

    private static string FormatDecimal(decimal? value, int decimals)
        => value.HasValue ? value.Value.ToString("F" + decimals, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "N/A";
}

internal sealed class SrScannerProgress
{
    public string Stage { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public string CurrentSymbol { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public int Current { get; init; }
    public int Total { get; init; }
    public int Requested { get; init; }
    public int RuleValidated { get; init; }
    public int RuleExcluded { get; init; }
    public int Fresh { get; init; }
    public int Signals { get; init; }
    public int Eligible { get; init; }
    public int AutoReady { get; init; }
    public string Detail { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public bool Completed { get; init; }
    public bool StopWhenAutoReady { get; init; }

    public int Percent => Total <= 0 ? 0 : Math.Max(0, Math.Min(100, (int)Math.Round(Current * 100.0 / Total)));
    public int Remaining => Math.Max(0, Total - Current);
}

        void AddCompletedCandidate(SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate candidate, string symbol)
        {
            candidatesBag.Add(candidate);
            int done = Interlocked.Increment(ref processedCount);

                        localCandidate.Reason = AppendReason(localCandidate.Reason, "Exchange shadow skipped because signal age already fails <=2 candle auto-ready gate.");

            .OrderByDescending(x => x.AutoReady)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.HasSrSignal)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.IsEligible)
            .ThenBy(x => x.AutoReadinessMissingGateCount == 0 && !x.AutoReady ? 99 : x.AutoReadinessMissingGateCount)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.AutoReadinessScore)
            .ThenBy(x => x.SignalAgeCandles ?? int.MaxValue)
            .ThenBy(x => x.EntryDriftPercent ?? 999m)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.CurrentRewardRiskRatio ?? -1m)

            .ThenBy(x => x.SrStopLossPercent ?? 999m)
