            PriceCompatibilitySkipped = ranked.Count(x => x.PriceSourceStatus.StartsWith("SKIPPED", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)),
            ExchangeShadowChecksSkippedStale = ranked.Count(x => x.SignalStatus.Contains("STALE_EXCHANGE_SKIPPED", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)),
            LocalFreshnessVerifyOnlyCount = ranked.Count(x => x.FreshnessPassed),
            WatchDelaySecondsAfterClose = 75,
            FreshSymbols = ranked.Count(x => x.FreshnessPassed),
            SrSignalsFound = ranked.Count(x => x.HasSrSignal),
            EligibleSignals = ranked.Count(x => x.IsEligible),
            AutoReadySignals = ranked.Count(x => x.AutoReady),
            QualityPassedSymbols = ranked.Count(x => x.Top200QualityPassed),
            QualityBlockedSymbols = ranked.Count(x => !x.Top200QualityPassed),
            StandardSymbols = ranked.Count(x => x.StandardSymbolPassed),
            MinimumHistorySymbols = ranked.Count(x => x.MinimumHistoryPassed),
            ValidPlanSignals = ranked.Count(x => x.HasSrSignal && x.ValidSrPlanPassed),
            BestCandidate = bestAutoReady,
            BestShadowCandidate = bestShadow,
            NearestAutoReadyCandidate = nearestAutoReady,
            NearestAutoReadyCandidates = nearestAutoReadyCandidates,
            Success = bestAutoReady != null,
            Message = BuildScannerMessage(bestAutoReady, bestShadow),
            Candidates = ranked,
            Warnings = warnings
        };

        new SrShadowMarketScannerReportService().WriteReport(result);

        progress?.Report(new SrScannerProgress
        {
            Stage = result.Success ? "Completed PASS" : "Completed CHECK",
            Current = Math.Min(scanTotal, candidates.Count),
            Total = scanTotal,
            Requested = requestedSymbols.Count,
            RuleValidated = symbols.Count,
            RuleExcluded = excludedByRule.Count,
            Fresh = result.FreshSymbols,
            Signals = result.SrSignalsFound,
            Eligible = result.EligibleSignals,
            AutoReady = result.AutoReadySignals,
            StopWhenAutoReady = request.StopWhenAutoReady,
            Completed = true,
            Detail = result.Message
        });

        return result;
    }

    private static async Task<IReadOnlyList<string>> GetCachedTestnetRuleSymbolsAsync(
        TestnetOrderExecutionService exchangeShadowService,
        List<string> warnings,
        int requestedCount,
        IProgress<SrScannerProgress>? progress,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        lock (RuleCacheLock)
        {
            if (_cachedTestnetRuleSymbols != null &&
                DateTime.UtcNow - _cachedTestnetRuleSymbolsUtc <= RuleCacheTtl)
            {
                progress?.Report(new SrScannerProgress
                {
                    Stage = "Testnet rule cache HIT",
                    Current = 0,
                    Total = Math.Max(1, requestedCount),
                    Requested = requestedCount,
                    RuleValidated = _cachedTestnetRuleSymbols.Count,
                    Detail = $"Using cached Binance Testnet rules: {_cachedTestnetRuleSymbols.Count} symbols. No exchangeInfo wait."
                });
                return _cachedTestnetRuleSymbols;
            }
        }

        using var timeoutCts = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ct);
        Task<IReadOnlyList<string>> loadTask = exchangeShadowService.GetRuleValidatedSymbolsAsync(timeoutCts.Token);
        DateTime startedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        int heartbeatNo = 0;

        while (true)
        {
            Task completed = await Task.WhenAny(loadTask, Task.Delay(RuleValidationHeartbeat, ct));
            if (completed == loadTask)
            {
                IReadOnlyList<string> fresh = await loadTask;
                var distinct = fresh
                    .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
                    .Select(x => x.Trim().ToUpperInvariant())
                    .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                    .ToList();

                lock (RuleCacheLock)
                {
                    _cachedTestnetRuleSymbols = distinct;
                    _cachedTestnetRuleSymbolsUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
                }

                progress?.Report(new SrScannerProgress
                {
                    Stage = "Testnet rules loaded",
                    Current = 0,
                    Total = Math.Max(1, requestedCount),
                    Requested = requestedCount,
                    RuleValidated = distinct.Count,
                    Detail = $"Loaded Binance Testnet rules: {distinct.Count} symbols. Starting scanner loop now."
                });

                return distinct;
            }

            heartbeatNo++;
            TimeSpan elapsed = DateTime.UtcNow - startedUtc;
            progress?.Report(new SrScannerProgress
            {
                Stage = "Loading Testnet rules",
                Current = 0,
                Total = Math.Max(1, requestedCount),
                Requested = requestedCount,
                Detail = $"Waiting for Binance Testnet exchangeInfo... {elapsed.TotalSeconds:0}s elapsed. If still slow, scanner will bypass rule pre-filter at {RuleValidationTimeout.TotalSeconds:0}s."
            });

            if (elapsed >= RuleValidationTimeout)
            {
                try { timeoutCts.Cancel(); } catch { }
                _ = loadTask.ContinueWith(t => { _ = t.Exception; }, TaskContinuationOptions.OnlyOnFaulted);

                lock (RuleCacheLock)
                {
                    if (_cachedTestnetRuleSymbols != null && _cachedTestnetRuleSymbols.Count > 0)
                    {
                        warnings.Add($"TESTNET_RULE_VALIDATION_TIMEOUT: Binance exchangeInfo did not return within {RuleValidationTimeout.TotalSeconds:0}s. Used previous cached rule set with {_cachedTestnetRuleSymbols.Count} symbols.");
                        return _cachedTestnetRuleSymbols;
                    }
                }

                throw new TimeoutException($"Binance Testnet exchangeInfo/rule validation did not return within {RuleValidationTimeout.TotalSeconds:0} seconds.");
            }
        }
    }

    private static async Task<(List<string> ValidSymbols, List<string> ExcludedSymbols)> ResolveTestnetRuleValidatedSymbolsAsync(
        List<string> requestedSymbols,
        TestnetOrderExecutionService exchangeShadowService,
        List<string> warnings,
        CancellationToken ct,
        IProgress<SrScannerProgress>? progress)
    {
        try
        {
            IReadOnlyList<string> ruleSymbols = await GetCachedTestnetRuleSymbolsAsync(
                exchangeShadowService,
                warnings,
                requestedSymbols.Count,
                progress,
                ct);
            var ruleSet = new HashSet<string>(ruleSymbols, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

            var valid = requestedSymbols
                .Where(x => ruleSet.Contains(x))
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();

            var excluded = requestedSymbols
                .Where(x => !ruleSet.Contains(x))
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();

            if (excluded.Count > 0)
            {
                string sample = string.Join(", ", excluded.Take(40));
                if (excluded.Count > 40)
                    sample += $", ... +{excluded.Count - 40} more";

                warnings.Add($"TESTNET_RULE_VALIDATION_EXCLUDED: {excluded.Count} audit universe symbols were skipped before strategy scan because no Binance Testnet trading rule was found: {sample}");
            }

            return (valid, excluded);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            throw;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            warnings.Add("TESTNET_RULE_VALIDATION_WARNING: failed/timeout while loading Binance Testnet symbol rules before scanner; scanner continued without rule pre-filter so UI does not freeze. " + ex.GetType().Name + ": " + ex.Message);
            progress?.Report(new SrScannerProgress
            {
                Stage = "Testnet rules bypassed",
                Current = 0,
                Total = Math.Max(1, requestedSymbols.Count),
                Requested = requestedSymbols.Count,
                RuleValidated = requestedSymbols.Count,
                RuleExcluded = 0,
                Detail = "Rule validation was slow/unavailable; scanner is continuing with the Button 18 1h universe. Exchange shadow remains candidate-only and no order is sent."
            });
            return (requestedSymbols, new List<string>());
        }
    }

    private static string BuildScannerMessage(
        SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate? bestAutoReady,
        SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate? bestShadow)
    {
        if (bestAutoReady != null)
        {
            return $"SR SCANNER PASS - AUTO_READY_SHADOW_ONLY found: {bestAutoReady.Symbol} {bestAutoReady.SrDirection}. NO ORDER SENT.";
        }

        if (bestShadow != null)
        {
            return $"SR SCANNER CHECK - nearest auto-ready candidate is {bestShadow.Symbol} {bestShadow.SrDirection}; missing {bestShadow.AutoReadinessMissingGateCount} gate(s): {bestShadow.AutoReadinessSummary}. NO ORDER SENT.";
        }

        return "MAINNET-vs-TESTNET PRICE COMPATIBILITY WATCH CHECK - no AUTO_READY c1 clean champion SR candidate found after fresh-signal, price-source, quality, and valid-plan filters. NO ORDER SENT.";
    }

    private static SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate? TryBuildFastPreSkippedCandidate(string symbol, string timeframe)
    {
        int candleCount1h = CountLocalCandles(symbol, "1h");
        bool standard = IsStandardCryptoUsdtSymbol(symbol);

        if (standard && candleCount1h >= MinimumHistory1hCandles)
            return null;

        var failures = new List<string>();
        if (!standard)
            failures.Add("BLOCKED_NON_STANDARD_SYMBOL_FAST_SKIP");
        if (candleCount1h < MinimumHistory1hCandles)
            failures.Add("BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY_1H_FAST_SKIP");

        return new SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate
        {
            Symbol = symbol,
            Timeframe = timeframe,
            Success = false,
            IsEligible = false,
            AutoReady = false,
            Decision = "BLOCKED",
            AutoReadinessStatus = failures.Count > 0 ? failures[0] : "BLOCKED_FAST_PRE_FILTER",
            AutoReadinessSummary = string.Join(" | ", failures),
            AutoReadinessMissingGateCount = failures.Count,
            AutoReadinessScore = 0m,
            SignalStatus = "FAST_PRE_FILTER_SKIP",
            Message = "SMART INCREMENTAL WATCH - skipped before heavy SR backtest/exchange shadow. NO ORDER SENT.",
            FreshnessPassed = true,
            LagCandlesAfterUpdate = 0,
            HasSrSignal = false,
            Top200QualityPassed = false,
            QualityStatus = failures.Count > 0 ? failures[0] : "BLOCKED_FAST_PRE_FILTER",
            StandardSymbolPassed = standard,
            MinimumHistoryPassed = candleCount1h >= MinimumHistory1hCandles,
            ValidSrPlanPassed = false,
            CandleCount1h = candleCount1h,
            CandleCount4h = 0,
            CandleCount1d = 0,
            QualityGateFailures = failures,
            ExchangeShadowPassed = false,
            PreAutoGateFailures = failures,
            Reason = "Fast 1h-only pre-filter blocked this symbol before heavy SR scan."
        };
    }


    private static async Task ApplyPriceCompatibilityAuditAsync(
        SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate c,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var failures = new List<string>();
        c.PriceSourceStatus = "CHECKING";
        c.PriceSourceGatePassed = false;

        decimal? localLastClose = TryReadLatestLocalClose(c.Symbol, "1h");
        c.LocalLastClosePrice = localLastClose;

        try
        {
            decimal? mainnetMark = await TryGetPublicFuturesMarkPriceAsync("https://fapi.binance.com", c.Symbol, ct);
            decimal? testnetMark = await TryGetPublicFuturesMarkPriceAsync("https://testnet.binancefuture.com", c.Symbol, ct);

            c.MainnetMarkPrice = mainnetMark;
            c.TestnetMarkPrice = testnetMark;

            if (!localLastClose.HasValue || localLastClose.Value <= 0m)
                failures.Add("BLOCKED_PRICE_SOURCE_LOCAL_LAST_CLOSE_UNAVAILABLE");

            if (!mainnetMark.HasValue || mainnetMark.Value <= 0m)
                failures.Add("BLOCKED_PRICE_SOURCE_MAINNET_MARK_UNAVAILABLE");

            if (!testnetMark.HasValue || testnetMark.Value <= 0m)
                failures.Add("BLOCKED_PRICE_SOURCE_TESTNET_MARK_UNAVAILABLE");

            if (localLastClose.HasValue && localLastClose.Value > 0m && mainnetMark.HasValue && mainnetMark.Value > 0m)
            {
                c.MainnetVsLocalDriftPercent = Math.Abs(mainnetMark.Value - localLastClose.Value) / localLastClose.Value * 100m;
                if (c.MainnetVsLocalDriftPercent.Value > MaxMainnetVsLocalDriftPctForAutoReady)
                    failures.Add("BLOCKED_MAINNET_LOCAL_PRICE_MISMATCH");
            }

            if (mainnetMark.HasValue && mainnetMark.Value > 0m && testnetMark.HasValue && testnetMark.Value > 0m)
            {
                c.TestnetVsMainnetDriftPercent = Math.Abs(testnetMark.Value - mainnetMark.Value) / mainnetMark.Value * 100m;
                if (c.TestnetVsMainnetDriftPercent.Value > MaxTestnetVsMainnetDriftPctForAutoReady)
                    failures.Add("BLOCKED_TESTNET_MAINNET_PRICE_MISMATCH");
            }

            c.PriceSourceGateFailures = failures;
            c.PriceSourceGatePassed = failures.Count == 0;
            c.PriceSourceStatus = failures.Count == 0
                ? "PASS_MAINNET_TESTNET_PRICE_COMPATIBLE"
                : "BLOCKED_PRICE_SOURCE_COMPATIBILITY";

            if (failures.Count == 0)
            {
                c.Reason = AppendReason(c.Reason,
                    $"Price source audit PASS. Local={FormatPriceForReason(localLastClose)} Mainnet={FormatPriceForReason(mainnetMark)} Testnet={FormatPriceForReason(testnetMark)} Mainnet/Local={FormatPctForReason(c.MainnetVsLocalDriftPercent)} Testnet/Mainnet={FormatPctForReason(c.TestnetVsMainnetDriftPercent)}.");
            }
            else
            {
                c.Reason = AppendReason(c.Reason,
                    $"Price source audit BLOCKED: {string.Join(" | ", failures)}. Local={FormatPriceForReason(localLastClose)} Mainnet={FormatPriceForReason(mainnetMark)} Testnet={FormatPriceForReason(testnetMark)} Mainnet/Local={FormatPctForReason(c.MainnetVsLocalDriftPercent)} Testnet/Mainnet={FormatPctForReason(c.TestnetVsMainnetDriftPercent)}.");
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            throw;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            c.PriceSourceStatus = "BLOCKED_PRICE_SOURCE_AUDIT_EXCEPTION";
            c.PriceSourceGateFailures = new[] { "BLOCKED_PRICE_SOURCE_AUDIT_EXCEPTION" };
            c.PriceSourceGatePassed = false;
            c.Reason = AppendReason(c.Reason, "Price source audit exception: " + ex.GetType().Name + ": " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private static void MarkPriceCompatibilitySkipped(SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate c, bool freshEnough)
    {
        if (!c.HasSrSignal)
            return;

        c.PriceSourceGatePassed = true;
        c.PriceSourceGateFailures = Array.Empty<string>();
        c.PriceSourceStatus = freshEnough
            ? "SKIPPED_PRICE_AUDIT_NOT_NEEDED"
            : "SKIPPED_PRICE_AUDIT_STALE_SIGNAL";
    }

    private static void CopyPriceCompatibilityAudit(
        SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate source,
        SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate target)
    {
        target.LocalLastClosePrice = source.LocalLastClosePrice;
        target.MainnetMarkPrice = source.MainnetMarkPrice;
        target.TestnetMarkPrice = source.TestnetMarkPrice;
        target.MainnetVsLocalDriftPercent = source.MainnetVsLocalDriftPercent;
        target.TestnetVsMainnetDriftPercent = source.TestnetVsMainnetDriftPercent;
        target.PriceSourceGatePassed = source.PriceSourceGatePassed;
        target.PriceSourceStatus = source.PriceSourceStatus;
        target.PriceSourceGateFailures = source.PriceSourceGateFailures;
    }

    private static void RecalculateTestnetVsMainnet(SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate c)
    {
        if (!c.MainnetMarkPrice.HasValue || c.MainnetMarkPrice.Value <= 0m ||
            !c.TestnetMarkPrice.HasValue || c.TestnetMarkPrice.Value <= 0m)
            return;

        c.TestnetVsMainnetDriftPercent = Math.Abs(c.TestnetMarkPrice.Value - c.MainnetMarkPrice.Value) / c.MainnetMarkPrice.Value * 100m;
        if (c.TestnetVsMainnetDriftPercent.Value > MaxTestnetVsMainnetDriftPctForAutoReady)
        {
            var failures = c.PriceSourceGateFailures.ToList();
            if (!failures.Contains("BLOCKED_TESTNET_MAINNET_PRICE_MISMATCH", StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                failures.Add("BLOCKED_TESTNET_MAINNET_PRICE_MISMATCH");
            c.PriceSourceGateFailures = failures;
            c.PriceSourceGatePassed = false;
            c.PriceSourceStatus = "BLOCKED_PRICE_SOURCE_COMPATIBILITY";
        }
    }

    private static async Task<decimal?> TryGetPublicFuturesMarkPriceAsync(string baseUrl, string symbol, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        using var http = new HttpClient { Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(6) };
        string url = baseUrl.TrimEnd('/') + "/fapi/v1/premiumIndex?symbol=" + Uri.EscapeDataString(symbol.Trim().ToUpperInvariant());
        using var response = await http.GetAsync(url, ct);
        string body = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct);
        if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            return null;

        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);
        if (TryReadDecimal(doc.RootElement, "markPrice", out decimal mark) && mark > 0m)
            return mark;
        if (TryReadDecimal(doc.RootElement, "indexPrice", out decimal index) && index > 0m)
            return index;
        return null;
    }

    private static decimal? TryReadLatestLocalClose(string symbol, string timeframe)
    {
        try
        {
            string fileName = $"{symbol.Trim().ToUpperInvariant()}_{NormalizeTimeframe(timeframe)}.csv";
            string path = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Candles, fileName);
            if (!File.Exists(path))
                return null;

            string? lastDataLine = null;
            foreach (string line in File.ReadLines(path))
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line))
                    continue;
                string trimmed = line.Trim();
                if (trimmed.StartsWith("Time", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    continue;
                lastDataLine = trimmed;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(lastDataLine))
                return null;

            string[] parts = lastDataLine.Split(',');
            if (parts.Length >= 5 && decimal.TryParse(parts[4].Trim(), NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out decimal close))
                return close;

            for (int i = parts.Length - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                if (decimal.TryParse(parts[i].Trim(), NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out close) && close > 0m)
                    return close;
            }

            return null;
        }
        catch
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static bool TryReadDecimal(JsonElement element, string propertyName, out decimal value)
    {
        value = 0m;
        if (!element.TryGetProperty(propertyName, out JsonElement property))
            return false;

        if (property.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Number && property.TryGetDecimal(out value))
            return true;

        if (property.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String &&
            decimal.TryParse(property.GetString(), NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out value))
            return true;

        return false;
    }

    private static string FormatPriceForReason(decimal? value)
        => value.HasValue ? value.Value.ToString("F8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "N/A";

    private static string FormatPctForReason(decimal? value)
        => value.HasValue ? value.Value.ToString("F4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "%" : "N/A";

    private static SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate BuildCandidate(SrStrategySignalShadowResult sr)
    {
        var exchange = sr.ExchangeShadow;
        string reason = FirstWarningOrMessage(sr);
        bool shadowEligible = sr.Success &&
                              sr.HasSrSignal &&
                              sr.CandleFreshnessPassed &&
                              exchange != null &&
                              exchange.Success;

        return new SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate
        {
            Symbol = sr.Symbol,
            Timeframe = sr.Timeframe,
            Success = sr.Success,
            IsEligible = shadowEligible,
            AutoReady = false,
            Decision = shadowEligible ? "ELIGIBLE_SHADOW_ONLY" : "BLOCKED",
            AutoReadinessStatus = "NOT_EVALUATED",
            SignalStatus = sr.SignalStatus,
            Message = sr.Message,
            FreshnessPassed = sr.CandleFreshnessPassed,
            LagCandlesAfterUpdate = sr.LagCandlesAfterUpdate,
            HasSrSignal = sr.HasSrSignal,
            SrDirection = sr.SrDirection,
            IntendedSide = sr.IntendedSide,
            SrScore = sr.SrScore,
            SrEntryPrice = sr.SrEntryPrice,
            SrStopLossPrice = sr.SrStopLossPrice,
            SrTakeProfitPrice = sr.SrTakeProfitPrice,
            SrStopLossPercent = sr.SrStopLossPercent,
            SrTakeProfitPercent = sr.SrTakeProfitPercent,
            SrAtr14 = sr.SrAtr14,
            SrRsi14 = sr.SrRsi14,
            SrSignalTimeUtc = sr.SrSignalTimeUtc,
            Top200QualityPassed = false,
            QualityStatus = "NOT_EVALUATED",
            StandardSymbolPassed = false,
            MinimumHistoryPassed = false,
            ValidSrPlanPassed = false,
            CandleCount1h = 0,
            CandleCount4h = 0,
            CandleCount1d = 0,
            QualityGateFailures = Array.Empty<string>(),
            ExchangeShadowPassed = exchange?.Success ?? false,
            MarkPrice = exchange?.MarkPrice,
            TestnetMarkPrice = exchange?.MarkPrice,
            PriceSourceStatus = "NOT_CHECKED",
            PriceSourceGatePassed = true,
            PriceSourceGateFailures = Array.Empty<string>(),
            ValidQuantity = exchange?.ValidQuantity,
            NotionalUsdt = exchange?.NotionalUsdt,
            RequiredMarginUsdt = exchange?.RequiredMarginUsdt,
            AvailableUsdt = exchange?.AvailableUsdt,
            AccountOpenPositionCount = exchange?.AccountOpenPositionCount ?? 0,
            AccountNormalOpenOrderCount = exchange?.AccountNormalOpenOrderCount ?? 0,
            AccountAlgoOpenOrderCount = exchange?.AccountAlgoOpenOrderCount ?? 0,
            Reason = reason,
            ReportPath = sr.ReportPath
        };
    }

    private static void ApplyPreAutoSafetyGates(
        SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate c,
        string timeframe,
        DateTime generatedUtc)
    {
        var failures = new List<string>();
        bool staleExchangeSkipped = c.SignalStatus.Contains("STALE_EXCHANGE_SKIPPED", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        TimeSpan candleSpan = ResolveTimeframeSpan(timeframe);

        ApplyTop200QualityFilter(c);
        if (c.QualityGateFailures.Count > 0)
            failures.AddRange(c.QualityGateFailures);

        // Quality failures must prevent a symbol from being treated as an auto-trade candidate.
        // It can still remain visible in the report for audit, but it cannot be AUTO_READY.
        if (!c.Top200QualityPassed)
            c.IsEligible = false;

        if (c.HasSrSignal && c.PriceSourceGateFailures.Count > 0)
            failures.AddRange(c.PriceSourceGateFailures);

        if (!c.FreshnessPassed)
            failures.Add("BLOCKED_STALE_CANDLES");

        if (!c.HasSrSignal)
            failures.Add("BLOCKED_NO_CURRENT_SR_SIGNAL");

        if (!c.ExchangeShadowPassed && !staleExchangeSkipped)
            failures.Add("BLOCKED_EXCHANGE_SHADOW_CHECK");

        if (c.AccountOpenPositionCount != 0 || c.AccountNormalOpenOrderCount != 0 || c.AccountAlgoOpenOrderCount != 0)
            failures.Add("BLOCKED_ACCOUNT_NOT_CLEAN");

        if (c.SrSignalTimeUtc.HasValue && candleSpan > TimeSpan.Zero)
        {
            TimeSpan age = generatedUtc - c.SrSignalTimeUtc.Value;
            if (age < TimeSpan.Zero)
                age = TimeSpan.Zero;

            c.SignalAgeHours = (decimal)age.TotalHours;
            c.SignalAgeCandles = Math.Max(0, (int)Math.Floor(age.TotalSeconds / candleSpan.TotalSeconds));

            if (c.SignalAgeCandles > MaxSignalAgeCandlesForAutoReady)
                failures.Add("BLOCKED_SIGNAL_TOO_OLD");
        }
        else if (c.HasSrSignal)
        {
            failures.Add("BLOCKED_SIGNAL_TIME_MISSING");
        }

        decimal? strategyMarkPrice = c.MainnetMarkPrice ?? c.MarkPrice;
        if (strategyMarkPrice.HasValue && strategyMarkPrice.Value > 0m && c.SrEntryPrice.HasValue && c.SrEntryPrice.Value > 0m)
        {
            c.EntryDriftPercent = Math.Abs(strategyMarkPrice.Value - c.SrEntryPrice.Value) / c.SrEntryPrice.Value * 100m;
            if (c.EntryDriftPercent > MaxEntryDriftPctForAutoReady)
                failures.Add("BLOCKED_ENTRY_DRIFT_TOO_HIGH");
        }
        else if (c.HasSrSignal && !staleExchangeSkipped)
        {
            failures.Add("BLOCKED_ENTRY_DRIFT_UNAVAILABLE");
        }

        if (!staleExchangeSkipped)
        {
            EvaluateCurrentRiskReward(c, failures, strategyMarkPrice);
        }
        else
        {
            c.CurrentPlanValid = false;
        }

        c.PreAutoGateFailures = failures;
        ApplyAutoReadyClarity(c, failures);

        bool autoReady = c.IsEligible && failures.Count == 0;
        c.AutoReady = autoReady;
        c.Decision = autoReady
            ? "AUTO_READY_SHADOW_ONLY"
            : c.IsEligible
                ? "ELIGIBLE_SHADOW_ONLY"
                : "BLOCKED";
        c.AutoReadinessStatus = autoReady
            ? "AUTO_READY_SHADOW_ONLY"
            : c.AutoReadinessSummary;
    }

    private static void ApplyAutoReadyClarity(SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate c, List<string> failures)
    {
        var distinctFailures = failures
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        c.AutoReadinessMissingGateCount = distinctFailures.Count;
        c.AutoReadinessSummary = distinctFailures.Count == 0
            ? "AUTO_READY_SHADOW_ONLY"
            : string.Join(" | ", distinctFailures);

        c.CandleFreshnessGatePassed = !distinctFailures.Contains("BLOCKED_STALE_CANDLES", StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        c.ExchangeShadowGatePassed = !distinctFailures.Contains("BLOCKED_EXCHANGE_SHADOW_CHECK", StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        c.AccountCleanGatePassed = !distinctFailures.Contains("BLOCKED_ACCOUNT_NOT_CLEAN", StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        c.QualityGatePassedForAutoReady = c.Top200QualityPassed &&
            !distinctFailures.Any(x => x.StartsWith("BLOCKED_NON_STANDARD", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                                       x.StartsWith("BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                                       x.StartsWith("BLOCKED_INVALID_PLAN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                                       x.StartsWith("BLOCKED_STOP_LOSS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                                       x.StartsWith("BLOCKED_TAKE_PROFIT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

        c.AgeGatePassed = !distinctFailures.Any(x => x.Contains("SIGNAL_TOO_OLD", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                                                     x.Contains("SIGNAL_TIME_MISSING", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        c.DriftGatePassed = !distinctFailures.Any(x => x.Contains("ENTRY_DRIFT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        c.CurrentRrGatePassed = !distinctFailures.Any(x => x.Contains("CURRENT_RR", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

        c.AutoReadinessScore = CalculateAutoReadinessScore(c);
        c.NextRequiredAction = BuildNextRequiredAction(c, distinctFailures);
    }

    private static decimal CalculateAutoReadinessScore(SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate c)
    {
        decimal score = 0m;
        if (c.Top200QualityPassed) score += 20m;
        if (c.FreshnessPassed) score += 10m;
        if (c.HasSrSignal) score += 15m;
        if (c.ExchangeShadowPassed) score += 15m;
        if (c.AccountCleanGatePassed) score += 10m;
        if (c.AgeGatePassed) score += 10m;
        if (c.DriftGatePassed) score += 10m;
        if (c.CurrentRrGatePassed) score += 10m;

        if (c.EntryDriftPercent.HasValue)
        {
            decimal driftPenalty = Math.Min(20m, Math.Max(0m, c.EntryDriftPercent.Value - MaxEntryDriftPctForAutoReady));
            score -= driftPenalty;
        }

        if (c.SignalAgeCandles.HasValue && c.SignalAgeCandles.Value > MaxSignalAgeCandlesForAutoReady)
        {
            int extraAge = Math.Max(0, c.SignalAgeCandles.Value - MaxSignalAgeCandlesForAutoReady);
            score -= Math.Min(20m, extraAge * 2m);
        }

        if (c.CurrentRewardRiskRatio.HasValue)
        {
            decimal rrBonus = Math.Min(10m, Math.Max(0m, c.CurrentRewardRiskRatio.Value - MinCurrentRewardRiskForAutoReady) * 5m);
            score += rrBonus;
        }

        return Math.Max(0m, Math.Min(100m, score));
    }

    private static string BuildNextRequiredAction(SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate c, IReadOnlyList<string> failures)
    {
        if (failures.Count == 0)
            return "READY - can be used by future V8.10.4 testnet auto-execution, but this version still sends no order.";

        if (failures.Contains("BLOCKED_SIGNAL_TOO_OLD", StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "Wait for the next fresh 1h signal; this one is too old for safe auto-ready.";

        if (failures.Any(x => x.Contains("PRICE_SOURCE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || x.Contains("PRICE_MISMATCH", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
            return "Price-source audit failed: real Binance mainnet price and/or testnet price does not match the strategy candle basis. Do not auto-execute; keep watching.";

        if (failures.Contains("BLOCKED_ENTRY_DRIFT_TOO_HIGH", StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "Do not chase; price moved too far from strategy entry. Wait for a new setup or retest.";

        if (failures.Any(x => x.Contains("CURRENT_RR", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
            return "Current reward/risk is not acceptable; wait for better mark price or a new signal.";

        if (failures.Contains("BLOCKED_ACCOUNT_NOT_CLEAN", StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "Clean account first: close positions and cancel normal/algo orders.";

        if (failures.Contains("BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY_1H", StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "Exclude from fast watch until it has enough 1h history.";

        if (failures.Contains("BLOCKED_NO_CURRENT_SR_SIGNAL", StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "No current SR setup; keep in universe only for periodic watch.";

        return "Keep watching; not auto-ready under current safety gates.";
    }

    private static void EvaluateCurrentRiskReward(
        SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate c,
        List<string> failures,
        decimal? strategyMarkPrice)
    {
        c.CurrentPlanValid = false;

        if (!c.HasSrSignal)
            return;

        if (!strategyMarkPrice.HasValue || !c.SrStopLossPrice.HasValue || !c.SrTakeProfitPrice.HasValue)
        {
            failures.Add("BLOCKED_CURRENT_RR_UNAVAILABLE");
            return;
        }

        decimal mark = strategyMarkPrice.Value;
        decimal sl = c.SrStopLossPrice.Value;
        decimal tp = c.SrTakeProfitPrice.Value;

        if (mark <= 0m || sl <= 0m || tp <= 0m)
        {
            failures.Add("BLOCKED_CURRENT_RR_INVALID_PRICE");
            return;
        }

        decimal risk;
        decimal reward;

        if (c.IntendedSide == TQGA.Domain.Trading.ExchangeOrderSide.Buy)
        {
            risk = mark - sl;
            reward = tp - mark;
        }
        else
        {
            risk = sl - mark;
            reward = mark - tp;
        }

        if (risk <= 0m || reward <= 0m)
        {
            failures.Add("BLOCKED_CURRENT_RR_INVALID");
            return;
        }

        c.CurrentRiskPercent = risk / mark * 100m;
        c.CurrentRewardPercent = reward / mark * 100m;
        c.CurrentRewardRiskRatio = reward / risk;
        c.CurrentPlanValid = true;

        if (c.CurrentRewardRiskRatio < MinCurrentRewardRiskForAutoReady)
            failures.Add("BLOCKED_CURRENT_RR_TOO_LOW");
    }


    private static void ApplyTop200QualityFilter(SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate c)
    {
        var failures = new List<string>();

        c.CandleCount1h = CountLocalCandles(c.Symbol, "1h");
        c.CandleCount4h = 0;
        c.CandleCount1d = 0;

        c.StandardSymbolPassed = IsStandardCryptoUsdtSymbol(c.Symbol);
        if (!c.StandardSymbolPassed)
            failures.Add("BLOCKED_NON_STANDARD_SYMBOL");

        c.MinimumHistoryPassed = c.CandleCount1h >= MinimumHistory1hCandles;
        if (!c.MinimumHistoryPassed)
            failures.Add("BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY_1H");

        c.ValidSrPlanPassed = true;
        if (c.HasSrSignal)
        {
            c.ValidSrPlanPassed = IsValidSrPlan(c, failures);
        }

        c.Top200QualityPassed = failures.Count == 0;
        c.QualityStatus = c.Top200QualityPassed ? "QUALITY_PASS" : failures[0];
        c.QualityGateFailures = failures;
    }

    private static bool IsValidSrPlan(SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate c, List<string> failures)
    {
        if (!c.SrEntryPrice.HasValue || !c.SrStopLossPrice.HasValue || !c.SrTakeProfitPrice.HasValue)
        {
            failures.Add("BLOCKED_INVALID_PLAN_MISSING_PRICE");
            return false;
        }

        decimal entry = c.SrEntryPrice.Value;
        decimal sl = c.SrStopLossPrice.Value;
        decimal tp = c.SrTakeProfitPrice.Value;

        if (entry <= 0m || sl <= 0m || tp <= 0m)
        {
            failures.Add("BLOCKED_INVALID_PLAN_PRICE_NON_POSITIVE");
            return false;
        }

        bool directionValid;
        if (c.IntendedSide == TQGA.Domain.Trading.ExchangeOrderSide.Buy)
        {
            directionValid = sl < entry && tp > entry;
            if (!directionValid)
                failures.Add("BLOCKED_INVALID_LONG_SL_TP_DIRECTION");
        }
        else
        {
            directionValid = sl > entry && tp < entry;
            if (!directionValid)
                failures.Add("BLOCKED_INVALID_SHORT_SL_TP_DIRECTION");
        }

        if (!directionValid)
            return false;

        if (!c.SrStopLossPercent.HasValue || !c.SrTakeProfitPercent.HasValue ||
            c.SrStopLossPercent.Value <= 0m || c.SrTakeProfitPercent.Value <= 0m)
        {
            failures.Add("BLOCKED_INVALID_PLAN_PERCENT");
            return false;
        }

        if (c.SrStopLossPercent.Value > MaximumStopLossPercentForAutoReady)
        {
            failures.Add("BLOCKED_STOP_LOSS_PERCENT_TOO_WIDE");
            return false;
        }

        if (c.SrTakeProfitPercent.Value > MaximumTakeProfitPercentForAutoReady)
        {
            failures.Add("BLOCKED_TAKE_PROFIT_PERCENT_TOO_WIDE");
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static int CountLocalCandles(string symbol, string timeframe)
    {
        try
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(timeframe))
                return 0;

            string fileName = $"{symbol.Trim().ToUpperInvariant()}_{NormalizeTimeframe(timeframe)}.csv";
            string path = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Candles, fileName);
            if (!File.Exists(path))
                return 0;

            int count = 0;
            foreach (string line in File.ReadLines(path))
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line))
                    continue;

                string trimmed = line.Trim();
                if (trimmed.StartsWith("Time", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    continue;

                count++;
            }

            return count;
        }
        catch
        {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    private static bool IsStandardCryptoUsdtSymbol(string symbol)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol))
            return false;

        string s = symbol.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
        if (!s.EndsWith("USDT", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            return false;

        foreach (char ch in s)
        {
            bool ok = (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z') || (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9');
            if (!ok)
                return false;
        }

        string root = s[..^4];
        if (root.Length == 0)
            return false;

        foreach (string blocked in BlockedNonCryptoLikeRoots)
        {
            if (root.Equals(blocked, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static string FirstWarningOrMessage(SrStrategySignalShadowResult sr)
    {
        if (sr.Warnings.Count > 0)
            return sr.Warnings[0];

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sr.SrReason))
            return FirstLine(sr.SrReason);

        return sr.Message;
    }

    private static async Task<List<string>> NormalizeSymbolsAsync(IEnumerable<string> symbols, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        IReadOnlyList<string> resolved = await SrTradingUniverse.ResolveScannerSymbolsAsync(symbols, ct);

        // V8.10.3K: do NOT force Take(200) here.
        // TOP200 mode is already limited inside SrTradingUniverse.GetDynamicTop200SymbolsAsync().
        // ALL_BINANCE_USDT_FUTURES / BUTTON18_AUDIT must keep the full Button 18 universe
        // so the scanner can evaluate all current Binance USD-M USDT futures symbols.
        return resolved
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
            .Select(x => x.Trim().ToUpperInvariant())
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();
    }

    private static string NormalizeTimeframe(string timeframe)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(timeframe))
            return "1h";

        return timeframe.Trim();
    }

    private static bool IsSignalFreshEnoughForExchangeShadow(
        SrShadowMarketScannerCandidate c,
        string timeframe,
        DateTime generatedUtc)
    {
        if (!c.HasSrSignal)
            return false;

        if (!c.SrSignalTimeUtc.HasValue)
            return false;

        TimeSpan candleSpan = ResolveTimeframeSpan(timeframe);
        if (candleSpan <= TimeSpan.Zero)
            candleSpan = TimeSpan.FromHours(1);

        TimeSpan age = generatedUtc - c.SrSignalTimeUtc.Value;
        if (age < TimeSpan.Zero)
            age = TimeSpan.Zero;

        c.SignalAgeHours = (decimal)age.TotalHours;
        c.SignalAgeCandles = Math.Max(0, (int)Math.Floor(age.TotalSeconds / candleSpan.TotalSeconds));

        return c.SignalAgeCandles <= MaxSignalAgeCandlesForAutoReady;
    }

    private static string AppendReason(string current, string addition)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(addition))
            return current ?? string.Empty;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(current))
            return addition.Trim();

        string trimmedCurrent = current.Trim();
        string trimmedAddition = addition.Trim();

        if (trimmedCurrent.Contains(trimmedAddition, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return trimmedCurrent;

        return trimmedCurrent + " | " + trimmedAddition;
    }

    private static TimeSpan ResolveTimeframeSpan(string timeframe)
    {
        string tf = NormalizeTimeframe(timeframe).ToLowerInvariant();
        return tf switch
        {
            "1m" => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1),
            "3m" => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(3),
            "5m" => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
            "15m" => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15),
            "30m" => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30),
            "1h" => TimeSpan.FromHours(1),
            "2h" => TimeSpan.FromHours(2),
            "4h" => TimeSpan.FromHours(4),
            "6h" => TimeSpan.FromHours(6),
            "8h" => TimeSpan.FromHours(8),
            "12h" => TimeSpan.FromHours(12),
            "1d" => TimeSpan.FromDays(1),
            _ => TimeSpan.FromHours(1)
        };
    }

    private static string FirstLine(string value)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
            return string.Empty;

        return value.Replace("\r", "\n").Split('\n', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).FirstOrDefault()?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using TQGA.Application.Reporting;
using TQGA.Application.Trading;
using TQGA.Domain.Market;
using TQGA.Domain.Trading;
using TQGA.Infrastructure.MarketData;

namespace TQGA.WinForms;

internal sealed class SrStrategySignalShadowBridge
{
    public async Task<SrStrategySignalShadowResult> BuildSrShadowSignalAsync(
        SrStrategySignalShadowRequest request,
        TestnetOrderExecutionService exchangeShadowService,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(request);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(exchangeShadowService);

        SrStrategySignalShadowResult local = await BuildSrLocalSignalOnlyAsync(request, ct);
        if (!local.HasSrSignal)
        {
            new SrStrategySignalShadowReportService().WriteReport(local);
            return local;
        }

        return await EnrichLocalSignalWithExchangeShadowAsync(
            local,
            request,
            exchangeShadowService,
            ct,
            writeReport: true);
    }

    // V8.10.3T: candidate-first scanner path with local freshness verify-only.
    // This runs only the local SR strategy and does NOT call Binance exchange shadow.
    // It also does NOT write a per-symbol report, which removes hundreds of disk writes per scan.
    public async Task<SrStrategySignalShadowResult> BuildSrLocalSignalOnlyAsync(
        SrStrategySignalShadowRequest request,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(request);

        string symbol = NormalizeSymbol(request.Symbol);
        string timeframe = NormalizeTimeframe(request.Timeframe);
        var warnings = new List<string>();
        int lookbackCandleCount = ResolveLookbackCandleCount(timeframe);

        SrCandleFreshnessUpdateResult freshness = await new SrCandleFreshnessUpdater()
            .VerifyLocalFreshnessFastAsync(symbol, timeframe, lookbackCandleCount, ct);

        warnings.AddRange(freshness.Warnings ?? Array.Empty<string>());

        var freshnessGate = BuildBase(request, symbol, timeframe, warnings);
        ApplyFreshness(freshnessGate, freshness);
        if (!freshness.Success)
        {
            freshnessGate.Success = false;
            freshnessGate.Message = "SR LOCAL CHECK - candle data is stale or Binance futures kline update failed. NO ORDER SENT.";
            freshnessGate.SignalStatus = freshness.Status;
            return freshnessGate;
        }

        List<Candle> allCandles = new CsvCandleDataFeed()
            .GetCandles(symbol, timeframe)
            .OrderBy(x => x.Time)
            .ToList();

        if (allCandles.Count < 300)
        {
            var noData = BuildBase(request, symbol, timeframe, warnings);
            ApplyFreshness(noData, freshness);
            noData.Success = false;
            noData.Message = $"SR LOCAL CHECK - not enough candles for {symbol} {timeframe}. NO ORDER SENT.";
            noData.SignalStatus = "NO_DATA";
            noData.CandlesLoaded = allCandles.Count;
            return noData;
        }

        List<Candle> candles = allCandles
            .Skip(Math.Max(0, allCandles.Count - lookbackCandleCount))
            .ToList();

        DateTime startUtc = candles[0].Time;
        DateTime endUtcExclusive = candles[^1].Time.AddMinutes(ResolveTimeframeMinutes(timeframe));
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings = BuildSrChampionShadowSettings(request);

        SrBacktestResult backtest = new SrTradeBacktestEngine().Run(
            symbol,
            timeframe,
            startUtc,
            endUtcExclusive,
            candles,
            settings,
            saveOutputFiles: false,
            calculateBestR: false);

        SrTradeLogRow? srSignal = backtest.Rows
            .Where(x => x.Status == SrTradeStatus.Placed)
            .Where(x => x.Result.StartsWith("OPEN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .Where(x => x.Direction.HasValue && x.Entry.HasValue && x.StopLoss.HasValue && x.TakeProfit.HasValue)
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.SignalTime)
            .FirstOrDefault();

        var result = BuildBase(request, symbol, timeframe, warnings);
        ApplyFreshness(result, freshness);
        result.CandlesLoaded = candles.Count;
        result.CandleStartUtc = startUtc;
        result.CandleEndUtc = candles[^1].Time;

        if (srSignal == null)
        {
            SrTradeLogRow? lastRow = backtest.Rows
                .OrderByDescending(x => x.SignalTime)
                .FirstOrDefault();

            result.Success = false;
            result.Message = "SR LOCAL CHECK - no current OPEN SR strategy signal. NO ORDER SENT.";
            result.SignalStatus = "NO_CURRENT_SIGNAL";
            if (lastRow != null)
            {
                warnings.Add($"Last SR row: {lastRow.SignalTime:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm} Status={lastRow.Status} Result={lastRow.Result} Reason={FirstLine(lastRow.ReasonTrade + lastRow.ReasonMiss)}");
            }

            return result;
        }

        decimal entry = srSignal.Entry!.Value;
        decimal stopLoss = srSignal.StopLoss!.Value;
        decimal takeProfit = srSignal.TakeProfit!.Value;
        decimal slPct = CalculateStopLossPercent(srSignal.Direction!.Value, entry, stopLoss);
        decimal tpPct = CalculateTakeProfitPercent(srSignal.Direction!.Value, entry, takeProfit);

        FillSrFields(result, srSignal, slPct, tpPct);
        result.HasSrSignal = true;
        result.IntendedSide = srSignal.Direction.Value == SrTradeDirection.Long
            ? ExchangeOrderSide.Buy
            : ExchangeOrderSide.Sell;

        if (slPct <= 0m || tpPct <= 0m)
        {
            result.Success = false;
            result.Message = "SR LOCAL CHECK - SR signal found but SL/TP percent calculation is invalid. NO ORDER SENT.";
            result.SignalStatus = "INVALID_SR_RISK";
            warnings.Add($"Invalid SR risk calculation. Entry={entry:F8}, SL={stopLoss:F8}, TP={takeProfit:F8}, SL%={slPct:F4}, TP%={tpPct:F4}.");
            return result;
        }

        result.Success = true;
        result.SignalStatus = "SR_LOCAL_SIGNAL_FOUND_EXCHANGE_PENDING";
        result.Message = "SR LOCAL PASS - current SR signal found. Exchange shadow not checked yet. NO ORDER SENT.";
        return result;
    }

    public async Task<SrStrategySignalShadowResult> EnrichLocalSignalWithExchangeShadowAsync(
        SrStrategySignalShadowResult localSignal,
        SrStrategySignalShadowRequest request,
        TestnetOrderExecutionService exchangeShadowService,
        CancellationToken ct,
        bool writeReport)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(localSignal);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(request);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(exchangeShadowService);

        var warnings = localSignal.Warnings?.ToList() ?? new List<string>();

        if (!localSignal.HasSrSignal || !localSignal.SrStopLossPercent.HasValue || !localSignal.SrTakeProfitPercent.HasValue)
        {
            localSignal.Success = false;
            localSignal.SignalStatus = "NO_LOCAL_SR_SIGNAL_FOR_EXCHANGE_SHADOW";
            localSignal.Message = "SR SHADOW CHECK - no valid local SR signal to validate against exchange. NO ORDER SENT.";
            localSignal.Warnings = warnings;
            if (writeReport)
                new SrStrategySignalShadowReportService().WriteReport(localSignal);
            return localSignal;
        }

        var exchangeRequest = new TestnetOrderExecutionRequest
        {
            Mode = ExchangeMode.BinanceTestnetTrade,
            Symbol = localSignal.Symbol,
            Side = localSignal.IntendedSide,
            TradeSizeUsdt = request.TradeSizeUsdt,
            MaxTradeSizeUsdt = request.MaxTradeSizeUsdt,
            Leverage = request.Leverage,
            StopLossPercent = localSignal.SrStopLossPercent.Value,
            TakeProfitPercent = localSignal.SrTakeProfitPercent.Value,
            RequireNoExistingPosition = true,
            RequireNoOpenOrders = true
        };

        TestnetStrategyShadowResult exchangeShadow = await exchangeShadowService.BuildStrategyShadowSignalAsync(exchangeRequest, ct);

        localSignal.SignalStatus = exchangeShadow.Success
            ? "SR_SIGNAL_EXCHANGE_SHADOW_PASS"
            : "SR_SIGNAL_EXCHANGE_SHADOW_BLOCKED";
        localSignal.Success = exchangeShadow.Success;
        localSignal.Message = exchangeShadow.Success
            ? "SR SHADOW PASS - local SR signal found and exchange safety shadow passed. NO ORDER SENT."
            : "SR SHADOW CHECK - local SR signal found but exchange safety blocked. NO ORDER SENT.";
        localSignal.ExchangeShadow = exchangeShadow;
        localSignal.ExchangeShadowReportPath = exchangeShadow.ReportPath;
        localSignal.Warnings = warnings.Concat(exchangeShadow.Warnings ?? Array.Empty<string>()).ToList();

        if (writeReport)
            new SrStrategySignalShadowReportService().WriteReport(localSignal);

        return localSignal;
    }

    private static SrStrategySignalShadowResult BuildBase(SrStrategySignalShadowRequest request, string symbol, string timeframe, List<string> warnings)
    {
        return new SrStrategySignalShadowResult
        {
            GeneratedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,
            Symbol = symbol,
            Timeframe = timeframe,
            StrategyProfile = "SR_V8_10_3T_C1_CLEAN_CHAMPION_MAINNET_TESTNET_PRICE_COMPAT",
            Warnings = warnings
        };
    }

    private static void ApplyFreshness(SrStrategySignalShadowResult result, SrCandleFreshnessUpdateResult freshness)
    {
        result.CandleFreshnessStatus = freshness.Status;
        result.CandleFreshnessMessage = freshness.Message;
        result.CandleFreshnessPassed = freshness.Success;
        result.CandleDataPath = freshness.CandleFilePath;
        result.BinanceKlineEndpoint = freshness.BinanceKlineEndpoint;
        result.FreshnessCurrentUtc = freshness.CurrentUtc;
        result.CurrentOpenCandleUtc = freshness.CurrentOpenCandleUtc;
        result.ExpectedLatestClosedCandleUtc = freshness.ExpectedLatestClosedCandleUtc;
        result.LatestLocalCandleBeforeUpdateUtc = freshness.LatestLocalBeforeUtc;
        result.LatestLocalCandleAfterUpdateUtc = freshness.LatestLocalAfterUtc;
        result.LocalCandlesBeforeUpdate = freshness.LocalCandlesBefore;
        result.LocalCandlesAfterUpdate = freshness.LocalCandlesAfter;
        result.DownloadedCandles = freshness.DownloadedCandles;
        result.DownloadBatches = freshness.DownloadBatches;
        result.LagCandlesBeforeUpdate = freshness.LagCandlesBefore;
        result.LagCandlesAfterUpdate = freshness.LagCandlesAfter;
        result.MaxAllowedLagCandles = freshness.MaxAllowedLagCandles;
        result.BinanceKlineUpdateAttempted = freshness.UpdateAttempted;
    }

    private static void FillSrFields(SrStrategySignalShadowResult result, SrTradeLogRow row, decimal slPct, decimal tpPct)
    {
        result.SrDirection = row.Direction?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
        result.SrOrderType = row.OrderType?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
        result.SrType = row.SrType;
        result.SrSignalTimeUtc = row.SignalTime;
        result.SrEntryTimeUtc = row.EntryTime;
        result.SrBacktestResult = row.Result;
        result.SrEntryPrice = row.Entry;
        result.SrStopLossPrice = row.StopLoss;
        result.SrTakeProfitPrice = row.TakeProfit;
        result.SrRisk = row.Risk;
        result.SrTargetR = row.TargetR;
        result.SrScore = row.Score;
        result.SrRsi14 = row.Rsi14;
        result.SrAtr14 = row.Atr14;
        result.SrStopLossPercent = slPct;
        result.SrTakeProfitPercent = tpPct;
        result.SrReason = row.ReasonTrade;
    }

    private static SrTradeBacktestSettings BuildSrChampionShadowSettings(SrStrategySignalShadowRequest request)
    {
        decimal leverage = request.Leverage > 0 ? request.Leverage : 2m;
        decimal margin = leverage > 0 ? request.TradeSizeUsdt / leverage : request.TradeSizeUsdt;

        return new SrTradeBacktestSettings(
            EnableMO: false,
            EnableLO: false,
            EnableSO: true,
            EnableLong: true,
            EnableShort: true,
            StopLossAtrMultiplier: 0.35m,
            TargetR: 0.75m,
            StartEquityUsdt: 1000m,
            TradeSizeUsdt: request.TradeSizeUsdt,
            Leverage: leverage,
            MarginUsdt: margin,
            EnableTrailingStopLoss: true,
            TrailStopAtrMultiplier: 0.75m,
            TrailActivationR: 1.00m,
            EnableScoreRule: true,
            MinimumLoScore: 85m,
            MinimumSoScore: 60m,
            MinimumMoScore: 100m,
            EnableRsiRule: true,
            RsiSupportMin: 30m,
            RsiSupportMax: 58m,
            RsiResistanceMin: 42m,
            RsiResistanceMax: 70m,
            RsiBreakoutLongMin: 50m,
            RsiBreakoutLongMax: 78m,
            RsiBreakdownShortMin: 22m,
            RsiBreakdownShortMax: 50m,
            EnableMacdRule: true,
            EnableVolumeRule: true,
            RetestVolumeMultiplier: 1.35m,
            BreakoutVolumeMultiplier: 1.15m,
            EnableCandleRule: true,
            MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent: 50m,
            MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent: 50m,
            MinimumRejectionWickPercent: 25m,
            EnableDistanceRule: true,
            MaxRetestDistanceAtr: 0.50m,
            MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr: 3.00m);
    }

    private static decimal CalculateStopLossPercent(SrTradeDirection direction, decimal entry, decimal stopLoss)
    {
        if (entry <= 0m)
            return 0m;

        return direction == SrTradeDirection.Long
            ? Math.Max(0m, (entry - stopLoss) / entry * 100m)
            : Math.Max(0m, (stopLoss - entry) / entry * 100m);
    }

    private static decimal CalculateTakeProfitPercent(SrTradeDirection direction, decimal entry, decimal takeProfit)
    {
        if (entry <= 0m)
            return 0m;

        return direction == SrTradeDirection.Long
            ? Math.Max(0m, (takeProfit - entry) / entry * 100m)
            : Math.Max(0m, (entry - takeProfit) / entry * 100m);
    }

    private static int ResolveLookbackCandleCount(string timeframe)
    {
        // V8.10.3T speed fix: keep minimum-history gate at 3000 candles in scanner service,
        // but run the live 1h SR detection on the latest 360 candles to avoid 20+ minute scans.
        // This is for catching fresh 0-2 candle signals only; no order is sent in this version.
        return timeframe.Trim().ToLowerInvariant() switch
        {
            "1m" => 6000,
            "3m" => 6000,
            "5m" => 6000,
            "15m" => 5000,
            "30m" => 4000,
            "1h" => 360,
            "2h" => 2500,
            "4h" => 2000,
            "6h" => 1600,
            "8h" => 1400,
            "12h" => 1200,
            "1d" => 900,
            _ => 2500
        };
    }

    private static int ResolveTimeframeMinutes(string timeframe)
    {
        return timeframe.Trim().ToLowerInvariant() switch
        {
            "1m" => 1,
            "3m" => 3,
            "5m" => 5,
            "15m" => 15,
            "30m" => 30,
            "1h" => 60,
            "2h" => 120,
            "4h" => 240,
            "6h" => 360,
            "8h" => 480,
            "12h" => 720,
            "1d" => 1440,
            _ => 60
        };
    }

    private static string NormalizeSymbol(string symbol)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Symbol is required for SR shadow mode.");

        return symbol.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
    }

    private static string NormalizeTimeframe(string timeframe)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(timeframe))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Timeframe is required for SR shadow mode. Example: 1h or 4h.");

        return timeframe.Trim();
    }

    private static string FirstLine(string text)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
            return string.Empty;

        return text.Replace("\r", "\n").Split('\n', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).FirstOrDefault()?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
    }
}

    }

    private static string Safe(string value) => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ? "N/A" : value;

    private static string FormatLag(int value)
        => value == int.MaxValue ? "N/A" : value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

    private static string FormatDate(DateTime? value)
        => value.HasValue ? value.Value.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "N/A";

    private static string FormatDecimal(decimal? value, int decimals)
        => value.HasValue ? value.Value.ToString("F" + decimals, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "N/A";
}

internal sealed record SrBacktestResult(
    string Symbol,
    string Timeframe,
    DateTime StartUtc,
    DateTime EndUtcExclusive,
    List<SrTradeLogRow> Rows,
    string CsvPath,
    string TxtPath,
    string XlsxPath,
    decimal BestR,
    decimal BestExpectancy,
    int WinCount,
    int LossCount,
    int OpenCount)
{
    public SrTradeBacktestSettings Settings { get; init; } = SrTradeBacktestSettings.Default;
}

internal sealed class SrTradeBacktestEngine
{
    private const decimal DefaultTargetR = 2.0m;

    // V2 safer execution policy based on first trade-log review.
    // MO is disabled for now because direct market entries produced most bad trades and invalid SL-side cases.
    private const bool EnableMarketOrders = false;

    private const decimal MinimumLoScore = 75m;
    private const decimal MinimumSoScore = 75m;
    private const decimal MinimumMoScore = 85m;

    // Do not chase retest entries far away from the SR zone.
    private const decimal MaxRetestDistanceAtr = 0.50m;

    // Breakout candle quality filters.
    private const decimal MinimumBreakoutBodyToRange = 0.35m;
    private const decimal MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickToRange = 0.50m;
    private const decimal MaximumBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr = 1.25m;

    public SrBacktestResult Run(
        string symbol,
        string timeframe,
        DateTime startUtc,
        DateTime endUtcExclusive,
        List<Candle> selectedCandlesOnly,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings? settings = null,
        bool saveOutputFiles = true,
        bool calculateBestR = true)
    {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol);
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(timeframe);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(selectedCandlesOnly);

        settings = NormalizeFinancialSettings(settings ?? SrTradeBacktestSettings.Default);
        DateTime runUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;

        List<Candle> candles = selectedCandlesOnly
            .Where(c => c.Time >= startUtc && c.Time < endUtcExclusive)
            .OrderBy(c => c.Time)
            .ToList();

        var rows = new List<SrTradeLogRow>();

        if (candles.Count < 30)
        {
            rows.Add(BuildNoSetupRow(
                1,
                startUtc,
                symbol,
                timeframe,
                "Not enough selected-date candles to create mature SR zones."));
        }
        else
        {
            RunBacktest(symbol, timeframe, candles, rows, settings.TargetR, settings);
        }

        ApplyRunFinancialFields(rows, settings, runUtc);

        BestRResult bestR = calculateBestR
            ? FindBestR(symbol, timeframe, candles, settings)
            : new BestRResult(settings.TargetR, 0m);

        string csvPath = string.Empty;
        string txtPath = string.Empty;
        string xlsxPath = string.Empty;

        if (saveOutputFiles)
        {
            SaveTradeLogs(
                symbol,
                timeframe,
                startUtc,
                endUtcExclusive,
                rows,
                bestR,
                settings,
                out csvPath,
                out txtPath,
                out xlsxPath);
        }

        int wins = rows.Count(x => x.Result == "WIN" || x.Result == "TRAIL_WIN");
        int losses = rows.Count(x => x.Result == "LOSS");
        int open = rows.Count(x => x.Result.StartsWith("OPEN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

        return new SrBacktestResult(
            symbol,
            timeframe,
            startUtc,
            endUtcExclusive,
            rows,
            csvPath,
            txtPath,
            xlsxPath,
            bestR.BestR,
            bestR.Expectancy,
            wins,
            losses,
            open)
        {
            Settings = settings
        };
    }

    private static void RunBacktest(
        string symbol,
        string timeframe,
        List<Candle> candles,
        List<SrTradeLogRow> rows,
        decimal targetR,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings)
    {
        int warmupCandles = GetWarmupCandles(timeframe);
        int rowNumber = 1;

        for (int i = warmupCandles; i < candles.Count - 2; i++)
        {
            Candle signal = candles[i];
            List<SrTradeZone> zones = BuildMatureSrZones(candles, i, timeframe, settings);
            if (zones.Count == 0)
                continue;

            IndicatorSnapshot ind = BuildIndicators(candles, i);

            SrTradeCandidate? candidate = BuildBestCandidate(
                candles,
                i,
                zones,
                ind,
                targetR,
                settings,
                out string missReason);

            if (candidate == null)
            {
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(missReason))
                    rows.Add(BuildMissedRow(rowNumber++, signal.Time, symbol, timeframe, ind, missReason));

                continue;
            }

            SrTradeLogRow placed = SimulateCandidate(rowNumber++, symbol, timeframe, candles, i, candidate, ind);
            rows.Add(placed);

            if (placed.ExitTime.HasValue)
            {
                int exitIndex = candles.FindIndex(x => x.Time == placed.ExitTime.Value);
                if (exitIndex > i)
                    i = exitIndex;
            }
        }
    }

    private static SrTradeCandidate? BuildBestCandidate(
        List<Candle> candles,
        int signalIndex,
        List<SrTradeZone> zones,
        IndicatorSnapshot ind,
        decimal targetR,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings,
        out string missReason)
    {
        Candle c = candles[signalIndex];
        var candidates = new List<SrTradeCandidate>();
        var misses = new List<string>();

        void TryAddCandidate(SrTradeCandidate candidate, decimal minimumScore, string setupName)
        {
            if (candidate.Direction == SrTradeDirection.Long && !settings.EnableLong)
            {
                misses.Add($"{setupName} rejected: Long disabled from UI.");
                return;
            }

            if (candidate.Direction == SrTradeDirection.Short && !settings.EnableShort)
            {
                misses.Add($"{setupName} rejected: Short disabled from UI.");
                return;
            }

            if (candidate.OrderType == SrOrderType.MO && !settings.EnableMO)
            {
                misses.Add($"{setupName} rejected: MO disabled from UI.");
                return;
            }

            if (candidate.OrderType == SrOrderType.LO && !settings.EnableLO)
            {
                misses.Add($"{setupName} rejected: LO disabled from UI.");
                return;
            }

            if (candidate.OrderType == SrOrderType.SO && !settings.EnableSO)
            {
                misses.Add($"{setupName} rejected: SO disabled from UI.");
                return;
            }

            if (candidate.Score < minimumScore)
            {
                misses.Add($"{setupName} score {candidate.Score:0.0} < {minimumScore:0.0}. {candidate.Reason}");
                return;
            }

            if (!IsCandidateRiskValid(candidate, out string riskReason))
            {
                misses.Add($"{setupName} rejected: {riskReason}");
                return;
            }

            if (!IsCandidateDistanceValid(candidate, c, ind, settings, out string distanceReason))
            {
                misses.Add($"{setupName} rejected: {distanceReason}");
                return;
            }

            if (candidate.OrderType == SrOrderType.SO && !IsBreakoutCandleValid(candidate, c, ind, settings, out string breakoutReason))
            {
                misses.Add($"{setupName} rejected: {breakoutReason}");
                return;
            }

            candidates.Add(candidate);
        }

        foreach (SrTradeZone zone in zones.Where(z => CandleTouchesZone(c, z)).OrderByDescending(z => z.Score).Take(3))
        {
            if (zone.IsSupport)
            {
                decimal score = ScoreLongAtSupport(c, zone, ind, settings, out string reason);
                SrTradeCandidate candidate = BuildLongSupportCandidate(c, zone, ind, score, reason, targetR, settings);
                TryAddCandidate(candidate, settings.EnableScoreRule ? settings.MinimumLoScore : 0m, "Support retest LO long");
            }
            else
            {
                decimal score = ScoreShortAtResistance(c, zone, ind, settings, out string reason);
                SrTradeCandidate candidate = BuildShortResistanceCandidate(c, zone, ind, score, reason, targetR, settings);
                TryAddCandidate(candidate, settings.EnableScoreRule ? settings.MinimumLoScore : 0m, "Resistance retest LO short");
            }
        }

        SrTradeZone? breakoutResistance = zones
            .Where(z => !z.IsSupport && c.Close > z.Upper)
            .OrderByDescending(z => z.Score)
            .FirstOrDefault();

        if (breakoutResistance != null)
        {
            decimal score = ScoreLongBreakout(c, breakoutResistance, ind, settings, out string reason);
            SrTradeCandidate candidate = BuildLongBreakoutCandidate(breakoutResistance, ind, score, reason, targetR, settings);
            TryAddCandidate(candidate, settings.EnableScoreRule ? settings.MinimumSoScore : 0m, "Resistance breakout SO long");
        }

        SrTradeZone? breakdownSupport = zones
            .Where(z => z.IsSupport && c.Close < z.Lower)
            .OrderByDescending(z => z.Score)
            .FirstOrDefault();

        if (breakdownSupport != null)
        {
            decimal score = ScoreShortBreakdown(c, breakdownSupport, ind, settings, out string reason);
            SrTradeCandidate candidate = BuildShortBreakdownCandidate(breakdownSupport, ind, score, reason, targetR, settings);
            TryAddCandidate(candidate, settings.EnableScoreRule ? settings.MinimumSoScore : 0m, "Support breakdown SO short");
        }

        missReason = string.Join(" | ", misses);

        return candidates
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.OrderType == SrOrderType.SO ? 1 : 0)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.Score)
            .ThenByDescending(x => x.Zone.Score)
            .FirstOrDefault();
    }

    private static SrTradeCandidate BuildLongSupportCandidate(
        Candle c,
        SrTradeZone zone,
        IndicatorSnapshot ind,
        decimal score,
        string reason,
        decimal targetR,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings)
    {
        SrOrderType orderType = settings.EnableMO && HasBullishRejection(c, settings.MinimumRejectionWickPercent) && score >= (settings.EnableScoreRule ? settings.MinimumMoScore : 0m)
            ? SrOrderType.MO
            : SrOrderType.LO;

        decimal entry = orderType == SrOrderType.MO ? c.Close : zone.Price;
        decimal sl = zone.Lower - (ind.Atr14 * settings.StopLossAtrMultiplier);
        decimal risk = Math.Max(entry - sl, ind.Atr14 * 0.10m);
        decimal tp = entry + (risk * targetR);

        return new SrTradeCandidate(
            orderType,
            SrTradeDirection.Long,
            zone,
            entry,
            sl,
            tp,
            risk,
            targetR,
            score,
            $"LONG near support. Safe retest. {reason}")
        {
            TrailStopEnabled = settings.EnableTrailingStopLoss,
            TrailStopAtrMultiplier = settings.TrailStopAtrMultiplier,
            TrailActivationR = settings.TrailActivationR
        };
    }

    private static SrTradeCandidate BuildShortResistanceCandidate(
        Candle c,
        SrTradeZone zone,
        IndicatorSnapshot ind,
        decimal score,
        string reason,
        decimal targetR,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings)
    {
        SrOrderType orderType = settings.EnableMO && HasBearishRejection(c, settings.MinimumRejectionWickPercent) && score >= (settings.EnableScoreRule ? settings.MinimumMoScore : 0m)
            ? SrOrderType.MO
            : SrOrderType.LO;

        decimal entry = orderType == SrOrderType.MO ? c.Close : zone.Price;
        decimal sl = zone.Upper + (ind.Atr14 * settings.StopLossAtrMultiplier);
        decimal risk = Math.Max(sl - entry, ind.Atr14 * 0.10m);
        decimal tp = entry - (risk * targetR);

        return new SrTradeCandidate(
            orderType,
            SrTradeDirection.Short,
            zone,
            entry,
            sl,
            tp,
            risk,
            targetR,
            score,
            $"SHORT near resistance. Safe retest. {reason}")
        {
            TrailStopEnabled = settings.EnableTrailingStopLoss,
            TrailStopAtrMultiplier = settings.TrailStopAtrMultiplier,
            TrailActivationR = settings.TrailActivationR
        };
    }

    private static SrTradeCandidate BuildLongBreakoutCandidate(
        SrTradeZone zone,
        IndicatorSnapshot ind,
        decimal score,
        string reason,
        decimal targetR,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings)
    {
        decimal entry = zone.Upper + (ind.Atr14 * 0.15m);
        decimal sl = zone.Lower - (ind.Atr14 * settings.StopLossAtrMultiplier);
        decimal risk = Math.Max(entry - sl, ind.Atr14 * 0.10m);
        decimal tp = entry + (risk * targetR);

        return new SrTradeCandidate(
            SrOrderType.SO,
            SrTradeDirection.Long,
            zone,
            entry,
            sl,
            tp,
            risk,
            targetR,
            score,
            $"LONG breakout above resistance. {reason}")
        {
            TrailStopEnabled = settings.EnableTrailingStopLoss,
            TrailStopAtrMultiplier = settings.TrailStopAtrMultiplier,
            TrailActivationR = settings.TrailActivationR
        };
    }

    private static SrTradeCandidate BuildShortBreakdownCandidate(
        SrTradeZone zone,
        IndicatorSnapshot ind,
        decimal score,
        string reason,
        decimal targetR,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings)
    {
        decimal entry = zone.Lower - (ind.Atr14 * 0.15m);

        decimal tp = entry - (risk * targetR);

        return new SrTradeCandidate(
            SrOrderType.SO,

            zone,
            entry,
            sl,

            risk,

            score,
            $"SHORT breakdown below support. {reason}")
        {

            TrailActivationR = settings.TrailActivationR
