    private static SrTradeLogRow SimulateCandidate(int rowNumber, string symbol, string timeframe, List<Candle> candles, int signalIndex, SrTradeCandidate candidate, IndicatorSnapshot ind)
    {
        Candle signal = candles[signalIndex];

        if (!IsCandidateRiskValid(candidate, out string invalidRiskReason))
        {
            return new SrTradeLogRow(rowNumber, SrTradeStatus.Missed, signal.Time, symbol, timeframe, candidate.OrderType, candidate.Direction,
                candidate.Zone.IsSupport ? "Support" : "Resistance", candidate.Zone.Price, candidate.Zone.Upper, candidate.Zone.Lower,
                candidate.Entry, candidate.StopLoss, candidate.TakeProfit, candidate.Risk, candidate.TargetR, candidate.TargetR,
                ind.Rsi14, ind.MacdHistogram, ind.MacdHistogramPrevious, ind.Volume, ind.VolumeSma20, ind.Atr14,
                candidate.Score, string.Empty, $"Invalid trade rejected before simulation: {invalidRiskReason}", null, null, null, "INVALID_RISK", null);
        }

        bool filled = false;
        DateTime? entryTime = null;
        DateTime? exitTime = null;
        decimal? exitPrice = null;
        string result = "OPEN";
        decimal? profitR = null;

        decimal activeStopLoss = candidate.StopLoss;
        decimal highestFavorablePrice = candidate.Entry;
        decimal lowestFavorablePrice = candidate.Entry;
        decimal lowestAdversePrice = candidate.Entry;
        decimal highestAdversePrice = candidate.Entry;
        decimal? mfePrice = null;
        decimal? maePrice = null;
        decimal? mfeR = null;
        decimal? maeR = null;

        for (int i = Math.Min(signalIndex + 1, candles.Count - 1); i < candles.Count; i++)
        {
            Candle c = candles[i];

            if (!filled)
            {
                filled = IsOrderFilled(candidate, c);
                if (!filled)
                    continue;

                entryTime = c.Time;

                if (candidate.OrderType == SrOrderType.MO)
                {
                    decimal newEntry = c.Open;

                    if (candidate.Direction == SrTradeDirection.Long)
                    {
                        decimal newRisk = Math.Max(newEntry - activeStopLoss, ind.Atr14 * 0.10m);
                        candidate = candidate with
                        {
                            Entry = newEntry,
                            Risk = newRisk,
                            TakeProfit = newEntry + (newRisk * candidate.TargetR)
                        };
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        decimal newRisk = Math.Max(activeStopLoss - newEntry, ind.Atr14 * 0.10m);
                        candidate = candidate with
                        {
                            Entry = newEntry,
                            Risk = newRisk,
                            TakeProfit = newEntry - (newRisk * candidate.TargetR)
                        };
                    }
                }

                highestFavorablePrice = candidate.Entry;
                lowestFavorablePrice = candidate.Entry;
                lowestAdversePrice = candidate.Entry;
                highestAdversePrice = candidate.Entry;
                mfePrice = candidate.Entry;
                maePrice = candidate.Entry;
                mfeR = 0m;
                maeR = 0m;
            }

            if (candidate.Direction == SrTradeDirection.Long)
            {
                highestFavorablePrice = Math.Max(highestFavorablePrice, c.High);
                lowestAdversePrice = Math.Min(lowestAdversePrice, c.Low);
                mfePrice = highestFavorablePrice;
                maePrice = lowestAdversePrice;
                mfeR = candidate.Risk > 0m ? Math.Max(0m, (highestFavorablePrice - candidate.Entry) / candidate.Risk) : 0m;
                maeR = candidate.Risk > 0m ? Math.Max(0m, (candidate.Entry - lowestAdversePrice) / candidate.Risk) : 0m;

                if (candidate.TrailStopEnabled && ind.Atr14 > 0m)
                {
                    decimal favorableR = (highestFavorablePrice - candidate.Entry) / candidate.Risk;
                    if (favorableR >= candidate.TrailActivationR)
                    {
                        decimal proposedStop = highestFavorablePrice - (ind.Atr14 * candidate.TrailStopAtrMultiplier);
                        if (proposedStop > activeStopLoss && proposedStop < candidate.TakeProfit)
                            activeStopLoss = proposedStop;
                    }
                }

                if (c.Low <= activeStopLoss)
                {
                    exitTime = c.Time;
                    exitPrice = activeStopLoss;
                    profitR = (activeStopLoss - candidate.Entry) / candidate.Risk;
                    result = profitR > 0m ? "TRAIL_WIN" : "LOSS";
                    break;
                }

                if (c.High >= candidate.TakeProfit)
                {
                    exitTime = c.Time;
                    exitPrice = candidate.TakeProfit;
                    result = "WIN";
                    profitR = candidate.TargetR;
                    break;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                lowestFavorablePrice = Math.Min(lowestFavorablePrice, c.Low);
                highestAdversePrice = Math.Max(highestAdversePrice, c.High);
                mfePrice = lowestFavorablePrice;
                maePrice = highestAdversePrice;
                mfeR = candidate.Risk > 0m ? Math.Max(0m, (candidate.Entry - lowestFavorablePrice) / candidate.Risk) : 0m;
                maeR = candidate.Risk > 0m ? Math.Max(0m, (highestAdversePrice - candidate.Entry) / candidate.Risk) : 0m;

                if (candidate.TrailStopEnabled && ind.Atr14 > 0m)
                {
                    decimal favorableR = (candidate.Entry - lowestFavorablePrice) / candidate.Risk;
                    if (favorableR >= candidate.TrailActivationR)
                    {
                        decimal proposedStop = lowestFavorablePrice + (ind.Atr14 * candidate.TrailStopAtrMultiplier);
                        if (proposedStop < activeStopLoss && proposedStop > candidate.TakeProfit)
                            activeStopLoss = proposedStop;
                    }
                }

                if (c.High >= activeStopLoss)
                {
                    exitTime = c.Time;
                    exitPrice = activeStopLoss;
                    profitR = (candidate.Entry - activeStopLoss) / candidate.Risk;
                    result = profitR > 0m ? "TRAIL_WIN" : "LOSS";
                    break;
                }

                if (c.Low <= candidate.TakeProfit)
                {
                    exitTime = c.Time;
                    exitPrice = candidate.TakeProfit;
                    result = "WIN";
                    profitR = candidate.TargetR;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        if (!filled)
        {
            result = "MISS_NOT_FILLED";
            profitR = 0m;
        }

        if (filled && result == "OPEN")
        {
            Candle last = candles[^1];
            exitTime = last.Time;
            exitPrice = last.Close;
            profitR = candidate.Direction == SrTradeDirection.Long
                ? (last.Close - candidate.Entry) / candidate.Risk
                : (candidate.Entry - last.Close) / candidate.Risk;
            result = profitR >= 0m ? "OPEN_PROFIT" : "OPEN_LOSS";
        }

        decimal? mfeCapturePercent = null;
        decimal? maeRiskPercent = null;

        if (mfeR.HasValue && mfeR.Value > 0m && profitR.HasValue)
        {
            // MFE Capture must show how much favorable excursion was captured.
            // Losses after MFE should count as 0% capture, not negative capture.
            // Values above 100% are capped to avoid impossible/unstable summary averages.
            decimal capturedR = profitR.Value > 0m ? profitR.Value : 0m;
            decimal capture = (capturedR / mfeR.Value) * 100m;

            if (capture < 0m)
                capture = 0m;

            if (capture > 100m)
                capture = 100m;

            mfeCapturePercent = capture;
        }

        if (maeR.HasValue)
            maeRiskPercent = maeR.Value * 100m;

        var tradeRow = new SrTradeLogRow(rowNumber, SrTradeStatus.Placed, signal.Time, symbol, timeframe, candidate.OrderType, candidate.Direction,
            candidate.Zone.IsSupport ? "Support" : "Resistance", candidate.Zone.Price, candidate.Zone.Upper, candidate.Zone.Lower,
            candidate.Entry, activeStopLoss, candidate.TakeProfit, candidate.Risk, candidate.TargetR, profitR,
            ind.Rsi14, ind.MacdHistogram, ind.MacdHistogramPrevious, ind.Volume, ind.VolumeSma20, ind.Atr14, candidate.Score,
            candidate.Reason, string.Empty, entryTime, exitTime, exitPrice, result, profitR)
        {
            MfePrice = filled ? mfePrice : null,
            MaePrice = filled ? maePrice : null,
            MfeR = filled ? mfeR : null,
            MaeR = filled ? maeR : null,
            MfeCapturePercent = filled ? mfeCapturePercent : null,
            MaeRiskPercent = filled ? maeRiskPercent : null,
            TradeQualityGrade = BuildTradeQualityGrade(result, profitR, mfeR, maeR, mfeCapturePercent),
            TradeQualityNote = BuildTradeQualityNote(result, profitR, mfeR, maeR, mfeCapturePercent)
        };

        return tradeRow;
    }

    private static string BuildTradeQualityGrade(
        string result,
        decimal? profitR,
        decimal? mfeR,
        decimal? maeR,
        decimal? mfeCapturePercent)
    {
        if (!profitR.HasValue || !mfeR.HasValue || !maeR.HasValue)
            return string.Empty;

        bool isWin = profitR.Value > 0m;
        bool isLoss = result.Equals("LOSS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        if (isWin && maeR.Value <= 0.35m && mfeCapturePercent.GetValueOrDefault() >= 75m)
            return "A+ Excellent";

        if (isWin && maeR.Value <= 0.60m && mfeCapturePercent.GetValueOrDefault() >= 55m)
            return "A Good";

        if (isWin && mfeCapturePercent.GetValueOrDefault() < 40m)
            return "B Won but poor capture";

        if (isLoss && mfeR.Value >= 1.0m)
            return "C Loss after +1R MFE";

        if (isLoss && maeR.Value >= 0.80m && mfeR.Value < 0.50m)
            return "D Weak entry";

        if (isLoss)
            return "C Loss";

        return "B Neutral";
    }

    private static string BuildTradeQualityNote(
        string result,
        decimal? profitR,
        decimal? mfeR,
        decimal? maeR,
        decimal? mfeCapturePercent)
    {
        if (!profitR.HasValue || !mfeR.HasValue || !maeR.HasValue)
            return string.Empty;

        var notes = new List<string>();

        if (maeR.Value > 0.80m)
            notes.Add("Entry had high adverse movement; improve entry timing or require stronger SR confirmation.");
        else if (maeR.Value <= 0.35m)
            notes.Add("Entry quality good: low adverse movement.");

        if (mfeR.Value >= 1.0m && profitR.Value <= 0m)
            notes.Add("Trade reached +1R MFE but closed loss; use breakeven/trailing after +1R.");

        if (profitR.Value > 0m && mfeCapturePercent.GetValueOrDefault() < 40m)
            notes.Add("Exit captured low part of available move; optimize TP/trailing stop.");

        if (profitR.Value > 0m && mfeCapturePercent.GetValueOrDefault() >= 70m)
            notes.Add("Exit quality strong: captured most available movement.");

        if (mfeR.Value < 0.50m && profitR.Value <= 0m)
            notes.Add("Setup had weak follow-through; add volume/body/trend filter.");

        return string.Join(" ", notes);
    }

    private static bool IsCandidateRiskValid(SrTradeCandidate candidate, out string reason)
    {
        reason = string.Empty;

        if (candidate.Risk <= 0m)
        {
            reason = "risk is zero or negative";
            return false;
        }

        if (candidate.Direction == SrTradeDirection.Long)
        {
            if (candidate.StopLoss >= candidate.Entry)
            {
                reason = $"long SL must be below entry. Entry={candidate.Entry:0.########}, SL={candidate.StopLoss:0.########}";
                return false;
            }

            if (candidate.TakeProfit <= candidate.Entry)
            {
                reason = $"long TP must be above entry. Entry={candidate.Entry:0.########}, TP={candidate.TakeProfit:0.########}";
                return false;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (candidate.StopLoss <= candidate.Entry)
            {
                reason = $"short SL must be above entry. Entry={candidate.Entry:0.########}, SL={candidate.StopLoss:0.########}";
                return false;
            }

            if (candidate.TakeProfit >= candidate.Entry)
            {
                reason = $"short TP must be below entry. Entry={candidate.Entry:0.########}, TP={candidate.TakeProfit:0.########}";
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static bool IsCandidateDistanceValid(
        SrTradeCandidate candidate,
        Candle signal,
        IndicatorSnapshot ind,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings,
        out string reason)
    {
        reason = string.Empty;

        if (!settings.EnableDistanceRule)
            return true;

        if (ind.Atr14 <= 0m)
        {
            reason = "ATR is zero";
            return false;
        }

        if (candidate.OrderType == SrOrderType.SO)
            return true;

        decimal distanceFromZone = 0m;

        if (candidate.Entry > candidate.Zone.Upper)
            distanceFromZone = candidate.Entry - candidate.Zone.Upper;
        else if (candidate.Entry < candidate.Zone.Lower)
            distanceFromZone = candidate.Zone.Lower - candidate.Entry;

        decimal maxDistance = ind.Atr14 * settings.MaxRetestDistanceAtr;

        if (distanceFromZone > maxDistance)
        {
            reason = $"entry too far from SR zone. Distance={distanceFromZone:0.########}, Max={maxDistance:0.########}";
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static bool IsBreakoutCandleValid(
        SrTradeCandidate candidate,
        Candle signal,
        IndicatorSnapshot ind,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings,
        out string reason)
    {
        reason = string.Empty;

        if (!settings.EnableCandleRule && !settings.EnableDistanceRule)
            return true;

        decimal range = signal.High - signal.Low;
        if (range <= 0m)
        {
            reason = "breakout candle range is zero";
            return false;
        }

        if (settings.EnableCandleRule)
        {
            decimal body = Math.Abs(signal.Close - signal.Open);
            decimal minimumBodyRatio = settings.MinimumBreakoutBodyPercent / 100m;
            if (body < range * minimumBodyRatio)
            {
                reason = $"weak breakout body. Body/Range={(body / range):0.00}; Required={minimumBodyRatio:0.00}";
                return false;
            }
        }

        decimal maximumWickRatio = settings.MaximumBreakoutRejectionWickPercent / 100m;

        if (candidate.Direction == SrTradeDirection.Long)
        {
            if (signal.Close <= candidate.Zone.Upper)
            {
                reason = "long breakout candle did not close above resistance zone";
                return false;
            }

            if (settings.EnableCandleRule)
            {
                decimal upperWick = signal.High - Math.Max(signal.Open, signal.Close);
                if (upperWick > range * maximumWickRatio)
                {
                    reason = $"long breakout has large upper rejection wick. Wick/Range={(upperWick / range):0.00}; Max={maximumWickRatio:0.00}";
                    return false;
                }
            }

            if (settings.EnableDistanceRule && ind.Atr14 > 0m && signal.Close > candidate.Zone.Upper + (ind.Atr14 * settings.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr))
            {
                reason = "long breakout close is too far from SR zone; avoid chasing";
                return false;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (signal.Close >= candidate.Zone.Lower)
            {
                reason = "short breakdown candle did not close below support zone";
                return false;
            }

            if (settings.EnableCandleRule)
            {
                decimal lowerWick = Math.Min(signal.Open, signal.Close) - signal.Low;
                if (lowerWick > range * maximumWickRatio)
                {
                    reason = $"short breakdown has large lower rejection wick. Wick/Range={(lowerWick / range):0.00}; Max={maximumWickRatio:0.00}";
                    return false;
                }
            }

            if (settings.EnableDistanceRule && ind.Atr14 > 0m && signal.Close < candidate.Zone.Lower - (ind.Atr14 * settings.MaxBreakoutCloseDistanceAtr))
            {
                reason = "short breakdown close is too far from SR zone; avoid chasing";
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static bool IsOrderFilled(SrTradeCandidate candidate, Candle c) => candidate.OrderType switch
    {
        SrOrderType.MO => true,
        SrOrderType.LO when candidate.Direction == SrTradeDirection.Long => c.Low <= candidate.Entry,
        SrOrderType.LO when candidate.Direction == SrTradeDirection.Short => c.High >= candidate.Entry,
        SrOrderType.SO when candidate.Direction == SrTradeDirection.Long => c.High >= candidate.Entry,
        SrOrderType.SO when candidate.Direction == SrTradeDirection.Short => c.Low <= candidate.Entry,
        _ => false
    };

    private static List<SrTradeZone> BuildMatureSrZones(
        List<Candle> candles,
        int activeIndex,
        string timeframe,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings)
    {
        int lookback = GetSrLookbackCandles(timeframe);
        int start = Math.Max(0, activeIndex - lookback);
        int end = activeIndex;

        if (end - start < 30)
            return new List<SrTradeZone>();

        List<Candle> window = candles.Skip(start).Take(end - start).ToList();

        decimal atr = CalculateAtr(candles, Math.Max(0, activeIndex - 1), 14);
        if (atr <= 0m)
            return new List<SrTradeZone>();

        decimal zoneHalfWidth = atr * settings.StopLossAtrMultiplier;

        const int pivotStrength = 3;
        var pivots = new List<SrPivot>();

        for (int i = pivotStrength; i < window.Count - pivotStrength; i++)
        {
            bool swingHigh = true;
            bool swingLow = true;

            for (int j = 1; j <= pivotStrength; j++)
            {
                if (window[i].High <= window[i - j].High || window[i].High <= window[i + j].High)
                    swingHigh = false;

                if (window[i].Low >= window[i - j].Low || window[i].Low >= window[i + j].Low)
                    swingLow = false;
            }

            int realIndex = start + i;

            if (swingHigh)
                pivots.Add(new SrPivot(window[i].High, realIndex, false));

            if (swingLow)
                pivots.Add(new SrPivot(window[i].Low, realIndex, true));
        }

        if (pivots.Count == 0)
            return new List<SrTradeZone>();

        return BuildPivotClusters(pivots, zoneHalfWidth)
            .Where(x => x.Touches >= 2)
            .Select(x =>
            {
                decimal price = x.Price;
                decimal score = (x.Touches * 20m) + (100m / Math.Max(1, activeIndex - x.LastTouchIndex));

                return new SrTradeZone(
                    price,
                    price + zoneHalfWidth,
                    price - zoneHalfWidth,
                    x.IsSupport,
                    x.Touches,
                    score,
                    candles[x.FirstTouchIndex].Time,
                    candles[x.LastTouchIndex].Time);
            })
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.Score)
            .Take(12)
            .ToList();
    }

    private static List<SrPivotCluster> BuildPivotClusters(List<SrPivot> pivots, decimal zoneHalfWidth)
    {
        var clusters = new List<SrPivotCluster>();
        foreach (SrPivot pivot in pivots.OrderBy(x => x.Price))
        {
            SrPivotCluster? cluster = clusters
                .Where(x => x.IsSupport == pivot.IsSupport && Math.Abs(x.Price - pivot.Price) <= zoneHalfWidth * 2m)
                .OrderBy(x => Math.Abs(x.Price - pivot.Price))
                .FirstOrDefault();
            if (cluster == null) { cluster = new SrPivotCluster(pivot.IsSupport); clusters.Add(cluster); }
            cluster.Add(pivot);
        }
        return clusters;
    }

    private static bool CandleTouchesZone(Candle candle, SrTradeZone zone) => candle.Low <= zone.Upper && candle.High >= zone.Lower;

    private static decimal ScoreLongAtSupport(
        Candle c,
        SrTradeZone zone,
        IndicatorSnapshot ind,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings,
        out string reason)
    {
        decimal score = 0m;
        var parts = new List<string>();

        decimal srScore = Math.Min(30m, zone.Score / 4m);
        score += srScore;
        parts.Add($"SR={srScore:0.0}");

        if (settings.EnableRsiRule && ind.Rsi14 >= settings.RsiSupportMin && ind.Rsi14 <= settings.RsiSupportMax)
        {
            score += 15m;
            parts.Add($"RSI support zone {settings.RsiSupportMin:0}-{settings.RsiSupportMax:0}");
        }

        if (settings.EnableMacdRule && ind.MacdHistogram > ind.MacdHistogramPrevious)
        {
            score += 15m;
            parts.Add("MACD rising");
        }

        if (settings.EnableVolumeRule && ind.VolumeSma20 > 0m && ind.Volume >= ind.VolumeSma20 * settings.RetestVolumeMultiplier)
        {
            score += 15m;
            parts.Add($"volume confirmation >= {settings.RetestVolumeMultiplier:0.00}x");
        }

        if (ind.Atr14 > 0m)
        {
            score += 10m;
            parts.Add("ATR healthy");
        }

        if (settings.EnableCandleRule && HasBullishRejection(c, settings.MinimumRejectionWickPercent))
        {
            score += 15m;
            parts.Add($"bullish rejection wick >= {settings.MinimumRejectionWickPercent:0}%");
        }

        reason = string.Join("; ", parts);
        return Math.Min(100m, score);
    }

    private static decimal ScoreShortAtResistance(
        Candle c,
        SrTradeZone zone,
        IndicatorSnapshot ind,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings,
        out string reason)
    {
        decimal score = 0m;
        var parts = new List<string>();

        decimal srScore = Math.Min(30m, zone.Score / 4m);
        score += srScore;
        parts.Add($"SR={srScore:0.0}");

        if (settings.EnableRsiRule && ind.Rsi14 >= settings.RsiResistanceMin && ind.Rsi14 <= settings.RsiResistanceMax)
        {
            score += 15m;
            parts.Add($"RSI resistance zone {settings.RsiResistanceMin:0}-{settings.RsiResistanceMax:0}");
        }

        if (settings.EnableMacdRule && ind.MacdHistogram < ind.MacdHistogramPrevious)
        {
            score += 15m;
            parts.Add("MACD falling");
        }

        if (settings.EnableVolumeRule && ind.VolumeSma20 > 0m && ind.Volume >= ind.VolumeSma20 * settings.RetestVolumeMultiplier)
        {
            score += 15m;
            parts.Add($"volume confirmation >= {settings.RetestVolumeMultiplier:0.00}x");
        }

        if (ind.Atr14 > 0m)
        {
            score += 10m;
            parts.Add("ATR healthy");
        }

        if (settings.EnableCandleRule && HasBearishRejection(c, settings.MinimumRejectionWickPercent))
        {
            score += 15m;
            parts.Add($"bearish rejection wick >= {settings.MinimumRejectionWickPercent:0}%");
        }

        reason = string.Join("; ", parts);
        return Math.Min(100m, score);
    }

    private static decimal ScoreLongBreakout(
        Candle c,
        SrTradeZone zone,
        IndicatorSnapshot ind,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings,
        out string reason)
    {
        decimal score = Math.Min(30m, zone.Score / 4m);

        if (settings.EnableRsiRule && ind.Rsi14 >= settings.RsiBreakoutLongMin && ind.Rsi14 <= settings.RsiBreakoutLongMax)
        {
            score += 15m;
            parts.Add($"RSI bullish breakout {settings.RsiBreakoutLongMin:0}-{settings.RsiBreakoutLongMax:0}");
        }

        if (settings.EnableMacdRule && ind.MacdHistogram > 0m && ind.MacdHistogram > ind.MacdHistogramPrevious)
        {
            score += 20m;
            parts.Add("MACD positive rising");
        }

        if (settings.EnableVolumeRule && ind.VolumeSma20 > 0m && ind.Volume >= ind.VolumeSma20 * settings.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier)
        {
            score += 20m;
            parts.Add($"breakout volume >= {settings.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier:0.00}x");
        }

        if (c.Close > zone.Upper)
        {
            score += 15m;
            parts.Add("close above resistance zone");
        }

    private static decimal ScoreShortBreakdown(
        Candle c,
        SrTradeZone zone,
        IndicatorSnapshot ind,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings,
        out string reason)
    {
        decimal score = Math.Min(30m, zone.Score / 4m);
        var parts = new List<string> { $"SR={score:0.0}" };

        if (settings.EnableRsiRule && ind.Rsi14 >= settings.RsiBreakdownShortMin && ind.Rsi14 <= settings.RsiBreakdownShortMax)
        {
            score += 15m;
            parts.Add($"RSI bearish breakdown {settings.RsiBreakdownShortMin:0}-{settings.RsiBreakdownShortMax:0}");
        }

        if (settings.EnableMacdRule && ind.MacdHistogram < 0m && ind.MacdHistogram < ind.MacdHistogramPrevious)
        {
            score += 20m;
            parts.Add("MACD negative falling");
        }

        if (settings.EnableVolumeRule && ind.VolumeSma20 > 0m && ind.Volume >= ind.VolumeSma20 * settings.BreakoutVolumeMultiplier)
        {

        if (c.Close < zone.Lower)
        {
            score += 15m;
            parts.Add("close below support zone");
        }

        reason = string.Join("; ", parts);
        return Math.Min(100m, score);
    }

    private static bool HasBullishRejection(Candle c, decimal minimumRejectionWickPercent = 25m)
    {
        decimal body = Math.Abs(c.Close - c.Open);
        decimal lowerWick = Math.Min(c.Open, c.Close) - c.Low;
        decimal range = c.High - c.Low;
        decimal minimumWickRatio = minimumRejectionWickPercent / 100m;

        return range > 0m &&
               lowerWick >= Math.Max(body * 1.2m, range * minimumWickRatio) &&
               c.Close >= c.Open;
    }

    private static bool HasBearishRejection(Candle c, decimal minimumRejectionWickPercent = 25m)
    {
        decimal body = Math.Abs(c.Close - c.Open);
        decimal upperWick = c.High - Math.Max(c.Open, c.Close);
        decimal range = c.High - c.Low;
        decimal minimumWickRatio = minimumRejectionWickPercent / 100m;

        return range > 0m &&
               upperWick >= Math.Max(body * 1.2m, range * minimumWickRatio) &&
               c.Close <= c.Open;
    }

    private static IndicatorSnapshot BuildIndicators(List<Candle> candles, int index)
    {
        decimal atr = CalculateAtr(candles, index, 14);
        decimal rsi = CalculateRsi(candles, index, 14);
        (decimal macdHist, decimal macdHistPrevious) = CalculateMacdHistogram(candles, index);
        decimal volume = candles[index].Volume;
        decimal volumeSma20 = candles.Take(index + 1).TakeLast(Math.Min(20, index + 1)).Select(x => x.Volume).DefaultIfEmpty(0m).Average();
        return new IndicatorSnapshot(rsi, macdHist, macdHistPrevious, volume, volumeSma20, atr);
    }

    private static decimal CalculateAtr(List<Candle> candles, int index, int period)
    {
        if (index <= 0 || candles.Count < 2) return 0m;
        int start = Math.Max(1, index - period + 1); var trueRanges = new List<decimal>();
        for (int i = start; i <= index; i++)
        {
            Candle current = candles[i]; Candle previous = candles[i - 1];
            trueRanges.Add(Math.Max(current.High - current.Low, Math.Max(Math.Abs(current.High - previous.Close), Math.Abs(current.Low - previous.Close))));
        }
        return trueRanges.DefaultIfEmpty(0m).Average();
    }

    private static decimal CalculateRsi(List<Candle> candles, int index, int period)
    {
        if (index < period) return 50m;
        decimal gain = 0m, loss = 0m;
        for (int i = index - period + 1; i <= index; i++)
        {
            decimal change = candles[i].Close - candles[i - 1].Close;
            if (change >= 0m) gain += change; else loss += Math.Abs(change);
        }
        decimal avgGain = gain / period; decimal avgLoss = loss / period;
        if (avgLoss == 0m) return 100m;
        decimal rs = avgGain / avgLoss; return 100m - (100m / (1m + rs));
    }

    private static (decimal Current, decimal Previous) CalculateMacdHistogram(List<Candle> candles, int index)
    {
        if (index < 35) return (0m, 0m);
        List<decimal> closes = candles.Take(index + 1).Select(x => x.Close).ToList();
        List<decimal> ema12 = CalculateEmaSeries(closes, 12);
        List<decimal> ema26 = CalculateEmaSeries(closes, 26);
        var macdLine = new List<decimal>();
        for (int i = 0; i < closes.Count; i++) macdLine.Add(ema12[i] - ema26[i]);
        List<decimal> signal = CalculateEmaSeries(macdLine, 9);
        decimal current = macdLine[^1] - signal[^1];
        decimal previous = macdLine.Count >= 2 ? macdLine[^2] - signal[^2] : current;
        return (current, previous);
    }

    private static List<decimal> CalculateEmaSeries(List<decimal> values, int period)
    {
        var result = new List<decimal>(); if (values.Count == 0) return result;
        decimal multiplier = 2m / (period + 1m); decimal ema = values[0]; result.Add(ema);
        for (int i = 1; i < values.Count; i++) { ema = ((values[i] - ema) * multiplier) + ema; result.Add(ema); }
        return result;
    }

    private static SrTradeBacktestSettings NormalizeFinancialSettings(SrTradeBacktestSettings settings)
    {
        decimal leverage = settings.Leverage > 0m ? settings.Leverage : 1m;

        decimal margin = settings.MarginUsdt > 0m
            ? settings.MarginUsdt
            : settings.TradeSizeUsdt > 0m && leverage > 0m ? settings.TradeSizeUsdt / leverage : 0m;

        decimal tradeSize = margin > 0m && leverage > 0m
            ? margin * leverage
            : 0m;

        return settings with
        {
            Leverage = leverage,
            MarginUsdt = margin,
            TradeSizeUsdt = tradeSize
        };
    }

    private static void ApplyRunFinancialFields(
        List<SrTradeLogRow> rows,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings,
        DateTime runUtc)
    {
        string runUtcText = runUtc.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string runPktText = runUtc.AddHours(5).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

        decimal startEquity = settings.StartEquityUsdt;
        decimal equity = startEquity;
        decimal effectiveTradeSize = ResolveTradeSizeUsdt(settings);
        decimal effectiveMargin = ResolveMarginUsdt(settings);
        var updatedRows = new List<SrTradeLogRow>(rows.Count);

        foreach (SrTradeLogRow row in rows)
        {
            decimal? equityBefore = null;
            decimal? equityAfter = null;
            decimal? pnl = null;

            if (row.Status == SrTradeStatus.Placed)
            {
                equityBefore = equity;
                pnl = CalculatePnlUsdt(row, effectiveTradeSize);
                equity += pnl ?? 0m;
                equityAfter = equity;
            }

            updatedRows.Add(row with
            {
                RunTimestampUtc = runUtcText,
                RunTimestampPkt = runPktText,
                StartEquityUsdt = startEquity,
                EndEquityUsdt = equity,
                EquityBeforeTradeUsdt = equityBefore,
                EquityAfterTradeUsdt = equityAfter,
                TradeSizeUsdt = effectiveTradeSize,
                Leverage = settings.Leverage,
                MarginUsdt = effectiveMargin,
                PnlUsdt = pnl,
                MfeUsdt = CalculatePriceMoveUsdt(row, row.MfePrice, effectiveTradeSize),
                MaeUsdt = CalculatePriceMoveUsdt(row, row.MaePrice, effectiveTradeSize),
                TrailStopEnabled = settings.EnableTrailingStopLoss,
                TrailStopAtrMultiplier = settings.TrailStopAtrMultiplier,
                TrailActivationR = settings.TrailActivationR
            });
        }

        decimal finalEquity = equity;

        rows.Clear();
        rows.AddRange(updatedRows.Select(row => row with { EndEquityUsdt = finalEquity }));
    }

    private static decimal ResolveTradeSizeUsdt(SrTradeBacktestSettings settings)
    {
        if (settings.MarginUsdt > 0m && settings.Leverage > 0m)
            return settings.MarginUsdt * settings.Leverage;

        if (settings.TradeSizeUsdt > 0m)
            return settings.TradeSizeUsdt;

        return 0m;
    }

    private static decimal ResolveMarginUsdt(SrTradeBacktestSettings settings)
    {
        if (settings.MarginUsdt > 0m)
            return settings.MarginUsdt;

        if (settings.TradeSizeUsdt > 0m && settings.Leverage > 0m)
            return settings.TradeSizeUsdt / settings.Leverage;

        return 0m;
    }

    private static decimal? CalculatePnlUsdt(SrTradeLogRow row, decimal tradeSizeUsdt)
    {
        if (tradeSizeUsdt <= 0m || !row.Entry.HasValue || !row.ExitPrice.HasValue || !row.Direction.HasValue)
            return row.ProfitR.HasValue ? 0m : null;

        return CalculatePriceMoveUsdt(row, row.ExitPrice, tradeSizeUsdt);
    }

    private static decimal? CalculatePriceMoveUsdt(SrTradeLogRow row, decimal? price, decimal tradeSizeUsdt)
    {
        if (tradeSizeUsdt <= 0m || !row.Entry.HasValue || !price.HasValue || !row.Direction.HasValue)
            return null;

        if (row.Entry.Value <= 0m)
            return 0m;

        decimal priceMovePct = row.Direction == SrTradeDirection.Long
            ? (price.Value - row.Entry.Value) / row.Entry.Value
            : (row.Entry.Value - price.Value) / row.Entry.Value;

        return tradeSizeUsdt * priceMovePct;
    }

    private static BestRResult FindBestR(
        string symbol,
        string timeframe,
        List<Candle> candles,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings)
    {
        decimal[] targets = [1.0m, 1.5m, 2.0m, 2.5m, 3.0m];

        decimal bestR = settings.TargetR;
        decimal bestExpectancy = decimal.MinValue;

        foreach (decimal target in targets)
        {
            var tempRows = new List<SrTradeLogRow>();

            RunBacktest(
                symbol,
                timeframe,
                candles,
                tempRows,
                target,
                settings with { TargetR = target });

            List<SrTradeLogRow> closed = tempRows
                .Where(x => x.ProfitR.HasValue && (x.Result == "WIN" || x.Result == "LOSS"))
                .ToList();

            if (closed.Count == 0)
                continue;

            decimal expectancy = closed.Average(x => x.ProfitR!.Value);

            if (expectancy > bestExpectancy)
            {
                bestExpectancy = expectancy;
                bestR = target;
            }
        }

        return new BestRResult(bestR, bestExpectancy == decimal.MinValue ? 0m : bestExpectancy);
    }

    private static decimal CalculateDailyProfitPercent(DateTime startUtc, DateTime endUtcExclusive, decimal totalProfitPercent)
    {
        double days = Math.Max(1.0, (endUtcExclusive - startUtc).TotalDays);
        double growth = 1.0 + ((double)totalProfitPercent / 100.0);

        if (growth <= 0.0)
            return totalProfitPercent / (decimal)days;

        return (decimal)((Math.Pow(growth, 1.0 / days) - 1.0) * 100.0);
    }

    public static string BuildExecutiveSummaryText(SrBacktestResult result)
    {
        return BuildExecutiveSummaryText(
            result.Symbol,
            result.Timeframe,
            result.StartUtc,
            result.EndUtcExclusive,
            result.Rows,
            result.BestR,
            result.BestExpectancy,
            result.Settings);
    }

    private static string BuildExecutiveSummaryText(
        string symbol,
        string timeframe,
        DateTime startUtc,
        DateTime endUtcExclusive,
        List<SrTradeLogRow> rows,
        decimal bestR,
        decimal bestExpectancy,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings)
    {
        int placed = rows.Count(x => x.Status == SrTradeStatus.Placed);
        int missed = rows.Count(x => x.Status == SrTradeStatus.Missed);
        int wins = rows.Count(x => x.Result == "WIN" || x.Result == "TRAIL_WIN");
        int losses = rows.Count(x => x.Result == "LOSS");
        int open = rows.Count(x => x.Result.Contains("OPEN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        int closedTrades = rows.Count(x => x.ProfitR.HasValue && (x.Result == "WIN" || x.Result == "TRAIL_WIN" || x.Result == "LOSS"));

        int longTrades = rows.Count(x => x.Direction == SrTradeDirection.Long);
        int shortTrades = rows.Count(x => x.Direction == SrTradeDirection.Short);

        int moTrades = rows.Count(x => x.OrderType == SrOrderType.MO);
        int loTrades = rows.Count(x => x.OrderType == SrOrderType.LO);
        int soTrades = rows.Count(x => x.OrderType == SrOrderType.SO);

        decimal netR = rows
            .Where(x => x.ProfitR.HasValue)
            .Sum(x => x.ProfitR!.Value);

        decimal winRate = closedTrades > 0
            ? wins * 100m / closedTrades
            : 0m;

        decimal lossRate = closedTrades > 0
            ? losses * 100m / closedTrades
            : 0m;

        decimal avgProfitR = rows
            .Where(x => x.ProfitR.HasValue)
            .Select(x => x.ProfitR!.Value)
            .DefaultIfEmpty(0m)
            .Average();

        List<decimal> winRValues = rows
            .Where(x => x.ProfitR.HasValue && x.ProfitR.Value > 0m)
            .Select(x => x.ProfitR!.Value)
            .ToList();

        List<decimal> lossRValues = rows
            .Where(x => x.ProfitR.HasValue && x.ProfitR.Value < 0m)
            .Select(x => Math.Abs(x.ProfitR!.Value))
            .ToList();

        decimal averageWinR = winRValues.DefaultIfEmpty(0m).Average();
        decimal averageLossR = lossRValues.DefaultIfEmpty(0m).Average();

        decimal grossWinR = winRValues.Sum();
        decimal grossLossR = lossRValues.Sum();

        decimal profitFactor = grossLossR > 0m
            ? grossWinR / grossLossR
            : grossWinR > 0m ? 999m : 0m;

        decimal payoffRatio = averageLossR > 0m
            ? averageWinR / averageLossR
            : averageWinR > 0m ? 999m : 0m;

        decimal breakEvenWinRate = payoffRatio > 0m && payoffRatio < 999m
            ? 100m / (1m + payoffRatio)
            : 0m;

        decimal startEquity = settings.StartEquityUsdt;

        decimal netProfitUsdt = rows
            .Where(x => x.PnlUsdt.HasValue)
            .Sum(x => x.PnlUsdt!.Value);

        if (netProfitUsdt == 0m && rows.Any(x => x.ProfitR.HasValue))
        {
            decimal fallbackMargin = settings.MarginUsdt > 0m
                ? settings.MarginUsdt
                : settings.TradeSizeUsdt > 0m && settings.Leverage > 0m
                    ? settings.TradeSizeUsdt / settings.Leverage
                    : 50m;

            netProfitUsdt = rows
                .Where(x => x.ProfitR.HasValue)
                .Sum(x => x.ProfitR!.Value * fallbackMargin);
        }

        decimal endEquity = startEquity + netProfitUsdt;

        decimal totalProfitPercent = startEquity > 0m
            ? (netProfitUsdt / startEquity) * 100m
            : 0m;
        decimal dailyProfitPercent = CalculateDailyProfitPercent(startUtc, endUtcExclusive, totalProfitPercent);

        decimal edgeR = closedTrades > 0
            ? rows
                .Where(x => x.ProfitR.HasValue && (x.Result == "WIN" || x.Result == "TRAIL_WIN" || x.Result == "LOSS"))
                .Average(x => x.ProfitR!.Value)
            : 0m;

        decimal edgeUsdt = closedTrades > 0
            ? netProfitUsdt / closedTrades
            : 0m;

        string edgeStatus =
            edgeR > 0m && closedTrades >= 50
                ? "POSITIVE EDGE - stronger proof from 50+ closed trades"
                : edgeR > 0m && closedTrades >= 30
                    ? "POSITIVE EDGE - acceptable proof from 30+ closed trades"
                    : edgeR > 0m
                        ? "EARLY POSITIVE EDGE - sample too small, not proven yet"
                        : "NO POSITIVE EDGE - weak or negative expectancy";

        string edgeProof =
            closedTrades >= 50
                ? $"Proof strong enough for research: {closedTrades} closed trades."
                : closedTrades >= 30
                    ? $"Proof acceptable for research: {closedTrades} closed trades."
                    : $"Not proven: only {closedTrades} closed trades. Need minimum 30-50 closed trades.";

        List<SrTradeLogRow> mfeMaeRows = rows
            .Where(x => x.MfeR.HasValue && x.MaeR.HasValue)
            .ToList();

        decimal averageMfeR = mfeMaeRows.Select(x => x.MfeR!.Value).DefaultIfEmpty(0m).Average();
        decimal averageMaeR = mfeMaeRows.Select(x => x.MaeR!.Value).DefaultIfEmpty(0m).Average();
        decimal mfeMaeRatio = averageMaeR > 0m ? averageMfeR / averageMaeR : averageMfeR > 0m ? 999m : 0m;
        decimal averageCapturePercent = mfeMaeRows
            .Where(x => x.MfeCapturePercent.HasValue)
            .Select(x => ClampPercent(x.MfeCapturePercent!.Value))
            .DefaultIfEmpty(0m)
            .Average();
        decimal averageMaeRiskPercent = mfeMaeRows.Where(x => x.MaeRiskPercent.HasValue).Select(x => x.MaeRiskPercent!.Value).DefaultIfEmpty(0m).Average();
        int lossAfterOneRMfe = mfeMaeRows.Count(x => x.ProfitR.HasValue && x.ProfitR.Value <= 0m && x.MfeR.HasValue && x.MfeR.Value >= 1.0m);
        int highMaeTrades = mfeMaeRows.Count(x => x.MaeR.HasValue && x.MaeR.Value >= 0.80m);
        int excellentQualityTrades = mfeMaeRows.Count(x => x.TradeQualityGrade.StartsWith("A+", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        int weakEntryTrades = mfeMaeRows.Count(x => x.TradeQualityGrade.StartsWith("D", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

        string mfeMaeQualityFocus =
            lossAfterOneRMfe > 0
                ? "Several trades reached +1R MFE then lost; enable breakeven/trailing after +1R."
                : highMaeTrades > placed * 0.30m
                    ? "Many trades have MAE above 0.80R; improve entry timing, require retest confirmation, or increase score threshold."
                    : averageCapturePercent < 45m && averageMfeR > 0m
                        ? "MFE exists but capture is weak; optimize TP and trailing stop to keep more profit."
                        : averageMfeR < 0.75m
                            ? "Low MFE means weak follow-through; use stronger trend, volume, and breakout-body filters."
                            : "MFE/MAE profile acceptable; continue walk-forward validation and separate MO/LO/SO review.";

        decimal peakEquity = startEquity;
        decimal maxDrawdownUsdt = 0m;

        foreach (SrTradeLogRow row in rows.Where(x => x.EquityAfterTradeUsdt.HasValue))
        {
            decimal equity = row.EquityAfterTradeUsdt!.Value;

            if (equity > peakEquity)
                peakEquity = equity;

            decimal drawdown = peakEquity - equity;

            if (drawdown > maxDrawdownUsdt)
                maxDrawdownUsdt = drawdown;
        }

        decimal maxDrawdownPercent = peakEquity > 0m
            ? (maxDrawdownUsdt / peakEquity) * 100m
            : 0m;

        string decision =
            edgeR > 0m && netProfitUsdt > 0m && winRate >= 60m && profitFactor >= 1.5m && closedTrades >= 30
                ? "PROMISING - positive edge with acceptable sample"
                : edgeR > 0m && netProfitUsdt > 0m
                    ? "EARLY PROMISING - profitable but needs more sample and safety validation"
                    : netR > 0m
                        ? "ACCEPTABLE - positive R but edge quality is not proven"
                        : "WEAK - do not use without further optimization";

        string qualityFocus =
            edgeR <= 0m
                ? "Improve filters: reduce weak LO trades, require stronger breakout candle, increase score threshold, avoid low-volume setups."
                : closedTrades < 30
                    ? "Need larger sample: test more months, more timeframes, and verify no overfitting."
                    : maxDrawdownPercent > 10m
                        ? "Control drawdown: reduce leverage, reduce trade size, tighten invalid/late entries, use trailing stop carefully."
                        : "Continue validation: walk-forward, out-of-sample test, separate MO/LO/SO performance.";

        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        sb.AppendLine("EXECUTIVE TRADE SUMMARY");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Symbol                    : {symbol}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Timeframe                 : {timeframe}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Date Range                : {startUtc:yyyy-MM-dd} to {endUtcExclusive.AddDays(-1):yyyy-MM-dd}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Decision                  : {decision}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Placed Trades             : {placed}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Closed Trades             : {closedTrades}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Missed Setups             : {missed}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Wins                      : {wins}");

        sb.AppendLine($"Win Rate                  : {winRate:0.00}%");

        sb.AppendLine($"Net R                     : {netR:0.00}");

        sb.AppendLine($"Edge                      : {edgeR:0.000}R per closed trade");
        sb.AppendLine($"Edge USDT                 : {edgeUsdt:0.00} USDT per closed trade");
        sb.AppendLine($"Edge Status               : {edgeStatus}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Edge Proof                : {edgeProof}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Average MFE R             : {averageMfeR:0.000}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Average MAE R             : {averageMaeR:0.000}");
        sb.AppendLine($"MFE / MAE Ratio           : {mfeMaeRatio:0.000}");

    private static decimal ClampPercent(decimal value)
    {
        if (value < 0m)
            return 0m;

        if (value > 100m)
            return 100m;

        return value;
    }

    private static void SaveTradeLogs(
        string symbol,
        string timeframe,
        DateTime startUtc,
        DateTime endUtcExclusive,
        List<SrTradeLogRow> rows,
        BestRResult bestR,
        SrTradeBacktestSettings settings,
        out string csvPath,
        out string txtPath,
        out string xlsxPath)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);

        string start = startUtc.ToString("yyyyMMdd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string end = endUtcExclusive.AddDays(-1).ToString("yyyyMMdd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

        string baseName =
            $"TRADE_LOG__{SanitizeFileName(symbol)}__{SanitizeFileName(timeframe)}__{start}_{end}";

        csvPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, baseName + ".csv");
        txtPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, baseName + ".txt");
        xlsxPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, baseName + ".xlsx");

        string executiveSummary = BuildExecutiveSummaryText(
            symbol,
            timeframe,
            startUtc,
            endUtcExclusive,
            rows,
            bestR.BestR,
            bestR.Expectancy,
            settings);

        File.WriteAllText(csvPath, BuildCsv(rows, executiveSummary), Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(txtPath, BuildTxt(rows, bestR, executiveSummary), Encoding.UTF8);
        WriteXlsx(xlsxPath, rows, bestR, executiveSummary);
    }

    private static string BuildCsv(List<SrTradeLogRow> rows, string executiveSummary)
    {
        string[] headers = GetHeaders();
        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        sb.AppendLine("EXECUTIVE SUMMARY");

        foreach (string line in executiveSummary.Split(Environment.NewLine))
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line))
                sb.AppendLine(EscapeCsv(line));
        }

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("TRADE LOG");
        sb.AppendLine(string.Join(",", headers.Select(EscapeCsv)));

        foreach (SrTradeLogRow row in rows)
            sb.AppendLine(string.Join(",", GetValues(row).Select(EscapeCsv)));

        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static string BuildTxt(
        List<SrTradeLogRow> rows,
        BestRResult bestR,
        string executiveSummary)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine(executiveSummary);
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("DETAILED TRADE LOG");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");

        foreach (SrTradeLogRow row in rows)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
            sb.AppendLine($"Row: {row.RowNumber} | Status: {row.Status} | Time: {row.SignalTime:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm} | {row.Symbol} {row.Timeframe}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Run UTC: {row.RunTimestampUtc} | Run PKT: {row.RunTimestampPkt}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Order: {row.OrderType} {row.Direction} | SR: {row.SrType} @ {FormatDecimal(row.SrPrice)} [{FormatDecimal(row.SrLower)} - {FormatDecimal(row.SrUpper)}]");
            sb.AppendLine($"Entry: {FormatDecimal(row.Entry)} | SL: {FormatDecimal(row.StopLoss)} | TP: {FormatDecimal(row.TakeProfit)} | TargetR: {FormatDecimal(row.TargetR)}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Trade Size: {FormatDecimal(row.TradeSizeUsdt)} USDT | Leverage: {FormatDecimal(row.Leverage)}x | Margin: {FormatDecimal(row.MarginUsdt)} USDT | PnL: {FormatDecimal(row.PnlUsdt)} USDT");
            sb.AppendLine($"Equity: {FormatDecimal(row.EquityBeforeTradeUsdt)} -> {FormatDecimal(row.EquityAfterTradeUsdt)} | Start: {FormatDecimal(row.StartEquityUsdt)} | End: {FormatDecimal(row.EndEquityUsdt)}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Trail SL: {row.TrailStopEnabled} | TrailATR: {FormatDecimal(row.TrailStopAtrMultiplier)} | TrailActivationR: {FormatDecimal(row.TrailActivationR)}");
            sb.AppendLine($"MFE: {FormatDecimal(row.MfeR)}R @ {FormatDecimal(row.MfePrice)} ({FormatDecimal(row.MfeUsdt)} USDT) | MAE: {FormatDecimal(row.MaeR)}R @ {FormatDecimal(row.MaePrice)} ({FormatDecimal(row.MaeUsdt)} USDT)");
            sb.AppendLine($"MFE Capture: {FormatDecimal(row.MfeCapturePercent)}% | MAE Risk: {FormatDecimal(row.MaeRiskPercent)}% | Quality: {row.TradeQualityGrade}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Quality Note: {row.TradeQualityNote}");
            sb.AppendLine($"RSI: {FormatDecimal(row.Rsi14)} | MACD Hist: {FormatDecimal(row.MacdHistogram)} | Volume/SMA20: {FormatDecimal(row.Volume)} / {FormatDecimal(row.VolumeSma20)} | ATR: {FormatDecimal(row.Atr14)}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Score: {row.Score:0.0} | Trade Reason: {row.ReasonTrade}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Miss Reason: {row.ReasonMiss}");
            sb.AppendLine($"Result: {row.Result} | Exit: {row.ExitTime:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm} @ {FormatDecimal(row.ExitPrice)} | ProfitR: {FormatDecimal(row.ProfitR)}");
        }

        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static string[] GetHeaders() => new[]
    {
        "RunTimestampPkt", "RunTimestampUtc",
        "RowNumber", "Status", "SignalTime", "Symbol", "Timeframe", "OrderType", "Direction", "SrType",
        "SrPrice", "SrUpper", "SrLower", "Entry", "StopLoss", "TakeProfit", "Risk", "TargetR", "RMultiple",
        "Rsi14", "MacdHistogram", "MacdHistogramPrevious", "Volume", "VolumeSma20", "Atr14", "Score",
        "ReasonTrade", "ReasonMiss", "EntryTime", "ExitTime", "ExitPrice", "Result", "ProfitR",
        "StartEquityUsdt", "EndEquityUsdt", "EquityBeforeTradeUsdt", "EquityAfterTradeUsdt",

    };

    {

    private static void WriteXlsx(string path, List<SrTradeLogRow> rows, BestRResult bestR, string executiveSummary)
    {
        using FileStream stream = File.Create(path); using var archive = new ZipArchive(stream, ZipArchiveMode.Create);
        AddZipEntry(archive, "[Content_Types].xml", "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?><Types xmlns=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types\"><Default Extension=\"rels\" ContentType=\"application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml\"/><Default Extension=\"xml\" ContentType=\"application/xml\"/><Override PartName=\"/xl/workbook.xml\" ContentType=\"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet.main+xml\"/><Override PartName=\"/xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml\" ContentType=\"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml\"/><Override PartName=\"/xl/worksheets/sheet2.xml\" ContentType=\"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml\"/></Types>");
        AddZipEntry(archive, "_rels/.rels", "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?><Relationships xmlns=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships\"><Relationship Id=\"rId1\" Type=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument\" Target=\"xl/workbook.xml\"/></Relationships>");
        AddZipEntry(archive, "xl/workbook.xml", "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?><workbook xmlns=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main\" xmlns:r=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships\"><sheets><sheet name=\"TradeLog\" sheetId=\"1\" r:id=\"rId1\"/><sheet name=\"Summary\" sheetId=\"2\" r:id=\"rId2\"/></sheets></workbook>");
        AddZipEntry(archive, "xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels", "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?><Relationships xmlns=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships\"><Relationship Id=\"rId1\" Type=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/worksheet\" Target=\"worksheets/sheet1.xml\"/><Relationship Id=\"rId2\" Type=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/worksheet\" Target=\"worksheets/sheet2.xml\"/></Relationships>");
        AddZipEntry(archive, "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml", BuildTradeLogWorksheetXml(GetHeaders(), rows));
        AddZipEntry(archive, "xl/worksheets/sheet2.xml", BuildSummaryWorksheetXml(rows, bestR, executiveSummary));
    }

    private static string BuildTradeLogWorksheetXml(string[] headers, List<SrTradeLogRow> rows)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder(); sb.AppendLine("<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?><worksheet xmlns=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main\"><sheetData>");
        WriteXlsxRow(sb, 1, headers); int rowIndex = 2; foreach (SrTradeLogRow row in rows) WriteXlsxRow(sb, rowIndex++, GetValues(row));
        sb.AppendLine("</sheetData></worksheet>"); return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static string BuildSummaryWorksheetXml(
        List<SrTradeLogRow> rows,
        BestRResult bestR,
        string executiveSummary)
    {
        var summaryRows = new List<string[]>
        {
            new[] { "Executive Summary", "" }
        };

        foreach (string line in executiveSummary.Split(Environment.NewLine))
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line))
                summaryRows.Add(new[] { line, "" });
        }

        summaryRows.Add(new[] { "", "" });
        summaryRows.Add(new[] { "Metric", "Value" });

        int placed = rows.Count(x => x.Status == SrTradeStatus.Placed);
        int missed = rows.Count(x => x.Status == SrTradeStatus.Missed);
        int wins = rows.Count(x => x.Result == "WIN" || x.Result == "TRAIL_WIN");
        int losses = rows.Count(x => x.Result == "LOSS");
        decimal netR = rows.Where(x => x.ProfitR.HasValue).Sum(x => x.ProfitR!.Value);

        summaryRows.Add(new[] { "Generated UTC", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) });
        summaryRows.Add(new[] { "Placed Trades", placed.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) });
        summaryRows.Add(new[] { "Missed Setups", missed.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) });
        summaryRows.Add(new[] { "Wins", wins.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) });
        summaryRows.Add(new[] { "Losses", losses.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) });
        summaryRows.Add(new[] { "Net R", netR.ToString("0.####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) });
        summaryRows.Add(new[] { "Best R Target", bestR.BestR.ToString("0.0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) });
        summaryRows.Add(new[] { "Best R Expectancy", bestR.Expectancy.ToString("0.####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) });

        var sb = new StringBuilder();

        sb.AppendLine(@"<?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""UTF-8""?>");
        sb.AppendLine(@"<worksheet xmlns=""http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"">");
        sb.AppendLine("<sheetData>");

        for (int i = 0; i < summaryRows.Count; i++)
            WriteXlsxRow(sb, i + 1, summaryRows[i]);

        sb.AppendLine("</sheetData>");
        sb.AppendLine("</worksheet>");

        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static void WriteXlsxRow(StringBuilder sb, int rowNumber, string[] values)
    {
        sb.Append($"<row r=\"{rowNumber}\">");
        for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
        {
            string cellRef = GetExcelColumnName(i + 1) + rowNumber.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            sb.Append($"<c r=\"{cellRef}\" t=\"inlineStr\"><is><t>{EscapeXml(values[i])}</t></is></c>");
        }
        sb.AppendLine("</row>");
    }

    private static string GetExcelColumnName(int columnNumber)
    {
        string columnName = string.Empty; while (columnNumber > 0) { int modulo = (columnNumber - 1) % 26; columnName = Convert.ToChar('A' + modulo) + columnName; columnNumber = (columnNumber - modulo) / 26; }
        return columnName;
    }

    private static void AddZipEntry(ZipArchive archive, string path, string content)
    {
        ZipArchiveEntry entry = archive.CreateEntry(path); using Stream entryStream = entry.Open(); using var writer = new StreamWriter(entryStream, new UTF8Encoding(false)); writer.Write(content);
    }

    private static string EscapeCsv(string value) { value ??= string.Empty; return value.Contains(',') || value.Contains('"') || value.Contains('\n') || value.Contains('\r') ? "\"" + value.Replace("\"", "\"\"") + "\"" : value; }
    private static string EscapeXml(string value) => (value ?? string.Empty).Replace("&", "&amp;").Replace("<", "&lt;").Replace(">", "&gt;").Replace("\"", "&quot;").Replace("'", "&apos;");
    private static string FormatDecimal(decimal? value) => value?.ToString("0.########", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) ?? string.Empty;
    private static string SanitizeFileName(string text) { foreach (char c in Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars()) text = text.Replace(c, '_'); return text.Replace(" ", "_"); }

    private sealed record IndicatorSnapshot(decimal Rsi14, decimal MacdHistogram, decimal MacdHistogramPrevious, decimal Volume, decimal VolumeSma20, decimal Atr14);
    private sealed record SrTradeCandidate(SrOrderType OrderType, SrTradeDirection Direction, SrTradeZone Zone, decimal Entry, decimal StopLoss, decimal TakeProfit, decimal Risk, decimal TargetR, decimal Score, string Reason)
    {
        public bool TrailStopEnabled { get; init; }
        public decimal TrailStopAtrMultiplier { get; init; }
        public decimal TrailActivationR { get; init; }
    }
    private sealed record SrPivot(decimal Price, int Index, bool IsSupport);
    private sealed record BestRResult(decimal BestR, decimal Expectancy);

    private sealed class SrPivotCluster
    {
        private readonly List<SrPivot> _pivots = new();
        public SrPivotCluster(bool isSupport) { IsSupport = isSupport; }
        public bool IsSupport { get; }
        public decimal Price => _pivots.Count == 0 ? 0m : _pivots.Average(x => x.Price);
        public int Touches => _pivots.Count;
        public int FirstTouchIndex => _pivots.Count == 0 ? 0 : _pivots.Min(x => x.Index);
        public int LastTouchIndex => _pivots.Count == 0 ? 0 : _pivots.Max(x => x.Index);
        public void Add(SrPivot pivot) => _pivots.Add(pivot);
    }
}

    private static readonly HttpClient Http = new()
    {
        BaseAddress = new Uri("https://fapi.binance.com"),
        Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(75)
    };

    public static async Task<IReadOnlyList<string>> ResolveScannerSymbolsAsync(
        IEnumerable<string> inputSymbols,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var tokens = NormalizeTokens(inputSymbols);

        if (tokens.Any(IsAllUsdtFuturesToken))
            return await GetAllBinanceUsdtFuturesSymbolsAsync(ct);

        if (tokens.Count == 0 || tokens.Any(IsTop200Token))
            return await GetDynamicTop200SymbolsAsync(ct);

        if (tokens.Any(IsTop40Token))
            return ResearchTop40Symbols.Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToList();

        return tokens
            .Where(x => !IsTop200Token(x) && !IsTop40Token(x) && !IsAllUsdtFuturesToken(x))
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();
    }

    public static Task<IReadOnlyList<string>> GetDynamicTop100SymbolsAsync(CancellationToken ct)
        => GetDynamicTopSymbolsAsync(100, FallbackTop200Symbols.Take(100).ToArray(), ct);

    public static Task<IReadOnlyList<string>> GetDynamicTop200SymbolsAsync(CancellationToken ct)
        => GetDynamicTopSymbolsAsync(200, FallbackTop200Symbols.Take(200).ToArray(), ct);

    /// <summary>
    /// V8.10.3I: Resolve every active Binance USD-M USDT perpetual futures symbol from exchangeInfo.
    /// This is for candle update/folder audit. It intentionally does NOT use TOP200 volume ranking.
    /// </summary>
    public static async Task<IReadOnlyList<string>> GetAllBinanceUsdtFuturesSymbolsAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        try
        {
            using var response = await Http.GetAsync("/fapi/v1/exchangeInfo", ct);
            string body = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct);

            if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Binance USD-M exchangeInfo HTTP {(int)response.StatusCode}: {body}");

            using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);
            if (!doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("symbols", out JsonElement symbolsElement) || symbolsElement.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Array)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Binance USD-M exchangeInfo returned no symbols array.");

            var output = new List<string>();
            foreach (JsonElement item in symbolsElement.EnumerateArray())
            {
                string symbol = GetString(item, "symbol").ToUpperInvariant();
                string quoteAsset = GetString(item, "quoteAsset").ToUpperInvariant();
                string status = GetString(item, "status").ToUpperInvariant();
                string contractType = GetString(item, "contractType").ToUpperInvariant();

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol) || !symbol.EndsWith("USDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    continue;

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(quoteAsset) && !string.Equals(quoteAsset, "USDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    continue;

                if (!string.Equals(status, "TRADING", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    continue;

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(contractType) && !string.Equals(contractType, "PERPETUAL", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    continue;

                // Exclude quarterly/index-style internal symbols. Regular symbols are still allowed, including new Binance listed synthetic roots.
                if (symbol.Contains('_', StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    continue;

                output.Add(symbol);
            }

            return output
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();
        }
        catch
        {
            // Conservative fallback keeps Button 18 usable if exchangeInfo is temporarily unavailable.
            return FallbackTop200Symbols.Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToList();
        }
    }

    private static async Task<IReadOnlyList<string>> GetDynamicTopSymbolsAsync(int limit, IReadOnlyList<string> fallbackSymbols, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        try
        {
            using var response = await Http.GetAsync("/fapi/v1/ticker/24hr", ct);
            string body = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct);

            if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Binance USD-M 24h ticker HTTP {(int)response.StatusCode}: {body}");

            using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);
            if (doc.RootElement.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Array)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Binance USD-M 24h ticker returned non-array JSON.");

            var ranked = new List<(string Symbol, decimal QuoteVolume)>();

            foreach (JsonElement item in doc.RootElement.EnumerateArray())
            {
                string symbol = GetString(item, "symbol").ToUpperInvariant();
                if (!IsStandardTradableUsdtSymbol(symbol))
                    continue;

                decimal quoteVolume = GetDecimal(item, "quoteVolume");
                if (quoteVolume <= 0m)
                    continue;

                ranked.Add((symbol, quoteVolume));
            }

            var output = ranked
                .OrderByDescending(x => x.QuoteVolume)
                .ThenBy(x => x.Symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .Select(x => x.Symbol)
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .Take(limit)
                .ToList();

            return output.Count >= Math.Min(50, limit)
                ? output
                : fallbackSymbols.ToList();
        }
        catch
        {
            return fallbackSymbols.ToList();
        }
    }

    private static bool IsStandardTradableUsdtSymbol(string symbol)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(symbol))
            return false;

        if (!symbol.EndsWith("USDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return false;

        if (symbol.Contains('_', StringComparison.Ordinal))
            return false;

        foreach (char ch in symbol)
        {
            bool ok = (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z') || (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9');
            if (!ok)
                return false;
        }

        string root = symbol[..^4];
        if (root is "XAU" or "XAG" or "SKHYNIX" or "SOXL" or "MSTR")
            return false;

        return true;
    }

    private static List<string> NormalizeTokens(IEnumerable<string> inputSymbols)
    {
        return inputSymbols
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
            .Select(x => x.Trim().ToUpperInvariant())
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();
    }

    private static bool IsTop200Token(string value)
    {
        return string.Equals(value, "ALL", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "*", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "ACTIVE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "TOP200", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "ALL200", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "MARKET200", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "TOP100", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "ALL100", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "MARKET100", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "ALL_MARKET", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "BINANCE_TOP100", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "BINANCE_TOP200", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    private static bool IsAllUsdtFuturesToken(string value)
    {
        return string.Equals(value, "ALLFUTURES", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "ALL_FUTURES", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "ALLUSDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "ALL_USDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "ALL_USDT_FUTURES", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "ALL_BINANCE_USDT_FUTURES", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "BINANCE_ALL", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "BINANCE_ALL_USDT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "USDT_FUTURES_ALL", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    private static bool IsTop40Token(string value)
    {
        return string.Equals(value, "TOP40", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "RESEARCH40", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
               string.Equals(value, "ALL_RESEARCH_TOP40", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    private static string GetString(JsonElement element, string propertyName)
    {
        return element.TryGetProperty(propertyName, out JsonElement p)
            ? p.GetString() ?? string.Empty
            : string.Empty;
    }

    private static decimal GetDecimal(JsonElement element, string propertyName)
    {
        if (!element.TryGetProperty(propertyName, out JsonElement p))
            return 0m;

        if (p.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Number && p.TryGetDecimal(out decimal n))
            return n;

        string? text = p.GetString();
        return decimal.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out decimal value)
            ? value
            : 0m;
    }
}
