using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using TQGA.Application.Paths;

namespace TQGA.WinForms;

internal sealed class Top100CandleUpdateMarketResult
{
    public string Symbol { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public string Timeframe { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public bool Success { get; init; }
    public string Status { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public string Message { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public DateTime? LocalLatestBeforeUtc { get; init; }
    public DateTime? LocalLatestAfterUtc { get; init; }
    public int LagBefore { get; init; }
    public int LagAfter { get; init; }
    public int DownloadedCandles { get; init; }
    public int DownloadBatches { get; init; }
    public int LocalCandlesBefore { get; init; }
    public int LocalCandlesAfter { get; init; }
    public string CandlePath { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public string WarningText { get; init; } = string.Empty;
}

internal sealed class Top100CandleUpdateResult
{
    public DateTime GeneratedUtc { get; init; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public bool Success { get; set; }
    public string Message { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public int SymbolsRequested { get; init; }
    public int TimeframesRequested { get; init; }
    public int MarketsRequested { get; init; }
    public int MarketsProcessed { get; set; }
    public int MarketsFresh { get; set; }
    public int MarketsChecked { get; set; }
    public int TotalDownloadedCandles { get; set; }
    public string ReportPath { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string CsvPath { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public IReadOnlyList<string> Symbols { get; init; } = Array.Empty<string>();
    public IReadOnlyList<string> Timeframes { get; init; } = Array.Empty<string>();
    public IReadOnlyList<Top100CandleUpdateMarketResult> Markets { get; set; } = Array.Empty<Top100CandleUpdateMarketResult>();
}

internal sealed class Top100CandleUpdateService
{
    private const int SeedLookbackCandles = 3000;

    public async Task<Top100CandleUpdateResult> UpdateTop100AllThreeTimeframesAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        DateTime generatedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        IReadOnlyList<string> symbols = await SrTradingUniverse.GetDynamicTop100SymbolsAsync(ct);
        IReadOnlyList<string> timeframes = SrTradingUniverse.ScannerTimeframes;
        var markets = new List<Top100CandleUpdateMarketResult>();
        var updater = new SrCandleFreshnessUpdater();

        foreach (string symbol in symbols)
        {
            foreach (string timeframe in timeframes)
            {
                ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

                try
                {
                    SrCandleFreshnessUpdateResult r = await updater.UpdateAndVerifyAsync(
                        symbol,
                        timeframe,
                        SeedLookbackCandles,
                        ct);

                    markets.Add(new Top100CandleUpdateMarketResult
                    {
                        Symbol = symbol,
                        Timeframe = timeframe,
                        Success = r.Success,
                        Status = r.Status,
                        Message = r.Message,
                        LocalLatestBeforeUtc = r.LatestLocalBeforeUtc,
                        LocalLatestAfterUtc = r.LatestLocalAfterUtc,
                        LagBefore = r.LagCandlesBefore,
                        LagAfter = r.LagCandlesAfter,
                        DownloadedCandles = r.DownloadedCandles,
                        DownloadBatches = r.DownloadBatches,
                        LocalCandlesBefore = r.LocalCandlesBefore,
                        LocalCandlesAfter = r.LocalCandlesAfter,
                        CandlePath = r.CandleFilePath,
                        WarningText = string.Join(" | ", r.Warnings ?? Array.Empty<string>())
                    });
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException)
                {
                    throw;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    markets.Add(new Top100CandleUpdateMarketResult
                    {
                        Symbol = symbol,
                        Timeframe = timeframe,
                        Success = false,
                        Status = "UPDATE_EXCEPTION",
                        Message = ex.GetType().Name + ": " + ex.Message,
                        WarningText = ex.ToString()
                    });
                }

                await Task.Delay(125, ct);
            }
        }

        var result = new Top100CandleUpdateResult
        {
            GeneratedUtc = generatedUtc,
            Symbols = symbols,
            Timeframes = timeframes,
            SymbolsRequested = symbols.Count,
            TimeframesRequested = timeframes.Count,
            MarketsRequested = symbols.Count * timeframes.Count,
            MarketsProcessed = markets.Count,
            MarketsFresh = markets.Count(x => x.Success),
            MarketsChecked = markets.Count(x => !x.Success),
            TotalDownloadedCandles = markets.Sum(x => x.DownloadedCandles),
            Markets = markets
        };

        result.Success = result.MarketsProcessed == result.MarketsRequested && result.MarketsChecked == 0;
        result.Message = result.Success
            ? $"TOP100 candle update PASS - {result.MarketsFresh}/{result.MarketsRequested} markets fresh across 1h/4h/1d."
            : $"TOP100 candle update CHECK - {result.MarketsChecked}/{result.MarketsRequested} markets need attention; valid markets remain usable.";

        WriteReport(result);
        return result;
    }

    public string BuildReport(Top100CandleUpdateResult result)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("TQGA V8.10.3E BUTTON 18 - UPDATE CANDLES DATA - BINANCE TOP100 x 3TF");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Result                : {(result.Success ? "PASS" : "CHECK")}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Message               : {result.Message}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated UTC         : {result.GeneratedUtc:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Symbols Requested     : {result.SymbolsRequested}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Timeframes Requested  : {string.Join(",", result.Timeframes)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Markets Requested     : {result.MarketsRequested}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Markets Processed     : {result.MarketsProcessed}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Fresh / Passed Markets: {result.MarketsFresh}");
        sb.AppendLine($"CHECK Markets         : {result.MarketsChecked}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Downloaded Candles    : {result.TotalDownloadedCandles}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Path           : {result.ReportPath}");
        sb.AppendLine($"CSV Path              : {result.CsvPath}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("UNIVERSE");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine(string.Join(", ", result.Symbols));
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("MARKET UPDATE DETAIL");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("Symbol       TF   Result  Status                         LagBefore LagAfter Downloaded Before After LatestAfter");

        foreach (Top100CandleUpdateMarketResult m in result.Markets
                     .OrderBy(x => x.Symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                     .ThenBy(x => TimeframeSortKey(x.Timeframe)))
        {
            sb.AppendLine(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                "{0,-12} {1,-4} {2,-7} {3,-30} {4,9} {5,8} {6,10} {7,6} {8,5} {9}",
                m.Symbol,
                m.Timeframe,
                m.Success ? "PASS" : "CHECK",
                Trunc(m.Status, 30),
                m.LagBefore,
                m.LagAfter,
                m.DownloadedCandles,
                m.LocalCandlesBefore,
                m.LocalCandlesAfter,
                m.LocalLatestAfterUtc.HasValue ? m.LocalLatestAfterUtc.Value.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "N/A"));
        }

        var checkMarkets = result.Markets.Where(x => !x.Success).ToList();
        if (checkMarkets.Count > 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine("CHECK / WARNINGS");
            sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
            foreach (Top100CandleUpdateMarketResult m in checkMarkets)
            {
                sb.AppendLine($"- {m.Symbol} {m.Timeframe}: {m.Status} - {m.Message}");
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(m.WarningText))
                    sb.AppendLine($"  {m.WarningText}");
            }
        }

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("SAFETY STATE");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("This button updates local Binance USD-M futures candle CSV files only.");
        sb.AppendLine("No exchange orders are sent. No live trading is implemented.");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private void WriteReport(Top100CandleUpdateResult result)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);
        string stamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string txtPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, $"BINANCE_TOP100_CANDLE_UPDATE_3TF_{stamp}.txt");
        string csvPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, $"BINANCE_TOP100_CANDLE_UPDATE_3TF_{stamp}.csv");

        result.ReportPath = txtPath;
        result.CsvPath = csvPath;

        File.WriteAllText(txtPath, BuildReport(result), Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(csvPath, BuildCsv(result), Encoding.UTF8);
    }

    private static string BuildCsv(Top100CandleUpdateResult result)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("Symbol,Timeframe,Success,Status,LagBefore,LagAfter,DownloadedCandles,DownloadBatches,LocalCandlesBefore,LocalCandlesAfter,LatestBeforeUtc,LatestAfterUtc,CandlePath,Message,Warnings");

        foreach (Top100CandleUpdateMarketResult m in result.Markets)
        {
            sb.AppendLine(string.Join(",",
                Csv(m.Symbol),
                Csv(m.Timeframe),
                m.Success ? "true" : "false",
                Csv(m.Status),
                m.LagBefore.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.LagAfter.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.DownloadedCandles.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.DownloadBatches.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.LocalCandlesBefore.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.LocalCandlesAfter.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                Csv(m.LocalLatestBeforeUtc?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) ?? string.Empty),
                Csv(m.LocalLatestAfterUtc?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) ?? string.Empty),
                Csv(m.CandlePath),
                Csv(m.Message),
                Csv(m.WarningText)));
        }

        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static int TimeframeSortKey(string tf)
    {
        return tf.ToLowerInvariant() switch
        {
            "15m" => 0,
            "1h" => 1,
            "4h" => 2,
            "1d" => 3,
            _ => 99
        };
    }

    private static string Trunc(string value, int max)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) || value.Length <= max)
            return value ?? string.Empty;

        return value[..Math.Max(0, max - 3)] + "...";
    }

    private static string Csv(string value)
    {
        value ??= string.Empty;
        string escaped = value.Replace("\"", "\"\"");
        return $"\"{escaped}\"";
    }
}

    public string CandlePath { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public string WarningText { get; init; } = string.Empty;
}

internal sealed class Top200CandleUpdateProgress
{
    public string Stage { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public string CurrentSymbol { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public string CurrentTimeframe { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public int Current { get; init; }
    public int Total { get; init; }
    public int Fresh { get; init; }
    public int Check { get; init; }
    public int UpdatedFiles { get; init; }
    public int DownloadedCandles { get; init; }
    public string Detail { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public bool Completed { get; init; }

    public int Percent => Total <= 0 ? 0 : Math.Max(0, Math.Min(100, (int)Math.Round(Current * 100.0 / Total)));
    public int Remaining => Math.Max(0, Total - Current);
}

internal sealed class Top200CandleUpdateService
{
    private const int DefaultSeedLookbackCandles = 3000;

    // Backward-compatible entry point now means Button 18 all scanner TFs: 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d.
    public Task<Top200CandleUpdateResult> UpdateTop200AllThreeTimeframesAsync(CancellationToken ct)
        => UpdateAllBinanceUsdtFuturesAllScannerTimeframesAsync(ct);

    public async Task<Top200CandleUpdateResult> UpdateAllBinanceUsdtFuturesOneHourOnlyAsync(
        CancellationToken ct,
        IProgress<Top200CandleUpdateProgress>? progress = null)
    {
        IReadOnlyList<string> symbols = await SrTradingUniverse.GetAllBinanceUsdtFuturesSymbolsAsync(ct);
        return await UpdateSymbolsAsync(
            symbols,
            new[] { "1h" },
            "ALL_BINANCE_USDT_FUTURES_FAST_DELTA_1H_ONLY",
            "1h only",
            ct,
            progress);
    }

    public async Task<Top200CandleUpdateResult> UpdateSelectedSymbolsOneHourOnlyAsync(
        IReadOnlyList<string> selectedSymbols,
        CancellationToken ct,
        IProgress<Top200CandleUpdateProgress>? progress = null)
    {
        if (selectedSymbols == null || selectedSymbols.Count == 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("No coin selected for selected-symbol 1h candle update.");

        var symbols = selectedSymbols
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
            .Select(x => x.Trim().ToUpperInvariant())
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        return await UpdateSymbolsAsync(
            symbols,
            new[] { "1h" },
            "SELECTED_SYMBOLS_FAST_DELTA_1H_ONLY",
            "selected symbols 1h only",
            ct,
            progress);
    }

    public async Task<Top200CandleUpdateResult> UpdateAllBinanceUsdtFuturesAllScannerTimeframesAsync(
        CancellationToken ct,
        IProgress<Top200CandleUpdateProgress>? progress = null)
    {
        IReadOnlyList<string> symbols = await SrTradingUniverse.GetAllBinanceUsdtFuturesSymbolsAsync(ct);
        return await UpdateSymbolsAsync(
            symbols,
            SrTradingUniverse.ScannerTimeframes,
            "ALL_BINANCE_USDT_FUTURES_FAST_DELTA_15M_1H_4H_1D",
            "15m, 1h, 4h, 1d",
            ct,
            progress);
    }

    private async Task<Top200CandleUpdateResult> UpdateSymbolsAsync(
        IReadOnlyList<string> inputSymbols,
        IReadOnlyList<string> inputTimeframes,
        string updateMode,
        string modeLabel,
        CancellationToken ct,
        IProgress<Top200CandleUpdateProgress>? progress)
    {
        DateTime generatedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var symbols = inputSymbols
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
            .Select(x => x.Trim().ToUpperInvariant())
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        var timeframes = inputTimeframes
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
            .Select(x => x.Trim())
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .OrderBy(TimeframeSortKey)
            .ToList();

        if (symbols.Count == 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("No valid symbols were supplied for candle update.");

        if (timeframes.Count == 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("No valid timeframes were supplied for candle update.");

        var markets = new List<Top200CandleUpdateMarketResult>();
        var updater = new SrCandleFreshnessUpdater();
        int totalMarkets = symbols.Count * timeframes.Count;

        progress?.Report(new Top200CandleUpdateProgress
        {
            Stage = "Universe loaded",
            Current = 0,
            Total = totalMarkets,
            Fresh = 0,
            Check = 0,
            Detail = $"FAST DELTA will update/audit {symbols.Count} Binance USDT futures x {modeLabel} = {totalMarkets} markets."
        });

        foreach (string symbol in symbols)
        {
            foreach (string timeframe in timeframes)
            {
                ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

                try
                {
                    SrCandleFreshnessUpdateResult r = await updater.UpdateAndVerifyFastIncrementalAsync(
                        symbol,
                        timeframe,
                        ResolveSeedLookbackCandles(timeframe),
                        ct);

                    markets.Add(new Top200CandleUpdateMarketResult
                    {
                        Symbol = symbol,
                        Timeframe = timeframe,
                        Success = r.Success,
                        Status = r.Status,
                        Message = r.Message,
                        LocalLatestBeforeUtc = r.LatestLocalBeforeUtc,
                        LocalLatestAfterUtc = r.LatestLocalAfterUtc,
                        LagBefore = r.LagCandlesBefore,
                        LagAfter = r.LagCandlesAfter,
                        DownloadedCandles = r.DownloadedCandles,
                        DownloadBatches = r.DownloadBatches,
                        LocalCandlesBefore = r.LocalCandlesBefore,
                        LocalCandlesAfter = r.LocalCandlesAfter,
                        CandlePath = r.CandleFilePath,
                        WarningText = string.Join(" | ", r.Warnings ?? Array.Empty<string>())
                    });
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException)
                {
                    throw;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    markets.Add(new Top200CandleUpdateMarketResult
                    {
                        Symbol = symbol,
                        Timeframe = timeframe,
                        Success = false,
                        Status = "UPDATE_EXCEPTION",
                        Message = ex.GetType().Name + ": " + ex.Message,
                        WarningText = ex.ToString()
                    });
                }

                progress?.Report(new Top200CandleUpdateProgress
                {
                    Stage = "Updating candles + freshness",
                    Current = markets.Count,
                    Total = totalMarkets,
                    CurrentSymbol = symbol,
                    CurrentTimeframe = timeframe,
                    Fresh = markets.Count(x => x.Success),
                    Check = markets.Count(x => !x.Success),
                    UpdatedFiles = markets.Count(x => x.DownloadedCandles > 0),
                    DownloadedCandles = markets.Sum(x => x.DownloadedCandles),
                    Detail = $"Completed {markets.Count}/{totalMarkets}. Remaining {Math.Max(0, totalMarkets - markets.Count)}. Last: {symbol} {timeframe}."
                });

                await Task.Delay(25, ct);
            }
        }

        var result = new Top200CandleUpdateResult
        {
            GeneratedUtc = generatedUtc,
            UpdateMode = updateMode,
            Symbols = symbols,
            Timeframes = timeframes,
            TotalBinanceUsdtFuturesSymbols = symbols.Count,
            SymbolsRequested = symbols.Count,
            TimeframesRequested = timeframes.Count,
            MarketsRequested = symbols.Count * timeframes.Count,
            MarketsProcessed = markets.Count,
            MarketsFresh = markets.Count(x => x.Success),
            MarketsChecked = markets.Count(x => !x.Success),
            TotalDownloadedCandles = markets.Sum(x => x.DownloadedCandles),
            UpdatedFileMarkets = markets.Count(x => x.DownloadedCandles > 0),
            FreshButNotRewrittenMarkets = markets.Count(x => x.Success && x.DownloadedCandles == 0),
            StaleExpectedMarkets = markets.Count(x => !x.Success),
            Markets = markets
        };

        progress?.Report(new Top200CandleUpdateProgress
        {
            Stage = "Auditing candle folder",
            Current = totalMarkets,
            Total = totalMarkets,
            Fresh = result.MarketsFresh,
            Check = result.MarketsChecked,
            UpdatedFiles = result.UpdatedFileMarkets,
            DownloadedCandles = result.TotalDownloadedCandles,
            Detail = "Market update complete. Auditing current candle folder files now."
        });

        ApplyFolderAudit(result);

        result.Success = result.MarketsProcessed == result.MarketsRequested && result.MarketsChecked == 0 && result.CurrentUniverseFilesMissing == 0;
        result.Message = result.Success
            ? $"FAST DELTA Binance USDT futures candle update PASS - {result.MarketsFresh}/{result.MarketsRequested} markets fresh on {TimeframeLabel(result.Timeframes)}."
            : $"FAST DELTA Binance USDT futures candle update CHECK - {result.MarketsChecked}/{result.MarketsRequested} markets need attention; valid markets remain usable.";

        WriteReport(result);

        progress?.Report(new Top200CandleUpdateProgress
        {
            Stage = result.Success ? "Completed PASS" : "Completed CHECK",
            Current = totalMarkets,
            Total = totalMarkets,
            Fresh = result.MarketsFresh,
            Check = result.MarketsChecked,
            UpdatedFiles = result.UpdatedFileMarkets,
            DownloadedCandles = result.TotalDownloadedCandles,
            Completed = true,
            Detail = $"Report saved. Missing files: {result.CurrentUniverseFilesMissing}. Orphan/old files: {result.OrphanCandleFiles}."
        });

        return result;
    }

    private static void ApplyFolderAudit(Top200CandleUpdateResult result)
    {
        string candleRoot = DataPaths.Candles;
        string[] allCsv = Directory.Exists(candleRoot)
            ? Directory.GetFiles(candleRoot, "*.csv", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly)
            : Array.Empty<string>();

        var expectedNames = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach (string symbol in result.Symbols)
        {
            foreach (string tf in result.Timeframes)
                expectedNames.Add($"{symbol}_{tf}.csv");
        }

        var expectedFullPaths = expectedNames
            .Select(x => Path.Combine(candleRoot, x))
            .ToList();

        var timeframeSuffixes = result.Timeframes
            .Select(tf => "_" + tf + ".csv")
            .ToArray();

        var timeframeCsv = allCsv
            .Where(path => timeframeSuffixes.Any(sfx => path.EndsWith(sfx, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
            .ToList();

        var existingNames = new HashSet<string>(
            allCsv
                .Select(path => Path.GetFileName(path) ?? string.Empty)
                .Where(name => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)),
            StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        var missing = expectedNames
            .Where(name => !existingNames.Contains(name))
            .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        var orphan = timeframeCsv
            .Select(path => Path.GetFileName(path) ?? string.Empty)
            .Where(name => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name))
            .Where(name => !expectedNames.Contains(name))
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

        result.CurrentUniverseExpectedFiles = expectedNames.Count;
        result.TotalCandleCsvFilesInFolder = allCsv.Length;
        result.TimeframeCsvFilesInFolder = timeframeCsv.Count;
        result.CurrentUniverseFilesFound = expectedFullPaths.Count(File.Exists);
        result.CurrentUniverseFilesMissing = missing.Count;
        result.OrphanCandleFiles = orphan.Count;
        result.MissingCurrentUniverseFiles = missing;
        result.OrphanCurrentTimeframeFiles = orphan;
    }

    public string BuildReport(Top200CandleUpdateResult result)
    {
        string timeframeLabel = TimeframeLabel(result.Timeframes);
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine($"TQGA BUTTON CANDLE UPDATE - FAST DELTA - {timeframeLabel} - BINANCE USDT FUTURES + FOLDER AUDIT");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        sb.AppendLine($"Result                : {(result.Success ? "PASS" : "CHECK")}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Message               : {result.Message}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated Local       : {FormatLocalFromUtc(result.GeneratedUtc)} ({LocalZoneLabel()})");
        sb.AppendLine($"Generated UTC         : {FormatUtc(result.GeneratedUtc)}");
        sb.AppendLine("Time Note             : Report file name uses PC local time. Binance candle timestamps are UTC; LatestAfter shows both UTC and local.");
        sb.AppendLine($"Update Mode           : {result.UpdateMode}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Binance USDT Futures  : {result.TotalBinanceUsdtFuturesSymbols}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Symbols Requested     : {result.SymbolsRequested}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Timeframes Requested  : {string.Join(",", result.Timeframes)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Markets Requested     : {result.MarketsRequested}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Markets Processed     : {result.MarketsProcessed}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Fresh / Passed Markets: {result.MarketsFresh}");
        sb.AppendLine($"CHECK Markets         : {result.MarketsChecked}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Downloaded Candles    : {result.TotalDownloadedCandles}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Updated File Markets  : {result.UpdatedFileMarkets}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Fresh No Rewrite      : {result.FreshButNotRewrittenMarkets}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Report Path           : {result.ReportPath}");
        sb.AppendLine($"CSV Path              : {result.CsvPath}");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("CANDLE FOLDER AUDIT");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"Candle Folder                     : {DataPaths.Candles}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Total CSV Files In Folder          : {result.TotalCandleCsvFilesInFolder}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Selected TF CSV Files In Folder    : {result.TimeframeCsvFilesInFolder}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Expected Current Universe Files    : {result.CurrentUniverseExpectedFiles}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Current Universe Files Found       : {result.CurrentUniverseFilesFound}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Current Universe Files Missing     : {result.CurrentUniverseFilesMissing}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Orphan/Old Selected TF Files       : {result.OrphanCandleFiles}");
        sb.AppendLine("Audit Rule                         : Freshness is judged by LatestAfter/LagAfter, not Windows Date Modified.");
        sb.AppendLine("Time Rule                          : Binance candle open/close timestamps are UTC; Local column converts UTC to this PC time zone.");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("UNIVERSE");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine(string.Join(", ", result.Symbols));
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("MARKET UPDATE DETAIL");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine("Symbol       TF   Result  Status                         LagBefore LagAfter Downloaded Before After LatestAfterUTC   LatestAfterLocal");

        foreach (Top200CandleUpdateMarketResult m in result.Markets
                     .OrderBy(x => x.Symbol, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                     .ThenBy(x => TimeframeSortKey(x.Timeframe)))
        {
            sb.AppendLine(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                "{0,-12} {1,-4} {2,-7} {3,-30} {4,9} {5,8} {6,10} {7,6} {8,5} {9,-16} {10}",
                m.Symbol,
                m.Timeframe,
                m.Success ? "PASS" : "CHECK",
                Trunc(m.Status, 30),
                m.LagBefore,
                m.LagAfter,
                m.DownloadedCandles,
                m.LocalCandlesBefore,
                m.LocalCandlesAfter,
                FormatUtcShort(m.LocalLatestAfterUtc),
                FormatLocalShortFromUtc(m.LocalLatestAfterUtc)));
        }

        var checkMarkets = result.Markets.Where(x => !x.Success).ToList();
        if (checkMarkets.Count > 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine("CHECK / WARNINGS");
            sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
            foreach (Top200CandleUpdateMarketResult m in checkMarkets)
            {
                sb.AppendLine($"- {m.Symbol} {m.Timeframe}: {m.Status} - {m.Message}");
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(m.WarningText))
                    sb.AppendLine($"  {m.WarningText}");
            }
        }

        if (result.MissingCurrentUniverseFiles.Count > 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine("MISSING CURRENT UNIVERSE FILES");
            sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
            foreach (string file in result.MissingCurrentUniverseFiles.Take(200))
                sb.AppendLine(file);
            if (result.MissingCurrentUniverseFiles.Count > 200)
                sb.AppendLine($"... plus {result.MissingCurrentUniverseFiles.Count - 200} more");
        }

        if (result.OrphanCurrentTimeframeFiles.Count > 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine("ORPHAN / OLD SELECTED-TF FILES NOT IN CURRENT REQUEST UNIVERSE");
            sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
            foreach (string file in result.OrphanCurrentTimeframeFiles.Take(200))
                sb.AppendLine(file);
            if (result.OrphanCurrentTimeframeFiles.Count > 200)
                sb.AppendLine($"... plus {result.OrphanCurrentTimeframeFiles.Count - 200} more");
        }

        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("SAFETY STATE");
        sb.AppendLine("------------------------------------------------------------");
        sb.AppendLine($"This button true-incrementally updates local Binance USD-M futures candle CSV files only for {timeframeLabel}.");
        sb.AppendLine("No exchange orders are sent. No live trading is implemented.");
        sb.AppendLine("============================================================");
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private void WriteReport(Top200CandleUpdateResult result)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DataPaths.Reports);
        string stamp = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string tfSafe = SanitizeFileToken(TimeframeLabel(result.Timeframes));
        string modeSafe = SanitizeFileToken(result.UpdateMode);
        string txtPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, $"BINANCE_CANDLE_UPDATE_{modeSafe}_{tfSafe}_{stamp}.txt");
        string csvPath = Path.Combine(DataPaths.Reports, $"BINANCE_CANDLE_UPDATE_{modeSafe}_{tfSafe}_{stamp}.csv");

        result.ReportPath = txtPath;
        result.CsvPath = csvPath;

        File.WriteAllText(txtPath, BuildReport(result), Encoding.UTF8);
        File.WriteAllText(csvPath, BuildCsv(result), Encoding.UTF8);
    }


    private static string FormatUtc(DateTime? utc)
        => utc.HasValue ? FormatUtc(utc.Value) : string.Empty;

    private static string FormatUtc(DateTime utc)
        => DateTime.SpecifyKind(utc, DateTimeKind.Utc).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

    private static string FormatUtcShort(DateTime? utc)
        => utc.HasValue ? DateTime.SpecifyKind(utc.Value, DateTimeKind.Utc).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "N/A";

    private static string FormatLocalFromUtc(DateTime? utc)
        => utc.HasValue ? FormatLocalFromUtc(utc.Value) : string.Empty;

    private static string FormatLocalFromUtc(DateTime utc)
        => DateTime.SpecifyKind(utc, DateTimeKind.Utc).ToLocalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

    private static string FormatLocalShortFromUtc(DateTime? utc)
        => utc.HasValue ? DateTime.SpecifyKind(utc.Value, DateTimeKind.Utc).ToLocalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "N/A";

    private static string LocalZoneLabel()
    {
        try
        {
            return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(TimeZoneInfo.Local.StandardName)
                ? TimeZoneInfo.Local.Id
                : TimeZoneInfo.Local.StandardName;
        }
        catch
        {
            return "Local PC Time";
        }
    }

    private static string BuildCsv(Top200CandleUpdateResult result)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("Symbol,Timeframe,Success,Status,LagBefore,LagAfter,DownloadedCandles,DownloadBatches,LocalCandlesBefore,LocalCandlesAfter,LatestBeforeUtc,LatestBeforeLocal,LatestAfterUtc,LatestAfterLocal,CandlePath,Message,Warnings");

        foreach (Top200CandleUpdateMarketResult m in result.Markets)
        {
            sb.AppendLine(string.Join(",",
                Csv(m.Symbol),
                Csv(m.Timeframe),
                m.Success ? "true" : "false",
                Csv(m.Status),
                m.LagBefore.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.LagAfter.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.DownloadedCandles.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.DownloadBatches.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.LocalCandlesBefore.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                m.LocalCandlesAfter.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                Csv(FormatUtc(m.LocalLatestBeforeUtc)),
                Csv(FormatLocalFromUtc(m.LocalLatestBeforeUtc)),
                Csv(FormatUtc(m.LocalLatestAfterUtc)),
                Csv(FormatLocalFromUtc(m.LocalLatestAfterUtc)),
                Csv(m.CandlePath),
                Csv(m.Message),
                Csv(m.WarningText)));
        }

        return sb.ToString();
    }


    private static int ResolveSeedLookbackCandles(string timeframe)
    {
        return timeframe.Trim().ToLowerInvariant() switch
        {
            // Keep the same calendar-depth idea across TFs.
            // Old fixed 3,000 count made 15m only ~31 days, while 1h was ~125 days.
            // These values cover roughly five years for 1h, and deep history for other scanner timeframes.
            "15m" => 60000,
            "1h" => 43800,
            "4h" => 4000,
            "1d" => 750,
            _ => DefaultSeedLookbackCandles
        };
    }

    private static int TimeframeSortKey(string tf)
    {
        return tf.ToLowerInvariant() switch
        {
            "15m" => 0,
            "1h" => 1,
            "4h" => 2,
            "1d" => 3,
            _ => 99
        };
    }

    private static string TimeframeLabel(IReadOnlyList<string> timeframes)
    {
        if (timeframes.Count == 0)
            return "NO_TF";

        return string.Join("_", timeframes.OrderBy(TimeframeSortKey));
    }

    private static string SanitizeFileToken(string value)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        foreach (char c in value)
        {
            if (char.IsLetterOrDigit(c))
                sb.Append(char.ToUpperInvariant(c));
            else
                sb.Append('_');
        }

        return sb.ToString().Trim('_');
    }

    private static string Trunc(string value, int max)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) || value.Length <= max)
            return value ?? string.Empty;

        return value[..Math.Max(0, max - 3)] + "...";
    }

    private static string Csv(string value)
    {
        value ??= string.Empty;
        string escaped = value.Replace("\"", "\"\"");
        return $"\"{escaped}\"";
    }
}

- Therefore the safest institutional upgrade path is to apply risk budgeting at the portfolio/backtest layer first.

CURRENT RISK BUDGET ENGINE
--------------------------
PortfolioRiskBudgetEngine now decides how much to trust each selected market opportunity.

Current dimensions:
- ATR sizing
- regime multiplier
- 4h preference bonus
- per-symbol cap
- per-cluster cap
- total portfolio risk cap
- drawdown-based throttling
- hard position value cap

Purpose:
- reduce concentration blowups
- smooth fold dispersion
- lower over-allocation to unstable markets
- improve realism before deeper TradingEngine surgery
